title: Graphic Designer- Pursuits
description:
About the opportunity

Do you love turning complex ideas into clear, compelling visuals that help win work?

At SWCA, the Pursuit Graphic Designer plays a key role in transforming complex information into compelling visual communications that make our proposals and client presentations easier to understand, more compelling, and make a memorable impact. Working across pursuits in water resources and energy and infrastructure to habitat restoration and cultural resources, you'll use your creative expertise to help clients quickly understand our approach, trust our expertise, and recognize why SWCA is the right partner for their project.

This role is for a designer who sees visual storytelling as a strategic part of the pursuit process. You’ll work closely with a national team of proposal professionals, technical experts and client-focused leaders to understand what matters most to the client, identify the story we need to tell, and translate complex ideas into persuasive visual communications.

Your work may include infographics, data visualizations, proposal layouts, organizational graphics, process diagrams, maps, interview client presentations, or interactive marketing materials. Whether you’re simplifying a complicated technical approach, highlighting the experience of a project team, or helping bring a win strategy to life, your design work will help make our proposals easier to understand, more memorable, and more competitive.

The role is a full-time position reporting to the Creative Services Manager. We offer flexibility to work remotely, in a hybrid capacity, or from an SWCA office. Candidates residing in the Midwest region are preferred, though qualified applicants from other locations will be considered.

A cover letter and portfolio showcasing your design experience in various media must accompany your resume. We're specifically looking for examples of content-rich design work that demonstrate strong layout, infographics, presentations, data visualizations or other technical communications. We will not consider applications without these materials.

Application Deadline: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews may be scheduled as qualified candidates are identified. This position may close without prior notice once a strong candidate pool is established.

What you will accomplish

• Leads design processes or projects from conception to completion. This includes spearheading marketing campaigns, brand-building events, and multimedia projects, ensuring that each project aligns with strategic objectives and is delivered on time.

• Analyzes and interprets both internal and external business challenges, offering creative solutions and best practices to enhance efficiency and achieve company goals. Uses technical expertise in graphic design and multimedia to offer innovative solutions.

• Exhibits a strong technical proficiency in graphic design and multimedia that is grounded in a thorough understanding of fundamental theories, practices, and concepts. Applies this expertise to create compelling visual content that supports marketing objectives.

• Contributes to strategy development by leveraging past experiences and market research. Works collaboratively with leadership to guide decision making within the graphic design and multimedia domain, ensuring that creative strategies effectively support broader marketing goals.

• Coordinates and manages project schedules to ensure the timely completion of tasks. Oversees project team efforts, ensuring that all members are effectively contributing to project milestones and deliverables.

• Implements rigorous quality control measures to verify the accuracy and completeness of all creative materials. Reviews and edits marketing and proposal graphics for clarity, coherence, and compliance with requirements, maintaining high standards of quality across all outputs.

• Follows applicable federal, Tribal, state, local, industry, contractual, and company regulations, standards, and specifications.

• Performs related work as assigned.

Additional Job-Specific Responsibilities:

• Design & prepare proposal, presentation, and pursuit-related visual materials that strengthen messaging and support business development efforts.

• Create graphics, infographics, maps, diagrams, data visualizations, and other visual assets that simplify complex information and communicate SWCA's value.

• Partner with proposal, marketing, business development, and technical teams to develop strategic visual solutions that enhance competitiveness and support win strategies.

• Maintain and evolve SWCA's library of proposal graphics, templates, and visual assets while ensuring brand consistency across client-facing materials.

• Embrace SWCA's core value of Always Learning by exploring innovative approaches to visual storytelling and continuously improving how the firm communicates its expertise, solutions, and value to clients.

Experience and qualifications for success

• Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, or related field.

• Three (3) years of graphic design experience, preferably with at least two years of experience designing proposals, qualifications packages, presentations, or other business development materials in an in-house corporate creative department or design firm with the ability to effectively manage multiple projects.

• Ability to collaborate with pursuit teams and technical experts to solve complex communication challenges.

• Experience designing and producing large, complex document layouts.

• Strong understanding of design principles, typography, color, imagery and layout.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop on a Windows-based platform.

• Demonstrated experience designing and managing long-form documents in InDesign.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint, including advanced presentation design.

• Familiarity with print production and digital publishing environments

Preferred Qualifications:

• Five (5) years of graphic design experience.

• Experience/background working in the environmental consulting industry or other science field

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

• Ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling visual communications.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with pursuit teams, marketing professionals, and technical subject matter experts to create persuasive visual storytelling solutions.

• Excellent creative thinking, organization, problem-solving, and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (PE Required)
description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Issued for Construction (IFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.

Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

•
Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

•
Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

•
P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

•
Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

•
Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

•
Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

•
Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

•
Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

•
Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

•
Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

•
Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

•
Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

•
Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

•
Proven experience delivering complete substation design packages from conceptual to IFC, covering both physical and P&C design, at voltages from 34.5 kV to 345 kV or higher.

•
Experience with both greenfield substations and brownfield modifications to existing, energized facilities.

•
Working knowledge of NESC, NFPA, IEEE and utility/transmission owner design standards, and of how NERC requirements apply to substation design.

•
Solid understanding of protection philosophy and protective relays (SEL, GE, Siemens or similar), plus substation communications, SCADA/RTU and revenue metering.

•
Experience with AutoCAD and grounding analysis software (CDEGS, WinIGS or similar).

• Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with clients and contractors.

• Occasional travel to project sites for walkdowns, filed verification and construction support.

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

How we support you:

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you

• Generous PTO and paid holidays

• MyShare Employee Ownership Program

• Work with industry leaders

• 401K, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

Location: This position will be remote US

Travel: Occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

EPE is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. The EEO is the Law poster, and its supplement are available using the following links: EEOC is the Law Poster

Third-Party Recruiting Notification

EPE does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited third-party resumes forwarded by recruiters to EPE via our career page or to any of our managers or employees will be considered public information, may be treated as a direct application from the person identified in the resume, and will not be eligible for placement fee payment to the agency. EPE will not pay a fee to a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed third-party agreement and has not coordinated their recruiting activity with the appropriate member of the Talent Acquisition team.

title: Web Designer
description:
JOIN THE TEAM BUILDING AN AI-FIRST COMPANY.

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles https://www.hostinger.com/principles




YOUR ROLE AT HOSTINGER

The website is where most customers first meet Hostinger, and where they decide whether to stay. As Web Designer you'll own the end-to-end experience of our web pages and purchase flows: how people discover products, understand what we offer, and move from curiosity to conversion. It's work that mixes storytelling with real commercial impact, where small design decisions move real numbers.
AI is changing this space too, from faster experimentation to smarter personalisation of what visitors see. You'll be designing those experiences, not just reacting to them.




YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

 - Own the design of website and landing page experiences seen by millions of visitors.

 - Craft conversion-focused flows that feel clear and trustworthy.

 - Work closely with marketers, PMs, and engineers in a cross-functional team, from concepts through to shipped pages.

 - Use AI tools to move faster: prototype more ideas, test more hypotheses, and generate variants at scale.

 - Iterate based on data: monitor performance after launch, run A/B tests, and keep improving.

 - Run and synthesise user research and usability testing to understand what makes visitors hesitate and why.

 - Be autonomous and initiative: pitch your ideas, take ownership to improve working processes and outcomes, innovate on brand display.

 - You use AI tools in your daily workflow: whether that's speeding up exploration, generating variants, or synthesising research faster.

 - Comfortable with HTML/CSS basics, enough to prototype in browser and collaborate with engineers.

 - Strong communication skills: you can present decisions, take feedback, and push back when needed.

 - Familiar with analytics and testing tools (Amplitude, Hotjar, or similar).

 - A portfolio showing real work: process, thinking, and outcomes, not just polished screens.
   
   


BENEFITS YOU'LL LOVE

People give each other open feedback https://www.hostinger.com/blog/reaching-your-peak/, share what they know https://www.hostinger.com/blog/learning-culture/, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace https://www.headspace.com/ subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at Summerfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CPnIDaaq0jc & Winterfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AfytsnQyE2I, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.



Compensation starts from €3,500 EUR/month, depending on your experience and skills.



We're always looking for experienced talent to raise the bar. If you're excited about the role but the listed compensation range doesn't align with your expectations, we still encourage you to apply — we're open to adjusting it based on the impact and value you bring.

 

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

The opportunity

You'll design the tools that get groceries onto millions of doorsteps: not what shoppers see, but the systems used by people working in logistics operations at our fulfillment centers.

Oda’s mission is to build the world’s most efficient retail system, so people have space for life. A huge part of that is our sophisticated fulfillment and delivery system, designed and built entirely by us. It packs and delivers nearly half a million items every day to around 80.000 homes and businesses across Norway and Sweden.

What we’ve built is second-to-none in the world when it comes to efficiency, and it’s held together by internal tools and processes that make the jobs of operators and drivers easy, fast, ergonomic, and smooth. That's where you come in.

You'll work in close collaboration with our colleagues in both Norway and at our sister company Mathem in Stockholm, and you’ll help us on the path to launching Oda Systems in new markets as we find customers who want to work with us to bring the most efficient solution for online groceries to more parts of the world.

The role

Service/UX designers play a major part in the design of our processes and tooling. Great processes are as much about ergonomics, workflow, physical space, team structures, and incentives as they are about screens. You’ll get the chance to not only work on software solutions but also consider how digital experiences should best interact with hardware/machinery, the physical space they’re situated in, and last but not least the operator routines around them. That combination is what makes logistics design at Oda different from most UX roles: you're never just designing a screen, you're designing a multi-dimensional workflow.

You’ll join the Delivery team within Oda’s Logistics platform, which is responsible for everything that happens out on the road. You’ll design the best possible experience for employees working with everything from capacity and route planning to traffic coordination, delivering groceries to customers, and leaders following up drivers and operations. While we’re happy with today’s processes, we’re not satisfied: there is a ton to be done to make things more efficient, more automated, and smarter, so that we have even better control over capacity, drivers have a better workday, and customers get their food on time and in full.

You'll work embedded in a cross-functional team, closely collaborating with other disciplines – Product Management, Engineering, Data and Insight, and Logistics development. This is a hands-on, office-based role. You'll be at our Fulfillment Center in Lier regularly, and at our Tøyen office most of the week (most of the team is at Tøyen at least 3 days a week). You’ll use AI actively in your processes, and contribute to driving agentic UX forwards.

What you'll do in Oda

•
Lead big projects from start to finish: own them from the initial idea through concept, design, prototyping, implementation, testing, and follow-up after launch, working closely with your product team, as well as stakeholders in Logistics. You should feel comfortable putting on the PM hat and driving projects.

•
Conduct UX research and data analysis: observe what’s going on in operations, run workshops with your team and stakeholders, look at the data, gather feedback in operations.

•
Communicate and present your work to peers as well as stakeholders, showing your process, and the impact of your designs.

•
Map and model complex, systemic workflows.

•
Design user interfaces and build prototypes. You don’t have to be a pixel perfectionist, but you will draw screens. Prototype in Figma, or directly in code – whatever’s the fastest way to test an idea, with room to ship and test changes in production alongside developers.

•
Work closely with teammates and stakeholders all the way from ideation to roll-out, rather than handing off at the end of a solo-design process.

•
Contribute to setting the direction of the Delivery team, which determines its own projects based on company strategy

•
Work with other designers to spar, give feedback, and build a stronger design community across Oda.

What we're looking for 🌟

•
At least 8 years of experience in UX, interaction, or service design, in-house or agency, with a portfolio showing full ownership from insight to shipped product

•
A full-stack design attitude: insight, concept, structure, and visual design, without waiting for handovers. Being open to being hands-on both on the warehouse floor and in our codebase.

•
Very solid fundamentals in product sense and design: demonstrated insight-centric process, root cause analysis, work framed in desired outcomes, ability to distill complexity.

•
Speed over perfection: You understand the importance of shipping fast, learning, and iterating over polishing a "perfect" blueprint. You leverage the advantage we have with having short feedback loops with our end-users.

•
A track record of driving process change: not just shipping a solution, but bringing the operators who'll use it along with you.

•
You already use AI as part of your own design process: you're genuinely interested in an AI-enhanced product development workflow, not just AI features bolted onto Figma.

•
Fluent English. Intermediate Norwegian or Swedish is a strong plus, since you'll be working directly with traffic coordinators, drivers, and leaders on-site.

•
Previous logistics experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer 🚀

•
A flexible schedule built around a healthy work-life balance.

•
Modern, empowered product teams: democratized data access, good tools, a sustainable pace. We ship, and you will immediately see the impact of your work.

•
A team that's actively working AI into both design and development, not just talking about it, and genuinely open to designers who want to prototype or write code.

•
A design community across all Oda teams: UX design, Service design, Digital design, UX research, Content design, and Graphic design.

•
A culture that values kindness, transparency, and taking action over process for its own sake.

•
A modern office at Tøyen with an amazing subsidized canteen by Naked Lunch, bike parking, and a great rooftop terrace.

You'll be working with people who are ambitious about logistics in a way most designers never get to be. Come build the future with us!

title: Senior Designer - 12 month FTC
description:
Universal Design Studio (part of AKQA and WPP) is an architecture and interiors practice based in London and New York, dedicated to creating spaces that inspire and endure. Founded in 2001 by Edward Barber and Jay Osgerby, the studio has built an international reputation for delivering thoughtful, finely crafted environments grounded in design-led strategy and research.

We design from the inside out, crafting spaces that elevate everyday experiences. Through the ideas, objects, and spaces we create, we seek to cultivate intelligence, find beauty, and drive transformation, all while deepening connections, inspiring participation, and unlocking creative potential in every interaction. We are looking for a talented Senior Designer to join Universal Design Studio in London on a fixed term contract. Reporting to the Senior Creative Team, you will take responsibility for leading projects day-to-day, ensuring the highest standards of creative and technical delivery while inspiring and motivating your team.

As a Senior Designer, you will play a key client-facing role, guiding projects from concept through to completion. You will balance strong conceptual thinking with technical rigour, ensuring accuracy and quality throughout. This is an exciting opportunity for a confident, proactive designer to take on greater responsibility, leading teams and shaping design outcomes across a range of projects.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the day-to-day design and delivery of small to medium-sized projects.

• Implement creative direction in collaboration with the Senior Creative Team.

• Manage and support Designers, Design Assistants, and Interns.

• Oversee design intent and technical drawing packages, ensuring quality and deadlines are met.

• Represent Universal in client and site meetings, resolving issues while protecting design intent.

• Build strong client relationships and present design concepts with clarity.

• Contribute to recruitment, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing across the studio.

Essential Skills & Experience

• Proven experience leading project teams in architecture, interiors, or spatial design.

• Strong conceptual design skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Confident communicator, able to present ideas and solutions clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Solid understanding of RIBA stages, technical detailing, and construction processes.

• Positive, proactive, and collaborative approach to leadership.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: Senior UX Researcher (d/f/m)
description:
Senior UX Researcher (d/f/m)

Berlin, Hamburg, Hybrid

JOB PURPOSE

As a User Researcher, you help product teams make confident, customer-centered decisions by uncovering real user needs, motivations, behaviors and opportunities. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on research to explore problem spaces, test hypotheses and turn insights into action.

In this role, you’ll work at the core of one of our key client teams, shaping how research contributes to the development of digital products and services. From exploring the adoption of AI technologies to enabling journey-driven product thinking – you’ll bring clarity to complexity and structure to uncertainty.

You’ll design and conduct studies, synthesize results, and make insights accessible and actionable for product managers, designers and other stakeholders. But you’ll also help evolve the research practice itself by refining methods, improving tooling and championing user needs across the team. And you’ll do it all in a dynamic environment with some of the most talented (and fun) people the industry has to offer.

WHAT YOU´LL DO

• Plan and conduct user research – from exploratory discovery work to usability tests and concept validations

• Frame research questions and help teams explore problem spaces before jumping into solutions

• Analyse results, document insights, and share them in ways that support product and design decisions

• Work closely with designers, product managers and developers in a cross-functional team environment

• Support the development of research standards and ways of working that scale across teams and topics

• Bring inspiration and structure to the research process, through methods, tools and best practices

• Advocate for a journey-driven, evidence-based approach to product development

• Stay curious: continuously evolve your methods and contribute to the research culture across the team

WHAT YOU BRING

• Several years of experience in user research, ideally at an agency and in agile, product-focused environments

• Strong skills in running and analysing studies – from usability tests to interviews and concept validations

• A talent for making research results easy to understand and act on for designers, product managers and stakeholders

• You stay up to date with emerging tools, methods and technologies and enjoy bringing fresh perspectives into the team

• Familiarity with journey mapping and experience frameworks and a drive to make them part of real product work

• Confidence in facilitating sessions, speaking with users and contributing to product strategy

• A proactive mindset: you bring structure, keep pushing your practice forward, and enjoy working hands-on

• You’re fluent in German and comfortable working in English

WE OFFER

• Flexible, hybrid working policy (1-2 days at the office, depending on location);

• Company pension scheme.

• Lease bike options / JobRad and 25% subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.

• Occasional breakfast/lunch at the office, Smoothie Tuesdays.

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform;

• €50 personal monthly allowance via our dedicated benefits apps for use across daily expenses and lifestyle perks.

• Future Bens - Exclusive access to sustainable, healthy products at attractive deals.

• Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: Art Director
description:
About the Role

Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else misses. We need someone to make it look like the future it is.

We're looking for an Art Director who is first and foremost an artist. This is not a creative production role. You will own Abnormal's aesthetic direction, a singular visual identity with a bold and cinematic sensibility, and communicate that vision clearly to every team, vendor, and collaborator who executes creative work. You'll work closely with our CEO, CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and VP of Revenue Marketing to internalize Abnormal's worldview, then make it your own, ideally pushing it further than we imagined.

This role is distinct from our creative services function, which runs the production engine. Your job is to set the vision, protect its integrity, and elevate it. At Abnormal, you'll do the most exciting work of your career because you'll be shaping how the future of cybersecurity is seen, in a company where AI is at the core of the product and the way we work.

The ideal candidate is a concept artist at heart, someone who has spent their career in sci-fi film, cyberpunk or sci-fi video games, or similarly high-craft visual storytelling environments. Specifically, we want someone who knows how to design computer interfaces, holograms, and imagined future worlds, with the kind of detail that maps to a visionary technology company and its products: the in-world UI of a sci-fi game or film, the readout on a futuristic digital weapon, the menu architecture of a spacecraft. Not characters. Not atmospheric environments. Designed systems and objects with detail and intention. You see and express vision. You don't just execute.

What You Will Do

• Define and own Abnormal's visual aesthetic direction

• Lead visual ideation for high-stakes moments: major product launches, experiential events (RSA, Black Hat), and brand campaigns

• Contribute hands-on concept work when the moment demands it. This is a vision-first role, but your craft should be evident

• Build a shared creative language across the org so the aesthetic direction scales without bottlenecking through you

• Serve as the creative authority and taste-setter for all visual output, from brand identity to campaigns to experiential environments

• Translate the CEO's and leadership's vision into a clear, communicable aesthetic that others can execute without needing you in every room

• Partner with creative services to keep production output style-consistent, setting guardrails and reviewing work rather than running the factory

• Develop mood boards, concept art, and visual references that define "in the zone" creative for recruiter screening, vendor briefs, and internal alignment

Must Haves

• 10+ years of experience in concept art, visual design, or art direction, with a body of work that shows artistic progression and a distinct point of view

• Shipped credits on AAA game titles, major film productions, or equivalent high-craft visual projects in sci-fi, cyberpunk, or adjacent genres, with work focused on interface design, in-world UI/UX, holographic displays, or designed objects (virtual weapons, vehicles, technology systems) rather than characters, creatures, or natural environments

• A portfolio that demonstrates genuine aesthetic vision, not just execution. Your work should show world-building expressed through designed objects and systems: architecture, vehicles, digital weapons, futuristic technology, UI. Detailed, intentional, engineered creative work. Painterly or landscape-driven portfolios are not the profile we're hiring

• Experience as the sole or lead visual voice on at least one significant project: not just a contributor, but the person who owned the aesthetic direction end to end

• Ability to articulate and document a visual language clearly enough that others can execute it without you present

• Experience collaborating directly with senior leadership or creative directors and translating their vision into something tangible

• Craft fluency across visual mediums: digital, environmental, editorial, motion

• Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in a fast-moving tech company. You operate with autonomy, take feedback, and collaborate cross-functionally. You want to stay close to the work, and you're here to bring the vision, not manage a team

• Strong communication and presentation skills. You can defend and sell a creative direction with clarity and confidence

Nice to Haves

• Experience in B2B tech, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, or a demonstrated ability to quickly internalize a technical domain and translate it visually

• Familiarity with experiential or event design (large-format, spatial, environmental)

• Experience working alongside or managing a creative production team

• Comfort with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools

title: Researcher
description:
JOIN THE TEAM BUILDING AN AI-FIRST COMPANY.

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles https://www.hostinger.com/principles.

 


YOUR ROLE AT HOSTINGER

Join Hostinger's Public Relations team as a Researcher! In this role, you’ll turn data from millions of websites and businesses into stories that make headlines. From first idea to final insight, you’ll own research projects that uncover trends in AI, ecommerce, and the small business economy. Working closely with PR Managers, you’ll give journalists around the world the data behind their stories, and help build a research hub that becomes a go-to source of credible insights.



Curious to learn more? Connect with your team: Elena B. https://www.linkedin.com/in/elena-babarskaite/

 
 


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

 - Own research projects end to end, turning Hostinger’s product and customer data into newsworthy studies.

 - Spot trends and research opportunities across AI, small businesses, ecommerce, domains, website creation, and wider tech, including timely angles on trending news.

 - Support colleagues with media requests by quickly pulling data and suggesting angles from internal or external figures.

 - Design surveys and brief external panel providers where needed.

 - Analyse large datasets, find meaningful patterns, and turn them into clear stories and visuals for media and wider audiences.

 - Make sure every study is sound, with the right sample sizes, reliable data, and credible findings.

 - Work with PR Managers and external agencies to develop research angles, support media pitches, and provide data-backed insights for international markets.

 - Work with Product, Data, and other teams to audit internal data and set up a standard data request process.

 - Build and maintain a research hub, an online catalogue of repeatable studies that builds credibility and visibility over time.

 - Use AI tools to collect, clean, and categorise data, and explore AI-powered workflows to make research faster and more consistent.




WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED

 - 3+ years of experience in research, data analysis, insights, or a related field, ideally within PR, data journalism, media, technology, social sciences or other research-driven organization.

 - A portfolio of research reports, studies, or content that turned complex data into stories for wider audiences, with a strong sense of what makes findings newsworthy.

 - Strong quantitative research skills, including statistical analysis, data interpretation, survey design, research methodology, and evaluating data reliability.

 - Hands-on experience analysing large datasets with tools such as Excel or Google Sheets, SQL, SPSS, or similar. Experience with Python, R, Amplitude, or BigQuery is a plus.

 - Experience collaborating with communications teams, journalists, or PR agencies to translate research into media coverage.

 - An eye for visual storytelling, with experience creating charts and dashboards in tools such as Tableau or Looker Studio, and briefing designers on clear, compelling data visualisations for media and non-specialist audiences.

 - Hands-on experience using AI in research workflows, such as LLM-based categorisation of text data, AI-assisted coding, or automating repeatable analysis.

 - Ability to independently manage research projects, challenge assumptions, and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

 - A curious, creative mindset and a genuine interest in AI, technology, and digital trends.

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.




BENEFITS YOU'LL LOVE

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge https://www.reforge.com/ and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. Depending on your location, you can mentor or be mentored through TesoXchange https://tesoxchange.com/. People give each other open feedback https://www.hostinger.com/blog/reaching-your-peak/, share what they know https://www.hostinger.com/blog/learning-culture/, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace https://www.headspace.com/ subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at Summerfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CPnIDaaq0jc & Winterfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AfytsnQyE2I, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.




Compensation starts at €3,800 gross/month, depending on your experience and skills.

 

We’re always looking for experienced talent to raise the bar. If you’re excited about the role but the listed salary range doesn’t align with your expectations, we still encourage you to apply - we’re open to adjusting compensation based on the impact and value you bring.

 

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

 

Three. Two. Onboard

title: Systems Designer (Live Ops & Economy) - 6 Month FTC/Freelance, Electric Square

With our diverse portfolio, which includes acclaimed titles such as Tomb Raiders: Legacy of Atlantis, Diablo 4, Lords of the Fallen, Battlefield 2042, and several other exciting AAA console games currently in progress, we strive to deliver unforgettable gaming experiences.

We foster a unique studio culture that empowers and inspires our teams, ensuring that everyone feels motivated to bring their best ideas to life.

We can offer you an award-winning working environment. At Electric Square, we don't just accept difference, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Electric Square is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We are looking for a Systems Designer (Live Ops & Economy) to manage the operation and balance of our live game. In this role, you will oversee the virtual economy, plan regular content updates, and design new features and live events that drive player retention and revenue. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, art, design, and product, to keep the player experience fresh and hit key commercial goals.

• Owns the design, tuning, and rollout of live events, new content, and Live Ops mechanics.

• Partners with programmers, artists, product managers, and QA to ship live updates on time and at a high level of quality.

• Will Triage design issues quickly during production to protect release schedules and feature quality.

• Collaborate with engineering and fellow designers to build and refine internal tools that streamline live content delivery.

• Analyses' live telemetry and player data alongside analysts to evaluate feature performance and optimize game balance.

• Strong knowledge of the mobile games market, backed by a broad personal background playing games across mobile, PC, console, and tabletop formats.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills, capable of breaking down complex systems for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Pragmatic problem-solving mindset, comfortable finding creative solutions within technical and production constraints.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight live-service deadlines.

• Collaborative and adaptable approach, suited to an evolving production environment.

• Hands-on experience specializing in game economy modelling and systems architecture.

• Strong mathematical and spreadsheet modelling skills.

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Role overview 🌟

Alan has passed 1M members, works with 40K+ companies and operates in seven countries. New products and a flagship international event are coming, and the Brand team is investing in bigger campaigns. So far brand spend has gone mostly to broad awareness. We now need targeted B2B campaigns for specific verticals (for example TNS, retirees, very small company owners), run alongside the broad campaigns to reinforce them.

You'll own these vertical B2B brand campaigns for France, plus a portfolio of other brand projects. You'll work closely with the Brand Lead, Product Marketing, Growth, segment owners and Sales. This is an individual-contributor role at C1-D level.

What you'll do

•
Vertical campaigns: Define the audience, message, proof points and channels for each priority vertical. Choose priorities and objectives with segment owners, Growth and Product Marketing. Run each campaign from brief to post-mortem, and build reusable toolkits (messaging, assets, case studies) for other teams.

•
Product and offer launches: Support the launch of new product features (e.g. Mo, Alan Précision) and new offers (e.g. Alan retirees) in France. Work in strong collaboration with the Product teams to build a creative, impactful go-to-market that stands out in the market. Turn product positioning into launch plans and assets.

Serving as a vital link between hardware development and software execution, you will assemble and refine our aerial platforms, design mechanical and electrical solutions, and build critical testing environments.

• Drone Assembly & Prototyping: Work closely alongside hardware engineers to assemble, wire, configure, and maintain C-UAS drone platforms.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

• Academic Background: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.

• Engineering Fundamentals: Solid foundation in mechanical/electrical engineering principles and eager to learn CAD/design software.

• Availability & Mindset: Pragmatic troubleshooting mindset, available up to 20 hours/week during semesters, and willingness to support local field testing.

NICE TO HAVE

• Prior UAV / Robotics Experience: Building, maintaining, or piloting drones (FPV, multirotor, fixed-wing).

• Flight Control & Autopilot: Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight, or ground control stations like QGroundControl.

Effective as one team.

title: Product Designer
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a passionate product design generalist to join our Product Design team, which owns the experience for our robust platform of code quality and security products. You will belong to one of our product areas, where you’ll help ensure that our developer and agent users write better code and have a seamless experience in the product.

You will work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help development teams write better and more secure code. You will also collaborate with other designers and researchers across the organization, ensuring consistency and contributing to best practices.

What you will do

Research and map complex user workflows to ensure our solutions are intuitive and highly functional.

Integrate AI into every stage of your design workflow, leveraging it to accelerate research synthesis, automate repetitive tasks, and explore high-fidelity prototypes more efficiently.

•

Listen to our users and customers to understand their needs. Develop a deep understanding of the SDLC and how we can enable developers and AI agents to produce better quality software.

•

Work closely with other product designers to ensure a cohesive information architecture and a unified experience across the entire product platform.

•

Align with your product manager on problem definition, providing design solutions throughout the end-to-end development stage.

•

Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to vet technical feasibility and uncover edge cases.

•

Help the Product Design team grow by contributing to our design processes, tools, and collaborative frameworks.

Experience and qualifications

•

Experience organizing data-heavy environments into logical structures and mapping user journeys that minimize friction.

•

Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation and design velocity.

A self-starter mindset with the drive to identify UX gaps and propose structural improvements without being prompted.

Ability to articulate design decisions and the "why" behind them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfort working in a cross-functional environment where feedback is shared openly and success is a team effort.

Delivery mindset. Your role does not end when the design is handed off.

title: Senior Product Designer, Merchant
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own and execute all user experience and design-related aspects of the Incentives domain within the Merchants team. This includes all products related to campaigns, discounts, ads, and promotional mechanics across the Merchants experience.

Bolt's incentives experience spans three surfaces: the merchants who configure campaigns, the Bolt teams who run platform-wide incentives and subscriptions, and the consumers who encounter them. This role owns the merchant side of that system, working alongside other designers covering the other surfaces.

You will play a key role in shaping how our partners discover, understand, and manage their ads and campaigns to promote and grow their business. Ready to build at scale and solve complex system challenges? Join us.

About us

With over 200 million users in 50+ countries, Bolt is one of the fastest-growing tech companies in Europe and Africa. And it's all thanks to our people.

We believe in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or ability.

Our ultimate goal is to make cities for people, not cars. And we need your help on this mission!

About the role

We’re looking for a skilled Senior Product Designer to take full ownership of the incentives experience across the Merchants domain. Your main objective will be to help evolve and optimise the flows and merchants-facing mechanics for ads and campaigns management. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration.

Main tasks and responsibilities

•
Help evolve the Merchants platform to help increase business partners’ satisfaction and retention.

•
Turn complex campaign logic into simple, intuitive user experiences.

•
Collaborate closely with Incentives, Subscription, Stores, and Growth teams to align business goals with user needs.

•
Work with engineers and product managers to ensure feasibility and high-quality execution.

•
Prototype and test concepts quickly to validate ideas and reduce ambiguity.

•
Partner closely with the consumer incentives designers to ensure merchant-configured campaigns translate into clear, on-brand experiences across consumer surfaces.

About you

•
You understand business metrics behind campaigns and subscriptions, and are comfortable managing complex systems effectively.

•
You’re a collaborative, design-led thinker who speaks the language of product, leading discussions and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

•
You know when to prioritize fast iterations and prototypes, collaborating effectively with senior designers and cross-functional teams.

•
You can communicate fluently in English and confidently pitch your design vision through storytelling, backed by user research and strong design intuition.

•
You’re expert in Figma for UI, advanced prototyping, and scalable design systems. You actively use AI tools to speed up exploration and iteration.

•
You may ideally have worked on tools used by marketing and business operators.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. Even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying.

Why you’ll love it here

•
Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.

•
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.

•
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.

•
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.

•
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.

•
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.

*Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

title: Principal UX Designer
description:
Are you on a mission to create games that bond players together into deeply invested communities? Are you fascinated by IPs that blend genres in interesting ways and approach UXUI in potentially novel ways? Are you delighted by game interfaces that make it frictionless to play with friends? Do you spend time dissecting trends in game UX and interaction design?

As a Principal UX Designer on teamLFG, you will drive the UX/UI of an Unannounced Project from pre-production and beyond. From early technical planning and user flows to playtesting and tweaking the UI of the shipping game, you’ll use research, prototyping, and collaboration to turn gameplay ideas into user experiences that support both player needs and product goals. Most importantly, you will work with a fun, dedicated, cross-discipline team devoted to turning a creative dream into a new franchise at PlayStation.

We look for candidates who value joining a mission-focused team with a diverse set of backgrounds, experiences, interests, and viewpoints.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive, own and deliver holistic UX for new features and player experiences, ensuring cohesive and engaging player experiences, bridging the gap from design goals and features to exceptional user experiences

• Break down product needs and translate product strategy into successful, goals-driven features and player systems

• Be a key leader in the creation of comprehensive end-to-end systems -- encompassing information architecture, and interaction design -- communicating ideas through wireframes, flows, prototypes, and design documentation

• Collaborate across disciplines when designing features, ensuring UI effectively supports aspects such as core gameplay mechanics, social mechanics, monetization strategies, live events, and player progression systems

• Champion your UX designs across all areas and disciplines, including Studio Leadership reviews, to drive buy-in and alignment for the product

• Design from first principles, deeply understanding the game genre, analyzing competitive references, actively participating in playtesting sessions, and collaborating with UX Research to uncover player needs and motivations, and address usability concerns

• Identify and prioritize tackling down weak points in designs, gaps in thinking, and opportunities to better deliver on our goals by applying critical thinking and a sharp design eye to strengthen solutions

• Establish and uphold robust UX standards and best practices across the studio in coordination with your Lead and others in your discipline, encompassing design systems, pipelines, and component libraries to enhance development efficiency, consistency, and quality

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Exceptional skills of clearly communicating your ideas, achieved through various mediums, such as wireframes, flows, prototypes, and design documentation

• Exceptional ability to articulate design decisions and reasoning, provide constructive feedback, and work effectively with cross-disciplinary teams (game designers, artists, engineers, test, etc.)

• Ability to navigate ambiguity through proactive goal alignment, problem definitions, solution proposals, and moving work forward in uncharted territory

• Impeccable conceptual and problem-solving skills with a strong understanding of how complex game mechanics and business requirements can be visually and functionally transformed into an intuitive user interface

• Strong attention to detail, with a meticulous approach to design execution, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and adherence to established guidelines

• Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, layout principles, typography, color theory, and composition as applied to user interfaces

• Strong understanding of game development pipelines and technical constraints

• Embrace a "we" culture in addition to being an outstanding collaborator and communicator

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

• Experience with building across a variety of platforms (PC, Console)

• Experience with global gaming markets and the competitive gaming/esports landscape

• Experience with multiplayer genres

• Familiarity with development using Unreal Engine

• Experience with motion design principles and tools (e.g., After Effects) to create engaging UI animations and transitions

REQUIRED

• Portfolio required

Our pursuit of fresh ideas, techniques, and technologies is driven by the belief that together, through creativity and collaboration, we can accomplish anything. If you want to be part of an environment that empowers you to experiment, learn, and contribute to exciting projects, come and join us.

En tant qu’Artiste en Éclairage, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour donner vie à nos mondes animés. In this role, you will help shape the visual mood, atmosphere, and storytelling impact of a feature animation project by partnering closely with creative and technical teams and contributing to work that meets a high bar for artistic and production quality.

As a Lighting Artist, you will play an essential role in bringing our animated worlds to life. In this role, you will help shape the visual mood, atmosphere, and storytelling impact of a feature animation project by partnering closely with creative and technical teams and contributing to work on various marketing materials that meet a high standard of artistic and production quality.

Responsibilities
Ce que vous ferez :

• Créer et affiner les configurations d’éclairage pour les personnages, les accessoires et les environnements dans Blender, en veillant à ce que les plans respectent la vision artistique, le style visuel et les objectifs narratifs du projet.

What you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with other departments to optimize lighting and scenes for rendering, ensuring efficiency while maintaining visual quality and consistency across shots.

• Work closely with the CG Supervisor, Leads, and other departments to maintain continuity of lighting, shading, colour, and mood throughout the project.

• Identify and troubleshoot technical issues related to lighting, shading, and rendering in Blender, and implement creative solutions to overcome them.

• Work within established lighting templates, tools, and workflows, contributing to improvements where appropriate to enhance efficiency, consistency, and quality.

• Manage lighting and rendering tasks, including setting up appropriate render settings and passes, optimizing scenes, and ensuring efficient render times.

• Conduct rigorous quality-control checks to ensure that final shots meet the project's artistic and technical standards, with particular attention to the visual quality and consistency of the stylized look.

Requirements

Ce que vous apporterez :

• 3 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en tant qu’Artiste éclairage dans l’industrie de l’animation ou des effets visuels, avec une expérience en animation de longs métrages fortement souhaitée.

• Bonne maîtrise de Blender, particulièrement pour l’éclairage et le rendu dans un environnement de production ou sur des projets personnels, constitue un atout.

• Bonne compréhension des matériaux, du shading, des paramètres de rendu et de la relation entre l’éclairage et le look development, idéalement dans Blender.

• Familiarité avec les workflows de compositing et des logiciels tels que Nuke ou un équivalent.

• Expérience ou intérêt pour l’animation stylisée.

• Disponibilité pour commencer dès que possible dans le cadre d’un mandat de 8 semaines.

• Un reel d’éclairage démontrant un travail de qualité dans Blender constitue un atout.

What you’ll bring:

• Working proficiency in Blender, particularly lighting and rendering within a production environment or personal projects, is an asset.

• Experience working with established lighting templates, production pipelines, and workflows; experience with Blender-based pipelines is an asset.

• Strong understanding of colour theory, composition, cinematography, and lighting principles, with the ability to apply them to stylized animation.

• Strong understanding of materials, shading, render settings, and the relationship between lighting and look development, preferably in Blender.

• Familiarity with compositing workflows and software such as Nuke or equivalent.

• Experience or interest in stylized animation.

•
Availability to start as soon as possible for an 8-week engagement.

• A professional lighting reel demonstrating strong work in Blender is a bonus.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if…

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if…

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

•
Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

•
Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

•
Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

•
Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

•
Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

•
Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

•
Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

•
Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

•
Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

•
Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

•
4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

•
Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

•
Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

•
Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

•
Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

•
Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.

•
Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

•
Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting.

•
Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products.

•
Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components.

•
Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills.

•
Fluent English; German is a plus.

•
Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

•
Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability).

•
Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes.

•
Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials.

•
Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR.

•
Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge.

•
Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD.

Benefits

•
Equity + competitive salary.

•
Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition.

•
Hybrid work with flexible working times.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

About the Team

The UX Research team partners directly with Product and UX Design from early opportunity discovery and ideation through delivery. This role supports the Integrated Care portfolio, including products serving acute and payer markets and healthcare and financial workflows such as Prior Authorization and Concurrent Review. The team keeps product and design decisions moving with timely, actionable customer insights.

Position Summary:

The Senior UX Researcher drives strategic and tactical product decisions by planning and conducting research, usability studies, and mixed-method discovery. Working directly with Product and UX Design, this role identifies the right participants, recommends fit-for-purpose methodologies, recruits and conducts studies, synthesizes qualitative and quantitative findings, and translates insights into strategy and design recommendations. The Senior UX Researcher also provides project leadership and communicates research decisions and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partner with Product and UX Design at the beginning of projects, opportunities, and ideation to formulate discovery plans, identify the right customers and stakeholders to engage, and recommend appropriate research methodologies.

• Lead end-to-end research activities, including participant recruitment, discussion guide development, study facilitation, analysis, synthesis, and sharing findings. Methods may include surveys, in-depth interviews, remote feedback, usability testing, and prototype-based research when appropriate.

• Conduct user outreach, use-case discovery, persona and journey mapping, validation, and usability studies using unbiased and standardized research practices.

• Translate customer feedback and research data into actionable insights and strategy and design recommendations for Product, UX Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders.

• Lead or participate in workshops, communicate strategic research decisions to leadership, and provide project leadership to researchers and designers on assigned initiatives.

• Collaborate with internal subject matter experts, Customer Success, Data Science, and Customer Insights to strengthen understanding of personas, journeys, and use cases and encourage adoption of research best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience as a UX researcher or in a similar customer-focused research role.

• Bachelor’s degree in psychology, statistics, human-computer interaction, information systems, or a related field.

• Demonstrated ability to create research strategy and discovery plans, develop discussion guides, select methodologies, conduct interviews and studies, and quickly analyze and synthesize findings.

• Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, with the ability to translate real user feedback into insights that drive user-centered decisions for broad audiences.

• Experience with research and survey tools such as Dovetail, User Interviews, Salesforce, SurveyMonkey, Qualtrics, and analytics or product-experience platforms such as Pendo.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain strategic decisions, present findings, persuade, negotiate, and articulate alternative approaches.

• Ability to travel to customer sites on a limited basis, approximately four times per year.

• Experience using AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to enable day-to-day research work.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience researching healthcare, medical, regulated, payer, acute-care, or financial applications.

• Experience collaborating in Figma and Miro; this role contributes to prototype-based research but is not expected to create prototypes.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, UX Design, Engineering, Customer Success, Data Science, Customer Insights, and internal subject matter experts to advance user-centered outcomes.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

•
Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

•
Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.
