title: Senior Product Designer - Cards & Credit
description:
In 1954, architect Eero Saarinen designed a radically modern bank branch for Irwin Union in Columbus, Indiana. With glass walls, no private offices, and a floor plan that invited openness, it embodied a new kind of transparency in finance. The building was surrounded by trees, furnished by Herman Miller, and featured rustic brick flooring. Today, that space is a conference center, and that spirit of design-forward thinking in banking* feels all but extinct.

Mercury believes that level of care and craft in design has been lost in modern finance, and we’re building products that bring it back. Cards and credit are built on complicated systems and inherited conventions, but our customers shouldn’t have to experience that complexity. We believe thoughtful design can turn something traditionally transactional into an experience that feels simple, intuitive, and distinctly Mercury.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Cards & Credit team. You’ll tackle complex product problems, question inherited assumptions, and shape experiences that help startups spend less time banking and more time building.

In this role, you’ll:

• Own meaningful Cards & Credit product problems from initial framing through shipped experience, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to understand the problem and shape what we should build.

• Turn complicated systems, requirements, and edge cases into experiences that feel remarkably simple and intuitive.

• Work across the entire design stack, from framing problems and exploring concepts to workflows, detailed interactions, visual design, prototyping, and final implementation.

• Explore broadly and design from first principles, questioning inherited patterns and assumptions when a better answer may exist.

• Bring a high level of interaction and visual craft to the Cards & Credit experience, from the structure of a workflow to the details of hierarchy, typography, motion, and state.

• Collaborate with Mercury’s Brand team on physical cards and related products, creating a cohesive experience between the objects our customers hold and the product experiences surrounding them.

• Develop a deep understanding of our customers, communicate the reasoning behind your decisions clearly, and work through tradeoffs with your partners to arrive at the strongest solution.

What you’ll bring:

• A strong portfolio of product work demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.

• An ability to understand complicated systems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

• Deep curiosity about why a problem exists before deciding how to solve it, with a willingness to question assumptions and work from first principles.

• Real ambition for the work itself. You want to do the best work of your career here, and you’re energized by being surrounded by people who hold themselves to the same bar.

• A high bar for craft and the judgment to know where additional thought and detail meaningfully improve an experience.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for every requirement to be defined.

• A habit of exploring multiple possibilities, prototyping ideas, and changing direction when a stronger solution emerges.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate your thinking, explain tradeoffs, and build conviction with Product and Engineering partners.

• Deep care for customers and an ambition to create products that don’t just function well, but genuinely make their lives better.

You don’t need a background in banking, fintech, cards, or credit. We care much more about whether you’ve demonstrated the ability to understand complicated problems and turn them into simple, thoughtful product experiences.

Complexity can be learned. The instinct to find its essence is harder to teach.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Animator / Motion Graphics Designer to create engaging animations, motion graphics, and visual storytelling content for digital campaigns, paid ads, social media, training content, and branded experiences.

title: UX/Product Researcher
description:
Product Researcher

About Bask Health

Bask Health is building the infrastructure that powers modern telehealth businesses.
Our platform enables healthcare companies to launch, operate, and scale digital care experiences, from patient onboarding and clinical workflows to prescriptions, payments, subscriptions, fulfillment, and ongoing care.
We move quickly, work across complex healthcare problems, and believe deeply understanding our users is essential to building the right products.
We're looking for a Product Researcher to help us understand those users, uncover meaningful problems, and turn evidence into better product decisions.

About the Role

As a Product Researcher at Bask, your job is not simply to validate designs. You'll help us determine what we should build, why it matters, and whether what we shipped actually improved the experience.
You'll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other teams to identify important questions, investigate user behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear product opportunities.
Our users span multiple sides of the telehealth ecosystem, including healthcare businesses, operators, providers, and patients. You'll develop a deep understanding of how these groups work, where they struggle, and where Bask can create meaningful leverage.
We value researchers who are pragmatic, curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and focused on outcomes rather than research ceremony.

What You'll Do

• Partner with Product and Design to identify the highest-value questions to answer before solutions are defined.

• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research across customers, operators, providers, and patients to understand their needs, behaviors, motivations, and pain points.

• Build continuous relationships with users so research becomes an ongoing input into product development rather than something that happens only around individual projects.

• Combine user interviews, usability testing, surveys, product analytics, support feedback, customer conversations, and business context to develop a complete understanding of user behavior.

• Identify unmet needs, inefficient workflows, emerging behaviors, and opportunities that can influence Bask's product strategy and roadmap.

• Turn ambiguous research findings into clear insights, product opportunities, recommendations, and prioritization decisions.

• Challenge assumptions and help teams distinguish between what users ask for and the underlying problems they actually need solved.

• Design lightweight experiments and research approaches appropriate to the level of uncertainty. We value getting reliable answers quickly over unnecessary research ceremony.

• Work closely with designers throughout the product development process, from early concepts through prototypes and production experiences.

• Conduct usability testing and evaluate prototypes to identify friction before products are shipped.

• Evaluate shipped experiences to understand whether product changes actually improved user behavior and outcomes.

• Help identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve healthcare workflows while understanding where human judgment and control remain essential.

• Use AI-assisted research workflows to increase the speed and breadth of research operations and synthesis while maintaining strong judgment around evidence quality, bias, privacy, and research validity.

• Create journey maps, research reports, personas, frameworks, or other artifacts when they meaningfully improve communication or decision-making—not simply as deliverables.

• Build systems that make research insights accessible and useful across Product, Design, Engineering, and the broader company.

How We Think About Research

At Bask, research isn't a step in the design process.

It's a way of reducing uncertainty.

Sometimes that means spending significant time understanding a complex workflow. Sometimes it means talking to five customers this week. Sometimes it means analyzing behavioral data, testing a prototype, reviewing support conversations, or running a quick experiment.
We're less interested in the number of research artifacts you produce and more interested in what changed because of what you learned.
The best researchers at Bask will help us answer three questions:
Are we solving a real problem?
Are we solving it in the right way?
Did the experience actually get better after we shipped it?

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when teams involve research before solutions are defined, product decisions are increasingly grounded in evidence rather than assumptions, and Bask develops a deeper shared understanding of its customers and patients.
Most importantly, your work will help us build fewer things that don't matter and build the things that do with much greater confidence.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• Proven experience in Product Research, UX Research, User Research, or a similar role within a digital product organization.

• A strong track record of taking ambiguous product questions, determining what evidence is needed, gathering it efficiently, and influencing meaningful product decisions.

• Experience with qualitative research methods including user interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry, and concept testing.

• Experience using quantitative signals such as surveys, product analytics, experiments, or behavioral data alongside qualitative research.

• Strong analytical thinking and the ability to distinguish meaningful patterns from noise.

• Excellent synthesis skills—you can take large amounts of messy information and turn them into a clear understanding of what matters and why.

• Strong product judgment and an understanding of how research connects to product strategy, design, engineering constraints, and business outcomes.

• The ability to communicate research findings clearly and persuasively to designers, engineers, product managers, executives, and other stakeholders.

• Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where questions may be ambiguous and the ideal research methodology isn't always obvious.

• A pragmatic approach to research. You know when a question requires rigorous investigation and when a lightweight approach can provide enough confidence to move forward.

• Experience collaborating closely with Product and Design throughout discovery, development, and post-launch evaluation.

• Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate research workflows while maintaining critical thinking and independent judgment.

• Curiosity about how AI is changing user behavior, software interfaces, and the way products are designed and built.

Nice to Have

• Experience with B2B SaaS, healthcare, telehealth, fintech, marketplaces, or other complex software platforms.

• Experience researching products with multiple user types or sides of a marketplace.

• Experience working with product analytics and behavioral data.

• Experience conducting research in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.

• Experience researching AI-powered products, automation, or workflows involving human-AI collaboration.

• Experience establishing research practices, repositories, or continuous discovery programs within a growing product organization.

title: 3D Artist (Blender & Real-Time Specialist)
description:
Job Spec: 3D Artist (Blender & Real-Time Specialist)

Location: Remote

Reporting to: Creative Director

The Role

We are looking for a versatile and technically proficient 3D Artist to join our growing creative team. You will be responsible for bringing complex concepts to life through high-quality modeling and fluid animation, primarily using Blender. As we specialize in interactive web-based demos, your primary challenge will be the "magic trick" of 3D: making assets look like high-end cinema while keeping them lightweight enough to load

instantly in a mobile browser. You will work under our Creative Director and alongside our development team to bridge the gap between high-fidelity art and web performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Modeling & Texturing: Create high-quality 3D assets optimized for performance. This includes expert-level retopology and baking high-to-low poly details.

• Animation: Develop smooth, purposeful animations—ranging from mechanical movements to

environmental storytelling—using Blender’s animation suite.

• Web Optimization: Ensure all assets are "game-ready" for the browser, focusing on low draw calls, efficient texture atlasing, and minimal file sizes.

• Collaboration: Work alongside other 3D artists and frontend developers to ensure visual consistency and technical compatibility.

• Pipeline Integration: Prepare and export assets (primarily glTF/GLB) that are ready for immediate implementation into our interactive platforms.

Technical Requirements

• Blender Mastery: Advanced proficiency in modeling, retopology, rigging, shading, and animation.

• Real-Time Optimization: Proven experience creating assets for web-based engines (Three.js, Babylon.js, or PlayCanvas). You should be an expert in:

○ Polygon Budgeting: Keeping mesh density low without losing silhouette.

○ Texture Compression: Efficient use of 1k/2k textures and PBR workflows.

○ Draw Call Reduction: Merging meshes and materials strategically.

• Visual Flair: A strong portfolio demonstrating a mastery of lighting and material creation.

Bonus Points

• Development Experience: Experience working directly within a dev sprint, using version control (Git), or understanding the limitations of WebGL.

• Technical Art: Knowledge of Python scripting within Blender to automate export pipelines.

• Material Science: Experience with KHR extensions for glTF (clearcoat, transmission, sheen) to achieve high-end looks in the browser.

Why Us?

We create virtual instrument simulations for lab equipment - helping people learn and service. We work with global biotech companies and we are always pushing boundaries with technical and creative ideas.

title: Sr Product Designer

Design system extension, governance, and documentation

What we offer you

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

description:
Infilla is looking for a UX/UI Designer to design and deliver intuitive web experiences and native mobile apps for code enforcement and inspections products, while scaling design quality and judgment across the company.

Infilla’s mission is to make more housing happen faster by making permitting unremarkable. The U.S. is short 4-7 million homes, and local permitting is one of the top bottlenecks with approvals taking months to years. Infilla is building the modern permitting platform that helps local governments review projects faster, more consistently, and more transparently. Customers include San Francisco, New York City, and the State of Delaware, among others. We’re backed by Basis Set Ventures, Base10 Partners, Urban Innovation Fund, SHAKTI VC, 20Growth, Bloomberg Beta, and 20+ founders/operators who’ve built products at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER

•
Design and deliver the Inspections MVP to live customers within 3 months of start, and Code Enforcement within 5.

•
Maintain the Infilla design system after the contractor build, across web and mobile components, so engineers and coding agents implement from it without translation and with minimal drift as new surfaces ship.

•
Enable engineers to independently ship UI that meets the bar through shared design principles, a working critique practice, and a design system that makes the consistent choice the easy one.

WHAT YOU’VE DONE BEFORE

•
You’ve designed, shipped, and iterated on 0-to-1 B2B mobile apps that real users use

•
You’ve independently owned cross-platform, end-to-end designs without a design manager

•
You use AI in the work itself, daily

WHAT YOU’RE GREAT AT

•
Product judgment & scoping - Takes a fuzzy problem and decides what makes the MVP and what waits. Grounds decisions in how the work is actually done rather than in what similar products look like.

•
Design craft - Makes intuitive experiences that hold up in real conditions, across native mobile and dense desktop, from information architecture through visual detail.

•
Systems thinking - Designs products that fit a coherent whole — thinks in models and workflows rather than just screens, and keeps the design system consistent as new surfaces ship.

•
Design enablement - Makes other people better at design without doing the work themselves. Co-creates the principles and holds the bar when engineers ship UI unassisted.

•
Ownership in ambiguity - Makes progress without a spec, a PM, or a clear brief. Decides and moves rather than waiting for the requirements to firm up.

NICE TO HAVE, NOT NEEDED

•
You’ve designed for deskless workers, government staff, or less technology-savvy users

•
You’ve designed AI product surfaces

•
You’ve maintained design systems

•
You’ve designed products that meet WCAG AA 2.1 accessibility standards

•
You have experience with brand design or marketing design work

•
You are a former founder, beyond being a solopreneur or consultant

Research shows women & minorities are more likely to consider themselves unqualified if they don’t meet every single requirement in a job description. This represents what we’re ideally looking for, but everyone is unique. We hire for strengths & potential, not lack of weakness or a perfect resume fit.

DETAILS

•
This is a full-time remote role based in either LatAm. If you'd prefer to start on a contract basis, we're open to that

•
You will join as 2nd designer and report to the Founder & CEO

•
Competitive salary based on experience and working location

•
US-based employee benefits: meaningful equity, healthcare / vision / dental insurance, 401K, and 26 days of PTO including federal holidays

THE PROCESS

We aim to make this happen in 2 weeks:

•
Initial call with Savanna to assess mutual fit (20 min)

•
Design portfolio deep dive with Daria to assess design craft (60 min)

•
Jam session #1 with Phi to assess product judgment & scoping (60 min)

•
Team day onsite (virtual onsite for remote candidates)
- Jam session #2 with Carl to assess systems thinking (60 min)
- Scaling design taste conversation with Brandon to assess design enablement (30 min)
- Founder conversation with Jenny to assess ownership in ambiguity (45 min)

•
Reference checks (manager, PM peer, designer peer, engineering peer)

HOW WE WORK

•
Ideas > Hierarchy - Best idea wins regardless of source. Be intellectually honest.

•
Kind > Nice - Share clear, helpful feedback often. Voice your concerns and listen.

•
Courage > Comfort - We do the right thing, even when hard or uncomfortable.

•
Hours > Weeks - Solve it in hours, not "eventually." Speed is our biggest edge as a startup.

•
Fix > Flag - See a problem, own it, and fix it — don't wait for someone else to.

LEGAL

Infilla is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the interview process, let us know and we'll make it work.

• Ability to balance speed, consistency, and quality while managing multiple creative projects.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering polished, production-ready work.

• Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and a desire to continuously improve your workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

• Delivering polished visual assets that meet client expectations and align with brand standards.

• Producing creative deliverables quickly without compromising quality.

• Building efficient AI workflows that improve creative production across the agency.

• Staying ahead of emerging AI capabilities and helping the team adopt new tools and best practices.

• Becoming a trusted resource for AI-powered design and creative production.

Bonus Points

It's a plus if you have experience with:

• Brand identity systems and visual design.

• UI and web design.

• Packaging, advertising, or marketing collateral.

• Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or other professional design platforms.

• Building AI prompt libraries, templates, and production workflows.

• Image editing, compositing, retouching, and upscaling.

• Automation tools that improve creative production pipelines.

Why Join Invisible Colors?

Creative production is changing rapidly, and AI is becoming an essential part of the design process. At Invisible Colors, you'll help shape how AI is integrated into professional creative workflows, working on a wide variety of brands and campaigns while experimenting with the latest tools and technologies. If you're passionate about graphic design, branding, and using AI to produce exceptional creative work more efficiently, we'd love to hear from you.

Le poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Designer IA capable de créer des éléments visuels de haute qualité pour des marques à l'aide des plus récents outils d'intelligence artificielle générative.

Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste traditionnel en design graphique, ni simplement d'écrire des prompts. Il s'agit d'un rôle axé sur la production, où vous combinerez de solides compétences en design avec une expertise technique en IA afin de créer rapidement, à grande échelle, des visuels professionnels prêts à être livrés aux clients.

Vous travaillerez sur une grande variété de projets, notamment la création de visuels marketing, de contenus de marque, de campagnes publicitaires, de contenu pour les médias sociaux, de présentations, de maquettes (mockups) et d'autres livrables visuels.

Vous saurez tirer parti de l'IA pour accélérer la production tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité, de cohérence visuelle et de respect des normes de marque.

L'univers de l'IA évolue extrêmement rapidement. Nous recherchons une personne curieuse, qui explore constamment de nouveaux outils, optimise ses méthodes de travail et développe des processus plus efficaces pour produire des contenus créatifs professionnels.

Vos responsabilités

Votre principale responsabilité sera de créer des éléments visuels de haute qualité à l'aide d'outils de création alimentés par l'intelligence artificielle.

Vous serez notamment appelé(e) à :

• Produire des visuels de marque destinés aux campagnes de marketing numérique, aux médias sociaux, aux présentations, aux sites web, à la publicité et à divers projets clients.

• Créer des graphiques, des mises en page, des maquettes (mockups), des visuels produits, des illustrations, des icônes et d'autres éléments graphiques à l'aide d'outils d'IA générative.

• Développer des techniques de prompting efficaces ainsi que des processus de travail reproductibles permettant d'obtenir des résultats professionnels de façon constante.

• Modifier, peaufiner et améliorer les contenus générés par l'IA afin qu'ils répondent aux standards de qualité du design professionnel.

• Assurer la cohérence visuelle entre les différents projets tout en respectant les lignes directrices des marques.

• Collaborer avec les équipes créatives afin de transformer les briefs en livrables visuels soignés.

• Préparer les fichiers pour différentes plateformes numériques et canaux marketing.

• Tester de nouveaux modèles d'IA, plateformes et méthodes de travail afin d'améliorer continuellement la qualité et l'efficacité de la production.

• Organiser des bibliothèques de prompts, des modèles et des ressources internes permettant d'optimiser la production créative.

Le profil recherché

Nous accordons beaucoup plus d'importance à votre portfolio qu'à votre CV.

La personne idéale possède de solides bases en design graphique, comprend les principes du branding et sait utiliser l'intelligence artificielle comme un véritable outil de production professionnel plutôt que comme un simple générateur d'images.

Vous possédez probablement de l'expérience dans plusieurs des domaines suivants :

• Création de visuels professionnels à l'aide des principales plateformes d'IA générative.

• Excellente maîtrise des principes du design graphique : typographie, mise en page, couleurs, hiérarchie visuelle, espacement et composition.

• Expérience de travail avec des normes graphiques établies et des systèmes d'identité visuelle.

• Maîtrise avancée des techniques de prompting et des processus itératifs utilisant l'IA.

• Expérience dans l'amélioration de contenus générés par l'IA à l'aide de logiciels comme Adobe Creative Suite, Figma ou d'autres outils de design professionnels.

• Capacité à maintenir un excellent équilibre entre rapidité, qualité et cohérence tout en gérant plusieurs projets simultanément.

• Grand souci du détail et volonté de livrer un travail impeccable, prêt à être utilisé en production.

• Curiosité envers les nouvelles technologies en intelligence artificielle et désir constant d'améliorer ses méthodes de travail.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Vous réussirez dans ce poste si vous êtes capable de :

• Produire des visuels professionnels répondant aux attentes des clients tout en respectant les standards des marques.

• Livrer rapidement des créations de qualité sans compromettre le niveau de finition.

• Développer des processus de production basés sur l'IA qui améliorent l'efficacité de l'ensemble de l'agence.

• Rester à l'affût des nouvelles avancées en IA et contribuer à l'adoption des meilleurs outils et des meilleures pratiques.

• Devenir une personne-ressource reconnue en matière de design assisté par l'intelligence artificielle et de production créative.

Atouts recherchés

Une expérience dans les domaines suivants constitue un avantage :

• Développement d'identités visuelles et de systèmes de marque.

• Design d'interfaces (UI) et conception web.

• Emballage, publicité ou matériel promotionnel.

• Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva ou d'autres plateformes professionnelles de design.

• Création de bibliothèques de prompts, de modèles et de processus de production basés sur l'IA.

• Retouche d'images, composition visuelle (compositing), amélioration et agrandissement d'images (upscaling).

• Outils d'automatisation permettant d'optimiser les flux de production créative.

Pourquoi joindre Invisible Colors?

La production créative évolue rapidement, et l'intelligence artificielle fait désormais partie intégrante du processus de création. Chez Invisible Colors, vous contribuerez à définir la façon dont l'IA est intégrée aux processus créatifs professionnels. Vous travaillerez sur une grande variété de marques et de campagnes tout en expérimentant les technologies les plus récentes. Si vous êtes passionné(e) par le design graphique, le branding et les possibilités qu'offre l'intelligence artificielle pour produire un travail créatif exceptionnel, plus rapidement et plus efficacement, nous aimerions faire votre connaissance.

title: Social Media & Communications Designer | Fluent C2 English Role
description:
Puulse Marketing | Remote | Full-Time

Puulse Marketing is a performance-based sales and marketing company that builds and runs sales teams for brands like Bell Canada. We're growing our internal creative function and looking for someone to own how Puulse shows up online and how we communicate with our own teams.

Please read before applying: this is an English-language role. Every post, newsletter, and internal message you create will be in English, and part of the job is proofreading other people's writing. You need C2-level (native or near-native) written and spoken English. Applications, resumes, and portfolios not submitted in English will not be considered.

This role is a mix of social media, design, and internal communications. One day you might be building a top-performer graphic for our teams in Ontario, the next you're putting together a recruiting post for Instagram or a newsletter going out across offices. If you like variety and want your work seen by hundreds of people, this is a good fit.

What you'll do

• Create social media posts for our recruiting and culture channels (Instagram, LinkedIn, and more)

• Design internal communications: employee shoutouts, leaderboards, incentive announcements, newsletters

• Build recruiting and employer-brand content that features real employees and real stories

• Support marketing materials across print and digital as needed

• Keep our visual style consistent across everything you touch

• Proofread and polish copy so it reads clean and sounds like us

The details

• Full-time, independent contractor

• Core hours 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday, with flexibility to finish earlier some days once your work is done

• $1000 USD per month

• Fully remote

• Either party may end the agreement with one month's written notice

Requirements

What we're looking for

• Strong design skills and a strong portfolio

• Comfort creating for social media, not just print

• Good writing instincts and an eye for detail

• Someone reliable who communicates well and works independently

• Bonus: photo retouching and basic video editing

Language requirement

This is an English-first role and near-native English is essential. You'll be writing and proofreading social posts, newsletters, and internal communications every day, so C2-level written and spoken English is a hard requirement. Please submit your application, resume, and portfolio in English.

Benefits

Why you'll like working here

• Fully remote — work from wherever you are

• Flexible hours: finish earlier some days once your work is done

• Variety — social, design, communications, and content all in one role

• Your work seen by hundreds of people across a growing company

• A creative function you get to help build and shape as we grow

title: Industrial Design to UX Design Career Changer Apprenticeship
description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

• Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

• Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables

• Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

• Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

• Build digital products and services 0-1

• Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice

• Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management

• Identify target market for product and position product for launch success

• Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process

• Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics

• Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users

• Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales

• Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

• Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution

• Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables

• Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

• Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution

• Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options

• Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

• Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

• Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables

• Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

• Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

• Build digital products and services 0-1

• Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice

• Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management

• Identify target market for product and position product for launch success

• Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process

• Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics

• Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users

• Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales

• Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

• Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution

• Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables

• Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

• Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution

• Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options

• Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. title: Design Lead
description:
Design Lead

Quatrain Creative

About the Company

Quatrain is a fully remote, woman-owned content agency that blends strategy, storytelling, and design to create high-impact content. For more than a decade, our team of experienced writers, designers, and content strategists has worked with B2B brands across industries—from education to technology—to craft compelling blog posts, case studies, ebooks, videos, and more. Our values define everything we do, and we are deeply committed to a culture that is positive, transparent, collaborative, and grounded in trust. Our team members enjoy flexible schedules, family-friendly PTO policies, and true work-life balance.

Position Overview

We're looking for a hands-on Design Lead to own the quality and execution of our design work. You'll split your time between creating design work yourself and leading a small team of freelance designers. You'll develop creative briefs, review deliverables, and help ensure projects meet client expectations and high creative standards while staying on schedule and within budget. You will represent our design team in client meetings, confidently communicating with clients and leading design discussions. You'll also contribute to the evolution of our agency's website and internal creative processes.

Please note: This is not a branding, web, or marketing campaign design role. We specialize in designing content-heavy marketing assets for B2B companies, and we're looking for someone with deep experience creating polished, professional editorial-style marketing assets.

Our ideal candidate has an exceptional portfolio featuring ebooks, guidebooks, white papers, case studies, sales collateral, slide decks, infographics, and other editorial-style marketing assets. Many of our projects are +20 pages and require expert typography, page layout, information hierarchy, and production skills in Adobe InDesign and PowerPoint.

* If your experience is primarily in branding, UI/UX, websites, paid media, packaging, environmental design, illustration, or advertising campaigns, this role is likely not the right fit.

Core Responsibilities

• Produce high-quality design work for multiple clients (approximately 50-70% of your time).

• Design long-form marketing assets including ebooks, guidebooks, case studies, white papers, sales collateral, slide decks, and infographics with a strong emphasis on typography, layout, and readability.

• Manage and mentor a small group of freelance designers.

• Write creative briefs and translate client needs into actionable design direction.

• Review and provide feedback on design deliverables.

• Attend client meetings as the design lead and communicate creative decisions clearly.

• Coordinate design workflows and maintain consistency across projects.

• Build and maintain internal style guides for each of our clients.

• Improve and maintain the agency website and other internal creative assets.

• Help establish design standards, templates, and processes as the agency grows.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design or related field.

• 5+ years of professional graphic or digital design experience, preferably in an agency or client services environment.

• Experience leading or mentoring designers, freelancers, or creative teams.

• Confidence leading client meetings, advising clients on design direction, presenting creative work, and communicating design decisions to clients.

• Experience developing creative briefs and translating business goals into effective visual solutions.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide thoughtful, constructive design feedback.

• Excellent organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Proficiency with PowerPoint and Adobe Creative Cloud, with advanced knowledge of Adobe InDesign.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with little direction or oversight.

• Must reside in Eastern or Central time zone and be available to work Eastern business hours.

•
A portfolio is required and should demonstrate significant experience designing long-form, content-heavy marketing materials. We're specifically looking for work such as ebooks, guidebooks, white papers, case studies, sales sheets, slide decks, infographics, and other editorial-style business collateral. Experience focused primarily on branding, logos, websites, UI/UX, packaging, environmental graphics, or paid advertising does not align with the primary responsibilities of this role.

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with web design and tools like Webflow

• Experience with PM tools like Monday, Asana, or Wrike

• Experience designing for B2B clients in tech or education

• Basic motion graphics experience

Benefits

• $80,000/yr salary

• Flexible work schedule

• Fully remote

• 12 days of paid time off for federal/school holidays

• Annual office closure from Christmas Eve to New Years Day

• Unlimited PTO after 90 days of employment

• HRA available after 90 days of employment

Salary: $80,000 / year

title: Plumbing Design Engineer
description:
Plumbing Designer – Independent Contractor (Ukraine)

Location: Ukraine, Remote
Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor Agreement for Provision of Services (Long-Term)

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Plumbing Designer for a long-term independent contractor engagement.

This is an ongoing contractual engagement with a US-based company and is not limited to a single project. The role involves continuous collaboration across multiple mission-critical projects, based on business needs.

You will provide services as an independent, self-employed professional under a formal independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume in English detailing their relevant experience.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled Plumbing Designer to support the design, modeling, and coordination of plumbing systems for cutting-edge data center projects across the U.S.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing plumbing system layouts and BIM models, preparing drawings and technical documentation, and coordinating plumbing systems with other engineering disciplines.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from schematic design through detailed design and execution.

Strong technical expertise in plumbing design, proficiency with BIM tools, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills are essential.

What We Offer

• Experience in a high-tech industry completing work for an international company

• Unique, cutting-edge data center projects

• Dynamic work partnering with a team of professionals focused on engineering

• Competitive hourly rate

• Ability to collaborate remotely

• Supportive dynamic environment

• English classes made available

Key Responsibilities

• Using BIM tools to model plumbing systems and coordinate with other disciplines; hands-on Autodesk Revit experience is a must

• Developing plumbing system layouts and detailed designs for mission-critical facilities

• Designing and modeling domestic water, sanitary waste, vent, storm drainage, and other plumbing systems

• Developing plumbing piping layouts, equipment connections, riser diagrams, and system schematics

• Performing plumbing calculations and supporting equipment and piping sizing

• Producing coordinated BIM models and construction drawings

• Developing a thorough understanding and delivery of project requirements as they relate to scope, cost, and schedule

• Determining and expediting engineering deliverables for projects

• Developing and maintaining project scope of work documentation and revisions as required during design evolution

• Coordinating plumbing systems with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and fire protection disciplines

• Identifying and resolving design and coordination issues within the BIM environment

• Ensuring designs comply with applicable plumbing, building, and project-specific codes and standards

• Preparing technical documentation required for project execution, including drawings, schedules, specifications, calculations, and equipment data

• Reviewing shop drawings and submittals for compliance with design intent

• Supporting project teams throughout design development and construction

• Performing occasional site visits to support construction progress (valid U.S. work visa considered an asset but not required)

Qualifications & Experience

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or a related technical field

• At least 3 years of experience in plumbing design

• Proven experience designing and modeling plumbing systems for commercial, industrial, or mission-critical facilities

• Strong knowledge of domestic water, sanitary, vent, and storm drainage systems

• Hands-on experience with Autodesk Revit – is a must

• Experience producing coordinated BIM models and construction documentation

• Understanding of applicable plumbing and building codes and standards

• Experience coordinating plumbing systems with other engineering disciplines

• Experience with U.S.-based projects and data centers is considered an advantage

• Written and spoken English B1 and higher

• Microsoft Office proficiency (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize while meeting project deadlines

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Why Us?

• Perform on high-profile, hyperscale, and AI data center projects in a rapidly expanding industry

• Collaborate with leading professionals and global clients such as Microsoft, Oracle, Uber, and Amazon

• Competitive terms of the contract

• Dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to advanced technologies such as BIM, VDC, digital twins, and augmented reality

Collaborate with Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

Ehvert Mission Critical specializes in the design and construction management of data centers. We are a business unit within Salas O’Brien — a 4,000-person engineering and professional services firm, widely recognized for its extensive expertise and impressive project portfolio. With more than 10,000 projects annually and 100 offices across North America, Salas O'Brien is ranked #39 on Engineering News-Record’s 2024 Top 500 Design Firms list.

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is an industry leader in data center facility engineering, specializing in hyperscale and AI data centers, designing massive data centers for global tech giants like Microsoft, Uber, Oracle, and Amazon. Our projects involve complex electrical, mechanical, fire protection, automation, security, and plumbing systems necessary to support high-demand facilities, often exceeding loads of 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

We are recognized for our advanced engineering and construction techniques, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), and augmented reality.

We offer highly competitive service fees to our independent contractors.

This engagement is strictly as an independent contractor. You will not be eligible for any employee benefits, and we will not withhold taxes, provide insurance(s), or make contributions to social security/pensions on your behalf. You are responsible for complying with all tax and labor obligations in your country of residence. A formal independent contractor agreement will be required before work begins, governed by Texas, United States law.

For more information, visit Ehvert and Salas O’Brien websites.

title: Controls Design Modeler (Electrical, ELV) Philippines
description:
Location: Philippines, Remote.
Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers.
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor Agreement for Provision of Services (long-term).

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Controls Design Modeler (ELV) for a long-term independent contractor basis.

This is an ongoing contractual engagement with a US-based company and is not limited to a single project. The role involves continuous collaboration across multiple mission-critical projects, based on business needs.

You will provide services as an independent, self-employed professional under a formal independent contractor agreement.

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume in English detailing their relevant experience.

Role Summary:
As a Controls Designer, you will support the design and documentation of control systems for mission-critical projects, including large-scale data centers. This role is focused on developing high-quality design and modeling deliverables in close coordination with controls engineers and multidisciplinary teams. There is a strong emphasis on Revit-based design, as well as supporting broader low-voltage systems, including fire alarm, where applicable. This position is well-suited for someone with a solid technical foundation who can contribute to production work and help scale project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and produce control system design drawings and models using Revit.

• Support the design of building automation and control systems for HVAC and related systems under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Assist with layout, schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel designs for control systems.

• ⁠Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, and other disciplines to ensure integrated and consistent design delivery.

• Contribute to low-voltage system design efforts, including controls, fire alarm, and related systems as needed.

• ⁠Update and maintain project documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with project standards.

• Support design reviews by incorporating feedback and making necessary revisions.

• Assist with the preparation of submittals, as-built drawings, and commissioning documentation.

• Follow internal QA/QC processes and applicable industry standards and codes.

Qualifications & Experience:

• A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related field, is preferred (or equivalent practical experience).

• 3+ years of experience in controls design, building systems, or extra low-voltage systems.

• ⁠Proficiency in Autodesk Revit is required - not less than 1 year of constant using.

• Basic understanding of BAS/BMS systems, DDC controls, and integration with HVAC systems.

• ⁠Exposure to fire alarm and/or other low-voltage systems (security, communications) is a plus.

• ⁠Detail-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills.

• Able to work effectively in a team environment and support multiple projects simultaneously.

• Good communication skills and ability to follow technical direction.

Why Us?

• Perform on high-profile, hyperscale, and AI data center projects in a rapidly expanding industry.

• Collaborate with leading professionals and global clients such as Microsoft, Oracle, Uber, and Amazon.

• Competitive terms of the contract.

• A dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to advanced technologies such as BIM, VDC, digital twins, and augmented reality.

Collaborate with Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

Ehvert Mission Critical specializes in the design and construction management of data centers. We are a business unit within Salas O’Brien - a 4,000-person engineering and professional services firm, widely recognized for its extensive expertise and impressive project portfolio. With more than 10,000 projects annually and 100 offices across North America, Salas O'Brien is ranked #39 on Engineering News-Record’s 2024 Top 500 Design Firms list.

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is an industry leader in data center facility engineering, specializing in hyperscale and AI data centers, designing massive data centers for global tech giants like Microsoft, Uber, Oracle, and Amazon. Our projects involve complex electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems necessary to power, cool, and secure these high-demand facilities, often exceeding loads of 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.
We are recognized for our advanced engineering and construction techniques, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), and augmented reality.
Join our team at Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

title: Creative Director, Digital
description:
At Red Antler, we launch and grow brands. From startups seeking to bring new ideas to life to established companies aiming to retain their category leadership, we help businesses tell the story of why they matter to put them at the center of every tomorrow. We’re looking for a Creative Director to lead our digital team, including UX and Visual Design, and partner with our strategists, brand designers, and art directors to guide and shape our next wave of digital launches for companies looking to change the way we eat, shop, explore, and live.

As a Creative Director on our digital team, you'll use your experience and creative intuition to push our work to new places and bring our clients’ ideas to life. You have a passion for bringing new products to market and know what it takes to get the next big thing off the ground. You want to see your work in the world.

Who you are:

• You have 10+ years of digital design experience working at a creative agency, design studio or in house creative teams. In addition, you’ve spent 3+ years in previous leadership roles and can effectively oversee the quality and efficacy of our digital team’s work.

• You have a killer design aesthetic and an excellent handle on user experience and digital strategy. You know how to push creative teams to imagine new ways to bring digital experiences to life through interaction and content.

• You want to partner with interdisciplinary leads to build a vision for something that hasn’t yet been defined; working with copywriters, brand designers, art directors, and developers to build something new across every customer touchpoint.

• You can build trust and guide clients through our creative process. You have the ability to define and establish digital processes that align with both client and internal needs.

• You’ll be an arbiter of our digital vision and will find opportunities to foster this vision within the team and agency. You’ll help us push digital design to tell evocative brand stories that create emotional connections with consumers.

• You will collaborate with our business development team and help advise on digital opportunities with potential clients that express our distinct digital POV. You can effectively scope projects and during the planning stages, consult on deliverables and project team casting that will optimize success.

• You have a solid understanding of UX design principles and prototyping tools, and an equally polished portfolio showcasing your UI/visual design capabilities. A strong grasp of CSS, Javascript, HTML5, and front-end development trends is a plus.

• You are fluent in emerging AI-powered creative workflows and understand how tools like Figma AI, generative image/video platforms, and rapid prototyping can accelerate ideation, design systems, and production—without compromising craft or strategic thinking.

• You bring strong product design instincts, with experience designing user-centered digital experiences across web, apps, and digital products. You know how to balance brand expression with usability, leveraging user insights, testing, and iterative design to create experiences that drive engagement and business outcomes.

• You are a mentor and a leader and are excited to manage and grow our team of digital designers.

Salary: $170,000 – $225,000 / year

title: Sound Designer
description:
OUR MISSION

Prisms VR is a San Francisco-based team of educators, game developers, and engineers transforming K12 STEM education through experiential real-world problem-solving powered by the next generation of spatial computing. We utilize adaptive Virtual Reality (VR) to engage, inspire, and open pathways to creative problem-solving to rapidly improve engagement and proficiencies in Math and Science across our country and beyond. Our mission is to break down barriers to access and build STEM proficiencies at scale for all students, worldwide.

THE JOB

Interactive Sound Designer

JOB DESCRIPTION
Prisms seeks a developer with enterprise experience to build immersive learning experiences for mobile VR platforms using the Unity framework. Your main task will be to create scalable and reliable tools and systems to aid in the development of immersive learning experiences. You will also lead the development of core systems and make architectural decisions to be executed by other team members. We require a strong commitment to collaborative problem-solving, sophisticated design, and delivering a high-quality product.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design and produce original sound assets that align with educational objectives and elevate the immersive VR experience.

• Implement and integrate sound assets directly into the Unity game engine, ensuring seamless audio-visual interaction

• Create rich and immersive spatial audio soundscape for virtual reality environments.

• Collaborate with educational content designers and developers to create sound schemes that support pedagogical goals.

• Create dynamic audio assets that enhance learning in interactive experiences.

• Conduct user testing and iteration to refine sound design for clarity and effectiveness in an educational context.

• Innovate and adapt sound design techniques to suit evolving VR technologies and educational methodologies.

• Maintain a comprehensive asset library for use in current and future projects.

• Provide audio support for ongoing development and maintenance of VR applications.

REQUIREMENTS

• Proven experience in sound design, preferably within interactive or gaming environments.

• Strong understanding of Unity and its audio implementation processes.

• Familiarity with educational sound design principles and the importance of sound in learning environments.

• Ability to create a wide range of audio from ambient soundscapes to dynamic interactive audio assets.

• Experience with audio recording, editing, and mixing tools.

• Basic knowledge of C# programming is a plus but not mandatory.

• A strong portfolio showcasing relevant sound design work.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

• Passion for transforming education through innovative technology and immersive experiences.

title: Junior UX/UI Designer (AI-Native Process)
description:
About Us

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.

Role context

We are looking for an ambitious Junior or early Mid-level Designer who wants to grow in an AI-native environment.

You do not need to be an AI expert.

You do not need to know how to code.

And you do not need several years of commercial experience.

What matters much more to us is whether you are curious, willing to experiment, quick to learn and already trying to use AI as part of your design process.

Maybe you have already tested Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude or another similar tool.

Maybe you have built a small app, prototype, landing page or personal project.

Or maybe you are simply the kind of person who sees a new tool and immediately wants to find out what can be done with it.

That is the mindset we are looking for.

At Flying Bisons, you will work alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers and learn how to turn briefs, ideas and user needs into interactive solutions.

The goal is not to replace design fundamentals with AI.

The goal is to use AI to design faster, smarter and better.

Scope of services

•
work in project teams alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers,

•
help translate briefs, concepts and user needs into user flows and interactive prototypes,

•
use AI to quickly explore different solutions instead of designing every screen from scratch,

•
experiment with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code and new solutions emerging on the market,

•
create early versions of flows that can quickly be clicked through, discussed and developed further,

•
iterate on solutions based on feedback from more experienced designers and the project team,

•
think about how the whole product behaves, not just about individual screens,

•
consider different states, errors, user actions and edge cases,

•
work in Figma when it is the best tool for the job,

•
develop your ability to combine AI with solid UX and UI fundamentals,

•
gradually build your own AI-native workflow,

•

share interesting tools, experiments and learnings with the team.

Over time, we want you to become increasingly independent in taking a well-defined product problem and turning it into a solid interactive solution.

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who:

•
has some practical experience with UX/UI or Product Design, gained through commercial work, internships, freelance work, university projects or personal projects,

•
understands basic UX principles and can think about the entire user flow rather than individual screens,

•
has a good visual sense and understands the basics of hierarchy, spacing and interface design,

•
actively looks for ways to use AI to improve or speed up their design process

•
is interested in how AI is changing design and wants to actively develop in this area,

•
is comfortable trying new things even when they do not initially know exactly how to approach them,

•
learns new tools quickly,

•
is open to feedback and comfortable showing work that is still in progress,

•
can explain the reasoning behind their design decisions,

•
thinks not only about how a button looks, but also about what happens after the user clicks it,

•

can communicate comfortably in English in a project environment.

You do not need to meet every requirement perfectly.

If you are at the beginning of your career but already experimenting, building your own things and learning quickly, we would still be very happy to hear from you.

Nice to have

•
built a prototype, small app, website or personal project using AI,

•
experience with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code or similar,

•
basic knowledge of how websites and digital products are built,

•
basic knowledge of HTML, CSS or general front-end concepts,

•
experience working with developers, Product Managers or researchers,

•
personal projects that demonstrate curiosity and initiative beyond work or university,

•

experience experimenting with different AI models and tools.

None of these are mandatory.

What matters more than years of experience

We are not looking for the person with the longest CV.

We are looking for signs of potential.

What matters most to us is:

•
curiosity,

•
learning speed,

•
product thinking,

•
initiative,

•
willingness to experiment,

•
solid design fundamentals,

•
genuine interest in AI-native design.

A small project that you built yourself and can explain well may tell us more about you than a perfectly polished portfolio.

Short video application

Instead of a traditional cover letter, we would like you to send us a short video in English.

Maximum length: 8-10 minutes.

You do not need to prepare or edit it professionally. A simple screen recording or Loom is absolutely fine.

We would like you to show us two things.

1. Show us something you created, around 5 minutes

Show us one project or experiment where you used AI.

It can be:

•
a prototype,

•
a small app,

•
a website,

•
a university project,

•
a personal project,

•
an experiment,

•
or something you created mainly to learn a new tool.

Briefly tell us:

•
What were you trying to create?

•
Which AI tool did you use?

•
What did AI help you with?

•
What did you change or design yourself?

•
What did you learn while working on it?

The project does not need to be commercial or particularly complex.

We are much more interested in how you approached it.

2. Tell us what you are learning now, around 3 to 5 minutes

Tell us:

What AI tool, workflow or capability are you currently exploring? Show or tell us what caught your attention and what you would like to be able to do with it.

There is no single correct answer.

We simply want to understand what interests you and how you approach learning new things.

A few important things:

•
You do not need professional equipment.

•
You do not need to edit your recording.

•
You do not need a commercial AI project.

•
Please do not show any confidential client materials.

•
You do not need to prepare a presentation.

•
If your project is small, that is absolutely fine.

Show us something real and tell us about it in your own words.

Recruitment process

We want to keep the process simple and straightforward.

Step 1: Short video

You send us your CV, portfolio and the short video described above.

Step 2: HR screening

Around 30 minutes.

Step 3: Design interview

Around 45 minutes with one of our designers.

Optional: Short practical task

In some cases, we may ask you to complete a short practical task if we need one additional data point before making a decision.

access to selected tools, systems and project environments required for project delivery,

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer 2 – AI
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.
In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software, turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.
This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products, including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control.

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge
We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.
The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience.
Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built, not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.
