title: Orchard - Senior Art Director (Health)
description:
We’re looking for a Snr Art Directorto drive ideas, craft excellence and creative direction across all channels while providing leadership within our creative team. Providing creative direction, ideation, problem-solving, mentoring and quality control to meet our clients’ requirements, we’re looking for an experienced manager of people- someone who will inspire others, taking our creative to new levels as we continue to grow. You must be extremely creative, dedicated and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. You’ll be a hands-on design leader, spending most of your time creating (around 70%) and the rest (around 30%) mentoring and supporting the team.

This senior-level role, reporting to the Creative Director, balances design execution with creative leadership, elevating craft standards, enhancing ways of working, and owning day-to-day creative delivery. You can manage the design and execution of entire campaigns (not just the production of specific pieces) and demonstrate an ability to keep other team members working alongside you within established deadlines. You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in design software and applications as well as great knowledge of printing procedures, photography, illustration, 3D and structural. You’ll also play a key role in leading new business efforts, from contributing to standout creative ideas through to confidently presenting and delivering pitches.

Your work will span a diverse range of clients and categories: from brand identity and campaign rollouts to leave-behinds, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D, structural, sales aids, eDMs, and social content.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver best-in-class creative ideas and design across digital and print.

• Execute solutions from concept to final delivery: typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, animation storyboards, and sales/educational collateral.

• Develop assets for a wide range of touchpoints: social, eDMs, websites, conference/event materials, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D and structural.

• Lead and contribute to new business pitches with standout creative ideas, polished execution, and confident delivery.

• Present and deliver design thinking in client presentations and internal forums, delivering irresistible presentations that showcase solutions and astound clients.

• Decipher, question, and absorb briefs at client meetings, developing clear ideas with bulletproof rationales and knowing the client’s brand guidelines better than they do.

• Serve as a key client-facing creative lead, building strong day-to-day relationships, attending status and briefing meetings, and confidently presenting creative work that earns trust and drives results.

• Go the journey from initial mood boards and scamps, through to supporting the final execution. Live and breathe projects, big and small, approaching each challenge with passion, intelligence and humour.

• Bring an inquisitive multi-channel mindset and a keen eye for the latest industry trends, helping push clients’ brands forward with big, ideas-led thinking.

• Use Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to create, manage, and evolve design systems and collaborative workflows.

• Embrace and champion AI tools and workflows as part of the creative process exploring how emerging technology can accelerate ideation, enhance output quality and open up new creative possibilities for the team and our clients.

Note on working arrangements

• The role is expected to be remote; however, some travel to New Jersey, USA, may be required.

• Availability to work 9am-5pm within the US East Coast time zone is essential

• Candidates must have in-depth knowledge of US regulations, including FDA promotional regulations and the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Health Care Professionals

About You

• 8+ years’ experience in a similar Creative role, with a demonstrated track record of conceptualising and executing impactful, engaging creative across platforms. Experience in health/pharma essential.

• Strong leadership and mentoring experience, able to support and inspire a creative team.

• A portfolio of previous work that shows the ability to turn a concept into a finished execution—spanning digital, print, OOH, social, campaign, and pitch work.

• Abundant experience designing for Print, Digital, 3D, Structural, Experiential, Social, Animation, large format, and POS across a wide range of deliverables, including typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, sales aids, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, eDMs, and OOH.

• Proven experience leading and delivering new business pitches with confidence.

• Advanced fluency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma; Cinema 4D (or similar 3D software) highly regarded. Experience in Unreal, After Effects and/or Premiere is a strong advantage.

• Extensive experience conceptualising and executing your own ideas within established brand guidelines, across campaign concepting, branding, production and multi-channel rollout.

• A confident communicator who can inspire clients and colleagues alike.

• A genuine curiosity about AI and its role in the future of creativity — comfortable experimenting with AI-assisted workflows and keen to help build a culture where the team uses these tools thoughtfully and to their full potential.

• Passionate about ideas and the power of creativity to make real-world impact across any category. Background in retail marketing (online/in-store), OOH advertising, film/TV, gaming or consumer electronics a bonus.

Above all, the successful candidate to join Orchard will be someone who has a strong work ethic driven by creative passion, positive energy and thrives on challenges, alongside a desire to grow with the company!

Orchard Marketing is part of the Enero Group. As a Group, we proudly acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land on which we operate, the Gadigal People of the Eora Nation. Our Innovate, Level 2, RAP endorsement aims to nurture, develop, encourage, and include Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander talent, partners, and advisors both in our own agency, and across the broader industry. As such, we encourage peoples of all backgrounds to apply.

At Orchard, the future has always inspired us. As we imagine how people will connect, what they expect from brands, and where they'll turn for their essentials, we're driven by curiosity.

This curiosity pushes us to see brands not as single moments, but as a web of connected experiences. In an era where every touchpoint is an opportunity to delight and engage, we fuse creativity, data and technology to influence action across the entire customer journey.

Which is why, at Orchard, we rally around a single purpose: to invent better outcomes through creativity, data and technology. Those better outcomes can only exist in the context of people irrespective of if we label them users, customers, patients or clients.

title: Unity Technical Artist, Event Pipeline
description:
Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar.

Join the VRChat team!

We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves.

We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms.

You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises.

What You'll Do

•
Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed.

•
Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability.

•
Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable.

•
Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists.

•
Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness.

•
Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar.

•
Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026.

Who You Are

•
You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work).

•
You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well.

•
You can write scripts (most likely C#) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk.

•
You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality.

•
You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them.

•
You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow.

•
You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.”

Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!)

•
Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity.

•
Familiarity with the VRChat creator toolchain: Unity + VRChat SDK (Worlds/Avatars) + Creator Companion (VCC/VPM)

•
Experience building interactivity in VRChat worlds using Udon / UdonSharp (C# that compiles to Udon)

•
Familiarity with common VRChat avatar components like PhysBones/Contacts and performance best practices.

•
Experience optimizing content for multiple hardware tiers and platforms (PC + mobile constraints, etc.).

•
Experience supporting live ops or high-cadence content publishing.

Not sure if you meet every single requirement?

We’d still love to hear from you. We know technical artists come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you’re excited to help ship a steady stream of 3D content to a global community, and you like making pipelines fast, safe, and human-friendly, please apply.

Where You’ll Be

This is a remote-first role. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. We’re a fully distributed company with team members across the globe. While we work asynchronously, overlap with U.S. time zones is needed for team collaboration.

Benefits

•
100% Remote – work from anywhere in the world

•
Health benefits for U.S. and Canadian employees

•
401K (U.S.) and RRSP (Canada) retirement plans

•
Stock options

•
Unlimited/flexible vacation policy

•
Paid parental leave

•
Generous holiday schedule

VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time. If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!

All job offers are subject to early stage ID checks, satisfactory referencing and background checks.

title: Senior Product Designer (Fully Remote)
description:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape and improve experiences across our two-sided housing marketplace. Working on a growth-focused product team, you’ll tackle meaningful, complex problems for members and hosts, helping make it easier to find, access, and provide affordable housing. You’ll play a central role in designing intuitive, human, and scalable experiences that create measurable impact for our customers and business.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re looking for a senior-level designer who blends strong product intuition, systems thinking, deep empathy for users, and growth-minded experimentation. You thrive in complex problem spaces, move fluidly between big-picture strategy and pixel-level detail, and can clearly connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes. Above all, you are authentic, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems with cross-functional teams.

Here’s What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

•
Own End-to-End Product Design – Lead design from early problem definition and exploration through prototyping, launch, and iteration across PadSplit’s marketplace.

•
Simplify Complex Experiences – Turn complicated workflows, rules, and marketplace dynamics into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and approachable.

•
Conduct User Research – Interview, observe, and gather insights from members and hosts to deeply understand their needs and translate them into stronger products.

•
Drive Product Strategy – Partner with PMs to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and connect customer needs with measurable business outcomes.

•
Experiment & Iterate – Use data, customer feedback, prototypes, and experiments to test assumptions and continuously improve experiences.

•
Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with PMs, engineers, marketers, operations, and data partners to develop and deliver cohesive solutions.

•
Craft High-Quality UI – Build responsive, polished interfaces in Figma using thoughtful components, interaction patterns, and PadSplit’s design system.

•
Build AI-Infused Experiences – Prototype and design intelligent workflows and AI-powered features alongside our engineering, ML, and AI teams.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

•
Proven Experience – 4+ years designing digital products, ideally with complex acquisition funnels or marketplace environments.

•
Deep UX Skills – Strong research abilities and comfort engaging directly with users to uncover pain points and opportunities.

•
Business Fluency – Ability to connect design decisions to metrics, revenue, and real estate economics like rent, ROI, and occupancy.

•
Workflow Mastery – Experience designing multi-step processes, complex service environments, and edge-case-heavy workflows.

•
UI Excellence – Expertise in Figma and interaction design across web and mobile, with strong systems thinking and component reuse.

•
Data Orientation – Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and interpreting both qual and quant insights.

•
AI Capability – Demonstrated experience designing AI-powered features and leveraging modern AI tools in your design practice.

•
Authentic Collaboration – A humble, kind, curious, and mission-driven approach that elevates the team and the user experience.

The Interview Process:

• NO BOTS HERE: your resume will be reviewed by live humans from PeopleOps and the hiring manager.

• If we’re interested, the next step would be a video screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next steps would be a project review with the hiring manager (1) hour.

• If warranted, the next step would be a design case study with key Design stakeholders at PadSplit for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the final step would be a design craft exercise with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one-and-a-half (1.5) hours.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

• Fully remote position - we swear!

• Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity

• National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans

• Company provided life insurance policy

• Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits

• Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays

• 401(k) plan

• Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents

• The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

description:

Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs.

About the Role

The Athletic is redefining what a sports app is. We need a design leader who is hands-on, opinionated, and genuinely obsessed with sports, with a clear vision for what the "essential sports app" becomes over the next several years.

This role is reporting into our Chief Product Officer.

This role is 100% remote for candidates based in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

•
Product vision and prototyping the future. We want working prototypes and opinionated concepts that demonstrate what the next-generation sports app looks like, and where the biggest opportunity is for us to lead. You own the process and the design output behind ongoing strategic visioning with cross-functional leadership, driving toward decisions the exec team rallies behind.

•
A strategic voice in product direction, with real weight in the business. You bring informed, data-backed points of view to planning, and help design shape where the product goes. You partner directly with the VP Eng, the VP Data, and the CPO on the business priorities and metrics that matter, and you make sure design has a seat at the table.

•
Day-to-day craft leadership. You stay in the work: reviewing flows, jumping into Figma, and prototyping directly alongside your team.

•
AI-native transformation of the design practice. You set the direction for how design works in an AI-native world, covering tools, workflows, and team structure, so that velocity and craft rise together.

•
Org leadership and performance. You build, coach, and manage a design org (~10) that can operate at this level, with clear accountability for what each team and person delivers.

•
Collaboration. You are part of the leadership team of The Athletic. As such, your role goes beyond “design” and you work hand in hand with the other leads (engineering, product, data, marketing, commercial etc.).

Requirements

• Someone who is a sports fan first, who uses the product, has opinions about it, and lets that passion show up in the work.

• A design leader with a track record of hands-on craft at senior levels. We want to see recent, personal work.

• Experience leading a design org through a step-change in how it works, ideally involving AI tooling and workflow, at a company shipping consumer product at scale.

• Strong, well-argued opinions about what makes a sports product, or a comparable habit-forming consumer product, great, along with the conviction to defend them in a room of product and engineering leaders.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity.

description:

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours
Location: Pakistan

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a talented Graphic Designer to own and execute brand visuals across marketing campaigns, social media, digital advertising, presentations, and print.

This is more than a task-based production design role. You’ll be responsible for translating marketing concepts into compelling visual assets, maintaining a consistent brand identity, and creating creative that supports engagement and campaign performance.

The ideal candidate combines a strong design eye, brand thinking, and execution speed and can comfortably manage multiple projects in a fast-moving remote environment.

What You’ll Own

Marketing & Campaign Design

• Design high-quality creative for social media, email campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and sales initiatives.

• Translate campaign briefs and marketing concepts into compelling visual assets.

• Create designs optimized for engagement, click-through rates, and brand recognition.

• Adapt creative concepts across different platforms, audiences, and formats.

• Produce multiple creative variations for campaigns and testing when needed.

Brand Identity & Visual Consistency

• Build, maintain, and apply brand guidelines across all creative.

• Work with typography, color systems, layouts, and visual identity elements.

• Ensure consistency across digital and offline touchpoints.

• Help strengthen brand recognition through cohesive visual execution.

• Identify opportunities to improve the overall quality and consistency of brand assets.

Digital & Advertising Creative

• Create:

• Social media graphics

• Web banners

• Landing page graphics

• Display advertisements

• Paid social creatives

• Design assets for platforms including LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Display Network.

• Collaborate with marketing teams to align creative with campaign objectives and messaging.

• Optimize designs for different dimensions, placements, and platform requirements.

Print & Marketing Collateral

• Design brochures, flyers, posters, event materials, and other marketing collateral.

• Prepare professional, print-ready files with appropriate specifications.

• Maintain consistency between digital and print brand experiences.

Motion & Creative Enhancements

• Create simple animations, GIFs, and motion graphics.

• Use Adobe After Effects or similar tools to bring static creative to life.

• Support marketing campaigns with lightweight motion and video assets where appropriate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Sales teams.

• Understand campaign briefs, objectives, audiences, and messaging before beginning creative execution.

• Incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently while maintaining design quality.

• Manage multiple requests and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

Asset Management & Delivery

• Prepare and deliver organized files in formats including AI, PSD, PNG, and PDF.

• Maintain clean and structured creative asset libraries.

• Follow consistent naming and version-control practices.

• Ensure teams can easily locate and reuse approved creative assets.

Required Experience & Skills

• 2+ years of professional graphic design experience.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating branding and marketing-focused design work.

• Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly:

• Adobe Illustrator

• Adobe Photoshop

• Adobe InDesign

• Experience designing for both digital and print channels.

• Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.

• Strong visual storytelling abilities.

• Ability to translate marketing concepts into polished creative.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Comfortable working remotely during U.S. client business hours.

Nice to Have

• Motion graphics or video editing experience.

• Experience with Adobe After Effects.

• Familiarity with Figma and Canva.

• Previous experience supporting SaaS companies, marketing agencies, or e-commerce brands.

• Understanding of marketing performance metrics such as CTR, engagement, and conversions.

• Experience designing paid advertising creative for Meta, LinkedIn, or Google campaigns.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• You understand the difference between good-looking design and effective marketing design.

• You can maintain brand consistency without making every asset look identical.

• You work quickly while maintaining a high quality bar.

• You take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions on every task.

• You can interpret marketing briefs and turn ideas into polished visual concepts.

• You handle feedback professionally and iterate efficiently.

• You keep your files, assets, and workflows exceptionally organized.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

• Review campaign briefs and incoming design requests.

• Create social, advertising, email, and marketing assets.

• Develop or refine brand visuals.

• Collaborate with marketing teams on campaign messaging.

• Produce creative variations for different platforms.

• Incorporate stakeholder feedback and finalize designs.

• Prepare digital and print-ready deliverables.

• Organize completed assets within the creative library.

In short: you ensure the brand looks consistent, professional, engaging, and performance-focused across every customer touchpoint.

Key Metrics for Success

• Consistent on-time delivery of creative projects.

• High-quality visual execution with minimal errors.

• Reduced revision cycles.

• Strong stakeholder satisfaction.

• Consistent application of brand standards.

• Positive contribution to campaign CTR and engagement.

• Well-organized and accessible creative asset libraries.

Why This Role Stands Out

• Own meaningful brand and campaign creative.

• Work across social, advertising, digital, and print design.

• Collaborate directly with marketing, product, and sales teams.

• Influence how the brand is presented and perceived.

• Gain exposure to performance-focused marketing creative.

• Fully remote opportunity based in Pakistan.

• Work with U.S.-based clients and collaborative teams.

Interview Process

• Initial Screening

• Portfolio Review

• Client Interview

• Final Interview

• Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it — only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Graphic Designer who understands both brand identity and performance-focused marketing creative, can move quickly without sacrificing quality, and takes ownership of your work, we’d love to see your portfolio.

Apply today with examples of your branding, social media, advertising, and marketing design work.

title: Visual Design Lead, UX
description:
The UX team at Cricut is responsible for user research, interaction design and visual design of software applications across desktop and mobile platforms. We design intuitive, easy-to-use software that inspires our customers, and helps them design and make projects.

The team is uniquely positioned – it reports directly to the CEO – and we collaborate across the organization to ensure hardware, content, materials, and software all work together to deliver awesome experiences. Our UX team members come from varied backgrounds and experience; all of us were drawn to the mission of empowering every person to be creative.

If you are interested in helping others realize their creativity and enjoy working on consumer-facing hardware / software, Cricut may have the dream job for you!
We are looking for top-notch, seasoned UX visual design leaders who have vision, communicate it well and love deep problem solving.

This position is not about skinning software; it is about artfully applying visual communication to create compelling user experiences. You’ll be hands-on yourself, as well as direct the work of a small team of other UX visual designers. This is a once-in-a-lifetime job opportunity – the right person will have incredible impact on the look and feel of Cricut’s software across the board.

You’ll focus on the design of delightful software experiences that clearly communicate functionality and interactivity, while maintaining and extending Cricut’s brand. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in the entire user-centered UX design process – from concept through execution, incorporating customer feedback throughout the process. Your work will happen in a highly collaborative environment, where you partner with interaction designers, researchers, product managers, software developers, industrial designers, and colleagues from the Marketing and Creative teams.

Responsibilities:

• Create visual designs that support compelling user experiences on a variety of software platforms (including desktop and mobile) that integrate with our branded hardware.

• Deliver work that translates complex ideas into simple and useful designs.

• Collaborate with UX researchers, interaction designers, software developers and QA to deliver high quality visual designs that effectively communicate interactivity.

• Help drive development of a visual design system that will empower the UX team and development to move more quickly, with consistency.

• Participate in every stage of the user-centered design process – visualize possibilities early in the design process to facilitate communication, create graphics to support user-testable prototypes, and deliver pixel-perfect visual designs that are implementation-ready.

• Clearly articulate how and why your design directions address the challenge at hand and be ready to consider tradeoffs and alternatives to meet new requirements as they arise.

• Leverage, extend and maintain the integrity of the Cricut brand in collaboration with our Creative Team (who are responsible for packaging, marketing, etc.)

• Balance work on several design projects simultaneously, bringing system’s thinking and a clear understanding of relationships between different aspects of the software to ensure visual coherence.

• Execute to the quality of top consumer brands such as Apple and Google Nest, stay abreast of product design trends, and communicate them to the entire UX team to ensure our work and process are state-of-the-art.

• Strong conceptual thinker who has a passion for design problem solving.

• Keen attention to detail and a passion for simplifying complicated systems.

• Excellent written and spoken communication; ability to clearly defend design choices with clear rationale.

• Egoless, with a clear focus on collaboration over individual accolades.

• Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time management skills and the ability to work independently.

• Interest in DIY / crafting experiences and a keen interest in gaining an understanding of and empathy for Cricut’s users.

• 10+ years of experience as a UI / Product designer working on consumer-facing software applications on more than one platform (e.g., Mac, Windows, iOS, Android).

• Proven ability to partner with UX designers, UX researchers, software developers and QA to ensure user needs are met and designs are implemented correctly.

• Exceptional portfolio, demonstrating software application visual design executed to a high level of impact and refinement.

• Experience working in an Agile environment.

• Proficiency with user interface design patterns and standard User Centered Design methods. Mastery of standard design tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe Creative Suite and a willingness to learn new tools.

• Excellent visual design skills, including a strong understanding of typography, color theory, composition, and branded experiences.

• A willingness to jump into design work at multiple stages of development and provide guidance to other designers, with a keen eye towards weaving it all together coherently.

• Previous experience overseeing, managing, and mentoring other designers.

• Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, information design, fine art, or relevant field. Graduate degree is a plus.

• Able to work Mountain Time hours.

A Quick Note Before You Apply…

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.
You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.
You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.
You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well, and manage your time wisely.

You collaborate like a pro.
You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume including links to your portfolio where applicable. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut® is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information!

At Cricut®, we celebrate inclusion and diversity. Cricut is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit. Cricut prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, nationality, citizenship, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, or any other unlawful consideration. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Cricut participates in E-Verify.

Cricut® makes smart cutting machines that work with an easy-to-use app, an ever-growing collection of materials, and crafting essentials to help you design and personalize almost anything — custom cards, unique apparel, everyday items, and so much more.

We believe everyone is born creative. We’re a diverse tapestry of thinkers, dreamers, givers, DIYers, handi-workers, artisans, and forever and always architects of things.

At Cricut, we place the power of handmade into the hands of all. We give you beautiful, easy-to-master tools so you can make something unique, remarkable, perfect. We surround you with ideas, community, inspiration, and encouragement to take your creativity further than you ever imagined. And as a community, we celebrate the exhilarating act of making every single day.

So, make that handcrafted card that feels like a hug. Design a shirt for fun, for family, or for a full-blown business. Craft with a passion or for a purpose. Make something big and bold, itsy-bitsy, amazingly ambitious, or just plain silly. Whatever you make, just make your heart out. Because here’s the remarkable truth: When we all make together, we make all things possible.

Let’s make.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:

As a UI/UX Designer at Digital Forms, you’ll work at the heart of our digital transformation projects—shaping experiences for web and mobile products used by companies around the world.

This role blends strong product design craft with a consulting approach. You will collaborate directly with clients, uncover real user and business needs, facilitate workshops, and translate insights into user journeys, prototypes, and production-ready UI. Whether you’re designing a new product from scratch or improving an existing platform, your work will directly impact adoption, efficiency, and business outcomes for our international clients.

Requirements

Responsibilities

•
Translate business goals and user needs into clear UX strategies, user flows, information architecture, and interaction models.

•
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI for web and mobile applications (from concept to delivery).

•
Facilitate discovery workshops with stakeholders (e.g., problem framing, user journeys, prioritization, validation planning).

•
Plan and conduct UX research (interviews, surveys, usability testing, competitive analysis) and synthesize findings into actionable insights.

•
Design clean, consistent interfaces aligned with brand and usability standards; ensure accessibility and inclusive design practices.

•
Build, maintain, and scale design systems (components, patterns, guidelines) to support multiple products and teams.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to ensure feasibility, clarity, and quality in implementation.

•
Prepare clear handoffs: specs, annotations, user stories support, edge cases, and responsive/adaptive behavior.

•
Use data and feedback loops (analytics, user feedback, testing) to iterate and continuously improve the product experience.

•
Present and defend design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders—clearly explaining trade-offs, risks, and rationale.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

•
Strong experience in UI/UX / Product Design with a portfolio showing end-to-end work (problem → process → solution → impact).

•
Proficiency in Figma (components, auto layout, prototyping) and modern collaboration workflows.

•
Strong UX fundamentals: user flows, IA, interaction design, usability heuristics, responsive design.

•
Experience conducting and/or supporting research and validation (usability testing, interviews, synthesis).

•
Experience creating and maintaining design systems and working consistently with components and guidelines.

•
Ability to collaborate effectively with developers (handoffs, constraints, QA feedback); basic understanding of technical feasibility is expected.

•
Familiarity with accessibility principles (WCAG mindset) and designing for diverse users and contexts.

Soft Skills:

•
Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable presenting and collaborating with international clients.

•
Consulting mindset: can understand business context and translate it into user-centered product decisions.

•
Strong business orientation: able to connect design decisions to KPIs, adoption, conversion, retention, efficiency, cost, risk.

•
Clear communicator who can guide stakeholders through ambiguity and align teams around a shared direction.

•
Proactive, organized, and comfortable working across multiple projects and priorities.

•
Comfortable giving/receiving feedback, iterating quickly, and documenting decisions.

Nice to Have

•
Experience designing complex B2B tools (dashboards, workflows, admin panels, enterprise products).

•
Experience with analytics tools and experimentation (funnels, cohorts, A/B tests, event tracking thinking).

•
Workshop facilitation experience (discovery, design sprints, stakeholder alignment).

•
UX writing / content design sensibility.

•
Experience working with international teams/clients across time zones.

We're looking for an experienced Technical Animator who is passionate about bringing quadruped characters to life with realistic, believable movement in Unreal Engine. • Set up locomotion: walk, trot, canter, gallop, turns, starts/stops, jumps

• Collaborate with animators, game designers, and programmers

• Develop and improve the animation pipeline and internal tools

REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of experience in technical animation / gameplay animation

• Hands-on experience with quadruped characters

• Portfolio with quadruped animation examples — required

• Strong knowledge of Unreal Engine: Animation Blueprints, Control Rig, IK Rig / Retargeter, Blend Spaces, State Machines

• Solid understanding of animal biomechanics and quadruped locomotion

• Experience with rigging, skinning, and skeleton setup

• Experience with motion capture pipelines

• Experience with Maya, MotionBuilder, or a similar DCC tool

• Understanding of root motion, animation curves, notifies, montages, additive animation

• Experience debugging and optimizing animation systems

• Understanding of the differences between local and replicated character state

• Understanding of which animation states/variables should be calculated locally versus driven by replicated gameplay state

• Understanding of latency, desync, animation popping issues, and ways to minimize them

• Conversational English

• Experience working on AA or AAA game projects

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience animating large quadrupeds (not just domestic animals, but heavy/massive locomotion)

• Motion Matching / Pose Search

• Full Body IK / procedural locomotion

• Python / scripting

• C++ in Unreal

• Building animation tools

• Experience optimizing NPC crowds / large numbers of skeletal meshes

This includes unlimited Flexible Time Off and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

description:
At Blink, we constantly have new opportunities so if you are interested in working for Blink, apply and we will contact you if a position that fits your experience comes in.

Blink's Embedded practice supports long-term contract opportunities (6-18 months) with some of Blink’s largest clients.

Embedded- Please review the salary ranges listed in the job descriptions, posted on our career page.

title: Roblox Art Director
description:
Sawhorse Productions is a Los Angeles based, Award winning full-service creative studio turning ideas into unforgettable experiences through captivating branded content, viral social moments, and groundbreaking interactive experiences. We partner with industry-leading brands, artists, and studios such as Walmart, Google, NBCUniversal, Fanatics, Toyota, Pepsi and Alo to deliver industry-leading, innovative multi-platform content. At Sawhorse, we believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and relentless excellence while shaping the future of digital storytelling.

Our releases include: [Roblox, Fortnite, Rec Room, ZEPETO]

• Roblox: How To Train Your Dragon

• Roblox: Wicked RP

• Roblox: Walmart Discovered - 2024 ADDY Winner

• Roblox: Fenty - 2024 Webby winner

• Roblox: Alo Sanctuary

• Roblox: Beetlejuice Escape the Afterlife

• Roblox: Lamborghini Lanzador Lab - 2024 Telly Winner

• Roblox: Elton John’s 'Beyond The Yellow Brick Road'

• Roblox: Olivia Rodrigo

• Roblox: Fashion Klossette

• Gen AI applet: Coca - Cola Cappy

• And numerous digital fashion releases on UGC Gaming platforms - Sawhorse Productions

We're looking for a bold, visually driven, and hands on Roblox Art Director to set the creative bar for Sawhorse Productions' branded experiences on Roblox. This role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, game art, and platform culture, turning the world's biggest brands and IPs into worlds that feel native to the Roblox community.

You will define the visual direction of every experience we build, lead a team of 3D artists, UI designers, and technical artists, and partner closely with clients, game designers, and producers to deliver work that looks incredible and performs on every device. As Sawhorse continues to grow its Interactive division across Roblox, Fortnite (UEFN), and emerging UGC platforms, you'll shape how our work shows up in the spaces where audiences play, create, and connect.

This is an hourly freelance position, with expected availability during PST core hours M-F 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM.

Requirements

•
Visual Direction: Own and define the art direction for Sawhorse's branded Roblox experiences, from initial pitch and concept through launch and live updates.

•
Style Guides and Standards: Establish style guides, color scripts, asset specifications, and polycount and texture budgets that keep every project consistent and production-ready.

•
Pitch and Concept Development: Lead visual development for client pitches, creating mood boards, key art, concept sketches, and environment paintovers that sell the idea and set the tone for production.

•
Brand to Platform Translation: Translate brand guidelines and IP into Roblox-native visual languages that feel authentic to the community while staying true to partner brands.

•
Art Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and review the work of 3D artists, environment artists, UI designers, VFX artists, and animators, providing clear and actionable creative feedback.

•
Art Pipeline Ownership: Build and manage art pipelines across Blender, Maya, Substance 3D Painter, and Roblox Studio, moving assets from concept and blockout to optimized, in-engine delivery.

•
Performance and Optimization: Partner with Technical Artists and Roblox engineers to balance visual ambition with performance across mobile, console, PC, and VR, including mesh, texture, and lighting optimization.

•
UI and UX Direction: Oversee the look and feel of in-experience UI, HUDs, icons, shop interfaces, and onboarding flows so every touchpoint is clear, on-brand, and intuitive for Roblox players.

•
Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Game Designers, Producers, Creative Directors, and Sawhorse's commercial production and post teams to align art with gameplay, narrative, and campaign goals.

•
Client Presentations: Present creative direction, work-in-progress, and final art to clients and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while protecting the creative vision.

•
Marketing and Launch Assets: Direct key art, experience thumbnails, icons, trailers, and social assets that drive discovery and engagement on and off platform.

•
Quality Control: Drive art reviews and sign-off checkpoints at every milestone to maintain a high bar for craft, consistency, and on-time delivery.

•
Trend and Platform Awareness: Stay ahead of Roblox platform updates, top-performing experiences, avatar and UGC trends, and emerging tools, including generative AI workflows, to keep Sawhorse's work innovative.

Qualifications

A strong candidate for this position should have the following qualities:

•
Experience: 5+ years of experience as an Art Director, Lead Artist, or similar role within games, interactive media, or branded digital experiences, including 2+ years of hands-on work on Roblox.

•
Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating art direction on shipped games or branded experiences, with clear examples of Roblox work and range across multiple stylized art styles.

•
Roblox Studio Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of Roblox Studio, including lighting, materials, MeshParts, SurfaceAppearance, and the technical constraints of building for the platform.

•
3D and Design Tools: Proficiency in Blender or Maya, Substance 3D Painter, and Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with the ability to create or paint over assets directly.

•
Art Fundamentals: Strong command of composition, color theory, lighting, shape language, and visual storytelling across characters, environments, and UI.

•
Real-Time Pipeline Knowledge: Solid understanding of real-time art pipelines, including polycount budgets, UVs, texture atlasing, LODs, and performance optimization for mobile-first audiences.

•
Team Leadership: Proven experience leading and mentoring art teams, including in-house artists and external or outsourced contributors.

•
Brand and Client Experience: Experience working with brands, IP holders, or agency partners, translating brand guidelines into game-ready visual systems.

•
Communication: Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate creative decisions to both technical teams and non-technical clients.

•
Platform Fluency: Active, first-hand knowledge of the Roblox ecosystem, player culture, and what makes top experiences succeed visually.

Nice To Have's

• Experience with Fortnite Creative and UEFN, Minecraft, or other UGC gaming platforms

• Background designing Roblox avatar items, accessories, or Marketplace UGC

• Familiarity with generative AI tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or Stable Diffusion for concepting and look development

• Experience with Unreal Engine 5 or Unity

• Background in commercial production, animation, or agency art direction

• Motion design or trailer editing skills in After Effects or Premiere Pro

Benefits

$45 - $60 per hour

EEO Statement

Sawhorse Productions is an equal employment opportunity employer. All employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of their qualifications, consistent with applicable state and federal laws. In addition, Sawhorse Productions will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Sawhorse Productions will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and federal law.

description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

Mission

As a Lead Economy Designer (Hybrid RPG), you’ll play a key role in shaping the commercial destiny of our RPG portfolio. You won’t be supporting someone else’s economy, you’ll own it. Across multiple live titles, you’ll be the person who decides how players earn, spend, and engage, and your decisions will be the difference between a game that stagnates and one that scales into global top rankings. Your main responsibilities will include:

•
Design scalable RPG economy systems: build a core economic model that becomes a replicable strategic asset across titles, not a one-off rebuild per game

•
Own the economic impact of every product feature: assess KPI implications before launch, produce risk-adjusted roadmaps, and ensure the team always knows what’s at stake

•
Define pricing, sink/source balancing, and offer targeting strategies: create the full monetization architecture that drives IAP conversion and long-term player engagement

•
Build economy simulations and data models: own all quantitative economy work end-to-end, from raw data analysis to live balancing decisions

•
Partner directly with studios and publishing teams: translate complex economy frameworks into clear, actionable guidance that small teams can implement without friction

This is a great opportunity to own the economy across multiple live titles simultaneously, a rare scope in this industry, make your impact measurable in revenue and player KPIs, and operate at the intersection of product, game design, and data in a team that moves fast and plays to win.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with years of experience in free-to-play RPG economy design, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You’re a great fit if you have:

•
Direct RPG - F2P economy ownership: you’ve designed and driven the core economy of a free-to-play RPG title end-to-end, not just contributed to sub-loops

•
Strong data analysis skills: SQL is a must; you read game data fluently and translate it into clear economic decisions

•
Hands-on execution mindset: you go into the details, you implement, and you iterate; you don’t hand over a framework and walk away

•
Structured thinking and clear documentation: your work is organized, your outputs are legible, and studios can act on what you produce

•
Strong communication skills: written and verbal; you can align distributed studio teams remotely without losing clarity or momentum

Bonus points if you have:

• Python or R experience for economic modeling and simulation

• Basic Unity knowledge for direct studio collaboration

• Experience on titles with significant IAP in the top 200 grossing RPG charts

• An AI-native workflow: you actively use AI to build models, speed up analysis, and multiply your output

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Our Culture

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

•
Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.

•
Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.

•
Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.

•
Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

•
🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.

•
🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

•
🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

•
🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

•
✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

•
📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

•
💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you’re working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you’re based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Overview:
Creative Chaos is seeking a talented 3D Designer/Animator to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will create stunning 3D models and animations that contribute to our gaming and multimedia projects. You will work closely with our artists and game designers to bring characters, environments, and visual storytelling to life. If you have a passion for design and animation, along with a strong portfolio showcasing your skills, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

• Create high-quality 3D models and animations for characters, environments, and props.

• Develop and implement animations using various techniques, ensuring fluid and lifelike movement.

• Collaborate with designers and artists to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.

• Optimize 3D models and animations for performance across multiple platforms.

• Modify and refine existing assets based on feedback, ensuring continuous improvement and adherence to project goals.

• Stay current with industry trends and advancements in 3D design and animation technology.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Animation, Graphic Design, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in 3D modeling and animation.

• Proficiency in Blender. Cinema 4D or related software

• Proficiency with materials, texturing, and rendering processes

• Ability to 3D model various products and accessories from static photos and measurements, and create high-quality, photorealistic renderings

• Strong understanding of animation principles and character rigging.

• Experience with texture mapping, lighting, and rendering.

• Excellent portfolio demonstrating your 3D design and animation skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

• Strong attention to detail and a passion for high-quality visual storytelling.

• Familiarity with game engines like Unity or Unreal Engine is a plus.

Benefits

• Paid Time Off

• Work From Home

• Health Insurance

• OPD

• Training and Development

• Life Insurance

title: Unreal Engine Level Designer
description:
In this volunteer position you will be asked to create landscapes and building interiors for The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO), based off concepts and layouts, in the Unreal Engine. We are still building a long list of assets; we expect our Level Designers to be resourceful with the assets they use. We also expect you to use various Houdini Tools that we've built, so Houdini is recommended, but not required. Blueprint Scripting and Quixel Megascans experience is also recommended.

Communication is key to a smooth and efficient pipeline. You must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with other team-members. Don't be afraid to ask questions. We are an English-speaking team, so English fluency is a must. All of this is especially important for Level Designers as we expect them to communicate with 3D Artists letting them know assets that are still needed.

If you are comfortable with teaching, you may be called upon to aid the more junior members of the team in any relevant area.

Other duties include following team policies (given through team orientation as upon acceptance to the team) as well as attending meetings through Slack (our instant message program that we use to communicate).

Minimum Requirements:

• Ability to create detailed landscapes and building interiors in Unreal Engine 4

• Ability to optimize with use of LODs (Level of Detail)

Recommended Requirements:

• Houdini experience, used for creating Procedural Development tools to be used in Unreal Engine

• Unreal Engine 4 Blueprint Scripting experience

• Quixel MegascansAsset Library usage

• Heightmap development experience

Required Software:

•
Epic Games' Unreal Engine 4:

Optional Software:

•
SideFX's Houdini: - we can provide Level Designer with a copy if needed

• Heightmapping Software (such as QuadSpinner Gaea:

Minimum Hardware Requirements:

• The ability to run Unreal Engine 4

• The disk space and Internet Speeds to download (Git Pull) at least 25 GB of game files

Epoch Games is a volunteer-based, all-online, global game development team. The Co-Founders of Epoch Games were originally part of a Modding Team developing the total conversion Middle Earth Roleplaying Project (MERP) mod for the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim:

Epoch Games is developing The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO). LoA:SO is an in-development indie open-world RPG set in an original fantasy world:

The game is being developed using Epic Games' Unreal Engine 4 (UE4):

See our Benefits page for more information about what we can (and can't) offer Team Members at this time:

The address listed is our central office, but we are working as a completely remote development team at this time. No relocation is necessary.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a UX designer for our Design System Team.

You will play a key role making open source software available to the world. Our Design function ensures the experience of the software and infrastructure we build is true to our intentions, and delivers the tools our community and customers need. The Design System UX designer makes that possible by defining, evolving and advocating for a consistent use of design system that scales across our products.

This role sits in the design system team reporting to Design Systems Management

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

• Building and evolving Canonical’s design system, ensuring measurable adoption, consistency, scalability and accessibility across our products

• Collaborating with designers, engineers and stakeholders to translate user needs and brand principles into reusable components, patterns and guidelines

• Championing design system best practices, advocating for cohesive user experience and design, providing documentation and support for cross-functional teams

• Designing and documenting UI components, design tokens and interaction patterns

• Ensuring timely and efficient delivery of the roadmap

• Enabling alignment on design system usage and governance across teams

• Advocating for accessibility, performance, and scalability in design system decisions and iterating based on data and technological advancements

• Staying ahead of industry trends, ensuring innovation and balancing it with system coherence and performance

What we are looking for in you

• Relevant experience in UX/product design, with a strong focus on design systems in complex environments

• A portfolio demonstrating strong expertise in design systems, including component libraries, documentation and handling complex environments

• Exceptional educational achievements in design or related behavioral science discipline

• Expertise in Figma, Storybook and design token workflows

• Experience of collaborating with engineers and bridging design and code

• Proven ability to apply design process and clearly communicate and document design decisions

• Excellent attention to detail and systemic approach to solving complex design challenges

• Commitment to transparent project delivery and owning team deadlines

• A passion for balancing consistency and innovation

• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Read more about the design team

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Job Overview

Team: Ivans UX

Salary Range: $120,000-$165,000 USD

Location: Remote US and Canada

Opportunity for Impact

Ivans, a division of Applied Systems, is where insurance technology gets reinvented, and we build it fast. Our cloud software and AI-powered solutions reach thousands of agencies and brokers worldwide, setting the pace for what modern insurance can do.

We’re looking for a Lead UX Designer to join our UX team. This person will be designing complex, multi-step, high-volume workflows that insurance agents will use over and over. Success will result in removing time, friction, and errors. The Lead UX Designer will shape strategic direction for this major initiative, providing product vision and leadership to this critical initiative.

What You’ll Do

Planning and Process

• Defines UX strategies and frameworks for multi‑team initiatives.

• Leads planning sessions to align scope, timeline, and success metrics across disciplines.

• Ensures UX activities connect seamlessly to product and business roadmaps.

UX Research

• Shapes research agendas and ensures insights and tangible success metrics drive cross‑product decisions.

• Integrates data from multiple sources to inform strategic design direction.

• Guides research prioritization and alignment across teams or product lines.

Information Architecture

• Creates scalable IA frameworks and models that span multiple workflows and systems.

• Aligns content structures and naming conventions across teams for consistency.

• Validates navigation frameworks through iterative testing and stakeholder review.

Interaction Design

• Designs system‑level interaction models that unify patterns across products.

• Leads development of design frameworks that support reusable experiences.

• Mentors peers in designing for scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.

Visual Design

• Defines visual direction for complex experiences and ensures system alignment.

• Shapes evolution of visual standards within the design system.

• Drives collaboration with engineering and marketing to maintain brand coherence.

Deploying

• Oversees design delivery and implementation planning across product teams.

• Defines and enforces standards for QA, design fidelity, and usability validation.

• Collaborates with engineering leads to improve handoff tools and processes.

Facilitation

• Facilitates high‑impact design workshops and cross‑disciplinary planning sessions.

• Navigates competing priorities and builds alignment through structured discussion.

• Mentors others in effective facilitation and decision‑making practices.

Storytelling

• Delivers compelling design narratives that shape vision and inspire action.

• Translates design strategy into clear, audience‑specific communication.

• Coaches teams in developing storytelling skills for stakeholder alignment.

Key Performance Outcomes

• Execution: Defines and delivers UX strategies that align product vision with user needs and business goals.

• Insights: Applies research & design leadership across complex initiatives, resulting in depth of user understanding and accurate prioritization of highest impact unknowns, and highest business value opportunities.

• Impact: Ensures design consistency across large product areas through system-level thinking and coaching. Raises UX quality through formal and informal mentorship, critique, and design guidance.

What We’re Looking For

• B2B complex interaction design experience, crafting multi-step, high-volume workflows.

• 7+ years of experience in UX/product design, with at least 2 years in a leadership or strategic role.

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Design, HCI, or a related discipline — or equivalent senior experience.

• Proven success leading large-scale design efforts with measurable business and user impact.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating design leadership across complex, shipped digital products.

title: Design Lead, Consumer
description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

• TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)

• Fortune Change the World (2024)

• CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

• Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)

• Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the role

We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.

What You'll Do:

• We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.

• This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.

• It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.

• You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.

• You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.

• You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.

• The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.

What You'll Bring:

• 7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.

• Experience formally managing or leading design teams.

• Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.

• A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.

• Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.

• Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.

• A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.

We’d especially love to see

• Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.

• Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.

• Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.

The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:
