title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Job Description

Team: Ivans UX

Salary Range: $120,000-$165,000 USD

Location: Remote US and Canada

Opportunity for Impact

Ivans, a division of Applied Systems, is where insurance technology gets reinvented, and we build it fast. Our cloud software and AI-powered solutions reach thousands of agencies and brokers worldwide, setting the pace for what modern insurance can do.

We’re looking for a Lead UX Designer to join our UX team. This person will be designing complex, multi-step, high-volume workflows that insurance agents will use over and over. Success will result in removing time, friction, and errors. The Lead UX Designer will shape strategic direction for this major initiative, providing product vision and leadership to this critical initiative.

What You’ll Do

Planning and Process

• Defines UX strategies and frameworks for multi‑team initiatives.

• Leads planning sessions to align scope, timeline, and success metrics across disciplines.

• Ensures UX activities connect seamlessly to product and business roadmaps.

UX Research

• Shapes research agendas and ensures insights and tangible success metrics drive cross‑product decisions.

• Integrates data from multiple sources to inform strategic design direction.

• Guides research prioritization and alignment across teams or product lines.

Information Architecture

• Creates scalable IA frameworks and models that span multiple workflows and systems.

• Aligns content structures and naming conventions across teams for consistency.

• Validates navigation frameworks through iterative testing and stakeholder review.

Interaction Design

• Designs system‑level interaction models that unify patterns across products.

• Leads development of design frameworks that support reusable experiences.

• Mentors peers in designing for scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.

Visual Design

• Defines visual direction for complex experiences and ensures system alignment.

• Shapes evolution of visual standards within the design system.

• Drives collaboration with engineering and marketing to maintain brand coherence.

Deploying

• Oversees design delivery and implementation planning across product teams.

• Defines and enforces standards for QA, design fidelity, and usability validation.

• Collaborates with engineering leads to improve handoff tools and processes.

Facilitation

• Facilitates high‑impact design workshops and cross‑disciplinary planning sessions.

• Navigates competing priorities and builds alignment through structured discussion.

• Mentors others in effective facilitation and decision‑making practices.

Storytelling

• Delivers compelling design narratives that shape vision and inspire action.

• Translates design strategy into clear, audience‑specific communication.

• Coaches teams in developing storytelling skills for stakeholder alignment.

Key Performance Outcomes

• Execution: Defines and delivers UX strategies that align product vision with user needs and business goals.

• Insights: Applies research & design leadership across complex initiatives, resulting in depth of user understanding and accurate prioritization of highest impact unknowns, and highest business value opportunities.

• Impact: Ensures design consistency across large product areas through system-level thinking and coaching. Raises UX quality through formal and informal mentorship, critique, and design guidance.

What We’re Looking For

• B2B complex interaction design experience, crafting multi-step, high-volume workflows.

• 7+ years of experience in UX/product design, with at least 2 years in a leadership or strategic role.

• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Design, HCI, or a related discipline — or equivalent senior experience.

• Proven success leading large-scale design efforts with measurable business and user impact.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating design leadership across complex, shipped digital products.

• Deep experience with user research, design systems, and interaction models.

• Expert-level skills in design and collaboration tools (Figma, Miro, etc.).

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading in environments with shifting priorities.

• Mastery of UX design principles, systems thinking, interaction models, and product strategy alignment.

• Exceptional facilitation and communication skills; able to influence senior stakeholders and guide decision-making.

• Deep understanding of research methodologies and their strategic application.

• Ability to coach designers through complex problem spaces and grow team capability.

• Experience working across multiple product domains or platforms.

• Knowledge of technical constraints and development workflows; collaborates effectively with engineering.

• Experience working across multiple product domains and stakeholder groups.

Bonus points if you also have:

• Visionary thinking with the ability to drive long-term design impact while delivering in the short term.

Talent shows up in a lot of different ways, and we mean that. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels, including military members and their spouses and those without a traditional degree or tech background. If this role speaks to you, apply.

Why You’ll Like Working on Team Applied

The best work happens when smart people move fast, together. For over 40+ years, Applied has built technology that solves real problems for insurance professionals - and we’re still pushing what’s possible.

You’ll be part of our people-first culture built on trust, inclusion, and growth - where you’re supported to deliver, collaborate with teammates who care, and grow with leaders invested in your success.

How We’ll Support You

We invest in the whole person, not just the role. Our benefits and resources are built to support your health, your time, and your life outside of work:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

• Holiday and Vacation Time

• Health & Wellness Days

• A Bonus Day for Your Birthday

Compensation Transparency

Our targeted starting base salary in the United States for this position considers a variety of factors, including depth and breadth of experience, skills and role scope. Depending on the role, team members may also be eligible for additional compensation plans (bonus and commission).

Your Security Matters:

Our candidates’ personal information and online safety are top of mind. Applied communicates with candidates only via a secure @appliedsystems.com email address or through our official careers portal. Recruiters will never request payments or ask for financial account or sensitive personal information like Social Security numbers.

AI Utilization

We leverage AI tools to streamline parts of our recruitment workflow (such as resume parsing and interview scheduling). However, final decisions are always conducted by real humans.

EEO Statement

Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. At Applied, we don’t discriminate, and we are committed to recruit, develop, retain, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Product Designer, AI Platform
description:
About Gladly

For business leaders who want to get AI right, Gladly is the only customer experience AI that delivers the cost savings they need AND the customer devotion that drives lasting business value. With over a decade of singular CX focus and trusted by the world's most customer-centric brands including Crate & Barrel, Breeze Airways, and Ulta Beauty, Gladly was designed for devotion, not deflection: purpose-built to engage customers and turn every conversation into lasting relationship equity. The result is experiences that are radically personal and effortlessly scalable, emotionally intelligent and operationally efficient.

At the heart of our simply powerful platform, Gladly maintains one continuous conversation across all channels while striking the perfect balance of AI and human connection. With 450M+ conversations powered globally, $510M+ cumulative cost savings delivered for customers, and a 65% increase in CSAT, this is a team where your work has real impact at scale. Learn more at.

About the role

You will own product design for the Agent Harness, the part of Gladly AI where teams build, test, launch, monitor, and improve AI agents. Your surface spans both sides of the harness.

• On the side Gladly controls, the agent itself and the channels it works across, your job is helping AI handle more conversations end to end without a human.

• On the side our customers control, the reporting, simulations, and configuration tools brands use to improve their own agents, your job is making every change a customer ships drive more revenue and resolutions.

This is a generalist role where range matters more than depth in any single discipline. In a given week, you might design an eval review workflow, prototype an agent-steering interaction, tighten the design system components that every team consumes, and review UI that shipped without a designer touching it. Much of the product surface at Gladly is now built with AI-assisted tools by engineers and PMs, so a core part of this job is setting and elevating the quality bar for interfaces you didn't author: through the design system, through review, and through taste.

Thoughtful problem-solvers do well here. They dig into the problem before the fix, make their case clearly, and hold strong opinions loosely. The best work usually has more than one mind in it, so we look for designers who seek out other people's ideas and treat them as well as their own.

What you'll own

• End-to-end product design for the Agent Harness: research, flows, interaction design, and visual design for the tools teams use to configure, steer, and evaluate AI agents.

• The shared design library: components, patterns, and guidelines that keep quality high across every team, including teams shipping UI without a dedicated designer.

• Direction on the undefined problems: taking a product area where the direction is still ambiguous, finding the real problem in it, and giving the team something concrete to build toward.

• Design quality across your product areas, including reviewing and elevating AI-generated and engineer-built UI rather than personally producing every screen.

• Prototyping as a first-class design tool: working prototypes, built fast with AI-assisted tooling, used to test ideas with users and align teams before a line of production code is written.

• Designers here shape the practice as well as the product. You'll have real say in the critique rituals, review norms, and craft standards we already run on, and in where they go next.

What we're looking for

• A strong generalist portfolio spanning complex workflow tools, systems thinking, and polished visual craft, ideally including AI product surfaces such as conversational interfaces, agent configuration and oversight tools, or evaluation/observability dashboards.

• Fluency with AI-assisted prototyping and design tooling as part of your daily workflow (going from idea to working prototype in a matter of hours) and a clear point of view on where AI accelerates design work and where human judgment is non-negotiable.

• Experience designing for AI-native products: interfaces where the system's behavior is probabilistic, where trust and steering matter, and where the design problem is as much about legibility and control as about pixels.

• Comfort operating as the design owner for surfaces you didn't personally build: giving crisp, actionable feedback, encoding standards into reusable systems, and raising the bar without being a bottleneck.

• Demonstrated senior-IC judgment: you scope your own work, make progress before the problem is fully defined, carry multiple product areas at once, and operate with minimal oversight.

What this role is not

• This is not a people-management role; it is a senior individual contributor position reporting to the Head of Product.

• This is not a specialist role in a single discipline (pure UX research, pure visual design, or pure design systems); it deliberately spans all of them.

• This is not a brand or marketing design role; it is product design for our AI platform.

Compensation:

$150,000 to $185,000 annual salary + equity + benefits

For cash compensation, we set standard ranges for all U.S.-based roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Why Join Gladly?

Gladly is redefining customer experience AI; we're designed for devotion, not deflection. We put people at the center of everything we build, from our platform to our culture. When you join us, you'll enjoy:

• Competitive salaries, stock options, and comprehensive benefits

• Generous paid time off, parental leave, and home office stipends

• A fully remote work environment with opportunities for in-person team gatherings

• A strong commitment to professional growth and an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives thrive

• A company where AI is not a buzzword. We build AI products and we expect our team to use AI tools daily

We're a team that believes in transparency, collaboration, and the idea that the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together. Top talent, good vibes, no politics. If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. The perspectives and experiences you bring matter more than checking every box.

• Passion pour l'innovation et une compréhension approfondie des dernières tendances et technologies dans le développement de jeux et le rendu en temps réel.

• Maîtrise des langages de script tels que Python, Blueprints ou C++ pour le développement d'outils et l'automatisation dans Unreal Engine.

• Solide compréhension de l'intégration des VFX et des systèmes de particules en temps réel dans Unreal Engine 5.

• Familiarité avec les exigences spécifiques aux plateformes et les techniques d'optimisation pour les consoles et les PC haut de gamme.

• Strong ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, including gameplay, animation, and art teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Company Description

Établie à Montréal, Game On a initialement émergé comme une maison de production audio pour soutenir les développeurs de jeux. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une force continue d'innovation, d'expérimentation et de collaboration créative dans l'industrie du jeu. Notre mission est de soutenir les productions, du script au dernier pixel.

Founded in 2002, Game On started as an audio postproduction house that forayed into facial capture before spawning one of the largest motion-capture studios in the world. We are now a full-service animation production studio - a turnkey studio that translates scripts into vibrant final products.

title: Senior Visual (UI/UX) Designer
description:
The Role

The Senior Visual Designer translates design concepts into wireframes and high fidelity according to the project requirements, technical capabilities and limitations, product objective, as well as Bonza’s brand personality and design styles to its users. He/She also explores new design ideas through creating sketches, building mock-ups, and design prototypes. He/She conducts visual audit, visual design research on competitors’ products and market trends, using data-driven insights to uncover new ways of visual delivery and provide recommendations to the relevant stakeholders.

The Senior Visual Designer is responsible for the overall solution of the visual forms of the design output and its user experience. Therefore he/she possesses skills not only producing visual output –either in the format of illustrations, low fidelity to high fidelity user interface, and/or animation/motion graphics–, but also creating a great and seamless user experience of the product. To make sure the product is well-fitted to the other and overall Bonza's products, He/She ought to create suitable product flow and the foundational information architecture of the product.

To obtain optimal product fit and quality, he/she is able to juggle on multiple tasks in parallel and getting involved across end-to-end project phases. At the same time, He/She needs to maintain high quality design solutions that meet overall business and product objectives while dealing with some changes and iterations. In addition, he/she demonstrates stakeholder management skills in partnering with internal stakeholders to align on the design decisions at each of the design phase.

Job Description

Deliver and Enhance Design Output

• Create relevant visualisations based on the design concepts and requirements

• Map out the best-fitted design and product flow while at the same time laying out the relevant information architecture based on the different requirements of the product

• Execute sketch, prototypes, visualisations, and mock-ups design for the development

• Generate ideas for new design concepts and prototypes

• Participate in design research and workshop activities for insights gathering, if necessary

• Prototype and iterate the design output in order to be readily implemented for development

• Conduct usability and concept testing of design prototypes in laboratory, remotely, or real-life setting

• Analyse and synthesize user and/or expert feedback of the visual elements, user interface experience, as well as overall quality of the design solution

• Incorporate feedback from previous iterations of designs into relevant mock-ups

• Recommend refinements and iterations to design based on usability and concept testing results

• Maintaining and advocating the use of UI kit and/or Design System to the peer designers and stakeholders

• Demonstrate deep level of crafting visual design aesthetics that balance the alignment with brand guidelines while suggesting innovative design solution

• Recognise as many constraints as possible as a prevention to inform the continuous development and iteration of the products and its features to work within the constraints

Manage and Execute Design Research Projects

• Understand the research context based on business requirements as well as stakeholders' goals and expectations and incorporate them into the research scope and plan, including the formulation of the research questions

• Based on the research questions, identify the most relevant methodology, methods, and create research tools as well as define the sampling strategy and research participants

• Plan and prepare all essentials logistics and documentations for the research execution, including logistics for participants recruitments and schedule arrangement

• Collect research data based on the research plan, could be using quantitative and/or qualitative approach that are relevant to answer the research questions and achieve the project, research, and design goal

• Analyse and synthesize data collected from the research, draw conclusions on some pattern of findings that could help formulate actionable insight to define opportunity areas and/or design solutions

• Uncover trends and patterns beyond research data to enlighten and inspire opportunity areas if necessary

• Liaise and communicate with relevant stakeholders to communicate design research insights, and when necessary, facilitate the discussion to craft actionable and relevant design solutions

Stakeholders Management and Team Collaboration

• Facilitate the discussion in framing the problems using appropriate design perspective with also considering users and business needs

• Holistically taking into account the perspectives from users, business, and technology requirements and/or needs and initiate the discussion on the multidisciplinary meetings, workshops, and sprints

• Provide guidance to peers and stakeholders for the implementation of appropriate design research practice and user-centric solutions

• Collaborate with the Product Management, Business, and/or Engineering team to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals, and experience

Minimum Requirements

• Between 4–6 years overall work experience as a hands-on Designer in a digital product industry

• Portfolio that showcases visual design output (and its rationale of the output) with some level of understanding of the Human Centered Design methodology/method/tools and willingness to learn and iterate.

• Have been involved and/or created design system is preferable

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree range from Visual Communication Design, Interaction Design, Product Design, Service Design, Design Strategy or any other relevant Digital Design disciplines; or Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science; or other related field, with equivalent practical design experience

• The ability to form agreement across a fast-moving organization through excellent communication and interpersonal skills (including: negotiation, constructive feedback, presentation, managing expectations, resolve conflicts).

• Experience working with web or mobile based technologies using design and prototyping tools (mainly Figma, but also familiar with Sketch, Balsamiq, Adobe, ProtoPie, Miro, etc.)

• A sense of responsibility, adaptability, embracing ambiguity, and working collaboratively in a fast moving and agile setting

• Quick self learner and highly self-motivated with strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver

• Have mentored more juniors designers and/or led one or multiple end-to-end design projects are plus points

• Proficiency in Indonesian language (both verbal and written) and able to communicate in basic English (both verbal and written)

• Plus point for familiarity using data based technologies for data analytics and/or visualisation (such as Excel, Tableau, DOMO, Data Studio, SQL, R, etc)

What’s on offer

• To be part of Indonesia’s fastest growing data analytics company

• A great work culture, with coaching, massive ownership and growth opportunities

• Data driven, quick iterations, and deployment - fail-fast attitude

• Attractive remuneration package and insurance coverage

About Bonza
Bonza is a low-to-no code collaborative data engineering and analytics platform. We build powerful tools for everyone to automate data workflows and operationalize analytics. Established in 2020 with offices in Jakarta and Singapore, our mission is to empower entire organizations to derive intelligent insights and take decisive actions where we bring together disparate data into a single source of truth to bring clarity into actions and deploy data driven decisions at-scale.
We are driven to make a difference- Bonza is the first Indonesia dashboard to track the spread of Covid-19 in Indonesia.

Now, as our business grows, we are looking for great talent to join our family!

Stability. We've been in business for over 25 years.

Work stays at work. We promote a healthy work/life balance to help ensure you have the time that you need. We encourage no more than a 40 hour work week.

Great company culture. We’ve been recognized by Texas Monthly, Clutch, Comparably, and more for the quality of our workplace. Feel free to check out our rating on Glassdoor.

We’re here to empower you. It’s your work and your career. Our management team is here to help you become who you want to be. Not to micromanage you.

Stay healthy. We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as wellness days. We also provide disability insurance and we even have a wellness program.

Plan for the future. We don’t want you to work here forever. Save for retirement with an IRA and we’ll match up to 3% every year.

We value your ideas. At Praxent, our doors are always open. Need help? Come on in. Have a vision for the future of the company? We’d love to hear it.

Rest and relaxation. Employees enjoy 15 days of PTO, 9 US holidays, 5 wellness days, and a closed office the last week of the year. Employees earn more PTO each year.

You’re more than an employee, you’re a person. Every co-worker you’ll meet is committed to treating you with respect and kindness. You won’t hear stuff like, “It’s just business.”

•
Family values. Praxent provides paid parental leave.

title: Senior Game Puzzle Design Artist (Themed Visuals & Motion) - Remote Dayshift
description:
Position: Senior Puzzle Design Artist (Themed Visuals & Motion)

Salary: Php 80,000 - 100,000 per month

Working Hours & Conditions: New Zealand Hours

Holidays: Public holidays in New Zealand

About the Role

You'll take the puzzles we create and turn them into finished, on-theme visual assets (every question and its matching answer slide) that look like they belong inside a polished game, not a slideshow. Early on we'll hold your hand: we'll hand you each puzzle, a clear brief, and a moodboard for the theme's look and feel. From there, you run the artwork end to end.

Our production pipeline often uses AI to generate raw imagery (we mostly use Gemini, but we're not precious about the tool; if something else gets a better result, use it), which you then composite, retouch and lay out in the Adobe suite into final, export-ready assets. For the more involved questions, you'll build animated versions in After Effects.

This is a senior, largely self-directed role. We want someone with the design judgement to know what good looks like without being told, the range to shift convincingly between wildly different visual styles, and the reliability to deliver a full theme on schedule with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

• Turn briefed puzzles into polished, on-theme visual assets - one finished slide per question, plus a corresponding answer slide for each that shows the answer and often how the puzzle is solved.

• Generate source imagery with AI tools, then direct, curate and clean up that output — you have the eye to know when it's working and the skill to fix it when it isn't.

• Composite, retouch and lay out final artwork in (but not limited to) Photoshop and Illustrator, exporting to AVIF.

• Build animated question slides in After Effects, exporting to MP4, for the more complex puzzles.

• Adapt convincingly to a different visual style for every theme. It could be anime one week, photoreal Rome the next, pixel-art parody after that. Range matters more than a signature look.

• Spot problems in briefs and puzzles before they reach an audience, and either flag them clearly or solve them yourself.

Requirements

• Senior-level design experience. You have strong, independent design instincts and don't need to be told what good design is. You set the bar yourself. This is not a junior role.

• Expert Adobe skills. Deep command of Photoshop and Illustrator, and confident in After Effects for motion. You must own and work in the Adobe suite so files transfer cleanly and we can make edits on our end without disruption.

• Genuine stylistic range. You can move between very different aesthetics — illustrated, photoreal, retro-game, and more — and make each look intentional and high-quality.

• Hands-on with AI image generation. You know how to brief it, push it, and refine its output into something that meets a professional standard.

• Strong written English. Clear enough to describe a puzzle accurately, write answer-slide explanations, and give us sharp, useful feedback when something in a brief doesn't add up.

• Self-managing and deadline-driven. You can work with minimal oversight, keep your own pace, and hit delivery dates reliably.

accessible

title: Senior Slot Game Designer
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Slot Game Designer with a passion for creating engaging, high-performing slot experiences. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep mathematical expertise with a strong understanding of player psychology and data-driven design.

You will participate the development of innovative slot concepts from ideation through launch, ensuring games are mathematically sound, emotionally engaging and commercially successful. This position plays a critical role in defining gameplay mechanics, verifying all mathematical calculations, and shaping player-centric experiences that resonate in the market.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Slot Game Designer, you will:

• Lead the creation of original mathematical models, game themes, and innovative slot mechanics.

• Design and own slot game concepts from ideation to final delivery, focusing on entertainment value, pacing, volatility, RTP structure, and long-term engagement.

• Develop and verify all mathematical calculations and simulations to ensure regulatory compliance and optimal performance.

• Collaborate closely with mathematicians to refine mechanics and balance risk-reward structures.

• Work cross-functionally with producers, animators, sound designers, engineers, and product teams to ensure cohesive execution.

• Interpret creative briefs and align game concepts with overall product strategy and market positioning.

• Utilize player data and analytics to inform design decisions and optimize mechanics pre- and post-launch.

• Create detailed Game Design Documents (GDDs) and pitch materials that clearly communicate gameplay mechanics, feature flow, and player experience goals.

• Playtest and iterate on in-development games, providing structured feedback on math, UI, pacing, art, and sound integration.

• Support external partners with clear explanations of game mechanics and value propositions to maximize commercial success.

• Analyze post-launch performance data and apply learnings to future releases.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Game Design or equivalent professional experience.

• 4–5+ years of proven experience in slot game design with successful released titles.

• Strong proficiency in Excel for modeling, simulations, and probability calculations.

• Deep knowledge of Combinatorics, Probability Theory, and Statistics.

• Demonstrated ability to translate player insights and performance data into optimized design decisions.

• Strong understanding of pacing, visual choreography, and entertainment flow in slot gameplay.

• Experience using visual design or storyboarding tools to communicate concepts.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.

• Strong digital portfolio showcasing relevant slot or gaming work.

Keys to Success

• Builds strong collaborative relationships across departments

• Makes informed, data-driven decisions

• Drives results with ownership mindset

• Fosters innovation in mechanics and player engagement

• Brings high personal energy and accountability

• Demonstrates self-leadership in a feedback-driven environment

Gameloft Montréal recherche un(e) Artiste technique pour rejoindre l'équipe qui travaille sur Disney Dreamlight Valley, un jeu hybride de simulation de vie et d'aventure multiplateforme !

Rempli de quêtes, d'exploration et d'activités captivantes avec des personnages emblématiques de Disney et Pixar, Disney Dreamlight Valley est une production originale de Gameloft Montréal créée par une équipe passionnée impatiente de vous accueillir !

Bande-annonce :
officiel :

Il ou elle veille à répondre à toutes les attentes artistiques et de design, dans le respect des contraintes de performance et des délais de production.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Pipeline et outils

• Superviser et tenir à jour le pipeline des ressources artistiques, et détecter les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent une version.

Performance et optimisation

• Établir des budgets par asset (nombre de triangles, densité de texels, nombre de matériaux, etc.) par scène ou par classe d'assets, et vérifier les nouvelles soumissions d'assets par rapport à ces budgets avant que les dépassements ne s'accumulent dans tout le projet.

• Examiner et corriger les bugs de matériaux/shaders (artefacts de profondeur et de tri, artefacts de mosaïquage, réponse PBR incorrecte, etc.).

• Valider les configurations de matériaux dans différentes conditions d'éclairage et sur les plateformes cibles.

Normes de l'équipe artistique

• Rédiger et mettre à jour les sections techniques du guide artistique (conventions de nomenclature, spécifications d'exportation, formats de textures, structure des dossiers, considérations d'optimisation, etc.), qui sont cruciales pour les artistes internes et les partenaires en sous-traitance.

• Former les nouveaux artistes aux outils de pipeline et appliquer les normes.

• Assumer le triage initial de tous les problèmes d'intégration des ressources.

• Définir et spécifier les demandes et caractéristiques du nouveau pipeline artistique.

• Évaluer et recommander de nouveaux outils, plugins et mises à niveau du pipeline.

Pipeline & Tooling

• Investigate and fix material/shader bugs (depth and sorting artifacts, tiling artifacts, incorrect PBR response, etc.).

Art Team Standards

• Write and maintain the Art Bible's technical sections (naming conventions, export specs, texture formats, folder structure, optimization considerations, etc.), which are critical for internal artists and outsourcing partners.

• Onboard new artists to pipeline tools and enforce standards.

• Own first-response triage for all art-to-engine issues.

• Scope and spec new art pipeline requests and features.

• Evaluate and recommend new tools, plugins, and pipeline upgrades.

Outils de création numérique

Shaders et matériaux

Atouts

Scentbird: The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment

•
Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.

In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.

title: Human-Centered Design Specialist IV - UI/UX
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Specialist III-IV - UI/UX to support the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) portfolio. This role will focus on creating intuitive, accessible, visually cohesive, and user-centered digital experiences based on stakeholder research and user needs.

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in user experience and user interface design, with demonstrated ability to translate research findings, workflows, and requirements into high-quality digital experiences. This individual will create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, interaction patterns, interface designs, and reusable design components that guide development teams from concept through implementation.

The role will work across the HCD lifecycle, including discovery, stakeholder engagement, design, prototyping, usability testing, and iteration. Compared with a technically oriented HCD role, this position will place greater emphasis on interaction design, visual hierarchy, interface behavior, usability, design systems, and the quality and consistency of the overall user experience.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

UI/UX and Product Design

• Design intuitive, effective, and visually cohesive user experiences for digital products supporting VA programs and stakeholders.

• Translate research findings, business requirements, user needs, and technical requirements into clear design concepts.

• Develop user flows, task flows, information architectures, navigation models, wireframes, interface designs, and interactive prototypes.

• Create low- through high-fidelity designs that enable stakeholders to experience and evaluate concepts before development.

• Design interface components, interaction patterns, layouts, forms, dashboards, workflows, and data-rich experiences.

• Establish and apply consistent visual and interaction patterns across digital products.

• Contribute to design systems, component libraries, UX standards, and reusable design assets where appropriate.

• Prepare clear developer handoff documentation and collaborate with technical teams during implementation.

• Participate in design reviews and provide design guidance as solutions move from prototype through development.

HCD Research and Discovery

• Conduct stakeholder interviews, user interviews, workshops, usability studies, and other HCD discovery activities.

• Help stakeholders articulate user goals, needs, frustrations, behaviors, workflows, and desired outcomes.

• Synthesize qualitative research into findings, themes, personas, user journeys, experience maps, design principles, and recommendations.

• Connect research findings directly to UI/UX design decisions.

• Develop and test design hypotheses through prototypes and iterative user feedback.

• Facilitate usability testing and translate test results into prioritized design improvements.

Accessibility and Inclusive Design

• Apply Section 508, WCAG, and inclusive-design requirements to digital experiences.

• Design for users with different abilities, levels of digital proficiency, roles, and operating environments.

• Incorporate accessibility considerations into navigation, forms, visual hierarchy, content presentation, interaction patterns, and prototypes.

• Collaborate with technical teams to address accessibility early rather than treating compliance as a final-stage review.

Magnify Reports and HCD Deliverables

• Support development of Magnify Reports, the formal HCD deliverable associated with each SBIR contract.

• Provide research findings, personas, journey maps, visualizations, prototype concepts, user feedback, and design recommendations for inclusion in formal HCD documentation.

• Develop polished visual artifacts and presentations to communicate findings and proposed experiences to client and internal stakeholders.

• Clearly document design rationale and trace significant design decisions back to user research or validated requirements.

Stakeholder and Team Collaboration

• Facilitate design sessions, co-design workshops, prototype reviews, and usability-testing sessions.

• Present design concepts and explain design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with HCD researchers, technical designers, developers, analysts, product owners, healthcare subject matter experts, and program leadership.

• Balance user needs, business requirements, accessibility considerations, and technical constraints when developing solutions.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies and integrate UX activities into iterative delivery cycles.

• Participate actively in LMI's HCD community of practice by sharing tools, templates, patterns, techniques, and lessons learned.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Human-Centered Design, User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Information Design, Psychology, or a related field.

• 5-7+ years of professional experience in UI/UX, product design, HCD, interaction design, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience designing digital products from early concept through prototype and development handoff.

• Strong proficiency with Figma or comparable modern UI/UX design and prototyping tools.

• Demonstrated experience developing user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished interface designs.

• Strong understanding of information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design principles.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Ability to translate research findings and complex requirements into intuitive user experiences.

• Knowledge of Section 508, WCAG, accessibility, and inclusive-design practices.

• Strong written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.

• Ability to independently organize and prioritize design work across multiple activities.

• Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Desired

• Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Computer Interaction, UX Design, Interaction Design, or a related field.

• Portfolio demonstrating UI/UX design, research-informed design decisions, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, or shipped digital experiences.

• Experience designing for federal government, healthcare, public-sector, or enterprise environments.

• Prior experience supporting VA or VHA programs.

• Experience designing dashboards, complex workflows, enterprise applications, or data-rich experiences.

• Experience creating or contributing to design systems and reusable component libraries.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, Power BI, or Microsoft 365 environments.

• Experience with Agile, Lean UX, Design Thinking, or iterative product development.

• Relevant UX, accessibility, HCD, or Agile certifications.

Target salary range: $100,000 - $130,000.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

title: Senior Product Design Strategist
description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

A Product + Design Strategist can carry a problem from an ambiguous user and business opportunity to a validated experience. As a Product + Design Strategist, you will operate at a senior IC level: leading the highest-leverage, most ambiguous scopes of work at Omada and setting direction for a collection of related experiences rather than a single feature. You translate engineering’s increased pace into more of the right experiences launched for our customers and members, not just more output.

AI is a core part of how this role works day to day as a co-intelligent partner you direct across research synthesis, prototyping, spec drafting, and analysis, extending your judgment so you can move from open question to validated direction faster, with more rigor.

You thrive in ambiguity, especially in 0 to 1 spaces where the problem is not yet defined and the path forward is yours to shape. You bring a strong, evidence-backed point of view, initiative and ability to find answers, and you're as comfortable in an executive strategy conversation as you are prototyping with users.

Core Responsibilities

A Product + Design Strategist owns four things — problem framing, direction setting, vision casting, and alignment. Everything else is craft in service of these.

Problem framing — turning ambiguous asks, business opportunities, and lived member experience into a scoped, evidence-backed understanding of what's actually wrong and worth solving.

• Problem framing & requirements — turning a vague ask into a scoped, buildable piece of work.

• User journey mapping — diagnosing end-to-end friction and drop-off with empathy.

• Research study design & execution — running interviews, surveys, and experiments to test assumptions.

• Data analysis (quant + qual) — pulling product performance data and synthesizing qualitative signal into a clear read of the problem.

• Competitive, inspiration, & analogous research — auditing adjacent products for pattern or gap insight.

• Metrics instrumentation — in partnership with data analytics, defining upfront what “solved” will actually look like.

Direction setting — reconciling research, data, engineering, and business input into a clear point of view on what to pursue, and revisiting that call against real evidence once it's live.

• Synthesis & direction-setting — recommending which directions to pursue and which to drop.

• Prioritization & trade-offs — arbitrating competing product and stakeholder requests with transparent rationale.

• Quantitative and qualitative evaluation design & analysis — defining core questions and hypotheses, then translating results into insights and go/no-go decisions.

• Stop/start/continue investment decisions — revisiting prior bets against evidence of what's actually working.

• Vendor & partner evaluations — build vs. buy justifications.

Vision casting — making the future state tangible and compelling enough that cross-functional partners, leadership, and members can see it and support it.

• Roadmap ownership & narrative — owning a multi-quarter roadmap that maps to corporate OKRs, key strategic initiatives, operational cadences, and commercial cycles.

• Executive communications & narratives — building the strategic story for budget and prioritization conversations.

• Product marketing & commercial partnerships — carrying the vision into go-to-market and partner contexts.

• Visual & interaction design — makes the vision tangible enough to inform viability, desirability, and feasibility decisions, and to support build and operational planning. Brings strong product taste, and can articulate what makes a health experience good in both strategic and tangible terms.

• Prototyping — building click-through and interactive prototypes to test and communicate ideas.

Alignment — keeping every function that touches the work — engineering, clinical, ops, leadership — moving on the same understanding of what's being built and why.

• Stakeholder syncs & demos — running team meetings, reviews, and critiques that keep work visible.

• Cross-functional handoff — prepping documents and prototypes that give build and operations teams clarity.

• Clinical, legal, and regulatory partnerships — integrating guidance on safety, quality, and compliance throughout.

• Launch & release readiness — owning the go/no-go call and sequencing logic for a release, in partnership with Product Ops, who runs the operational checklist and cross-team chase.

• Stakeholder alignment on product priorities and vision — resolving cross-functional disagreement directly.

Core Skills

Product + Design Strategists are T-shaped: every Strategist can operate across all of this at a working level, and leans deeper into a Design, PM, research, and/or operational specialty depending on the scope they're leading. The craft toolkit a Product + Design Strategist draws on includes:

• Prototyping — low- to high-fidelity mockups and click-through flows to test and communicate ideas, including coded experiences that give users and stakeholders a more immersive way to test.

• Visual & interaction design — applying design system components, typography, and interaction patterns to real screens and other touchpoints; drafting microcopy and in-product messaging.

• Writing PRDs/specs — documenting functional requirements and success metrics for engineering handoff.

• Backlog grooming & sprint planning — writing and prioritizing tickets, estimating scope with engineering.

• Product/design/research documentation — maintaining decision logs and research repositories so knowledge supports entire teams.

• Accessibility & QA review — checking designs and built product against accessibility standards.

• AI orchestration & prompting fluency — directing AI tools effectively across design, spec, and analysis work.

• Data-informed strategy — interpreting quantitative and qualitative data, such as product analytics and clinical outcomes, to inform product strategy and build.

• Facilitation — running workshops, critiques, and cross-functional working sessions in service of decisionmaking and alignment.

• Engineering/technical literacy — enough fluency to reason about feasibility and scope trade-offs in partnership with Eng and Ops.

We'd love to talk more if you have…

• 8+ years of experience solving complex, ambiguous problems across product management, design, and/or research, including a track record of owning outcomes at a multi-team level.

• 3-5 years of demonstrated success carrying work from 0 to 1 — defining new products or experiences from an undefined problem space through to a shipped, measurable result.

• A strong, evidence-based point of view, with the judgment to reconcile research, data, engineering, and business input into a clear direction — and the conviction to defend it and the humility to revise it.

• 3-5 years of experience owning a multi-quarter roadmap and communicating it persuasively to executive and cross-functional audiences, including budget and prioritization conversations.

• High craft in at least 2 specialist areas (design, product management, strategy, research, or operations), with genuine working fluency across the others.

• Excellence in prototyping, and fluency with modern AI-assisted prototyping and building tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Design, Figma Make, Cursor, Lovable, or similar) — this is a required, hands-on craft skill for this role, not a nice-to-have.

• Experience partnering with clinical, legal, regulatory, or other high-stakes compliance functions in health, wellness, fintech, or another regulated domain.

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with a 3-5 year track record of influencing decisions across senior leadership.

• Experience mentoring or informally leading other ICs, even without formal people-management responsibility.

• Fluency with AI orchestration and prompting across design, spec, and analysis work, and comfort pulling data directly from self-serve analytics tools.

Bonus points if you have…

• Experience designing or leading strategy for clinical, care delivery, or chronic condition management experiences.

• Experience building production-adjacent or fully coded prototypes.

• A background as a specialist in 2 areas (Design, PM, or Research) who has deliberately broadened into other health or technology disciplines rather than staying siloed.

• Experience in a startup setting, operating like a builder — self-driven, biased toward action, and energized by owning problems from discovery through launch.

• Experience running vendor and partner evaluations, including build-vs-buy business cases.

What this role is not:

To protect focus, Product + Design Strategists are not expected to own all day-to-day project coordination and status reporting (Product Ops and automated tooling own the checklist and cross-team chase once you've made the go/no-go call), detailed design of every screen and flow (owned by UX Design and Engineering, enabled by design-system-aware prototyping and coding tools), high-volume or specialized content production (owned by the content platform team), or administrative backlog upkeep (AI-assisted or Eng-owned). Formal people management of other Strategists sits with Product + Design Directors; Strategists at this level lead through influence, craft, and mentorship rather than direct reports.

Our Design Roots

Omada was founded in 2011 out of IDEO, where our founders explored how human-centered design could be applied to chronic health challenges. What began as an internal project grounded in deep user research evolved into a new approach to digital care.

That origin continues to shape how we work today. We place a strong emphasis on understanding real human needs, designing from first principles, and creating experiences that are not only effective, but engaging and thoughtfully crafted.

Design is not a layer at Omada. It is foundational to how we build products, make decisions, and deliver care.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

• Equity grants

• Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)

• Remote first work from home culture

• Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

• Generous parental leave

• Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)

• 401k retirement savings plan

• Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

• Mental Health Support Solutions

• ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

•
Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.

•
Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.

•
Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.

•
Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.

•
Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.

•
Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. About the Role

Invisible Colors is looking for a Freelance Brand Art Director to help shape distinctive visual identities and creative worlds for brands, campaigns, and experiences.

We’re looking for someone who can take a strategic idea and turn it into a strong visual point of view — from the initial concept and moodboards through to the development of complete brand systems and creative executions.

You have a strong understanding of branding and visual culture, but you’re not interested in following formulas. You know how to build visual languages that feel intentional, contemporary, and ownable, and you’re equally comfortable thinking big-picture or obsessing over the smallest detail.

This is a freelance opportunity with the potential to collaborate across a variety of projects, industries, and creative formats.

What You’ll Do

• Develop creative direction and visual concepts for new and evolving brands.

• Create and evolve brand identities, visual languages, and design systems.

• Translate brand strategy and positioning into compelling visual concepts.

• Develop moodboards, creative territories, visual references, and presentation decks.

• Establish art direction across typography, color, composition, imagery, illustration, motion, and other visual elements.

• Extend brand identities across digital, social, web, campaigns, print, physical environments, and experiential activations.

• Provide clear creative direction to designers, photographers, videographers, animators, and other creative partners.

• Collaborate with strategists, copywriters, designers, producers, and clients to develop ideas from concept through execution.

• Present and articulate creative concepts clearly, explaining the thinking behind the work.

• Ensure creative consistency and quality across multiple touchpoints and deliverables.

• Push concepts beyond the expected and identify opportunities to make the work more distinctive, culturally relevant, and memorable.

• Stay curious about emerging visual trends, technology, culture, AI, design, photography, fashion, music, and other influences that can inform creative work.

• Participate in creative brainstorms and contribute ideas beyond your immediate area of expertise.

• Adapt quickly between different brands, industries, creative challenges, and visual styles.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as an Art Director, Brand Art Director, Senior Designer, or similar creative role.

• Strong experience developing or evolving brand identities and visual systems.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong art direction, branding, conceptual thinking, and visual storytelling.

• Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color, imagery, layout, and visual hierarchy.

• Strong conceptual and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect creative ideas back to a brand’s objectives.

• Ability to develop a distinctive visual point of view while working within a broader brand strategy.

• Experience taking creative concepts from early exploration through to final execution.

• Strong presentation and communication skills.

• Ability to give thoughtful, constructive creative direction and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

• Comfortable working independently and managing multiple creative projects or priorities.

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger creative idea.

• Curiosity and openness to experimentation, new technologies, and emerging creative tools.

• Experience working within a creative agency, branding studio, production company, or similarly fast-paced creative environment is an asset.

Bonus Points

• Experience directing photography, video, motion, or other visual production.

• Strong understanding of digital and social-first creative.

• Experience working with emerging technologies, AI tools, or generative design workflows.

• Experience working with lifestyle, technology, fashion, beauty, entertainment, hospitality, or consumer brands.

• Ability to move between high-level creative direction and hands-on design when needed.

How You Work

We’re less interested in titles and credentials than in how you think and what you make.

You’re someone who:

• Has a strong visual point of view.

• Can explain why an idea works, not just what it looks like.

• Knows when to follow the brief — and when to challenge it.

• Is comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out along the way.

• Can work collaboratively without losing your creative voice.

• Cares about the details that make good work feel exceptional.

• Brings curiosity, taste, and energy to the creative process.

What We Offer

• Freelance, project-based collaboration.

• Opportunity to work across a diverse range of brands, industries, and creative challenges.

• Collaboration with a multidisciplinary creative team across branding, strategy, digital, content, production, and emerging technology.

• Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.

• Opportunity to contribute to work spanning brand identity, campaigns, digital experiences, and experiential projects.

• Potential for ongoing collaboration based on project needs and fit.

Portfolio

Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.

Please share a portfolio that demonstrates your approach to brand thinking, art direction, visual identity, and creative problem-solving.

We’re interested in seeing the thinking behind the work, not just polished final visuals.

À propos du rôle

Votre façon de travailler

Nous accordons moins d’importance aux titres et aux diplômes qu’à votre façon de réfléchir et à ce que vous créez.

Vous êtes une personne qui :

• Possède une vision visuelle forte et distinctive.

title: Art Director
description:
ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

NOT JUST CONSUMERS. HUMANS.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

You see ideas visually. You understand that great art direction is about more than making something look good. It’s about creating a distinct point of view, building an aesthetic language, and knowing how every image, composition, detail, and decision works together to tell a story. You can take a concept from an early sketch or instinct and turn it into a visual world that people can see, feel, and connect with.

You’re not just executing a creative direction. You’re a creative partner who helps shape the idea from the start. You know when to push a concept further, when to challenge what is expected, and how to translate an idea across 2D, 3D, physical, and digital spaces. You can art direct a shoot, build a presentation that brings a concept to life, and give a team the clarity and confidence to see the vision.

Your visual thinking helps shape more than individual pieces. It helps shape entire campaigns. You’ll work alongside Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists, bringing your perspective to the table and helping establish the aesthetic direction from the beginning. You’ll also mentor emerging talent, sharing your perspective and helping others develop their own visual instincts. You’re curious enough to explore what’s next, confident enough to lead the vision, and thoughtful enough to know that great art direction lives in both the big idea and every detail that brings it to life.

A portfolio or work samples are required to be considered for the role.

REQUIRED SKILLS

•
Set the visual standard. You’ll shape the aesthetic direction for major projects, establishing the visual language, mood, and point of view that everything else builds from. You know how to take a brief and turn it into a visual world that feels distinctive, considered, and ownable across campaigns and brand touch points.

•
See the whole picture. You move naturally between 2D, 3D, experiential, digital, and physical spaces, finding the right visual expression for an idea. You understand how individual images, compositions, materials, and details come together to create a larger brand experience.

•
Make ideas visible. You’re an exceptional visual thinker who can sketch, collage, build mood boards, and use AI imagery to explore ideas quickly. You know how to develop those early explorations into polished presentation materials and visual systems that make a concept clear, compelling, and easy to believe in.

•
Bring the vision to life. You have experience art directing photoshoots and video production at a high level, from pre-production through final delivery. You understand how to make thoughtful decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, location, and production while keeping the larger creative vision intact.

•
Shape the work, not just the execution. You’ll partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors, and strategists. Sometimes you’ll translate an existing vision. Other times, you’ll help define it. You bring a strong point of view, ask the right questions, and know when pushing an idea further will make the work better.

•
Make good ideas better. You’ll develop visual systems that give teams a clear creative foundation, from palettes and compositions to imagery and aesthetic principles. You know how to create consistency without sacrificing personality, and you’re comfortable working from the big picture down to the smallest detail.

•
Lead & inspire. Set the bar for excellence and create a collaborative environment where creativity thrives. You inspire, motivate, and challenge your team to consistently deliver exceptional work, while providing clear, direct, real-time feedback that helps people grow not just improve the work in front of them.

•
Present with clarity and conviction. You can lead a client through a creative idea, explain why the visual choices matter, and make a compelling case for the work. You bring both strategic thinking and artistic confidence to the room.

•
Bring the craft and experience. You have professional art direction experience in an agency, production, or integrated creative environment, expert level sketching and rapid visualization skills, and mastery of Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Acrobat. You’re curious about emerging tools and technologies and know how to use them to make the work more ambitious, not simply faster.

•
Bring a point of view. Your portfolio shows aesthetic authority, diverse project experience, exceptional craft, and work produced at scale. More than anything, it shows that you can set a standard, lead a visual vision, and create work that people remember.

The annual range for this role varies between $80,000- $95,000 and may vary depending on the candidate’s experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.

IMPACT & INCLUSION

Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.

Our guiding principles can be found here.

To view our compliance policies, please go to the main menu on our site GMR Marketing: Experience Marketing Agency.

title: Sr. Staff Product & Visual Designer, Technology Workflows
description:
At ServiceNow, we embrace representation in and from all professional and personal backgrounds and cultures. This diversity inspires passion and creativity among our teams and propels innovation in our products.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer (Design Technology & Craft Lead) to serve as an elite, hands-on craft visionary bridging advanced visual design, fluid motion choreography, and front-end code. This role sits within our Technology Workflows organization, directly shaping flagship, next-generation AI platforms, and design frameworks.

This is not a traditional systems-architecture or wireframing UX role. We are seeking an exceptional practitioner who blurs the boundary between high-end digital aesthetics and front-end engineering. You will be the team’s creative technical anchor: setting the benchmark for visual depth, kinetic responsiveness, and production-grade prototypes. Working shoulder to shoulder with product designers, design systems teams, and engineering peers, you will define and codify how our AI experiences look, move, and respond across complex enterprise workflows.

You must be obsessed with craft excellence, unapologetic about visual polish, and driven to turn complex technical interactions into fluid, responsive, consumer-grade software.

What you get to do in the role:

• Build Reference-Grade Prototypes: Develop high-fidelity, interactive code prototypes and sandboxes (React, modern CSS/Tokens, WebGL/Canvas) that test and prove out next-generation UX for AINPX and Lux before production handoff.

• Pioneer AI Kinetic Systems: Codify motion design patterns, timing curves, elevation models, and dynamic state transitions (such as AI thinking, streaming, settling, and ambient feedback) into production-ready specifications.

• Partner with Design Systems: Collaborate directly with centralized Design Systems engineering teams to translate motion guidelines, visual tokens, and micro-interactions into scalable components used across ServiceNow workflows.

• Elevate Team Craft through Direct Pairing: Champion a player-coach culture by embedding directly with product designers on critical paths. Pair-design interactions, run code-backed workshops, and actively raise the visual and kinetic craft floor of the broader team.

• Bridge Design and Engineering: Serve as the definitive technical translator between design vision and front-end execution, ensuring that intended motion physics and pixel-perfect visual nuance survive into production code.

• Thrive in an AI-Native Workflow: Rapidly experiment with code-backed AI design tools, algorithmic prototyping, and generative interaction paradigms to accelerate design cycles and unlock new interface capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

• 10+ years of experience as a Product Designer, Design Technologist, Creative Technologist, Motion Designer, or Hybrid Visual/UI Designer working on complex web applications.

• A portfolio showcasing world-class visual craft, sophisticated motion/animation choreography, and real interactive prototypes.

• Proven proficiency in modern front-end web technologies (HTML5, modern CSS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React) and component-based workflows.

• Deep expertise in kinetic design and prototyping tools (Framer, Principle, After Effects, Rive, or code-based animation libraries like Framer Motion or GSAP).

• Experience designing and engineering for dynamic AI interactions, including agentic state visualization, streaming tokens, and responsive real-time feedback loops.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional peers across Product, Design, and Front-End Engineering.

Basic Qualifications:

• Experience scaling tokens and kinetic animation systems within enterprise-grade design systems.

• Strong background in micro-interaction design, spatial elevation, accessibility (such as reduced motion support), and performance profiling for web rendering.

• Familiarity with AI-native developer tooling, code-backed design environments, or LLM API integrations for rapid prototyping.

• Prior experience delivering consumer-grade polish to complex enterprise, developer, or data-intensive workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $171,900 - $300,800, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
