title: Senior UX Researcher, Mixed Methods
description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior User Experience (UX) Researcher, Mixed Methods with a passion for uncovering customer insights and a track record of turning research into real product influence. Your focus will span the full product lifecycle, combining generative, evaluative, and quantitative research to build a holistic picture of our customers. You'll be part of our UX Research team, where we help onX build a deep, ongoing understanding of our customers, so product decisions are grounded in how people actually explore the outdoors with onX, helping our teams build with confidence. This is a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic, growing company focused on making an impact on the business, and to shape how onX understands its customers at the moments that matter most. This role will serve as the link between what we learn from onX customers and how product and business teams act on it. This role will report to the UX Research Manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

Own end-to-end research

• Independently plan and run research, both qualitative and quantitative, across the full product lifecycle to shape strategy and sharpen the onX customer experience.

• Know which method fits which question, and bring sound judgment to every call you make: balancing speed with rigor, weighing tradeoffs honestly, and making decisions that keep your conclusions credible and your team confident in them.

Build cross-functional partnerships and influence to scale impact

• Build deep knowledge of our customers and products so you can spot the right questions before anyone asks, challenge assumptions, and help shape product strategy and priorities.

• Build close, trusted relationships with Product, Design, and other partners from day one — understanding their goals and context well enough to spot research opportunities together and scope studies collaboratively, not just deliver findings at the end.

• Turn research into clear next steps — tell a compelling story with your findings and partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Marketing to inform decisions.

• Act as a go-to advisor when partners are running their own research by weighing in on study design and methodology to help strengthen their approach.

• Coach non-researchers, contribute to shared research standards and practices, and look for ways AI can make our research faster, sharper, and easier to reuse.

Execute across mixed methods

• Use qualitative methods like interviews, usability testing, diary studies, and other generative and evaluative approaches.

• Design and execute quantitative studies, using descriptive and inferential statistics to turn survey, behavioral, and CX data into clarity we can act on. You'll also help shape how we measure UX more broadly, so teams understand how well our products serve customers at scale.

• Know when one approach fits better than the other, and when combining them gets you further — for example, working through a multi-phase study where each builds on the other to answer a bigger question.

• Continuously integrate qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral data to spot patterns, make sense of conflicting signals, and build a fuller picture of onX customers and how their needs and experiences change over time.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

•
A portfolio, work samples, or case studies is required as part of the application.

• It should demonstrate your ability to independently scope and execute mixed-method research and translate evidence into meaningful product and business impact.

• Eight (8) years of relevant experience, that includes at least five (5) years in UX, product, or consumer research, preferably in a fast-paced B2C product environment

• A Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree, or PhD in Psychology, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, or related field or equivalent experience.

• A proactive, strategic mindset. You understand customers, the product, and the business well enough to know what's worth researching.

• Strong communication and collaboration. You explain findings, implications, and limitations clearly to any audience, and build real partnerships with Product, Design, and other cross-functional partners along the way.

• Proven mixed-methods research fluency, with the ability to independently design, execute, analyze, and integrate qualitative and quantitative studies to answer strategic questions.

• Experience across foundational and evaluative qualitative methods, including interviews, usability testing, diary studies, and other generative and evaluative approaches.

• Hands-on quantitative research experience, including survey design and analysis, sampling strategies, data-quality assessment, and applying descriptive and inferential statistics.

• Experience with UX measurement and Voice of Customer (VoC) practices, and interest in helping that work evolve and scale.

• Ability to juggle multiple research efforts at once, and adjust as questions, timelines, or business needs shift.

• A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI.

• A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

• Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

• Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

• Experience working in a democratized or enabled research environment

• Experience with data analysis or visualization tools like R or Python

• Proficiency with advanced statistics like regression, factor analysis, cluster analysis, etc.

• Expertise with advanced survey methods like MaxDiff, conjoint, Van Westendorp pricing or similar

• Genuine enthusiasm for the outdoors and how people explore it

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $154,000 and $180,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

• Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth

• Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

• Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

• 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%

• Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks

• Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

• Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
About the Company

At Rezilient, we're redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we're building a healthcare experience that's as convenient as it is comprehensive. We are a Series B company, which means the work is real, the pace is fast, and the design decisions you make now become the patterns we scale on.

About the Role

Rezilient is seeking a Senior UX Designer to help build a member app people love coming back to. As we extend care beyond the clinic, you'll shape how members understand their health, connect with their care team, and take useful next steps between visits.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role spanning research, interaction and visual design, prototyping, and iteration after launch. Your initial focus will be the member-facing mobile experience. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Growth to create a coherent experience across the app and the care it connects members to. Care-team workflow improvements will be prioritized alongside member-facing work, rather than treated as a separate, unlimited mandate.

AI will be an important part of what you design, but not the answer to every problem. You'll help determine when AI makes an interaction more useful and when a simpler approach is better. Where AI is involved, you'll design for transparency, user control, appropriate human review, and recovery when something goes wrong.

Our ideal candidate brings deep consumer mobile experience, strong interaction and visual design skills, and a record of improving products after launch. You care about the details of the shipped experience, learn directly from users, and can explain how your work helped people accomplish something that matters to them.

What You'll Design

• The member mobile experience: Onboarding, access to care, navigation, communication, and between-visit engagement that feel coherent, useful, and easy to return to.

• Health and wearable data experiences: Clear ways for members to connect devices, understand relevant health information, and identify useful next steps without being overwhelmed by data.

• Member-facing AI experiences: Assistance with intake, care navigation, education, and follow-up, with clear boundaries and a straightforward handoff to a person when needed.

• Connections to the care team: Member-to-care-team handoffs and supporting workflows that keep the digital experience connected to how care is delivered.

• Efficient clinical workflows: Intuitive experiences for medics, providers, and care navigators across visit preparation, encounters, documentation, orders, and referrals, designed to reduce repetitive work and context switching so care teams can focus on members.

• Care-team coordination: Clear task queues, messaging, and handoffs that make ownership, priority, and next steps visible across virtual and CloudClinic care, helping teams move work forward without losing clinical context.

• Innovative AI-assisted care delivery: New ways to summarize relevant information, draft documentation, and support follow-up, designed and tested with care teams, with appropriate clinician review, easy correction, and clear accountability.

• Trust, control, and recovery: Consent and permission flows, review and correction, understandable explanations, and recovery when information is incomplete or a system is wrong, slow, or unavailable.

• Reusable mobile patterns: Accessible components and interaction patterns, including loading, empty, error, and success states, that maintain a consistent quality bar as the product grows.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end member experience design: Take priority journeys from discovery and workflow mapping through prototypes, production-ready designs, implementation review, and post-launch iteration.

• Partner in product discovery: Work closely with the Product Manager and mobile engineering lead to define problems, explore alternatives, and make informed tradeoffs before committing to a solution.

• Deliver a high standard of craft: Create polished interaction and visual designs with clear information hierarchy, thoughtful content, and platform-appropriate mobile patterns. Partner with Engineering through design QA so the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar.

• Learn directly from users: Run practical interviews, concept tests, and usability sessions with members and, where relevant, medics, providers, and care navigators. Combine those findings with product data to challenge assumptions and guide iteration.

• Accelerate product and design cycles with AI: Rethink traditional research, synthesis, prototyping, and validation workflows using AI to test more ideas, reach evidence-backed decisions faster, and shorten the path from problem to shipped experience. Demonstrate measurable improvements in cycle time while preserving research integrity, privacy, and design quality.

• Build realistic prototypes: Use Figma and approved prototyping tools to test interactions before implementation. For AI-powered flows, explore representative model outputs and failure cases rather than relying only on idealized mockups.

• Develop reusable design foundations: Define and document components, patterns, and guidance with Engineering so quality and consistency scale beyond individual features.

• Connect design to member outcomes: Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate onboarding success, task completion, comprehension, satisfaction, and meaningful repeat engagement. Use AI acceptance, correction, and override behavior as additional diagnostic signals, not substitutes for a useful member experience.

• Design responsibly: Work with Clinical Operations, Quality, and Compliance to translate agreed safety expectations into clear review, consent, escalation, and recovery flows. Use approved tools and appropriately protected or synthetic data for research and prototyping.

• Support focused delivery: Participate in planning, backlog refinement, and delivery rituals, keeping design work well-scoped and aligned with product priorities. Establish practical design review and learning habits without adding unnecessary process.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

• Senior-level design experience: 5+ years in UX, product design, or interaction design in a high-growth, technology-enabled environment, with a record of taking work from an unclear problem through launch and iteration.

• Deep consumer mobile experience: Experience designing and shipping a consumer health, wellness, or fitness app used by a substantial active user base. You can explain the audience, scale, your contribution, and what changed as the product grew.

• Strong interaction and visual design: A portfolio showing excellent craft and shipped mobile experiences, with a clear account of the problem, research, tradeoffs, and results. Anonymized examples and directional results are welcome when work is confidential.

• Research and evaluation skills: Experience learning directly from users and combining qualitative findings with product data to make and test design decisions.

• Mobile and accessibility fundamentals: Familiarity with iOS and Android interaction patterns and the ability to design for people with different abilities, levels of health literacy, and comfort with technology.

• Prototyping and systems skills: Strong proficiency in Figma, including component-based design, interactive prototyping, design systems, and clear communication of behavior and intent to engineers.

• Sound AI design judgment: An understanding of uncertainty, disclosure, review and correction, permissions, and human handoff. You can reason about failure cases and avoid creating unwarranted trust in an automated response.

• Thoughtful use of AI tools: Fluency with AI-enabled design, research, and productivity tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where direct human research and review remain necessary.

• Cross-functional ownership: Proven ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering on a small team where priorities evolve and designers are expected to remain hands-on.

• Systems thinking and communication: The ability to simplify complex journeys, explain design rationale, facilitate tradeoff discussions, and incorporate clinical, technical, and business feedback without losing sight of member needs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Shipped AI-powered features: Experience bringing AI interactions to real users, including evaluating quality, handling errors, and learning after release.

• High-trust products: Experience in care delivery or another regulated environment where privacy, clarity, and safety influence design decisions.

• Sustained engagement: Experience helping people build useful habits or follow through on health goals without relying on unnecessary notifications or manipulative patterns.

• Connected health experiences: Work with wearable or device data, personalized health information, or experiences spanning an app and a human care team.

• Clinical workflow familiarity: Experience with documentation, referrals, care-team tasks, or patient-provider messaging, and familiarity with clinical data standards such as FHIR or HL7.

• Early-stage design practice: Experience establishing practical design foundations and research habits on a small team while continuing to deliver hands-on product work.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

• Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow

• Competitive base compensation

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums

• Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients

• 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days

• Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first

• 11 paid company holidays each year

• Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments

• Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

Competitive remuneration

Remote work

Bonuses and stock options

description:

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (United States, Europe, Canada, or LATAM)

Role Type: Full-time

Reporting to: VP of Engineering

Compensation: $148,000 to $190,000 per year for US-based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.

CodePath's educational programs run on our learning platform, a set of applications with functionality spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. These tools have been amazingly effective, but we’re increasingly seeing our limited design bandwidth holding us back in our efforts to take them further.

We're looking for our first Senior Product Designer to own the experience design of the platform: how a flow is structured, how people navigate, how an interaction feels. You'll also own the design system that keeps everything coherent as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You'll own the work end to end: talk to the people who use our products, decide how an experience should work, and hand engineers something they can build from.

We focus on what's most impactful for our students: the quality of the experience. A UI-focused contractor is available to you as a resource, and you'll set the direction they execute against.

The ideal candidate is a designer inspired by potential projects like these:

• Designing the Learner Hub, the student-facing part of our Career Mobility OS: personalized career roadmaps, skills tracking, and employer-connected pathways

• Building and owning CodePath's first design system: its interaction patterns and components

• Untangling and redesigning the core platform areas no single product manager owns today, like accounts, onboarding, and navigation

• Designing the interfaces for AI-powered learning tools, including tutoring, coaching, and grading

Key Activities

• Design end-to-end user flows, navigation, and information architecture across the platform, and document them as wireframes and specifications engineers can build from

• Own CodePath's design system: the interaction patterns, components, and standards that keep the platform consistent

• Run lightweight product discovery. Talk to students, staff, and internal stakeholders to define what's needed, especially for platform areas and internal tools that no product manager owns

• Partner with product managers to turn prioritized initiatives into build-ready designs, and with engineers to resolve design questions as they build

• Direct a UI design contractor to extend your output

• Set and hold the bar for experience quality across the product

Qualifications

• 6+ years designing web products end-to-end, with a portfolio that shows your thinking on flows and structure and the process behind your work

• Strong information architecture and interaction design skills. You can take an ambiguous problem and produce a clear flow, navigation model, and spec

• Experience running your own discovery: talking to users and stakeholders to figure out what's needed rather than waiting for a fully specified brief

• Experience building a design system

• Fluency producing engineer-ready artifacts (wireframes, prototypes, specs) in Figma or a comparable tool

•
Comfort with ambiguity and small-team dynamics. You've worked without a large design org around you and know how to prioritize without perfect information

• Enough front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, Tailwind) to collaborate closely with engineers and judge what's feasible

• Strong written and verbal communication

• Passion for education and desire to make a positive impact

Nice to haves

• Experience designing for education, marketplaces, or data-heavy products

• Experience as the first or an early design hire on a team

• Working familiarity with how AI and LLM features change product design

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for an IC position at an annual salary of $148,000 to $190,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

title: UX Designer
description:
About Us

Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the Team

Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we’re a software company whose users work on warehouse floors, not at desks. The people using our products are forklift operators checking inventory on a tablet, site managers reading AI-generated insights on a dashboard, and field technicians running drone workflows mid-shift. Design here isn’t about pixels. It’s about understanding how people work under pressure and making sure the software gets out of their way.

About the Role

Most UX roles ask you to improve something that already exists. This one asks you to define what good looks like for an entirely new category of product.

As our UX Designer, you’ll design the software that warehouse associates interact with every day: operator apps for our drone and MHE Vision systems, tablet interfaces built for people who are on their feet and can’t afford confusion, and Sage, our emerging AI-powered inventory intelligence platform. You won’t design from assumptions. You’ll go to the warehouses in Houston, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, stand next to the people using our software, and let what you see drive what you build.

This is Gather AI’s first dedicated UX hire. The person who takes this role owns the design vision for the entire product surface, and the path to Director of UX is already visible from day one.

What You’ll Do

• Own UX design for the MHEV operator app: ramp fast, ship a v2 concept by month 3, and take full design ownership of the product line from there

The person in this role will drive the creative vision, gameplay design, and execution quality of new playable hero characters and collaborate with our Gameplay Programmers, Animators, VFX Artists, and Character Artists to create world class moment-to-moment gameplay.

The ideal candidates are self-driven, highly technical, and extremely creative, with deep experience in leading and creating high quality 3rd person gameplay. We’re looking for designers who value game feel, player clarity, and high levels of polish in their work and are searching for highly collaborative development environment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Creative leadership and primary ownership of player character systems for one or more playable characters. Accountable for the design, prototyping, iteration and polish of hero core combat, as well as features such as movement / traversal, abilities, interactivity, progression, non-combat mechanics, allies, or game balance.

• Directly prototypes, implements, and iterates on Hero combat and non-combat gameplay through proprietary internal tools and scripting systems. Brings a focus on innovation, clarity, playability, and presentational polish to hero design work.

• Collaborates directly with Gameplay Programming and Animation partners to best leverage skills and creativity across both departments. Fosters a strong environment of creative collaboration across all disciplines
Creative leadership for one or more development pods of cross-discipline contributors. Collaborates with Development Management to plan milestones, set priorities, and coordinate feedback.

• Works autonomously to drive quality, iterate, and innovate in service of the project’s creative goals and values. Is proactive about flagging problems, implementing solutions, and responding to feedback to continuously improve Hero gameplay. Drives collaboration with cross-discipline stakeholders for problem solving and alignment.

• Collaborates directly with Mission Designers and Combat Designers to integrate and support player work in Missions, encounters, and core combat gameplay.

• Works with Systems Designers, Gameplay Programmers, and the UI/UX team to help create compelling long-term gameplay through player progression systems and meaningful player growth.

• Collaborates with the Narrative Department, Mission Designers, and Mission Directors to support player-driven storytelling through player mechanics and interactive experiences.

• Writes and regularly updates clear player system documentation detailing the scope and feature set for player features. Creates tutorial videos and documentation to support as needed.

• Regularly reviews player work in progress, proactively gathers feedback, and drives iteration and quality. Accountable for creative quality of all assigned player work and for ensuring the team is hitting on-screen quality targets for each milestone.

• Collaborates with the Combat Director and project Game Director to ensure player design meets the project’s creative and technical goals and reaches Insomniac’s quality standards.

• Creates, tracks, and supports player standards and metrics across the whole experience to ensure consistency and quality. Directly supports Mission Design work with metrics as needed.

• Runs brainstorms / reviews, creates buy-in and alignment, and champions design vision and values through clear communication and inclusivity.

• Drives, documents, and disseminates standards, best practices, and creative process for Hero / player character design work across the studio. Serves as a Design Department subject matter expert in 3rd person player character design within the studio and keeps up with the state of the art across the industry.

• Drive innovation and improvement in internal design tools for 3rd person character prototyping, implementation, and iteration.

• Reviews and provides feedback on hero character work across the studio. Mentors and coaches other Hero Designers.

• Creates a safe, supportive, and creative work environment that exemplifies our studio values.

• May take on other gameplay systems design as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

• Eight or more years of professional game design experience, with at least one shipped title as a primary design owner of player combat and / or overall player character systems.

• Proven expertise in creating, tuning, and polishing high-quality player movement, combat, controls, and gameplay balance.

• Deep expertise in the current state and history of design craft across the games industry, especially 3rd person narrative games.

• High proficiency with modern game engines, such as Unreal or proprietary engines. Proven experience in scripting, prototyping, and iterating gameplay systems directly. Experience in 3D layout a plus.

• Proven ability to implement, iterate, and tune high-quality game feel matched with polished presentation.

• Extremely strong skills in written, verbal, and visual communication across disciplines.

Reasoning Skills:

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Computer Skills:

 Intermediate knowledge and experience with level editing tools and scripting (Unreal Engine, Unity, or similar editors). Intermediate knowledge of Maya or other major 3D modeling programs. Experience with animation tools or programming languages a plus.  Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, Miro, Confluence or equivalent office software. 

Other Skills:

 Individual must have very good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with team members and other developers.  Strong communication skills including verbal and written skills are required.

title: Senior Manager, UX Design
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. By supporting primary care physicians and their teams, we help identify patient needs earlier, make complex clinical information actionable, and support longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?

The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

• Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

• Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.

• Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.

• Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.

• Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

• In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.

• In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.

• Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

• You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.

• You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.

• You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.

• You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.

• You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.

• You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.

• You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

• Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

• Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

• Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

• Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

• Reimbursement for office setup expenses

• Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

• Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

• Paid parental leave for all new parents

• And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

$188,500—$245,000 USD

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About Our Team

Visual Design turns complex financial products into experiences customers can understand, trust, and remember. Through motion, illustration, and visual storytelling, we connect brand promise to product reality, bringing clarity and cohesion to every moment, from discovery and onboarding to everyday use.
We partner with Product Design, Brand, Content Design, Engineering, and Product Marketing to create expressive, accessible, and scalable experiences across Affirm’s ecosystem. Our role is to elevate the quality of execution, build visual systems that help teams move with consistency, and use craft to guide attention, explain value, and create moments of confidence and delight. We ensure Affirm does not simply work well - it communicates clearly, feels unmistakably our own, and earns customer trust at every touchpoint.

About the Role

We’re looking for a motion-forward Visual Designer who brings strong craft in animation, visual storytelling, and illustration. You’ll help elevate the quality and consistency of customer experiences across Affirm’s product ecosystem, using motion to guide attention, explain product behavior, improve comprehension, and create moments of clarity and delight.

This role sits at the intersection of product and brand. Your work will range from in-product interactions and animated illustrations to web, email communications, lifecycle journeys, and product launches. You’ll pair deep motion and visual-design craft with UX thinking and an understanding of design systems to create experiences that are cohesive, accessible, scalable, and purposeful.

You think holistically about end-to-end customer journeys, care deeply about craft, and understand how thoughtful motion and visual systems can make experiences both functional and emotionally engaging.

• Own defined visual and motion-design projects from concept and storyboarding through production and implementation, maintaining a consistently high level of craft.

• Contribute to product-design initiatives by mapping user flows, developing interaction concepts, and carrying solutions through high-fidelity design and prototyping.

• Create and extend reusable visual assets, motion patterns, guidelines, and components that strengthen Affirm’s product and communication systems.

• Collaborate with Product Design, Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Brand, Content Design, Lifecycle, and Growth partners to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.

• Prepare production-ready assets and specifications, partnering with engineers to ensure motion and visual details are accessible, performant, and implemented as intended.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of production environments (especially in email and mobile).

• UX and product-design experience, including an understanding of user flows, interaction design, information hierarchy, and how motion can support an end-to-end experience.

• Ability to storyboard, prototype, and articulate design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

• Ability to independently deliver defined projects, communicate design rationale, incorporate feedback, and collaborate effectively with designers, engineers, marketers, and other cross-functional partners.

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). As Flying Bisons shifts further toward strategic design, the Strategic Designer role is becoming the backbone of our delivery model. Strategic Designers lead the entire flow - from initial offer, research, strategy, concept, and validation through UX/UI design and development support.

Leading high-stakes projects end-to-end, from framing the challenge to launch readiness.

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. And the language in those interfaces is how they understand what the system did, what it's asking of them, and what happens next.

We're hiring our first dedicated content strategist to own that layer across a portfolio of enterprise products. You'll sit at the intersection of language, product strategy, system logic, and emerging technology, and you'll be the authority on what we call things and how we explain them.

You'd join a User Experience team built deliberately as a strategic function — design, research, content, and design systems together. The problems are unglamorous in the best way: dense workflows, real consequences, users who notice when language is imprecise.

How this role operates

This is not a copywriting role or an embedded-writer role. Instead of writing every string yourself, you'll build the infrastructure that lets other people write well without you: terminology systems, voice & tone, content patterns, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted drafting on-voice. You'll own the logic, taxonomy, and rationale behind our hardest content problems and scale that intent across products and teams.

Expect to oscillate. Some weeks you'll be deeply embedded in a single high-leverage initiative. Others you'll operate consultatively across several product teams at once, setting direction and auditing what ships. Both modes require you to be persuasive without formal authority.

• Content systems and governance.Build, govern, and maintain our voice & tone, terminology standards, and content pattern libraries that span our portfolio. Own the content layer of our design system — voice and tone, UI terminology, taxonomy, content components and patterns — documented for others to use independently.• Enablement and practice maturation. Upskill product designers, PMs, and partner teams through documentation, workshops, and review mechanisms.• Quality assurance across the journey. Serve as the standing check on narrative coherence across live experiences, so that teams building in parallel don't fragment the customer journey.

description:
Industrial Designer

Location: Remote

About Us

Atari, one of the world's most iconic entertainment brands, is a pioneer in interactive entertainment. With operations spanning gaming, e-commerce, licensing, and hardware, Atari thrives at the intersection of innovation and legacy. Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the financial health of our diverse business operations.

About the Role

We are seeking a creative and passionate Industrial Designer to help establish our internal product design capabilities. You’ll bring your knowledge of concept design, manufacturing, video games, pop culture, and niche fandoms to our growing team. In this role, you will create and iterate on industrial designs in electronics and collectibles to surprise, delight, and connect with our fans.

You’ll support the design process from early concepts through production, creating beautiful, functional, and brand-appropriate consoles, controllers, and collectibles. Our collaborative, fast-paced team values creativity, ownership, and bringing products to life quickly. This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys prototyping, iterating, and solving real-world product challenges.

What You'll Do

Product Design & Development

• Design exciting products that capture the heart of our brands and licensed collaborators while satisfying the needs of our audiences.

• Collaborate closely with the Creative team to bring 3D designs to life in solutions that convey appropriate visual and tactile messages with consideration for the production process and cost targets.

• Help develop and mature our existing product design language.

• Generate multiple concept directions for assigned projects and advance strong solutions within the agreed concept and refinement timelines

• Prepare and develop concepts for user testing through prototypes or renderings.

• Support designers with generating and communicating the visual and physical aspects of designs through sketches, illustrations, renderings, and 3D prototype models.

• Develop manufacturable, durable products by identifying and helping resolve design, engineering, material, and assembly challenges before final production handoff.

• Help drive efforts surrounding R&D in new materials, 3D rendering, and on-site production.

• Support design team with creative feedback, production assistance, etc.

• Collaborate cross-functionally and with vendors to maintain project momentum and achieve 100% alignment with agreed development milestones and deliverable dates.

• Deliver high-quality design solutions on schedule and achieve approximately 90% approval from cross-functional partners within each project phase, incorporating feedback promptly when revisions are needed.

Design Process & Collaboration

• Clearly communicate design strategy and creative process to internal stakeholders, including design and executive teams.

• Participate in regular group design critiques and planning/concepting meetings in order to arrive at the best possible products and experiences for our customers.

• Collaborate with team members to identify social, industry, and technology trends that influence the development of future products.

• Set and meet design project deadlines on-time, with team support.

Collaboration

• Work closely with the Creative Team and other LOBs inside the company to develop designs that align with visual assets and overall product launch goals

• Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment with a can-do, problem-solving attitude.

What We're Looking For

• A strong portfolio that illustrates your creative skills across the design process.

• Great sketching, concept generation, and design development skills, knowledge of design methodology.

• Excellent visualization skills (hand sketching, digital 2D and 3D rendering).

• Prototyping, mock-up, and modeling ability.

• Understanding of prototyping, materials, and manufacturing processes within product development.

• Acute attention to detail.

• Ability to develop an understanding of human factors and design trends as they relate to project needs.

Software

• Strong knowledge of 2D, 3D, and rendering software – including Rhino 3D, AutoCAD, Sketchbook, Keyshot, Photoshop, Illustrator, Solidworks, Cinema 4D, and Blender; Maya a plus but not mandatory.

Manufacturing & Materials

• Knowledge of manufacturing materials and processes, primarily plastic injection molding, metal die casting, and stamping.

• Familiarity with defining and implementing color, materials, and finishes is a plus.

• Knowledge of plastics, manufacturing processes, and design for manufacturing

• Strong hands-on prototyping skills across materials and methods

Industry Knowledge

• An interest in and knowledge of consumer electronics products.

• Strong understanding of pop culture trends, fandoms, and the licensing landscape.

Professional Skills

title: Lead UI/UX Designer - Mobile Casual F2P Games
description:
The Opportunity

UserWise is looking for an experienced Lead UI/UX Designer to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.

You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.

This is not a management-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.

What You’ll Do

• Own the overall UX quality and UI/UX discipline across the game.

• Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.

• Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.

• Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.

• Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.

• Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.

• Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.

• Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.

• Improve the Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.

• Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.

• Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.

• Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

• Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.

• Strong shipped experience with mobile Free-to-Play games, ideally casual or mass-market titles.

• A portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and finished game experiences, not just polished UI screens.

• Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.

• Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.

• Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.

• Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.

• Strong proficiency with Figma or equivalent modern product-design tools.

• Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.

• Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.

• Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.

• Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.

• Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.

• Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

• Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences

• User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes

• Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI

• Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX

• Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem

• Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team

Case studies showing how you arrived at a solution are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

Benefits

Why Join UserWise

• Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

• Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.

• Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.

• Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.

• Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.

• 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.

What We Offer

• Market-competitive compensation

• Paid Time Off

• Performance Bonus

• Annual Performance Reviews

title: Mechanical Engineer V - Design
description:
Voyager is an innovative defense, national security and space technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. 

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Job Summary:

Design

• Has expertise in complex design challenges, optimizing actuator performance, designing specialized igniters, designing pressure vessels, designing solid rocket motor systems, and leading the development of hot gas valve and rocket thruster designs.

• Can generate complex actuator designs, conduct thorough performance analysis, and implement innovative solutions.

• Has expertise in trade-off analysis, integrating multidisciplinary considerations, and providing comprehensive recommendations for design optimization and decision-making.

Drafting/Modelling

• Possesses exceptional skills in designing intricate 2D or 3D models, using advanced CAD commands, and generating technical drawings.

• Can interpret complex GD&T symbols, analyze engineering drawings, and provide guidance on dimensional and tolerance requirements.

• Can create intricate 3D models, use advanced features, and contribute to the development of solid modeling practices within the software.

Materials

• Possesses expertise in advanced ceramic properties, insulator material characterization, and advanced metal types.

• Can conduct detailed characterization, develop customized solutions, contribute to research and innovation, provide expert consultation, lead research projects, and optimize metal selection for challenging applications.

• Has expertise in refractory metal types, their properties, behavior at extreme temperatures, and processing techniques.

Communications

• Possesses exceptional skills in communication theories, presentation design, technical presentation, and writing specialized technical documents.

• Can provide expert guidance on complex communication challenges, develop compelling narratives, tailor content for specific audiences, and provide expert consultation on presentation strategies and audience engagement methods.

• Excels in writing technical documents with precision and accuracy.

Analysis

• Has expertise in complex simulation setups, analysis techniques, structural analysis, dynamic analysis, and thermal analysis.

• Can build complex simulations, validate models, and make informed engineering decisions.

• Can interpret and validate dynamic analysis results, optimize structural designs, and address thermal management challenges.

• Has expertise in geometric dimensioning and tolerancing principles, statistical tolerance analysis methods, and virtual inspection techniques.

Manufacturing

• Has expertise in complex additive manufacturing, mechanical assembly, composite layups, machining, molding and casting, advanced manufacturing planning techniques, and welding tasks.

• Can optimize designs, select materials and processes, and specify quality control checks including NDT methods.

• Can lead assembly teams, perform composite fabrication, set up and program machining equipment, and perform molding and casting tasks.

• Can provide expert consultation on manufacturing planning strategies and best practices.

Testing

• The individual can perform assembly tasks, follow instructions, and integrate components for testing including the handling of energetics.

• The individual understands test data collection principles and methods, perform data preprocessing, statistical analysis, and visualizations, set up and operate measurement instruments, perform calibrations, and acquire test data using standard techniques.

• The individual can develop test plans, identify objectives, define procedures, and create schedules for simple scenarios.

Systems Engineering

• Possesses advanced knowledge of mass estimation techniques, acquisition process, requirements analysis, prioritization, validation, and risk management.

• Can conduct detailed mass analyses for complex systems, identify critical areas for mass reduction, and propose optimization strategies.

• Can contribute to identifying potential risks, analyzing failure modes, and implementing reliability and safety measures. The individual is a recognized authority in the field.

Project Management

• Possesses basic financial knowledge, can lead small teams, understand operations research principles, understands complex procurement tasks, create simple proposals, and manage simple schedules.

• Can effectively communicate goals and expectations, develop procurement strategies, manage vendor evaluations, analyze supplier performance, and implement effective contract management practices.

Ballistics

• Understands advanced grain design methodologies, analyze burning characteristics, and optimize performance.

• Understands propellant chemistry, combustion principles, grain geometry, internal ballistics, and solid propellant manufacturing processes, including types, composition, combustion mechanisms, and grain performance factors.

System Performance

• Designs simple control systems using standard techniques, understand diagrams and specifications, and implement basic algorithms.

• Conducts requirements elicitation, prioritize stakeholder needs, and document requirements using standard templates.

• Understands solid rocket motor performance principles, including thrust, specific impulse, and propellant combustion.

Avionics

• Understands basic battery design principles, cable/wire harness design, circuit board design, rocket motor ignition systems, and software design principles, contributing to tasks under guidance.

• Identifies common components and connections and contributes to the generation of basic software designs while following standard specifications and guidelines.

Required Qualifications:

• Able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

• Ten (10) to fifteen (15) years of mechanical engineering experience.

• Bachelor of Science required in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other relevant engineering discipline from an accredited university. May consider equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Positive, cooperative, self-motivated, and professional behavior

• Contribute as necessary to get the job done

• Rocket motor design and testing experience

• Master of Science required in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other relevant engineering discipline from an accredited university. May consider equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

• Must be able to travel approximately 10% of the time.

title: Project Engineer - Site Design
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

Olsson provides multidisciplinary, preliminary, and construction design services for mixed-use, commercial, and residential land development projects, along with industrial, sports, schools, and other site development types. As a Civil Project Engineer in either our Dallas or Fort Worth office, you will apply diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices to a broad variety of assignments and related fields. The project engineer is a registered professional engineer, whose supervision and guidance relate largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts, and policy matters. The project engineer supervises, coordinates, and reviews work of engineers or technicians and performs complex or novel assignments that require development of new and improved techniques and procedures.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

• Prepares planning and design documents in appropriate engineering discipline.

• Performs process design calculations, prepares cost estimates, and uses economic analyses for comparison of alternatives.

• Assists with or develops project scope of work or portions of it; assists with or develops project schedule or portions of it; assists with completion of initiation paperwork; assists with budget reviews and schedules progress reports.

• Coordinates projects with other Olsson teams; performs and coordinates design aspects of projects; directs team members on design tasks; maintains project records (correspondence, drawings, and files); informs project managers of progress and problems; coordinates with clients; attends client meetings.

• Assists with marketing/business development; may help write proposals.

• May serve as project manager on small projects.

• Independently performs assignments on complex projects.

• Coordinates assistant and associate professional staff and technical staff’s work; may supervise student or technical staff.

Olsson currently has growth opportunities for our Site Design group. This role offers flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities, to accommodate diverse working preferences and promote work-life balance. Candidates can work hybrid schedules, work remotely, or work out of any Olsson office location in these regions/areas.

Applicants should have the ability to travel for in-office activities, client and site visits as needed.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to contribute and work well on a team.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering.

• 6 or more years of related Civil Engineering experience.

• Must be a registered Professional Engineer.

• Proficiency in site layout, grading, utility design, erosion control, regulatory approvals, etc.

• Working knowledge of Civil 3D.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

title: Senior UX Visual Designer
description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

We think about our product more broadly than most: Northbeam isn't only a web app. It's our data and our recommendations, delivered wherever our customers already work. Sometimes that's our platform. Sometimes it's an alert that lands in their inbox and shapes their day. Sometimes it's our data flowing into their own systems, or back into the ad platforms to make those platforms smarter. All of that is Northbeam, and all of it has to be designed.

As Senior UX Visual Designer, you'll be the person who makes it look like the best product in its category. Projects here start with our SMEs (our Media Strategists, CEO, Data Scientists and Engineers) and product team, who define requirements and work on an initial concept. You take it from there — fleshing it out, resolving the details, and bringing a level of visual craft that makes dense analytical software genuinely delightful to use. You'll work alongside product, media strategists, data science and engineering to ship.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Chief Product and Design Officer.

What You'll Work On

•
AI inside the product. Automated alerts that tell a marketer what needs attention before they ask, and interfaces where customers can shape their own views and pages through natural language. These are new surfaces that need a visual language invented for them.

•
Incrementality. Making causal measurement feel approachable to someone who isn't a statistician through engaging and beautiful visualizations.

•
Actionable Data Insights. A coherent visual experience across our web app, mobile, email, and the integrations that push our data into our customers' own tools and workflows.

•
The core data platform. Complex, data-heavy interfaces that stay elegant as we add new capabilities for our customers.

Your Impact

• Take initial concepts from our subject matter experts and product team and develop them into resolved, high-fidelity design.

• Raise the visual bar across the platform — typography, color, layout, density, and the details that separate good software from forgettable software.

• Build and extend our design system so quality scales beyond any one screen.

• Design data visualizations that make complicated numbers immediately readable.

• Present work clearly to customers and executives, and give and receive critique well.

• Partner closely with our brand and marketing team on a coherent visual identity.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of product design experience, with solid B2B SaaS and enterprise work.

•
A visually outstanding portfolio. We want to see your finished work that you’ve shipped with real command of typography, color, layout, and hierarchy.

• Real experience with complex, data-dense interfaces, including data visualization.

• Experience building or substantially shaping a design system.

• Experience taking a rough concept and making it visually exceptional

• Expert command of Figma and adjacent design tools.

• Experience using AI to expedite design processes and to enable SMEs across the organization to build designs to spec.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, including giving and receiving critique.

Nice to Have

• Marketing, advertising, or eCommerce domain experience.

• A background that brings craft and playfulness to utility software — game design, motion, entertainment, or a formal art/design education.

• Motion design and interaction work.

Base Salary Range

$185,000—$210,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.
