title: Product Designer - Visual Craft & AI
description:
About Envato

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

Have you made something beautiful because you wanted it to exist?

Maybe you’ve built a small creative tool. Made an interface behave in a way we haven’t seen before. Used AI to turn an idea into something people can actually play with.

You’ve got a strong eye, ideas of your own and work to show for it. You might not have held a product design job yet.

We’re looking for a designer with exceptional visual craft, ideas of their own and the AI skills to turn them into working experiences. We’d like to see what you’re making.

Make things for people who make things.

At Envato, we’re building tools that help creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. We want those tools to feel as creative and considered as the work people make with them.

We’re looking for someone with fresh ideas who brings excellent visual craft and is already using AI to explore and build. You could be coming from uni, independent projects, freelance work or another creative discipline. We’re not fussed about your current job title or background, but what we do care about is raw design talent who can bring something different to the team.

What you could get your hands on

• You might prototype how a filmmaker saves a character reference and uses it across different shots. Explore how arranging and playing video clips could help someone see a story coming together. Or use motion, imagery and interaction to make an AI capability easier to understand and more enjoyable to use.

• You’ll bring different approaches, make them interactive and try them with the team and customers. Then you’ll help develop the promising ones into experiences people can use.

• This is work on the core product, not a separate collection of experiments that never makes it into customers’ hands. This work matters.

Bring your eye. Build your product experience.

• We want to see care in the typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. We’re interested in how you direct and work with AI.

• You should be curious about the person using what you’ve made, willing to share unfinished work, test things in the wild and able to change your approach when you learn something.

• You’ll work alongside experienced designers and engineers, with support on framing problems, testing ideas and getting work into the product. You won’t be expected to independently lead a whole product area from day one, but you will have real work to own, feedback to help you develop it and the opportunity to contribute things we haven’t yet thought of

Show us what you’re making.

To be considered, send us something you’ve built using AI, a finished product, prototype, website or interactive tool, and something that shows your visual craft. They can be the same project. Uni work, client work and independent experiments are all welcome.

Add a few lines about your contribution, the tools you used and the details you sweated

Life at Envato

• Flexible Working: remote-first across Australia or New Zealand with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need

• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.

• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.

• Learning Budget: study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.

• Home Office Allowance: a contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.

• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.

• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.

• Parental Leave:20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.

About Viamo

Mobile technology is revolutionizing how organizations engage with populations they serve. More than 96% of the world’s population has access to a mobile phone, meaning it is now possible to reach nearly every single person on the planet. Yet, three billion people still lack access to relevant and timely information in local languages and their voices remain under heard.

Viamo's vision is to be the organization that brings the world’s knowledge to the next billion people via voice.

The “Road to 100 Million Users” requires a product that is safe, affordable, available in local languages, and functional on any mobile phone. We manage the Viamo Platform, a national public information service called 8-4-5 in Rwanda. By calling 8-4-5 through an MTN connection, anyone in Rwanda with access to a basic mobile phone can access information on topics such as health, agriculture, financial literacy and more via IVR and a generative IA voice assistant, “Miss Baza”. To meet our scale and sustainability objectives, we are shifting from a project-funded model to a market-led utility embedded in the daily lives of users and the operations of partners.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Data Visualization Specialist to join our globally distributed team. In this role, you will lead the data analysis for our flagship product, Ask Viamo Anything (AVA). You will serve as the crucial link between AVA's data and the strategic objectives of the team. Working closely with the AVA Product Director, your insights will directly inform critical product evolution, user experience improvements, and commercial market decisions. You will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and shape the data function from the ground up while collaborating closely with leadership and cross-functional teams

Key Responsibilities

•
Dashboarding & Visualization: Create clear, impactful visualizations of data, including reports and dashboards, utilizing tools like Google Data Studio.

•
Quality Assurance: Ensure the absolute accuracy and reliability of all built data products by proactively troubleshooting, debugging technical errors, and resolving data discrepancies.

•
Product & Commercial Decision Support: Partner with the AVA Product Director to build master dashboards and visualizations that guide product roadmaps and commercial decisions.

•
Data Analysis & Insight Generation: Query Viamo data to answer specific questions about the performance of AVA across multiple countries, helping to unearth insights and interpret trends in complex datasets.

•
Funnel & Churn Analysis: Map and analyze the end-to-end user journey within AVA to support the product manager to identify drop-off points, friction in the user experience, and opportunities to increase lifetime value or engagement impact.

•
Data Storytelling for Leadership: Translate complex data architectures and statistical findings into clear, narrative-driven insights and commercial recommendations for executive stakeholders, commercial partners, and donors.

•
Metrics Definition & Strategy: Guide the product team to plan metrics definitions and recommend approaches towards a unified approach to product measurement.

Reporting Structure

• Reports to the Senior Director, Product Partnerships

Location: This is a remote position; however, applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada and reside within the Ontario (Eastern) Time Zone. Regular collaboration with team members requires availability during standard business hours in the Eastern Time Zone.

Profile

Desire

• 3-5 years of experience working as a data analyst or in a related role.

• Strong expertise in SQL.

• Proven experience in dashboarding software such as Google Data Studio.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel.

• Strong technical problem-solving skills with a proven ability to troubleshoot, debug, and communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical team members.

• Ability to work independently, taking ownership of responsibilities, managing priorities effectively, and following through on tasks with minimal supervision.

Desirable

about us

This role is fully remote. You can be located anywhere in Europe with a + in France.
Cycloid’s mission is to help organizations scale their platform engineering initiatives. Our platform optimizes the developer experience and operational efficiency by accelerating the delivery of internal developer portals and platforms. We reduce cognitive load for IT teams and advocate for FinOps and Green IT best practices. With Cycloid, platform teams don’t need to start from scratch to get a fully customized and sustainable solution.

Platform teams use Cycloid to design, build, and run platforms that enable end users to visualize, deploy, and manage projects, interact with DevOps and Cloud automation, and enforce best practices without needing deep expertise, all while keeping cloud costs and carbon footprint under control.

Cycloid is both an Internal Developer Platform and an Internal Developer Portal, with modules covering self-service workflows, platform orchestration, project lifecycle and resource management, FinOps and GreenOps, and an extensible plugin system. It can be consumed via the web console, CLI, or API.

We are an open organization. Your voice matters, and your point of view has a real impact on how we work and what we build. We are looking for someone opinionated, pragmatic, and comfortable shaping direction, not just executing.

Our long-term goal is to build the leading internal developer platform in the world, sustainably.

what is my challenge ?

Cycloid is currently defining the foundations, plans, and specifications for a full-scale rewrite of the platform, including a deep integration of AI into both development and design workflows. We are rethinking architecture, UX patterns, workflows, and the entire product experience.

You will own the design function end-to-end and become the primary driver of the product design vision for this new platform. This is a hands-on IC role: deep product thinking, complex systems UX, architecture-level design, and UI execution.

The design team is currently composed of one person (who will transition out), meaning you will step into a role with full ownership and autonomy, directly collaborating with product, engineering, DevOps experts, and the Founder.

This is a product-first role. You will work on complex workflows, platform and infrastructure UX, configuration models, permissions, environment lifecycle, and the connective tissue that helps highly technical and less technical users be successful.

We value designers who understand how things are built. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be comfortable discussing implementation constraints, reading code when useful, and collaborating efficiently with engineering teams.

what should i bring to the table?

Responsibilities

• Own and drive the product design vision for Cycloid, in alignment with product strategy and company goals.

• Lead the design of new features end-to-end: discovery, flows, architecture, prototypes, UI, and iterative refinement.

• Shape UX for complex, technical domains such as platform engineering workflows, infrastructure automation, permissions, configuration, and lifecycle management.

• Collaborate daily with product managers, frontend, backend, and DevOps experts to define requirements, challenge assumptions, and validate solutions.

• Establish a scalable design system for the next-generation version of Cycloid, ensuring coherence, quality, and long-term maintainability.

• Integrate AI-powered workflows and tools into design processes to accelerate discovery, prototyping, documentation, and iteration.

• Work closely with frontend teams to translate designs into high-quality Vue.js implementations; contribute small visual or interaction fixes when appropriate.

• Provide clear reporting to the Founder on product direction, priorities, and progress.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in product design, including senior or lead-level ownership of complex products.

• Proven experience driving design for technical products (developer tools, platforms, infrastructure, SaaS, DevOps, or cloud software strongly preferred).

• Demonstrated ability to own design in small or startup teams; able to bootstrap a design practice before scaling the design team progressively.

• Strong interaction design, UX architecture, and UI design skills, with a portfolio that shows systems thinking and clarity.

• Comfortable with frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, basic JS) and able to reason about implementation trade-offs.

• Experience influencing product strategy and collaborating closely with engineers.

• Ability to communicate design rationale, constraints, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Pragmatic, simplicity-oriented problem-solving mindset (KISS).

• Fluent in English.

• Startup mindset and comfort operating with autonomy.

Nice to have

• French speaker.

• Deep understanding of the IDP, DevOps, Cloud, CMP, or developer tooling ecosystem.

what we bring to the table

• Competitive salary and benefits.

• 100% remote work.

• High autonomy and full ownership of product design.

• A friendly, highly technical team.

• Real influence on the direction of a growing platform.

• Support for professional development and continuous learning.

• Strong commitment to sustainability and positive environmental impact.

• Home office setup budget up to €1200.

• Choose-your-own-device policy.

• One company retreat per year in the EU.

how we manage from now

• Application review (resume + portfolio).

• Interview with the current design lead to discuss your background, design approach, and fit.

• Design exercise to evaluate product thinking, systems design, and execution quality.

• Interviews with cross-functional leads (product, engineering, DevOps) and Founder to align on workflows and product vision.

You will join our talented production team, which serves as your creative division. Requirements

• Integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow for ideation, concepting, image generation, retouching, and producing creative variations at speed.

• Collaborate with strategists, media buyers, video editors, and content creators to translate creative concepts into high-performing assets.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and never compromising on quality.

Attitude

Experience & Skills

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
About Us:

Consertus is a global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.

Our integrated services span digital, advisory, and delivery, empowering organizations to navigate complexity, manage risk, and achieve strategic goals in sectors including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology.

At Consertus, we celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Join us to grow your career, develop your skills, and make a lasting impact as we transform how the world is built.

Discover how Consertus is driving transformative change for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve at www.consertus.com

About this Role:

We are seeking a Senior UI/UX Designer to own the experience layer across our digital product suite, this position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

This isn’t a role where you’ll be handed wireframes to polish. Consertus is a capital program management and advisory firm that leverages digital innovation to redefine how the world gets built. We’ve managed over $300B in capital programs across 10+ industries, and we’re now building a suite of AI-agent-powered products, that are fundamentally changing how owners manage construction projects, costs, and compliance.

Our engineering team moves fast—they build with AI. Cursor, Claude, and other generative coding tools are part of how we ship. We need a designer who doesn’t just understand that world but thrives in it: someone who can co-create at the speed of AI-assisted development and translate design intent into something our team can build without losing a step.

The question we’re obsessed with: when AI can do 90% of the routine work, what does the remaining experience need to be to make our products the ones people want to use? That’s what you’ll help us figure out.

Key Responsibilities:

•
Own end-to-end design for Consertus’ digital products, from early research and concept exploration through high-fidelity UI, prototyping, and engineering handoff

•
Design the interaction layer for AI-agent-powered features, including conversational interfaces, exception-based workflows, confidence indicators, and trust-building patterns

•
Collaborate with a vibe-coding engineering team—our devs build with Claude, Cursor, and other AI-assisted tools, and you’ll need to match their pace, speak their language, and design in a way that translates cleanly into their workflow

•
Bring AI-native instincts to your own process—leveraging generative tools, AI-assisted prototyping, and emerging design workflows to move faster and think bigger

•
Set and defend the quality bar across multiple product surfaces, ensuring consistency and delight even as we ship fast

•
Apply deep product thinking to complex business systems

•
Conduct user research to deeply understand the needs, pain points, and workflows of capital program managers, owners’ representatives, and project controls professionals

•
Champion the user’s perspective in every conversation—from sprint planning to architectural decisions—and push back when something isn’t good enough

•
Collaborate daily with engineering, product, and advisory teams across time zones

•
Build and evolve a design system that scales across the product suite while allowing for the flexibility each product surface demands

•
80–85% hands-on design work; the remaining time spent on research, design system stewardship, and cross-functional collaboration

Qualifications/Requirements:

•
7–10+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong taste and end-to-end ownership

•
AI-native design fluency — you use AI tools as a core part of your workflow (generative prototyping, AI-assisted research synthesis, LLM-powered design exploration) and can articulate where they help and where human judgment is irreplaceable

•
Ability to work alongside AI-assisted developers — our engineering team uses tools like Cursor and Claude to build; you’ll need to understand their workflow, communicate design intent with precision, and keep up with their pace without sacrificing quality

•
Proven ability to take complex, data-heavy workflows and make them feel simple—and even enjoyable

•
Deep product understanding of complex business systems — you can internalize multi-step approval chains, audit trails, cost control hierarchies, and compliance frameworks, and translate that understanding into designs that are smart without being overwhelming

•
Experience shipping production software (not just concepts or case studies)

•
Strong product thinking: you rethink what an experience should be, not just how it looks

•
Track record of defining and defending a quality bar, especially when there’s pressure to cut corners

•
Proficiency in Figma and modern design tooling

•
Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams through implementation

•
Bachelor's in design (Interaction Design, HCI, Visual/Communication Design) or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have:

•
Experience designing AI-powered, AI-agent-driven, or conversational interfaces

•
Background in AEC, construction tech, or similar complex B2B domains (financial services, logistics, legal tech, or any domain with multi-step approval workflows and dense data)

•
Experience building or scaling design systems

•
Motion design and micro-interaction skills

•
Front-end fluency—enough to prototype in code, read a pull request, or communicate directly in the language of the codebase

•
Startup or early-stage experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped under constraints

•
Familiarity with AI-assisted development environments (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)—not as a developer, but as a collaborator who understands how they shape the build process

What It Means to Be AI-Native Here:

This isn’t a buzzword. Our engineering team builds AI tools every day—using Claude, Cursor, and similar platforms to dramatically accelerate development. That changes the designer’s role in a real way:

•
Speed: Features that used to take weeks to scaffold now take days. Your design process needs to be moved accordingly.

•
Communication: When a developer is prompting their way through an implementation, precision in your specs and design intent matters more than ever. Ambiguous designs create expensive detours.

•
Collaboration: You’ll be expected to participate in the feedback loop of AI-assisted builds—reviewing outputs, flagging drift from design intent, and helping the team course-correct in real time.

•
Your own tools: We expect you to bring AI into your own design workflow—whether that’s using LLMs to synthesize research, generate explorations, or accelerate documentation. If you’re still doing everything by hand, you’re leaving speed on the table.

Working Hours:

•
Fully remote

•
Report directly to the CTO

Compensation Range:

•
$140,000–$180,000 annually, with flexibility based on experience and location.

What’s In It For You:

•
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision)

•
Company-paid life and disability insurance

•
Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans

•
401(k) with day-one eligibility, 3% safe harbor, plus up to 2.5% company match

•
Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25

•
Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development

Why Consertus:

•
Shape the UX vision for an AI-powered product suite at the intersection of construction, technology, and capital program management—a $13T global industry that’s ripe for transformation

•
Direct line to the CTO—your work will have immediate strategic impact, not get lost in a design org

•
Work on products powered by Consertus Labs, our innovation engine where AI agents, intelligent adapters, and machine-learning forecasting are being built and shipped

•
Join a company with deep domain credibility ($300B+ in programs managed, 90% repeat client engagement, 850+ employees, projects in 40 states and 5 countries) that’s investing aggressively in its digital future

•
Work at the frontier of AI-assisted design and development — this is a rare opportunity to define what it looks like when a design practice and an AI-native engineering team operate in true lockstep

•
Be part of a culture that puts the employee experience at its core—exceptional benefits, career growth, and flexibility

How to Apply:

If you’re passionate about digital innovation we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

title: Creative Director
description:
We are looking for a Creative Director to join our team. You will lead the development and delivery of exceptional creative work across art and copy. You will set the creative vision for a portfolio of pharmaceutical and wellness clients, ensuring ideas are strategically grounded, creatively distinctive, and effective within a highly regulated environment. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, develop creative leaders, strengthen client relationships, and help shape the capabilities and standards that support P10’s continued growth.

This role is open to remote candidates in the United States, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern time zone. You will report to an executive creative leader.

Responsibilities

•
Set and uphold the creative vision, standards, and ways of working across art and copy.

•
Lead integrated creative strategy and execution across a portfolio of brands, audiences, channels, and complex client assignments.

•
Guide Associate Creative Directors and other creative leaders, ensuring teams have clear direction, effective coaching, and appropriate decision-making authority.

•
Create an environment where art and copy operate as an integrated partnership and consistently produce strategically sound, compelling work.

•
Serve as the senior creative voice in high-stakes client discussions, brand planning, concept presentations, and executive-level meetings.

•
Build trusted relationships with senior clients by connecting creative recommendations to brand strategy, audience needs, and business objectives.

•
Provide decisive creative direction and resolve complex challenges involving strategy, craft, client feedback, regulatory requirements, timelines, staffing and resources.

•
Maintain accountability for the quality, strategic alignment, accuracy, and regulatory viability of creative work across the portfolio.

•
Partner with cross-functional leaders to shape briefs, brand plans, communication strategies, and innovative client solutions.

•
Develop the department’s leadership pipeline through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and thoughtful delegation.

•
Monitor the performance and health of the creative function, using business and talent insights to improve quality, efficiency, collaboration, and scalability.

•
Stay ahead of trends across healthcare, culture, technology, media, and creativity—translating relevant developments into stronger work and agency-wide points of view

Requirements

•
Bachelor’s degree in advertising, communications, marketing, design, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

•
At least 16 years of creative experience, including significant experience within a pharmaceutical or healthcare agency environment.

•
At least five years of progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for multidisciplinary teams and other people leaders with demonstrated success building teams, developing senior talent, managing performance, and planning resources across competing priorities.

•
A strong foundation in either art or copy, with demonstrated ability to evaluate, direct, and elevate both disciplines.

•
A portfolio demonstrating strategically grounded concepts, integrated campaigns, and high-quality work across multiple channels and audiences.

•
Proven experience leading complex, high-value client relationships, brand planning, and creative work across multiple brands or accounts.

•
Strong business judgment, including an understanding of scopes, budgets, staffing, utilization, profitability, and agency growth.

•
Exceptional communication, presentation, influence, and relationship-building skills.

•
Ability to balance ambitious creative thinking with strategic, regulatory, operational, and commercial realities

Interested in working with us? Apply online today. For this role, a copy of your work portfolio will also be required for future interview stages.

Not an agency*

The layer-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego-driven dog-and-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working—or could work better—change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.

P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different - join us.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.

If you’re a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, we’d love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

• Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.

• Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.

• Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.

• Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.

• Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.

• Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.

• Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.

• Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.

• Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.

Requirements

What you'll bring:

• Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.

• Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.

• Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.

• The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.

• The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.

• Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.

• Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.

• Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.

• Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.

• Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.

• An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.

Benefits

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:

• A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversary

• A “ReFuel Day” once a quarter to relax and refuel

• Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to life’s events

• A progressive parental leave policy

• Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern Cross

What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50’s team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If you’re based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, we’ll pay for you to get here.

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful. Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.

• We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.

• We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.

• We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.

• We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.

Application process:

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If you’re not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.

description:

That’s not our style. So if you want to see your creative ideas come to life - and be seen by millions of people around the world – this is the perfect job for you.

•
3+ years experience as a video editor.

Other Qualities You’ll Need

At AlgaeCal we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

• You’re humble, you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own

• You’re hungry to learn more

• You’re people smart, in the sense that you’re a great teammate

The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

Let’s agree on salary once we know what you’ve got to offer, but we’ll aim to pay above the market rate for your unique skills.

How to apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicants. So, to make sure our future Multimedia Designer is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

• Send us a minimum of 3 examples of videos you’ve edited.

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but it’s our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the “Apply Now” button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document.

Applications without a cover letter will not be read! Include the URL link to your personal website / portfolio****

DOOR understands that job requirements sometimes exclude people who identify with historically marginalized groups from applying to jobs for which they are qualified. What is required?

• Being encouraged to invent and innovate within your role and working in a company where calculated risk-taking is highly encouraged and thinking outside the box is a must.

Attention Job Seekers: Beware of job scams!

Job scams are on the rise, and you should take steps to protect yourself in your job search. Here are some guidelines to help you stay safe if you are applying for a job with Latch or DOOR:

• Communications from Latch or DOOR will always come from @ or @. Do not accept a job interview invitation with Latch or DOOR from anyone who does not contact you through an email that comes from @ or @.

• Latch never interviews candidates via Skype or in writing where you do not see the interviewer. All of our interviews happen either by video or in person.

• We will never offer you a job based on a single conversation with someone claiming to be from our People organization. In all of our job interviews, you will always speak, by video or in person, with the hiring manager for the position.

• Do not share your sensitive personal information with anyone who purports to offer you a job at Latch or DOOR unless you verified that the offer is from Latch or DOOR (check email senders addresses). We will never ask you for your bank account information or your mother’s maiden name during the interview process.

• We will never ask you to purchase any equipment with a promise that we will reimburse you after you begin working for us.

Обов'язковий досвід роботи з іграми на етапі оперування (LiveOps).

Офер

title: Associate Electrical Engineer-Federal Engineering & Design
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

We are seeking an Associate Electrical Engineer to join our Federal Engineering and Design Team. In this role, you will support the planning and design of electrical systems for federal facilities and infrastructure projects. Working alongside experienced engineers and designers, you will gain exposure to federal design standards, including UFC, DoD, and VA requirements, while developing technical expertise in power distribution, lighting, communications, and other building electrical systems.

This position provides hands-on experience designing mission-critical facilities and offers the opportunity to contribute to projects that support national interests while building a strong foundation for your engineering career.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist in the design of electrical systems for federal facilities, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, communications, and life safety systems.

• Perform engineering calculations, system layouts, and equipment selections under the guidance of licensed engineers.

• Develop and apply knowledge of electrical engineering principles, codes, standards, and industry best practices.

• Utilize engineering and design software such as Revit, AutoCAD, or other electrical modeling and analysis tools.

• Assist with project schedules, design coordination efforts, and interdisciplinary collaboration with mechanical, civil, structural, and architectural teams.

• Research applicable federal design criteria and recommend solutions to technical challenges.

• Gain experience creating and maintaining project information within the firm's project management systems.

• May travel to project sites and federal installations to support design development, construction, and project coordination activities.

Why Join Us?

• Contributes to projects that support national defense, public service, and critical federal infrastructure.

• Enjoy flexible work arrangements, including remote work options.

• Grow your technical expertise through mentorship, professional development opportunities, and exposure to complex federal projects.

• Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment that values teamwork, learning, and career growth.

Qualifications

You Are Passionate About:

• Solving complex engineering challenges.

• Working collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.

• Building technical expertise and continuous learning.

• Using your talents to positively impact communities and federal clients.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a concentration in Power.

• Minimum of one year of engineering experience, internship experience, or equivalent academic project experience.

• Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe.

• Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles related to building and facility systems.

• Working knowledge of, or ability to become proficient in, design and modeling software such as Revit, AutoCAD, SKM, AGi32, or similar tools.

• Familiarity with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and electrical building systems is preferred.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Willingness to travel and perform occasional field work as required.

At Olsson, your expertise helps deliver innovative solutions for projects that matter. If you're passionate about electrical engineering, eager to grow your technical skills, and excited to contribute to impactful federal projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

• Receive a competitive 401(k) match

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

GA is at the leading edge of creating practical solutions to one of the most pressing challenges of our time - the future of work. As recognized by The World Economic Forum, BCG, the OECD and more, these are big challenges to which only a few companies are offering real solutions. In this role, you'll be speaking every day to corporate leaders who rely on GA to help them apply these solutions to their workforce of the future.

*We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer with a proven track record of developing technical education and capability-building programs across domains such as Software Engineering, Data Science, DevOps, and MLOps, etc.*

As a Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer (LED), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and contextualizing high-quality GA learning programs for enterprise, technical, and professional audiences. This role requires strong learning experience design knowledge, excellent program development and project management skills, and hands-on fluency with AI tools and emerging workplace technologies.

You will create practical, outcome-driven learning experiences that help learners build relevant skills and apply them with confidence in real workplace contexts. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides, assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

While this role will contribute significantly to GA’s AI-enabled and emerging technology portfolio, it is not a purely AI curriculum role. The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.

You will project manage and collaborate with subject matter experts, instructors, product managers, learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

Terms and Details:

• This is a flexible, contractor position on a 2 or 3 month term

• We would expect someone to provide 30 hours per week when on a project

• This role will be 100% remote

• For US Candidates: Pay is between $45 and $55 USD per hour

• For European Candidates: Pay is between €23 and €35 Euros per hour

• For South Asian Candidates: Pay is between $15 and $25 USD per hour

• For APAC Candidates: Pay is between $20 and $38 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities:

Program Ownership & Discovery

• Serve as the Lead Learning Experience Designer for GA programs that may include AI, emerging technology, digital transformation, technical skills, leadership, role-based application, or workplace productivity components.

• Own the complete Client-facing Design Process; requirements gathering, learning outcomes, project timelines, scope, resourcing, development plans, and content quality from discovery through delivery.

• Partner with sales, product, client success, solutions, and delivery teams to identify client and learner needs and translate those needs into practical learning solutions.

• Support pre-sales and client conversations by helping define skill needs, learner personas, program objectives, audience readiness, and recommended learning pathways.

• Evaluate the tools, workflows, use cases, and workplace contexts most relevant to a client or learner audience, including AI tools where relevant, and determine how they should be represented in the learning experience.

• Define clear learning outcomes that move learners from awareness to practical application, workflow improvement, productivity gains, behavior change, and responsible technology use.

Applied Learning Design & AI-Enabled Development

• Design and develop practical, instructor-led learning experiences for learners at varying levels of expertise, including programs where AI tools, workflows, or emerging technologies are central to the learner outcome.

• Create instructor-led training materials, including slides, hands-on labs, case studies, simulations, assessments, facilitator guides, learner workbooks, and practical workplace exercises.

• Build learning experiences that help learners actively apply new skills in realistic workplace contexts, including the use of AI tools and platforms where relevant.

• Design hands-on activities using current workplace and AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Midjourney, NotebookLM, or other tools relevant to enterprise learning.

• Translate complex or technical concepts into structured, accessible, and engaging learning experiences in partnership with subject matter experts.

• Curate, contextualize, and update content to reflect emerging industry trends, new tool capabilities, evolving best practices, accessibility expectations, and responsible use considerations.

• Design structured learning pathways across levels of proficiency, including AI literacy, role-based application, technical skill development, workflow redesign, responsible technology use, and advanced concepts where appropriate.

• Develop practical, interactive exercises such as tool walkthroughs, prompt refinement activities, workflow mapping, use case development, ethical decision-making scenarios, productivity tasks, coding challenges, technical labs, or real-world business simulations.

• Ensure learning experiences are grounded in adult learning principles, learning science, accessibility, measurable learner outcomes, and practical transfer to the workplace.

• Follow GA’s design and development standards, best practices, templates, QA processes, and productization expectations for core and customized curriculum.

• Create, execute, and own the quality of project and program development timelines, deliverables, and required resources.

• Onboard and project manage all resources required for program development, including SMEs, other LEDs or instructional designers, assessment specialists, instructors, vendors, contractors, and freelancers.

Delivery & Instructor Enablement

• Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery, including facilitator guides, run-of-show documents, learner workbooks, real-world case studies, tool setup instructions, troubleshooting guidance, and activity facilitation notes.

• Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for applied, interactive learning, including live tool demonstrations, coaching, discussion facilitation, learner support, applied exercises, and technology-supported problem solving.

• Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, government organizations, technical teams, business leaders, and cross-functional employee populations.

• Ensure instructors are equipped to deliver learning experiences confidently, accurately, consistently, and in alignment with GA’s instructional standards.

• Collect, synthesize, and analyze data on learning impact to support continuous improvement, content refinement, learner outcomes, and program updates.

• Where applicable, work with translation vendors and localization partners to adapt learning experiences for global audiences.

Productization

• Lead conversations and workflows with product management and learning systems design teams to standardize reusable GA learning patterns, components, activities, templates, and program structures.

• Contribute to the development of a scalable library of reusable GA learning components, including program structures, activities, assessments, facilitator resources, client-ready assets, and AI-enabled learning patterns where relevant.

• Identify which custom learning materials can be converted into reusable product components or repeatable delivery models.

• Support the evolution of GA’s learning portfolio by identifying emerging client needs, market shifts, tool trends, and opportunities for new or improved learning products.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, curriculum design, or a related field, with significant experience creating instructor-led training content.

• Demonstrated ability to design high-quality learning experiences for enterprise, professional, technical, or workplace audiences.

• Strong experience creating practical, outcome-driven learning materials, including slides, facilitator guides, activities, assessments, case studies, labs, simulations, and learner resources.

• Experience managing clients, stakeholders, SMEs, instructors, vendors, or cross-functional partners through a content development process.

• Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE, experiential learning, practice-based learning, and adult learning principles.

• Ability to design for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leaders, business teams, functional teams, and technical practitioners.

• Hands-on fluency with current AI tools and the ability to use those tools to design, prototype, evaluate, and improve learning experiences.

• Demonstrated experience designing learning experiences related to AI, emerging technology, data, digital transformation, technical skills, or workplace technology adoption.

• Strong working knowledge of AI concepts, including generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, machine learning, AI agents, ethical AI, responsible use, and enterprise AI adoption.

• Experience designing practical, hands-on learning activities that may include AI tools, labs, case studies, simulations, workflow exercises, or tool-based practice.

• Experience collaborating with subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into structured, engaging, and accessible learning experiences.

• Familiarity with LMS platforms, content management systems, and authoring tools.

• Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings across time zones, particularly in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

• Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments where priorities, tools, and client needs evolve quickly.

• Passionate about helping diverse learners build practical, future-facing skills for the changing world of work.

Nice to Have:

• Technical proficiency in AI, data science, or coding, including Python, APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.

• Experience using GitHub or other technical collaboration tools.

• Experience designing AI training labs, coding exercises, model-building workshops, or real-world AI case studies.

• Familiarity with virtual machines, cloud-based labs, sandbox environments, or technical learning environments.

• Experience integrating AI-driven personalization, adaptive learning, or AI-supported learner practice into course design.

• Experience designing enterprise AI adoption programs, leadership AI programs, role-based AI academies, technical academies, digital transformation programs, or role-based learning journeys.

• Experience creating learning experiences for tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, Midjourney, or similar platforms.

Unless otherwise noted, remote positions can be performed from the following approved General Assembly operating countries.

United States of America (states of operation may vary), Canada (provinces of operation may vary), United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo’s Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.

Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.

You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

•
Vision & creative direction

• Own and evolve Prenuvo's creative expression, translating brand and business strategy into a distinctive experience across channels.

• Set the creative vision, principles, and quality standards that guide the brand design team and its partners.

• Provide senior creative direction for major campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives while empowering Creative Leads to direct individual programs and bodies of work.

• Ensure the brand remains cohesive while continuing to evolve as Prenuvo, its audiences, and its offerings grow.

•
Organizational leadership

• Own the structure, capabilities, performance, and development of Prenuvo's Creative function, building a multidisciplinary team capable of supporting the company's evolving brand and business needs.

• Lead and develop team members, establishing clear accountability and empowering them to lead their teams and work independently.

• Identify capability and talent gaps and determine where to build internally versus leverage agencies, freelancers, and production partners.

• Create an environment of high standards, collaboration, accountability, creative ambition, and professional growth.

•
Portfolio, priorities, and resources

• Own creative portfolio planning and resourcing, partnering with the VP of Design & Experience and cross-functional leaders to prioritize creative investment against the company's highest-value opportunities.

• Balance business demand, team capacity, strategic importance, and creative opportunity when establishing priorities.

• Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.

• Provide visibility into creative priorities, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

•
Cross-functional leadership

• Serving as the senior creative authority to the local brand design and creative team while taking broader direction from the VP, Design and Experience and partnering with leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other functions.

• Translate business objectives, audience insights, and channel strategies into creative opportunities and direction.

• Present and advocate for creative strategy and work with senior and executive stakeholders.

• Partner closely with Product Design where brand and product experiences intersect, creating continuity while maintaining clear ownership between the two functions.

• Creative systems and effectiveness

•

• Establish scalable approaches to creative intake, prioritization, briefing, review, production, and delivery.

• Oversee agencies, freelancers, production partners, and other external creative resources.

• Partner with Marketing and Growth to understand creative performance and translate learnings into stronger creative strategy.

• Balance brand-building and performance objectives, ensuring short-term optimization doesn't come at the expense of long-term brand equity.

• Identify opportunities for AI and emerging technologies to improve creative exploration, production, scalability, and efficiency.

• Remain connected to the work and step directly into creative development when the scale, complexity, or strategic importance of an initiative warrants it.

What You’ll Bring

• 15+ years of experience in creative, brand, design, or related disciplines, including significant creative leadership experience.

• 5+ years managing and developing creative teams and senior creative talent, with demonstrated success building high-performing multidisciplinary organizations.

• An exceptional portfolio demonstrating brand thinking and creative direction across multiple channels and experiences.

• Deep experience across brand, digital, web, paid advertising, social, video/motion, and integrated campaigns.

• Experience with physical or experiential design—including retail, clinics, hospitality, or events—is highly valued.

• Strong understanding of both brand building and performance marketing.

• Demonstrated experience with portfolio prioritization, resource planning, team building, and organizational development.

• Experience managing agencies, production partners, freelancers, budgets, and complex creative programs.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and articulate the thinking behind creative decisions.

• Familiarity with product and UX design and the ability to partner effectively with Product Design leadership.

• Strong understanding of contemporary creative tools and emerging AI-enabled creative technologies.

• Consumer marketing experience in healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, wellness, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

• Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

• We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

• We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

• An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health

• We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member

• Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way

• Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize

• Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it

•
Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family

• The base salary for this role ranges from $180,000-$210,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to .

title: Brand Designer
description:
About Subsense

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

Subsense · Remote first, Bay Area hybrid or on-site later · Reports to Alex Karpman, Brand & Marketing Lead

Engagement: Independent contractor, starting with a 1-month project estimated at 30 hours per week. Project scope: advance and finalize the brandbook, build social templates, create marketing materials for conferences, add slides to the master deck and create a new creative brochure.

Path to in-house: Depending on fit and business needs, Subsense may offer a full-time, in-house (W-2) Brand Designer position after the project.

The role

Subsense is building an AI-native NanoBCI: a non-surgical brain-computer interface that uses nanoparticles instead of implants. We are a team of about 40 scientists and engineers across two Bay Area labs, starting with medical applications such as Parkinson's and ALS. Our brand has to feel human, calm and clinically credible while explaining deep science and vision to investors, clinicians, press and future patients.

You will be the in-house hand behind every Subsense visual. We have brand guidelines (palette, Sora and Inter type system, gradients, chart style, logo rules). Your job is to advance them, turn them into a working system and then use that system every week, fast and consistently.

The work moves between two modes, and you should feel native in both. One day it is structured, clear and readable pitch deck slides that help investors follow complex science. The next it is creative, catchy and sometimes bold marketing materials that stop people at a conference or in a feed. Switching between them easily is the job.

Today this work is spread across several agencies and freelancers. We are bringing all of it in-house with one designer who knows the brand deeply, keeps clean source files and can turn a request around in a day when an investor meeting is tomorrow.

What you will do

•
Brand system: build and maintain our Figma library (templates, components, icons, chart styles) so every file starts on brand

•
Pitch decks and investor materials: maintain the master pitch deck, make fast slide edits for fundraising, build one-pagers and data room documents

•
Presentations: keynote and conference slides for our CEO and scientists, templates the whole team can use

•
Social media: monthly static posts, carousels, infographics and simple motion for LinkedIn and X, built on reusable templates

•
Event and conference materials: roll-up banners, booth graphics, sponsor assets, signage, badges, printed programs, ready for print vendors

•
Out of home and campaigns: billboard and digital ad creative, from concept to print-ready files

•
Merch: artwork and tech packs for caps, T-shirts and gifts

•
File hygiene: every deliverable ships with an editable native file in our shared drive, named and versioned

You might be a fit if you

• Have a portfolio that shows brand systems, not just one-off pieces, ideally including decks and print

• Are fluent in Figma and Canva, and comfortable in Google Slides

• Use AI image and video tools as part of your workflow and know where they help and where they hurt quality

• Can take a messy request ("make slide 8 clearer, tomorrow") and ask the two right questions before you start

• Care about typography, spacing and restraint

• Are curious about neuroscience, biotech or deep tech

• Are reachable during California business hours (Pacific Time) and can turn quick adjustments around the same day

Nice to have

• Experience with scientific or medical visuals

• Packaging, merch or environmental design

How to Apply & What to Expect

Submit your portfolio, weekly availability, and responses to four application questions, including why you’re interested in Subsense. Brief, thoughtful answers are welcome! We ask for more detail up front to keep the interview process focused and streamlined.

Shortlisted candidates can expect:

•
Recruiter screen — 30 minutes over Zoom to discuss your experience, interests, and the role.

•
Test tasks + Loom walkthrough — Complete three short design tasks and present your approach in a recorded Loom video.

•
Final hiring manager interview — 45 minutes over Zoom to discuss your work, collaboration style, and any remaining questions.

Why You’ll Thrive

You'd be joining a small team developing a non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it.

A few things that make this different:

•
Own meaningful technical work: Take projects from early R&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions.

•
Build across disciplines: Work hands-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI.

•
Help shape a novel platform: Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain-to-AI communication.

•
Make a visible impact: Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth.

Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off.

Subsense is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Responsibilities

•
Lead strategy and own the problem from end to end -> Own the client relationship and lead engagements from discovery through delivery, developing services, experiences, and product strategies that hold together across user needs, business goals, and what's operationally feasible. That means translating an ambiguous business problem into a defined scope of work, then staying accountable for the strategy as it moves into execution.

Design experiments and pilots that test full service moments, people, process, and technology together, rather than validating an interface in isolation.

•
Bring product fluency into the work -> Ground strategy in real user research and market validation, and understand roadmapping, backlog prioritization, and agile delivery well enough to know what's actually executable. This is what keeps a strategy from becoming a deck: knowing where the technical and organizational constraints actually are.

•
Orchestrate and deliver -> Coordinate across design, product, engineering, and data to keep engagements moving toward a real deliverable, not just a recommendation. Use blueprints, journeys, measurable insights, and roadmaps as the artifacts that get stakeholders who don't naturally agree to a shared decision.

•
Communicate, coach, and grow the practice -> Present strategy to audiences ranging from frontline staff to executive teams, and coach client teams in service design methods so they can keep using the tools after the engagement ends. Contribute to proposals and mentorship, and act as a subject matter expert Cabin can put in front of a client.

Qualifications

• Track record leading service design or product strategy work, with a portfolio showing blueprints, products, journeys, or ecosystem work.

• Hands-on curiosity with AI tools: already using them to think, research, and build.

• Strong human-centered and service design fundamentals, with a systems mindset.

• Working knowledge of product leadership: discovery, roadmapping, backlog prioritization, and sprint facilitation.

• Exceptional facilitation and communication skills across frontline and executive audiences.

• Comfortable defining the right question in ambiguous problem spaces.

• 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally client-facing consultancy work.

Focus Areas / Role Differentiation

This role sits within a team that covers several areas of depth. If you're applying, tell us which one matches your strengths best. We'll also help you find the right fit through the interview process if you're not sure.

Senior Innovation Strategist
Focused on ecosystem thinking and problem framing to imagine new systems and experiences: mapping how a complex mix of people, process, policy, and technology fits together, and finding where the leverage points are. Strong in facilitation and in guiding client teams through ambiguity toward a clear strategic direction, using service design in the midst of a broad toolset.

Senior Product Strategist
Focused on product strategy and delivery: research, roadmap definition, and the product management discipline to take an idea or plan through an actual build. Strong in user needs research, backlog ownership, sprint-level prioritization, and day-to-day partnership with design and engineering, staying accountable for a product from strategic direction through shipped software, not just the plan for getting there.

Senior Service Designer
Focused on the craft of service design itself: building and facilitating the blueprints, journey maps, and future-state artifacts that other strategists and clients use to make decisions. Deep hands-on capability with the artifacts themselves, with a capability in measurement, new service innovation, and behavioral change.

Senior Strategist, AI and Data
Focused on delivering AI and data-driven outcomes as the client-facing product itself, not just using AI as part of how the work gets done. Designs and frames engagements where AI capability, data infrastructure, or a data-enabled strategy are what the client is actually buying, and takes those engagements from framing through delivery.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Design Researcher for our Design Team.

User Science is an evolving design discipline at Canonical. While we have long incorporated diverse research on user needs into our products, the mission of the newly formed User Science team is to expand beyond traditional models of UX research, integrating user needs end-to-end in development processes and quality standards across the company.

This mission requires skillful advocacy as well as organizational learning and change. As process pioneers, we draw insights from others, foster collaborative user research cultures, and constantly innovate with frameworks and standards.

This role sits in the design team reporting to the User Science Manager.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

• Conducting user research: Developing user insights in diverse formats, identifying and championing user needs across product areas.

• Sharing findings concisely and skillfully: Supporting different teams with well-matched research presentations and clear documentation systems.

• Promoting and shaping a data-informed culture: Working closely with process, product, and engineering teams to integrate user research into existing decision-making flows.

• Building research scalability and interoperability: Owning research ops infrastructure, making key methodologies more accessible, actionable, and repeatable.

• Fostering a learning culture: Contributing to the evolving definition of User Science through user-centered training, resource development, and outreach.

What we are looking for in you

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering or similar, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.

• Deep research expertise: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative user research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, A/B testing, surveys, and data analysis. Exceptional depth in either qualitative or quantitative skills.

• Strong technical curiosity: An alignment with and interest in open-source culture and the ability to engage deeply with technical subjects and stakeholders.

• Proficiency in visual design and/or information design: Capability to translate complex data or ideas into strong, convincing visuals, ensuring that insights are both accessible and memorable.

• A talent for storytelling and collaboration: Outstanding ability to craft narratives that effectively explain research findings and resonate with diverse audiences.

• A knack for turning chaos into clarity: Meticulous organization and archivist skills, with the ability to transform scattered findings or disparate processes into cohesive, structured knowledge systems.

• Portfolio: A robust portfolio showcasing a range of user research and/or design projects that highlight the ability to derive actionable insights from research and directly influence 1) product design and strategy or 2) organizational change.
