title: Senior EPMS Design Engineer
description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

We are seeking a Senior EPMS Design Engineer who thinks in terms of scalable, mission-critical systems and high-reliability operational architectures. As a senior member of the Controls Design Engineering (CDE) team, you will own the technical development, design standardization, and system integration of Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) across our global fleet.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between electrical design concepts, controls engineering, and operational reality. You will serve as the primary owner for global EPMS specifications, network architectures, and control logic—ensuring that our critical power infrastructure (including switchgear, generators, UPS lineups, and distribution units) delivers robust telemetry, fault visibility, and automated power monitoring for hyperscale environments.

Key Accountabilities

•
Design & Architecture Governance: Author and maintain detailed EPMS design deliverables, including network architecture diagrams, Sequences of Operation (SOO), Basis of Design (BOD) documents, input/output (I/O) points lists, and project scopes of work (SOW).

•
Standards & Specifications: Own and maintain company-wide Division 25 (Integrated Automation) and Division 26 (Electrical) EPMS specifications, standardized drawing templates, and telemetry schemas.

•
Engineering Document & Drawing Reviews: Review detailed MEP design drawing packages—with a deep focus on electrical single-line diagrams, three-line diagrams, and control schematics—to ensure complete EPMS coverage, redundancy, and metering alignment.

•
Submittal & Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Audits: Review electrical equipment manufacturer submittals (switchgear, UPS systems, PDU/RPP units, generators, ATS) to ensure factory-installed meters, protection relays, and gateways comply with communication and telemetry standards.

•
Vendor & Bid Coordination: Create detailed EPMS vendor scopes of work, review technical proposals during contractor bidding, evaluate control system integrators, and manage technical Requests for Information (RFIs) to drive down scope gaps and change orders.

•
Hardware & Communications Architecture: Specify control panel requirements, PLC hardware lineups, and communication protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP, BACnet/IP, and TCP/IP), ensuring optimal bus capacity and network segmentation.

•
Cross-Functional Integration: Define integration strategies linking EPMS to industrial PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), Branch Circuit Monitoring Systems (BCMS), and cloud telemetry brokers (e.g., MQTT / Sparkplug B architectures).

•
Testing & Quality Assurance: Participate in Factory Witness Tests (FWTs) and Equipment Qualification Tests (EQTs) to validate point mapping and EPMS device functionality on first-of-kind electrical assemblies.

•
Commissioning & Construction Support: Conduct QA/QC audits on active builds, supporting commissioning agents through L1–L5 testing phases, point-to-point checkout validation, and final "As-Built" package reviews prior to Ready For Service (RFS) handoff.

•
Operational Root-Cause Support: Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) to diagnose complex system anomalies, including Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), or power metering discrepancies.

Required Skills

•
Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) design, engineering, or systems integration within data centers or mission-critical facilities.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or commensurate industry/military experience in lieu of degree.

•
Engineering Documentation: Demonstrated expertise in generating and interpreting electrical single-line diagrams, control network schematics, sequences of operation, control panel layouts, and Bills of Materials (BOM).

•
Protocols & Industrial Networks: Strong working knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus (RTU and TCP), BACnet (MS/TP and IP), and Ethernet TCP/IP networking.

•
System Knowledge: Hands-on design fluency with PLC-based EPMS architectures, Branch Circuit Monitoring Systems (BCMS), and power metering hardware.

•
Specifications: Demonstrable experience authoring or interpreting CSI Division 25 and Division 26 specifications.

Preferred Skills

•
7+ years of progressive engineering experience within hyperscale or colocation data center infrastructure.

•
Deep understanding of critical data center electrical infrastructure, including medium/low voltage switchgear lineups, static transfer switches (STS), UPS lineups, transformers, power distribution units (PDUs), and utility/generator paralleling logic.

•
Familiarity with cloud data aggregation models and modern telemetry brokers (e.g., MQTT, Sparkplug B, Inductive Automation Ignition).

•
Experience participating in L1–L5 commissioning cycles, Integrated System Testing (IST), and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).

Work Location & Travel Expectations

•
Location: Flexible; preferences include primary operational hubs (Georgia, Texas, or Arkansas).

•
Travel: Up to 25% travel to global data center construction sites, equipment manufacturing facilities for Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and corporate functions.

Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.

description:
Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

About the roleWe're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our BNPL stream and design the merchant side of Tabby's core product. You'll work on the Merchant Dashboard, across web and the mobile app, the place where merchants run their business with Tabby: manage transactions, settlements and invoices, set up in-store and integrations, and use self-service tools.

You'll join a newly formed Merchant Experience team with a lot of attention on it and a lot to build: upgrading core dashboard pages, launching new self-service products, running merchant experiments, and rethinking how Tabby works in physical stores.

We're looking for someone who thrives on complexity, turns uncertainty into clarity, owns problems end to end, and brings strong product thinking alongside strong craft.

Why join

• Work on the merchant side of Tabby's core BNPL product, in an area that is a current company priority

• A lot to build: core page upgrades, new self-service products, experiments and a rethought in-store experience

• Real ownership in a newly formed team: shape how the product and the team work from the start

• An AI-forward team where design can iterate fast and get close to code

• A dedicated UX writer and UX researcher to work with

What you will be doing

• Own merchant journeys in the Merchant Dashboard end to end, across web and mobile, from early concept through polished execution

• Upgrade core dashboard pages such as transactions, settlements and invoices, and design new self-service tools for merchants

• Design clear, data-dense interfaces that make complex financial and operational information easy to understand and act on

• Design and iterate on merchant experiments and new features with your Product Manager, and measure what works

• Help reimagine the in-store experience together with product and engineering

• Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers and our UX researcher and UX writer to identify and solve key merchant problems

• Use data, merchant feedback and research insights to inform design decisions and validate hypotheses

• Partner with designers from other B2B and B2C streams to keep the experience consistent across Tabby, and contribute to the design system

• Use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow: prototyping, ideation, and moving solutions closer to code

• Present and advocate for your work to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment

What you will need

• Proven experience designing digital products, ideally B2B, fintech, or complex data-rich tools

• Strong craft skills demonstrated through a portfolio, with excellent Figma skills

• Comfort designing across both web/dashboard and native mobile (iOS and Android)

• Strong product thinking: you understand business goals, product logic and user needs, and can explain the reasoning behind your decisions

• A strong level of AI proficiency: you use AI tools on real project work to prototype, explore and move faster

• Understanding of technical constraints and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering

• Experience applying systems thinking and contributing to shared design systems

• Autonomy: you operate without close supervision and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluency in English

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech or financial products

• Experience conducting UX research

• A strong base in graphic design

• Experience designing for GCC markets or Arabic/RTL interfaces

• Comfort working close to code, with interest in contributing to code through AI tools

Benefits

Locations

We hire candidates based within four hours of Dubai time, with remote work available in eligible locations. Depending on your circumstances, we can also discuss an individual relocation plan to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Poland, and Spain.

What you can expect

• Flexible working hours, coordinated with your team and the needs of your role.

• Autonomy and responsibility from day one.

• Opportunities to grow through the quality and impact of your work.

• Participation in our employee stock option program.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Who we are

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Romania.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Fluxon, you'll lead design end-to-end on ambitious projects, often working directly with founders and product leads to shape what gets built. We are looking for design generalists, someone who owns the design surface, thrives in ambiguity, and cares as much about why something gets built as how it ships.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will:

• Partner with founders, product leads, and other stakeholders to turn business goals into experiences customers love

• Lead design end-to-end, from discovery and research through interaction design and production-ready execution, calling the right level of depth for each project

• Make the right call when user needs, technical constraints, and business goals pull in different directions

• Collaborate closely with clients, PMs, and engineers to set the direction and ship high quality work

• Bring a point of view on craft, process, and where the field is going, while staying current with new technologies and design trends

Qualifications

• Experience leading product design end-to-end, from strategy through to production ready execution, delivering work that customers love and drives business results

• Strong judgment and ability on process, knowing when to go deep on research and when to move fast

• Strong UX foundations across the full discovery and design process, from research through interaction design, user testing and accessibility

• Strong visual craft across layout, typography, iconography, color, and motion, with the ability to take work to a polished, production ready bar

• Excellent communication and presentation skills across written, visual, and spoken formats, with experience presenting directly to clients

• Comfortable collaborating closely with clients, PMs, and engineers, including managing expectations, navigating disagreement, and keeping the work aligned

• Experience shipping with startups or founding teams, comfortable building from zero without established design foundations or process

• Experience working with US clients (European clients a plus)

A note on applications - A portfolio is a required part of your application. We treat it as a critical element of the review process, and it must be included in your submission.

What we offer

• Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you

• Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing

• Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)

• "No internal meetings" on Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work

• A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language

• A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health

• Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections

• A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience

• Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together

• A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organisation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process.

This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Lead Product Designer

Givelify is a fintech-for-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we’ve helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7.5 billion. Together, they’re changing their world with kindness and generosity.

Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters.

Make an impact at one of the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits.

About your role:

We’re seeking a Lead Product Designer to elevate the quality, strategy, and impact of product design across Givelify’s mobile and web experiences. You’ll drive design excellence, guide cross-functional alignment, and shape end-to-end product vision—from discovery through delivery. In this role, you’ll combine hands-on design leadership with systems-level thinking to create simple, inspiring, and scalable product experiences for our giving community.

The Creative Team:

Givelify’s Creative Team produces the experiences that wow our audiences and users. We consistently deliver world-class design and creativity across the entire business, serving our customers in collaboration with product, technology, marketing, support, and operations. This role reports to the Director of Product Design.

The Lead Product Designer will get to:

•
Drive Product Design Initiatives
Lead design initiatives, imagine novel solutions, and guide cross-functional teams toward cohesive product outcomes. You move fluidly across the entire design process—from problem framing to high-fidelity prototypes—and elevate complexity into elegant simplicity. You know great design is invisible because it works effortlessly for our giving community.

•
Own End-to-End Design Execution
Ensure successful delivery of product experiences by driving all phases of design work. From discovery and solution ideation to refined interfaces and engineering handoff, you set the standard for quality, clarity, and completeness.

•
Optimize Design Operations & Efficiency
Maximize throughput and design velocity by shaping and owning design operations for your scope of work. You establish structure, anticipate needs, remove friction, and scale effective design practices across teams.

•
Quality Elevation & Feedback Culture
Continuously raise the bar for design excellence by soliciting, synthesizing, and acting on feedback from stakeholders. You model a culture of “feedback is fuel” and know how to extract value from different points-of-view to arrive at quality—strengthening both the work and the team behind it.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

•
Apply Human-Centered Design for Major Initiatives
Shape end-to-end product experiences by driving cross-functional conversations, orchestrating user flows, and guiding teams from concept through launch with a deeply human-centered approach.

•
Lead Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate strategically with Product, Engineering, and senior cross-functional leaders to influence priorities, illuminate trade-offs, and ensure every touchpoint reflects Givelify’s mission and strategic objectives.

•
Drive Insight-Informed Decision Making
Embed a deep understanding of Givelify’s audiences and business strategy into design decisions, representing the customer perspective at all times to guide product direction and elevate design quality.

•
Advance the Design System & Standards
Drive growth and adoption of the Givelify Design System—ensuring scalable, consistent, and brand-aligned experiences across platforms while coaching teams on best practices. 

•
KPIs:

• # of creative cycle days

• # of replies per cycle

Your experience:

• Bachelor’s degree  

• Experience working on a native mobile apps team

• 5+ years of B2C native mobile app experience

•
Expert level proficiency of Figma, Adobe CC suite and/or other industry standard creative tools

• A portfolio highlighting some of your best work (please include password)

•
Prototyping: Lofi and Hifi prototypes, you know when to use one over the other and embrace an iterative process. 

•
Languages: English; Spanish a plus 

•
Communication: You can articulate what makes a good vs great design, as well as articulate your design point of view. 

• Problem solver who requires very little guidance on projects; thrives in a fast-paced environment. 

• Expert-level applied understanding of formal elements of design, including typography, layout, balance, and proportion. 

•
(Bonus) Research: You are familiar with front-end research (light ethnography) and/or able to facilitate user testing sessions to validate your designs with users. 

• (Bonus): Remote: Experience working with remote teams. 

Your superpowers:

•
Problem-Solving: Is resourceful and creative in solving complex issues. Uses sound judgment, data, and collaboration. Connects design decisions to brand and business outcomes.

•
Integrity: Demonstrates congruence in thought, speech, and action. Can be trusted to act with courage and to do the right thing. 

•
Collaboration: Fosters productive relationships; values others' opinions, shows appreciation, and seeks to understand different perspectives. 

•
Customer Focus: Adopts a human-centric approach that meets or anticipates customers' needs when developing solutions. 

•
Drive for Results: Can be relied upon to be resourceful & tenacious in achieving key desired results. 

•
Effective Communication: Inspires and aligns through clear, thoughtful dialogue.

•
Mentorship: Invests in the growth and success of fellow designers.

Our culture:

We are a virtual team of award-winning and high-performing professionals who innovate and collaborate to fulfill our mission to instantly connect people to causes that matter most to them so they can change their world with kindness and generosity. Our four keys to success - integrity, heart, simplicity, and wow - fuel our passion to be recognized among the tech industry’s most inclusive and purpose-driven workplaces.

We are steadfast in our conviction to overcome challenges while performing meaningful work alongside some of the most brilliant minds and biggest hearts. It propels our growth as individuals and as a team. We are committed to respecting each other in our workplace, firmly believing diversity is our strength.

At the heart of everything we do are our giving community, our donors and our partner organizations. We lean on research and human-centered design to consistently push the envelope and innovate our products and customer experiences.

We take great pride in providing competitive pay, full benefits to help care for you today and in the future, amazing perks (including flexible PTO), and, most importantly, the opportunity to put passion and purpose front and center.

About Givelify

Givelify is the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving platform. Along with its powerful donation management system, it’s the fastest-growing technology for advancing generosity in the world. We instantly connect people to their heart’s impulse to do good with award-winning products and experiences. A global community of over 2 million generous people supports their favorite churches, places of worship, nonprofits, and causes with over $7.5 billion in donations across more than 80,000 organizations. Givelify leads all giving apps on the App Store and Google Play Store with more than 135,000 verified, authentic reviews with an average 4.9 out of 5-star rating. Learn more at Givelify.com.

Ready to join the Givelify team? Apply below.

title: Game Design Intern [Spring 2027]
description:
Crystal Dynamics is constantly seeking the best gaming talent worldwide to add to our 30-plus year legacy of game development creating new and iconic franchises. We are committed to making great games with great people and living the dream while doing it.

Benefits for our regular full-time positions include, but are not limited to, a competitive regional salary, 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance options, professional development reimbursement, flexible hybrid on-site/off-site work opportunities, company paid holidays, plus additional paid days in December when the studio is closed for holiday break, and the ability to accrue additional paid time-off.

Join us and help shape an amazing studio culture, where we’re building award-winning franchises like Tomb Raider and more!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Crystal Dynamics is now accepting applications for a remote spring internship, open to candidates across most U.S. states. As part of this 12-week program, you will take part in meaningful, hands-on work that contributes directly to active AAA projects. Throughout the program, you will step into a professional development environment where ongoing projects, experienced mentors, and collaborative teams give you a direct view into AAA game creation. This internship is designed to help you build industry ready skills, form strong professional relationships, and deepen your understanding of how world class games are made!

Eligibility Criteria: 

• Graduated from a college or university program in 2026 (Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter).

• Degree in Animation, Art, Game Art, Technical Art, Game Design, Game Development, Engineering, or related fields.

• Availability to work full-time (40 hrs / week), during core business hours, for the duration of the program (February 1st – April 23rd, 2027), including the first week onsite at our studio in San Carlos, CA for onboarding.

• Legal eligibility to work in the United States.  

• Submission of a complete application that includes a resume, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or GitHub. 

What You Will Gain:  

•
Practical Project Involvement: Contribute to active game development efforts while learning production scope, workflows, and the advanced tools used across modern AAA pipelines.  

•
Professional Mentorship: Receive guidance from experienced professionals with deep industry knowledge. 

•
Skill Development: Expand your skill set, establishing a solid foundation for your professional journey.  

•
Team Collaboration: Work alongside our dedicated onsite and remote teams including fellow interns, building valuable professional relationships within the gaming industry.  

What You Will Do:

• Learn and apply development workflows in Unreal Engine, using Blueprint scripting, rapid prototyping, and playtesting to turn design ideas into working gameplay. Review, test, and refine your work with guidance from your design mentor.

• Help improve existing combat and traversal mechanics by reproducing issues, debugging Blueprint logic, tuning gameplay values, and building small test spaces to evaluate movement distances, timing, readability, and game feel.

• Prototype clearly scoped gameplay features with guidance from the project’s design leadership. Potential assignments include progression and upgrade systems, new movement abilities, systemic encounters, or a focused boss encounter. Contribute fresh ideas and iterate on a small playable prototype through regular feedback.

• Help develop and document repeatable workflows for designing, building, and testing gameplay and levels. Explore Unreal Engine’s procedural content generation (PCG) tools, create reusable test setups, and record what works so others can build on your experiments.

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Foundational hands-on experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint scripting, demonstrated through a small playable project, prototype, or coursework, together with a strong interest in learning and thoughtfully applying game development tools, systems, and workflows.

• Portfolio examples should show one or more of the following:

• Gameplay logic or systems you helped build, such as a character ability, movement mechanic, interaction, encounter, or simple progression system. Explain your contribution, how the logic works, and how you investigated a problem or improved the result.

• A playable gameplay or level prototype that demonstrates experimentation, attention to the player experience, and iteration based on testing or feedback. Personal, classroom, and game jam projects are welcome.

• Industry involvement outside classroom curriculum such as game jams, personal projects and/or contributions to group projects that show going above and beyond.

• Exposure to industry-standard development software tools and engines.

• Willingness to tackle challenges, learn from feedback, and adapt to new tools or workflows.   

• Ability to communicate your ideas with eagerness to learn and put feedback into action. 

INTERNSHIP FAQ

Interns are vital to our innovation and growth. Below are answers to some of the most frequently asked questions about our internship program. Given the volume of applications we receive, we aren’t able to accept resumes directly via email or provide individual updates through outreach. To be considered, please submit your application through our careers site so your materials are routed to the hiring team for review.

Q: When and how long will the internship take place?

A: The internship is a 12-week, full-time program, with interns working 40 hours per week. The exact dates will vary year over year, and may be subject to change.

Please see our upcoming schedule below for details:

Spring 2027 Internship

• February 1st – April 23rd, 2027

Q: Where will the internship be located?

A: This is a remote internship for candidates living in eligible US states. However, the first week will be on-site at our studio in San Carlos, California for onboarding and a chance to meet people who you will be working with throughout the internship.

Q: Will this be a paid internship?

A: Yes, the internship will be paid. Hourly rates for each position will be detailed in the job description. Compensation for this internship is $20-23/hr. Compensation is location-based and will be aligned to the intern’s confirmed work location during the program. Interns are also eligible for a medical, dental, and vision benefits package. Your recruiter can provide more information about total compensation. 

Q: What are we expecting an intern to do?

A: Interns will be selected based on our current project needs. Specific responsibilities and expectations for each intern will be outlined in the job description for the internship position you apply for. This will provide valuable hands-on experience within your chosen field at our studio.

Q: Does Crystal Dynamics have a dress code?

A: At Crystal Dynamics, we believe that creativity thrives when you can be yourself. That’s why we encourage you to wear what makes you comfortable and confident, as long as it’s within the bounds of professionalism and respect for others. Whether it’s casual wear or your favorite gaming tee, feel free to showcase your individuality. Just remember, any attire that could be considered offensive or inappropriate is not allowed.

Q: How do I apply?

A: To apply for an internship, please visit our careers page, where you will find detailed information on our current internship openings and the application process. We encourage you to apply since we’re looking at your skills, experience, and potential, not every requirement! Please note that incomplete applications or attempts to submit outside of the careers page will not be considered. If you make our shortlist, we’ll be in touch for further assessments and interviews. We look forward to receiving your application!

Q: What can I do to make my application stand out from the crowd?

A: To make your application stand out, focus on tailoring your resume to the specific internship role you’re interested in and put together a thoughtful cover letter. Highlight any relevant experience or coursework related to game development and consider including a well-organized portfolio if it showcases your skills effectively. Emphasize your ability to work collaboratively in teams, stay informed about industry trends and the studio’s projects, and ensure your application materials are error-free and professional. If you have references who can vouch for your skills, consider including them. Lastly, closely follow application instructions and be thoroughly prepared for interviews, demonstrating your passion and suitability for the role.

Q: Do I need a degree?

A: At Crystal Dynamics, we value diverse backgrounds, including various levels of education and experience. Having a university degree is not a strict requirement for all of our regular full-time positions. However, if you’re interested in our internship program, eligibility is as follows:

Spring 2027 Internship:

• Recent college or university graduates from Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter 2026 with a relevant degree.

Q: Is there a possibility for an intern to become a full-time employee?

A: We value the impact our interns bring to the teams and projects. Our goal is to give interns the experience they need to be successful after schooling is complete. These opportunities are limited and depend entirely on business needs at the time. Interns are encouraged to make the most of their internship and explore future opportunities with us as they become available.

Q: What perks and benefits does Crystal Dynamics offer to interns?

A: Interns at Crystal Dynamics enjoy a range of perks and benefits. These include competitive compensation, access to industry professionals, networking opportunities, and a supportive learning environment. Additionally, interns will be eligible for medical, dental, and vision benefits and have access to unlimited snacks in the office! Detailed information about these perks and benefits will be provided to successful candidates during the onboarding process.

Q: If I’m not eligible for the program at this time, can I be considered for any future internship programs?

A: If you are not eligible for the program at this time, we encourage you to keep an eye on our future internship opportunities. We regularly assess our needs and welcome talented individuals to apply when suitable positions become available.

The pay for this internship role includes the base hourly rate, and does not include the medical, dental and vision benefits package that interns will also be eligible for.

Your recruiter will be able to share more information about total compensation.

Internship Pay Rate (United States)

$21—$24 USD

Not sure if you are qualified? We hope that you will still choose to apply so we may review your application!

• High proficiency with modern game engines, such as Unreal or proprietary engines. Proven experience in scripting, prototyping, and iterating gameplay systems directly. Experience in 3D layout a plus.

Mathematical Skills

Reasoning Ability

title: Economy & Balancing Game Designer - Casual HTML5 Games (remote, fulltime)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Economy & Balancing Game Designer who can design, model, and tune the economies, progression, and reward systems of casual HTML5 games played by millions of people worldwide.

As part of one of our multidisciplinary game development teams, you will design, model, balance, test, and iterate game economies from early concept through live operations. You understand that a great casual game economy is not just “generous” or “tight”: it paces progression, makes every reward feel earned, gives every purchase a clear purpose, and stays healthy for years.

About CoolGames

At CoolGames, we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly.

CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands.

With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams.

If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team, CoolGames is the right place for you.

About the role

As an Economy & Balancing Game Designer at CoolGames, you take ownership of the economies inside our casual games: the sources, sinks, progression, and reward systems that decide how players earn, spend, and advance. You will design systems that are fun, fair, understandable, and commercially effective. And you own the outcome: not just the analysis behind the numbers, but the retention and revenue they produce.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary agile team. Together, you will work on new titles, improve existing live games, and help shape the models, tools, and processes that make good economy design scalable across our portfolio. Because our games run on a range of platforms with different monetization models, you know how to make an economy work whether it is driven by in-app purchases, ads, or a subscription platform.

On new games you are involved from the very first design sessions, so that the economy, its sinks, and its progression are designed in from the start rather than balanced after the game has been built. On live games you take the economy apart per title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships, and you model and simulate that change rather than shipping it and reading the result afterwards.

You are comfortable working both creatively and analytically. You can feel when a progression curve or a reward loop is right, but you also know how to validate that instinct through models, simulations, A/B tests, and player data.

About You

You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You care deeply about how players feel when they play, and you know that a healthy economy and a great player experience are the same goal, not a trade-off. You know how to design systems that motivate without manipulating, monetize without frustrating, and reward without devaluing progress.

If you are:

• An experienced Economy, Systems or Balancing Game Designer

• Ready to work on long-lasting casual titles, and to move between them when needed

• A strong believer in teamwork

• Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go

Then you are on the right track to be a great match with Coolgames.

Responsibilities

• Design and balance the economy, progression, and reward systems of our casual games, from the first design sessions of a new title through live operations

• Own the revenue outcome of the economies you design

• Build and maintain the economy models, balancing sheets, and simulations for each title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships.

• Use player data and A/B tests to find friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities, and to show, with data, where balancing proposals from game and level designers will take retention and revenue.

• Design motivation loops and a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events that work together rather than compete for player attention

• Communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to the team and the studio, and take ownership of a title’s economy when moving between projects.

• Research how comparable games in our genres structure, pace, and price their economies, and keep that as the reference we balance and price against.

Requirements

Requirements

• 5+ years designing, balancing, and operating the economies of successful, released free-to-play games on mobile and/or HTML5, including casual or puzzle titles.

• Comfortable being accountable for a title’s KPIs: you make and defend decisions

• Advanced spreadsheet and modeling skills: balancing, simulation, and forecasting models, and fluent use of AI tools to build and analyze them faster.

• Strong analytical mindset: you design and evaluate data, translating it into concrete design changes.

• Deep understanding of player motivation, retention mechanics, LiveOps, and monetization design, and the empathy to feel what our casual audience will and won’t accept.

• Independent and proactive, quick to get up to speed on a new game and its audience, with excellent English and experience working in remote, multidisciplinary teams.

• A habit of benchmarking: you know the economies of the leading games in our genres well enough to say where ours sits against them.

Benefits

What we can offer you

• An international team of 80+ professionals from almost 20 different countries;

• Work closely with some of the biggest upcoming game platforms in the world on high-quality casual games that are played by millions of players;

• Competitive remuneration;

• A flexible remote working environment;

• A very open, informal, and international company culture where everyone can make a difference.

Apply

Do you love building game economies that players find fair, motivating, and worth investing in, and that stay healthy for years?

Then we would love to hear from you. Please include your CV and, where possible, a portfolio, economy models or balancing sheets, shipped games, design documents, or examples that show how you think about progression, monetization, and player experience.

title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & LiveOps (remote or on-site, full time)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Game Designer who combines systems design and economy design expertise with LiveOps and product strategy. You will shape the core progression and monetization systems of our free‑to‑play titles while owning an events and content roadmap that boosts retention and revenue. You’ll blend creative design with data‑driven decision‑making, transforming KPIs and player insights into clear, high‑impact updates. You’ll be a key force in an agile, multidisciplinary and creatively charged development team.

About CoolGames

At CoolGames, we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly.

CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries and headquartered in The Netherlands.

With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams.

If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team,CoolGames is the right place for you.

About the role

As a Senior Game Designer, you will be responsible for the entire systems and LiveOps lifecycle. This includes designing new casual free-to-play games for desktop, tablets, and mobile, from initial concept through all stages of the product lifecycle. You will design and balance core loops, progression, rewards and game economy, then extend them through LiveOps: in‑game events, content drops, experiments and monetization changes that address KPI opportunities, lift retention and grow both IAP and ad revenue. Armed with analytical tools, you will translate insights into actions, weigh impact versus effort, and continuously iterate to keep our games fresh and competitive. Working side‑by‑side with developers, artists, QA and marketing in an agile environment, you will articulate strategy and results to stakeholders at every level, ensuring smooth execution. At the same time you will coach and inspire other game designers, fostering a culture of creativity, data‑driven decision‑making and constant improvement across the team.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Define and maintain the systems design for core loops, progression, rewards and economy (sources/sinks, pacing, difficulty), ensuring they align with player needs and business goals

• Build and evolve a LiveOps strategy and content roadmap (events, seasonal mechanics, IAP offers and ad-driven promos) that drives engagement and revenue

• Design and implement in-game experiments (A/B tests, event variations) and use the results to inform design decisions; iterate so each update measurably improves retention and monetization

• Specify clear, developer-ready design documents and balancing sheets; be the single source of truth for feature scope, rationale and success metrics

• Stay on top of casual F2P market trends and top-grossing competitors; pitch new content, meta features or mechanics (e.g., collections, passes, streaks, time-limited challenges) that fit our audience

• Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team (design, engineering, art, QA, marketing) to deliver features and LiveOps smoothly; participate in agile rituals to align with development cycles and product goals

• Present product vision, LiveOps plans and post-event analyses; communicate the “why” behind your strategy with data and research to secure buy-in from internal stakeholders and external partners

• Mentor other game designers and raise team craft through feedback and reviews

Requirements

About You

• 5+ years of professional experience as a Senior Game Designer within the mobile or web F2P industry, with hands-on systems/economy and LiveOps experience

• Deep familiarity with top-grossing casual games and F2P mechanics; you know what keeps players returning and spending, and can anticipate shifts in player behavior or monetization patterns

• Ability to translate complex data and KPIs into actionable design changes and clear roadmaps, balancing player enjoyment with business objectives

• Strong written and verbal communication in English; concise specs and clear presentation skills

• Proven experience in cross-functional teams; you integrate creative, technical and commercial perspectives into a cohesive product direction

• Experience in mentorship or leadership, fostering designer growth, and promoting a positive, solution-oriented approach.

• Bonus: game economy design specialization; puzzle/casual background; HTML5/web distribution experience

Benefits

What we can offer you:

• An international team of 80+ professionals from almost 20 different countries;

• Work closely with some of the biggest (upcoming) game platforms in the world on high-quality casual games that are played by millions of gamers;

• Competitive remuneration;

• A flexible remote working environment;

• A very open, informal and international company culture where everyone can make a difference.

title: Senior Level Designer
location: Remote (Albania, Andorra, Austria, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Faroe Islands, Finland, France, Germany, Gibraltar, Greece, Guernsey, Holy See (Vatican City State), Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Isle of Man, Italy, Jersey, Kosovo, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, San Marino, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Svalbard and Jan Mayen, Sweden, Switzerland, Ukraine, United Kingdom, Åland Islands)
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to.

You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship. A dedicated level editor and an AI-powered level generation pipeline will be ready on day one, so you spend your time on what matters: making every level fun.

What you’ll do

•
Build. Design, build, and tune levels directly in Unity, covering layouts, encounters, pacing and difficulty.

•
Scale. Triple our level content by combining our AI pipeline with your own design judgment.

•
Balance. Model how health, damage, and stat changes affect the numbers before anything ships.

•
Polish. Bring existing levels to final quality and give them the feel and juice that make players stay.

•
Own. Set the level design roadmap, make design calls, and question whether each choice fits the game.

•
Specify. Write clear, detailed specs that developers can implement as written.

•
Learn from players. Use playtests and player data to see what works and iterate quickly.

•
AI. Use AI every day to generate layouts, prototype encounters, simulate balancing, and automate level work.

Requirements

• Years of level design experience, with shipped levels on a hybrid casual, RPG or combat-based game.

• Hands-on balancing skills: you’re comfortable with stats, health and damage maths, and spreadsheets.

• Fluency in Unity: you build and iterate levels in the engine yourself.

• A strong sense of game feel: you know when a level is fun, and you can explain why.

• AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.

• The autonomy to build your own roadmap and make design decisions.

• A data-driven approach to level tuning.

• Feature design experience alongside level design.

For this role, you’ll also bring

•
Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.

•
Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.

•
Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.

•
Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.

•
Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious, high-energy, and grounded.

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

•
Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.

•
Real ownership. You own the player experience of a game, and you’ll see your levels move the metrics.

•
The right tools from day one. A dedicated level editor and an AI level pipeline, so you focus on design.

•
A high talent bar. Our teams are small and ambiti us, and the people around you will push you to grow.

•
AI at the core. You’ll have access to the best AI tools, and you’ll help shape how level design works in an AI-first company.

Benefits

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

•
Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.

•
Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.

•
Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.

•
Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

• 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.

• 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.

• 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.

• 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

• ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.

• 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.

• 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
Remote · Anywhere in India

About Parallel

Parallel is a product and web design studio. Our clients are usually software companies in the US and Europe, and craft & taste are the reason they hire us. Quality is our competitive advantage. Most of the industry is optimising for speed right now, and we think craft holds its value longer. We sweat the details and we make it seem effortless.

Your role

The website is the piece of a company's design that everyone sees. It carries the brand, it does the selling, and it is usually the first real thing a customer touches. We are looking for a designer with impeccable taste and a deep command of the web to lead that work at Parallel. You will design our most important sites yourself and set the standard for every website the studio ships. It is a hands-on, high-ownership role.

What you'll do

•
Lead the web design on our biggest client projects, from the first concept to launch.

•
Work out how a brand behaves on the web, through type, colour, grid, and motion.

•
Design the sites we make for clients: homepage, product pages, pricing, landing pages.

•
Art direct photography, illustration, and 3D when a page needs it.

•
Present the work and the reasoning to clients, and iterate on the feedback.

•
Review the web work of other designers on the team and help them make it better.

•
Work with our developers so the site that ships matches the site you designed.

•
Work alongside our product designers so the site and the product feel cohesive.

•
Shape how Parallel designs for the web as the practice grows.

What you would bring

•
6+ years designing websites, at a studio, an agency, or in-house at a software company.

•
You have led web projects, with other designers working alongside you or reporting to you.

•
Exceptional craft and a sharp eye for typography. This is what separates good web work from decoration.

•
A strong grasp of brand systems. You can work inside one, and extend it when the website needs more than the guidelines cover.

•
Motion and interaction skill: scroll behaviour, transitions, the small movements that make a page feel alive. After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or Framer's own motion tools.

•
Fluency in Figma, and enough command of Framer or Webflow to know what is possible once a site gets built.

•
You are comfortable presenting to founders, and you can hold your ground on a decision that matters.

•
You use AI consciously in your process, and you know where it helps and where it gets in the way.

Good to have

•
Brand identity work of your own, beyond applying someone else's.

•
Enough front-end knowledge to talk to a developer precisely.

title: UX/UI Researcher
description:
About Yaqeen Institute

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We work to dismantle doubts through well-researched truths, nurture conviction by strengthening belief with practical, spiritual guidance, and inspire contribution by reviving our tradition of faithful changemakers, insha’Allah. We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

What You'll Do

Role description and overview

Yaqeen Institute for Islamic Research creates research papers, articles, videos, ebooks and learning curricula for Muslims around the world, from people exploring faith to educators and community leaders who share our work. We’re looking for a UX/UI researcher to help our product teams understand how people discover, use and value these products, and to bring that understanding into how we design and improve them.

The first project focuses on our free library of English-language ebooks. Our last in-depth study of these readers was in 2024, and reading habits and search tools, including AI assistants, have changed a lot since then. A reader survey is already running, and this project goes deeper through one-on-one interviews. You will own the study end to end, from research questions to synthesis. Your findings will shape the library’s product roadmap and help Yaqeen measure the value it creates for readers.

This is a four-month contract that may be extended or converted into a longer-term, full-time role.

Role Responsibilities

• For the ebook library, review the 2024 research and early results from the current reader survey, and work with the Product Manager to set the study's research questions and objectives.

• Write a discussion guide that ties each research question to the outcomes the product team tracks, such as downloads, how readers discover the library, and whether consuming a product leads them on to Yaqeen's research and other content.

• Screen and recruit a mix of participants across reader segments, by drawing on survey respondents who opt in to follow-up interviews.

• Run and record one-on-one interviews with ebook readers that explore:

• what readers do after they finish a book (for example, read further, share it, apply it, or move to other Yaqeen content)

• how they prefer to read and listen (PDF, EPUB, audiobook, print, on phone or on desktop)

• how the way they search for and research Islamic topics has changed over the past few years, including any use of AI tools

• which features they would find useful on the library's website and in the reading experience

• the topics they want Yaqeen to write about next

• Synthesize the findings, compare them against the 2024 research, and show what has held steady, what has shifted, and what is new.

• Deliver a written findings report on the ebook library and present a readout to stakeholders, with prioritized recommendations for the product, editorial and marketing teams.

• Handle participant data with care: get informed consent, collect only what the study needs, anonymize personal details in all notes and reports, and honor any request to change or delete a participant's data.

• Help measure the impact of Yaqeen's products on users' religiosity using BASIC, Yaqeen's religiosity framework, for example by building its measures into surveys and discussion guides and tracking change over time.

• Share research methods, templates and findings with other product teams, and advise on where user research could inform their roadmaps.

• Help set up research practices other teams can reuse, such as a participant panel, standard consent forms and a shared library of findings.

Qualifications & Required Skills

• A bachelor's degree in human-computer interaction, psychology, sociology, anthropology, information science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A master's degree or formal research training is a plus.

• Experience planning and running qualitative user research, especially in-depth interviews, from recruitment through synthesis.

• Ability to write neutral, open-ended interview questions and to probe for behavior rather than opinion.

• Strong synthesis skills, including affinity mapping and thematic analysis, and the ability to turn patterns into prioritized recommendations.

• Clear writing and presentation skills for a mixed audience of product, editorial and marketing colleagues.

• Familiarity with digital content products such as reading, video or learning platforms, and comfort reading survey data alongside interview findings.

• Understanding of the Muslim community and sensitivity in discussing faith, doubt and personal practice with participants.

• Comfort working independently and supporting more than one product team at a time.

• Prior experience researching Yaqeen's audiences is a strong advantage.

Yaqeen Institute embraces a philosophy that values and promotes diversity. Our goal is to attract, develop, retain, and advance a talented and diverse workforce within a culture where all employees are empowered to reach their fullest potential.

Please note that all career opportunities at Yaqeen Institute are subject to a three-month probationary period, during which we assess performance, alignment with our values, and mutual fit to ensure long-term success in the role.

title: Motion Graphics Editor
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Motion Graphics Editor who can turn static assets into kinetic masterpieces and elevate our video content with high-end visual polish.

Why This Role Matters

Movement, energy, and visual communication are your playground. As a Motion Graphics Editor, you are the visual alchemist of our post-production team. You bridge the gap between graphic design and video editing, using animation to explain complex product benefits, reinforce brand identity, and keep viewers glued to the screen.

In the world of performance marketing, dynamic text and seamless transitions are often the difference between a skip and a sale. If you thrive on creating kinetic typography, stunning visual effects, and fluid motion that drives conversion, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

•

Design & Animate High-Impact Assets

•
Create dynamic motion graphics for social media and TV ads, including kinetic typography, logo reveals, lower thirds, and transition effects.

•
Take static design assets (Ps/Ai) and bring them to life using Adobe After Effects.

•
Design engaging "explainer" sequences and infographics that visually communicate product USPs (Unique Selling Propositions).

•

Elevate Video Edits

•
Collaborate with Video Editors to layer high-end motion graphics over live-action footage.

•
Apply visual effects (tracking, compositing, screen replacements) to enhance production value.

•
Ensure all graphics align perfectly with the brand guidelines and visual identity of our diverse DTC clients.

•

Build Scalable Systems (MOGRTs)

•
Create and optimize Motion Graphics Templates (.mogrt) for use in Premiere Pro, allowing our editing team to scale their output efficiently.

•
Develop reusable animation libraries and assets to speed up the post-production workflow.

•

Innovate Visual Styles

•
Stay ahead of the curve on motion design trends (e.g., collage style, liquid motion, retro-tech) and implement them into our campaigns.

•
Experiment with new plugins and techniques to constantly raise the bar of our visual output.

Who You Are

•

A Motion Design Pro

•
3–5 years of experience in motion graphics and video editing (agency, broadcast, or high-end freelance).

•
A strong reel showcasing not just animation skills, but a strong eye for design, layout, and typography.

•

Adobe Suite Master

•
Expert proficiency in After Effects (compositing, expression scripting, shape layers) and Premiere Pro.

•
Strong command of Photoshop and Illustrator for asset preparation.

•
Bonus: Experience with Cinema 4D or Blender is a plus, but not required.

•

Performance-Driven

•
You understand that motion graphics in advertising must serve a purpose. You know how to use motion to guide the viewer’s eye to the most important information (the CTA).

•

Organized & Efficient

•
You keep your project files and pre-comps meticulous. You know how to structure a project so that other editors can navigate it easily.

•
You can render fast and manage version control without errors.

•

Collaborative Communicator

•
Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret feedback from Art Directors effectively and explain technical constraints or opportunities clearly.

Perks & Benefits

•
Growth Opportunities: Influence the visual language of major global brands and lead motion initiatives.

•
Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one keyframe at a time.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with a passion for sleep health and a strong UX mindset: someone who looks beyond the screen to define what we should build and why. You will be working on the evolution of Hatch Sleep Clock, our flagship adult product.

Join our growing team as we dream up new experiences that leverage our unique ecosystem of hardware, software, and content, working to define the sleep space as an essential part of overall health and wellness. As a Senior Product Designer at Hatch, you'll be an individual contributor on the adult products team, leading UX for new and evolving features that help adults fall asleep, stay asleep, and wake up rested.

You'll shape features from the earliest stage: framing problems, synthesizing research, mapping end-to-end journeys across app and device, and turning insights into new member journeys and experiences. You'll pair that strategy with hands-on design, partner closely with product and engineering to scope and ship features, and help build the product design practice at Hatch. You'll collaborate with our stellar design, product, and engineering teams and play a big role in shaping the creative culture at our company.

What You’ll Do

Within 1 month:

• Build a solid understanding of our adult device ecosystem, the science of adult sleep, and our customers by digging into existing research, feedback, and usage data.

• Form strong collaborative relationships across the design team, PMs, and engineering teams.

• Identify the biggest UX opportunities and gaps in the adult product experience and share a point of view with the team.

Within 3 months:

• Lead UX for one or more features from problem framing through launch, working closely with PM and engineering partners.

• Design and ship your first responsive sleep experience; working closely with PM and Engineering partners and taking advantage of Hatch’s contactless sleep tracking technology.

• Discover, define, and implement new customer journeys and experiences.

• Plan and run research and prototype testing at varying levels of fidelity, and turn the findings into clear decisions.

After 6 months:

• Take on larger, more ambiguous feature work, using what you've learned about our adult customers to shape what we build next.

• Build on your learnings and design system work to develop and launch new-to-the-world features and products.

• Actively contribute to infusing creativity, play, and learning into our team culture.

What You’ll Bring

• Passion for human-centered product experiences and for solving ambiguous problems.

• 5+ years of hands-on UX and product design experience, with a portfolio that shows strategic thinking and the process behind the work, not only polished UI.

• Demonstrated ability to define problems and shape product direction: framing opportunities, mapping journeys, and making the case for what to build.

• Strong research skills: planning and running studies and turning findings into clear decisions.

• Experience leading UX for features end to end, from concept to launch, in partnership with PMs and engineers.

• A strong understanding of UX and UI best practices in mobile applications, including accessibility.

• Ability to turn concepts into functional prototypes for testing and alignment.

• AI-native in how you work: you've built AI into your own design process, prototyping with code and generative tools, and you can show how that changed what you shipped, not just how fast you shipped it.

• Clear communication: storytelling, thorough design documentation, and the ability to influence cross-functional partners.

• Excitement about working in a fast-paced environment.

• Big bonus if you have experience in consumer facing products, IoT product development, or designing for adult audiences.

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

• We’re a certified Great Place to Work

• We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives

• Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution

• We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)

• We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

• 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)

• Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here

• 401(k) match with no vesting schedule

• 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• 16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)

• Financial support for family planning

• Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement

• Friends and family discounts on Hatch products

• Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

•
Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights

•
Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights

•
Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?

We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.
