title: Senior UX Researcher, Quantitative
description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Ondo's user research team is small but mighty, and works horizontally across the whole product suite, not inside a single pod. We're hiring a senior quantitative user researcher to build and lead quantitative research across the portfolio.

You'll set your own UXR strategy with minimal guidance, take on the hardest decision-shaping questions whichever team they come from, and answer them with evidence that holds up at scale.

What You'll Do

• Own the research intake and quant roadmap. Field research questions from product, design, GTM and leadership. Turn vague asks into answerable questions, decide which need quantitative evidence (and which don't), and prioritize where evidence most reduces risk on our biggest bets.

• Answer the big questions before launch. Use MaxDiff and conjoint to show which features, benefits and messages actually drive decisions. Design pre-launch experiments (stimulus tests, matched cohorts, vignettes, threshold studies) with decision rules set before fielding, and pretest instruments with cognitive interviews.

• Build measurement and segments that last. Adapt or develop validated scales for trust, perceived security and comprehension, track them across products and markets, and turn our user profiles into statistically validated, sized segments.

• Get data you can trust, and connect it to behavior. Design sampling, translation and fraud controls for a global, crypto-native audience, and partner with data science to link survey data with product data.

• Evaluate AI-assisted experiences. Design human evaluation for AI-assisted finance features: rubrics, rater reliability, and whether user trust matches how reliable the system actually is.

• Be leadership's partner for evidence. Present findings as recommendations with effect sizes, confidence and what would change the call. Give quick, right-sized answers to ad-hoc leadership questions, whether that's existing data, a fast pulse survey or a full study. Set the standards that let PMs and designers run sound lightweight surveys or data-driven validation themselves.

Requirements

• 7+ years of UX or applied research experience, including at least 5 years leading quantitative studies end to end, from study design through recommendation.

• Experience leading quantitative research studies for financial products (e.g., brokerage, trading, banking, payments, wealth or lending).

• A self-starter who operates with minimal guidance: you scope ambiguous problems, set your own priorities, and drive studies to a decision.

• Deep survey science expertise: sampling and weighting, instrument design, bias control, data-quality screening, and programming in Qualtrics or similar.

• Hands-on experience designing and analyzing MaxDiff and/or conjoint studies.

• Strong applied statistics: regression, power analysis, and experimental and quasi-experimental design.

• Fluency in R or Python for analysis and visualization.

• You have an existing AI-assisted research setup, from drafting survey instruments to writing and reviewing analysis code, and you proofread/validate every output with rigor.

• A track record of quantitative work that changed a product or business decision, and the ability to explain uncertainty clearly to executives and non-researchers.

Nice to Have

• Experience with crypto, onchain or tokenized-asset products.

• A master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as statistics, survey methodology, behavioral economics, or marketing science.

• Depth in advanced methods, such as hierarchical Bayes and simulators, psychometric scale development, segmentation, pricing research, or SQL and multilevel modeling.

• Experience evaluating AI or LLM-powered products, such as human evaluation design, rubrics or rater reliability.

• Research across markets in LATAM, APAC or EMEA, including translating survey instruments.

• Responsible AI-native research workflows, such as using LLM tools to speed up instrument design, coding of open-ended responses or analysis.

What we offer

• Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.

• Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).

• Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.

• A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.

• Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education. We build market-leading, online college credit and test-preparation solutions that help working adults earn their degrees, advance their careers, and achieve economic mobility. About the Role

We’re looking for an AI first Senior User Researcher to lead and modernize our research team across product, marketing, brand and lead the AI transformation for Research. This role is for a seasoned, full-stack researcher who brings mastery of qualitative and quantitative methods, deep experience in both product and marketing research, and the experience to leverage AI to accelerate the scale and quality of research at Study.com.

You’ll be responsible for leading our most important research initiatives across college credit and professional test prep segments to equip the company with strategic and actionable customer insights. You will also be responsible for internal voice of the customer programs, managing contractors and conducting your own research on high priority business areas.

This is a full-time contract position. You will be expected to work during Study.com's Pacific Time business hours Monday through Friday. Additionally, you will use your own computer and have reliable access to high-speed internet.

What You’ll Do

• Lead and scale high-impact research across product development, brand strategy, and marketing. Independently conduct complex generative and evaluative studies that uncover unmet needs, inform product vision, and de-risk decisions at scale.

• Connect the dots, patterns and connections across teams. Ensure insights are shared across teams and inform decisions. Partner with senior leadership to identify and evangelize the highest-impact opportunities for our customers.

• Be the in-house expert across all core research methods, including usability testing, ethnographic research, surveys, segmentation, message testing, brand tracking, and concept validation.

• Coach designers, marketers, product managers and other employees on conducting research, reviewing their projects and adapting the AI first workflow based on needs.

• Lead and moderate company-wide Voice of the Customer (VoC) sessions, interviewing real customers in live forums to bring their perspectives directly to cross-functional teams

• Build and scale a research enablement model, coaching designers, marketers, and product managers to run self-serve research with confidence and consistency. Develop tools, templates, and guidance that scale research capabilities and impact.

• Collaborate with cross-functional leadership to build and prioritize a unified, impact-driven research roadmap

• Be a skilled communicator to peers to executives. Articulate effective customer stories to drive change and inform strategy of product initiatives to business strategy.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

• 5+ years in user research roles, with experience spanning product, marketing, and brand research

• Deep fluency in all major research methodologies, qualitative and quantitative, statistical analysis, generative and evaluative. Hands on experience moderating user interviews is required.

• Experience managing contractors, vendors, and agencies across multiple workstreams

• Expert knowledge of AI tools to support the end-to-end research workflow

• Expert knowledge of UserTesting and SurveyMonkey for usability testing, survey design, and rapid feedback collection

• Strong leadership and enablement skills to equip non-researchers to conduct reliable, lean research

• Fluent in English (written and verbal)

title: Product Designer
description:
Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development

Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.

Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.

In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way.

With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space.

Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our' How We Work' guide.

As a Product Designer, you will…

• Design and prototype product experiences for Warp using Figma in close collaboration with Warp’s engineering, product, and growth teams.

• Iterate on existing features to improve ergonomics, cognitive load, workflow friction, design pattern consistency, and comprehension.

• Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.

• Contribute to and help manage Warp’s design system and ensure implementation meets specification.

• Use Warp to ship UI nits, bugs, and modifications to production.

• Test designs with our internal team and developer community.

• Drive the product forward. You will be expected to operate as a product thinker as much as a designer.

You may be a good fit if...

• You have 3+ years of experience working on AI, ML, DevTools, Data, or other technical products.

• You enjoy iterating and perfecting detailed workflows.

• You have a lived understanding of developers’ needs and want to improve their relationships with their tools.

• You're committed to building and facilitating relationships with non-designers to execute on your shared vision of building the best product for our users

• You have great communication skills, and have experience working with engineers on a technical product.

• You have experience contributing to or managing design systems.

• Bonus:

• Familiar with the developer experience

• Some basic experience with coding or using a terminal

• Experience at a fast paced startup environment

• Experience designing for AI tools

Salary Transparency

Warp operates from a place of high trust and transparency around compensation. We state the pay range that best aligns with our understanding of the market and the needs for the open role.

When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider your skills, the level of experience you bring, and what similar jobs in the market pay, all while ensuring equal pay for equal work at Warp.

Total compensation at Warp consists of: (1) a market-competitive base salary, (2) a generous benefits package, and (3) meaningful equity.

The budgeted compensation amount for this role is targeted at $160,000 to $215,000.

Exact compensation will vary based on skills and experience.

In addition to salary, all employees receive further compensation in the form of equity in the company. This is a meaningful stock option grant with a four-year vesting period and one-year cliff. Your equity is where most of the significant upside potential is. Comparing startup equity is always a bit tricky, so we’re happy to walk you through different valuation scenarios at the offer stage in order to help paint a clearer picture of the upside.

What we offer

• Competitive salary, generous benefits, and meaningful equity

• 100% coverage on medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees (80% coverage for dependents)

• A flexible remote-first culture, with optional office spaces in NYC and SF for folks who want to work together IRL

• Pre-tax FSA and Health Savings Plans

• Pre-tax Commuter Benefit

• 12 company holidays, 20 days of Paid Time Off, and unlimited sick time

• 16 weeks of paid Parental Leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents

• Twice-a-year all company retreats in awesome locations

• A monthly gym and internet stipend

• A company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell

• A complimentary OneMedical membership

Individuals seeking employment at Warp are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

About Warp

We are a company run by product-first builders, building a core product for all developers. We are committed to understanding our users deeply. We will ultimately build the best product and business if that team includes developers and designers from a wide range of backgrounds. The early team comes from Google, Dropbox, Gem, LinkedIn, and Facebook. We are looking for passionate individuals to join us and help bring Warp to the world.

We value honesty, humility, and pragmatism, and our core product principle is focusing on the user. If you’re interested in learning more about our company values and the culture of our engineering team, please take a look at our internal 'How We Work' guide.

We’re very fortunate to be backed by a great group of venture capital firms. In August 2023, we announced a $50M Series B funding round ($73M total raised), led by Sequoia Capital. Our other investors include Google Ventures, Neo, and Box Group. Here's what makes this role different: Modern AI work is no longer purely human-driven. Arize Phoenix is a platform used by AI teams and AI agents such as Claude Code. You won't just craft great UX. Agent Experience (AX)

Prototyping & Exploration

• Are curious about AI systems and eager to learn how agents, evaluations, and observability work

• Enjoy prototyping quickly and iterating toward polish

• Care about accessibility, performance, and craft

• Thrive in open-source communities and async collaboration

Why Arize

Arize Phoenix is becoming the shared workspace where AI teams investigate issues and make decisions—while agents run evaluations, triage failures, and propose fixes alongside them. We're not just building tools for AI development. We're building the environment where humans and AI agents work together.

This is a rare opportunity to define the design language for a new category of product experience. If you're excited about designing for users that include both people and AI systems, we'd love to talk.

title: Product Designer - UX/UI & Design Systems
description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Design Systems & SaaS

Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product design experience across web and mobile applications.

This is not a purely visual design role. We’re looking for someone who combines UX research, product thinking, UI design, prototyping, and design systems to solve real user problems and create intuitive, scalable digital products.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping workflows to designing polished interfaces, maintaining design systems, and supporting implementation.

If you think in user journeys, flows, systems, and outcomes — not just individual screens — this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

• Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and product research.

• Analyze user behavior and identify friction across the product experience.

• Translate research into:

• User flows

• Journey maps

• Personas

• Wireframes

• Interaction models

• Use qualitative and quantitative insights to recommend product improvements.

• Work with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms to support design decisions.

UX/UI & Product Design

• Own design from early concepts through production-ready interfaces.

• Create:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity UI

• Design intuitive experiences across web and mobile applications.

• Simplify complex workflows into clear, user-friendly experiences.

• Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• Iterate quickly based on user feedback, product requirements, and analytics.

Figma & Design Systems

• Work extensively in Figma to create and maintain production-ready designs.

• Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.

• Establish and document standards for:

• Typography

• Color

• Spacing

• Components

• Interaction patterns

• UI behavior

• Maintain consistency across products, features, and platforms.

• Improve collaboration and efficiency between Product, Design, and Engineering.

Accessibility & Usability

• Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 principles.

• Consider accessibility throughout the design process rather than as a final-stage requirement.

• Ensure interfaces work effectively across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.

• Identify usability issues and continuously reduce friction across key workflows.

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

• Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions.

• Support A/B testing across:

• Layouts

• User flows

• Features

• Interaction patterns

• Analyze user behavior and product feedback.

• Use findings to improve:

• Usability

• Conversion

• Engagement

• Retention

• Task completion

• Continuously iterate on launched experiences rather than treating design as complete after handoff.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

Work closely with:

• Product Managers

• Engineers

• Developers

• Other product and business stakeholders

You will:

• Translate product requirements into clear design solutions.

• Participate in product discussions and feature planning.

• Communicate design decisions and rationale clearly.

• Prepare developer-ready designs, assets, and specifications.

• Use Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools for handoff.

• Review implementations and help resolve UX/UI inconsistencies before release.

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

• 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating real product design work.

• Strong proficiency with Figma.

• Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile applications.

• Experience creating:

• User flows

• Wireframes

• Interactive prototypes

• High-fidelity interfaces

• Design systems

• Strong understanding of:

• UX principles

• Interaction design

• Information architecture

• Responsive design

• Usability testing

• Accessibility

• Experience collaborating directly with Product Managers and Engineers.

• Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.

Portfolio Requirements

Your portfolio should demonstrate more than polished final screens.

We want to see evidence of:

• The problem you were solving.

• Your role in the project.

• User or business requirements.

• Research and discovery.

• User flows and UX decisions.

• Wireframes and prototypes.

• Final UI execution.

• Design system or component thinking.

• How feedback, testing, or data influenced your decisions.

• The outcome or impact of your work.

Nice-to-Have Experience

• Experience designing SaaS products.

• B2B or enterprise software design experience.

• Consumer application experience.

• Experience building or scaling mature design systems.

• Familiarity with:

• Mixpanel

• Amplitude

• Hotjar

• Product analytics platforms

• Experience with experimentation and A/B testing.

• Basic understanding of:

• HTML

• CSS

• JavaScript

• Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams.

• Familiarity with developer handoff through Figma Dev Mode or Zeplin.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

• Think about the entire user journey rather than isolated screens.

• Can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions.

• Balance user needs with product and business objectives.

• Enjoy simplifying complicated workflows.

• Use research, feedback, and data rather than designing entirely from intuition.

• Think systematically about reusable components and patterns.

• Care about accessibility and usability.

• Collaborate effectively with engineers.

• Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly.

• Can independently take a product problem from discovery through final design.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

• Reviewing product requirements with a Product Manager.

• Analyzing user behavior or customer feedback.

• Mapping a new user journey or workflow.

• Creating wireframes for a new feature.

• Building an interactive prototype in Figma.

• Designing polished responsive interfaces.

• Conducting or reviewing usability tests.

• Updating components within the design system.

• Working with engineers on implementation questions.

• Reviewing a developed feature against the approved design.

• Analyzing post-launch feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.

In short: you turn user problems and product requirements into intuitive, scalable, accessible, and visually polished digital experiences.

Key Metrics for Success

• Improved usability and task completion rates.

• Increased product engagement and retention.

• Reduced friction across critical user journeys.

• Quality and consistency of UX/UI execution.

• Design system adoption and consistency.

• On-time delivery of design assets and prototypes.

• Reduced design-related implementation rework.

• Effective collaboration with Product and Engineering.

• Positive user and stakeholder feedback.

Why This Role Stands Out

• End-to-end ownership of meaningful product design work.

• Direct influence on product experience and customer satisfaction.

• Opportunity to work closely with Product and Engineering.

• Ability to shape and scale the product’s design system.

• Exposure to research, UX, UI, analytics, and experimentation.

• Fully remote environment.

• Growth opportunities into:

• Senior Product Designer

• Lead Product Designer

• Design Lead

• Head of Design

Spark Hire Intro Video

As part of the application process, you’ll be asked to complete a short Spark Hire intro video.

We’d like to hear about:

• Your experience as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer.

• The types of SaaS, web, or mobile products you’ve designed.

• A product or feature you designed end-to-end and the problem you were solving.

• How you approach UX research before beginning the visual design process.

• Your experience building or maintaining design systems in Figma.

• An example of a complex workflow you simplified for users.

• How you collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers during development.

• How user feedback, usability testing, or analytics influenced one of your design decisions.

Please keep your answers clear, concise, and conversational. We’re interested in understanding your product thinking, communication ability, UX process, and the reasoning behind your design decisions.

Completion of the Spark Hire intro video is required for your application to be considered.

Interview Process

• Initial Phone Screen

• Spark Hire Intro Video

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

• Portfolio Review

• Practical Product Design Task

• Client Interview

• Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you combine strong UX thinking with polished UI execution, understand how to build scalable design systems, and enjoy solving real product problems, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and complete the required Spark Hire intro video to move forward in the hiring process.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer

College Board – Technology – Core Assessment Platform, Onboard

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position.

Please include a portfolio of your work in your application that shows examples of your experience leading design research initiatives, we are unable to consider applications without a portfolio link.

About the Team

The Onboard team designs and builds the experiences that welcome new institutions, educators, and learners to College Board’s digital products and guide them to their first moment of value. Onboarding is where trust is earned: the first setup flow, the first sign-in, the first roster imported, the first assessment scheduled. Our mission is to make those first steps clear, confident, and inclusive—so that every user, regardless of their technical fluency, can get set up quickly and start doing meaningful work.We sit at the intersection of identity, provisioning, and activation, partnering across product domains to turn a complex, multi-tenant setup process into an experience that feels simple and human.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Product Designer on the Onboard team at College Board, you are a highly skilled, thoughtful, and user-centered practitioner with a passion for designing products and experiences that meet real user needs. You will facilitate product discovery, shape design strategy, and guide onboarding and activation solutions from concept through delivery. As the team's first dedicated designer, you will help lay the foundation for experiences that reach every student and educator.

This role depends on close collaboration between product owners/product managers, aligning on priorities and turning roadmap goals into clear design direction so that onboarding and activation experiences deliver on shared outcomes.

You will work across one or more cross-functional teams and products, helping to connect the dots between research, design, engineering, and company mission. You are confident working independently on features—owning the flows that get institutions provisioned and users to first value—while also seeking feedback and alignment with teammates and design leadership. You are an advocate for users and inclusive design. As a creative problem solver, you identify patterns across large systems and balance the big picture with hands-on execution, bringing clarity to complex setup, permissions, and first-run challenges while staying focused on impact.

Your responsibilities will span early-stage discovery, end-to-end product design, usability testing, accessibility, and the creation of design artifacts that support high-quality implementation. You will also contribute to our design culture through mentorship, continuous learning, and collaborative design practices.

In this role, your responsibilities include:

Product Discovery and Design Strategy (30%)

•
Design Thinking. Apply design thinking within complex education ecosystems to deeply understand the needs of new users and administrators, reframe onboarding problems, and drive the creation of intuitive, scalable, and human-centered setup and activation experiences.

•
Research. Continuously conduct and synthesize generative, formative, and evaluative research on first-run and onboarding journeys, using methods such as user interviews, usability testing, and surveys.

•
Design with Users. Facilitate workshops and co-creation sessions with institutions, educators, and internal operations teams to align on onboarding goals and uncover opportunities.

•
Data into Insights. Turn activation funnels, drop-off points, and support-ticket and operational metrics into actionable insights that reduce time-to-value.

•
Prioritization. Influence prioritization and roadmapping efforts by connecting user needs with business goals and mission, focusing on the highest-friction moments in the onboarding path.

•
User Advocacy. Champion human-centered and inclusive design principles for users who may be encountering our products for the very first time.

•
Storytelling. Use strategic storytelling to communicate onboarding vision, value, and direction across stakeholders.

Design Execution and Delivery (40%)

•
Product Design. Partner with product and engineering teams on continuous discovery to translate concepts into detailed, production-ready, extensible designs — including user flows, sitemaps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI — for setup, provisioning, and activation experiences.

•
Design Systems. Apply and contribute to design systems, ensuring visual and functional consistency across onboarding touchpoints and the products users graduate into.

•
Plain Language. Write and test onboarding content, instructions, and error messaging using plain language for clarity and accessibility.

•
Testing. Conduct usability tests and A/B tests to validate onboarding design decisions and improve completion and activation rates.

•
Accessibility. Perform accessibility audits to ensure onboarding meets inclusive design standards, so no user is blocked at the front door.

•
Responsive Design. Design for responsive, mobile-first experiences and mobile apps.

•
Artificial Intelligence. Experiment with generative AI tools to support ideation, prototyping, and smart onboarding guidance.

•
Tools. Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Dovetail to design and document work.

Collaboration and Communication (20%)

•
Collaborate. Collaborate with the Design Council, product managers, engineers, researchers, leadership, identity and platform partners, and other stakeholders throughout the design and development process.

•
Ceremonies. Participate in standups, sprint planning, design reviews, design critiques, and QA cycles.

•
Specifications. Translate design decisions into clear specifications for implementation, including edge cases and error and empty states common to onboarding.

•
Presenting. Present ideas, research findings, and designs with confidence and clarity.

•
Design Operations. Contribute to company-wide design efforts, including shared tools, systems, and templates.

Growth and Culture (10%)

•
Teaching. Mentor junior designers or peers through pairing and feedback.

•
Continuous Learning. Continuously invest in personal development and share emerging tools, trends, and provocations.

•
Organizational Support. Support design education efforts such as lunch & learns, design critiques, and by contributing to internal documentation.

•
Hiring. Participate in hiring and new hire onboarding activities.

About You

You have:

• A portfolio of your work included in your application.

• A Bachelor’s degree in a related field (interaction design, HCI, industrial design, information science, social sciences, computer science, graphic design, etc.) and/or equivalent years of work experience.

• 3–7 years of experience in product or service design

• A product design mindset and experience designing for complex, content-rich websites and applications, including strong skills in creating and communicating design artifacts, such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.

• Proficiency in design thinking and human-centered methodologies, with the ability to reframe challenges and translate insights into actionable design direction.

• Experience designing onboarding, first-run, setup, or account/identity experiences—or a demonstrated ability to bring clarity to complex, multi-step flows—is a strong plus.

• Strong skills in information design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI design, with fluency in tools like Figma, Miro, and Dovetail.

• Experience applying generative and evaluative research methods, along with facilitation skills to lead workshops and co-creation sessions.

• A strong understanding of design systems, responsive design, and accessibility standards, including designing for web and native mobile platforms.

• Comfortable discussing technical constraints and collaborating with engineers to ensure design feasibility (experience with front-end technologies is a plus).

title: Senior Creative Technologist, Games GenAI
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We’re seeking a seasoned Sr Creative Technologist, with sharp, proven design and creative instincts for what makes a game fun. Someone who can turn ideas into prototyped experiences, holding a clear point of view on visual style, voice and tone, sound, and overall execution. The ideal candidate is someone who treats generative AI as an instrument for creative exploration, not a shortcut - in service of finding the ideas that are genuinely good.

About the Role

Generative AI is opening up new creative possibilities for games, and the craft that matters most is knowing which of those possibilities are genuinely good, and shaping the promising ones into something that's truly fun to play. As Sr Creative Technologist, Games GenAI, you'll use GenAI tools to explore game concepts, levels, and moments — then bring that same creative direction to life across visual style, voice/tone, sound, and overall execution so what emerges feels intentional and true to the vision.

You'll work across three kinds of projects: early-stage prototypes and proofs of concept with external partners that push the frontier of what's possible; in-production titles; and internal experiments where you'll do a mix of hands-on building and creative guidance for engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Build and iterate on playable game prototypes using GenAI-accelerated workflows (agentic coding tools, generative image/video/audio, level and narrative prototyping tools) to explore whether a concept, mechanic, or moment truly comes alive — trying many directions in service of finding the right one.

Design and prototype pipelines connecting generative AI APIs to DCC tools and engine-side systems (Unreal Python API, Editor Utility Widgets, Unity).

Bring hands-on creative guidance to prototypes and in-flight projects: visual style and mood, voice and narrative tone, sound and music direction, and overall game feel/execution, translating a fuzzy creative intent ("make it feel like this") into concrete direction a team can build against.

Translate creative direction into technical game design: requirements, systems, and documentation precise enough that engineering can build against them.

Partner with the broader Games GenAI team to identify which GenAI tools and pipelines are worth building out, informed by what actually improves creative quality and the team's ability to iterate, not just what's technically possible.

Work directly with external development partners and internal project leads to give clear, opinionated creative feedback during early prototyping and proof-of-concept phases, grounded in the capabilities and gaps of GenAI.

Run workshops, demos, and office hours to help other teams get better at using GenAI tools for creative exploration.

Stay current on new GenAI creative tools (narrative/dialogue generation, procedural level design, voice and audio synthesis, image/video style transfer) and assess them primarily through a creative-quality lens.

Qualifications

Strong track record as a game director, lead designer, or similarly senior creative role, with shipped game(s) where you owned or heavily shaped creative direction (visual style, narrative voice, sound, or overall execution).

Hands-on comfort building rapid prototypes — using agentic coding tools, engine scripting, or no-code/low-code tools

Hands-on experience building with GenAI models and technologies to create new game experiences — to prototype mechanics, content, or systems that wouldn't have been possible otherwise.

Demonstrated "taste": a track record of correctly identifying what's fun (or isn't) early, and of making prototypes or products better through direct creative judgment calls — able to point to specific examples.

Experience directing across multiple creative disciplines at once (visual, narrative, audio) and synthesizing them into a coherent creative vision, under time pressure and with imperfect tools.

Comfort giving direct, specific creative feedback to both internal teams and external development partners, including in ambiguous, early-stage ideas.

Excellent communication skills; able to articulate why something is or isn't working in terms a cross-functional team (engineers, artists, producers) can act on.

Nice to have

Experience working with external/third-party studios as a creative partner or reviewer.

Experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code/Cowork) to build lightweight internal tools or skills.

Comfort generating quick directional prototypes and previz across a range of tools (e.g., Maya, Twine, Unity/Unreal, Figma, Miro) to align a team around a single creative vision fast.

Sound/music direction experience.

Experience with rapid, small-form game prototyping (vs. multi-year AAA production cycles).
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $250,000.00 - $370,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

description:
Lyntrisis a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace.Lyntrisbrings together the talents ofAccelintand Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deepexpertisewithin their domain.Combining differentiated hardware,softwareand missionexpertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed,precisionand confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, SpaceForceand allied partners — spanning strategic,operationaland tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs,Lyntrisworks at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over.Lyntrismoves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

• Senior Product Designer

• Full time

• Remote

The Senior Product Designer is responsible for leading the design of intuitive, scalable, and technically grounded digital product experiences from early problem definition through implementation. This role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and other stakeholders to translate complex business and technical requirements into thoughtful product experiences, interaction models, and high-fidelity prototypes.

The Senior Product Designer operates with a high degree of autonomy and contributes beyond traditional interface design by helping shape product strategy, explore solutions, and reduce ambiguity through rapid, AI-enabled prototyping. The role also serves as a bridge between design and engineering, using interactive prototypes to validate product behaviors, communicate design intent, and support efficient implementation.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and key stakeholders to define problem spaces, understand user needs, establish success criteria, and translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into clear product concepts and experience strategies.

• Lead end-to-end product design across user journeys, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces, creating intuitive, scalable experiences that align with product and business objectives while accounting for real-world usage and edge cases.

• Facilitate design thinking engagements, including workshops, ideation sessions, discovery exercises, and design sprints, to explore opportunities, generate solutions, and build alignment across stakeholders.

• Develop high-fidelity, interactive prototypes using Figma and AI-assisted or no-code tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or similar platforms to rapidly explore and validate product concepts.

• Create prototypes that demonstrate realistic user flows, conditional logic, system behaviors, edge cases, and representative data, using interactive prototypes as tangible tools for decision-making, validation, and engineering implementation.

• Leverage AI-assisted design and prototyping workflows, including Figma MCP or comparable integrations, to improve design-system alignment, accelerate exploration, and model lightweight logic, workflows, and functional behaviors.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs and prototypes are technically grounded, implementation-ready, and clearly communicate system logic, states, behaviors, and design intent.

• Contribute beyond interface design by influencing product strategy, roadmap decisions, opportunity framing, and solution direction across complex and ambiguous problem spaces.

• Present design solutions, prototypes, trade-offs, constraints, and rationale to clients, stakeholders, engineers, and executive leadership, adapting communication to the needs of each audience and driving alignment through demonstrated product behaviors.

• Apply user research, testing, task success measures, usability feedback, and other relevant insights to refine product experiences and improve usability outcomes.

• Operate autonomously with a high degree of ownership while managing complex design challenges, identifying opportunities, resolving ambiguity, and driving work toward measurable outcomes.

• Mentor and support mid-level and junior designers in product design, interaction modeling, prototyping methods, and AI-assisted design workflows.

• Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems and modern product design practices that improve consistency, speed, clarity, and technical alignment.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Senior-level experience in product design, UX/UI design, interaction design, or a closely related field.

• Demonstrated experience designing end-to-end digital product experiences, including user flows, interaction models, system states, and high-fidelity interfaces.

• Experience translating ambiguous business or technical requirements into clear product and experience solutions.

• Strong experience with prototyping and interactive design tools, including Figma or comparable platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to create prototypes that represent realistic user flows, system behaviors, conditional logic, and edge cases.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, Engineering, clients, and executive-level stakeholders.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale, trade-offs, constraints, and recommendations.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in complex and ambiguous problem spaces.

• Experience working with design systems and contributing to their continued evolution.

• Ability to incorporate AI-assisted design and prototyping tools into product design workflows.

• Experience working closely with Engineering to create technically grounded, implementation-ready product solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to mentor and provide guidance to less-experienced designers.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. national security clearance. To learn more about the security clearance process, please access this link.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

• Experience working in defense, national security, government, or other highly technical environments.

• Experience using AI-assisted development or prototyping tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or similar platforms.

• Experience using Figma MCP or comparable integrations to support design-system alignment and technical workflows.

• Experience integrating real or representative datasets into interactive prototypes.

• Experience participating in or leading design thinking workshops, discovery exercises, or design sprints.

• Experience influencing product strategy, roadmap decisions, and opportunity framing.

• Experience working directly with clients or external stakeholders in strategic product design engagements.

• Active-duty military experience.

• Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance

Physical Requirements

• Must be able tolift upto 15 pounds at times.

title: Art Director
description:
At Side, we partner with some of the world's leading developers and publishers to solve complex production challenges and help bring exceptional games to life. From concept through live operations, our co-development teams work as trusted extensions of our clients' studios, contributing expertise across design, engineering, art, audio, QA, and production.

We are looking for a visionary Art Director to lead and elevate 2D/3D art production for game development projects. You will drive artistic excellence, oversee production pipelines, and lead talented teams in delivering high-quality visuals that align with client expectations and project goals. This role combines creative leadership, technical expertise, and strategic client collaboration, with a strong focus on team development, production efficiency, and business growth.

Requirements

What will you do:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, providing strategic art direction, technical guidance, and timely feedback throughout the production cycle.

• Oversee the full 3D Art pipeline, ensuring projects meet established goals for quality, efficiency, and profitability

• Oversee and manage a team of 3D / 2D artists engaged in games asset production projects.

• Lead the artistic direction and ensure alignment with the overall visual style of the project.

• Lead the communication with clients about artistic and technical matters.

• Technical expertise to decide which technologies to pursue and which to avoid

• Establish Art production pipeline in coordination with clients.

• Ensure artistic quality of deliverables.

• Proven ability to articulate a game project's art goals and lead the team to meet objectives to fulfill those goals.

• Provide mentorship, guidance, and feedback to foster their artistic growth and ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality 3D art.

• Play a key role in recruiting and building a strong Art team.

• Contribute to project scoping and support client acquisition efforts.

What are we looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in 3D art production for games, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role.

• Mastery of common industry software such as 3D Studio Max or Maya, Blender, Adobe Photoshop, Maxon Zbrush, Adobe 3D Substance Painter.

• Expert with game engines (Unreal and Unity).

• Strong artistic aptitude, and ability to relay feedback visually through paint-overs.

• Experience creating and optimizing art pipelines.

• Exceptional communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with a track record of successfully leading creative teams.

• Great level of English communication is a must.

Benefits

• Competitive Salary.

• Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.

• You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.

• We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

About Side

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

AlphaSense’s Design team is a strategic driver of product differentiation, shaping how the world’s leading companies make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We believe great UX is not just about usability—it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.

As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows—from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.

Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer to join our growing team and play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a Staff-level individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through design craft, systems thinking, and a deep understanding of our customers’ workflows.

In this role, you will drive strategic design initiatives—translating complex, data-rich problems into intuitive, high-quality experiences that feel tailored to how our customers actually work. You’ll bring clarity to ambiguity, define end-to-end workflows, and ensure our product experiences are cohesive, scalable, and grounded in real user needs.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to shape how capabilities come together into meaningful user experiences — from early concept through execution. You’ll balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints, ensuring we deliver experiences that are not only functional, but differentiated through quality and usability.

As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier, mentoring other designers, contributing to our design systems and patterns, and helping raise the bar for craft and consistency across the product. You’ll play a critical role in defining how we deliver AI-native workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, trustworthy, and seamlessly integrated into our customers’ day-to-day work.

This role is an opportunity to help establish the foundations of a truly workflow-centric, AI-powered product experience — one that enables our customers to move from information to insight to decision with speed and confidence.

Why this role matters:

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make decisions.

In this role, you will help set that standard through the experiences you design, the systems you strengthen, and the team you help elevate.

Who You Are:

• 10+ years of experience in product design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in interaction design, systems thinking, and delivering high-quality, user-centered experiences.

• Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Deep expertise in designing end-to-end customer workflows, with a proven ability to simplify complex, data-rich problems into intuitive, habit-forming product experiences.

• Highly proficient in design and prototyping tools, with the ability to communicate ideas through flows, systems, and high-fidelity prototypes.

• Strong collaboration with engineering teams, with working knowledge of modern web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Bonus if you have experience with React or similar frameworks.

• Actively leverage AI to augment your design process from research and ideation to prototyping and iteration, and continuously build fluency with modern AI tools and workflows.

• Strong awareness of emerging AI and search technologies, with curiosity and initiative to apply new capabilities to real product experiences.

• Proven ability to lead complex projects end-to-end, navigate ambiguity, and drive clarity across cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing other designers, helping raise the bar for craft, systems thinking, and execution.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Highly curious, thoughtful, and driven, able to quickly build context, form strong points of view, and push work forward.

• Experience in financial services, investment workflows, or data-heavy SaaS products is a plus.

What You’ll Do:

• Deliver high-fidelity prototypes, interaction models, and end-to-end experiences that clearly communicate product vision and drive strategic alignment across stakeholders.

• Transform customer insights from interviews, surveys, and usability testing into actionable product direction, championing customer empathy throughout the product development lifecycle.

• Define and drive design strategy for key initiatives, ensuring alignment with company goals and a clear connection between user needs, business outcomes, and product direction.

• Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex requirements into intuitive, high-quality user experiences that scale.

• Deliver exceptionally crafted solutions while elevating design quality across the team by contributing to the design system, evolving patterns, and shaping best practices.

• Design for systems, not just screens, working within and advancing a growing design system to ensure consistency, scalability, and cohesion across the product.

• Stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and AI capabilities, applying new ideas to continuously improve product experiences.

• Communicate complex ideas with clarity and influence, ensuring alignment and momentum across cross-functional partners.

• Collaborate closely with engineering throughout development, advocating for design quality and ensuring a high bar for execution, usability, and attention to detail.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$160,000—$260,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

•
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

• All official communications will come from an @ email address.

• If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Executive Creative Director
description:
The Opportunity

At Method1, strategy, creative, and media are our tools — but business growth is the job. We use creativity and behavioral science to make indulgence brands irresistible and drive measurable growth. We are the indulgence agency. We craft brands people crave and build them into brands people choose.

We are building the next version of Method1, and we are looking for an Executive Creative Director who can make creative one of our strongest competitive advantages. This is not a maintenance role. It is an opportunity to raise the work, transform the creative team and how it operates, strengthen our most important client relationships, and help shape the future of the agency.

What You’ll Do

• Raise the creative standard — bringing exceptional taste, judgment, craft, and ambition to the work.

• Build enduring creative platforms — turning business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive ideas that can live across channels, experiences, retail, content, and culture.

• Lead in the client room — bringing the executive presence and creative credibility to earn trust, challenge thinking, and help clients buy bigger ideas.

• Transform the creative team — coaching and developing talent while creating clearer standards, stronger accountability, and better work.

• Build a more integrated creative process — partnering with Strategy, Client Partnership, Media, and Creative Operations to produce stronger work with greater speed and less churn.

• Modernize how we create — embracing flexible talent models and AI as ways to expand creative ambition, quality, speed, and range.

• Help drive growth — strengthening pitches, RFPs, Method1's own brand, and our credibility as the agency for indulgence brands.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a challenger-brand creative leader with:

• Exceptional creative taste and a portfolio of distinctive, business-moving work

• Executive presence, gravitas, and strong senior-client instincts

• Experience building brands and creative platforms—not simply campaigns

• Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect creativity to business outcomes

• Proven creative team leadership and talent development

• The ability and willingness to remain close to the work

• Integrated thinking across channels and disciplines

• Applied curiosity and fluency with AI

• High standards, strong opinions, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style

Experience in spirits, beverage, food, CPG, lifestyle, or other indulgence categories is highly valued, but creative horsepower and leadership capability matter more than category pedigree.

Why Method1

This is an opportunity to build, not simply inherit. You will have a seat at the senior leadership table, direct partnership with our CEO, meaningful relationships with world-class brands, and significant influence over the work, team, creative model, and future of Method1. We are remote, flexible, ambitious, and building with intention.

About Method1

Method1 is part of the XenoPsi Ventures portfolio, a collection of companies and brands united by a shared belief in the power of behavioral science, creativity, and innovation to drive meaningful business growth. Being part of XenoPsi Ventures gives Method1 the entrepreneurial focus and independence of a specialized agency while providing access to the broader capabilities, expertise, and resources of the XenoPsi ecosystem.

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
Department: Marketing

Reports To: Head of Growth

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Base Salary: $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

About Bask & Lather

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

Key Responsibilities

•
Creative strategy and testing: Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.

•
Production and delivery: Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.

•
Creative learning and iteration: Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.

•
Creators and partners: Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.

•
Team and resources: Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

Cross Functional Collaboration

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

Creative Operations and Accountability

• Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.

• Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.

• Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.

• Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.

• Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

How Success Will Be Measured

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

•
Creative effectiveness: The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.

•
Testing and learning: Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.

•
Operating performance: Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.

•
Diagnostic metrics: Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

Required Experience and Capabilities

• 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.

• A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.

• Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.

• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.

• Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.

• Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

Portfolio and Results Standard

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

Bonus points:

description:
Why this role

LearnWorlds helps creators, educators and organizations build and grow learning businesses. We're a profitable, product-led SaaS company with customers in more than 150 countries. Our product serves two audiences at once: the people who build and run online schools, and the learners who use them. Designing well for both is what makes the work interesting.

AI is changing how products get made, and design along with it. A product direction might now begin as a PM prototype, an engineering experiment, customer feedback, AI output, or a designer's own idea. The designer's job is to judge what is worth pursuing and make it better, with the whole product in mind.

With time to market shrinking, we're looking for a Product Designer who notices what could be better and acts on it. Someone who gets hands-on and uses AI to expand what they can take on, without lowering the bar on quality or product thinking.

How you'll work here

You work across the whole platform

You're not tied to one product area. You design for both admin and learner experiences, moving between focused UI and interaction improvements, complex workflow-heavy flows, AI-enabled experiences, and our shared patterns and design system.

You create momentum

You don't wait for every problem to become a ticket. You notice gaps and opportunities, then decide what is worth fixing and move it forward. Context will often be incomplete. Creating clarity is part of the job.

You know when to push

Good judgment matters as much as craft. You know when to challenge a direction, simplify it, keep going, or stop. You care about quality without treating every detail as equally important. Bring an opinion and explain it. Be ready to change it when someone has a better one.

You multiply your impact with AI

AI should increase the amount and range of work you can meaningfully take on. Use it throughout the work: explore and prototype, get up to speed on unfamiliar areas, test and critique ideas, and automate low-value tasks. You use AI to take on more without giving up the judgment that makes the work good, and you can explain what it contributed, what you rejected, and how you made the final call.

You make the work better with others

Reporting directly to the Head of Product Design, you work closely with Product Managers, engineers, instructional designers and fellow Product Designers, and you stay involved until the thing works. You can challenge an idea without making it personal, and you can be challenged without getting defensive. Strong opinions, lightly held. No ego, no politics.

You bring something distinctive

There should be something you're unusually good at. We don't need to define it for you, but we should feel the difference in the work and in the team. Meeting the brief is expected. Bringing useful ideas beyond it is what will make you stand out.

You have the fundamentals

You have strong product and UI craft and can take work from problem to delivery. Ideally, you have professional experience designing SaaS, B2B or other complex digital products. You're comfortable with changing priorities. You communicate clearly, work autonomously, and can drive initiatives forward when needed. You know when to use existing patterns and when they need to change.

Requirements

• This is a mid-level role. We expect roughly 3 or more years of professional product design experience, but we care more about evidence than exact years.

• A portfolio is required. Show strong work and be clear about what you owned, why you made the decisions you did, and what changed because of them. Where AI was part of your process, tell us what it contributed and where your own judgment took over.

• Strong English is required. It's our daily working language.

• We're a fully remote European team with offices in Athens, Crete and Limassol.

• We don't offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already have the legal right to work remotely from their country of residence, subject to LearnWorlds' hiring eligibility requirements.

• Practical exercises are part of the hiring process (see below).

Recruitment process

We want each step to tell us something different about how you work. The process is designed to stay focused while giving both sides enough evidence to make a good decision.

•
Application and practical assessment. Alongside your CV and portfolio, you'll answer a small set of role-specific questions and complete a short 10 min observation exercise.

•
Talent acquisition conversation. A conversation about your motivation, expectations, availability and practical fit for the role.

•
Design task and cognitive assessment. You'll have a week to work on a focused product design task and complete a short cognitive assessment. AI is welcome as part of your process.

•
Live design review and conversation with the Head of Product Design. We'll review your work together, challenge decisions, discuss trade-offs, and talk about how you work, collaborate and make decisions.

•
Final conversation with the CPO. A final discussion about product judgment, ambition, and alignment with where LearnWorlds is heading.

Benefits

• Private life and health insurance plan

• Fully remote work if you prefer to work from home, apart from when we have team meetings a few times per year

• Your personal annual training budget

• An annual home office allowance to set up your personal space

• Company laptop & monitor

• 23 days of paid time off

• 3 early summer Fridays in July and August

• Access to AI tools at work

• A free LearnWorlds School to build and sell your own courses

• Company retreats & other onsite team activities (see the video of our latest retreat).

description:

That covers brand campaigns, larger creator and media partnerships, content franchises, and the tentpole moments we want to own every year.

We need an exceptionally creative strategist who's always thinking about how we can make a moment our own, and who has their finger on the pulse of what's happening in culture. You still make things, but you can also easily direct a room and sell your vision. You've made campaigns people talked about, and you pair ambitious storytelling with the operating rigor an always-on growth team needs.

Ideally, you'll have:

• Fluency across art direction, copy, design, motion, and photography, with the eye and judgment to elevate work at every stage.
