• Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills. You can rally executives, win over skeptical stakeholders, and bring creative partners behind a shared vision.

• A passion for mentoring creative talent, raising the bar, and helping build a world-class team.

What you'll be responsible for:

In year one, expect roughly 80% leading beehiiv's highest-priority campaigns and brand moments, and 20% building the function around them.

Set the vision and lead the campaigns

• Own the creative vision behind beehiiv's biggest campaigns, shaping a distinctive voice across brand, product, partnerships, and cultural moments.

• Turn business goals into bold creative briefs with clear strategic intent and a sharp point of view, then lead ideas from initial spark to launch.

• Dream up and execute standout integrated campaigns across social, digital, out-of-home, experiential, partnerships, and emerging formats.

• Create ambitious brand activations and stunts that bring beehiiv's mission of creator ownership to life and generate buzz on their own.

• Build iconic tentpole moments and repeatable content franchises that become synonymous with beehiiv, year after year.

Lead the team and the production

• Ensure the quality of execution by our in-house creative team and our partners. You should have an eye for detail and the passion to make sure it’s executed to your incredibly high standards.

• Lead production from start to finish, assembling top-tier directors, photographers, animators, and agency partners, and staying hands-on through the final cut.

• Champion bold creative bets, build conviction across stakeholders, and sell ambitious ideas to executive leadership.

Make every channel carry the campaign

• Partner closely with Paid Marketing, Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms to ensure every campaign drives business impact and comes to life across channels.

• Turn big campaign ideas into always-on paid creative, building a testing engine that generates real insights, not just more variants.

• Dig into performance, uncover what resonates, and turn those learnings into sharper, more effective campaigns.

Build the function

• Establish creative principles, processes, and rituals that protect great work and continually raise the bar.

• Move fast and experiment with AI tools, rough cuts, and prototypes to pressure-test bold ideas before committing production budgets.

• Build a trusted bench of exceptional agencies, directors, editors, and freelancers.

• Mentor creative talent and build a world-class team as we grow.

What success looks like

A year in, you'll have brought several standout integrated campaigns from initial insight to launch, establishing a distinctive creative voice for beehiiv across billboards, feeds, and inboxes.

Your campaigns will come to life across paid, lifecycle, and partnerships, backed by a testing engine that turns performance into actionable insights. You'll have built a pipeline of ambitious tentpole moments and signature content franchises, assembled a trusted network of creative partners, and laid the groundwork for a world-class creative team.

Why this role might be for you

• You love momentum. You’d rather ship, learn, and iterate than polish something for months. Here, a good idea on Monday can be live by Friday, and you’ll see your impact in real time.

• You want your creative work to drive business results. You get energy from tying great storytelling to growth. You’ll own work that shows up in reach, pipeline, and revenue, and you’ll be able to point to exactly what it moved.

• You’re a builder who likes to stay hands-on. You’d rather shape a lean, high-caliber team than inherit a big one. You’ll set the bar, pick the right freelancers and agencies, and grow the team as the results justify it.

• You treat data as a creative partner. You like testing your instincts, learning from the numbers, and coming back with something sharper. Strong ideas get stronger here because we pressure-test them.

Why this role might not be for you

• You prefer long timelines. We move fast. Some campaigns go from idea to launch in days, not weeks.

• You're looking for a pure brand role. We're ultimately focused on growing the business. Your work will be measured by reach, pipeline, and conversion, not just creative craft.

• You need a large team from day one. You'll lead a lean, ambitious team, with the flexibility to bring in top-tier freelancers and agencies as needed.

• You're not comfortable having your ideas challenged. We believe great creative and data go hand in hand. Sometimes the numbers will challenge even your best ideas.

Why beehiiv?

Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're the bar. It’s how we operate, publicly and privately, and what we should return to when making decisions. That’s how we keep our team's momentum. That’s how we hire and keep A players.

beehiiv’s core values

• There's no room for B players ⭐: the best makes everyone better.

• Maniacal sense of urgency ⚡: speed is our superpower.

• Say what you think with positive intent 💬: disagree openly and give hard feedback directly, with the intent to help someone improve.

• User-obsessed 🐝: every decision starts with one question: how does this add value for the user?

• Ego comes second, winning comes first 🏆: we're here to create the best outcome; the team comes before the individual.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are seeking a Principal Product Designer to lead experience strategy for the Workiva Platform. This role shapes the long-term vision for the platform at a senior level of design leadership, with a focus on AI experiences, systems thinking, and workflow transformation.

Sitting at the intersection of UX, product strategy, and platform architecture, this leader will influence not only how our products look and feel, but how they are built, scaled, and evolve over time. They will reimagine how users work across the platform by identifying opportunities to simplify complexity, rethink legacy workflows, and design human-in-the-loop moments that combine human judgment with AI-driven efficiency and intelligence.

What You’ll Do

•
Lead platform UX strategy: Define and drive the long-term user experience vision across the Workiva Platform, aligning design direction with product strategy, platform architecture, and business goals.

•
Shape AI experiences: Lead the charge in envisioning AI-powered experiences, including generative interfaces, intelligent automation, recommendations, and decision-support workflows.

•
Reimagine workflows: Rethink and redesign existing workflows to create simpler, faster, and more intuitive experiences across complex enterprise use cases.

•
Design human-in-the-loop moments: Determine where human oversight, review, escalation, and decision-making should remain central in AI-enabled workflows, and design those interaction points with clarity and trust.

Solve complex system challenges: Lead discovery across ambiguous, cross-functional problems by combining research, product insight, data, and technical constraints into scalable solutions.

•
Drive experience architecture: Establish reusable patterns, interaction models, and information architecture that scale across a multi-product ecosystem.

•
Influence technical direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape platform direction, service design, data flows, and implementation choices that affect user experience.

•
Advance design systems and governance: Guide the evolution of design systems to support consistency, flexibility, and innovation at scale.

•
Mentor senior talent: Coach Lead and Senior Designers, raise craft standards, and strengthen design culture across the organization.

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, UX, or related fields, with significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

• Track record of delivering 0→1 products and scaling them in market

• Proven experience influencing product strategy, experience direction, and technical decision-making.

• Experience establishing UX best practices for emerging technologies or ambiguous problem spaces.

• Proven track record of driving innovation in user interface design through experimentation, new tools and processes, and close collaboration with design, engineering, data science, and research partners.

• Experience with AI/ML and agentic technologies; depth and breadth of knowledge that enables ideation and development of creative solutions.

• Deep expertise in user-centered design methodologies applied to enterprise workflows.

• Experience designing AI-powered product experiences and human-in-the-loop workflows.

• Experience working in large-scale Agile environments.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Visual Designer

Director, Senior Visual Designer

College Board - Engagement & Reach (EaR)

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position.

About the Team

The Engagement and Reach (EaR) division advances College Board’s mission by shaping how our work is understood, experienced, and acted on—helping protect the organization’s reputation while accelerating engagement and growth. We are a high-performing, collaborative team of communicators, marketers, creatives, and strategists who work together to deliver clear, compelling stories and turn them into creative, data-informed work that drives engagement, adoption, and real results. We partner closely with leaders across the organization to shape strategy, influence decisions, and amplify the impact of College Board’s highest-priority enterprises in service of our mission.

About the Opportunity

You’ll join CB Creative, College Board’s in-house design team within EaR, leading creative strategy, brand stewardship, and campaign design across AP, SAT, BigFuture, and enterprise brand work. Our team blends deep brand expertise with fast-turn campaign production, working across formats and channels to keep the College Board brand consistent and effective at scale. As a Director, Senior Visual Designer, you’ll own and develop compelling visual and video solutions that connect with our key audiences, while owning the College Board brand and video system — its development, standards, and evolution — across EaR. You’re just as comfortable building out a visual identity system as you are concepting and editing video and motion content — video and animation experience is required. We’re looking for a creative problem solver who’s ready to make the brand’s video and visual presence sharper, faster, and more consistent. If you are adaptable, service-oriented, and dedicated to being an advocate for our users through great design, then we want to work with you.

In this role, you will:

Strategize (60%)

• Own and evolve the College Board brand and video system strategy for EaR — including standards, guidelines, and how they extend to new formats and programs — applying it across campaign and brand initiatives.

• Direct brand and video decisions for outreach, operational, and campaign initiatives, and recommend and defend brand and video decisions to EaR leadership, design colleagues, and cross-functional partners as needed.

• Direct and mentor freelance designers and outside agency partners on brand and video execution, holding their output to College Board standards.

• Identify emerging brand and video needs not yet covered by existing standards, such as new formats, platforms, or program-specific requirements, and set direction before a playbook exists, with authority to decide new standards independently.

• Maintain system documentation as a living deliverable, published and updated regularly, so standards do not depend on individual memory.

• Use external exemplars and benchmarking to challenge legacy approaches and raise the visual and video bar.

Create (40%)

• Concept, design, and develop brand and video assets from start to finish — including social, digital, email, print, and campaign video/motion content — managing all phases from concept through completion.

• Own project timelines and delivery for brand and video work, partnering with production scheduling on capacity; resolve delivery risks independently, escalating only when the decision required falls outside the role’s authority.

• Own final sign-off on brand and video consistency across CB Creative’s output, with authority to decide new standards independently and require revisions before project completion.

• Resolve conflicts between agency-produced creative and established brand standards, deciding when a deviation is warranted for a specific campaign need, with authority to override agency direction.

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

• 8–10 years of experience in graphic design, with hands-on video and motion graphics production experience — video and animation experience is required, including owning a brand or design system at organizational scale.

• Advanced understanding of visual identity systems, hierarchy, typography, aesthetics, illustration, photography, and composition.

• Experience working with brand-level design systems, with a track record of setting standards that others follow and evolving a visual identity in partnership with cross-functional teams across multiple programs.

• Experience directing external agencies or freelancers, including holding them to a quality bar and addressing underperformance.

• A record of making and defending design decisions with data and external benchmarks.

• Mastery of industry-standard design tools, including Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Motion graphics experience in Cinema 4D or Blender is a plus.

• A portfolio demonstrating both brand/visual identity work and video/motion content.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Innovative conceptual thinking and problem-solving skills, with pixel-perfect attention to detail.

• The ability to travel 2-3 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.

All roles at College Board require:

• A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

• Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

• Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

• A learner’s mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

• A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

• A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

• Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

• Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

• While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

• The hiring range for this role is $72,000-$120,000.

• Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

• We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

• We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Das inspiriert, schafft einen Blick über den Tellerrand und macht Spaß!

title: Design Creative Lead
description:
About the Role We're looking for a Design Creative Lead who's equal parts art director, designer and leader. Someone with exceptional taste, strong opinions and the creative judgement to back them up. You'll be a player-coach: raise the bar, develop strong talent, and still get into the work yourself. At MoneyGram, everyone is an IC. You'll own how MoneyGram looks, sounds and feels everywhere it shows up. Right now, that work is spread across teams and external partners. We want one person with genuine taste and a clear creative point of view to own it end to end and set the visual standard across all of it. You'll have the freedom to make bold creative calls and the responsibility to see them through. We're not hiring you to simply maintain the brand. We're hiring you to make it impossible to ignore. Retail, CRM and digital channels will be your core focus, but your creative thinking will extend across the wider business. This isn't a role where you'll just direct the work and sign it off. You'll spend as much time designing as you do leading the team. One day might mean developing a new visual direction, the next designing retail assets, refining a template or getting into the detail of a piece of work that needs your eye. Working closely with Creative Operations and the Performance Creative Lead, you'll help make sure great design gets made, delivered and shared. Not just once, but in ways others can use and build on. If you have an eye that misses nothing, a point of view worth defending and the drive to make everything and everyone around you better, you're our person! What success looks like within a year: Stronger design craft and a team producing consistently better work. Established brand guardrails, templates and shared assets that make great design easier to create, find and scale across the business. How You'll Make an Impact

Set the creative bar. Bring a point of view. Challenge the concept, sharpen the visual direction and get into the details others miss. Make the work impossible to ignore. Make the brand unmistakable. Evolve MoneyGram's visual identity, guidelines and design language. Push how the brand shows up without losing what makes it recognizable and trusted. Lead a team that gets better. Coach designers, set expectations and give feedback they can use. Don't just fix the work; build a team that can solve the next brief without you. Stay in the work. Spend half your time designing and art directing. Own retail projects, step into complex briefs and make the work that shows the team what good looks like. Design for where it lives. A retail counter isn't an email. An email isn't a digital ad. Know what works in each and make the brand recognizable across all three. Build systems people actually use. Guidelines, toolkits and templates should make the work better and faster, not make everything look the same. Build them, test them and keep improving them. Make the work easy to find. Bring assets and templates out of silos. Improve how the business finds, shares and reuses approved creative, building towards a more accessible asset library. Direct the wider work. Give agencies and freelancers a clear brief and a high standard. Challenge the thinking, not just the execution, and own the finished result. Put AI to work. Use it to explore creative directions, create and adapt assets, and move faster without losing craft. Know when human judgement makes the difference. Get the work finished. Work with Creative Operations and the Performance Creative Lead to balance ambition with capacity. Make the decisions that keep work moving and quality high.

What You'll Bring

8+ years in creative. You've led creative work, developed teams and made decisions that shaped brands. Show us the standard you've set and what improved under your leadership. A portfolio with a point of view. Bring the work and the thinking behind it. Show us the ideas you've shaped, what you personally designed or art directed and why those creative decisions mattered. An eye for the details others miss. Typography, composition, colour, layout and art direction. You can tell when something isn't right, and you know how to fix it. Ideas, not just execution. You've turned briefs into concepts worth making. Show us how you got from a problem or insight to an idea, then made it real. A team you've led and developed. Direct people management, not just mentoring. You've hired, coached, managed performance and handled difficult conversations. Tell us who got better under you. Creative that works where it lives. You've made work for retail, CRM and digital channels. You understand the spaces, audiences and constraints, not just the file formats. A brand you've helped shape. You've evolved visual identities and made them work across different touchpoints. Built brand guidelines, design systems or templates from scratch? Even better. Show us what changed. Work you've made yourself. You can still design, art direct and deliver. Bring examples of your own hands-on work, not just decks of what your team produced. Real use of AI creative tools. You've made things with them, improved workflows and know when human judgement makes the difference. Show us what you've built. Tools you know inside out. Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud. Motion design, storyboarding or other specialist craft skills are a plus. Conviction without ego. You have opinions, can explain them and know when to change your mind. You make clear calls, take feedback and bring others with you.

A natural sense of creative calling and passion for craft.

Opportunity to work with flagship clients, including Google, Netflix, and Chanel.

Flexible, industry-leading PTO so you can balance work and life your way.

Click Apply. Share your CV and portfolio link with us.

We give priority to candidates located in South-East Asia, but we’re happy to consider talent from anywhere in the world.

title: Creative Director
description:
About Us

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are.

It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. But most of the people who need us have never heard of us. By the end of 2027, we expect half of America's seniors will know who we are.

You will be the author of what they see. This isn't about directing a campaign. It's about building a courageous, iconic household brand close to scratch, with real budget and real creative license behind you. We aren't trying to rent attention. We want the kind of organic awareness that comes from people recognizing us, remembering us, and telling each other about us. If that's what you want to spend the next few years on, we'd love to talk.

What you'll own

• You will set our creative direction as we scale from <10% of American seniors and their families knowing about us to >50% in 2027. That’s millions of impressions. Super-bowl-commercial scale.

• You'll decide how Community Phone looks everywhere it shows up: TV, paid social, web, direct mail, the box, and our social channels. A family should recognize the same brand whether they see us at 9pm on TV or open the box at mom's house.

• You will be the steward of our brand, ensuring all platforms, from paid ads to customer newsletters, meet our brand standards.

• You'll take the brand identity system our design agency is launching in mid-October and make it world-class. Their work is the starting point. Scaling it across every surface and pushing it further is your job.

• You'll do the real work yourself. You'll design the website, the box, and the pieces that define us, and you'll be excited to make things rather than just advise on them.

• You'll build the creative machine for paid social and guarantee the quality of its output.

• You'll own creative performance alongside growth. Beautiful work that doesn't move CAC isn't done yet.

• You'll build the team that scales the brand with you.

What we're looking for

• You have 8+ years in creative direction, and you've built a phenomenal consumer brand.

• You have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative work across digital, retail, social, packaging, experiential, film, photography, and product storytelling.

• You have both agency and in-house experience. You know how to get great work out of a studio, and you know what it takes to live with a brand every day.

• You grew up on the visual side of creative direction (art direction, design, motion), and you have real experience leading copy and concept too.

• You still love making the work. Your best days are the ones where you're designing, not sitting in review meetings.

• You believe in the power of AI in creative work. You use it every day, you know where it makes the work better, and you're excited about what it makes possible next.

• You've made creative that performs at scale, ideally across TV, paid social, and physical.

• You have experience managing production budgets, agencies, freelancers, and complex creative programs.

• You have excellent taste.

• You have superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. Great creative reveals truths that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as a pursuit of beauty. The people who can do it seem to possess these three qualities to a high degree.

• You have the judgment to operate as the entire creative function today, and you want to push and be pushed by the growth team.

Nice to have

• You've designed packaging and unboxing for a consumer hardware or DTC product.

• You've worked on eldercare, health-adjacent, or other trust-sensitive consumer brands.

How we work

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to our Cofounder who runs Revenue and Operations, and you'll have a very direct line from your work to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right.

How to apply

Send us your portfolio, including the consumer brand you're proudest of building and what happened to it in market. Tell us briefly why building a brand for this kind of customer is interesting to you.

title: Atlassian Instructional Designer Level III
description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Instructional Designer at the Level III level to develop accessible, effective learning experiences supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Agile practices and Atlassian Cloud adoption. This role combines learning strategy, curriculum design, digital content development, and performance support to translate complex processes and tools into practical instruction for a diverse federal workforce.

The Instructional Designer will design role-based learning paths for leadership, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, delivery teams, and tool administrators. The position develops live-instruction materials, self-paced e-learning, hands-on exercises, job aids, assessments, and adoption-hub resources using ADDIE or SAM and tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise. Content will be prepared for the existing learning management system and validated against accessibility requirements.

This is not a slide-production-only role. The designer must identify the performance problem behind a training request, define measurable learning objectives, test content with representative learners, and refine materials based on completion data and user feedback. The ideal candidate balances technical accuracy with adult-learning principles, concise writing, visual clarity, and Section 508 compliance.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

• Conduct needs analysis and translate assessed learner cohorts and job roles into measurable learning objectives.

• Design role-based courses on Agile practices, Jira Cloud, reporting, and administrative workflows using ADDIE or SAM.

• Develop instructor guides, presentations, demonstrations, exercises, assessments, e-learning modules, and concise job aids.

• Author and maintain Articulate Storyline or Rise content and package courses for SCORM-compatible LMS delivery.

• Coordinate publishing, course metadata, completion tracking, pilot testing, and revisions with LMS and training operations staff.

• Perform accessibility reviews and coordinate Section 508 and WCAG testing and remediation for self-paced content.

• Maintain consistent, version-controlled adoption-hub and knowledge-base resources.

• Create curriculum maps that connect learner role and readiness level to objectives, prerequisites, modality, activities, practice tasks, and knowledge checks.

• Script accurate Jira Cloud and Agile demonstrations with consistent terminology, realistic workflows, annotated screenshots, and accessible interaction patterns.

• Build facilitator notes, learner guides, scenario-based exercises, quick-reference cards, and assessment items that reinforce on-the-job application.

• Conduct editorial, functional, and accessibility quality assurance; document remediation decisions before course publication and updates.

• Manage content versions, review cycles, SME approvals, and content ownership so learning materials stay aligned with changing platform configurations.

Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, educational psychology, or a related field.

• 3+ years of instructional design, e-learning development, or performance-support experience.

• Demonstrated use of ADDIE or SAM and Articulate Storyline or Rise.

• Experience with SCORM packages, LMS course publishing, and training evaluation.

• Knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG accessibility requirements and accessible content design.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and satisfy applicable federal personnel vetting, security, privacy, accessibility, and data-handling requirements.

• Section 508 Trusted Tester certification or equivalent formal accessibility testing credential.

• Portfolio or work samples demonstrating both instructor-led design and interactive e-learning or digital performance support.

• Ability to collaborate with technical SMEs and translate detailed workflows into accurate, concise, and accessible learner-facing content.

Desired:

• Prior experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or federal health programs is highly desirable.

• Master's degree in instructional design, education, learning technologies, or a related discipline.

• Agile, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, or federal enterprise training experience.

• Experience creating blended learning for large distributed audiences.

• Experience designing simulation-based software instruction, formative assessments, and post-training performance reinforcement.

• Additional certifications such as ATD Associate Professional in Talent Development (APTD) or Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD) are desirable.

Target Salary Range: $85,000 - $115,000

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. title: Motion Designer II
description:
WHO WE ARE

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

WHAT'S A MOTION DESIGNER AT HOOK?

Motion Designers are passionate animators who bring visuals and narratives to life through their knowledge of animation principles and their proficiency with motion design and video editing tools. They utilize their understanding of the craft and inquisitive nature to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing their skills.

They seek to build and uphold our growth-oriented culture, to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing in the process. Motion Designers work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. On small projects they may be the sole motion designer while on larger projects they have the support of others in the Motion Department.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Collaborate with your team members to ensure motion work exceeds client expectations.

• Leverage knowledge of animation, editing and post-production tools to produce quality work that meets specifications.

• Respond to client and creative feedback with thoughtful solutions that solve the underlying creative challenges

• Become proficient in the tools and workflows Hook uses on a daily basis.

• Communicate clearly and frequently with teammates to maintain project cohesion.

• Seek out skill advancement by engaging in company initiatives and discussions.

• Seek out opportunities to enrich our existing culture within the department and organization.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• A firm understanding of the 12 Principles of Animation

• Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop and Premiere

• Interest in or experimentation with any of the following: frame-by-frame (cel) animation, 3D animation and rendering, AI design and animation tools, realtime motion graphics (Lottie/Rive/Unreal/etc), basic scripting/Expressions, video editing, and audio production.

• Knowledge of various A/V formats and when to use them

• A strong motion reel or portfolio that demonstrates your abilities as an animator

• A growth mindset that embraces challenges and new methods of thinking

• A friendly, collaborative attitude

WHAT ELSE

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you.

We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever (within the US)” approach. We're a close-knit group of people who love the internet and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us!

Hook believes in compensation transparency and equity. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments and aligns to location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as a L4. During the interview process we’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. Please follow this link to learn more.

title: Interior Designer II
description:
Purpose
From concept to completion the Interior Designer II is responsible for managing design components and client engagement across all project phases. The role requires both creativity, technical expertise, with a strong understanding of project workflows, documentation standards, and coordination. You will work in partnership to create and simultaneously deliver multiple, customized multi-family, hospitality, and well-centric projects.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Support, design and coordinate all phases of the interior design process from concept development through installation.

• Lead the production of schematic design, design development, and construction documents in trade software like Revit, AutoCAD, etc., with guidance and review from senior team members.

• Support the selection and documentation of finishes, fixtures, furniture, and lighting with consideration for budget, availability, and performance.

• Select and specify FFE products and accessories, developing custom furniture and drapery worksheets and updating furniture plans and documentation in AutoCAD and/or Revit.

• Coordinate FFE development with the design team, including furniture plans, specifications, material selections, and FFE presentations aligned with the project vision and client brand.

• Support preparation of documentation tied to design scope for proposals, change orders, and project milestone tracking.

• Collaborate with the contracts and project managers to ensure design scope, budget, fees, and deliverables align with contract terms; support plan reviews and FFE takeoffs as needed.

• Develop and review internal and client presentations for alignment with client vision, client branding packages, and CID conceptual design aesthetic.

• Collaborate with clients, consultants, and vendors to coordinate and develop project-specific design features and materials embodying CID’s commitment to client experience and excellence in partnership.

• Participate and occasionally lead in client presentations with clear communication of design intent and rationale.

• Develop and review FF&E specifications, procurement documentation, and installation coordination.

• Support FFE implementation through vendor coordination, installation scheduling, punch lists, returns, and on-site problem solving to ensure the design is carried through to completion.

• Conduct and complete quality control reviews of drawing sets, sample boards, and specifications to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Support construction administration, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals and shop drawings, and attending site visits as needed.

• Monitor scope boundaries and proactively flag potential changes that may impact schedule, budget, or contract terms.

• Partner with team lead and other departments to support standard processes and create team efficiency.

• Provide clear project level guidance and accountability on design development and technical documentation.

Foster a culture that promotes CID’s Core Values

• Forage | We embody a resourceful mindset, thoughtfully seeking inspiration, solutions, and opportunity while nurturing our connection to and appreciation for the natural world.

• Action | We are a high-performing, purpose-driven team that takes initiative, follows through, and executes with excellence.

• Positive | We lead with optimism and appreciation, believing in beneficial possibilities and bringing constructive energy to every challenge.

• Playful | We embrace levity, humor, and the power of play to unlock creativity and bring joy to our work.

• Authentic | We believe knowing ourselves allows us to show up with awareness, honesty, and alignment between our beliefs, words, and actions.

• Curious | We maintain an open mindset and a constant pursuit of becoming our best, fueled by a genuine joy for learning and growth.

• Team | We collaborate through trust and deep respect to accomplish our shared purpose. None of us are as strong as all of us.

Education + Experience Required

• Bachelor’s degree in interior design or architecture from an accredited institution

• WELL AP certification and other industry experience as needed

• 6+ years of experience in a similar position. Preferably with multi-family, hospitality, spa, and/or commercial industries

• Skills in Revit and AutoCAD with strong knowledge of Adobe Suite (especially Photoshop), MS Office (especially PowerPoint), Bluebeam, and SWW (a plus).

• Working knowledge of modeling software (Sketch -up, 3D Studios, Rhino 3-D, etc.)

• Strong space planning ability, knowledge of building codes, building systems, and construction methods.

• Understanding of current design trends, materials costs, budgets and specifications.

• Experience specifying FFE for a variety of project types ( i.e. models, clubhouses, pools, etc.,).

• Ability to manage priorities with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through while fostering collaboration and communicating effectively through written, verbal, and visual channels.

CID Design Group is a 40+ year old national interior design firm located in Naples, Florida. CID specializes in multifamily, hospitality, creative branding, and design forecasting. We work with 9 of the top 10 largest developers in the United States, and our portfolio spans 39 states and over 60 cities.

CID provides an amazing opportunity to nurture the career growth of designers who are ambitious and hungry for challenging, exciting, and fulfilling work. Our founders have fostered a culture that encourages true collaboration, career growth opportunities, learning opportunities, and work-life balance. They also believe in sharing the firm's successes through competitive salaries, annual bonuses, and a profit-sharing plan.

Our benefit package includes:

• Wellness Programs

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

• Profit-Sharing Plan

• Paid Continuing Education and certifications

• 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

• Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay (including your birthday!)

• Career Growth and Skill Development

• A Fun, Creative, Collaborative Environment + Positive Culture

title: Visual / UI Designer (Digital Content Production)
location: Remote (Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Aruba, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, Bolivia, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, Brazil, Canada, Cayman Islands, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Curaçao, Dominica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Falkland Islands (Malvinas), French Guiana, Greenland, Grenada, Guadeloupe, Guatemala, Guyana, Haiti, Honduras, Jamaica, Martinique, Mexico, Montserrat, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Puerto Rico, Saint Barthélemy, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Saint Martin (French part), Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Sint Maarten (Dutch part), Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, United States, United States Minor Outlying Islands, Uruguay, Venezuela, Virgin Islands, British, Virgin Islands, U.S.)
description:
Dura Digital is a global technology services company on a mission to ignite AI-enabled transformation and realize our client’s AI-powered future, empowering them through our global delivery studios and services. We bring together world-class talent across AI, engineering, human-centered design, data, and product delivery to help organizations accelerate innovation and create meaningful business outcomes.

The Visual / UI Designer (Digital Content Production) joins our Human-Centered Design Studio and is embedded with the content and production team of a leading global video game publisher. You will turn franchise key art and brand guidelines into high-impact web, email, and in-game experiences for some of the world’s most-played sports and entertainment titles—working at the speed of live game marketing and delivering work while the client’s North American team is offline.

Role Details

• Location: Remote, Latin America (Uruguay, Argentina, Brazil, or other locations with strong UK time-zone overlap).

• Schedule: Early-start working hours with substantial overlap with the UK business day, plus partial overlap with Eastern and Pacific time.

• Engagement: Embedded, full-time engagement of 6 to 9 months, with potential to extend.

• Openings: 2 to 3 designers, hired at two levels: Visual Designer (production and execution) and Senior Visual Designer (concept development through execution).

Key Responsibilities

Visual Design & Production

• Translate franchise key art, layouts, and brand guidelines into engaging web hero assets, including assets with motion that make pages more immersive as users scroll.

• Adapt creative across owned channels—email, in-game placements, and web—so the player journey feels cohesive from discovery to landing page.

• Select in-game characters, environments, and moments that make compelling hero banners and storytelling modules.

• Produce high volumes of polished, on-brand assets on tight timelines, maintaining quality as priorities shift.

Design Systems & UI

• Work within and contribute to the client’s Figma design system, extending components and templates while staying true to each franchise’s brand.

• Apply strong UI fundamentals—typography, layout, color, hierarchy, and accessibility (WCAG)—to every asset.

• Partner with UX designers to ensure visual work is usable and consistent across channels and devices.

• Keep all web assets organized, documented, and stored in Figma so the team can find and reuse them.

Concept Development (Senior level)

• Lead creative concepts from brief to final execution for campaigns, launches, and live-service moments.

• Present concepts and rationale to creative directors and marketing stakeholders, and iterate quickly on feedback.

• Elevate brand guidelines into fresh, engaging digital executions rather than simply reproducing them.

Collaboration & Ways of Working

• Work as an embedded member of the client team, building direct relationships with game studio creative directors and marketing leads in the UK, Canada, and Europe.

• Collaborate closely with the project coordinator to receive clear briefs, track assets, and hand off work for review.

• Hand off completed work at the end of your day so it is ready for the North American team at the start of theirs.

• Use AI tools, including Claude, to speed up exploration, versioning, and production where appropriate.

• Ensure your work reflects Dura Digital’s values: curious, vocal, trusted, creative, available, respectful.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in visual, UI, or digital design (5+ years for the Senior level), ideally in gaming, entertainment, sports, or consumer brands.

• A portfolio showing high-visual digital work: web heroes, landing pages, email, banners, or in-product placements.

• Advanced Figma skills, including working within and contributing to design systems.

• Strong Adobe Creative Cloud skills, especially Photoshop; After Effects or motion design experience is highly desirable.

• Solid understanding of usability and accessibility standards.

• Experience with, or genuine interest in using, AI tools such as Claude in creative workflows.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and same-week turnarounds.

• Advanced written and spoken English (C1 or higher); comfortable presenting work to senior stakeholders.

• Passion for video games is a strong plus.

Why join Dura Digital

• Work on globally recognized game franchises and see your work in front of millions of players.

• Be embedded in a world-class creative team while being supported by Dura Digital’s Human-Centered Design Studio.

• Be part of a remote-first, collaborative international culture across Canada, the United States, and Latin America.

• Grow your craft in design systems, motion, and AI-enabled creative production.

• Competitive compensation, supportive leadership, and significant opportunity for impact and career growth.

Dura Digital is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on merit and business needs, and not on the basis of race, color, religion, citizenship, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, veteran status, family care status, sex, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Industrial Designer – Consumer Products
description:
The Role

This role needs both strong technical 3D CAD skills and a real eye for industrial design. You will create visually appealing, commercially successful products that are also precise and practical to manufacture. Product design skills, aesthetic judgment and the ability to build a coherent design language matter as much as CAD proficiency. We are looking for a designer, not only a CAD technician.

Requirements

• 3+ years of professional experience in 3D CAD, industrial design and consumer product development

• Proven experience designing complete consumer products for commercial production and retail, balancing function, ergonomics, aesthetics and market appeal (mandatory)

• Strong aesthetic judgment: proportions, visual balance, form development, styling and a recognizable design language (mandatory)

• Advanced modeling of organic shapes, complex surfaces and geometric textures

• Strong parametric CAD skills: feature-based design, design history, assemblies, editable solid and surface geometry

• Design for manufacturing, especially laser cutting, CNC milling and machining

• Delivery of production-ready STEP files with accurate solid and surface geometry

• Ability to take products from concept and aesthetic development to manufacturing-ready CAD

• A portfolio showing both technical CAD work and refined consumer product design (mandatory). Portfolios of only mechanical parts or engineering assemblies will not qualify.

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to Have

• Experience designing handheld tools with a metal blade, or other high-end consumer products with premium finishes and refined geometry

• SolidWorks and/or CATIA

• Complex surface textures and ergonomic product geometry

• Building a consistent design language across a product family or collection

• Prototyping, material selection and production optimization

Job Type: Part-time, remote, hourly

How to Apply

Apply with your portfolio link and answer a few short questions. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short video introduction.

People Can Fly est l'un des principaux studios indépendants de développement de jeux AAA. Notre équipe internationale est composée de centaines de personnes talentueuses qui travaillent dans nos bureaux en Pologne, au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, aux États-Unis et au Canada, ainsi qu'à distance dans le monde entier.

Fondée en 2002, notre société s'est imposée dans le genre des jeux de tir avec des titres tels que Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgement and Outriders. En tant que l'un des studios les plus chevronnés dans l'utilisation du moteur Unreal Engine, nous continuons à développer notre expertise et à dépasser les limites du possible dans le domaine du développement de jeux vidéo.

Nos équipes créatives travaillent actuellement sur plusieurs titres captivants : Gears of War: E-Day développé en collaboration avec Microsoft: projet Echo pour KRAFTON; et Lost Rift, une propriété intellectuelle originale que nous développons en interne selon notre modèle d'auto-édition. Nous explorons également de nouvelles plateformes et expériences avec la réalité virtuelle et d'autres projets non annoncés.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience, PCF continue d'explorer de nouveaux horizons. Notre objectif est de combiner notre expertise avec la créativité des talents les plus brillants et les plus avant-gardistes du secteur, afin de créer la prochaine génération de jeux d'action pour les joueurs du monde entier.

Si vous nous rejoignez dans cette aventure, vous aurez la chance de perfectionner votre art, d'élargir vos connaissances et de travailler aux côtés des meilleurs du marché afin de créer des expériences uniques et inoubliables pour les joueurs du monde entier.

People Can Fly is one of the leading independent AAA game development studios. Our international team consists of hundreds of talented individuals working from offices in Poland, the UK, Ireland, the US, and Canada, as well as remotely across the globe.

Founded in 2002, we made our mark on the shooter genre with titles such as Painkiller, Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, and Outriders. As one of the most experienced Unreal Engine studios in the industry, we continue to expand on our expertise and push the boundaries of what’s possible in game development.

Our creative teams are currently working on several exciting titles: Gears of War: E-Day developed in collaboration with Microsoft; Project Echo for KRAFTON; and Lost Rift, an original IP we are developing in-house under our self-publishing model. We are also exploring new platforms and experiences with VR and other unannounced projects.

With over 20 years of experience, PCF continues to explore new horizons. We aim to combine our expertise with the creativity of the best and most forward-thinking talent in the industry, building the next generation of action games for players worldwide.

If you join us on this journey, you’ll have the chance to perfect your craft, expand your knowledge, and work alongside industry leaders to create unique, unforgettable experiences for gamers everywhere.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Welcome to OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe, smart, and environmentally responsible.

We do this with courage to innovate, commitment to outcomes, collaboration across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win – and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX and see how far you can go.

We believe the future of our products sits at the intersection of AI and design. Our ambition is to become an AI-native organization, where intelligent systems and human-centered design come together to create faster, smarter, and more meaningful customer experiences. We’re rethinking how products are built, how experiences are shaped, and how teams deliver impact.

A key part of this transformation is creating the right foundations and infrastructure to enable high-quality experiences at scale - where design systems, patterns, and workflows are structured, scalable, and AI-readable, unlocking new levels of speed, consistency, and innovation.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team. Reporting to the Product Design Manager, you will shape design strategy across product squads, own craft and quality standards, and mentor junior and mid-level designers. You'll work at the intersection of design, code, and AI systems—using tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor to prototype and iterate. Beyond shipping product experiences, you'll establish patterns, build systems thinking, and elevate the entire team's capabilities in AI-native design. The output we expect is not just working artifacts: it's strategic direction that raises design quality and team maturity across the organization.

What responsibilities will you get when working with us?

•
Lead design strategy across one or more product squads, translating business goals and user needs into coherent design direction that shapes product roadmaps and team priorities.

•
Use AI-native workflows to collapse the gap between strategy and production, prototyping and iterating directly in code rather than through static handoffs. Lead by example in adopting tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor for end-to-end design execution.

•
Establish and maintain high craft standards by defining foundational and reusable Agentic Experience patterns, designing scalable components for the design system (Nexus), and reviewing work to ensure quality and consistency.

•
Mentor and develop designers through critique, guidance, and structured feedback—helping them grow their craft, decision-making, and ability to work autonomously with AI-native tools.

•
Partner with Product and Engineering to align on experience strategy, success metrics, and technical feasibility—translating design insights into business outcomes and measurable impact.

•
Conduct user research and run experiments to validate design decisions. Define success metrics, gather feedback, and iterate fast—always balancing speed with quality and bias toward shipping.

•
Lead design reviews, brainstorming sessions, and strategic discussions with your design peers and cross-functional partners. Communicate design rationale clearly with data, influence decisions, and build alignment around priorities.

•
Identify gaps and opportunities for design improvement and innovation. Propose and champion new approaches to solving complex problems—whether through design systems improvements, new AI patterns, or cross-domain initiatives.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will need:

•
Proven experience in UX / Digital Product Design, with a strong portfolio that showcases shipped work, live prototypes, and measurable business impact—not just static screens. We won’t be interviewing if you don’t have a portfolio to share beforehand.

•
Demonstrated expertise in AI-native design: you actively use AI tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Cursor, Claude, etc.) as a core part of your design practice and can teach others how to leverage them effectively.

•
Experience building or contributing to design systems, including code components. You understand how design decisions impact engineering implementation and can collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

•
Proven track record mentoring and developing designers. You give and receive candid feedback, help others improve their craft, and create psychologically safe environments for growth and experimentation.

•
Strong product and business thinking: ability to frame problems strategically, connect design decisions to business outcomes, and define success metrics that demonstrate measurable impact.

•
Excellent English communication and influence skills: you articulate design rationale clearly with data, facilitate complex discussions, and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

•
Growth mindset and adaptability: you thrive in ambiguity and rapid change, prioritize learning and impact over mastery of any specific tool, and are excited about emerging technologies and evolving design practices.

What can we offer you:

• Work with and impact all OLX websites around the world

•
Salary + annual bonus up to 15% of your annual gross salary

•
Train and conference budget and free access to Udemy courses

•
Permanent contract, health insurance and life insurance

•
MacBook Pro or Windows Dell along with necessary accessories to make your work comfortable

•
100% remote work (and the possibility to work from our office in Lisboa or Barcelona)

Hiring Process

First Stage
TA Screen

This is your first interview with our Talent Acquisition team. We’ll explore your background, skills, and
experience, as well as your approach to autonomy, ownership, and critical thinking. It’s also a chance to
discuss your aspirations and ensure alignment with our culture and values.

Second Stage
Portfolio Review

In this stage, you’ll meet with the Hiring Manager and a Designer from the team. We’ll explore your
process thinking and approach to design through a case study of your choice. This is also a great
opportunity to discuss how you collaborate with others and how your values align with our team culture.

Third Stage
AI Sandbox Challenge

This is a dynamic and interactive session where you’ll have the chance to demonstrate your thought
process in action. It’s designed to give us insight into how you approach challenges, integrate AI into your
workflows, and apply your skills in a practical setting.
We aim to make this process clear, collaborative, and reflective of the way we work as a team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Responsibilities

• Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.

• Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.

• Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.

• Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.

• Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.

• Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.

• Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.

• Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.

• Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).

• Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.

• Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.

• This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

• A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies

• A remote and accomplished global team

• Opportunity for equity participation

• Unlimited vacation with manager approval

• 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents

• 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options

• 401k retirement savings plan

Salary range for US jobs

US Salary Range

$190,000—$210,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

title: Creative Director, Interactive Experiences
description:
Gigantic Playground, a CourtAvenue company, is a fast-growing creative technology agency that creates immersive and interactive experiences that connect people, places, and products in extraordinary ways. Our unique experience + technology approach blends creativity, immersive storytelling, and product innovation to create dynamic experiences that captivate, engage, and delight.

We're a purposely uncommon team, equal parts experience designers, creative technologists, and storytellers, with a mission to reimagine how people live, work, shop, and play.

Interactive work only earns its keep when someone actually stops, engages, and remembers it. That's the standard we hold ourselves to, and it's what this role exists to protect. As Creative Director, Interactive Experiences, you'll be the creative owner of everything we build that people touch, tap, walk into, or play with, from event installations to product launch apps to connected retail moments.

You're equally comfortable pitching the big idea in a client boardroom and sitting with a design team debugging why an interaction feels one beat too slow. We're looking for someone who can hold both altitudes at once: setting a creative bar for the whole studio while staying hands-on enough to shape the details that make an experience feel effortless. Your toolkit spans spatial storytelling, sensory and environmental design, and interactive technology, and you know how to weave all three into experiences that hold up whether someone spends five seconds or five minutes with them.

This is a leadership role with real creative stakes. You'll guide a team of designers and technologists, sit at the table with client leadership, and help define what "interactive" means for our studio as the tools and platforms we design for (AR, VR, connected hardware, generative AI, and whatever comes after) keep shifting.

Responsibilities

Shape the Creative Vision

• Define the point of view behind each interactive project, turning a client brief or a piece of new technology into an experience concept worth building

• Stay involved through production, not just at kickoff, so the finished experience still reflects the ambition of the original idea

• Set and protect a consistently high bar for design, motion, and interaction quality across every project the studio ships

Lead People and Client Relationships

• Manage and develop a team of designers, creative technologists, and producers, giving them clear creative direction and room to do strong work

• Serve as the primary creative contact for client teams, balancing their business goals against what will actually make for a compelling experience

• Pitch new ideas and present finished work in a way that builds client confidence in the studio's judgment, not just its execution

Push the Work Forward

• Keep a close eye on new interactive formats, hardware, and platforms, and bring recommendations to clients before they ask for them

• Introduce AI-assisted tools into the team's workflow where they genuinely help, whether that's early concepting, rapid prototyping, or content production

• Help junior and mid-level creatives grow by pairing critique with real mentorship, not just notes on a deck

Own the Details That Make It Real

• Oversee spatial and environmental design decisions alongside interactive content, so a physical installation and its digital layer feel like one idea rather than two

• Work with production, fabrication, and technology partners to keep ambitious concepts grounded in what can actually be built, staffed, and maintained on-site

• Stay current on trends in interactive art, entertainment design, and consumer technology, and bring that thinking back into the studio's own work

Requirements

•
10+ years or more in a creative role focused on interactive, digital, or experience design, including several years directly managing a team

•
Strong personal taste backed by a portfolio that shows range across interaction design, visual design, and concept development

•
Direct experience partnering with enterprise or consumer technology clients, and comfort navigating the layers of stakeholders that come with that kind of account

•
Willingness to get into the tools yourself. This isn't a role where you only review other people's Figma files

•
A working understanding of what's actually possible on today's hardware and software, so your ideas are ambitious but buildable

•
Real, current experience using AI tools as part of your own creative process, not just an interest in the idea of them

•
Comfort working across the full arc of a project, from early concept sketches through rapid prototyping to a finished, fabricated, on-site experience

•
Familiarity with the broader interactive and immersive landscape (AR, VR, projection, sensor-driven installations) even if your day-to-day tools are mostly digital

Preferred Qualifications

•
A portfolio piece that clearly moved the needle on how long people engaged with an experience

•
Recognition from peers or industry press for work you led

•
Clients who ask for you by name when something new and difficult comes up

•
Background in large-scale experiential production

Our PeopleWith over 1,500 team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our ImpactAs of mid 2025, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer (P5) who can lead high-impact product design work across multiple teams, connect adjacent product experiences and turn complex problem spaces into coherent shipped outcomes. You have spent 8+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy, AI-enabled or similarly sophisticated product experiences.

As a staff individual contributor, you will operate across product areas where the right solution depends on more than one roadmap, team or feature brief. You will partner deeply with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Design leadership and customer-facing teams to frame the right problems, define product experience direction and help teams move from ambiguity to high-quality execution.

This role requires exceptional craft, strong product judgment and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on design work. You should be comfortable defining experience direction, mapping complex workflows, prototyping new interaction models, strengthening shared patterns and helping teams preserve quality through implementation.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You'll Do

•
Lead design strategy and execution for complex initiatives that span multiple teams, product surfaces or customer workflows

•
Translate customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, data signals and product strategy into clear experience direction

•
Partner with product and engineering leaders to clarify problem spaces, sequence design work and align teams around high-quality outcomes

•
Create prototypes, workflows, interaction models and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and testable

•
Identify product experience gaps, design debt and cross-team inconsistencies, then turn them into practical improvements

•
Shape AI-enabled workflows, intelligent interfaces and automation-heavy experiences that give customers clarity, control and confidence

•
