description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

Position Summary

The Mechanical & Design Engineer provides mechanical engineering and design support for capital projects and chemical manufacturing operations across the organization. This position is responsible for performing detailed engineering analysis, calculations, equipment specification, design, and technical documentation to support safe, efficient, and reliable project execution.

You will work closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Designers, Drafters, plant personnel, and other stakeholders to develop practical engineering solutions for chemical plants. The role requires the ability to work independently, including remotely, with minimal direction while effectively managing multiple priorities and supporting projects from concept through construction and implementation.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform detailed mechanical engineering analysis, calculations, design, and sketches for CapEx projects, plant support activities, and construction installations.

title: Principal Brand Designer
description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

•
Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

•
Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

•
Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

•
Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

•
Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

Translate strategy into brand experiences

You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

Mentor and elevate the craft

As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

You create brands that people trust

Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

You think in systems

You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

You bring strategy to life through Design

You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

You influence without authority

You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

You bring depth of experience

You'll likely have:

•
10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

•
Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

•
Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

•
Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

•
Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

•
Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

•
Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:

First Stage
Portfolio & Design Leadership
This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

Second Stage
Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

Third Stage
Executive Partnership & Business Impact
This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

title: Creative Director
description:
About Foundation

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

Mission of the Role

You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.

You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.

Reports to: Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

What you'll own:

• The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.

• The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses.

• Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.

• Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.

• Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.

• Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.

• AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.

• Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

What you bring:

• 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.

• You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.

• You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.

• You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in real creative work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like Claude, Figma, Higgsfield, HeyGen or ElevenLabs counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.

• Experience teaching others: you've made writers, designers and editors better, including people who don't report to you.

• A clear point of view on what makes content get found and cited by AI assistants, and how that changes the creative brief.

Compensation: Base salary 110k–135k depending on experience and location

Variable compensation: Target 10% of base, tied to KPIs

Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a Senior Product Designer to own, hands-on, the design systems behind everything we ship. You'll own two outright, institutional and consumer, and support the marketing team's system so brand and design-to-code stay tight. Our products move real money, so precision and accessibility are the floor, not the ceiling: we want institutional and consumer users alike to feel the craft, which makes visual expression and motion core to the system. You'll join a small, senior team that runs on high ownership and low ego, and this is a building role: you'll be in Figma and alongside engineers every day, shipping the components and tokens yourself while setting the direction for the systems you own.

Target Outcomes

• Both design systems, institutional and consumer, fully adopted across their web and mobile products, with measurable coverage (share of screens built from system components) rising quarter over quarter.

• Figma libraries and the front-end component library in parity: tokens, variants, and states match one-to-one, with drift caught and resolved as part of normal release cadence.

• Every system component meets WCAG AA, with accessibility criteria documented and verified before release, and the systems carry a visual and motion language that users notice and teams can reuse.

• Product teams ship faster: fewer one-off components, shorter design-to-build cycles, and a clear contribution path that teams actually use.

• Documentation and governance that scale beyond the design team: engineers, PMs, and AI agents can build correctly from the system without a designer in the loop.

Responsibilities

• Own two design systems end to end, institutional and consumer: components, design tokens, theming, patterns, and the Figma libraries behind them, across web and mobile. Support the marketing team's design system as needed so brand practice stays consistent and design-to-code stays smooth.

• Define the expressive layer of both systems: visual language, motion principles, and the interaction details that make institutional and consumer products feel considered and alive, not merely correct.

• Design and ship the full stack of the system, from primitives and atoms through molecules and organisms to page templates, with polished interaction details and the visual hierarchy, typography, and layout rigor that trading and financial interfaces demand.

• Partner closely with UI engineers so that tokens and components map cleanly to the production component library, and so Figma and code stay in sync.

• Define how the system works on mobile: platform-appropriate interactions, responsive and adaptive behavior, and parity rules between web and native surfaces.

• Hold the system to WCAG 2.2 AA: color contrast, focus and keyboard behavior, motion, and screen-reader semantics baked into components rather than bolted on.

• Write clear, usable documentation (usage guidelines, do/don't examples, contribution guides) that designers, engineers, and AI agents can all work from.

• Run governance across teams: contribution and review process, versioning and deprecation, adoption tracking, and the forums where product teams propose and resolve system changes.

• Audit the system proactively to find gaps, inconsistencies, and drift across products, then prioritize and drive the fixes without waiting to be asked.

• Use AI tooling as part of daily work: agents, markdown guideline files, and MCP integrations that connect the design system to design and engineering workflows.

Requirements

• 6+ years in product design, including 3+ years focused on design systems.

• Experience building and scaling a shared design system across multiple products and platforms, web and mobile, including mobile-specific design systems and interactions.

• Strong UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and polished interaction details, with a point of view on motion and visual expression and the taste to know when restraint is the right call.

• Builds scalable components and design tokens, including theming (for example light/dark modes or multi-brand).

• A strong understanding of how components and tokens translate into front-end libraries: how components are built, composed, and consumed in code (for example React, React Native, or Swift/Kotlin component libraries), and how tokens flow from Figma into code.

• Advanced Figma skills: variables and modes, auto layout, component properties, and library management at scale.

• A track record of working closely with engineers as a day-to-day partner, not a handoff.

• Strong accessibility knowledge and experience shipping WCAG AA compliant components.

• Writes clear documentation and has run governance across teams: contribution models, review processes, and adoption.

• Fluency with AI tooling in a design or engineering workflow: using agents, writing markdown guideline files, and working with MCP integrations.

• Experience with design-to-code tooling such as Code Connect, token pipelines, or Storybook.

• A systems thinker with sharp attention to detail who sees both the pattern and the pixel.

• A portfolio that showcases design systems work: components, tokens, documentation, and the reasoning behind the decisions.

Nice to Have

• Experience with crypto, onchain or tokenized-asset products.

• Experience in fintech, exchanges, or trading platforms. Design systems for trading surfaces have their own nuances: dense data tables, real-time state changes, numeric typography, and color semantics for gains, losses, and risk.

• Familiarity with crypto and digital-asset products, or with tokenized assets and markets.

• Experience setting up motion and interaction standards within a system.

• Working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese.

What we offer

• Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.

• Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).

• Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.

• A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.

• Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

title: Designer, Brand and Growth
description:
Salary range: $90K to $110K, plus equity

About Badge

Mobile wallets now account for roughly as many in-store purchases as cash, and unlike cash, they're still climbing. Most brands still treat them as a place to store a card.

Badge is the infrastructure that changes that. We give enterprise brands and platforms one integration to issue and operate passes and cards across Apple, Google, and Samsung Wallet. Loyalty cards, stored value, memberships, IDs, and tickets, all living on the surface customers already carry, updating in real time, with no app download and no new account.

The platform meets teams wherever they work: a no-code UI for marketers, flexible APIs for developers, an embed SDK for platform partners, and an MCP server so AI agents can build on it directly. That powers in-wallet push notifications, location-based messages, offers, tap-to-redeem, and more.

We are a fast-growing team backed by leading investors including TTV Capital, Stripe, Synchrony Ventures, and Infinity Ventures, and trusted by companies like Hoka, Blackhawk Network, Shift4, and Yale University. We value sharp thinking, fast execution, and a real understanding of how customers behave in a mobile-first world.

Position overview

Join Badge as a Brand and Growth Designer to shape how the world sees and experiences Badge. You'll own design for our growth marketing, including the website, content, social, email, and sales materials. You'll also work closely with product to deepen knowledge and accuracy across the Badge product suite.

This role is a great fit for a versatile designer who loves ownership, moves quickly between brand and sales enablement, and gets energized when their work drives pipeline, closes deals, and helps customers succeed.

Questions we're exploring

* How do we make mobile wallets feel like an obvious, must-have channel to enterprise marketers who haven't thought about them before?
* How do we speak to three different audiences (marketers, developers, and platform partners) without our story fragmenting?
* How do we show wallet experiences like push notifications, location-based offers, and tap-to-redeem in ways that are visual and easy to understand?
* How do we give sales and marketing a template system they can use on their own while keeping the brand consistent?
* How can the marketing site and the product feel like one connected experience, from first visit to first pass created?

Core Responsibilities

• Orchestrate the Badge website. Design, build, and iterate on trybadge.com in Webflow in collaboration with agencies and leadership as needed. Website design includes landing pages, product and solution pages, and campaign/event pages. Work with marketing to test and improve what converts.

• Enable sales and leadership. Build and refine sales decks, one-pagers, customer case studies, and executive and investor presentations, and maintain a template library the team can use on their own.

• Power content and social. Create blog visuals, product diagrams, and LinkedIn assets (posts, carousels, event and launch graphics) that make wallet experiences easy to understand.

• Bring Badge to life at events. Design conference and event collateral, booth graphics, signage, and swag that make Badge stand out in person.

• Build email that scales. Design reusable email templates for newsletters, product updates, and nurture campaigns.

• Build systems, not one-offs. Maintain and evolve Badge's visual identity across every touchpoint, and contribute to our design system, brand guidelines, and scalable templates, so every new asset is faster to make and stays consistent.

• Design with AI. Use tools like Claude, Figma AI, and other emerging tools to explore concepts, speed up production, and prototype. AI helps you move faster; your judgment and craft decide what ships.

• Collaborate across the team. Work with marketing, sales, product, and engineering to understand goals, give and get feedback, and ship work that moves the business.

• Work closely with product design. Partner with the product team to keep a source of truth for screens, passes, and flows. Dig into how Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Badge actually work, so you depict the product accurately and can spot what's off before anyone flags it.

What You Bring To The Table

• 3–5 years of marketing and brand design experience, ideally on a technical product you had to learn and explain. In-house or agency both work, as long as you’ve owned output end to end and gotten up to speed on a complex product quickly.

• Expert in Figma, strong in Adobe Creative Suite, and comfortable in Pitch and Webflow (or similar tools).

• You have a sharp eye for typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy

• You have a strong, defensible point of view on what good looks like, and the editing discipline to strip a design down to its essentials rather than layering more on

• You're comfortable switching between a landing page, a LinkedIn carousel, a sales deck, and a product flow in the same week

• You care about results, and you use metrics like conversion, engagement, and sales feedback to improve your work

• You explain your thought process and trade-offs clearly and concisely

• You can take projects from brief to launch with limited supervision, and you're comfortable moving fast on ambiguous, time-sensitive requests

• You have a portfolio (required) that shows range across web, brand identity, marketing collateral, events, and decks, ideally with some UI or product work and a look at your process

Nice To Have

• Product pitch experience

• Webflow

• Prototyping experience, in Figma or with AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor

• Familiarity with HubSpot, plus basic HTML/CSS

• Motion, animation, or 3D skills (After Effects, Lottie, Rive, Blender, or Cinema 4D)

• Event, booth, or exhibit design experience

• Experience with A/B testing or analytics

• Interest in mobile wallets, fintech/payments, B2B SaaS, loyalty, or retail marketing

We offer a competitive salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package, as well as the opportunity to shape the brand and product experience of a fast-growing startup.

This is a remote position. If you're passionate about great design and want to see your work directly shape how customers discover and use Badge, we'd love to hear from you. Please include a link to your portfolio with your application.

A Flash é um ecossistema inteligente de soluções para RH e financeiro que simplifica toda a gestão do dia a dia de trabalho em uma única plataforma, desde a admissão e o controle de ponto aos benefícios e despesas corporativas. Transformamos processos complexos em uma jornada encantadora, criando uma experiência de trabalho mais leve, humana e eficiente para todos.

Aqui dentro, chamamos isso de Efeito Flamingo: cada ideia, cada linha de código, cada atendimento reverbera muito além da Flash, impactando a rotina de empresas e milhões de pessoas. Trabalhar aqui é viver o poder de fazer voar com criatividade, propósito e impacto real.

Vem ser Flamingo! ✨

🦩 Por que trabalhar com a gente?

Na Flash, acreditamos que grandes transformações nascem de voos individuais, ganham força no coletivo e encontram direção nos valores que nos guiam como bando:

✨Criamos valor com o Cliente

✨Resolvemos problemas com Pragmatismo

✨Jogamos Juntos

✨Entregamos Resultados Consistentes

✨Aprendemos e Transformamos

🦩Nosso jeitinho de trabalhar:

• Ser Flamingo na Flash é viver um ambiente de criatividade e tecnologia, com autonomia para criar, testar e transformar ideias em soluções reais que ajudam empresas e pessoas a voarem mais alto.

•
Aprendizado acelerado: cada desafio é uma chance de crescer e inovar.

•
Pertencimento de verdade: ninguém voa sozinho, sempre em formação.

•
Sentido de propósito: o que começa na Flash transforma o jeito que o mundo trabalha.

• Deixe sua marca no mundo do trabalho e viva com a gente o poder de fazer voar.

✨ Nossos benefícios:

•
Cartão Flash (o tão amado rosinha! 🦩) com benefício flexível para alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, saúde, educação, cultura e bem-estar

• Assistência médica

• Assistência odontológica

• Seguro de vida

• Vale-transporte

• Auxílio home office

• Auxílio-creche

• Licenças-maternidade e paternidade estendidas

• TotalPass para cuidar do corpo e da mente

• OnHappy para deixar as viagens ainda mais especiais

• Convênio Pet com a Guapeco 🐶🐱

• C4life, com assistência jurídica, emocional, social e financeira, além de apoio para pets

• +Família by Avus, com suporte e benefícios para diferentes momentos da vida

• Convênio com o SESC

• Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

• Day off no seu aniversário 🎂

🌈Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas

• Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que times plurais constroem soluções mais fortes, humanas e inovadoras para Flash. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de qualquer gênero, raça, etnia, idade, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, religião e pessoa com deficiência (PCD).

🦩O que você irá fazer:

Buscamos uma pessoa Diretor(a) de Arte / Designer Sênior com olhar apurado de branding, paixão por colocar a mão na massa e muita criatividade para integrar o nosso time de Criação!

Se você gosta de trazer ideias inovadoras para a mesa, tem forte repertório visual e quer impactar diretamente a consistência de nossa marca, esse desafio é para você. 🦩

Você será responsável por executar projetos criativos de média e alta complexidade, garantindo excelência estética, consistência de marca e colaboração com diferentes áreas da empresa. No dia a dia, você irá:

•

•
Criar e desdobrar KVs e campanhas;

•
Desenvolver materiais visuais on e offline;

•
Garantir que todas as entregas estejam alinhadas ao Guia de Marca da Flash;

•
Contribuir com ideias, referências e soluções visuais em diferentes projetos;

•
Apoiar revisões criativas e trocas com criativos jrs;

•
Apoiar a revisão de materiais desenvolvidos por fornecedores externos.

✨ O que buscamos:

•
Graduação em áreas criativas (Design, Publicidade e áreas correlatas);

•
Domínio de ferramentas de criação (pacote Adobe, Figma, etc.);

•
Experiência sólida tanto em entregas online (social, apresentações, landing pages, etc.) quanto offline (artes para eventos, impressos, etc.).

✨ O que esperamos:

•
Alto nível de qualidade estética e atenção aos detalhes;

•
Autonomia para conduzir entregas do início ao fim;

•
Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa;

•
Capacidade de interpretar, questionar e enriquecer briefings;

•
Curiosidade e senso crítico no uso de IA aplicada ao design;

•
Compromisso com a consistência visual e a evolução contínua da marca.

✨Diferenciais:

•
Noções sólidas de Branding;

•
Experiência prévia com marcas B2B e/ou startups;

•
Familiaridade com o uso de Inteligência Artificial generativa aplicada à criação, produtividade e animação (Gemini, Claude, etc.).
Vem fazer o mundo do trabalho voar com a gente! 🚀

Você vem voar com a gente? 💖

Inscreva-se agora em nossas vagas e ajude a levar o Efeito Flamingo para ainda mais empresas pelo Brasil! 🦩

Siga a gente no Instagram em @meuflash.

🤖

Podemos utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) para apoiar algumas etapas do processo de recrutamento e seleção, como a triagem de candidaturas, a análise de currículos ou a avaliação de respostas. Essas ferramentas auxiliam o nosso time de recrutamento, mas não substituem o julgamento humano. As decisões finais de contratação são sempre tomadas por pessoas.

title: Electrical Engineer (Buildings Design) - REMOTE
description:
Michael Baker International is seeking a motivated Electrical Engineer to join our growing Building Engineering team. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful projects that support Federal agencies, Department of Defense missions, and other critical infrastructure programs across the country.

As part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team, you will work alongside architects, civil engineers, structural engineers, and building systems professionals to deliver innovative electrical design solutions for complex facilities and infrastructure projects. While the primary focus of this role will be supporting Federal and DoD clients, you will also have opportunities to work on projects within the Life Sciences, Education, Healthcare, Industrial, and Commercial markets.

The ideal candidate is passionate about engineering, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is eager to grow their technical expertise while contributing to projects that make a meaningful difference for government and community stakeholders.

What You'll Do

• Design and develop electrical systems including power distribution, lighting, telecommunications, grounding, and specialty systems for Federal, DoD, and facility-based projects.

• Perform engineering analysis, calculations, evaluations, and system modeling to support project objectives and client requirements.

• Prepare construction documents, engineering reports, specifications, and technical design packages.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams to develop coordinated and constructible design solutions.

• Research and evaluate products and equipment to support project requirements and operational goals.

• Participate in project meetings and coordinate with clients, project managers, contractors, and other engineering disciplines.

• Assist with site investigations, field assessments, construction support, and commissioning activities.

• Review project requirements and technical standards to ensure compliance with applicable codes and Federal agency criteria.

• Support proposal development, qualifications packages, and technical presentations for new project opportunities.

• Utilize engineering and design technologies including Revit, BIM platforms, and industry-standard electrical analysis software.

• Provide guidance and mentorship to less experienced engineers, designers, and CAD technicians.

• Travel occasionally to support project meetings, site visits, and client engagements.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

• Work on high-visibility Federal and Department of Defense projects that support critical national missions.

• Collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists across multiple disciplines.

• Gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of facility and infrastructure projects.

• Build technical expertise while working toward increased engineering responsibility and project leadership opportunities.

• Join a company committed to innovation, technical excellence, and making a difference in the communities we serve.

Professional Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering with an Electrical Engineering emphasis.

• 5+ years of related electrical engineering experience.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license required.

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills.

• Understanding of building systems and coordination among design disciplines, clients, and construction teams.

• Experience with electrical engineering software such as SKM, EasyPower, AGi32, or ElumTools.

• Familiarity with Revit and Building Information Modeling (BIM).

• Proficiency with Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, Teams, and SharePoint.

• Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining quality and schedule commitments.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $100,000-$160,000. Actual compensation will be based on the successful candidate's experience, qualifications, and overall expertise.

Workplace Flexibility

This position can be remote, for candidates located within the United States.

Benefits
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

• Medical, dental, vision insurance

• 401k Retirement Plan

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability

• Professional and personal development

• Generous paid time off

• Commuter and wellness benefits

• Tuition reimbursement

title: SEASONAL - Social Media Graphics Designer
description:
ABOUT UNRIVALED

Unrivaled is a premier professional women’s 3v3 basketball league showcasing the top players in the sport. Our mission is to elevate the profile of women’s basketball through exceptional talent, groundbreaking partnerships, and unparalleled fan experiences.

JOB OVERVIEW

Unrivaled is seeking Social Media Graphics Designer to help bring the league to life across our social and digital platforms, during the 2026–2027 season. The engagement is expected to begin end of September, 2026, and continuing through approximately mid-March 2027, subject to completion of the agreed scope of services. The services are expected to be performed remotely, except as otherwise agreed by the parties.

This is a highly execution-focused creative role for a designer who understands the speed, energy, and visual language of sports and social media. The ideal candidate can move quickly without sacrificing quality, understands how design changes from Instagram to TikTok to X and YouTube, and can turn information, moments, statistics, photography, and creative concepts into compelling graphics that fans want to engage with and share.

This person will work closely with Unrivaled's Content, Social, Marketing, Basketball Operations, Partnerships, and Creative teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Social & Digital Graphics

• Create daily graphics for Unrivaled's social platforms, including Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and emerging platforms.

• Design both planned and reactive content around games, players, teams, league news, cultural moments, and breaking news.

• Create graphics that are optimized for each platform rather than simply resizing the same creative.

• Support high-volume content needs during the Unrivaled season while maintaining brand consistency and quality.

• Develop reusable templates that allow the social team to move quickly during games and breaking news moments.

Game & Basketball Content

• Create game-day graphics including:

• Matchups and tune-in

• Starting lineups

• Player statistics

• Scores and final scores

• Standings

• Records and milestones

• Player achievements

• Quotes

• Schedule information

• Playoff and championship graphics

• Support real-time graphics production during live games and major league events.

• Turn basketball statistics and storylines into visually compelling, easy-to-understand social content.

• Work with photography and video teams to rapidly create assets from live events.

Player & Team Storytelling

• Develop graphics that showcase the personalities, accomplishments, and stories of Unrivaled players.

• Create distinct creative executions for Unrivaled's clubs while maintaining the overall league identity.

• Support player announcements, roster announcements, transactions, awards, milestones, birthdays, and other player-driven moments.

• Help develop recurring social franchises and visual series that fans immediately recognize.

Marketing & League Initiatives

• Support graphics needs for league marketing campaigns.

• Create assets supporting ticket sales, tune-in, merchandise, events, community programs, and league announcements.

• Adapt major campaign creative into social-first executions.

• Help maintain consistency between Unrivaled's broader brand identity and its daily social presence.

Brand Partnerships

• Work with the Partnerships and Content teams to create sponsored social graphics and branded content.

• Incorporate partner branding while protecting the look, feel, and authenticity of Unrivaled.

• Execute contracted partner deliverables accurately and on deadline.

• Help find creative ways to integrate sponsors into social content without making the content feel overly commercial.

Creative Development

• Participate in brainstorms for campaigns, player storytelling, social franchises, and major league moments.

• Bring forward new design trends, formats, memes, visual styles, and social behaviors that could work for Unrivaled.

• Experiment with typography, photography, illustration, data visualization, motion, and other techniques.

• Help evolve Unrivaled's social design language as the league grows.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Approximately 2–5 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, media, culture, or a fast-moving consumer brand.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating social-first graphic design.

• Excellent understanding of typography, composition, hierarchy, color, photography, and visual storytelling.

• Advanced proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

• Familiarity with After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, or other motion/design tools is a plus.

• Ability to work quickly and produce high-quality creative under tight deadlines.

• Strong understanding of how creative performs differently across social platforms.

• Comfortable working with sports photography and creating graphics around live events.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly around player names, statistics, scores, sponsor requirements, and brand guidelines.

• Knowledge of basketball and women's sports is strongly preferred.

• Ability to receive feedback, make adjustments quickly, and collaborate with multiple departments.

• Comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change rapidly.

Unrivaled is an equal opportunity organization. All qualified individuals will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Creative Director
description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced Creative Director to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is hands-on in visual development, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experience Strategy & Design

•
Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.

•
Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.

•
Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.

•
Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

2. Creative & Art Direction

•

title: SEASONAL - Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
ABOUT UNRIVALED

Unrivaled is a premier professional women’s 3v3 basketball league showcasing the top players in the sport. Our mission is to elevate the profile of women’s basketball through exceptional talent, groundbreaking partnerships, and unparalleled fan experiences.

JOB OVERVIEW

Unrivaled is seeking a Graphic Designer and Illustrator who can help define the organization's look and feel across social media platforms during the 2026–2027 season. The engagement is expected to begin end of September, 2026, and continuing through approximately mid-March 2027, subject to completion of the agreed scope of services. The services are expected to be performed remotely, except as otherwise agreed by the parties.

This role is for a designer who is equally comfortable executing against an established brand system and creating something completely original from a blank canvas. We are asking all applicants to provide us with work from their professional portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Social & Real-Time Sports Graphics

• Design high-volume, high-quality graphics for Unrivaled's social platforms.

• Create game-day graphics, matchups, starting lineups, scores, statistics, standings, player milestones, breaking news, transactions, schedules, and results.

• Develop graphics around cultural moments, player performances, rivalries, and emerging storylines.

• Work quickly during live events while maintaining a high creative standard.

• Build adaptable templates that allow the creative and social teams to move quickly without making the brand feel repetitive.

Illustration & Original Creative

• Create original illustrations of Unrivaled players, teams, moments, and league stories.

• Develop poster-style artwork, editorial illustrations, player portraits, typography treatments, and campaign artwork.

• Translate player personalities and basketball culture into distinctive visual concepts.

• Create artwork that can extend beyond social into merchandise, apparel, posters, arena environments, and physical installations.

• Bring an identifiable artistic point of view while still working within the larger Unrivaled brand.

Brand & Marketing

• Support major league campaigns including player announcements, schedules, ticketing, tune-in, playoffs, special events, and league initiatives.

• Help evolve Unrivaled's visual identity while maintaining consistency across platforms.

• Create key art that can become the foundation for larger integrated campaigns.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Content to translate strategic ideas into strong visual concepts.

• Help establish design systems and templates that can scale across a fast-growing organization.

Players & Clubs

• Develop distinctive creative treatments for Unrivaled players and clubs.

• Create graphics that celebrate player personalities, achievements, fashion, culture, and interests beyond basketball.

• Help differentiate the visual identity of individual teams while ensuring they remain connected to the overall Unrivaled brand.

• Create player-focused artwork that athletes are excited to share on their own platforms.

Partnerships

• Collaborate with the Brand Partnerships team to create sponsor-integrated graphics and campaigns.

• Find creative ways to incorporate partner brands without compromising the quality or authenticity of Unrivaled creative.

• Develop original visual concepts that can elevate partnership pitches and existing sponsorship programs.

• Adapt league creative into partner-specific deliverables across social, digital, broadcast, and live events.

Live Events & Arena

• Design graphics for arena video boards, LED displays, signage, concourses, player areas, and fan experiences.

• Support creative needs for Unrivaled road events and special events.

• Think beyond the phone screen and understand how artwork translates into physical environments.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 3-7+ years of professional design experience

• Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional graphic design and illustration skills.

• Experience creating sports, entertainment, fashion, music, gaming, or culturally relevant creative.

• Strong command of typography, composition, color, photography, and visual hierarchy.

• Ability to create original illustration—not simply manipulate photography or existing assets.

• Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.

• Experience with motion design, After Effects, 3D, or animation is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted creative tools is a plus, particularly when used to accelerate ideation and production rather than replace original creative thinking.

• Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and evolving social formats.

• Ability to work quickly in a live sports environment.

• Comfortable receiving creative direction while also bringing original ideas to the table.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to craft.

Unrivaled is an equal opportunity organization. All qualified individuals will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Lead Design Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

As a Lead Design Engineer at Samsara, you'll build the systems that power our product and scale our impact as a design team. You'll define the components, patterns, tokens, and guidelines for both people and agents to build with. You'll work in design and in code, shipping highly interactive UI across web and mobile. You’ll codify our principles, heuristics, and taste for high quality ai generation. Your work will shape how quickly teams can build, how reliably our products behave, and how confidently customers use them.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in Canada.

You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

•
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop core system components, evals, and feedback loops to harden AI design and code generation.

• Govern taste through structure, preventing ai slop from ever making it into our customers’ hands.

• Make sure system decisions translate cleanly into code, with shared ownership of quality, performance, and maintainability.

• Build accessibility, responsiveness, and performance into the system by default.

• Set clear contribution, governance, and deprecation models that balance speed with system integrity.

• Meet regularly with the designers and engineers who use the system, and bring their feedback alongside usage data into what you build next.

• Share the AI tools, workflows, and tactics that work with the wider design and engineering teams.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as the company scales globally across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 8+ years of experience in design engineering, design systems, product design, or front-end engineering, building UX/UI for web and mobile applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction Design, or equivalent practical experience.

• Shipped design system or component library work, with a portfolio, case studies, or code samples that explain what you built, how you decided, and how teams adopted it. We cannot consider applications without a portfolio at this time.

• Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the judgment to know when to use an established pattern and when to invent one.

• Experience with design tokens, theming, and accessibility standards.

• AI tools in your regular practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Figma Make), with shipped work you can attribute to them, and experience connecting them to a design system. You can explain, review, and debug the code they generate.

• Experience partnering with designers, engineers, and product managers on short cycles.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$151,300—$195,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

Essential Responsibilities

Video, Motion, and Animation

• Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.

• Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.

• Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.

• Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.

• Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.

• Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.

• Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

Brand and Creative Support

• Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.

• Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.

• Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.

• Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.

• Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.

• Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

Collaboration and Tools

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.

• Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.

• Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

Project Execution

• Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.

• Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.

• Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

Requirements

Qualifications/Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.

• A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions through a strategic business lens.

• A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.

• Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.

• Based in the United States.

Bonus Points For

• B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.

• Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.

• Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.

• Availability in Mountain Standard Time or West Coast time zones.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

• Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.

• Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.

• 401(k) plan with employer match.

• Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).

• Tuition Reimbursement Program.

• Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.

• Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).

• Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.

• Community Give-Back initiatives.

• Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

This is an individual contributor role responsible for leading through expertise, influence, and decision-making authority. title: SRM Structures Design Engineer
description:
Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission.

Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success.

SRM Structures Design Engineer

DESCRIPTION

Long Wall is looking for an experienced Solid Rocket Motor (SRM) Structures Design Engineer to support the design, development, and production of SRMs for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring SRM motor cases, other primary structure, and secondary structure meet demanding missile interception requirements while maintaining manufacturability at scale. The SRM Structures Design Engineer serves as the technical authority for the design of SRM structural components. Responsibilities include design and analysis of motor cases, internal and external joints, raceways, flight equipment mounting, reviewing and interpreting static fire and flight test data, providing technical oversight and direction to suppliers, and defining requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous design methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, ballistics, structures and dynamics, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure structural design decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design SRM structural components to meet technical requirements, including pressure vessels, vehicle primary structure, and secondary structures.

• Develop, refine, and validate design methods and tools for motor cases, igniter structure, and vehicle integration.

• Review and provide oversight to suppliers designing structural components for integration into the Cyclops vehicle.

• Review test data from component structural tests, including solid rocket motor static tests.

• Prepare, present, and explain technical results to government partners, customers, and suppliers.

• Other duties as assigned.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a technical discipline, or equivalent experience in complex aerospace or defense development.

• 5+ years of experience with solid rocket motors or composite structures.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proficiency with NX, Creo, or other parametric CAD software.

• Proficiency with product definition creation, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing and engineering drawings.

• Experience with the design and development of filament-wound pressure vessels and other composite structures.

• Proven ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced environments that combine private‑investment‑driven development with government test requirements.

• Ability to interpret engineering artifacts, requirements, and configurations and convert them into actionable activities.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills; capable of aligning engineering teams, surfacing risks early, and maintaining clarity across disciplines.

• Demonstrated ability to partner closely across technical disciplines with technical authorities (chief engineering, systems engineering, mission assurance), customers, and suppliers to ensure disciplined technical execution.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Hands-on manufacturing experience with composite structures, including filament winding and hand lay-up.

• Proficiency in MATLAB, Python, C++, FORTRAN, or similar programming languages.

• Experience supporting missile defense, launch vehicle development, aerospace hardware integration, or other technically complex systems.

• Familiarity with requirements flow‑down, verification planning, ICD management, and configuration control.

• Prior experience working within a hybrid program environment (internal rapid development + government‑funded test campaigns).

• Ability to translate ambiguous technical requirements into executable work.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This position requires a national security suitability screening following offer acceptance.

• Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.

• Ability to use a computer for assignments and communicate effectively in person, via telepresence, and by phone.

• Ability to travel between Long Wall sites as needed.

ITAR Requirement

This position requires access to information protected under US export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and/or the Export Administration Regulations. As such, US person status (including US citizens, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted U.S. asylum status, or individuals admitted in U.S. refugee status) is a required qualification for this position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, genetics, or citizenship status (when otherwise legally authorized to work and access export-controlled data) and will not be discriminated against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We encourage applicants of all ages.

National Security Suitability
Depending on the position, Long Wall may require the successful completion of a national security suitability screening in addition to its standard background check. Where required, the screening is conducted by Long Wall’s Facility Security Officer following offer acceptance and may include verification of any current or prior U.S. government security clearances or public trust positions. Information provided during the screening is used solely to determine suitability for the role and is held in confidence by Security. For positions subject to this requirement, any offer of employment is contingent upon a favorable suitability determination.
