title: Art Director
description:
About the Role

Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else misses. We need someone to make it look like the future it is.

We're looking for an Art Director who is first and foremost an artist. This is not a creative production role. You will own Abnormal's aesthetic direction, a singular visual identity with a bold and cinematic sensibility, and communicate that vision clearly to every team, vendor, and collaborator who executes creative work. You'll work closely with our CEO, CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and VP of Revenue Marketing to internalize Abnormal's worldview, then make it your own, ideally pushing it further than we imagined.

This role is distinct from our creative services function, which runs the production engine. Your job is to set the vision, protect its integrity, and elevate it. At Abnormal, you'll do the most exciting work of your career because you'll be shaping how the future of cybersecurity is seen, in a company where AI is at the core of the product and the way we work.

The ideal candidate is a concept artist at heart, someone who has spent their career in sci-fi film, cyberpunk or sci-fi video games, or similarly high-craft visual storytelling environments. Specifically, we want someone who knows how to design computer interfaces, holograms, and imagined future worlds, with the kind of detail that maps to a visionary technology company and its products: the in-world UI of a sci-fi game or film, the readout on a futuristic digital weapon, the menu architecture of a spacecraft. Not characters. Not atmospheric environments. Designed systems and objects with detail and intention. You see and express vision. You don't just execute.

What You Will Do

• Define and own Abnormal's visual aesthetic direction

• Lead visual ideation for high-stakes moments: major product launches, experiential events (RSA, Black Hat), and brand campaigns

• Contribute hands-on concept work when the moment demands it. This is a vision-first role, but your craft should be evident

• Build a shared creative language across the org so the aesthetic direction scales without bottlenecking through you

• Serve as the creative authority and taste-setter for all visual output, from brand identity to campaigns to experiential environments

• Translate the CEO's and leadership's vision into a clear, communicable aesthetic that others can execute without needing you in every room

• Partner with creative services to keep production output style-consistent, setting guardrails and reviewing work rather than running the factory

• Develop mood boards, concept art, and visual references that define "in the zone" creative for recruiter screening, vendor briefs, and internal alignment

Must Haves

• 10+ years of experience in concept art, visual design, or art direction, with a body of work that shows artistic progression and a distinct point of view

• Shipped credits on AAA game titles, major film productions, or equivalent high-craft visual projects in sci-fi, cyberpunk, or adjacent genres, with work focused on interface design, in-world UI/UX, holographic displays, or designed objects (virtual weapons, vehicles, technology systems) rather than characters, creatures, or natural environments

• A portfolio that demonstrates genuine aesthetic vision, not just execution. Your work should show world-building expressed through designed objects and systems: architecture, vehicles, digital weapons, futuristic technology, UI. Detailed, intentional, engineered creative work. Painterly or landscape-driven portfolios are not the profile we're hiring

• Experience as the sole or lead visual voice on at least one significant project: not just a contributor, but the person who owned the aesthetic direction end to end

• Ability to articulate and document a visual language clearly enough that others can execute it without you present

• Experience collaborating directly with senior leadership or creative directors and translating their vision into something tangible

• Craft fluency across visual mediums: digital, environmental, editorial, motion

• Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in a fast-moving tech company. You operate with autonomy, take feedback, and collaborate cross-functionally. You want to stay close to the work, and you're here to bring the vision, not manage a team

• Strong communication and presentation skills. You can defend and sell a creative direction with clarity and confidence

Nice to Haves

• Experience in B2B tech, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, or a demonstrated ability to quickly internalize a technical domain and translate it visually

• Familiarity with experiential or event design (large-format, spatial, environmental)

• Experience working alongside or managing a creative production team

• Comfort with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools

Please review the job details below.

Lanteris Space is seeking a Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Configuration organization at our offices in Mountain View, California. This position may also be performed remotely within the U.S. The Mechanical Configuration organization is responsible for the spacecraft-level layout design. This top-level design of the spacecraft requires accommodating all the subsystems compatibly during all phases of the spacecraft mission. Our team converts the Systems Engineering book form specifications and block diagrams into 3D designs used to build the spacecraft on the assembly floor. We optimize layouts for system performance and other factors such as accessibility for assembly and test, optimal payload performance, mass properties, etc. The team documents the interfaces between major subsystems (for example: structures, antenna, and mechanisms) to ensure proper fit and alignments when the hardware comes to spacecraft integration. We are always looking at developing new ways to make Intuitive Machines satellites more competitive. The engineering support for a program starts as early as the proposal phase and continues through preparations for launch. The designs produced vary in complexity from component support bracketry to the spacecraft top assembly documentation.

Responsibilities:

• Acts as the Mechanical Design Engineer for the mechanical configuration department

• Generate engineering drawing and models with Creo and other design tools.

• Designs, document, and report on engineering progress on assigned projects

• Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or other engineering discipline. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree.

• 5 years of experience, including piece part and subassembly modeling in CREO or other CAD software and assembly drawing generation. A master's degree may account for two years of experience

title: Design and Creative Lead
description:
Position overview

PowerLines is a national nonprofit organization that aims to modernize the utility regulatory system for American energy consumers to lower utility bills and grow the economy. It focuses on state public utilities commissions (PUCs), which play a critical role in determining how much people pay for utility bills, how utilities invest in different types of energy, and where new energy projects are built. These 200 commissioners oversee more than $200 billion in utility spending each year and have significant influence over the future of our energy system.

Rising utility bills and electricity demand are quickly becoming a national economic and political issue. In the first half of 2025, utility rate increase requests from utilities totaled $29 billion, setting a record for any year and more than doubling the amount during the same period last year. Recognized on the 2025 “TIME100 Next” list, PowerLines is rapidly becoming a go-to source and leader in informing the national discussion of this issue and has already shaped the conversation in The New York Times here and here, Bloomberg, CBS News, Financial Times, TIME, Vox, The Daily Mail, Heatmap News, MIT Technology Review, Latitude Media, Yahoo News, and Canary Media.

PowerLines is seeking a full-time Design and Creative Lead to oversee the organization's visual identity and lead the development and production of design materials across print, digital, and web platforms, and help expand the PowerLines brand across new channels and formats. PowerLines is headquartered in Washington, DC. This is a three-month, term-limited contract role with the possibility to extend or convert to a full-time hire. This position can either be hybrid or remote. Candidates must be based in the United States. The Design and Creative Lead will report to the Director of Communications and Executive Director.

The Design and Creative Lead will be responsible for producing high-quality design work, maintaining and evolving PowerLines’ established visual identity, and managing the design process from initial request through final delivery. This person will serve as the primary point of contact for design across the organization, working closely with staff in communications, policy, and leadership to understand project needs, develop briefs, establish timelines, coordinate feedback, and keep projects moving. They will also manage routine website updates, ensuring PowerLines’ digital presence remains consistent with its brand. Beyond graphic design, they will provide art and creative direction across PowerLines’ multimedia, web, and event work and help grow PowerLines as a recognizable brand in its own right.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and Brand Implementation

• Lead the design and production of materials across PowerLines’ communications, including reports and publications, data visualizations, infographics, social media graphics, event materials, presentations, one-pagers, and web graphics.

• Apply PowerLines’ established visual identity and branding guidelines consistently across projects and platforms.

• Translate complex policy research, data, and technical information into clear and engaging visuals.

• Identify opportunities to thoughtfully evolve PowerLines’ visual identity as the organization and its communications needs grow.

title: Creative Director
description:
ABOUT STORD

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
About the Role

The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.

This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.

You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.
What You'll Do

Creative Vision & Brand Identity

• Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences

• Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators

• Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint

• Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning

Creative Studio Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers

• Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets

• Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company

• Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed

Campaigns & Content Creative

• Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media

• Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders

• Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it

• Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce

Brand Experience & Visibility

• Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements

• Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets

• Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels

What You'll Need

• 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services

• A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets

• Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state

• Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft

• Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players

• Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners

• Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it

• Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction

Leadership Competencies

•
Creative Vision: Turns complex positioning into simple, memorable ideas and visual systems that connect to commercial outcomes

•
Builder's DNA: Thrives in ambiguity; builds the processes, standards, and teams where none existed

•
Creative Rigor: Holds a high bar for quality while moving at the speed of a high-growth business; knows when to ship and when to push

•
Cross-Functional Influence: Earns trust with Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders; drives alignment without relying on authority

•
Coaching & Talent Development: Gives clear, constructive feedback and grows creative talent at every level

•
Customer Obsession: Uses voice-of-customer insight to inform creative decisions and keeps the DTC founder and ecommerce operator at the center of the work

•
UX Ownership: Brings deep understanding and empathy for the user experience and owns translating it into exceptional, engaging design

Education & Experience

• 10+ years of creative or marketing experience, including 4+ years leading creative direction in a high-growth B2B environment

• Experience managing and scaling an in-house creative or brand studio

• Demonstrated ability to deliver integrated campaigns that drive measurable business results

• Bachelor's degree in design, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Bonus: prior experience in ecommerce SaaS, logistics, or commerce-adjacent technology

title: Product Designer
description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

•
Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

•
Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

•
Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

•
Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

•
Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

•
Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

•
Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

•
Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

•
Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

•
Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

•
Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

•
Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products

Requirements

What You'll Bring:

•
Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

•
Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

•
Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

•
Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

•
Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

•
Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

•
Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

•
Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell

Visit and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team ().

SkyCell AG is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Design Lead - Systems
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Atlassian is used by teams around the world for everything from pizza deliveries to space travel. To help us achieve our mission of unleashing the potential of every team, the Atlassian Creative Team is looking for a Lead Designer to guide how our identity system evolves and scales across a growing portfolio and audience. We're looking for someone who pairs brand strategy and identity expertise with a deep understanding of how individual systems connect to create a brand. You'll be a hands-on player/coach who is actively on the tools and owning the quality of the work.

In this role, you'll

•
Shape and evolve the Atlassian brand system: its core elements, how it all scales, and the vision for where it goes next.

•
Lead brand systems projects from brief to delivery, directing designers, art directors, and copywriters and setting the creative bar for the work.

•
Be the main point of contact for leadership, clients, and agency partners. You'll align on goals, manage feedback, and keep projects moving.

•
Partner with other design teams across Atlassian so that our brand and product systems connect into one coherent experience for our customers.

•
Extend the brand into new territories, developing product and sub-brands alongside strategy, marketing, and product teams.

•
Turn the brand system into living, AI-ready guidance and tools that people and AI can both work from, so teams and partners can create on-brand work independently and quickly.

•
Shape how our team uses AI in brand work. Set the standard for where it belongs across concepting, production, and review, and protect quality as these tools become part of how work gets made.

On the first day, we'll expect you to have

•
8+ years of professional experience, with a portfolio of ambitious brand systems work and problem-solving at scale.

•
A track record of leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and directing other creatives toward a shared vision.

•
Deep expertise in the core elements of identity, including typography, color, layout, grid, hierarchy, iconography, and imagery. You bring a clear aesthetic point of view and an uncompromising eye for detail and quality.

•
Applied experience building and evolving design systems for brands, with a technical understanding of how they're implemented at scale. You know how type, color, and layout behave across print, web, product, and motion, and you can turn brand decisions into tokens, specs, and assets that teams and engineers can use.

•
Strong stakeholder and agency management skills. You build alignment, balance competing priorities, give clear creative direction, and earn the trust of leadership.

•
Fluency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and Keynote, and hands-on experience with AI tools for generation, workflow building, and automation.

•
A considered point of view on AI's role in brand and creative work. You've used it in real projects, you can judge generated work critically, and you can guide a team on where it helps without lowering the bar.

•
A collaborative mindset: you seek out feedback, mentor others, and believe the best work comes from productive debate.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Electrical Design Engineer II-III
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As a Design Engineer on Revamp’s PV BESS Electrical team, you help accelerate the clean energy transition by designing the electrical systems for utility-scale solar PV and battery energy storage projects, from early layouts through issued-for-construction drawings.

At the Engineer II level, you work on small projects or portions of larger ones while learning from and growing alongside senior staff. At the Engineer III level, you lead multiple projects, may serve as Engineer of Record, and mentor staff engineers.

Every design you deliver helps bring new clean generation and storage onto the grid, and adds to a body of work that has supported more than 10% of US utility-scale solar capacity since 2020. As an employee-owner, you share in the success your work creates and help shape a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and accountability. Candidates may be considered at either the Engineer II or Engineer III level depending on experience, technical depth, independence, and demonstrated ability to lead scope.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Across both levels, this role may include:

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

• Design electrical systems and components for utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects, producing plans, details, and calculations for each design phase.

• Prepare electrical design drawings, including one-line and three-line diagrams, electrical layouts, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, wiring diagrams, and grounding, trenching, and conduit details.

• Perform electrical design calculations, including conductor sizing, voltage drop, wire loss, and grounding, to support design decisions.

• Develop equipment specifications for PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, cable management systems, and balance-of-system (BOS) components.

• Evaluate, select, and apply standard design procedures and criteria, adapting methods for nonroutine aspects of assignments.

• Prepare project documentation, including calculation packages, design narratives, and issued-for-construction deliverables.

Project & Portfolio Execution

• Lead small projects or portions of larger projects through drawing and documentation delivery.

• Assign tasks to and coordinate work with discipline team members.

• Help determine schedule and budget requirements for electrical design tasks.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

• Ensure designs comply with the NEC, applicable IEEE, UL, and NFPA standards, utility requirements, and jurisdictional safety codes.

• Apply Revamp QA/QC procedures to your own work before submitting it for review.

Collaboration & Communication

• Coordinate with civil, structural, and power systems engineers to keep designs consistent and constructible.

• Work with clients, project managers, and subcontractors to understand expectations and resolve design comments.

• Present specific aspects of engineering assignments in project meetings.

Engineer III Expectations

• Lead multiple electrical design projects at once, managing discipline scope, schedule, and budget.

• Solve complex design problems independently, seeking guidance only on unconventional problems or conflicting criteria.

• Act as Engineer of Record on assigned projects when designated.

• Review deliverables prepared by staff engineers and designers for technical accuracy and adherence to Revamp standards.

• Mentor staff engineers and direct less experienced team members to complete assignments.

• Prepare scopes, budgets, and schedules for assignments and assist with proposals.

Additional Responsibilities

• Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.

• Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or similar applicable work experience.

• 2+ years of experience in electrical engineering design for Engineer II; 5+ years for Engineer III.

• Experience applying electrical codes and standards, including the NEC.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD.

• Ability to identify and solve complex design problems.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize work to meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

• Engineer in Training (EIT) certification; Professional Engineer (PE) license for Engineer III candidates.

• Renewable energy design experience on solar PV or BESS projects.

• Working knowledge of NEC Articles 690, 691, and 706 and applicable IEEE standards.

• Familiarity with PVsyst, Helioscope, ETAP, or similar design and analysis software.

• Experience with medium-voltage collection systems or substation interface design.

BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME POSITIONS

• Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program.

• Competitive compensation with bonus.

• Full benefits package offerings including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.

• Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.

• Monthly health and wellness stipend.

• Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

• Paid parental leave.

• 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.

• Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

ABOUT REVAMP

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the US since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit .

Employment with Revamp Engineering Inc. may be subject to background checks that are permitted by applicable law and relevant to the position. Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design
description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer - Substation Design (P.E. required) to lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage substations ranging from 34.5 kV through 345 kV and higher. This role will support our Owner's Engineering group, with a primary emphasis on physical substation design and the delivery of complete engineering packages from conceptual design through Approved for Construction (AFC). The ideal candidate will bring experience leading both greenfield and brownfield substation projects, with a strong understanding of physical design and exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C), as well as protection and control (P&C) design.

Our projects include utility-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), wind and hybrid collector substations, point-of-interconnection switching stations, and large-load interconnections supporting data centers and industrial customers across ERCOT and other U.S. markets. As a technical lead, you will guide engineers and designers, review and verify engineering deliverables, and collaborate directly with clients, transmission owners, and EPC contractors to deliver high-quality substation solutions.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

•
Lead design from concept to IFC: Own the technical scope, quality and schedule of substation design packages through conceptual, 30%, 60%, 90% and IFC milestones.

•
Physical design: Develop and check general arrangements, plan and section drawings, electrical clearances and phase spacing, rigid and strain bus design, equipment and structure layouts, ground grid design (IEEE 80), lightning shielding (IEEE 998), raceway (conduit, cable trench, duct bank), lighting and bills of material.

•
P&C design: Develop and check one-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC schematics, wiring diagrams, relay and control panel layouts, and cable schedules. Apply protection schemes for lines, transformers, buses, breakers and capacitor banks, including line current differential, distance, transformer and bus differential, breaker failure, and communication-assisted tripping (POTT, DTT).

•
Brownfield expansions: Lead field verification and reviews of existing conditions, integrate new bays, line terminals and P&C into energized substations, and develop outage, cutover and construction sequencing with the utility.

•
Utility and market interface: Apply transmission owner design standards and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO and other ISOs/RTOs), and support coordination on metering, telemetry and SCADA/communications.

•
Equipment and vendors: Write technical specifications and evaluate vendor proposals and drawings for power transformers, circuit breakers, switches, instrument transformers, relay panels, control enclosures, station service and DC systems.

•
Design reviews: Review EPC and third-party substation and collection system design packages, and provide clear, actionable comments to clients, both on EPE design projects and on owner's engineering assignments.

•
Proposals and estimating: Support scope development, engineering hour estimates and conceptual cost estimates for new work.

•
Mentoring and QA/QC: Mentor engineers and designers, check their work, and uphold EPE quality standards. Seal drawings as engineer of record where licensed.

•
Coordination and construction support: Coordinate with civil/structural, transmission line, system studies and communications/SCADA teams. Submit and respond to RFIs, and support construction and commissioning.

•
Deliver assigned projects on time while meeting project quality and budget objectives.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

•
Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with a minimum of six years of high-voltage and MV substation design experience with a utility, consulting firm or EPC.

•
Professional Engineer (PE) license (required).

•
Proven experience delivering complete substation design packages from conceptual to IFC, covering both physical and P&C design, at voltages from 34.5 kV to 345 kV or higher.

•
Experience with both greenfield substations and brownfield modifications to existing, energized facilities.

•
Working knowledge of NESC, NFPA, IEEE and utility/transmission owner design standards, and of how NERC requirements apply to substation design.

•
Solid understanding of protection philosophy and protective relays (SEL, GE, Siemens or similar), plus substation communications, SCADA/RTU and revenue metering.

•
Experience with AutoCAD and grounding analysis software (CDEGS, WinIGS or similar).

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

title: Head of Product Design
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower veterinary professionals with opportunities to achieve greater flexibility in their careers while helping animal hospitals provide care for more pets in their communities.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the leading veterinary staffing and careers platform, connecting Vets, Techs, and Veterinary Assistants with practices for relief support, full-time hiring, and free continuing education. Roo empowers the largest network of over 30,000 veterinary professionals to earn and learn on their schedule, helping Veterinarians earn over $400 million. Together, we’ve provided more than 5 million hours of coverage at over 10,000 animal hospitals.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design to lead our product design team and raise the craft bar across every Roo surface.

This role sits within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

Given Roo’s size and fast-paced environment, leading the design team at Roo will require you to be a player-coach. This means you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support mid and staff-level designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. You’ll make it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.

• Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear

• Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.

• Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.

• Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.

• Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

• Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.

• Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of product design experience with 4+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support staff-level designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user-centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces and turn loose ideas into compelling product concepts.

• Strong cross functional communication skills and experience working closely with cross-functional leadership

• Experience with a variety of user research methods. You know how to get answers from users yourself and help your designers do the same.

• Excitement about shaping the future of the industry by designing experiences that support meaningful work.

• Experience leading design across multiple products or surfaces. Two-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

Located in the US:
For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

• Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.

• Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.

title: Creative Director
description:
Seed Health is a microbiome science company pioneering clinically validated innovations for gut and whole-body health.Our portfolio of gut-directed products is developed in collaboration with leading scientists and backed by human clinical research. We’re best known for DS-01® Daily Synbiotic—the #1 digestive health probiotic in the U.S.—trusted by millions of people for its benefits in and beyond the gut, including skin, immune, and heart health.

We’ve since expanded our offerings to include PDS-08® for pediatric health, VS-01™ for vaginal health, and a new category of Co-Biotics for daily nutrition, energy, and sleep—each grounded in our commitment to scientific rigor, precision formulation, and impact across the body’s interconnected systems. Beyond the body, SeedLabs—our environmental research division—advances microbial solutions that restore biodiversity and support ecosystems affected by human activity.

We’ve built a profitable DTC business with category-leading retention, grown revenue 5x in the last 36 months, and expanded our reach across new channels and markets. With a robust clinical pipeline and continued expansion into new areas of microbiome health, we’re building for scale—with integrity, care, and curiosity.

Our work has been recognized by Fast Company (Most Innovative Companies, Brands That Matter, World Changing Ideas), TIME (Best Inventions), Forbes (America’s Best Startup Employers), and Inc. (Best in Business, Female Founder 100)—a reflection of the science behind our products and the stories we tell to bring them into the world.

We’re a galaxy-class team of researchers, clinicians, designers, engineers, storytellers, and builders—each aligned in our belief in the transformative potential of the microbiome. If you’re a kindred dot-connector looking to shape the future of health, join us.

• • •

You

You’re a creative leader. You can see the tiniest seed of an idea and help a creative team nurture it into existence. Your feedback is considered, clear and actionable. You put a premium on the most thoughtful and guiding notes - tuning your approach to meet the needs of the creative team. You are a champion of a diverse team, helping them make the best work possible by actively listening, communicating and removing any blockers that emerge along the way. When we say TED meets Vox meets The Hustle meets Carl Sagan meets VICE, you know what we mean. You are curious. You could wake up every day with the mission to make science accessible and cool (while also fully understanding the importance of integrity and the nuance of precision). You’re a writer by trade. You’ve told a lot of stories, written a lot of taglines, scripts, captions, and subject lines. You’re ready for something that satisfies and expands and piques your intellect, your interpersonal talents, and of course, your microbiome.

This is a leadership role reporting to the SVP, Creative. And an opportunity to do amazing work alongside a wonderful assemblage of talented and kind human beings.

What You’ll Do:

• Create Big Ideas: You’ll be a catalyst for big thinking. Sometimes leading with creative foundations. Sometimes rolling up your sleeves and getting in there.

• Lead: You’ll mentor and guide your creative team to their best work. And put a premium on their growth and development.

• The Brand: You’ll be a guardian of the brand’s creative standards - tone, voice, look, feel, vibe. Striving for consistency and awesomeness across touchpoints.

• Collaborate: You’ll serve as a cross-functional partner working directly with Organic, Growth, Product, Product Marketing, etc. You’ll operate across channels.

• Multi-Channel: Oversee advertising and design projects in all its forms. You’ll have a key role in our social channels.

• Standard Operating Procedure: Good to each other. Hard on the work.

Who You Are:

• Experience: Ten-plus years experience - either agency or brand-side - with a portfolio that’s filled with original thinking, immaculate craft and audacious swings.

• Skills: You’re an excellent writer. A writer’s writer. Big on craft, a conscientious editor, a headline machine. You have range - able to go long when necessary.

• The People: You operate from a place of empathy. You’re generous with your time. You’re deeply invested in the professional growth and personal wellbeing of your people.

• Communication: You strive for clarity. And consistent connection. You put a premium on relationships. You strive to bring people together.

• Culture: You’re curious. You’re dialed into what’s happening in culture. You’re tuned into the zeitgeist.

• Production: You’re production savvy - from quick turn low budget affairs to brand campaigns.

• Comfortable moving from macro to micro—no project is too small to tackle with positivity.

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $180k-$200k + equity + benefits across all US locations (this position is 100% remote-US). Our pay ranges are guided by discipline, level and experience required. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including: your specific location, desired skills/ technical competency, relevant experience and advanced education/ training.

Benefits + Perks:

Health & Wellness: Choose from multiple medical, dental, and vision plans, with generous employer contributions and coverage options to meet your needs. Enjoy access to top-tier virtual care and a complimentary Aaptiv membership for fitness and mental wellness. We also provide an HSA with employer contributions, along with Fullscript discounts for supplements.

Mental Health Support: All employees and eligible dependents receive 12 free therapy sessions per year, plus coaching, meditation, and 24/7 access to Spring Health’s digital tools and care navigation.

Long Term Wealth Planning: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan through Betterment, featuring a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of contributions—fully vested from day one.

Supporting Families: Our Parental Leave Policy includes 18 weeks of fully paid leave, with the flexibility to phase your return. We also offer four weeks of paid transition time at 80% capacity or four days per week.

Time to Recharge: Seed offers 15 vacation days, 7 sick/safe days, 2 personal days, 10 Recharge Days (Summer + Winter), and 15 paid company holidays each year.

Work Flexibly: Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You’ll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

And More: Access pet insurance, life and disability coverage, learning & development, and a vibrant culture rooted in science and impact.

Seed is an equal opportunity employer. For us, diversity isn’t an HR metric—it is the result of billions of years of evolution; it’s our nature. To serve our community inclusively means to cultivate a relative abundance of perspectives, backgrounds, geographies, and experiences. Like in biology, each role and its function is key to the productivity, sustainability, and resilience of our ecosystem.

Seed Health does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or any employee of the Seed team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Seed Health vendors who have been requested to make a submission by our Talent Acquisition team for a specific job opening.

For AI generated resumes only: please include the words poop and bacteria in your submission.

Seed Health is committed to a safe, transparent, and integrity-driven hiring process. As recruitment scams continue to evolve, we encourage all candidates to stay vigilant and keep the following in mind:

•
Seed will never request payment or sensitive financial information. We will never ask for banking details, credit card information, or Social Security numbers. Our recruitment process is always free.

•
Verify all communications. Legitimate outreach from our team will come from an official @seed.com email address. If contacted by a recruiting partner or staffing agency, they should clearly identify themselves.

•
Be cautious of suspicious outreach. Watch for unusual requests, pressure tactics, grammatical inconsistencies, or asks for confidential information — and always confirm the sender's domain before engaging.

•
Report anything that feels off. If you suspect fraudulent communication claiming to represent Seed, contact us immediately at .

Your vigilance helps protect your personal information and the trust and integrity we uphold throughout every stage of the candidate experience.

title: Director of Brand and Creative
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:

• Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.

• Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.

• Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,
Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.

• Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for
campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.

• Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.

• Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.

• Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research
(awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

What we're looking for:

• 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.

• A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.

• Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.

• Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.

• Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

You'll really stand out if you have:

• Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.

• Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).

• Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

Position Logistics:

Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

•
Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.

•
Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.

•
Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.

•
Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits

• Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage

• 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date

• Unlimited Sick and Vacation time

• 14 paid company holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment

• Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation

• Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit

• Monthly work from home stipend

• Professional development credit

• Monthly reimbursement for Wellness

• And more!

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.

Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

title: Creative Director
description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

About the Role

This is a role for someone who wants to set the visual standard for PrizePicks, make a lot of the work with their own hands, and build a team of supervillains while they do it.

PrizePicks is a skill-based Daily Fantasy sports platform where fans make Picks and build Entries. The Creative Collective is the small, high-conviction team that decides how the brand looks, sounds, and shows up. The talent is some of the best and hungriest we've worked with. The work is fun, the team is fun, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. We take the work very seriously.

As Creative Director, you're the visual authority for the brand. You set the direction for campaigns across OOH, TVC, social, and in-app messaging, and you shape how the brand evolves from sport to sport and year to year. You lead Design, Copy, and Creative Ops, and you're still in the files: designing OOH, end cards, and phone screens for TV, and steering key visuals alongside your designers.

This is a player-coach seat. Expect to spend roughly 60 to 70 percent of your week making and directing the work, and the rest leading the team and representing Creative in the room. You're also the first gate. Nothing reaches the Head of Brand & Creative until you've pushed it, sharpened it, or killed it.

The team has the talent. It needs more firepower. The impact you have on this business will set us apart from the competition.

How We Work

Lead with conviction: Be Iverson

Bring work you believe in and have a strong POV. Authenticity matters more than the idea itself. If the idea could live with another brand's logo on it, it doesn't belong here. We'd rather refine a bold idea than try to save a safe one.

Sharpen each other: Be Pharrell

Value direct feedback and be comfortable in conflict. Debate makes the work better. Once a call is made, we move together. Mediocre work is a collective failure, not an individual one.

Execute under pressure: Be Jordan

The standard does not change when the moment does. We move with precision and continually refine our judgment. Practice or clutch time, you show up with the same intensity.

Show up fully: Be Virgil

Show up wherever you are needed, whenever you are needed, without hesitation. Not for credit, for the outcome. It's not about doing everything. It's about doing what's required to make it right.

What You'll Do

Set the visual direction

• Own the visual direction for campaigns across OOH, TVC, social, and in-app messaging

• Define how the brand flexes across sports and evolves year over year while staying unmistakably PrizePicks

• Build and present visual identity and direction decks to the broader Marketing org as visuals are finalized

• Bring a way of thinking about our creative process and brand that we're not even considering yet, and push PrizePicks to be the standard for creative and branding in this space

Make the work

• Design hands-on: OOH, TV End Cards & Creative, campaign key visuals, in-app messages, and whatever the moment calls for

• Art direct motion and video, and add motion treatments yourself when they elevate the work

• Hold craft high at volume across every format and platform

Lead the team

• Manage Design, Copy, and Creative Ops.

• Own performance reviews, hiring decisions, and career growth for your team

• Learn each person's strengths and gaps, and put them where they do their best work

• Act as the first gate for creative: push it, sharpen it, or kill it before it goes to key stakeholders.

• Have the ability to recommend when additional resources are needed beyond the teams capacity with strong business cases.

• Run creative reviews with direct, useful feedback, and make sure the team moves together

Partner across the business

• Be the face of Marketing & Brand Creative beyond just marketing.

• Present finalized creative and visual direction to the wider org, and explain why the work works

• Partner with Legal to make great work inside compliance guardrails

• Keep the work culturally connected, from the TVC down to organic social

Who You Are

• A maker first. You want to be in the files, and you lead by raising the bar on the work itself

• Opinionated with taste. You can say why something is right, and you can kill what isn't

• Culturally fluent. You know the difference between participating in culture and chasing it, and your ideas start from real insight, not trends

• Hungry, fast, and efficient. Volume doesn't scare you

• A builder of people. You grow talent, set a high standard, and give feedback that makes the work and the person better

• More than a designer focused on craft. You're constantly looking for ways to break through & grow teams

• Low ego, high standards. If a teammate's idea beats yours, you back it

Qualifications

• A portfolio of strong work across sports and entertainment. We care about the work more than the years, and Daily Fantasy or adjacent industry experience is not required

• Experience leading and growing a creative team

• Figma and Adobe Creative Suite are mandatory

• Hands-on craft across OOH, TV and video, social, and digital or in-app

• Strong concepting instincts

• Experience presenting creative direction to cross-functional partners and senior leaders

• Comfort creating great work within legal and compliance guardrails

• Hungry, fast, and efficient

• A passion for sports, hip-hop, and/or culture

Bonus Points

• Motion design experience (a major plus)

• AI in your workflow in some way, shape, or form

• Experience on athlete, talent, or creator campaigns and shoots

• Experience building or evolving a brand system across multiple categories or properties

What to Expect

We work incredibly hard, and we care a lot about how PrizePicks is perceived in the world. To keep it a buck, that might mean some long days, sometimes nights, and rare weekends to make sure we stay ahead of the game.

What Success Looks Like

In six months, your impact is already visible. The team under you is growing and taking on bigger things, and you're bringing a different level of thinking to our creative process and branding.

In twelve months, you have full control of the creative team. You know each person's strengths and gaps, and you know how to push the team to its full potential. You have a solid understanding of the brand and how to present culturally connected ideas, not only at the TVC level but across every channel we impact. You will have made sure that PrizePicks is the standard when it comes to creative and branding in this space.

Location

• While we prefer candidates based in New York City or Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $160,000 to $200,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.
