title: Senior UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience
description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience to lead research that helps Bask Health better understand the needs, behaviors, and challenges of patients and healthcare providers using our platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient onboarding, digital questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

These experiences involve different types of users with different goals. Patients need to navigate digital healthcare experiences clearly and confidently, while providers need efficient, reliable workflows that support their responsibilities.

As a Senior UX Researcher, you'll help us understand how these users interact with the platform, where they experience friction, and what opportunities exist to improve the product.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role that combines qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and product strategy. You'll own research projects from defining questions and selecting methodologies through participant recruitment, study execution, analysis, and communication of findings.

Your work will focus on patient and provider experiences, including onboarding, intake questionnaires, clinical workflow interfaces, patient communications, and other interactions that influence usability and operational efficiency.

You'll conduct interviews, usability studies, concept testing, surveys, and observational research to understand user needs and evaluate existing or proposed product experiences.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, content designers, and operational stakeholders to ensure research addresses meaningful product questions and informs decisions throughout development.

You'll also help connect qualitative findings with available product analytics and operational data, giving teams a clearer understanding of both what users do and why they do it.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, research must be conducted with appropriate attention to privacy, informed participation, sensitive information, and the boundaries of approved clinical workflows.

You'll help establish repeatable research practices, maintain organized findings, and make insights accessible to teams across the company.

We're looking for a researcher who is comfortable navigating complex product environments, can independently lead studies, and knows how to turn user evidence into practical recommendations that improve real experiences.

What You'll Do

• Lead end-to-end UX research for patient-facing and provider-facing experiences across Bask Health.

• Develop research plans that address product questions, user needs, and business objectives.

• Conduct qualitative interviews with patients, providers, and other authorized research participants.

• Plan and execute moderated and unmoderated usability studies.

• Evaluate patient onboarding, intake questionnaires, and multi-step digital workflows.

• Research provider experiences involving clinical and administrative platform tools.

• Conduct concept testing to evaluate proposed product features and interaction patterns.

• Develop surveys and structured feedback methods to understand user needs.

• Use observational research to identify workflow inefficiencies and usability problems.

• Analyze qualitative findings to identify patterns, motivations, and unmet needs.

• Incorporate quantitative product data where appropriate to strengthen research conclusions.

• Develop research questions, hypotheses, and study objectives in collaboration with product teams.

• Recruit and screen appropriate research participants using approved processes.

• Create interview guides, usability tasks, and research discussion materials.

• Evaluate navigation, terminology, comprehension, and task completion across digital experiences.

• Identify sources of confusion, unnecessary friction, and workflow abandonment.

• Research how patients understand instructions, status updates, and next steps.

• Study how providers interact with platform tools during approved operational workflows.

• Develop journey maps, research summaries, and evidence-based opportunity assessments.

• Present findings and recommendations to product managers, designers, engineers, and leadership.

• Collaborate with product designers to validate concepts and improve proposed solutions.

• Work with content designers to evaluate language comprehension and information clarity.

• Partner with product managers to prioritize research opportunities.

• Support iterative testing throughout product development and after feature launches.

• Help establish research standards, documentation practices, and reusable study templates.

• Maintain organized research findings and make insights accessible to relevant teams.

• Ensure research activities respect participant privacy, consent, and appropriate data-handling requirements.

• Independently own complex research initiatives from planning through synthesis and actionable recommendations.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional experience in UX research, user research, product research, human-computer interaction, or a closely related field.

• Experience independently leading end-to-end research projects for digital products.

• Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating research methodology, findings, and product impact.

• Strong understanding of qualitative research methods.

• Experience conducting moderated user interviews and usability testing.

• Familiarity with quantitative research methods and survey design.

• Ability to select appropriate research methods based on product questions.

• Experience developing research plans, hypotheses, and study objectives.

• Experience recruiting and screening research participants.

• Strong understanding of research ethics and participant consent.

• Experience synthesizing qualitative findings into actionable insights.

• Ability to identify behavioral patterns, usability problems, and unmet user needs.

• Familiarity with user-centered design and product development processes.

• Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.

• Ability to communicate research findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

• Experience presenting evidence-based recommendations to product teams.

• Familiarity with usability metrics and task-based evaluation.

• Experience working with surveys, interviews, and observational research.

• Ability to evaluate complex workflows and multi-step user journeys.

• Understanding of information architecture and interaction design principles.

• Experience organizing and documenting research findings.

• Ability to balance research rigor with practical product development timelines.

• Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to independently manage multiple research priorities and deliver meaningful results.

Nice to Have

• Experience conducting UX research for healthcare or telehealth products.

• Familiarity with patient-facing digital healthcare experiences.

• Experience researching provider workflows or clinical software.

• Understanding of digital patient intake and onboarding processes.

• Experience conducting research involving sensitive or personal information.

• Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare-related privacy considerations.

• Experience working with clinicians, pharmacists, or healthcare operations stakeholders.

• Experience working with multi-tenant or white-label SaaS platforms.

• Experience evaluating AI-assisted healthcare product experiences.

• Experience developing scalable research operations and insight repositories.

•

•
You will coordinate closely with mechanical, controls, and architectural teams to ensure the electrical systems are fully integrated into the broader design framework.

•
You will mentor and support junior engineers, reinforcing consistent design practices and ensuring knowledge continuity across the team.

•
You will help capture lessons learned and apply them to improve future design processes, standards, and project outcomes.

•
You will support construction activities in the field, resolving installation issues, conducting walkthroughs, and ensuring a successful handoff to operations.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Engineering with electrical building systems emphasis.

•
Proficiency in power distribution and lighting design, including controls implementation.

Experience with short circuit analysis and utilization of analytical modeling software such as SKM or similar tools.

Strong background in the design, construction, and commissioning of medium and low voltage electrical distribution systems, and power management or SCADA tools.

Experience in mission-critical facilities and their electrical/mechanical infrastructure.

Knowledge and experience in estimating, electrical design, operation, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, and power monitoring.

Comprehensive understanding of professional services from conceptual design through project close-out.

title: Creative Director, Brand Experience
description:
About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in the US and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada or the US.

About the team

The Creative Director, Brand Experience is responsible for defining and advancing how the Kinaxis brand is expressed across campaigns, digital experiences, events, film, motion, social media, presentations and emerging channels. The role provides strategic creative direction, leads multidisciplinary creative talent and ensures that brand experiences are distinctive, consistent and aligned with business priorities.

title: Civil Underground Utility Design Engineer
description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated Civil Underground Utility Design Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and implementation of underground utility infrastructure projects. This role is primarily a civil engineering position focused on underground pathway design, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, and associated civil infrastructure.

The successful candidate will have practical experience developing buildable underground utility designs for electric, water, wastewater, telecommunications, or other buried infrastructure systems. Telecommunications experience is helpful but not required. The strongest fit is a civil design professional with hands-on experience creating underground pathway layouts, reviewing plan-and-profile drawings, coordinating utility conflicts, and supporting permitting and construction delivery.

This is a fully remote position requiring collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility owners, permitting agencies, municipalities, transportation agencies, and construction personnel across multiple geographic regions.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Underground Utility Infrastructure Design

• Develop and review civil engineering designs for underground utility systems and utility corridor projects. Design underground pathways, duct banks, trenches, utility crossings, access structures, conduit systems, and related civil infrastructure.

• Evaluate utility routes and develop buildable alignments for greenfield and brownfield projects.

• Incorporate utility conflicts, right-of-way constraints, environmental considerations, agency requirements, and permitting conditions into design solutions.

• Prepare construction drawings, plan-and-profile sheets, details, specifications, exhibits, and permit packages.

• Support utility relocation planning, pathway optimization, and coordination between proposed and existing infrastructure.

Civil 3D Design and Engineering

• Modeling Use Autodesk Civil 3D to develop and review alignments, profiles, surfaces, corridors, grading, utility layouts, and civil design models.

• Generate and validate plan-and-profile drawings, utility exhibits, quantity takeoffs, design calculations, and project deliverables.

• Analyze conflicts between proposed underground utility pathways and existing subsurface or above-ground infrastructure.

• Integrate survey data, GIS information, LiDAR, utility records, as-builts, and field information into engineering models.

• Support digital engineering workflows and model-based delivery practices.

Engineering Review and Quality Assurance

• Perform technical reviews of civil utility design packages and engineering deliverables.

• Verify compliance with client standards, utility owner requirements, agency criteria, and industry best practices.

• Review depth of cover, utility separations, crossings, access spacing, corridor configurations, constructability, and maintainability.

• Identify design risks, utility conflicts, constructability issues, and deficiencies, and provide clear recommendations for resolution.

• Support quality management reviews and continuous improvement of design delivery standards.

Utility Coordination and Permitting

• Coordinate with utility owners, municipalities, transportation agencies, permitting authorities, and project stakeholders.

• Support utility conflict resolution, utility relocation planning, and agency coordination throughout design and construction.

• Assist with permit applications, design exhibits, agency comments, and regulatory review responses. Participate in design review meetings, utility coordination meetings, and constructability workshops.

Construction and Implementation

• Support Provide engineering support during construction and implementation activities.

• Review contractor RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and change requests.

• Evaluate field conditions and recommend practical civil engineering solutions.

• Support as-built documentation, redline review, and project closeout activities.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline plus 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

• Experience with Autodesk Civil 3D is required.

• Experience developing civil engineering plans or underground utility designs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.

• Experience designing underground utility pathways, utility corridors, duct banks, utility crossings, utility relocations, or buried infrastructure systems.

• Background in civil infrastructure, electric distribution, water/wastewater utilities, municipal utilities, transportation utilities, telecommunications, or other utility design environments.

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D, AutoCAD, ArcGIS, Bluebeam Revu, Bentley OpenRoads, or similar engineering platforms.

• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, survey data, utility records, and construction documents.

• Working knowledge of utility coordination, right-of-way requirements, permitting processes, and agency review procedures.

• Experience performing utility conflict analysis, subsurface utility coordination, constructability reviews, quantity takeoffs, and cost estimating.

• Familiarity with DOT requirements, utility accommodation policies, municipal design standards, and common underground utility design practices.

• Experience supporting transportation, municipal, utility, industrial, energy, data center, broadband, or large infrastructure projects.

• Telecommunications or fiber optic OSP design experience.

• Sponsorship is not available for this role now or in the future.

• Relocation is not available for this role.

Life insurance has looked and sounded the same for over a hundred years. We’re here to change that.

This role has one core mandate: Make our UGC ads feel real, native, and impossible to scroll past. You’ll lead concepting, shape how ads look, and be part of a dedicated and highly resourced team to bring ideas to life.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Own the look of our UGC ads, dialing in native, authentic production quality, platform fit, and the shot-by-shot choices that boost engagement and performance

• Develop a deep understanding of how our audiences behave on each platform, turning those insights into trends and inspiration that fuel new concepts

• Stay deeply in tune with what’s working across our paid social creative, using performance data to continuously iterate and improve

• Lead concepting for new UGC ads across TikTok, Meta, and YouTube, creating platform-specific concepts grounded in channel aesthetics, trends, and insights

title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
WHAT WE DO

Nitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless. Since launching Riskalyze in 2011, we've been on a mission to create what we call Catalyst Moments — those powerful instances when an advisor leads a client from confused and fearful to confident and fearless.

Nitrogen is a connected suite of advisor products designed to showcase the value of advice in every client meeting. Combining agentic AI with Risk Alignment, Insurance Alignment, Investment Research, Income Planning, Tax Intelligence, and Legacy Planning, with trusted, deterministic analytics to turn complex financial insights into persuasive visuals. The result: clearer conversations, stronger relationships, and advisors who can prove their value in every client meeting.

Trusted by tens of thousands of advisors, backed by an industry-leading Net Promoter Score of 71, and the first wealthtech company to earn ISO 42001 certification, Nitrogen is built on fifteen years of advisor data and half a trillion dollars in assets on platform. We invented the Risk Number®, built on a Nobel Prize-winning academic framework, and we champion the Fearless Investing Movement — because a world empowered to invest fearlessly starts with empowered advisors.

WHY DESIGN MATTERS AT NITROGEN

The last mile of financial advice isn't more data; it's clarity. It's the moment someone goes from confused to fearless. At Nitrogen, we help financial advisors showcase the value of advice in every client interaction. A lot of that comes down to great design. An advisor can have powerful analytics, but if their client can't understand what it means for their future, it doesn't really help them. Our job is to make that part clear, so clients walk away feeling confident.

Three principles guide how we design and build at Nitrogen:

•
AI does the work. Nucleus™, our AI engine, doesn't just summarize or make suggestions. It takes action for advisors. You'll help design how that works, so advisors understand what it's doing, when it needs their input, and how to stay in control.

•
Connected intelligence makes the work right. Our analytics are grounded in proven methodology, not AI-generated math, and our products are designed to work better together. You'll help create the shared patterns and connected experiences that make the whole suite feel cohesive.

•
Persuasive visuals make the client feel it. You'll turn complex financial data into visuals that help clients understand where they stand, see the value of advice, and feel confident about what's next.

THE ROLE

This is a chance to help shape what AI-native financial advice looks like. You'll have a real voice in product decisions, room to experiment with new ways of working, and the opportunity to set a high bar for design in a complex product that advisors rely on every day. Our advisors love Nitrogen, and it shows in our Net Promoter Score of 71.

We're a small design team with a well-structured process that moves fast. Every designer owns real parts of the product from start to finish. As Nitrogen’s Senior Product Designer, Design Systems, you'll own the system libraries that our product and brand teams rely on. But this opportunity is more than maintaining a component library. It's about making it possible for anyone at Nitrogen (designers, engineers, marketers and agents) to build experiences that look, feel and work like Nitrogen, without the design team driving every change. How we build software is changing. More people can create than ever before. That makes design judgment more important, not less. AI agents build from the system every day, so it has to be clear enough for a person and structured enough for AI tools to build from accurately. It also keeps what an advisor sees in the app and what a prospect sees from our marketing team feeling like one cohesive experience.

You don't need an extensive background in wealth management to be a great fit. Most of us didn't either when we started. We have insurance experts, CFPs, and people who've built advisor tools for over a decade on the team, and they'll help get you up to speed fast. What matters more is your curiosity, your ability to make complex ideas clear, high standards for your own work, and your drive to make a real impact.

We're a fully remote team spanning Poland to California, and we welcome applicants across time zones in the US. Our core collaboration hours are Monday through Friday, 10am to 2pm ET, and you'll need to be reliably available during that time to collaborate with teammates, including our engineers in Poland. Some of our most valuable work happens during these overlapping hours, when we can work through problems, make decisions, and move ideas forward together quickly in real time. You won't be in meetings the entire time, but we do expect you to be available to collaborate during that window. Outside those hours, you have the flexibility to manage your own focused design time. We trust you to work with strong accountability, autonomy, and a commitment to delivering results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Elevate Nitrogen's visual and interaction design. Raise the bar for typography, hierarchy, density, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility and the states beyond the happy path.

•
Own the product design system. Build components, tokens, patterns and documentation, kept in sync with code alongside our engineers. Decide what to preserve, evolve, simplify or replace based on what builders and customers need.

•
Make great design reproducible. Encode what makes Nitrogen's product and brand assets great, so people and agents can produce coherent, usable, on-brand experiences by default.

•
Make the system easier for AI to build from. You'll work with engineers to structure components and tokens, write the documentation and context files, and connect tools like Code Connect and Storybook MCP so AI dev agents build our UI accurately. You'll measure it with benchmarks and UI quality trends.

•
Reimagine what a design system can be. Expand the system beyond components and tokens into composition, interaction patterns, agent guidance and evaluations.

•
Shape the shared AI patterns for Nucleus: how it shows progress, keeps the advisor in control, handles uncertainty, mistakes and partial failures, asks for permission and hands work back to a person.

•
Own our brand libraries. Build templates that let marketers create on-brand social posts, emails, one-pagers and case studies on their own.

•
Enhance the client experience. Turn dense client-facing deliverables like reports into something a client understands and trusts, in a way that holds up under any advisor's brand and colors.

•
Prototype early and often. AI prototyping is a core part of how we work. We use Figma, v0, Claude and Devin every day. You'll run system-quality checks in design reviews and do last-mile polish in code when that's the fastest path.

Requirements

•
Exceptional visual and interaction design skills. Your work shows attention to detail and an ability to make complex experiences feel simple. You have sharp taste and strong opinions about typography, hierarchy, interaction and motion.

•
Design system ownership. Deep systems thinking and experience building systems that others actually adopt. You can show how your work improved both their speed and the quality of what shipped.

•
Active use of AI in your design workflow. You're deeply curious about AI and already using it to change how you work. You prototype with it as a habit, and a static mockup is no longer your main artifact. You understand where AI helps, where it fails and how to improve its output.

•
Systems built for people and AI. You know how to structure tokens, name components and write documentation so AI tools can use them. You've turned design principles into practical guidance, reusable patterns and quality checks that work at scale.

•
Client-facing design experience. You've designed things that end up in front of a non-expert, like reports, proposals, statements or onboarding, and made complex information feel simple and on brand.

•
Curiosity and a bias toward learning. You can get your head around an unfamiliar domain quickly, identify what you need to learn, and use research, experimentation, and real feedback to guide your next move.

•
Conviction and humility. You're willing to ask hard questions, experiment, and advocate for what you believe is right. You're just as willing to listen, take feedback, and change your mind when you learn something new.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience designing and shipping agentic AI features, with patterns reused across more than one product or team.

• Experience with a multi-brand system where one set of components carries many brands, or with connecting product and brand experiences.

• Experience with a major redesign, a design system modernization or a company-wide change in how teams build.

• Experience designing investing, finance, or insurance products. You’re the one who's always tinkering with the newest AI tool on the weekend or the friend people ask about their 401(k).

The expected compensation range for this role is a $140k-$150k + annual bonus target.

Lesser experience may result in lower compensation and greater experience may result in greater compensation than the stated range.

Nitrogen is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We are committed to being fair and intentional in our hiring decisions by reviewing every application thoroughly.

Benefits

Financial Benefits & Perks

• 4% 401(k) Match. Our employees invest so much in our company and we love getting to invest in them. The company will match your contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to 4% of your total annual compensation.

• Free Financial Planning Services. By working at a financial technology company, you get the benefit of fantastic financial advice. This is offered to all employees wanting expert guidance on how to handle their money.

Health & Family

• Medical, Dental & Vision insurance plans. We want to help keep you (and your family) healthy! Comprehensive health insurance options for you & your family.

• Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) available depending on chosen medical plan. We know that investment risk isn’t a one-size-fits all and neither are your health savings options!

• Generous maternity & paternity leave for either the birth or adoption of a child. Mom's & Dad's need time with their new family members!

• Discounted pet insurance available. Pets are family too!!

Time Away & Culture

• 3 weeks vacation & 1 week sick time per year.Take the time you need for fun or simply time to recover from not feeling well.

• 11 paid company holidays per year. Enjoy your time off; you deserve it!

• Remote & in-person team building activities help our employees stay connected and engaged. We absolutely love to hype our people up!

• Company wide meetings held by our CEO benefit all employees by keeping everyone in the loop. We are one team, and we tackle projects together.

• Employee development is our priority. From leadership training, to mentorship, to industry resources, we care about progressing you in your career.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

title: Senior Art Director
description:
Who We Are

Construct is a B2B digital agency focused on delivering measurable outcomes for our clients. We've intentionally designed an agency where expertise becomes systems, AI strengthens delivery, and people do meaningful work. Our team values strategic thinking, continuous improvement, and sustainable pace.

We're looking for people who care about outcomes, want to grow their capabilities, and take pride in building something better than the industry standard.

Construct is looking for a Senior Art Director to lead concepting and art direction for our Philippines team. We don't need a specialist: we want a creative all-rounder who can design a visual identity on Monday, crack a big campaign idea on Wednesday and art direct a digital experience on Friday, on any account we run. Guided by our B2Human approach, you'll work with content strategists, brand planners, digital marketers and creative technologists, for clients in Finance, Professional Services, B2B Tech, Education, Government and Non-Profit across Asia-Pacific. Every job starts with a strong idea, AI gives you more options to explore, and your taste decides which one is right.

Responsibilities

You will:

• Lead concepting and art direction across brand identity, integrated campaigns, social, websites, display and film

• Use AI across the whole process: research and mood, idea exploration, quick prototypes, image and video generation, motion, and resizing and versioning at scale

• Build workflows that make our creative faster and better, then share them with the team

• Stay hands-on from concept to final delivery, including full suites of static, animated and responsive assets

• Protect each client's brand and own the quality of everything that leaves the studio, whether AI made it or not

• Mentor junior creatives with practical, constructive direction

• Present to and co-create with clients at every level

• Work with Account and Project Managers to deliver on time and on budget

Requirements

Required:

• 6+ years in a digital or integrated creative agency

• A strong portfolio showing creative impact across digital and offline work (applications without a portfolio will not be considered)

• AI fluency with clear proof in your process: AI is part of how you think, explore and make, and you can show us the workflow behind the work, not just the final frames

• Hands-on skill with current image, video, motion, design and language tools, such as Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, Firefly, Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT and ComfyUI, or whatever has replaced them by the time you read this; tell us your stack and why you use it

• Strong craft basics in typography, layout, colour and composition, because AI doesn't replace taste

• Range across brand, campaigns, social, web, motion, film and print

• Curious, experimental mindset; you're always trying new things and sharing what you find

• Excellent spoken and written communication; comfortable working with clients and colleagues across Southeast Asia

• Team-first attitude, generosity with what you know, and enthusiasm for mentoring others

Nice to have:

• Track record of improving how work gets done beyond your own brief, such as a workflow or template your team adopted

• Experience building AI workflows that other people use

• Track record of mentoring junior team members

Why Join Construct

Construct is building a new kind of marketing agency, one where expertise becomes systems, AI strengthens delivery, and people spend less time on repetition and more time solving meaningful problems.

As a Senior Art Director, you'll work at the intersection of creative craft and client outcomes. This means:

• Creative work that matters: You'll spend your time on what makes the work good: the idea, the art direction and the judgement calls. AI and good systems take on repetitive production such as resizing and versioning at scale, and you'll own the creative thinking behind our work.

• Growing as the industry evolves: You'll build deeper judgement and commercial awareness by working alongside strategists, planners, marketers and creative technologists, and you'll learn how to shape and direct AI on real client work.

• Real ownership and impact: Your ideas don't stay your ideas. When you build a workflow that makes our creative faster and better, it becomes part of how Construct operates. Growth here is tied to contribution.

• Ambitious work, sustainable pace: We care about excellence and impact, but we get there through smart thinking and good systems, not through constant scrambling. You'll do your best work when you're not exhausted.

What We Offer:

• Flexible schedule and remote work options - We trust our people to do great work where and when it works best. Depending on your location and role, this can mean hybrid or remote working.

• Professional development budget - You'll receive an annual training subsidy to build skills that matter for your role. You'll also learn through internal training and regular brown-bag sessions with the team.

• Exposure to strategy, content, and client outcomes (rare in agencies) - You won't be siloed in one part of the work. You'll see how strategy and creative translate into execution and measurable results, building the commercial judgement most agency roles never get to develop.

• Opportunity to shape how Construct approaches creative and AI - The workflows and improvements you bring become part of how we deliver for clients across the agency.

• Time off - Rest matters to us. You'll have paid annual leave and your local public holidays, plus a paid day off to celebrate your birthday. We also give you paid leave for life's big moments.

• Mental wellness - On top of annual and sick leave, you'll have 7 days of planned mental health breaks a year to look after yourself. We also run wellness initiatives and team engagement activities throughout the year.

• Tech & equipment support - We make sure you're set up to do your best work, with company-issued equipment or a monthly equipment allowance, depending on your location.

If you're the kind of person who gets excited about solving meaningful problems, building better systems, and continuously raising the bar, this is the right place for you.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Staff Product Designer

Why YOU want this position

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

About the Role

Enverus is looking for a Staff Product Designer to help bring structure, clarity, and a shared design practice to a product organization that is growing fast and scaling its design foundations. This is not a role where you inherit a mature design process. You’ll help create one: deciding what good looks like, setting the standards others follow, and building the systems that let the company move faster with more coherence.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy and craft. You’ll help decide what to build and why, not only how it should look and work.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Product Influence

• Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

• Help define product strategy by connecting user research and behavioral insight with business direction.

• Shape the “what and why” of product decisions, not only the “how.”

• Work with ambiguous problem spaces and help turn them into clear, actionable direction.

Design Systems and Foundations

• Partner with design system manager to evolve, and govern shared foundations, aligning on standards where systems overlap and making deliberate decisions where they diverge across Enverus products.

• Establish patterns, components, and principles that scale across squads and reduce inconsistency.

• Operate across squads to ensure coherence, quality, and long-term scalability of the product experience.

• Read and write front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React) well enough to prototype in production-like conditions, review implementation details, and collaborate closely with Engineering on how the system is built and maintained.

Leading Through Ambiguity

• Bring structure to a complex, evolving organization: create clarity where little exists today, without waiting for perfect conditions.

• Design ways of working that fit both agile product teams and the more waterfall-style processes that exist across the business.

• Lead large initiatives that span multiple product areas or systems.

Craft and Quality

• Set design standards and lead critiques and design reviews across teams.

• Simplify complex workflows, particularly in data-heavy and domain-specific products.

• Raise the bar on craft, from interaction details to information architecture to visual systems.

Influence and Communication

• Frame design vision in business and user terms, and make the case for it to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Align multiple teams around a shared direction, and facilitate discussions that lead to clear decisions.

• Tell compelling stories with research, prototypes, and data to build conviction.

Mentorship and Capability Building

• Mentor designers across teams and help grow the design practice from the ground up.

• Influence design decisions beyond the design team, across the wider Enverus organization.

• Help build the culture, processes, and habits that a design-led organization needs.

Working with AI

• Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

• Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

• Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

• Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We’re Looking For

Required

• At least 3 years of experience in a staff, senior, or equivalent product design role, with demonstrated ownership of complex work.

• Strong, mature product design craft across interaction, visual, and systems design.

• Working knowledge of front-end code (HTML, CSS, and component-level JavaScript or React), enough to collaborate effectively with engineers on design system implementation and product delivery.

• Experience working in agile product environments, and comfort working within waterfall processes where they exist.

• Proven ability to establish structure and build systems within an organization that lacks formal processes.

• Comfort working across multiple design systems or product-specific component libraries.

• Exceptional communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• High autonomy: you make design decisions, push back when needed, and manage trade-offs without needing detailed oversight.

• Hands-on curiosity about AI tools and a practical sense of how they can change design and development work.

Preferred

• Experience building or scaling a design system.

• Experience designing for complex, data-intensive, or B2B domain products.

• Experience introducing design practice or process into a company that is early in its design maturity.

• Experience mentoring designers or leading design reviews across teams.

• Experience using AI tools in a design or prototyping workflow, and a point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
About Treering

At Treering, we help people capture and preserve life’s most meaningful moments — from school milestones to unforgettable travel experiences. Our innovative memory-as-a-service platform combines intuitive, AI-enabled tools with a seamless user experience to make creating personalized keepsakes easy and joyful. We’re a fast-growing, purpose-driven company expanding beyond yearbooks into travel and experiential memories, and we’re equally intentional about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and connected to the impact of their work.

About the role

You'll be Treering's first dedicated UX researcher. There's no research team, playbook, or backlog of studies waiting for you. You'll build the practice from the ground up and make the voice of our customers part of how we decide what to build.

You'll report to the Head of User Experience and split your time between our core yearbook business and new products built for the schools and families we already serve. This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll do

•
Understand our four core audiences. Lead foundational research with yearbook editors, parents, students, and photography partners to understand their behaviors, goals, frustrations, and unmet needs.

•
Test ideas before we build them. Conduct generative research to find new opportunities and evaluative research to validate concepts, prototypes, and new product bets early, so we invest in what people will actually use and pay for.

•
Build an ongoing listening practice. Establish a steady rhythm of customer interviews and surveys, and analyze existing data, like product feedback and support tickets, to identify opportunities for improvement.

•
Empower the team. Build an insights repository the whole company can use, so findings reach further and keep informing the product.

•
Partner with analytics. Work hand in hand with our product analytics effort, pairing what people do with why they do it.

•
Tell the story. Share actionable findings and recommendations in ways that move product designers, product managers, engineers, and executives to act.

•
Set the foundation. Establish research standards, tools, and processes, including how we recruit participants and how we research responsibly with schools and families.

Who you'll work with

You'll work closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, our customer success team, and the analytics effort. Our teams are small, so your insights will reach the people building the product directly.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days: You're talking with customers on a regular rhythm. Foundational studies are underway with yearbook editors and parents. An insights repository is up and running.

In your first year: Research is a regular part of how Treering makes product decisions, and the team has an easy, ongoing way to hear from the people we serve.

What you bring

•
5+ years of UX research experience, with qualitative methods as your core strength. You're an exceptional interviewer and listener.

•
Comfort conducting surveys and working with behavioral data, analytics tools and A/B test results, though the ability to do advanced quantitative analyses is not required.

•
Experience using AI tools to speed up research and improve its quality.

•
A track record of planning and running qualitative studies that shaped product or business decisions.

•
Excellent written and verbal communication, including strong storytelling, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

•
Experience working with a cross-functional team including product managers, designers, and developers.

Bonus points

•
A background in EdTech or K-12, including working within school privacy and access constraints.

•
Research with children, including age-appropriate methods and consent/assent practices.

•
Work on consumer or e-commerce products, especially purchase flows.

•
Familiarity with B2B2C products, where you sell to organizations and serve the people inside and around them.

•
Time as a first or solo researcher, building a practice without an existing playbook.

•
Hands-on experience setting up research operations, such as participant recruiting and insights repositories.

Location, travel, and compensation

•
Location: Remote, US-based

•
Travel: Occasional travel to schools and to meet with the team

title: Senior Game Designer - Wordscapes - Peoplefun
description:
Who are we?

TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

This role sits within our Peoplefun studio.

PeopleFun is an award-winning creator of mobile games for players across the globe, and a part of Tripledot Studios, with world-class projects, resources, and infrastructure.

PeopleFun is a Dallas-based game studio founded and led by game industry veterans, where game developers thrive on collaboration, creativity, teamwork, and fun. Our games are played by over 25 million players each month, and we are hard at work on a number of exciting new mobile games to fuel our future growth.

We believe in bringing People together through Fun by creating best-in-class social features and communities in our games that enable our players to engage deeply with other players. We also bring our studio teammates together by creating the very best game teams, ones that foster healthy collaboration, incredible productivity, and life-long professional relationships.

Job Summary

Wordscapes is one of the most-loved word puzzle games on mobile, and a long-running live game with a huge, loyal player base. We're looking for a Senior Game Designer who can do two things really well: craft levels players can't put down, and design features that keep them coming back for years.

You'll own work end to end, from the first idea and spec through ABT, tuning and live ops. Some weeks that means reshaping the early level ramp so new players stick around longer. Other weeks it means designing a new event, meta system or level mechanic and seeing it in front of millions of players. You'll sit on a small, senior, data-literate team where good ideas ship fast and every change is measured.

Responsibilities

Level design

• Design, build and tune crossword levels and level ramps, balancing word choice, grid layout, letter sets and difficulty.

• Shape progression and pacing across hundreds of levels, with deliberate spikes, breathers and rewards.

• Use per-level funnels, churn points and completion data to find where players struggle, then fix it.

• Design new level mechanics and goals that add variety and depth without breaking the core loop.

• Partner with engineers on tooling, procedural generation, and general collaboration.

Feature design

• Own features end to end: pitch, spec, UX flows, reward tuning, and success metrics.

• Design retention-focused systems for new, engaged and returning lapsed players, from FTUE to long-term meta.

• Write clear features specs with a hypothesis, treatments and KPIs, then read results with data partners and decide next steps.

• Work closely with product, engineering, art, UX and QA to get features shipped on time and at quality.

Across both

• Prototype ideas quickly, on paper, in whitebox, or with AI tools, and drop what doesn't test well.

• Play the top casual and word games and bring back sharp, specific lessons.

• Bring your years of experience and expertise to raise the bar for design docs and reviews on the team.

Requirements

• 5+ years of game design experience, with at least 3 years on mobile casual or puzzle games.

• Hands-on level design: you've built, tuned and shipped levels at scale in a level editor, and can show examples.

• Feature design: you've taken features from concept to live, and can walk us through what moved the metrics and what didn't.

• Strong grasp of progression, pacing, difficulty curves, FTUE and retention levers.

• Comfortable working from data: funnels, cohorts, retention curves and A/B test results.

• Clear, structured writing. Your specs are easy for engineers, artists and QA to build from.

• Experience working in a live game with regular releases and live ops.

• This role is remote, with a hybrid schedule for those near our Dallas office: 4 days a week in office (Monday–Thursday) if you live in Dallas, or 3 days a week (Monday–Wednesday) if you live within a 3-hour radius.

Nice to have

• Shipped word, crossword, puzzle or match-3 games.

• Hands-on with Looker, BigQuery, Tableau or similar, enough to answer your own questions.

• Designing ABTs on level content: difficulty, ramps, content swaps.

• Spreadsheet fluency for ramp, economy and parameter tables.

• Unity experience.

• Procedural or AI-assisted content generation.

• Prototypes or tools you've built with AI.

• Experience designing for returning and lapsed players, or for social and competitive features.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you've shipped than a perfect match.

Working at Tripledot

• Time Off: Flexible Discretionary Time Off policy in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year.

• Financial: Generous 401k match, discretionary bonuses, and competitive salaries.

• Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage.

• Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand.

• Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development.

title: Creative Director
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

• Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.

• Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.

A brand system that morphs

Experience

• Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.

• The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.

• Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.

• Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

• Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.

Location

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

title: Senior Gen AI Video & Motion Designer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Gen AI Video & Motion Designer to join our global Creative Capability team and lead the production of high-quality video content across multiple client accounts.

This is a hands-on creative role combining video editing, motion design, storytelling, and generative AI production. You will take projects from brief and storyboard through to final delivery, using traditional video craft alongside Gen AI tools to create high-quality, scalable content for paid media, social, and digital platforms.

A key part of the role is developing repeatable workflows and automation that allow the team to produce multiple platform, market, and audience-specific video variations efficiently, while maintaining a high creative and technical standard.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop storyboards and video concepts based on creative briefs, audience insights, and performance objectives.

• Edit and produce video content across multiple formats, from hero assets to short-form paid social and 6-second cuts.

• Create and integrate Gen AI video using text-to-video, image-to-video, generative extension, scene creation, object removal, outpainting, and other AI-assisted techniques.

• Combine AI-generated content with traditional footage and professional post-production to ensure seamless, polished results.

• Create motion graphics, kinetic typography, transitions, lower thirds, end frames, and other branded elements.

• Adapt and version video content for different platforms, markets, languages, audiences, and aspect ratios.

• Develop scalable video production workflows, templates, and automation processes to increase production efficiency.

• Maintain prompt libraries, references, presets, and other systems that support consistent Gen AI output.

• Ensure all final content meets creative, technical, brand, and platform standards, identifying and correcting AI artefacts and continuity issues.

• Work closely with Creative Directors, Strategists, Designers, and other teams across the global Creative Capability.

• Incorporate performance insights into creative decisions and future video concepts.

• Share knowledge and help upskill other designers in Gen AI video tools and workflows.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional experience in video editing and motion design.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience using Generative AI video tools in real production environments.

• Mandatory: Portfolio/showreel demonstrating Gen AI video work.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.

• Strong knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator.

• Experience with DaVinci Resolve or an equivalent editing/color-grading tool.

• Strong storytelling and storyboarding skills.

• Experience creating video for performance marketing, paid media, social, or digital advertising.

• Experience producing high volumes of video variations and adapting content for different platforms and markets.

• Strong understanding of video formats, aspect ratios, codecs, compression, and digital platform specifications.

• Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing AI-generated content for artefacts, continuity, and brand consistency.

• Ability to explain and defend creative decisions to both creative and non-creative stakeholders.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ComfyUI, Figma Weave, or other node-based AI workflows.

• Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, or other scripting/automation experience.

• Experience with LoRAs, ControlNet, fine-tuning, or other methods for maintaining consistency in AI-generated content.

• Experience with creative automation and dynamic video templating.

• Advanced Figma knowledge.

• 3D or virtual production experience with tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, or Unreal Engine.

• Understanding of AI content provenance, licensing, synthetic likeness, and brand-safety considerations.

What Success Looks Like

• High-quality video output that combines strong creative craft with effective use of Gen AI.

• Scalable workflows that significantly increase video production capacity.

• Consistent, brand-safe, and technically compliant video across platforms and markets.

• Creative decisions informed by performance data and audience behaviour.

• Reusable systems and workflows that can be adopted by other members of the creative team.

• A higher standard of Gen AI video production across the Creative Capability.

Why Incubeta?

You will join a global, collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where you can have a direct impact on how media is delivered across the Americas.

This is an opportunity to shape the standards, processes and operating model behind a growing media execution function, while working alongside senior media leadership and a global media capability team.

Important: A portfolio or showreel containing demonstrable Gen AI video work is mandatory. Candidates without relevant Gen AI video examples will not be considered.

title: Director of Experience and Design
description:
Banking hasn’t changed much in decades. We’re changing that. One product at a time.

Lunar is a Nordic challenger bank building the future of financial life with AI at the core. Our engineers, designers and product people work on problems that actually matter: making money simpler, smarter and more rewarding for a million registered users across the Nordics.

Fully licensed and founded in 2015, with offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus and Stockholm.

We move fast, we build with purpose, and we’re just getting started.

Banking apps have converged. Open five of them and you’ll find the same tab bar, the same balance card and the same transactions, in a different accent colour. We intend to stay ahead on approach, not features: banking that runs smoothly in the background, with customers still in control, and more and more of the work done by AI agents acting on their behalf.

As our Director of Experience & Design, your job is to define how Lunar feels, and to make that feeling real. You’ll report to our Chief Product Officer, as a peer to our Product and Tech directors, and lead our design team of seven designers in Aarhus and Copenhagen, growing to ten. You’ll also own our Core Experience and Agentic Experience squads, so you’re not handing a vision to someone else to build. That’s why this role is half product, half design.

Our design team is better than our design process. The craft isn’t the question, but most of what reaches the team has already been decided, and the way we plan and work with product and engineering gets in the way more often than it helps. Changing that is a big part of the job.

What will you do?

•
Define how Lunar feels: what we promise our customers and how we show up in every screen, message and support conversation. Turn that into principles the whole company can build from, working closely with Marketing so the experience is consistent across every channel.

•
Own our Core Experience and Agentic Experience squads, covering the everyday app and the AI agents that increasingly act on our customers’ behalf: what they build, why, how fast it ships and what it changes for customers.

•
Get design into the shaping of what we build, early, and make that hold when you’re not in the room.

•
Rework how design and product work together now that AI is changing discovery, validation, feedback and handoff.

•
Lead and grow the design team and the product managers for both squads, across Aarhus and Copenhagen, with a consistent bar, real development and honest conversations about expectations. Expect to spend real time here, especially in your first year.

•
Set the quality bar and hold it when the pressure is on to ship, and keep new ideas from being flattened as they clear Risk, Compliance and our regulator.

•
Make Matter, our design system, shared infrastructure that designers, engineers and AI tooling build from, so it speeds up delivery rather than policing it.

What are we looking for in you?

•
Product and design leadership: You’ve led and grown a product design team with real management scope, and owned what gets built, not just what gets designed, either as a product leader or with product managers and squads in your remit.

•
Executive presence: You can hold your position in an executive room, and you’re honest enough to change it when you’re wrong.

•
AI at the centre: AI is central to how you and your teams work. You’re pushing what’s possible, and you have a clear view on how it changes the process and what designers and PMs are now accountable for.

•
Craft credibility: The team needs to trust your eye without you touching the file.

•
Outcomes, not output: You’ve tied design work to results that customers and the business could measure.

•
Nice to have: Experience in fintech, banking or another regulated product, Nordic market context, having rebuilt a design process, hiring bar or career ladder, shaping brand, voice or go-to-market, designing conversational or agentic experiences, and native mobile fluency across iOS and Android. Nobody will have all of it.

What you get.

•
4 days in the office. We’re a team that builds together, thinks together and moves together. Showing up is part of how we work. You can be based in Aarhus, Copenhagen or Stockholm, and you’ll travel monthly between the offices, more often at the start. It’s a standing part of the job, so make sure it works for you before you apply.

•
A remit that goes beyond design. Two product squads, a design team growing to ten, and ownership of how Lunar feels to every customer.

•
State of the art equipment. The newest computer, monitor, mouse and keyboard, so nothing slows you down.

•
Pension, health insurance and enhanced parental leave. From your financial future to your family moments, we’ve got you covered.

While you hold on tight for us to get back to you, curious to see what we’re up to? Follow us on LinkedIn for business announcements and releases 📢, and check out our Instagram for an inside scoop on what it’s like to work here.

Depending on the regulations in the country where you will be employed, we will ask to see or obtain information about your criminal record. Please note that our employment is conditional upon you not being registered in RKI (Ribers Kredit Information).

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer – Power, Harness Design & EMC (m/f/d)
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

As our (Senior) Electrical Systems Engineer (m/f/d), you own the electrical backbone of our robots, from industrial manipulators to our bimanual platform Alfie.

In this key role, you are responsible for the complete electrical system of a robot, not one section of it. You define the power, grounding and shielding concepts, engineer the wire harnesses through moving joints, and take them from first prototype to series supply. If you come from automotive Bordnetz development, you will find familiar work at a very different pace: concepts turn into running prototypes within weeks, and your decisions go straight into products at our customers.

Your Responsibilities

•
Own the electrical system architecture of our robots: power distribution concept, load distribution, fusing (Absicherung), wire cross-section sizing and data signal integrity.

•
Define grounding/earthing and shielding concepts (Versorgungs- und Massekonzepte) and design for EMC from the first concept onwards.

•
Plan and support EMC pre-compliance and certification testing, analyse findings and implement robust fixes.

•
Specify wire harnesses, connectors, contacts and cables, and create wiring diagrams (Kabelschaltpläne), harness drawings and BOMs that suppliers can produce from directly.

•
Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering.

•
Work closely with our electronics team on interfaces, connectors, power distribution boards and safety circuits.

•
Take harnesses from first prototype to series: supplier selection, first samples, change management, incoming inspection and quality standards. Use your expertise to inform and provide feedback on assembly procedures, build initial samples and support production engineers with new assembly procedures.

•
Work hand in hand with our prototyping technicians, who build your designs, and turn their feedback into better harnesses.

•
Support bring-up, integration and root-cause analysis of electrical issues in prototypes and in the field.

•
Set up our standards and processes for electrical systems engineering, including the choice of E-CAD tooling.

We're looking for someone who has:

•
Degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, vehicle electronics or a comparable field.

•
3+ years of experience in Bordnetz or wire harness development, e.g., in automotive, commercial vehicles, rail, aerospace or machine building. Robotics experience is not required.

•
Proven hands-on experience with grounding, shielding and EMC design, ideally including EMC testing.

•
Solid knowledge of connectors, contacts, cable types, wire sizing and fusing, and confidence creating wiring diagrams and harness drawings.

•
Experience with cables in moving applications (e.g., doors, seats, drag chains or robot joints) is a plus.

•
Experience with an E-CAD tool such as E3.series, Capital, LDorado or SOLIDWORKS Electrical.

•
Experience taking harnesses into series with external suppliers, including change management.

•
A strong ownership mindset and the drive to build up a discipline in a fast-growing company.

•
Language skills: either fluent German plus solid working English, or excellent English (no German required)

Why join RobCo?

•
Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

•
Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

•
As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

•
Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

•
Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

•
Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

•
Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: UX Researcher
description:
Company Overview

Closer Conveyancing is a dynamic team born in London, Ontario, comprised of law and tech professionals dedicated to enhancing the property closing experience. Our mission is to streamline the property conveyancing process for lawyers and clerks, ensuring it is optimized for today’s needs and future innovations. We pride ourselves on our values of trust, integrity, and delivering a world-class product.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced UX Researcher to lead a wide range of research initiatives at Closer. In this role, you’ll help us better understand what our users need from our product by conducting user research, facilitating interviews and usability studies, and working closely with cross-functional teams. You’ll play an important role in shaping the continued development of Closer, our software that streamlines the property closing process for lawyers, clerks, and their clients across Ontario and Alberta.

Reporting to the Head of UX Research, you’ll take ownership of research initiatives from planning through to execution. You’ll facilitate research sessions, conduct user interviews and usability studies, and spend time observing and learning from users to uncover their needs, behaviours, and pain points. We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys digging deeper, asks thoughtful questions, and wants to understand the “why” behind what people do. You’ll bring a thoughtful, user-focused approach to your work, using your research skills to turn what you learn into clear, meaningful insights that help inform product decisions.

If you’re confident using contextual research methods, user interviews, and usability testing, and are comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with colleagues and end users, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Working with our UX team to articulate research plans and define hypotheses to test at different stages of product development.

• Designing and leading the execution of a variety of customer research that will enable our team to understand customer pain points and behaviors.

• Aggregating results from multiple data sources and communicating findings to inform product, design, engineering and marketing decisions.

• Researching competing solutions to gain an understanding of current state and disseminating findings back to the product team.

• Conducting usability tests with lawyers and clerks based on designs created by our product team and assisting with iteration processes.

• Critiquing wireframes and prototypes along with using user insights to offer alternative ideas.

• Identifying, articulating and prioritizing potential usability issues.

• Facilitating internal meetings to triage and/or manage research findings.

• Communicating usability analysis, recommendations and potential design solutions.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor/Master of Science in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Science or a related field.

• Previous experience working on B2B SaaS or web-based software products.

• Proficiency in a variety of qualitative and quantitative research methods, including think aloud usability studies, contextual inquiries, remote usability testing, parallel prototyping, card sorting and A/B testing.

• Knowledge of current and evolving research tools, best practices and processes.

• Practical experience executing both generative and evaluation research methodologies.

• Great collaboration skills and a love for working with others to understand and solve user problems.

• Experience with common user research and usability testing methodologies and proven ability using data to inform your designs and decisions.

The base salary range for this role is $75,000 – $80,000 CAD annually, plus a performance bonus of up to 10% of base salary. Final compensation will reflect your experience, domain depth, and demonstrated delivery. In accordance with provincial pay transparency legislation, Closer discloses a pay range for all advertised positions.

Equal Opportunity & Statutory Notices

At Closer we have a strong belief in equity, diversity and inclusion and are committed to building and fostering an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized people, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and/or people with intersectional identities. We are committed to providing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any accommodations.

AI may be used to support certain administrative aspects of our recruitment process. However, every application and resume is carefully reviewed by members of our team, and all screening and hiring decisions are made solely by the hiring team.
