title: Senior Mechanical Designer
description:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure?

You want to take ownership of designs that move from early prototypes to reliable serial production?

Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks

Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production.

You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up.

Working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and production teams, you will help ensure that our designs perform in the field and can be produced and assembled consistently. We are looking for someone who have practical manufacturing knowledge and follows a design through until it works on the assembly line.

Core Responsibilities

•
Develop and refine 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings, with a strong focus on injection-molded plastic parts.

•
Take designs from functional prototypes through design release, tooling, initial production runs, and serial production.

•
Apply design for manufacturing and assembly principles to improve part quality, reduce cost, and simplify production.

•
Work directly with injection molding suppliers on feasibility reviews, tooling constraints, design changes, and first-sample evaluation.

•
Design for efficient, repeatable assembly, including accessible fastening, clear part orientation, and mistake-proofing methods such as poka-yoke.

Requirements

Your Profile

You bring practical experience turning designs into manufactured products. You understand how CAD decisions affect tooling, part consistency, assembly effort, and cost. You are comfortable discussing details with suppliers and working alongside the people who assemble your designs.

•
At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design or product development.

•
Demonstrated experience taking at least one product or significant assembly from prototype through production ramp-up.

•
Proficiency in professional 3D CAD software and the creation of complete manufacturing drawings.

•
Strong understanding of injection molding constraints, including draft angles, wall thickness, ribs, bosses, undercuts, shrinkage, and warpage.

•
Ability to work autonomously and collaborate closely with engineering, suppliers, and production teams.

•
BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, a Swiss apprenticeship as a Konstrukteur/in EFZ, or an equivalent relevant qualification.

Nice-to-Have

•
Proficiency in SolidWorks.

•
Experience with composite materials and their manufacturing and assembly processes.

•
Experience designing assembly fixtures, inspection aids, or production tooling.

•
Familiarity with machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing.

•
Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other products combining mechanical and electronic systems.

Benefits

Why CDDS

•
Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape.

•
Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership.

•
Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team.

•
Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations.

•
Attractive compensation.

Details

Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site
Start date: ASAP

The role combines hands-on engineering design using AutoCAD Plant 3D with professional leadership, development of engineering standards, creation of 3D libraries and training of engineering team members.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities:

3D Modeling & Detailed Engineering

• Develop detailed 3D models of treatment plants, including Integration of mechanical equipment, tanks, vessels, pumps, filters, piping systems, valves, fittings and instrumentation.

• Translate P&IDs and engineering requirements into detailed piping, motors, instrumentation and valves layouts, and coordinated 3D models.

• Design piping routes, equipment arrangements, maintenance access, drainage and installation interfaces.

• Design piping supports, including support arrangements, details and load considerations, in coordination with structural engineers.

• Coordinate the 3D model with civil, structural, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation disciplines.

• Perform model reviews and clash detection.

Engineering Drawings & Documentation

• Prepare General Arrangement (GA) drawings, layouts, plans and sections.

• Generate piping isometric drawings and construction details.

• Prepare detailed drawings of tanks, vessels, columns and skids, including openings and connections.

• Prepare piping support drawings and details.

• Generate and validate Bills of Materials (BOM)

• Ensure consistency between 3D models, P&IDs, specifications and engineering drawings.

Engineering Standards & Infrastructure

• Establish, develop and maintain standardized 3D design procedures, engineering guidelines and drafting standards.

• Build and maintain a comprehensive 3D component library, including equipment, piping components, valves, fittings, instrumentation and piping supports.

• Develop and maintain AutoCAD Plant 3D catalogs, piping specifications (Pipe Specs), templates and component databases.

• Establish standardized project templates, drawing formats, naming conventions and model structures.

• Develop and maintain the digital design infrastructure, tools and workflows required for efficient and consistent engineering activities.

• Lead the implementation of standardized 3D design methodologies and best practices across engineering projects.

Training & Professional Development

• Lead technical training and knowledge transfer for engineers and designers in AutoCAD Plant 3D and 3D design methodologies.

• Develop training materials, technical guidelines and internal working procedures.

• Provide ongoing technical support, guidance and mentoring to engineering team members.

Requirements:

Education

• Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering – advantage.

• A degree in Environmental /Chemical /Water and wastewater Engineering or a related engineering discipline will also be considered.

• Alternatively, a Mechanical Engineering diploma or equivalent technical qualification, combined with at least 7–10 years of proven experience in 3D plant design and piping engineering.

• Previous experience with other 3D design and plant modelling software is a significant advantage, particularly for candidates who have worked as design engineers or piping designers with independent engineering responsibilities, rather than solely as CAD drafters.

• Preference will be given to candidates with a strong practical engineering background in piping design, industrial process plants, and water and wastewater treatment facilities.

Professional Experience

title: Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The team

You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.

The opportunity

You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.

As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.

Your responsibilities

• Build. Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.

• Tune. Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.

• Introduce. New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.

• Test. You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.

• Optimize. You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.

• Shape. Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.

• Accelerate. You use AI to generate layout variants, explore difficulty options and check solvability.

What we look for

• Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.

• Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.

• Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.

• AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.

• Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.

• Motivated. You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

Requirements

• Experience. 1+ year in level design, game design or QA on mobile games, ideally puzzle games.

title: Associate Principal Electrical Engineer – BESS Design
description:
Role Summary

Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer for utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, including standalone storage and PV-plus-storage facilities. You will seal electrical design packages, own the technical direction of a program of BESS projects, and act as the PV/BESS group's main electrical point of contact for clients, EPC contractors, and authorities having jurisdiction. The storage projects you support will help turn renewable power generation into a source of dispatchable power, and your work will play a direct role in the energy transition. As an employee-owner, you will have a personal stake in the success of your projects and the organization as a whole.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

• Serve as Engineer of Record for BESS and PV-plus-storage projects, sealing electrical drawings, calculations, and specifications in states where you hold licensure.

• Direct BESS electrical design from conceptual layout through issued-for-construction, including DC block and PCS arrangements, MV collection, auxiliary power, grounding, and SCADA and communications interfaces.

• Review and approve single-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC cable sizing, grounding designs, and equipment specifications.

• Establish design criteria for AC- and DC-coupled storage, augmentation strategies, and hybrid PV-plus-storage plants.

• Evaluate battery enclosure, PCS, transformer, and switchgear submittals, resolving technical deviations with equipment manufacturers.

• Coordinate BESS electrical studies, including short-circuit, arc flash, load flow, voltage drop, wire loss, auxiliary load, and ground grid analysis.

• Integrate fire protection and hazard mitigation requirements, including NFPA 855 spacing and explosion control inputs, into the electrical design.

• Resolve unusual technical conditions and design conflicts using expert judgment, seeking guidance only for program-level issues.

Project & Portfolio Execution

• Oversee the technical and delivery performance of all BESS projects within an assigned program.

• Approve scopes, budgets, and schedules for electrical design assignments, identifying risks or deviations early.

• Prepare proposals and fee estimates for BESS electrical engineering services in collaboration with Business Development.

• Lead and assign engineers and designers needed to complete deliverables across concurrent projects.

• Lead and participate in BESS program reviews and client program meetings.

• Mentor Engineer I–III and Senior Engineer staff in BESS design practice, code application, and Engineer of Record responsibilities.

• Act as a supervisor of assigned staff, including performance feedback and development planning.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

• Review complete BESS design packages for conformity, constructability, and quality assurance before sealing.

• Ensure designs comply with the NEC (including Articles 480, 690, 691, 705, and 706), NFPA 855 and 70E, UL 9540 and 9540A, IEEE 1547 and 2800, and applicable utility and AHJ requirements.

• Set and maintain the group's BESS electrical design standards, templates, and calculation tools.

• Resolve AHJ, utility, and third-party review comments and maintain records of sealed documents.

Collaboration & Communication

• Act as one of the PV/BESS group's main electrical points of contact for clients, EPC contractors, and AHJs across a program of BESS projects.

• Coordinate with civil, structural, High Voltage, and Power Systems Engineering teams on layouts, substation interfaces, and interconnection requirements.

• Lead design reviews and technical meetings, presenting recommendations and trade-offs to clients and internal stakeholders.

• Negotiate technical scope and design changes with clients and contractors, documenting impacts on schedule and budget.

Program, Strategy & Innovation

• Track BESS technology, code, and market developments, setting the group's design response to them.

• Develop new techniques, tools, and improved processes for BESS electrical design and review.

• Advise Revamp leadership as a technical specialist on energy storage design.

• Represent Revamp in industry working groups and technical forums on energy storage.

Additional Responsibilities

• Perform essential duties, including meeting deliverables and deadlines.

• Occasionally perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or similar applicable work experience.

• 10+ years of electrical design experience on utility-scale power generation projects, with substantial experience specifically in solar PV or BESS design.

• Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in electrical engineering, with the ability to obtain licensure in additional states.

• Experience serving as Engineer of Record or lead electrical engineer for utility-scale BESS projects.

• In-depth knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 855, UL 9540 and 9540A, and IEEE standards that apply to energy storage and interconnection.

• Experience designing MV collection systems, grounding systems, and BESS auxiliary power systems.

• Demonstrated ability to manage scopes, budgets, and schedules across concurrent projects and to lead and mentor engineering teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting technical recommendations to clients and AHJs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in electrical engineering with a power systems focus.

• PE licensure in multiple states or an active NCEES Record.

• Proficiency with ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, CYMCAP, or comparable power analysis software, and with AutoCAD.

• Experience with battery enclosure and PCS products from multiple manufacturers and with augmentation planning.

• Experience with hybrid plant controls and SCADA integration for PV-plus-storage facilities.

• Prior work in an engineering consulting, owner/developer, or EPC environment supporting utility-scale renewable projects.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

· Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program.

· Competitive compensation with bonus.

· Full benefits package offerings including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.

· Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.

· Monthly health and wellness stipend.

· Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

· Paid parental leave.

· 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.

· Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the US since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp‑eng.com.

Disclaimers

Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. title: Human Centered Design Manager
description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Manager to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

• Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.

• Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

• Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.

• Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

• Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.

• Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

• Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.

• Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

• Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.

• Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

• Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.

• Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.

• Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.

• Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.

• Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.

• A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

• Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.

• Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.

• Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.

• Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.

• Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.

• Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.

• Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

• Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.

• Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.

• Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.

• Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.

• Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

• Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor

• Location: Remote

• Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Brand Marketing Intern, France
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The community you will join:

Airbnb is seeking a Brand Marketing Intern to join the French & BENELUX Marketing team for a six month internship starting March 15, 2027.

Join Airbnb’s Marketing team to help deliver inspiring, high-impact brand campaigns and partnerships sparking travel on Airbnb and supporting host community growth in France and the Netherlands. We have exciting projects coming up in 2027, including the third year of our partnership with the Tour de France & Tour de France Femmes, seasonal campaigns and the ongoing promotion of Airbnb Experiences and Services, which now complement our historical business of homes.

To help make these a success, we’re looking for a motivated intern who is eager to dive into real-world marketing, media, and partnership projects.

Internship dates: March 15 - September 15, 2027.

The difference you will make:

Supporting the operational execution of Local Programs & Partnerships

• Act as a day-to-day point of contact for the media agency on campaign execution.

• Help execute the creative strategy :

• Be the liaison with the internal creative teams and creative agency on the execution of high-quality, premium content

• Ensure creative outputs are aligned with the overall campaign objectives and media plan requirements

• Coordinate with the Community team to identify, source, and onboard hosts and listings participating in the campaign

• Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of the plan, including collecting internal clearances of selected listings through Legal and other relevant teams

• Help with contracts and administrative follow-ups

• Supervise production, attend shooting, manage schedules, timelines and logistics

• Organise creative reviews and approvals by coordinating feedback loops while ensuring deadlines are met

Helping on the day-to-day execution of always-on campaigns for guests & hosts

• Participate in the creative & localization efforts for France:

• Supporting on the localization of the assets in French jointly with the localization and copy writing teams, ensuring consumer and market relevance

• Attend the recording sessions of spots

• Partnering with the media team to determine weekly TV/OTT media rotations in line with the approved strategy for the French market

• Analyze creative and media performances, formulating future recommendations

• Help execute the Audio strategy (Podcasts, Radio) for France

Acting as a strategic partner to the Marketing team helping us go beyond our usual scope by bringing a fresh perspective to the table:

• Market & Competitor Insights

• Monitor competitors and market best practices in France, Belgium, and the Netherlands.

• Identify emerging trends, new and up‑and‑coming platforms, and opportunities to differentiate Airbnb from the competition.

• Process & Ways of Working

• Support the team in streamlining existing processes to improve collaboration, clarity, and efficiency.

• Help build or refine simple tools (trackers, templates, checklists) that make day-to-day execution smoother.

• Measurement, Reporting & Learnings

• Collect campaign results and key metrics from agencies and internal teams.

• Consolidate data and insights into clear, structured post‑campaign reports.

• Highlight key learnings and formulate actionable recommendations for future campaigns.

The intern experience:

As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our incredible employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during the summer. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel. You can expect to:

• Collaborate with multiple team members to achieve project milestones

• Communicate with stakeholders across different teams to provide project updates

• Seek and provide feedback throughout the internship

• Actively participate in and contribute to the Marketing team and broader Airbnb community

Your expertise:

• Preferred: End-of-studies internship

• Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

• French native & professional proficiency in English

• Proven record of creative skills and attention to detail.

• Prior experience in marketing, communications and/or PR (internship or student projects).

• Sensitivity to creative, brand, and media environments.

• Solid project management & communication skills: ability to manage multiple stakeholders and tasks, respect deadlines, and prioritize.

• Strong analytical skills

• Versatile, proactive, and “can-do” attitude.

• Comfortable with the Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs, Gmail).

Our commitment to inclusion & belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for benefits and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range

€25.000-€25.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Design Engineer
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Design Engineer

Job Location: United Kingdom

Job Type: Permanent

Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications

Structural Design Engineer — Design Creative, Sustainable Solutions That Restore Damaged Buildings to Life

Are you a Structural Design Engineer who thrives on solving complex, real-world problems? This is an exciting opportunity to join our busy and collaborative design office, where no two projects are ever quite the same. Working closely with the Design Office Manager, you'll develop creative and practical design solutions for buildings that have been damaged by fires, floods and subsidence — restoring them safely, cost-effectively and to the highest standards. From producing detailed drawings to obtaining the relevant permissions, you'll play a central role in bringing damaged properties back to life.

This is a role that rewards precision, creativity and technical expertise in equal measure. A significant proportion of our work involves listed buildings, so an appreciation of historic and traditional building techniques will serve you well, alongside your core knowledge of designing and specifying sub-structure schemes. You'll draw on your CAD skills daily, balancing engineering rigour with the ingenuity needed to find the most suitable and sustainable outcome for every scheme.

We're proud to be forward-thinking in how we work. You'll stay at the forefront of innovative and environmentally sustainable repair solutions, actively helping us develop net zero approaches while sharing your knowledge through the training of colleagues across the wider business. While the role is primarily home-based, offering you genuine flexibility and autonomy, travel to sites will be a regular and rewarding part of the job — giving you the chance to see your designs take shape and monitor schemes first-hand. If you're a confident communicator with first-class attention to detail and a passion for engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

The skills you will have when you apply:

•
Sub-structure expertise — A thorough understanding of construction engineering, particularly sub-structure works, including the design and specification of schemes.

•
Qualified engineer — An engineering degree or similar qualification.

•
CAD proficiency — Competence and confidence in the use of CAD for producing detailed design drawings.

•
Senior influence — The ability to effectively influence and engage with stakeholders at a senior level.

•
Organised & methodical — Strong organisational and administrative skills, with excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach.

•
IT literate — A comprehensive understanding of Windows-based programmes, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

•
Clear communicator — The ability to communicate clearly and confidently with a range of people, both on the phone and face-to-face.

•
Team player — Strong teamwork skills, working collaboratively within the design office and wider business.

•
Customer-focused — A superb communicator who delivers first-class customer service on every scheme.

What we’ll give you for this role:

Remuneration & more

• Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications

• A Self Invested Personal Pension Scheme (SIPP)

• Holiday allowance of 25 days plus bank holidays

• Flexible working from our office or your home

Health & support

• Private healthcare plan (including pre-existing conditions)

• Life assurance

• Employee assistance programme for employee wellbeing

• Group Income Protection

Other benefits

• Voluntary flexible benefits – green car scheme, travel insurance, dental cover, cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan, wellbeing and digital GP applications

• Discounts on various products and services

This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry

At Sedgwick, you won't just build your career; you'll cultivate a team of experts. Our Sedgwick University offering empowers you to excel as well as your team members, with the most comprehensive training program in the industry which includes more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue formal education.

Together, we're not only reshaping the insurance landscape, we’re building a legacy of talent. Come and be a catalyst for change within our industry.

Next steps for you:

Think we'd be a great match? Apply now – we want to hear from you.

If you’re unsure whether you have all the skills needed then do apply – we are looking for all backgrounds from seasoned professionals to those returning to the workforce, and everyone in-between.

Not only that, we are proud to have a zero tolerance policy towards discrimination of any kind regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital/ family status, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.

After the closing date we will review all applications, and may select some applicants for an interview (which may be virtual, or in-person).

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job Title: UI/UX Designer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We're looking for a UI/UX Designer with exceptional visual taste, strong product instincts, and a passion for crafting intuitive digital experiences. You'll own design across our websites, platforms, and digital products, translating complex workflows into elegant, intuitive, and scalable interfaces.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, cares deeply about design quality, and knows how to leverage AI to accelerate creative exploration and execution.

title: Staff Brand Designer
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍 London | 💰 £98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance | Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐ Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.

We’re looking for a Staff Brand Designer to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.

You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.

This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

• Shaping our creative direction. Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.

• Leading ambitious work. You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.

• Creating standout design. You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.

• Managing and developing designers. Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.

• Raising the bar across the team. Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.

• Connecting brand and product. Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.

• Evolving our brand systems. Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.

• Influencing decisions across teams. Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.

• Working with creative partners. Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.

• Improving how we work. Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.

• You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in typography, visual identity and art direction. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.

• You have experience managing and developing designers, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.

• You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.

• You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.

• You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.

• You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time.

• You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.

• You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.

• You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.

• You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.

• You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.

We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.

➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our benefits.

🌈 The application journey

• 30-minute call with our Recruiter

• 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team.

• 1-hour interview covering values & ways of working.

To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.

We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-TR1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering.

No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments

Responsibilities

•
Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions.

•
Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes.

•
Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency.

•
Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes.

•
Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation.

•
Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders.

•
Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop.

•
Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices.

Requirements

•
Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

•
5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries.

•
A portfolio showing end-to-end work, from research and workflows to high-fidelity UX/UI for data-rich professional software (e.g. situational-awareness, control-room or analytics applications).

•
Experience working on integrated software platforms rather than isolated websites or prototypes.

•
Experience handing designs over to front-end developers and working with and evolving a design system, with a working understanding of front-end technology and its constraints.

•
Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals.

•
Understanding of end-to-end systems in which sensor data is acquired in the field, processed and exposed on a software platform, ideally in complex or regulated environments.

•
Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality.

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Proficiency in Figma and in research and collaboration tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail and Miro.

•
Willingness to travel and do field research.

•
Driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

•
Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have

•
Big plus: Experience with underwater acoustics or sonar software.

•
Plus: Experience in design leadership, or in setting up design practices in a growing organisation.

•
Plus: Front-end skills (e.g. HTML/CSS, React) for prototyping next to AI based tooling.

•
Plus: Proficiency in Dutch.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Stage Brand & Culture
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Please note: this position is only available for students who are proficient in the Dutch language!

Ben jij een aanstormend talent met een passie voor branding, marketing en storytelling? Wil je meewerken aan inspirerende projecten die onze unieke WPP Media-identiteit versterken, zowel intern als extern, en tegelijkertijd een positieve maatschappelijke impact hebben? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Wie zijn wij? Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren en merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei te bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

• We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen en dagen het gewone denken uit.

• We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken.

• We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA; we omarmen verandering.

Ons Brand & Culture team is de drijvende kracht achter zowel onze externe merkidentiteit als onze interne cultuur en maatschappelijke impact. Je krijgt de unieke kans om te leren hoe we onze merkstrategie vertalen naar concrete acties én hoe we ons verhaal op een pakkende manier vertellen aan zowel interne als externe doelgroepen. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren professionals en krijgt volop ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen.

Wat ga jij doen? Als Stagiair(e) Brand & Culture ben jij een onmisbare schakel in ons team en help je mee om onze ambities waar te maken. Jouw missie is om ons te ondersteunen bij het versterken van de merkidentiteit van WPP Media en het creëren van impactvolle content. Je krijgt de kans om volop mee te werken aan diverse projecten en activiteiten, en er is ruimte voor jouw eigen initiatieven en ontwikkeling. Jouw takenpakket is veelzijdig en uitdagend:

• Merkidentiteit & Cultuur: Je ondersteunt bij het bewaken en verder ontwikkelen van de merkidentiteit, tone of voice en visuele richtlijnen van WPP Media. Je draagt bij aan de doorvertaling van onze merkstrategie naar praktische initiatieven en versterkt onze interne bedrijfscultuur.

• Content Creatie & Redactie: Je werkt actief mee aan de creatie van diverse content (tekst, beeld, video) voor verschillende kanalen. Denk hierbij aan social media posts, blogs, artikelen, whitepapers en communicatie voor interne activaties en evenementen.

• Content Planning & Promotie: Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van contentplannen en denkt mee over hoe we onze content effectief kunnen verspreiden via relevante kanalen. Je draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van content voor online vindbaarheid (SEO).

• Evenementen & Projectondersteuning: Je helpt bij de organisatie van inspirerende interne evenementen (zoals borrels, workshops en collega-activiteiten) en andere projecten die onze cultuur versterken. Dit omvat ondersteuning bij projectmanagement taken, zoals planning, coördinatie met diverse interne en externe stakeholders en het bewaken van deadlines.

• Social Impact: Je draagt bij aan projecten met maatschappelijke relevantie die aansluiten bij onze doelstellingen en een positieve impact maken.

• Analyse & Optimalisatie: Je helpt met het analyseren van markttrends, concurrentie en de prestaties van onze communicatie-uitingen, en draagt bij aan inzichten voor continue verbetering.

Wie ben jij? Jij bent een enthousiaste, open-minded en proactieve student(e) die gelooft in de kracht van verbinding. Je krijgt energie van het samenbrengen van mensen en ideeën, en je bent niet bang om de handen uit de mouwen te steken.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

• Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Marketing, Communicatie, Event Management, of een vergelijkbare studierichting.

• Je bent communicatief sterk in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk).

• Je bent creatief, leergierig en hebt een "get it done" mentaliteit.

• Je kunt zowel zelfstandig werken als goed functioneren in een team.

• Nieuwsgierigheid naar de laatste trends op het gebied van data, AI en media is een pluspunt.

• Ervaring met content creatie tools (bijv. Adobe Creative Suite) is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een uitdagende en leerzame stageplek bij een toonaangevend, mondiaal mediabedrijf in het hart van de AI-revolutie.

• De mogelijkheid om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan onze unieke bedrijfscultuur en maatschappelijke initiatieven.

• De kans om een breed netwerk op te bouwen binnen een dynamische en internationale organisatie.

• Een prachtig kantoor in Amsterdam met fantastische lunchmogelijkheden én een inspirerend uitzicht over de stad.

• Een stagevergoeding van € 450,- bruto per maand (bij een fulltime stage).

• Minimale duur: 5 maanden voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

• Startdatum: januari/februari 2027 (flexibel voor de juiste kandidaat).

• Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Krijg jij energie van het creëren van content, organiseren van evenementen en versterken van een unieke bedrijfscultuur? Dan is dit jouw kans om ervaring op te doen in een dynamische en internationale omgeving.

Let op: voor al onze stages geldt dat je gedurende jouw gehele stageperiode ingeschreven moet staan bij een opleidingsinstituut.

title: Designer, Social & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm, engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

This role is currently a Talent Pool, which means we are not actively interviewing — but plan to do so in the near future. We want to be transparent and cognizant of your time.

About the Role

This is a social content design role. You will own how Darkroom shows up visually on social media — carousels, static posts, content series, story templates, short-form video graphics, and campaign visuals across Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X.

You should understand what stops a scroll. You think about format constraints, platform behavior, and visual rhythm, not just aesthetics. You know that a carousel is a storytelling format, not a slide deck shrunk down. You know that a LinkedIn post image has a different job than an Instagram Reel cover.

You should also be a strong designer beyond social. You'll work on presentations, identity extensions, and marketing collateral.

You'll work closely with the VP, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to turn strategy and copy into design. This is a high-output role with real creative ownership — you won't just execute briefs. You'll concept visual systems, develop content series, and push the quality bar on everything that carries our name.

This is a fully remote role, EST hours (9 AM–5 PM).

What You'll Do

Social Content Design

•
Own the social content pipeline end-to-end: planning, narrative, storyboard, design, and iteration through approvals. Instagram is the priority platform, but you'll also design for LinkedIn, TikTok, and X.

•
Design carousels, static posts, story templates, short-form video graphics, and platform-native formats at a consistent weekly cadence. Carousels are a major format for Darkroom, and you should love making them.

•
Build visual systems and content series — repeatable frameworks and templates, not starting from scratch every time.

•
Hit content velocity targets. Consistency matters as much as quality.

•
Stay current on platform specs and in-feed trends and bring that into every asset.

•
Track performance and iterate. When something works, build on it. When it doesn't, diagnose and adjust.

•
Manage your own workstreams — flag blockers early and deliver on deadline.

Case Studies, Presentations, and Brand

•
Design case study visuals that turn client results into compelling proof points for sales and social.

•
Create assets for internal and external presentations: decks, pitch materials, and thought leadership visuals.

•
Maintain Darkroom's Figma-based brand system — templates, asset libraries, and scalable components.

•
Support identity work as the brand evolves: event branding, merch, and co-marketing materials.

You Should Apply If

•
You have 3+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or visual design.

•
Your portfolio leads with social work — carousel systems, content series, platform-native creative. If it's mostly logos and brand guides, this isn't the right fit.

•
You think in systems and understand how design performs on social: thumb-stops, pacing, format constraints, platform behavior.

•
You're fluent in Figma — scalable components, organized files, shared libraries.

•
You have strong typography and layout instincts across formats — a carousel slide and a presentation deck should both feel elevated.

•
You're a designer first who specializes in social, not a social media person who picked up Figma.

•
You're organized, accountable, and communicate your design thinking clearly.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

•
Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

•
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

•
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

•
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
CareerSwift is a technology company focused on making the job search process simpler, faster, and more effective. Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our product team and are looking for a thoughtful and user-focused Product Designer (UX/UI) to help us create simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences across the CareerSwift platform.

About the Role

As a Product Designer (UX/UI), you will work across the product design process, from understanding user needs and mapping user flows to creating wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Engineering teams to turn product requirements into practical and user-friendly experiences. Your work will directly contribute to how job seekers interact with CareerSwift's AI-powered tools and services.

Responsibilities

•
Design intuitive user experiences and interfaces across the CareerSwift platform.

•
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

•
Work with Product and Engineering teams to translate requirements into effective design solutions.

•
Conduct basic user research and use feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.

•
Maintain and contribute to design systems, reusable components, and UI guidelines.

•
Review implemented designs and collaborate with developers to ensure design quality.

•
Iterate on designs based on user feedback, product goals, and performance insights.

What We Are Looking For

•
1–3 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a related field.

•
Strong portfolio demonstrating web or digital product design.

•
Proficiency with Figma or similar design tools.

•
Good understanding of UX principles, user flows, wireframing, and responsive design.

•
Strong attention to detail and ability to balance user needs with business requirements.

•
Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other teams.

Nice to Have

•
Experience designing SaaS, AI, technology, or consumer digital products.

•
Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.

•
Experience conducting usability testing or analyzing user feedback.

•
Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how digital products are built.

Compensation

$60,000 - $80,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional benefits and employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.

What We Offer

•
Fully remote work environment.

•
Opportunity to shape the experience of an innovative AI-powered product.

•
Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

•
Opportunity to see your designs move from concept to real product.

•
Collaborative and supportive team environment.

•
Opportunities for professional growth as CareerSwift expands.

Apply today and help us create a simpler, smarter, and more intuitive job search experience.

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 60,000 - 80,000 USD (gross, annually)
