title: AI Native Creative Director - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
location: Remote (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Egypt, Estonia, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lebanon, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Turkey, United Arab Emirates)
description:
What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job. Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

1. Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

2. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

3. Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

4. Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

5. Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

6. Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy

•
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.

•
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.

•
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.

•
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.

•
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery

•
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.

•
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.

•
Deliver what you pitch.

•
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.

•
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents

•
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.

•
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.

•
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.

•
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.

4. Fuel the Growth Engine

•
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.

•
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.

•
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.

5. Go global, and keep the soul

•
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.

•
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

•
Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.

•
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.

•
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.

•
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

•
Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.

•
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.

•
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.

•
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.

•
No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Competitive Salary

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

Impact & Meaning

YOUR MISSION

As an Industrial Designer at Vesoma, you design a humanoid robot built to live and work beside people. You own the human side of the product: the surfaces, materials, and details people see and touch. You are involved in every stage of development and work at every scale, from the first impression to the smallest fastener.




You will join Vesoma's internal design studio. The studio owns everything from product strategy and early concepts to final CAD surfaces and brand assets. Your core is industrial design, but we look for range. A wide set of interests and skills lets you support needs across the whole company.






KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Shape how the robot looks and feels. Develop the design language from first sketch to production part. Keep it consistent across every part you touch.

 - Own your scope of the exterior. Design the outer surfaces assigned to you and make them work through the full range of motion. Define panel gaps, parting lines, and material intent. Solve pinch points, collisions, and cable routing with mechanical engineering. Hold fit and finish all the way to production.

 - Design for the people around it. Find every point where people meet the robot: handles, contact surfaces, indicators, controls. Map them early and design them on purpose.

 - Work alongside engineering, not after it. Partner with manufacturing and systems integration so every design can be prototyped fast and built at volume.

 - Carry the language past the robot. Packaging, accessories, and everything else people handle. Give them the same care.

 - Sketch, model, render, and prototype daily. Work on paper and in tools like Fusion 360, Blender, KeyShot, and Photoshop. Judge ideas in physical form when possible, not just on screen.

 - Present and own your work. Present directly to the Head of Design and stakeholders. Argue clearly for your ideas, take feedback on board, and plan the next steps.


YOUR PROFILE

We look for designers who are also makers. People who take on complex problems, take pride in their work, and hold precision as high as innovation and beauty.

 - Experience: 4+ years as an industrial designer, in-house or at a design studio or consultancy. We hire on the portfolio: range across product categories, depth in form and surface. An exceptional portfolio outweighs years.

 - Core Skills: Detailed, millimeter-precise CAD, including production-quality surfacing. Fast, clear sketching, on paper or digital. Renders that sell an idea in one image. Hands-on model making for rapid prototyping and mockups.

 - Mindset: You have exceptional taste and the range to use it: form, material, interaction, brand. You ask why a thing should exist before you decide how it looks. You are happy to do more than design work. You carry the agility of a startup and the rigor of a segment-leading design studio.

 - Parametric, T-spline, and surface modeling in Fusion 360.

 - Products that move: robotics, wearables, automotive, or consumer electronics.

 - Design for manufacture: injection molding, die casting, sheet metal, LSR.

 - Soft goods or hard-soft interfaces.

 - Graphic design, packaging, or art direction.

You are part of the design studio, but your role sits at the intersection of industrial design and mechanical engineering, holding the design's intent on one side and the system’s demands on the other. You carry the surface all the way into production.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Engineer the part behind the surface. Take the A-surface from industrial design and build the B-side behind it: wall thickness, ribs, bosses, draft, parting lines, fastening, clips.

 - Own surface quality through every trade. Continuity, highlights, radii, gaps, flushness. When engineering pushes back, know what the surface can give up and what it cannot.

 - Work in CAD and in the physical. Model parametrically and build physically. Iterate fast: prepare prototypes, print parts, and refine fit and finish in the hand.

 - Lead material and process selection for hard surfaces. Polymers, metals, coatings, and the processes that form them. Match each material to surface, structure, cost, and feel. Keep a working library of qualified materials, processes, and suppliers.

 - Take parts into production. Run sample rounds, DFM reviews, and tooling. Own fit and finish until the part ships.

You understand that our scope sometimes reaches beyond typical engineering work, and you are happy to help where needed. description:

This role is part of our Global Studios team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.

As part of DEPT’s Creative Automation team, you will bridge design teams, project management, and technical execution. In this role, you will lead creative automation campaigns, oversee integrated deliveries, and support hands-on data feed setup using Google Sheets to power our automated workflows. Working closely with designers, Creative Automation specialists, developers, account managers and external stakeholders, you will translate campaign briefs into efficient data schemas, streamline production pipelines, and ensure high-impact creative execution while maintaining agency profitability and technical integrity.

If you’re adept at problem-solving within data sets, have a passion for streamlining workflows, and are excited by the intersection of design and technology, this role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a highly relevant and evolving field.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Strong relationship management skills with the confidence to advise clients, partner with external suppliers, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Exceptional organizational and scheduling abilities to balance competing priorities, manage tight turnaround times, and hit deadlines consistently.

• Sharp attention to detail with an uncompromising standard for quality control across both data and creative output.

• Outstanding oral and written communication skills, skilled at translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and internal teams.

• Innate curiosity and drive to optimize processes, streamline workflows, and grow within a fast-evolving discipline.

Nice to have:

WE OFFER

WHY DEPT®?

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

title: STAGE – CMF Designer Textile & Apparel M/F/X
description:
Description de l'entreprise

Amer Sports est le leader mondial des équipementiers du sport avec les marques Salomon, Arc’teryx, Peak Performance, Atomic et Wilson.

Salomon SAS, « The Mountain Sport Company », est née en 1947 au cœur des Alpes et berceau de l’alpinisme moderne. Grâce à la passion du sport et un design innovant, Salomon a créé une vaste gamme de nouveaux concepts révolutionnaires en fixations, chaussures, skis et vêtements pour le ski alpin et nordique et a pu apporter des solutions innovantes dans le footwear, et les équipements pour le snowboard, la compétition, l’alpinisme, la randonnée, le trail running and bien d’autres sports.

Au travers de cette orientation vers la performance, Salomon innove et excelle sur les sports de montagne, en convertissant de nouvelles idées en produits et en repoussant les limites du possible. L’engagement, la culture et l’héritage de Salomon sont tous liés par un simple concept : chaque salarié peut faire de Salomon la marque de montagne de référence. Salomon s’engage de manière responsable pour l’outdoor au travers de son programme de développement durable. La diversité est l'une des cinq valeurs de Salomon, c'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à créer un environnement accessible à tous.

Le siège de Salomon est basé à Annecy (74), France et la filiale France est située à Villefontaine (38) à proximité de Lyon.

Description du poste

Tu es passionné.e par le design textile, les couleurs et les matières qui donnent leur caractère aux vêtements ?

Tu aimes explorer les textures, les imprimés et les finitions pour imaginer de nouvelles associations créatives ?

Tu aimerais contribuer à la création de l'identité visuelle et sensorielle des futures collections Apparel de Salomon ?

Si oui, ce stage pourrait bien t'intéresser !

_______________

Au sujet du CMF en design :

Le CMF, Color, Material & Finish, est une discipline du design qui consiste à définir l'identité visuelle et sensorielle d'un produit à travers le choix des couleurs, des matières et des finitions. Dans l'univers du textile et de l'habillement, le designer CMF donne vie aux collections en travaillant les associations de couleurs, les textures, les motifs, les imprimés et les aspects de surface. Il permet de créer une identité esthétique forte, tout en tenant compte des propriétés techniques des matières et des attentes des utilisateurs.

_______________

Tes missions

Au sein de l'équipe CMF (Color, Material & Finish) Apparel, tu contribueras à définir l'identité visuelle et sensorielle des futures collections textiles Salomon. Tu travailleras sur les couleurs, les matières, les textures, les imprimés et les finitions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Design et Développement Produit.

1. Couleurs, matières et finitions textiles

• Participer à la gestion et à la mise à jour des bibliothèques de couleurs, matières et échantillons.

• Explorer de nouvelles matières textiles, finitions et composants, en intégrant les enjeux de performance et de durabilité.

• Proposer des associations de couleurs et de matières cohérentes avec l'identité de Salomon.

• Participer à la création des palettes couleurs saisonnières et des moodboards CMF.

• Réaliser une veille créative et tendances autour des couleurs, matières, textures et finitions dans les univers de la mode et du textile.

2. Développement textile et graphique

• Explorer de nouvelles techniques de personnalisation et de finition textile.

• Analyser le rendu des couleurs, matières et imprimés afin de contribuer aux ajustements et validations.

• Préparer et suivre les essais d'impression textile (strike-offs) et les échantillons.

• Collaborer avec les designers graphiques pour décliner les inspirations et thèmes saisonniers sur les produits.

• Participer à la recherche et au développement de motifs, imprimés et graphismes textiles.

3. Collaboration et développement produit

• Participer à différents projets de développement en collaboration avec les équipes transverses.

• Réaliser des supports visuels, moodboards et présentations pour partager tes recherches et propositions.

• Apporter un soutien créatif et opérationnel à l'équipe CMF et aux équipes Apparel Design dans le développement des collections saisonnières.

_______________

Ce que ce stage pourra t'apporter

• Évoluer dans un environnement international et collaboratif.

• Apprendre à faire le lien entre créativité, esthétique et exigences techniques du développement produit.

• Explorer de nouveaux matériaux, textures, couleurs et procédés de finition.

• Contribuer concrètement à la création des futures collections Apparel Salomon.

• Découvrir les spécificités techniques des vêtements outdoor et les contraintes liées aux matières performantes.

• Développer ton expertise en CMF au contact de designers spécialisés dans le textile et l'habillement.

Qualifications

• Tu as un bon niveau d'anglais (B2/C1).

• Tu es curieux.se, créatif.ve, organisé.e, rigoureux.se et tu apprécies le travail en équipe.

• Tu maîtrises Adobe Photoshop et Illustrator. La connaissance de Clo3D, Substance ou d'autres outils 3D est un plus.

• Tu sais construire des moodboards, développer des pistes d'inspiration et proposer des palettes couleurs.

• Tu as une véritable sensibilité esthétique pour les couleurs, les textures, les motifs et les imprimés.

• Tu possèdes une bonne connaissance des matières textiles, de leurs structures, propriétés et procédés de fabrication ou de finition.

• Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 en design textile, design de mode, création textile ou design CMF, avec idéalement une spécialisation en matières et surfaces textiles.

_______________

Ton portfolio est indispensable et doit présenter des projets en lien avec le CMF (Color, Material & Finish), idéalement appliqué au textile et à l'habillement.

Nous souhaitons découvrir tes recherches et réalisations autour de :

Nous recherchons avant tout une véritable démarche CMF : un portfolio exclusivement orienté graphisme, identité visuelle ou design produit généraliste ne sera pas suffisant pour ce poste.

Une sensibilité pour l'univers du sport outdoor et de Salomon est un plus !

Informations supplémentaires

Contrat : Stage conventionné avec ton école

Lieu du stage : Annecy

Durée : 6 mois

Début de stage : Janvier/Février 2027

_______________

Chez Salomon les indemnités de stage se décomposent de la manière suivante :

Indemnités de stage :

• Bac à Bac + 3 : 700 € bruts

• Bac +4/+5 : 950 € bruts

• Doctorat : 1200 € bruts

Indemnités de logement :

300 € d'aide au logement sur présentation d'un bail de location trouvé à moins de 50 km de distance du siège et sur présentation des quittances chaque mois.

Avantages:

30% de réduction employés sur les ventes de nos articles

________________

Type de contrat :

Ce stage donne lieu à une convention de stage tripartite entre toi, ton établissement et l’entreprise. Celle-ci est obligatoire et le stage doit s'inscrire dans ton cursus. Les conventions non rattachées (achetées) à une inscription en cours de scolarité ne peuvent pas être acceptées.

Les candidats ressortissants de l’Union européenne peuvent postuler sans formalité particulière. Les candidats hors Union européenne doivent disposer, à la date de démarrage, d’un titre de séjour ou d’un visa en cours de validité les autorisant à réaliser un stage conventionné en France.

_______________

Diversité et inclusion :

La diversité est l'une de nos valeurs. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures selon les mêmes critères, liés uniquement aux compétences et à la motivation, sans considération de genre, d'origine, d'âge, de handicap, d'orientation ou de convictions. Notre processus de recrutement et notre environnement de travail sont pensés pour être accessibles à toutes et à tous. Si tu as besoin d'un aménagement à une étape du recrutement ou sur le poste, dis-le nous, nous trouverons ensemble la solution adaptée. Notre entreprise dispose également d'un référent handicap.

_______________

Prêt.e à rejoindre l'aventure ?

Envoie-nous ton CV et surtout ton portfolio pour nous faire découvrir ton univers créatif, tes recherches textiles et tes réalisations CMF. Nous avons hâte de découvrir ton talent !

title: Creative Director

title: Graphic Designer
description:

Our client started as a small digital magazine in Australia and grew into a global education and media company for founders. Today, their content reaches over 1M entrepreneurs each month through podcasts, courses, newsletters, events, social media, and their membership platform.

Their podcast has featured some of the biggest names in business, including Mark Cuban, Tim Ferriss, Tony Robbins, Richard Branson, Arianna Huffington, Seth Godin, Barbara Corcoran, Daymond John, Reid Hoffman, Simon Sinek, Alex Hormozi, Emma Grede, Neil Patel, Gary Vaynerchuk, and many more.

Now they need a talented Graphic Designer who can turn ideas, stories, and business insights into compelling visual content that stands out across digital platforms.

There are ideas to communicate, stories to tell, and an audience of entrepreneurs to capture.

Your job is to bring those ideas to life visually.

You design scroll-stopping social media graphics, create polished promotional assets, develop campaign visuals, and turn complex ideas into clear, engaging designs that feel unmistakably on-brand.

You might be creating Instagram carousels, podcast promotional graphics, YouTube thumbnails, email banners, or landing page visuals. Each design has a purpose: capture attention, communicate a message, and strengthen the brand.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the content and marketing teams, take creative direction, explore new visual approaches, and refine your work based on feedback and performance.

You end the day knowing your designs helped one of the world's leading entrepreneurship media brands connect with millions of founders.

What You'll Do

You will create high-quality visual assets that support our client's content, marketing, and brand initiatives.

You will:

•
Design engaging social media graphics, carousels, and promotional creatives

•

title: Senior Product Designer, International Commerce
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every individual to own their inner potential. The Oura Ring and its accompanying app help our global community gain a deeper understanding of their health, lifestyle, and sleep. The Commerce team makes that experience easy to discover, evaluate, and purchase across our direct-to-consumer website and other commercial channels.

Oura is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help make our international DTC experience first-class. This is an e-commerce-focused product design role with a clear growth mandate. You will take global DTC product work and make it relevant and compelling for non-US markets. That means more than translating pages or swapping images. You will design the local experience across content, creative, merchandising, experiments, payments, shipping, and checkout.You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Research, and market stakeholders. You will help us learn what should be consistent across markets, what should be adapted locally, and where local customer needs should change the product itself.This role reports to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

What You Will Do:

• Adapt global DTC journeys for international markets, balancing shared foundations with local customer needs, behaviors, and cultural context.

• Design market-specific experiences across discovery, merchandising, product evaluation, product detail, purchase, membership, and post-purchase.

• Partner with local market, Creative, and Marketing teams to localize campaigns, imagery, content, offers, and brand expression.

• Translate local customer insights, competitive patterns, and business needs into global product decisions and reusable market-launch patterns.

• Identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, average order value, attach rate, and customer confidence across international funnels; seek to reduce time to purchase cycle

• Define hypotheses, success metrics, and experiments across acquisition, landing pages, product pages, bundles, upsells, membership, and checkout.

• Use qualitative research, quantitative data, funnel analysis, customer feedback, and experiment results to prioritize work and guide product decisions.

• Design and evolve cart and checkout experiences that support local payment methods, currencies, taxes, duties, shipping, delivery estimates, returns, and regional requirements.

• Create clear experiences for availability, inventory constraints, payment and authentication states, order confirmation, and other operational edge cases.

• Ensure localization improves relevance without changing the meaning of the transaction, price, product, or order state.

• Produce user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and implementation-ready specifications within Oura’s design system, responsive, and accessibility standards.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, Payments, and Customer Care through critique, implementation, QA, launch, and post-launch iteration.

This role is a hybrid role out of our London office, with a preference for in-office 2 times a week.

This role will work across UK, EMEA, and US time zones, with a focus on our priority markets and creating a repeatable playbook for our emerging ones.

What you'll bring

• 5+ years of experience designing digital products, with meaningful experience for e-commerce, DTC, marketplaces, or other transactional products.

• Experience designing for international or multi-market products. This may include localization, internationalization, regional content, multi-currency, local payment methods, shipping, tax, duties, or returns.

• A portfolio that shows strong end-to-end product design, from problem framing and exploration through launch and iteration.

• Experience using AI tools like Figma Make, Claude, Cursor to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping, documentation, or production work is a plus.

• Able to connect design decisions to funnel behavior and business outcomes without reducing design to a single conversion metric.

• Experience designing and learning from experiments, A/B tests, or other structured product tests.

• Strong interaction and visual design craft, including responsive web design, content hierarchy, prototyping, and design systems.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills to build strong working relationships with market partners

• Curiosity about customer behavior across cultures and markets, with the humility to learn from local experts and customers.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary

• An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends & family

• Flexible working hours and remote working arrangements

• Wellness Time-Off

• Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

• Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.

• We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

title: Senior Creative Strategist - Creative - US Remote
description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Strategist who is equal parts sharp creative analyst and compelling storyteller: someone who can dig into performance data, figure out what is actually driving results, and turn that into test ideas and narratives that grow the business.

You know paid digital media from the inside. You understand how creative is served, scaled, and judged across Google App Campaigns, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and programmatic, and you can hold your own with growth marketers who challenge ideas based on what they see in performance trends. When the numbers push back, you can explain why, and propose what to test next.

You think big, but you understand how ideas come to life within paid media environments. You’re confident presenting to clients and internal teams, able to communicate strategy with clarity, charisma, and conviction. You enjoy collaborating closely with other strategists, growth marketers, and cross-functional partners to build strong, insight-driven creative platforms.

You’re comfortable working in ambiguity, connecting dots across audience behavior, culture, and performance signals to shape strategy that is both inspiring and executable.

This role sits at the intersection of insight, creativity, performance, and execution. You’ll partner closely with Associate Creative Strategy Directors, growth marketers, and cross-functional teams to elevate thinking and deliver work that performs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Creative Analysis & Testing

• Dig into creative performance data to identify what is driving results: winning hooks, formats, messages, visual patterns, and audience signals.

• Turn analysis into clear, high-impact test ideas with sharp hypotheses, prioritized by expected impact and past learnings.

• Own and evolve creative testing roadmaps and learning agendas that drive growth, not just activity.

• Run creative audits that combine performance analysis, competitive research, and audience insight.

• Pressure-test ideas with growth marketers and media teams, defending a point of view with data and adjusting when the evidence says otherwise.

• Document and share learnings so performance signals consistently feed back into new briefs and production.

Strategic Development & Storytelling

• Develop creative strategies grounded in audience insight, cultural signals, and performance learnings.

• Translate research, data, and platform knowledge into clear briefs and messaging frameworks.

• Craft compelling narratives that explain what is driving performance and guide creative ideation toward business goals.

• Present strategic thinking and test results confidently to clients and internal teams.

• Ensure ideas are both big-picture and executable within paid media channels.

• Write clear, persuasive briefs and presentations that elevate creative direction.

Collaboration & Execution

• Partner with Associate Creative Strategy Directors and fellow strategists to build and refine strategy.

• Work hand-in-hand with growth marketers, Analytics, Media, and Creative teams to ensure strategy is grounded in proof and feasibility.

• Support creative ideation by connecting concepts back to audience insight, intent, and performance data.

• Participate in brainstorms and workshops, helping shape ideas that ladder to strategy.

Craft & Growth

• Stay current on platform changes, ad formats, and best practices across Google App Campaigns, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and programmatic.

• Stay curious about emerging cultural trends, storytelling formats, and digital platforms.

• Continuously refine analysis, storytelling, writing, and presentation craft.

• Apply learnings from campaign performance to inform future strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

• 4+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative, content/comms strategy, or performance marketing with a creative focus.

• A proven track record of creative analysis and testing: you’ve built testing roadmaps, written strong hypotheses, and can point to tests that moved key metrics.

• Hands-on familiarity with paid digital media, including Google App Campaigns (UAC), Meta, TikTok, Snap, and programmatic, and how creative is evaluated and optimized on each.

• Comfort reading performance data (e.g., CTR, CVR, CPA/CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates) and turning it into clear creative recommendations.

• Strong storytelling ability with excellent writing and presentation skills.

• Confidence and presence when presenting strategy to clients, growth marketers, and internal teams, including holding a POV when it’s challenged.

• Ability to think conceptually while grounding ideas in execution realities.

• Collaborative mindset and comfort working in partnership with senior strategists.

• Experience writing strategy for B2C brands; tech or app experience is a plus.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and turning inputs into clear direction.

ADDITIONAL THINGS THAT WILL IMPRESS US:

• A natural storyteller who brings energy and clarity to every room.

• A sharp creative analyst who spots the pattern behind the numbers before anyone else does.

• A steady stream of smart, specific test ideas, and a bias toward learning fast.

• Strategic thinking that connects insight to actionable creative direction.

• Strong creative instincts paired with deep performance awareness.

• Experience with app growth or user acquisition creative.

• Curiosity, initiative, and a desire to keep improving craft.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• PTO

Vi gillar när det ser enkelt ut. Vi vet hur mycket arbete som ligger bakom. Som UX Designer hos oss kombinerar du design och teknik för att göra komplexa behov till genomtänkta, användarvänliga lösningar. Från tidiga idéer till färdiga digitala produkter.

Du är nyfiken på hur människor tänker och agerar, och vill förstå sammanhanget som en produkt ska fungera i. Du trivs med att utforska möjligheter tillsammans med andra, testa dina antaganden och låta insikterna påverka designen.

Som konsult arbetar du nära våra kunder och hjälper dem att förena användarnas behov med verksamhetens mål och tekniska förutsättningar. Du bidrar med ditt perspektiv, förklarar dina designbeslut och skapar samsyn kring vägen framåt.

Du blir en del av vårt affärsområde Hardware & Design, där vi kombinerar bred ingenjörskompetens med djup specialistkunskap och ett användarcentrerat arbetssätt. Tillsammans utvecklar vi fysiska produkter och digitala upplevelser, från koncept till storskalig produktion.

Det här kommer du att göra

Du arbetar genom hela UX-processen, i nära samarbete med kunder, utvecklare och andra designers. Dina arbetsuppgifter varierar mellan uppdragen och kan bland annat innebära att:

•
Utforska och förstå användarnas behov och kundens verksamhet genom research och workshops.

•
Omsätta insikter till koncept, användarflöden, wireframes och prototyper.

•
Utforma tydliga och tillgängliga gränssnitt med fokus på interaktion och visuell kvalitet.

•
Planera och genomföra användartester samt vidareutveckla lösningar utifrån resultaten.

•
Använda och vidareutveckla designsystem och komponentbibliotek.

•
Presentera och motivera designbeslut samt leda samskapande workshops.

Det här tar du med dig

Du har en trygg grund inom UX och är van att driva ditt arbete framåt tillsammans med andra. Du lyssnar, delar med dig av din kunskap och kan göra dina resonemang begripliga för människor med olika bakgrund och kompetens.

Vi söker dig som har:

•
Relevant akademisk utbildning inom design.

•
Minst tre års erfarenhet som UX Designer, interaktionsdesigner eller Produkt Designer.

•
Erfarenhet av hela UX-processen, från research och konceptutveckling till prototyper, användartester och iteration.

•
Erfarenhet av kundnära arbete i agila, tvärfunktionella team.

•
Erfarenhet av designsystem och digital tillgänglighet enligt WCAG.

•
God förståelse för visuell design och förmåga att skapa tydliga och tilltalande gränssnitt.

•
Erfarenhet från exempelvis medtech, fordonsindustrin, försvarsindustrin eller offentlig sektor.

•
Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska, i tal och skrift.

En spännande resa med Knightec Group
Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det?

Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling.

På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort.

För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt.

Låter det som platsen för dig? Häng med på vår fortsatta resa!

Praktisk information

Detta är en tillsvidareanställning med en provanställning på sex månader, placerad på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Resor i tjänsten kan förekomma till våra kunder. Startdatum är så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast 12 december 2026. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Mikael Westh, Talent Acquisition Specialist. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida för att säkerställa en trygg hantering av dina personuppgifter.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Designer
description:
With a crafted and collaborative approach, AKQA (part of WPP) design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns and meaningful impact for our clients.

Our Product Designers play essential roles in the strategy, design, and optimisation of beautiful ideas, products, and services. They bring intelligent thought and craft, developing and delivering projects from brief to end user.

As a Mid Product Designer in our Paris design product team, you will have the opportunity to create impact through imagining and shaping the design of products, services, and platforms for globally renowned companies. Your work will help establish distinctive digital experiences, from defining new visual languages to designing intuitive user journeys across multiple brands and touchpoints, reaching millions of users.

For this particular role, you should possess strong visual design craft skills, balanced with a solid understanding of UX and digital product logic. You will be comfortable taking ownership of design deliverables, translating briefs into thoughtful design solutions, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to bring ideas to life. You will work closely with senior designers, product strategists, and engineers, contributing to the evolution of our design systems and the quality of our digital products.

We are also looking for someone curious about the evolving relationship between design and technology. You should be familiar with the latest AI-powered design and development workflows, particularly the use of Figma MCP connected to tools such as Claude Code, to explore ideas, work with design systems, and rapidly build interactive prototypes. We value designers who embrace new ways of working and understand how these tools can improve both the creative process and the quality of the final product.

ROLE REQUIREMENT

• Take ownership of defined design projects and workstreams, translating briefs and business requirements into thoughtful, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

• Contribute to the definition and evolution of the art direction & branding, visual language, and core value propositions of the digital experiences we build.

• Demonstrate strong UI and visual design skills, with particular attention to layout, typography, composition, colour, interaction details, and overall design polish.

• Apply a solid understanding of UX principles to create intuitive, accessible, and user-centred digital experiences, balancing user needs with business objectives and technical constraints.

• Translate user research, feedback, and insights into meaningful design opportunities, working closely with UX Strategy, and Analytics teams.

• Contribute to the development, maintenance, and operationalisation of scalable design systems, including components, patterns, variables, and documentation across multiple platforms and brand touchpoints.

• Work confidently with Figma, making effective use of its advanced features, including Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, and prototyping capabilities.

• Stay curious and up to date with emerging design and development workflows, particularly AI-powered tools and agentic workflows.

• Be familiar with Figma MCP and its integration with Claude Code, understanding how to connect design files with AI coding tools to leverage existing components, design tokens, and design system structures.

• Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate design exploration, build quick interactive prototypes, test ideas, and bring concepts closer to working digital experiences.

• Collaborate closely with developers to ensure design intent is properly translated into implementation, maintaining consistency, quality, and attention to detail throughout delivery.

• Confidently communicate, present, and explain design decisions, concepts, and prototypes to peers, project teams, and clients.

• Actively participate in design reviews, welcome constructive feedback, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team's creative output.

• Work collaboratively with Product Designers, Product Strategists, and Engineers to maintain a coherent product vision.

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• 3+ Years of Experience: Proven experience in a Product Design or UI/UX Design role, ideally within a creative agency, digital product studio, or fast-paced digital environment.

• Strong Visual Craft: A good eye for detail and a genuine passion for visual design, typography, composition, and the refinement of digital interfaces.

• Solid UX Understanding: A clear understanding of user-centred design principles, interaction patterns, information architecture, and digital product logic.

• Product Mindset: Able to look beyond individual screens and understand how different elements work together to create coherent, useful, and engaging product experiences.

• Design System Familiarity: Practical experience working with component-based design systems, understanding their structure, purpose, and importance in creating consistent and scalable digital products.

• Technologically Curious: An interest in emerging technologies and the changing design landscape. Familiarity with Figma MCP, Claude Code, and AI-assisted prototyping workflows is particularly valuable.

• Ownership & Initiative: Able to independently manage assigned tasks and projects, take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and know when to seek guidance or challenge an approach.

• Collaborative Mindset: Comfortable working alongside different disciplines, sharing ideas, giving and receiving feedback, and contributing positively to a team environment.

• English speaker: A decent working level of English, with the ability to participate in conversations, present work, and explain design thinking and decisions clearly. Fluency is not required, but confidence in communicating ideas is important.

• Curious & Ambitious: Eager to learn, experiment, challenge existing ways of working, and continuously develop both design craft and technical knowledge.

AKQA is committed to developing wellbeing and supporting life choices for our team. We provide an extensive range of benefits. To find out more click here.

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Founder Brand & Thought Leadership Lead (US)
description:
Founder Brand & Thought Leadership Lead (US)

Location: Remote, US-based (San Francisco, CA preferred)

Type: Full-time or long-term contractor

Reports to: Marc Tuscher, Co-Founder & CTO




ABOUT US AND THE ROLE

Sereact builds AI software that lets robots see, understand and handle objects in real-world warehouses. We are growing fast in the US, and we want our co-founder Marc Tuscher to become one of the most recognized voices in physical AI and warehouse automation there.

You will own that mission end to end. You will run his presence on LinkedIn and X, get him into the right podcasts, publications and stages, and turn every appearance into content. Think of yourself as his chief of staff for public voice, not a social media scheduler. This is not a classic marketing role: you won't run ads, campaigns or lead generation. Your job is to build trust and authority around one person, mostly through earned media that can't be bought.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the narrative. Define 2–3 core themes and a clear point of view for Marc, together with him and our leadership team.

 - Run LinkedIn and X. Draft, edit and publish posts in his voice, several times a week. Engage with comments, build relationships with relevant voices and grow a following among US operations, supply chain and robotics leaders.

 - Tell Sereact's stories every day. Collect daily wins, milestones and behind-the-scenes stories from all Sereact locations and customer sites (new deployments, robots going live, customer results, the people behind them) and tell them through Marc's eyes: what he learned, what surprised him, why it matters for the industry. Work with our teams and customers on approvals, photos and video, within customer confidentiality.

 - Book podcasts. Identify the right shows in AI, robotics, logistics, manufacturing and startups, pitch hosts and prepare him for each recording.

 - Land bylines and press. Find target publications (trade and business media), pitch op-eds and interviews, and work with journalists and, if needed, a PR agency.

 - Secure stages. Get him speaking slots at US conferences, trade shows and industry dinners, and submit award and list nominations.

 - Repurpose everything. Turn each podcast, talk or article into clips, posts and newsletter content.

 - Measure what matters. Track reach within our target audience, inbound leads, media mentions and booked appearances, and report monthly.


HOW YOU WORK WITH OUR MARKETING TEAM

Our marketing team owns the Sereact brand, website, campaigns, trade show booths and lead generation. You own Marc's personal voice and his earned media: his LinkedIn and X accounts, podcasts, bylines, interviews and talks.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/e0cbe9e9-09d7-4021-a33e-0b9315b1164c/b61be6a3-e64e-4707-9f09-449536730ba6/Screenshot%202026-11-16%20at%2010.57.16.png]

Stories, approvals and big moments are planned together in the middle; each side then tells them in its own voice and is measured on its own results.

 - You share customer stories and milestones with marketing, so one story can live on Marc's account and on Sereact's channels without duplicate work.

 - You align with marketing on key moments such as product launches, funding news and major trade shows, and plan his appearances around them.

 - Customer approvals run through one shared process, so customers are asked once, not twice.

 - Your success is measured differently: not by leads or ad performance, but by appearances, media mentions, reach among US decision-makers and the inbound conversations he gets as a result.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in executive communications, founder branding, PR or journalism, ideally in tech or deep tech. A background mainly in performance or campaign marketing is not what we're looking for.

 - A track record of building a founder's or executive's presence on LinkedIn and/or X, with examples and numbers you can show us.

 - An existing network of podcast hosts, journalists, editors or event organizers in the US.

 - Excellent writing in American English: you can capture someone else's voice and make technical topics sharp and human.

 - Strong judgment on what to say and what not to say publicly.

 - Self-starter mindset: you work independently across time zones with a team based in Germany.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in robotics, AI, logistics, supply chain or manufacturing.

 - Short-form video skills (editing clips for LinkedIn, X and YouTube).

 - Experience with newsletters (Substack, beehiiv) or running a podcast.

 - Knowledge of US industry events such as ProMat, MODEX, Automate or CES.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Direct, daily work with a founder at a fast-growing AI and robotics company.

 - Real ownership: you shape the strategy, not just execute it.

 - Budget for tools, travel to US events and occasional trips to our team in Germany.

 - Flexible, remote-first setup.

 - Competitive salary and benefits


HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and 2–3 examples of executives or founders whose presence you built, with the results. Tell us in a few sentences how you would position Marc in his first 90 days.

title: Brand Designer VG
description:
Vil du være med å forme det visuelle uttrykket til Mediehuset VG?

VG er i utvikling, og med VGTV bygger vi en enda sterkere satsing på sport, underholdning og aktualitet. Nå ser vi etter en kreativ og operativ Brand Designer som vil være med å utvikle og produsere visuelt innhold som engasjerer, bygger merkevare og skaper gjennomslag.

Stillingen er et prosjektbasert vikariat på 12 måneder

Du blir en del av VGs markedsavdeling og får en sentral rolle i å utvikle det visuelle uttrykket for både VG og VGTV. Du vil jobbe tett med Head of Brand i VG om merkevareidentitet og visuelle prinsipper, og med Head of Marketing & Growth VGTV om kampanjer, distribusjon og markedsleveranser. Stillingen vil rapportere til Markedsdirektør i VG.

Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer sterke kreative ideer med evnen til å produsere og levere i høyt tempo og på tvers av mange flater.

Dette vil du jobbe med

•
Utvikle og produsere visuelle identiteter for VGTV-programmer innen sport, underholdning og aktualitet.

•
Designe key art, programgrafikk, thumbnails og annet visuelt materiell til programmer og lanseringer.

•
Produsere kreativt kampanje- og promomateriell for VG og VGTV, tilpasset ulike kanaler og formater.

•
Bidra aktivt i idé- og konseptutvikling sammen med markedsteamet, redaksjonelle miljøer og eksterne partnere.

•
Videreutvikle det visuelle uttrykket til VG og VGTV i tråd med merkevarestrategien og i tett samarbeid med Head of Brand.

•
Bruke AI aktivt i kreativ utvikling og produksjon, og bidra til smartere og mer effektive arbeidsprosesser.

Vi ser etter deg som

•
Har solid erfaring med grafisk design, digital design og visuell konseptutvikling.

•
Har erfaring med å produsere visuelt materiell til kampanjer, innhold eller underholdningsformater.

•
Behersker relevante designverktøy og har god forståelse for motion, video og digitale flater.

•
Har sterk visuell teft, høy gjennomføringsevne og trives med å jobbe operativt.

•
Er både kreativ, selvstendig og god til å samarbeide.

•
Du har gode ideer, men trives aller best med å være med å skape og produsere

Hvorfor VG?

Hos oss får du være med å forme fremtidens VG og VGTV. Du får jobbe tett på noen av Norges sterkeste redaksjonelle og kreative miljøer, med spennende programmer, store sportsøyeblikk og innhold som engasjerer hele Norge.

Du får hele VG-maskineriet i ryggen, en av Norges sterkeste merkevarer, med enorm rekkevidde, kraftfulle distribusjonskanaler og muligheten til å nå ut til millioner av mennesker.

Her får du ikke bare utvikle gode ideer. Du får muligheten til å gjøre dem synlige, skape engasjement og sette ditt kreative preg på noen av Norges største mediesatsinger.

title: Creative Director (Video Ads)
description:
Why should you join Jerry?

•
Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).

•
Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.

•
Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.

•
Bring sharp visual craft and creative energy to Jerry's video output — from concept through final cut.

About the Role

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners' needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we're just getting started.

We're looking for a Creative Director (Video) with a strong visual eye and a genuine curiosity about performance creative. Someone who cares deeply about craft, moves fast, and is excited by how AI and new media are reshaping what great advertising looks like. You'll work closely with senior creative leads to concept, produce, and iterate video ads across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV — learning and contributing at every stage of the process.

Why you will (or won't) like working here:

Large canvas: You won't inherit a set-in-stone playbook. You'll have real creative input and contribute meaningfully to our brand foundation early in your career.

Hands-on from day one: This isn't a support role. You'll be concepting, editing, and iterating — using AI tools and your own creative instincts to ship work that performs.

Car ownership is not "sexy": Insurance, maintenance, and safety are only topics people think about when they have a bill to pay or a flat tire to change. Can you build enthusiasm and trust around a "dry" topic? That's the creative challenge here.

What You'll Do

•
Concept and produce video creative across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels — working end-to-end from brief to delivery under the guidance of senior creative leads.

•
Lead a small and nimble team

•
Bring a sharp visual eye to every asset: elevating composition, pacing, and storytelling to raise Jerry's brand while keeping performance top of mind.

•
Stay on top of platform trends, formats, and cultural shifts to ensure Jerry's creative stays fresh and effective.

•
Develop hooks, angles, and visual frameworks rooted in what drives real performance — not just what looks good.

•
Edit video directly: fluent in editing tools and comfortable cutting, iterating, and polishing ads at speed.

•
Leverage AI tools (for ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, etc.) to accelerate workflows and expand creative range.

•
Collaborate closely with media, growth, and senior creative teammates to turn performance signals into stronger creative work.

What We're Looking For

•
8+ years in video creative, art direction, or production — at a performance agency, in-house growth team, or content studio.

•
A growing track record contributing to video creative for paid channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, etc.).

•
Strong visual instincts — you have an eye for design, composition, pacing, and brand quality.

•
Video editing fluency — you can cut and iterate ads yourself, making them feel polished without heavy direction.

•
Performance creative curiosity — you understand (or are actively learning) what makes people stop scrolling: hooks, pacing, CTAs.

•
Collaborative and eager mindset — comfortable in fast-paced environments and open to feedback from creative and analytics teams alike.

•
AI fluency — you experiment with generative tools to speed up production and expand what's creatively possible.

•
Bonus: exposure to both performance and brand creative contexts. You're building a point of view on how craft and conversion can coexist.

Why This Role Matters

Jerry's creative team has proven performance chops — and we're ready to level up. This role is an opportunity to grow fast inside a creative engine that blends craft, data, AI, and media strategy. You'll be hands-on from day one, contributing real work that reaches millions of people — and building the skills and portfolio to grow into a senior creative leader.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $180K - $210K

title: UI Designer - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

•
Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

•
Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

•
Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

•
Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

•
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

•
Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

•
Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

•
Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

•
2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

•
Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

•
Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

•
Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

•
Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

•
