title: Creative Director, Brand Studio
description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand Studio, to help us build a brand that carries our lineage forward, from the early days of building on the web to the future of designing new worlds online. You’ll steward our brand’s evolution as we introduce Source by Webflow and bring it to marketing teams looking for a new home to run their business. More of Webflow’s brand will soon be made by marketers and AI agents, not only by designers. That makes the brand system the product. You’ll set the creative bar, own our biggest brand surfaces, and build the system that lets everyone else make work that is on-brand by default.

You'll lead a multi-disciplinary senior design studio of brand, web and motion designers who design and build digital and event marketing. You'll sit in Design, next to the teams that build the product like Webflow and Source. Expect to spend about half your time on craft: setting direction, running crit, and doing hands-on work. The rest goes to brand marketing strategy and to running the studio.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - Location: Remote-first (United States)

 - Full-time

 - Permanent 

 - Exempt

 - The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.
   
   - United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
     
     - Zone A: $212,000-$265,000
     
     - Zone B: $195,000-$244,000
     
     - Zone C: $178,000-$223,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.

 

Please visit our Careers page https://webflow.com/careers#pay-zones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

 

 - Application Information:
   
   - Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
   
   - This posting is for an existing vacancy

 - Reporting to the VP of Design.

 

As a Creative Director, Brand Studio, you'll …

 - Set the direction for Webflow’s brand: its identity, voice and story, across web, launches, campaigns, motion, events, recruiting and the product itself. Hold the quality bar and decide what ships. Lead by making when it matters: concepts, art direction and identity work for flagship moments.

 - Elevate webflow.com http://webflow.com as our biggest brand surface. Partner with Growth, Events, and Marketing so it looks great, performs well and is easy for other teams to extend.

 - Encode taste into our harness. Turn guidelines, templates, skills, and agents into a design operating system within our harness. Encode the reasons behind key decisions into self-serve paths that let non-designers make on-brand work, until most routine requests no longer need a designer. Run these tools like products, and run the quality loop: define “good,” set up reviews and evals for generated work, and send each gap back into the system.

 - Build the studio’s operating system: intake, briefs, reviews, decisions and production. Decide with marketing and product leaders what the studio makes by hand, what becomes self-serve, and what it declines. Bring in agencies, freelancers and production partners when the work calls for it.

 - Deliver brand-defining initiatives each year, starting with how our brand evolves as our product and platform change. Fold the best decisions from each one back into the system.

 - Partner with senior leaders in Marketing, Product Design, the design system team, EPD, Recruiting and executive leadership so the brand feels like one experience everywhere. Measure the studio by outcomes, not by how many assets it makes.

 - Lead, coach and grow a multi-disciplinary senior team. Lead exceptional designers, help everyone do the best work of their career, build a bench of future leaders, and shape new roles, such as creative technologist or design engineer, as the work changes.

 


ABOUT YOU:

Requirements:

 - BS / BA college degree or relevant experience

 - 12+ years in brand and creative work, with 4+ years leading designers

 - A portfolio of brand systems, campaigns or brand evolutions you led end to end

 - Strong web craft. You have led brand-defining sites and you know how they are built. Webflow experience is strongly preferred
   
   
   
   You'll thrive as a Creative Director, Brand Studio if you:
   
   - Have a clear point of view on the future of creative work. You’ve shipped major rebrands and redesigns, and you know how to push the limits of the imagination.
   
   - Have exceptional craft across typography, color, layout, motion and identity, and you raise the level of other people’s work. You can say why a piece is a 6 and what it needs to be a 10.
   
   - Think in systems. You can explain a brand decision well enough that someone else, or an agent, can apply it to a case you never designed.
   
   - Have strong operational instincts. You’ve built creative processes that scale, and you can describe them clearly.
   
   - Lead like an owner. You focus on outcomes, set clear priorities, build alignment without relying on authority, and are comfortable saying no.
   
   - Grow people. You’ve hired exceptional designers and built teams where people do their best work and stay. You give and receive direct feedback with care, and you lead with low ego and curiosity.
   
   - Stay curious and open to growth by demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.




OUR CORE BEHAVIORS

 - Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

 - Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

 - Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

 - Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

 


BENEFITS

 - Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

 - Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

 - Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

 - Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

 - Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

 - Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

 - Stipends to support our distributed team. Localized support for cell, Wi-Fi, and WFH expenses to help you settle into your best remote life.

 - Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

 


BE YOU, WITH US

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed https://webflow.com/diversity-equity-inclusion to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 


STAY CONNECTED

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog https://webflow.com/blog, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/webflow-inc-/, X (Twitter) https://twitter.com/webflow, and/or Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Webflow-Reviews-E890506.htm.

 


PLEASE NOTE:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

Webflow uses AI tools to assist in screening and evaluating applications. AI does not make final hiring decisions. For details on how we process your personal information, see Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice https://webflow.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice.

title: Production Designer (6m FTC)
description:
Production Designer (6m FTC)

London or Manchester, Hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of our Global Studios team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support both the design development and delivery of web experiences for a large-scale eCommerce platform that will set the standards for others to follow. Bringing together creativity, curiosity and meticulous attention to detail, this role is a crucial bridge between idea and execution. You are design focused, tech savvy, detail-oriented, excellent at collaborating and multitasking, and eager to be part of a team that makes things come to life. This includes bringing as much enthusiasm for design as you do for production, repurposing, resizing and leveraging design systems. You are inspired by technology and the role brands play in culture today.

This person will regularly exercise discretion and independent judgement and will be involved in designing digital experiences, lifestyle, and technology content to create experiences that deeply connect with people. You possess a strong design intuition and want to continue to learn, grow and challenge yourself. You also have a strong desire to ensure that clients are extremely satisfied with our services and products. In addition, you possess strong problem-solving skills and a track record of success.

You will have a hand in both designing web pages within the framework of a large Design System and ensuring that visual assets are perfectly processed for web-readiness and hand off for build

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES;

• Supporting web page design and build. You’ll collaborate with a team of designers to bring our digital designs to life by fine tuning visual assets and preparing them for build primarily using Figma and Photoshop.

• Digital asset delivery: With an exacting eye, ensure that layouts and assets are pixel perfect paying close attention to specs, file weight and compression levels.

• Organize and communicate designs: Receive asset handoffs, organize them, export and compress, then communicate effectively so they can be easily referenced and integrated by content managers and engineering teams.

• Optimize and compress assets: Balance image quality and file weight for responsive viewports.

• Quality assurance: Perform visual QA, focusing on asset quality as it interacts with code and design systems.

• Innovate and improve: Implement efficient working processes for asset production and enhance communication methods.

• Build presentations, craft documentation and deliver asset kits to developers and other team members.

• Design, repurpose and package regional kits for global regions.

• Acts as a team player by contributing to the creative execution of the company’s efforts and putting the client and the team before yourself.

• Responsible for bringing a point-of-view with fresh perspectives to the team.

• Take on other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

• Work with minimal processes in place, solving problems by being optimistic and using proactive thought processes and skills.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

• Relevant experience working in design focused on web/digital platforms.

• Design eye: A keen eye for design, including composition and visual balance; zero tolerance for design inconsistencies.

• Design tool mastery:

• Figma or similar tools - proven experience using components and design system libraries.

• Photoshop, from a technical perspective - understanding layer interactions such as blending mode, masking, artboards, smart objects; export settings and computer graphics (not to be confused with graphic design).

• Organizational skills: Strong organizational skills and attention to detail while managing large volumes of assets.

• Graphics knowledge: Familiarity with static computer graphics (raster and vector), including image scaling, resolution, compression, and file formats.

• Interpersonal skills: Strong desire to collaborate with peers across departments to manage issues.

• Problem solver: Ability to react quickly in a fast-paced environment and apply situational problem-solving.

• Self-management: Strong self-management skills to balance workload and identify when to seek support.

• Dedicates time to understand the requested task, or feedback and decisions being made. Isn’t afraid to ask questions to ensure clarity for informed decision making.

• Additional Design Tools: Familiarity with After Effects & Illustrator are a big bonus

• Web development basics: Light familiarity with front-end development, including HTML, CSS, and static vs. dynamic web pages.

• Project management tools: Job ticketing in platforms such as JIRA, Asana, Trello

• Dev tools: Ability to navigate the inspector panel on Chrome to check CSS properties for QA purposes.

• Technical communication: Ability to communicate expectations clearly with technical teams.

• Video format knowledge: Willingness to develop understanding of motion format conversion and compression.

• Efficiency enthusiast: A mindset for scalability, and interest in leveraging tools to automate work

WE OFFER

• A flexible hybrid working policy to enjoy the best of both worlds (2 days from the office, depending on location).

• Early Finish Fridays, kickstart your weekend early with alternating early-finish Fridays.

• 26 days paid holiday, plus UK Bank Holidays.

• Access to dedicated mental health resources including enhanced sick pay scheme, employee assistance programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders.

• Company Pension Scheme.

• Access to a Private Medical Insurance or Cash Plan scheme.

• Season Ticket Loan, interest-free Season Ticket Loans to help spread the cost of travel.

• Cycle to Work Scheme, save money on a new bike and equipment.

• EV Car Scheme, access to an electric vehicle via a salary sacrifice arrangement.

• Enhanced family-friendly policies to support parents.

• Workplace Nursery Scheme, save on childcare by paying for nursery fees through a tax-efficient salary sacrifice scheme.

• DEPT® Allowance, a dedicated company contribution to spend on either your professional development or personal wellbeing.

• Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.

• Learning and Development, continuous growth opportunities through internal training, and "inspirational talks” guest speakers.

• Buddy Program, you will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you navigate your first weeks’ at DEPT®.

• A Certified BCorp Agency and is multi-award winning “Agency of the Year”.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global, at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• Global DEPT® Cares Month, an annual initiative where our teams donate their professional skills and time to support local charities and pr-bono projects.

•

WHO ARE WE?

We are pioneers at heart. What does that mean? We are always looking forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 30+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients problems, no matter where you are in the world.

DEPT® is committed to making a positive impact on the planet and since 2021 has been Climate Neutral and B Corporation certified.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX (Senior UX Researcher &
description:
Job Title: Chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX (Senior UX Researcher &

Job Location: Kirkland, Quebec, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX (Senior UX Researcher & Designer)

À propos d’IQVIA

IQVIA est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines de l’analytique avancée, des solutions technologiques et des services de recherche clinique destinés aux secteurs des sciences de la vie et des soins de santé. En combinant les données de santé, l’expertise sectorielle, les technologies de pointe et l’innovation alimentée par l’intelligence artificielle, IQVIA aide ses clients à accélérer le développement et la commercialisation de traitements médicaux, à améliorer les résultats pour les patients et à faire progresser les soins de santé à l’échelle mondiale.

Au sein du Centre des sciences des données appliquées (Applied Data Science Center) d’IQVIA, des équipes multidisciplinaires travaillent à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la recherche clinique, de la science des données et du développement de produits afin de concevoir des solutions innovantes qui optimisent la prise de décision, l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’expérience des utilisateurs à travers l’écosystème de la santé.

Sommaire du poste

IQVIA est à la recherche d’un(e) chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX pour diriger les initiatives de recherche et de conception de l’expérience utilisateur de bout en bout pour des solutions technologiques cliniques alimentées par l’intelligence artificielle au sein du Centre des sciences des données appliquées.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior en contribution individuelle qui exige une personne capable de travailler de façon autonome, de naviguer efficacement dans des contextes ambigus et de collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires en gestion de produits, ingénierie, science des données, recherche clinique et opérations commerciales. La personne retenue favorisera l’adoption de pratiques de conception centrées sur l’utilisateur et fondées sur des données probantes afin de créer des expériences intuitives, fiables et évolutives.

Le rôle contribuera également à l’évolution des Tiny Teams opérant selon le Modèle opérationnel agentique d’IQVIA (IQVIA Agentic Operating Model), une dérivation du processus Delta-Echo/FDE. La personne sélectionnée jouera un rôle clé dans la transformation de flux de travail cliniques, opérationnels et assistés par l’IA en expériences numériques significatives favorisant l’adoption, l’efficacité et une meilleure prise de décision.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger les activités de recherche UX et de conception tout au long du cycle de vie des produits, y compris la découverte, la définition des problèmes, la planification de la recherche, la synthèse des résultats, l’idéation, le prototypage, la validation, le déploiement et l’amélioration continue.

• Planifier et mener des recherches qualitatives et quantitatives afin de comprendre les besoins, les comportements, les flux de travail, les irritants et les contextes décisionnels des utilisateurs.

• Traduire les résultats de recherche en recommandations concrètes, orientations de conception et exigences produit alignées sur les objectifs d’affaires, techniques et utilisateurs.

• Concevoir et évaluer des expériences utilisateur pour des produits alimentés par l’IA, notamment des applications basées sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), des systèmes agentiques, des flux d’automatisation intelligents et des solutions d’aide à la décision intégrant l’intervention humaine.

• Créer et maintenir divers artéfacts UX, notamment des personas, cartes de parcours utilisateur, plans de services, modèles de flux de travail, maquettes, prototypes, rapports d’utilisabilité et spécifications de conception.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les ingénieurs, les scientifiques de données, les cliniciens et les parties prenantes afin d’aligner les priorités et de favoriser une prise de décision centrée sur l’utilisateur.

• Contribuer efficacement au sein de petites équipes agiles en participant aux cycles rapides d’expérimentation, d’itération, de mesure et d’apprentissage continu.

• Fournir un leadership dans des environnements complexes et ambigus en facilitant les discussions, en apportant de la clarté et en influençant l’orientation des produits grâce à des données probantes et à la recherche.

• Encadrer les professionnels UX et les partenaires interfonctionnels en promouvant les meilleures pratiques en matière de recherche, de conception, d’utilisabilité, de validation et de collaboration.

• Défendre les principes d’accessibilité, d’utilisabilité, d’éthique en intelligence artificielle et de conception centrée sur l’humain tout au long du processus de développement des produits.

Qualifications requises

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en interaction humain-machine (IHM), psychologie, design, sciences cognitives, facteurs humains ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Plus de 10 années d’expérience en recherche UX, conception de produits, évaluation de l’utilisabilité et conception centrée sur l’utilisateur pour des produits numériques complexes.

• Expérience démontrée dans la direction autonome d’initiatives UX de bout en bout, de la découverte à l’implantation et à l’optimisation continue.

• Solide expertise des méthodologies de recherche qualitatives et quantitatives, y compris les entrevues, l’enquête contextuelle, les tests d’utilisabilité, les sondages, l’analyse des flux de travail et la synthèse des résultats.

• Excellente maîtrise de la conception d’interaction, de l’architecture de l’information, du maquettage, du prototypage, de la communication visuelle et des systèmes de conception.

• Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires en gestion de produits, ingénierie logicielle, science des données, opérations cliniques et fonctions d’affaires.

• Excellentes aptitudes en communication, gestion des parties prenantes, animation d’ateliers et narration stratégique, avec une capacité démontrée à influencer les décisions grâce à des recommandations fondées sur des données probantes.

• Maîtrise des outils modernes de recherche UX, de conception et de productivité alimentés par l’IA, notamment Figma, FigJam, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor et d’autres plateformes de synthèse assistée par IA.

• Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes ainsi qu’une véritable passion pour la compréhension des comportements utilisateurs et l’amélioration des résultats produits.

Qualifications souhaitées

• Expérience dans la conception, la recherche ou l’évaluation de produits alimentés par l’IA, de flux de travail basés sur des LLM, de systèmes agentiques, de solutions d’automatisation intelligente ou d’outils d’aide à la décision.

• Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des sciences de la vie, de la recherche clinique, des biotechnologies, de l’industrie pharmaceutique ou dans d’autres environnements hautement réglementés.

• Connaissance des modèles opérationnels agentiques, des approches d’expérimentation rapide, de la pensée systémique et des pratiques de développement de produits assistés par l’IA.

title: UX Researcher
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we build technologies that help people be their best in the moments that matter. Our products support people working in complex, high-stakes environments — from public safety and emergency communications to enterprise security.

Understanding the people who use these technologies, the environments they work within and the challenges they face is fundamental to building products that are useful, trustworthy and effective.

Job Description

About the role
We are looking for a curious and thoughtful UX Researcher with strong foundations in social or behavioural science. This role is well suited to someone who wants to apply rigorous research to complex, real-world problems and grow their career in applied UX research.

You may already have some experience in UX or product research. Equally, you may be completing a PhD, working in academia, government, policy, behavioural research or another applied research environment and looking to move into industry.

What matters most is how you think: asking good questions, challenging assumptions, evaluating evidence critically, designing thoughtful research and turning complex findings into a clear point of view.

What you'll do
Frame complex problems

• Work with stakeholders to turn broad product or business questions into clear, answerable research questions.

• Identify assumptions, gaps in knowledge and areas of uncertainty before recommending new research.

• Review existing evidence and understand user behaviour within its wider social, organisational and technological context.

• Look beyond individual features to understand workflows, systems and broader patterns.

Design and conduct rigorous research

• Select research methods that fit the question and the decision being made.

• Plan and conduct qualitative research such as interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, field research and usability studies.

• Design studies that consider bias, validity, ethics and the limitations of the available evidence.

• Adapt research approaches to complex environments and populations that may be difficult to access.

• Use quantitative approaches where appropriate, including surveys, structured studies and analysis of behavioural or product data to help answer research questions and measure user outcomes.

• Partner with other researchers and specialists when a project requires different methodological expertise.

Make sense of evidence

• Analyse qualitative data systematically and identify meaningful patterns.

• Analyse and interpret quantitative data alongside qualitative findings, identifying patterns and relationships while being clear about sample size, uncertainty and the limitations of the evidence.

• Distinguish between evidence, interpretation and assumption.

• Connect individual findings to broader product, user and strategic questions.

Influence decisions

• Translate research findings into clear implications and recommendations.

• Communicate complex ideas in simple, accessible ways for multidisciplinary and senior audiences.

• Help Product and Design teams understand how evidence should influence priorities and decisions.

• Work collaboratively with stakeholders while maintaining an independent research perspective.

• Contribute to the research community

• Share methods, learning and evidence with other researchers.

• Contribute to reusable research knowledge rather than treating every project as an isolated study.

• Participate in critique, peer review and research planning.

• Develop your own methodological expertise through coaching, collaboration and practice.

Basic Requirements

What we're looking for
We are particularly interested in candidates with a background in social or behavioural science and strong evidence of critical thinking. You should be able to demonstrate:

• Strong research and analytical skills.

• Experience designing and conducting empirical research.

• The ability to take an ambiguous problem and break it into answerable questions.

• Strong critical-thinking skills and a willingness to question assumptions.

• The ability to evaluate the quality, strength and limitations of evidence.

• Experience analysing qualitative research systematically.

• The ability to identify patterns across complex or sometimes contradictory information.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• The ability to explain research clearly to people without a research background.

• Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding human behaviour.

• Comfort working independently while collaborating closely with others.

• A willingness to learn new research methods and work across different problem spaces.

Academic background
A postgraduate qualification in a relevant social or behavioural science is preferred. We would particularly welcome applications from candidates with a PhD, or equivalent research experience.

Relevant disciplines may include:

• Psychology, sociology, anthropology or behavioural science

• Cognitive science, Human-Computer Interaction or Human Factors

• Criminology, public policy, political or social science

• Education, organisational psychology or occupational psychology

• Science and Technology Studies or another empirical social-science discipline

Your exact discipline matters less than the research skills and way of thinking you have developed through it.

Quantitative research
Quantitative research experience is desirable, but not essential. We are interested in candidates who are curious about developing mixed-methods capability and using qualitative and quantitative evidence together.

Useful experience could include:

• Survey design and analysis

• Experimental or quasi-experimental research

• Statistical analysis or quantitative usability research

• Behavioural or product-usage data

• Data visualisation or working with structured datasets

• Tools such as R, Python, SPSS, SQL or similar

• We are not looking for a statistician or data scientist. Candidates with strong research foundations and an interest in learning will have opportunities to develop deeper quantitative and mixed-methods expertise within the team.

How research works at Motorola Solutions
Our researchers work across different kinds of questions. Some work closely with a product domain, building a deep understanding of its users, workflows and technology. Other work begins further upstream, investigating emerging behaviours, technologies, societal changes and unmet needs that may shape future opportunities.

Across both settings, the skills are closely connected: curiosity, critical thinking, rigorous research and the ability to turn evidence into better decisions.

description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

The Opportunity

Enterprise software should be as intuitive, engaging, and seamless as the consumer experiences people use every day. At Avaya, we’re bringing that standard to enterprise customer experience by transforming Avaya Infinity into a next-generation Connection Center—one that goes beyond traditional contact center workflows to create more intelligent, connected, and personalized customer interactions.

Our vision is built around three principles: Connections, Context, and Insights. By bringing together real-time data, customer history, and AI-powered capabilities, Avaya Infinity will help organizations deliver more meaningful interactions across web, desktop, mobile, and AI-driven workflows.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Designer – AI & Enterprise UX to help define and bring this vision to life. This is an opportunity to shape the experience of a strategic enterprise platform—not only designing new capabilities, but reimagining existing workflows, modernizing the user experience, and establishing the design systems and standards that will guide the platform forward.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy, design, and engineering. You’ll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences, use rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools to accelerate decision-making, and partner closely with engineering to translate design intent into high-quality products. Your influence will extend beyond individual features to the overall usability, consistency, and evolution of Avaya Infinity.

What You'll Do

•
Shape the Avaya Infinity Experience: Translate the vision for Connections, Context, and Insights into intuitive, human-centered experiences across web, desktop (Windows/Mac), and mobile—raising the bar for enterprise software usability and design.

•
Design New Capabilities and Modernize Existing Experiences: Lead UX and product design for key Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives while identifying and addressing usability gaps, outdated workflows, and inconsistencies across the platform.

•
Accelerate Innovation Through Rapid Prototyping: Use interactive prototypes, AI-enabled design tools, and iterative testing to validate concepts early, clarify requirements, and help engineering teams move from idea to implementation faster.

•
Build Scalable Design Systems and Engineering Workflows: Establish and evolve Figma components, variables, design tokens, and handoff standards in close partnership with engineering. Ensure designs translate effectively into production across React, Electron, and native applications while minimizing rework and improving implementation quality.

•
Design the Next Generation of AI-Powered Experiences: Create intuitive ways to incorporate real-time agent assistance, automated interaction summaries, predictive routing, and generative AI capabilities—making complex information actionable without overwhelming users.

•
Lead UX Strategy Across Product and Engineering: Own the UX roadmap for Avaya Infinity, influence product priorities, and advocate for user-centered design in executive reviews. Partner across Product Management, Solution Architecture, and Engineering to align design decisions with customer needs, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

What You Bring

•
Enterprise Product Design Experience: Significant experience designing complex B2B software across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Experience with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, or other enterprise SaaS products is highly valued.

•
A Strong UX Portfolio: Demonstrated ability to transform complex workflows and information-dense interfaces into intuitive, modern experiences. Your portfolio shows how you balance usability, visual design, and business requirements to simplify the user experience.

•
Strategic Thinking and Hands-On Execution: Ability to move seamlessly between defining a long-term UX vision and delivering high-quality designs for immediate product priorities. You know how to modernize existing experiences while building a foundation for future capabilities.

•
Advanced Figma and Design Systems Expertise: Strong command of Figma, including variables, design tokens, component libraries, auto-layout, and reusable design patterns. Experience establishing scalable design systems and integrating design workflows with frontend development is essential.

•
Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

•
Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

•
Product and Customer Experience Acumen: Understanding of complex customer interaction workflows, omnichannel experiences, real-time data, and analytics. You connect design decisions to customer needs, product strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

•
Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and experience incorporating inclusive design principles into complex enterprise applications from the outset.

Preferred Experience

•
Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including real-time agent assistance, contextual recommendations, automated summaries, or generative AI workflows.

•
Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

•
Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

How Success Is Measured

•
Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

•
Platform Modernization and UX Improvement: Evaluate existing Infinity experiences, identify the highest-impact usability challenges, and establish a prioritized UX improvement roadmap. Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

•
Design System Adoption and Handoff Quality: Establish consistent Figma components, design tokens, and design-to-code workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Reduce ambiguity, minimize developer rework, and improve the fidelity of implemented designs.

•
Measurable User Experience Impact: Improve usability through measurable reductions in cognitive load, unnecessary interaction steps, and task completion time. Track progress through usability testing, System Usability Scale (SUS) scores, and agent satisfaction (Agent CSAT), where applicable.

Why Join Avaya?

At Avaya, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience—not simply refine existing interfaces. You’ll help transform Avaya Infinity into a modern, AI-enabled Connection Center that brings together Connections, Context, and Insights to make customer interactions more intuitive, intelligent, and meaningful.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you can influence product strategy, establish the UX direction for a strategic platform, and see your work move from concept to production. You’ll combine creative ownership and hands-on design with close collaboration across Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering.

If you’re energized by simplifying complex technology, challenging legacy design conventions, and using emerging AI capabilities to create better user experiences, Avaya offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software that supports customer interactions around the world.

title: Custom Solutions Builder
description:
ABOUT KATANA

Katana is a B2B SaaS company that builds inventory and manufacturing software for 1,500+ businesses that make and sell physical products around the world.

As we move upmarket with our Advantage plan (a plan personalized around each customer's business), more customers come to us with a "job to be done" that our core product doesn't cover on its own: automatically moving stock between warehouses so no location runs out, a reporting flow nobody else needs, or an integration with the one tool their factory floor runs on. Those deals are landing and growing, and one senior Solution Engineer can't build for all of them. That's where you come in.

Most builder roles put you close to the code or close to the customer's problem. This one gives you both.

 - You build, not just advise. This is not a sales engineer role. You take a real customer problem, design the solution, build it, and keep it running

 - You stay close to customer problems. You understand their business, ask questions that make people think, and explain the value of what you built in their terms, not in terms of the code

 - You build AI-first. You plan, prompt, then review and validate what the tools produce. AI is how we work every day, not a side experiment

 - You own it from the first scope to go-live and beyond. Whoever builds it estimates it, and owns it after go-live

This isn't a role for someone who wants a finished spec. It's for someone who wants to solve real business problems with working tools, and to be judged on whether the customer's problem actually went away.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join the Custom Solutions team in Product Engineering and build solutions that extend Katana for one customer, or for a few customers with the same need. You'll work alongside our senior Solution Engineer, who calibrates your estimates and supports your scoping.

You build on top of Katana, not in the core product. You connect Katana to the tools a customer already uses, and build the small apps, automations, and reports they need. That boundary is deliberate: it lets you move fast and own your work fully, safely.

How you work. You work mostly through our Product Manager, who owns the customer's need and priority, and you join customer sessions on an as-needed basis. An engineer reviews your solution designs, and you build things that are easy to maintain, with our monitoring tools behind you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Frame the problem

 - Take a customer problem from the PM, whether it affects one customer or tens of them

 - Find out why the customer is asking, not just what they're asking for

 - Scope the most viable solution

Design and build the solution

 - Lead the solution design and review it with an engineer

 - Build AI-first on our REST API and miniapps platform: integrations, miniapps, automations, and data flows

 - Right-size every solution: build for specific customer needs, not a universal platform for a one-customer need

Take it live and keep it running

 - Put what you build live, keep an eye on it, and maintain it, like the whole team does

 - Handle keys, credentials, and customer data safely across many client projects

 - Fix what breaks, and learn from it so it doesn't break again

Make the work better

 - Demo what you built to customers and teammates, in the customer's terms

 - Spot repeated needs and help turn one-off builds into reusable tools over time

 - Give feedback on the miniapps platform you use every day


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - By week 4: You've shipped a small solution for a real customer. You think in the customer's domain, and you've proposed one improvement to how we run Advantage builds

 - By month 2: You have implemented one standard build end to end, with your estimate calibrated by our senior Solution Engineer

 - By month 4: You have implemented multiple builds end to end, with senior support on scoping. Your solutions are monitored and running well

Your first weeks. You're onboarded to our product and its domain, and tutored on the platforms and tooling you'll use. You join customer calls and team calls to learn first-hand, and an assigned mentor teaches you and answers your questions. We also keep asking for your feedback on our processes, so you have a say in how we improve them.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

What we care about most is your experience with customers: finding out what their real problems are, communicating clearly with them along the way, and solving those problems. Coding isn't required. Tools are just the means, whether you used Make.com, n8n, Lovable, AI tools like Claude Code, or an internal tool. There's no coding test in our process, but we expect the person to have hands-on experience building with AI.

How you think (must-have)

title: Senior Design Systems Engineer
location: Remote (US), San Francisco, CA, New York, NY (HQ)
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Design Systems Engineer to be one of the few engineers building the components that every Ramp product team uses — the person who makes our design system real in code. You’ll work in close partnership with our design systems lead and designers: they decide what the rules are, and you decide how to enforce them. Sometimes that’s a component that won’t allow a bad pattern. Sometimes it’s a codebase move that makes the right path the easy one. Sometimes it’s automation that catches drift before it spreads.

With AI agents now writing much of the UI, this role is also at the frontier of a changing craft. You’ll help decide what the system has to guarantee when humans and agents are both building on top of it — because agents don’t settle for the happy path, and the system needs to hold up either way.

Having worked as a designer (or deeply alongside one), you understand the design-eng collaboration challenges firsthand. You’re driven to improve it because you’ve lived with the pain points. You excel in UI and accessible design, prefer working directly in-browser, and get excited about emerging CSS properties.

This is an IC role on a small team, which means you’ll have real say in architecture, API design, and the tradeoffs that shape how Ramp builds — foundational, detail-obsessed frontend work with an outsized impact on every screen we ship.


What You’ll Do

 - Build and evolve the components and APIs that every product team at Ramp depends on

 - Make the enforcement call: when to encode a rule in the component itself, when to leave it to guidance, and when to invest in automation that catches drift

 - Partner with our design systems lead and designers to turn UX patterns and principles into working, consistent components

 - Shape the system so it holds up when both engineers and AI agents are building on it

 - Contribute to internal tooling and infrastructure that keeps velocity high without sacrificing quality

 - Champion the user experience and accessibility of our products, and keep the quality bar high

 - Help designers and engineers across Ramp ship faster with elegant, consistent component APIs and a focus on developer experience

 - Advocate for users by continuously iterating on our core products and experiences

 - Participate in day-to-day team rituals like design crit, story creation, and weekly stand-ups

 - Help us hire and grow the team to bring more craft and more perspectives to the work
   

What You Need

 - Tech/startup or digital product agency experience, or equivalent

 - A strong frontend engineer who could pass any engineering loop at Ramp — real hands-on skill, not just prompting AI to write code

 - Experience building design system components and APIs, not only consuming them

 - Excellent front-end development skills in semantic HTML, CSS (up to date on latest features) and JavaScript (and frameworks, pref. React)

 - Ability to drive implementation end to end, with sound UX and system design sense

 - Strong understanding of Product Design software (pref. Figma) and visual/interaction design principles

 - Strong organizational skills and a love for documentation

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to push back with reasons — e.g., when encoding a rule in a component would slow everyone down

 - Care for the details: motion, states, accessibility, and the small decisions that make a system feel coherent
   

Nice to Haves

 - Design systems experience from before AI tooling took off

 - Ability to articulate complex concepts to technical and non-technical peers

 - Solid understanding of accessibility development practices




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

title: INTERNSHIP - CMF Designer M/F/X
description:
Company Description

Amer Sports is a sporting goods company with internationally recognized brands including Salomon, Arc’teryx, Peak Performance, Atomic and Wilson.

Salomon’s commitment to innovative design and passion for mountain sports created a vast range of revolutionary new concepts in bindings, boots, skis and apparel for both Alpine and Nordic skiing and brought innovative solutions to footwear, apparel and equipment for snowboarding, adventure racing, mountaineering, hiking, trail running, and many other sports.

Through performance driven design, Salomon delivers innovation and progression to mountain sports; converting new ideas into action and expanding the limits of possibility. Salomon’s heritage, culture, and commitment are tied together by one simple concept: the world’s leading mountain people creating the world’s leading mountain products. Salomon is responsibly committed towards the outdoor through its sustainability program. Diversity is one of Salomon’s five values, therefore we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

Salomon is headquartered in Annecy, France.

Job Description

•
Are you passionate about colors, materials, and textures that bring outdoor apparel to life?

•
Do you love exploring trends and turning creative inspirations into innovative design concepts?

•
Would you like to help shape the look and feel of Salomon’s future apparel collections?

If so, we may have an internship which may interest you!

About Salomon:

Salomon is a leading global brand in outdoor sports equipment and apparel, dedicated to providing innovative and high-performance gear for trail running, outdoor activities, and winter sports enthusiasts. With a rich heritage rooted in the French Alps, Salomon is committed to pushing the boundaries of design and technology to enhance the outdoor experience for athletes and adventurers around the world.

Position Overview:

Salomon is seeking a highly motivated and creative CMF Design Intern to join our dynamic team in the Apparel Section. The CMF Design Intern will play a key role in assisting the CMF (Color, Material, and Finish) team in developing seasonal color palettes, graphic designs, and material&finish strategies that reflect Salomon's brand identity and meet the needs of our diverse customer base.

Your mission will include:

1. CMF Design Support

• Assist the CMF team in researching and identifying emerging trends in color, materials, and finishes relevant to outdoor sports apparel.

• Support the development of seasonal CMF mood boards, inspiration sources, and presentation materials.

• Collaborate with designers to create and refine color palettes aligned with Salomon’s brand DNA and consumer insights.

• Assist in organizing and maintaining color and material libraries for internal reference.

2. Graphic and Material Development

• Support graphic designers in developing print and pattern concepts for apparel collections, incorporating seasonal themes, brand identity, and technical requirements.

• Help coordinate and maintain strike-off and sample libraries.

• Conduct trend and material research, exploring innovative, sustainable, and performance-driven materials and trims for apparel products.

3. Operational and Project Support

• Provide timely and effective operative design support to the CMF and Apparel Design teams, contributing to short-term project planning and execution.

• Actively participate in cross-functional development projects as a collaborative team member.

Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a degree in CMF Design, Textile Design, Fashion Design, or a related field.

• Passion for outdoor sports and strong familiarity with Salomon’s brand and products.

• Excellent visual and aesthetic sensibility with a keen eye for color, pattern, and texture.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator); knowledge of Clo3D, Substance, or other 3D CMF software is a plus.

• Strong communication, organizational, and collaboration skills.

• Knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes is an advantage.

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

• English level : B2/C1

Additional Information

Contract: Internship (a convention agreement is mandatory)

Location: Annecy

Duration: 6 months

Starting date: January/February 2027

________________

Working conditions:

• Remote work possible after your first month.

• Flexible hours: arrive between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m. with a flexible end to the day, so you can balance your weeks at school and in the company.

• Accessible workplace: dedicated parking spaces for people with disabilities, workstation and furniture adjustments as needed.

________________

Administrative conditions:

This internship is covered by a tripartite training agreement (convention de stage) between you, your school, and the company. Applicants who are EU nationals can apply without any specific formality. Applicants from outside the EU must hold, as of the start date, a valid residence permit or visa authorising them to complete a school-sanctioned internship in France.

________________

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is one of Salomon's five core values. We review every application against the same criteria, based solely on skills and motivation, regardless of gender, background, age, disability, orientation, or beliefs.

Our recruitment process and our work environment are designed to be accessible to everyone. If you need any adjustment at any stage of the recruitment process or in the role, just let us know and we will find the right solution together. Our company also has a dedicated disability officer.

________________

Recruitment process:

Here's what to expect once you apply:

• Application review: a recruiter reviews your CV and application to assess the fit with the role and shortlists the candidates to contact.

• Phone pre-qualification: a first call to get to know you and talk through your expectations and the role.

• Manager interview: a meeting with your future manager to explore the position and your profile in more detail.

• Case study: a short practical exercise so you can put your skills into a real-world context.

• Offer: if it's a match on both sides, we make you an offer and prepare your arrival.

________________

Compensation:

At Salomon, internship allowances are broken down as follows:

Internship allowances:

High school diploma to bachelor's degree: €700 gross

Master's degree: €950 gross

Doctorate: €1,200 gross

Housing allowance:

€300 housing assistance upon presentation of a lease agreement for a property located within 50 km of the head office and monthly receipts.

________________

Interested in this position? Don't wait, send us your portfolio and . We can't wait to learn more about you!

Your responsibility is to ensure that infrastructure decisions meet current business needs while supporting long-term goals for security, scalability, standardization, and efficiency.

• Develop high-level and low-level infrastructure solution designs based on business requirements, technical constraints, security, cost, and long-term sustainability.

• Analyze and consult stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify dependencies, evaluate technical alternatives, and recommend the most suitable infrastructure solutions.

• Support investment proposals, cost estimates, financial assessments, procurement activities, and the effective handover of agreed solutions to Delivery teams.

• Collaborate with architects, technical leads, application teams, and system owners to improve infrastructure standards, reusable building blocks, Infrastructure as a Service, and ways of working.

We are on a continuous transformation journey, which means that new ways of working need to evolve across all areas. Within Solution Design, we focus on lean ways of working, clear priorities, and delivering value efficiently.

What will help you thrive in this role:

You are analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to connect business needs with technical possibilities.

You understand that the best solution is not necessarily the most technically advanced one, but the one that provides the right balance between business needs, cost, risk, operational requirements, and long-term strategic direction.

 

• Extensive practical experience in IT infrastructure, including experience across several infrastructure or IT functional areas.

• Strong knowledge of infrastructure technologies, such as cloud, virtualization, Data Centers, networks, databases, operating systems, servers, storage, NAS, and load balancing.

• Ability to design end-to-end infrastructure solutions, analyze requirements, evaluate technical alternatives, and balance business value, cost, security, operational needs, and long-term goals.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical specialists and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience with AI agents, Infrastructure as a Service, technical documentation, or infrastructure standardization is considered an advantage.

• Fluency in English and the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for the position.

Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet

 

At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator & Climate Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.

 

Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.

 

What we offer

 

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.

 

Ready to make better happen?

 

We look forward to receiving your application by December 18. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

 

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

 

Equal opportunities

 

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

• Review project documentation to identify coordination issues, discrepancies, or constructability concerns.

• Support the preparation and review of construction documentation and drawing packages.

• Participate in project meetings and communicate design decisions clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

• Assist with RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, samples, and other construction-phase documentation when required.

• Support project managers and design leads throughout project development and delivery.

• Maintain high standards of design quality, technical accuracy, documentation, and attention to detail.

• Work independently while managing assigned priorities, deadlines, and project deliverables.

Requirements

• Degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, or a closely related field.

• Approximately 6–10+ years of relevant professional experience in architecture, interior architecture, or interior design.

• Strong experience delivering residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, workplace, or high-end interior projects.

• Demonstrated experience working across multiple project phases, including:

• Concept Design

• Schematic Design

• Design Development

• Construction Documentation

• Strong experience producing and coordinating technical architectural and interior design drawings.

• Proficiency in Revit and/or AutoCAD.

• Strong working knowledge of SketchUp or similar 3D design tools.

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or other design-presentation software is preferred.

• Strong understanding of materials, finishes, FF&E, lighting, millwork, and architectural detailing.

• Ability to read, understand, and coordinate architectural, engineering, and construction drawings.

• Experience coordinating with consultants and multidisciplinary project teams.

• Strong design judgment combined with practical understanding of construction and constructability.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to communicate effectively with international clients and project teams.

• Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.

• Availability to work during U.S. business hours, aligned with the required client and project schedule.

• Immediate availability or availability within an agreed timeframe is preferred.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following are strongly encouraged to apply:

• High-End Residential Design

• Interior Architecture

• Hospitality Design

• Commercial Interiors

• Retail Design

• Workplace Design

• Luxury Interiors

• FF&E

• Custom Millwork & Cabinetry

• Construction Documentation

• BIM / Revit Coordination

• Multidisciplinary Design Coordination

• U.S. Architectural or Interior Design Projects

Preferred Software & Technical Skills

Experience with some or all of the following is highly desirable:

• Revit

• AutoCAD

• Adobe Photoshop

• Adobe InDesign

• Adobe Illustrator

• BIM coordination tools

• Project collaboration and document-management platforms

What We Offer

• Remote work arrangement

• Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications

• Opportunity to work on international architecture and interior design projects

• Exposure to U.S.-based project teams and clients

• Opportunity to contribute to high-quality residential, commercial, hospitality, and interior design projects

• Long-term opportunity for a suitable candidate

• Professional remote working environment

• Opportunity to work with multidisciplinary and internationally distributed design teams

Interested candidates are requested to complete our Candidate Pre-Screening Form as part of the application process. The form will allow us to review your relevant experience, software proficiency, project background, availability, expected hourly rate, and other information related to the position.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

title: Robotics Senior Actuator Design Engineer
description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

Based in Barcelona, this role sits at the heart of Helsing's robotics engineering function, responsible for driving the mechanical architecture, design, and development of next-generation robotic systems. You will own complex electromechanical systems from concept through to production, ensuring platforms are robust, scalable, and built for real-world deployment. Working closely with electrical, firmware, and software engineers, you will bring both technical depth and cross-functional leadership to a team building some of the most consequential technology in European defence

The day-to-day

• Lead the detailed design and integration of complex robotic subsystems, including high-precision actuators, structural chassis, and dynamic motion systems, translating high-level concepts into robust 3D assemblies and comprehensive engineering drawing packages.
• Drive cross-functional integration with electrical and software teams to ensure seamless packaging, cable routing, and thermal and sensor integration, resolving technical challenges across the full development cycle.
• Define material selection strategies and fabrication methods, conducting FEA, stress analysis, and tolerance stack-up analysis to ensure designs meet rigorous functional, cost, yield, and lead-time requirements.
• Establish and advocate for mechanical engineering best practices, including modelling standards, GD&T drawing controls, and technical documentation, raising quality across the team.
• Critically evaluate system architectures in design reviews, identifying risks and delivering high-impact solutions that optimise performance and manufacturability from prototype through to production ramp-up.

You should apply if you

• Have shipped complex robotic, mechatronic, or automated systems to market, with a verifiable track record of ownership across the full product development cycle.
• Bring expert-level proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, ideally SolidWorks, combined with deep knowledge of GD&T for precision manufacturing environments.
• Have applied structural and thermal FEA, static simulations, and tolerance stack-up analysis to solve real engineering problems in production-grade systems.
• Have worked extensively across diverse manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, injection moulding, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing, in high-mix or low-to-medium volume environments.
• Communicate complex technical decisions with clarity to cross-functional stakeholders, from firmware engineers to programme leadership, driving alignment without sacrificing rigour.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

• Experience architecting high-performance, high-power-density actuators and advanced mechatronic systems for legged robotics platforms.
• Background working in agile, small-scale mechanical design teams, with direct experience taking full technical ownership from early concept through to serial production.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

•

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

•

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

•

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

•

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

•

Competitive salary and VSOP options

•

Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

•

Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

•

Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

•

Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

•

Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

•

Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

•

A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: CDI - Prototypiste, H/F
description:
Company Description

Amer Sports is a sporting goods company with internationally recognized brands including Salomon, Arc’teryx, Peak Performance, Atomic and Wilson.

“The Mountain Sport Company”, Salomon was born in 1947 in the heart of the French Alps and the birthplace of modern alpinism. Salomon’s commitment to innovative design and passion for mountain sports created a vast range of revolutionary new concepts in bindings, boots, skis and apparel for both Alpine and Nordic skiing and brought innovative solutions to footwear, apparel and equipment for snowboarding, adventure racing, mountaineering, hiking, trail running, and many other sports.

Through performance driven design, Salomon delivers innovation and progression to mountain sports; converting new ideas into action and expanding the limits of possibility. Salomon’s heritage, culture, and commitment are tied together by one simple concept: the world’s leading mountain people creating the world’s leading mountain products. Salomon is responsibly committed towards the outdoor through its sustainability program. Diversity is one of Salomon’s five values, therefore we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

Salomon is headquartered in Annecy, France.

Amer Sports est le leader mondial des équipementiers du sport avec les marques Salomon, Arc’teryx, Peak Performance, Atomic et Wilson.

Salomon SAS, « The Mountain Sport Company », est née en 1947 au cœur des Alpes et berceau de l’alpinisme moderne. Grâce à la passion du sport et un design innovant, Salomon a créé une vaste gamme de nouveaux concepts révolutionnaires en fixations, chaussures, skis et vêtements pour le ski alpin et nordique et a pu apporter des solutions innovantes dans le footwear, et les équipements pour le snowboard, la compétition, l’alpinisme, la randonnée, le trail running and bien d’autres sports.

Au travers de cette orientation vers la performance, Salomon innove et excelle sur les sports de montagne, en convertissant de nouvelles idées en produits et en repoussant les limites du possible. L’engagement, la culture et l’héritage de Salomon sont tous liés par un simple concept : chaque salarié peut faire de Salomon la marque de montagne de référence. Salomon s’engage de manière responsable pour l’outdoor au travers de son programme de développement durable. La diversité est l'une des cinq valeurs de Salomon, c'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à créer un environnement accessible à tous.

Le siège de Salomon est basé à Annecy (74), France.

Job Description

Au sein de notre atelier de prototypage, vous réalisez des prototypes physiques permettant de valider des concepts, des structures, des volumes, des procédés, des comportements et des caractéristiques techniques, dans le respect du cadre projet ou du thème d'exploration.

Vous intervenez sur des projets variés, notamment dans les univers Footwear et Apparel, en collaboration avec les équipes de développement produit et différents partenaires internes. L'environnement de travail est dynamique et demande une forte capacité d'adaptation pour répondre à des projets planifiés comme à des demandes plus réactives.

Principales activités et responsabilités

• Réaliser des prototypes en suivant le cahier des charges et en préparant les différents éléments nécessaires à leur fabrication.

• Assurer les réglages appropriés des équipements et machines associés.

• Réaliser les contrôles qualité nécessaires sur les produits finis.

• Participer aux activités de couture, de découpe de pièces et de prototypage selon les besoins de l'atelier.

• Tenir à jour les stocks de consommables et de matières premières et déclencher les approvisionnements si nécessaire.

• Contrôler périodiquement les installations et alerter en cas de dysfonctionnement.

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des produits, des procédés et des méthodes de fabrication.

• Assurer un support opérationnel aux équipes R&D et contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes de travail.

Qualifications

Formation

• Bac Professionnel technique minimum souhaité.

Expérience et compétences professionnelles

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle minimum (alternance comprise).

• Expertise confirmée en couture, idéalement dans l'univers de la chaussure, avec maîtrise des machines associées.

• Expérience en environnement atelier et goût pour le travail manuel de précision.

• Polyvalence permettant d'intervenir sur différentes activités de fabrication en fonction des priorités.

• Notions de gestion de stock et bonnes capacités d'organisation.

Compétences techniques

• Maîtrise du Pack Office (Outlook, Excel, Word).

• Connaissance des matières et des procédés de fabrication.

• Adobe (Illustrator, Photoshop ou équivalent) constitue un plus.

Langues

• Anglais niveau B2 minimum

Additional Information

• Contrat : CDI à temps plein.

• Localisation : Annecy
