title: Brand Collaborations Manager
description:
JOIN THE TEAM BUILDING AN AI-FIRST COMPANY 🚀

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles https://www.hostinger.com/principles.




YOUR ROLE AT HOSTINGER

As part of the Brand Collaborations team, you will be responsible for building and managing external partnerships that increase Hostinger’s brand visibility and trust. You will work with real Hostinger clients to develop testimonials and case studies, build and scale our brand ambassador programme, and explore co-branding opportunities with relevant companies and communities.
This role suits someone who is confident in managing external relationships, comfortable negotiating partnership agreements, and who can also assess and craft a strong brand story.



Curious to learn more? Meet your future Team Lead: Justina Bučinskaitė https://www.linkedin.com/in/justina-bucinskaite/, Head of Brand Collaborations




YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

 - Identify and develop client success stories and case studies, working closely with clients to capture their experience and share it across Hostinger's channels.

 - Manage the full process from first outreach to published content: relationship management, interviews, consents, briefs for writers, visual requests, and placement across channels such as blog, social, newsletters, and the website.

 - Build and scale Hostinger's brand ambassador programme: identify and select ambassadors in focus markets, manage onboarding, content planning, and ongoing partnerships.

 - Identify and develop co-branding opportunities with relevant companies, platforms, and communities.

 - Work with design, copy, video, and social media teams to make sure all collaboration content meets Hostinger’s quality and brand standards.

 - Partner with local Country Managers to find and activate relevant stories and partnerships in focus markets.

 - Track the performance of each collaboration and report on reach, engagement, and brand impact.

 - Bring new ideas on formats, partners, and ways to expand our collaborations programme.




YOUR EXPERTISE AND EXPERIENCE

 - 3 to 5 years of experience in brand partnerships, partner marketing, PR, or communications, with a proven track record of building and managing relationships with external partners, clients, or ambassadors.

 - Experience identifying, negotiating, and closing partnership or sponsorship agreements.

 - Strong judgement for brand fit: you can quickly tell whether a client story or a partner is a good match for Hostinger.

 - Good written communication skills. You will be writing outreach messages, briefs, and partner-facing materials regularly.

 - Organised and able to manage multiple active partnerships at different stages at the same time.

 - Comfortable using data to review results and improve future decisions.

 - Curious to develop and iterate on AI and automation flows for collaborations sourcing and tracking.

 - Fluent in English. Additional languages are a plus.




BENEFITS YOU'LL LOVE

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge https://www.reforge.com/ and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. Depending on your location, you can mentor or be mentored through TesoXchange https://tesoxchange.com/. People give each other open feedback https://www.hostinger.com/blog/reaching-your-peak/, share what they know https://www.hostinger.com/blog/learning-culture/, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace https://www.headspace.com/ subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CPnIDaaq0jcSummerfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=37qrjt2SDwc & Winterfest https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AfytsnQyE2I, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.




COMPENSATION 

Compensation from €3,200 - €4,200 gross/month, depending on your experience and skills.



We're always looking for experienced talent to raise the bar. If you're excited about the role but the listed compensation range doesn't align with your expectations, we still encourage you to apply — we're open to adjusting it based on the impact and value you bring.



Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

title: Design Principal, Engineering Development (Mechanical)
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
Job Summary
The Design Principal is responsible for design decisions related to a portfolio of datacenter projects which can include: new construction, phased expansion, retrofits and upgrades, acquisition conversions, M&E equipment selections, and standards upgrades in either a specific region or globally. • Inspire and mentor a team of designers and creatives. Your job is to raise the bar, not just clear it. You'll coach, challenge and champion the people around you.

• Drive creative strategy in partnership with our strategy teams, translating consumer insights and brand thinking into distinctive design solutions that work on shelf, on screen and everywhere in between.

• Own client relationships at a senior level. You'll present with confidence, navigate feedback with grace, and build the kind of trust that turns a project into a long-term partnership.

• Champion craft — typography, colour, structure, illustration, print production. You care deeply about the details, and it shows in your work.

• Stay curious about what's happening in culture, retail, design and technology. You bring fresh thinking into the studio and help set our creative direction in the consumer space.

• Collaborate across disciplines — with motion, strategy, verbal identity and client teams — because the best work always happens when different minds are in the room.

What You Need

• A strong portfolio of consumer packaging and FMCG work that demonstrates range, craft and commercial thinking.

• 10+ years of design experience, with at least a few years in a creative leadership role, ideally within a brand or design consultancy.

• A deep understanding of packaging design - print production, structural considerations, retail environments and the very specific magic of making something work at scale.

• Proven leadership skills - You know how to build a creative culture, give regular feedback, and bring out the best in a team.

• Excellent communication skills in English - written, verbal, and visual. German is a plus.

• A collaborative spirit - we work as a team, we win as a team.

• An eye on the future - familiarity with how AI tools, digital retail and sustainability are reshaping packaging design, and a genuine interest in what comes next.

Please send us your detailed portfolio with your application. Unfortunately, we cannot consider your application without a portfolio.

What We Offer You

With us, you won't just find a job, but an environment where you can thrive. We offer flexibility through hybrid and remote working, internationality in a global team, flat hierarchies, and space for your ideas. And that's not all: in addition to the familiar fruit basket, we support you with a contribution to your company pension plan, the Deutschlandticket, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, corporate benefits with attractive discounts, access to LinkedIn Learning and Headspace, and much more!

Our commitment to Diversity

We build brands. We build futures. Landor, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics, committed to a culture of respect where everyone belongs and can progress in their careers.

title: Brand Director
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.

Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

As Brand Director, you'll lead Mentimeter's brand team and the creative work that helps people understand, recognize and choose us. You'll set an ambitious creative direction, develop the team, and build the systems that help great work reach further.

Our mission is to make every leader better. We have a clear brand direction grounded in that mission, and your role is to develop how we express it across audiences, channels and markets. You'll own our Brand Platform and Creative Platform, building on the strategy in place to create ideas and storytelling that people connect with and remember.

Brand sits within Design at Mentimeter. We see our product and brand as one experience, and you’ll work closely with product managers, designers, researchers, analytics and the design system team to bring that to life. Our brand designers, copywriters and producers work as an internal agency, supporting teams across the business through a retainer model that serves both of our go-to-market motions: product-led growth (PLG) and Enterprise.

You'll lead that agency end to end: setting priorities, directing the work and developing how it gets made. That includes building AI-enabled tools and ways of working that help colleagues across Mentimeter produce on-brand material themselves, freeing the creative team to focus where their expertise makes the biggest difference.

You'll report to our Chief Design Officer, join the Design Leadership Team, and work closely with our CDO and CEO on the direction of the brand.

What we are looking for

You're a creative leader with depth in your craft and the ability to make the people around you better. You can turn a strategic direction into a strong creative idea, explain why it works, and help a team develop it into work that delivers.

We're particularly interested in a copywriting background. You enjoy working with language, ideas and storytelling, and can move comfortably between shaping a campaign concept, working through the details of a headline and coaching someone else through their approach. You'll join a team with expertise across brand design, copywriting and production, bringing your own craft and creative direction to help develop both the work and the people behind it.

You also think about what makes good work possible beyond your own involvement. You've built tools, standards or processes that others can use, and you're actively exploring how AI can improve creative production. We'd like to hear what you've tried to build, where it worked, where it fell short and how your thinking changed as a result.

Experience across both agency and in-house or product environments would be especially valuable. You understand how to serve different stakeholders, prioritise competing needs and keep developing a brand over time.

In this role, you will:

• Set the creative direction: Lead ideas and storytelling across Mentimeter's brand work, and run crits and reviews that help the team produce stronger work.

• Own our brand and creative platforms: Build on our strategic foundation and develop a lasting creative concept that works across audiences, channels and markets.

• Lead the internal agency: Own delivery, prioritisation and capacity across the business, making sure our biggest company and growth priorities get the attention they need.

• Build brand as a system: Develop guidelines, templates, prompt libraries and AI-enabled tools that help teams produce on-brand work. Set clear standards for quality, tone of voice, IP and legal considerations, with human review where it matters.

• Connect brand and product: Work with product design and our design system team so that what people see and hear from Mentimeter feels connected to their experience of using it.

• Lead and develop our creative people: Manage our brand creative and design leads, and own craft standards, hiring quality and development across design, copy and production.

Requirements

• 10+ years in creative or brand work, including experience leading and developing creative teams across disciplines, with responsibility for both people and the quality of their work.

• A strong foundation in creative direction and storytelling, ideally rooted in copywriting.

• A portfolio that demonstrates your creative judgement and makes your own role and contribution clear.

• Experience translating brand strategy into creative ideas that work across channels and markets.

• Experience building guidelines, templates, tools or processes that enable others to produce good work within a brand.

• Practical experience experimenting with AI in creative production, and thoughtful examples of what you've learned.

• Good business judgement and the ability to prioritise creative capacity across competing needs.

• The ability to build strong working relationships across creative, product and commercial teams.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience running an internal agency or retainer model is a strong advantage.

Not required

You don't have to know Swedish. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!

Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 84,000 - SEK 98,000 per month. It's intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role. Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role's requirements.

We're committed to supporting your growth. You'll have ongoing development conversations with your manager and build skills, contribute to our mission and have meaningful impact.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm

What Mentimeter can offer
At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people. AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Creative Director (London)
description:
Who we are

Kurppa Hosk is a brand agency built for decisive moments. Across Europe and the U.S., our team of 220+ partners with companies at the moments that define them, when clarity is required, and compromise is costly. Working closely with leaders, we help turn bold decisions into confident brands that stand out far from the middle to create momentum and drive demand. From early-stage startups to some of the world’s most admired companies, we work with brave organizations and are proud to count brands like On, Zalando, Electrolux, Scania, H&M, Nike, Estée Lauder, Meta, Snap, Minecraft, Spotify and Heart Aerospace among our clients.

Kurppa Hosk is a founding member of the Eidra Group, a consulting collective where we partner closely with our sister agencies, like Above (innovation), Eidra Consulting (management consulting), Curamando (digital marketing), and Umain (digital products), among others.

As we launch and build Kurppa Hosk in the UK, we're looking for a Creative Director to be one of the founding members of our London team, shaping not just the work, but the creative culture and standards of the studio from day one.

The opportunity

You'll help set the creative direction of Kurppa Hosk in the UK and globally. Inspiring new thinking, pushing concepts further, and nurturing an environment where everyone around you can do the same. Bringing together your co-leads across account, strategy, and creative, as well as the larger design team and client partners to create work that's stronger than the sum of its parts. You bring exceptional creative judgment, a strong point of view, and a gift for world-building; the ability to create rich, coherent brand worlds that hold together through an entire ecosystem. You have the conviction to push work until it's truly great, from early strategic thinking through to final execution.

You'll define what great looks like at Kurppa Hosk UK, leading teams to produce work that's both ambitious and commercially effective. Raising the bar through your coaching, your craft, and your curiosity. Inspiring clients and colleagues to be braver and to keep pushing it.

You'll contribute far beyond your own projects, helping us win work, develop talent, strengthen client relationships, and shape our creative offer as we build the UK studio from the ground up and strengthen our offer globally. Making the team stronger. Making the work more ambitious. And helping establish Kurppa Hosk as a creative force in this market.

Responsibilities

•
Set and safeguard the creative direction and quality bar for Kurppa Hosk's design work – from strategic concept through to final execution, across brand creation, rebrands, and other transformative creative challenges.

•
Lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams – consisting of accounts, strategists, designers, creatives, and client partners; creating work that's stronger than the sum of its parts.

•
Build the London studio from day one – shape the creative culture, hire the team, and coach design talent as it grows, establishing the standards, rituals and ways of working that define what Kurppa Hosk UK stands for.

•
Build strong, trust-based relationships directly with clients – acting as a creative partner they trust to push their thinking.

•
Partner with the Business Director and founding UK team on new business – from pitches to growing existing accounts, bringing creative conviction into every commercial conversation.

•
Champion AI-enabled ways of working – experimenting with emerging tools in our design processes and deliverables, and helping the UK studio integrate them into how we ship and what we ship, in service of higher pace, quality and ambition.

•
Shape Kurppa Hosk's design offer and point of view in the UK – establish our creative presence externally through published perspectives, industry engagement and visibility that positions us as a serious voice in the London market.

•
Actively engage the wider Eidra network – to bring cross-disciplinary strength into UK client work and open new commercial opportunities.

The ideal person

You're a creative leader with a strong point of view and the craft to back it up, someone who can move fluidly from early strategic thinking to final execution without losing ambition along the way. You're generous with your time and your thinking: as comfortable coaching a junior designer as you are challenging a client to be braver.

You're curious about how design craft is evolving, actively experimenting with new tools, AI included, and pulling the teams around you into that exploration rather than waiting for the answer to arrive.

You're energized by the idea of building a creative culture from the ground up. You collaborate naturally with strategy and commercial partners, understanding that great creative work and great client relationships build each other.

And most of all – you're a genuinely nice person.

Qualifications

•
Exceptional track record leading creative work at a brand, design or advertising agency. Shaping creative direction, not just executing it. Typically 10+ years, with 3+ at CD level or equivalent.

•
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary creative teams and coach individual designers.

•
Experience building trust-based relationships directly with senior clients.

•
Strong portfolio of brand-led transformation, brand creation, rebrands or comparable transformative work, with examples where you shaped the direction.

•
Fluent in modern design tools and actively engaged with how AI is reshaping design craft; keen to experiment and help teams adopt new capabilities.

•
Experience contributing to new business, pitches – scoping, account growth – making the creative case in commercial conversations.

•
Comfortable in a founding-team environment, building rather than maintaining. Prior experience starting up a new studio, office or practice is a strong plus.

•
Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written (English is our working language)

•
Eligible to work in the UK.

Why join us

•
30 days paid holiday

•
Private medical insurance

•
Regular international travel, with opportunities to work and connect in Sweden, Norway, the Netherlands, DACH, and the US, where Kurppa Hosk/Eidra have operations

•
Play a central role in scaling a fast-growing business

•
Latest Apple kit (MacBook + iPhone) to do your best work

•
Company conferences in standout European locations to connect, learn, and celebrate

title: Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

The day-to-day

• Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.

• Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.

• Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.

• Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.

• Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.

• Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.

• Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

You should apply if you

•

Hold a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).

•

Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.

•

Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).

•

Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.

•

Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.

•

Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.

•

Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.

•

Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.

•

Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

•

Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

•

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

•

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

•

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

•

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

•

Competitive salary and VSOP options

•

Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

•

Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

•

Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

•

Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

•

Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

•

Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

•

A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Internship - Creative
description:
We are Bold. An international brand consultancy shaping identities and experiences that move culture, commerce and industry forward.

Across our studios in Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo and London, we unite strategic thinking, curiosity and creative ambition to build brands that stand for something. Brands that break convention. Brands that last.

Now we're looking for the next generation of creative minds to join us.

The Internship

At Bold, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be part of the creative process, working alongside our designers and creative directors to turn ideas into identities and experiences that make an impact.

From first sketches to final details, you'll get the chance to explore, experiment, challenge conventions and sharpen your craft. We believe the best ideas can come from anyone. Including you.

What You'll Do

•
Explore ideas, develop concepts and bring them to life.

•
Help create visual identities, design systems, motion and digital experiences.

•
Collaborate with designers, strategists and creative directors on real client projects.

•
Experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of thinking.

•
Bring your own perspective. Challenge ours.

Who You Are

We're looking for curious minds with a passion for great design. People who care about the big idea as much as the smallest detail.

•
You're studying graphic design, art direction, digital design, motion or a related discipline.

•
You have a portfolio that shows how you think, not just what you make.

•
You're comfortable working with tools like Adobe CC and Figma.

•
You're curious, ambitious and eager to learn.

•
You're open to feedback, unafraid to ask questions and ready to contribute.

Guidance from great minds.

Space to explore.

Good people. Great culture.

Show us what you've got. Share your portfolio, your CV and a few words about yourself, what drives you and why you'd like to join Bold.

We review applications continuously and match interns with dedicated mentors to make sure everyone gets the right support and experience.

Curious? Ambitious? Ready to make your mark? Come join us.

title: Senior Web Designer / Delivery Lead
description:
NAXCON GmbH, located in the heart of Freiburg, is at the forefront of the German IT and engineering industry.

Our experts have extensive knowledge in software and hardware development, state-of-the-art electronics, and future-oriented technologies such as artificial intelligence and virtual reality.

We are not only dedicated to project work for our customers, but also intensively pursue in-house innovation projects as well as research & development. Renowned companies from a wide range of German industries place their trust in us - demonstrating the outstanding expertise and commitment of our engineers.

Position: Senior Web Designer / Delivery Lead

Type: Full-time/Remote

Field: Development of Information Platform

About the Role

The Senior Web Designer is the creative and delivery lead for a confidential geospatial project. The role combines senior-level screen design ownership with project management responsibility for the development period.

Design work covers: a TYPO3 13 LTS editorial website, a React 18 geospatial dashboard with interactive map (MapLibre GL JS), five chart types, paginated data tables, a report builder with PDF export, and an embeddable widget distributed as an npm package. The platform must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA on the website and best-effort Level AA on the dashboard, with colour-blind-safe cartographic palettes throughout. All client communication is conducted in German.

Key Responsibilities

•
Own corporate design Develop the project-specific corporate design from scratch: logo direction, colour palette, typography, iconography, and form language — creating a visual identity that can be shared across two independent institutional project partners (Brandenburg & Mecklenburg-Vorpommern).

•
Screen design all view types Design responsive layouts for all page types (desktop, tablet, mobile) — including the Homepage, 12+ CMS page templates, and all dashboard states (standard fullpage, two-column comparison, filter panel, map layer controls, chart views, table views, and report builder flow).

•
Lead dashboard UX Translate complex geospatial and forestry inventory data into clear, usable dashboard interfaces. Design the information hierarchy for map layers, filters, legends, layer ordering, chart frames, and data tables. Define UX for the comparison view and URL-shareable filter states.

•
Build Figma component library Deliver a complete Asset Library and component set in Figma covering all interactive UI elements: CTAs, buttons, labels, tags, filter selectors, map controls, tooltips, chart frames, table controls, and report builder components.

•
Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA compliance Validate all colour choices for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios. Design colour-blind-safe palettes for map layers and chart series (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia). Annotate all Figma components with accessibility requirements (ARIA roles, focus states, keyboard interaction patterns).

•
Manage client delivery Serve as primary client contact for all design-related reviews. Lead formal design feedback cycles, present screen designs to client stakeholders in German, and ensure all accepted designs meet contractual accessibility and UX quality gates before handover to frontend development.

•
Support through Alpha & Beta Provide ongoing design support through both test phases — clarifying design intent, reviewing frontend implementations against Figma specs, and iterating based on user test feedback collected in the Beta round.

•
Optional deliverables Optionally lead Naming process, define a photographic image language, produce a clickdummy for stakeholder validation, and design a Dark Mode variant for the map view and/or the full platform.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience as a Senior Web Designer, UX/UI Designer, or equivalent creative lead role on web platform or digital product projects.

• Demonstrated project responsibility: at least 2 reference projects meeting the financial thresholds — one project with a minimum turnover of EUR 250,000 and a minimum duration of 2 years; one project with a minimum turnover of EUR 150,000 completed within one year.

• Proficiency in Figma — including component libraries, variants, auto-layout, and design-to-developer handoff workflows.

• Demonstrated experience designing responsive web interfaces across website and web application contexts.

• Proven WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance at the design stage — practical knowledge of colour contrast validation, keyboard navigation patterns, and accessible component design for at least 1 reference project.

• Portfolio demonstrating at least one dashboard, data visualisation, or mapping/GIS interface design.

• Fluent German at minimum C1 level — all client communication and design presentations are conducted in German.

Nice to Have

• Experience designing geospatial or map-based interfaces (layer controls, map legends, filter panels, H3 hexagonal overlays).

• Background in creating complete design systems or corporate identity from scratch for multi-partner projects.

• Familiarity with BITV 2.0 or German public-sector accessibility expectations and EN 301 549.

• Experience designing colour-blind-safe palettes for data visualisation (tools such as Viz Palette, Colour Oracle, or equivalent).

• Knowledge of PDF/UA requirements for exported report design.

• Prior involvement in a German public-sector, open-source, or institutional digital platform project.

• Exposure to agile delivery workflows with structured developer handoff using Figma dev mode or design tokens.

• Optional: familiarity with dark-mode design for web applications.

What we offer:
•Join a cosmopolitan and internationally mixed team: We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and cultures to contribute their unique perspectives and talents to our team.
•Polish your German language skills: If you are looking to improve your German language skills, we offer a supportive environment where you can practice and develop your language abilities: whether you are a beginner or an advanced speaker.
•Benefit from a fixed contact person from the company: We understand the importance of having a reliable point of contact within the company. That's why we assign a dedicated contact person who will provide guidance and support throughout your employment with us.
•Professional growth and development: With us, our engineers can immerse themselves in new industries or projects after just 1-2 years and actively transfer knowledge.
•Enjoy regular team events with the company: We believe in the power of team building and fostering positive relationships within the workplace. That's why we organize regular team events to promote collaboration and strengthen our team bonds.

title: Executive Researcher, DoorDash International
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our Global Structure

Wolt is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

The Doordash International Executive Recruiting Team is a newly formed team with the mission of identifying and hiring exceptional leadership talent to support the growth of our international businesses (including Wolt and Deliveroo). We’re hiring an Executive Recruiting Researcher who will play a key role in supporting complex leadership searches across multiple functions and markets. In this role, you will own the research and engagement strategy for senior talent across DoorDash International, partnering closely with recruiters and hiring leaders to build strong, diverse leadership pipelines. This role will report to the Director of Executive Recruiting.

What You'll Do

• Help define, design, and implement leadership recruiting programs and search engagements for a variety of executive roles, including talent landscape mapping, internal calibration and referrals, and aligning those insights with the external talent market.

• Focus on external talent market mapping, market and talent insights, as well as senior talent cultivation and bench-building for future leadership needs.

• Partner closely with Executive Recruiters to launch search engagements, create robust role and candidate specifications, and qualify and present leadership candidates.

• Deliver qualified and diverse pipelines for active searches, while actively networking and building strong relationships with exceptional candidates.

• Evaluate the effectiveness of sourcing efforts through data analysis and reporting, including search progress updates, status reports, and market trends for presentation to senior leadership.

• Proactively recommend and drive process improvements that enhance candidate identification, engagement, and overall search effectiveness.

• Support an exceptional candidate experience at every stage of the executive hiring process.

• Leverage AI tools to work smarter and drive market mapping, company research and candidate profiling, while keeping the quality and accuracy of insights high.

What We're Looking For

• Proven experience leading executive-level searches and building senior talent pipelines across diverse company environments (e.g., executive search firm and/or in-house experience within a fast-paced organisation).

• Deep expertise in market mapping, talent research, and senior-level candidate identification.

• Skilled at using AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude or AI-enabled sourcing platforms to identify senior talent.

• Ability to combine AI-enabled research with data and market insight to produce sharper, faster talent intelligence for executive searches.

• Experience leveraging talent market insights and data to influence decision-making with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships with leaders and stakeholders across the organization.

• Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and highly driven to deliver impact.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up sourcing, market research and candidate outreach, with sound judgement on where human review is needed.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement company with a simple goal: to make every leader better. Through interaction, insights and recommendations, its platform helps organizations turn participation into better understanding and stronger performance.

Founded in Stockholm in 2012, Mentimeter is used by 20 million people each month across 1.3 million organizations. At Mentimeter, we believe better leadership starts with listening and that the strongest results are achieved together. That’s why we foster a culture built on curiosity, collaboration and shared ownership. By joining us, you’ll help leaders turn participation into deeper understanding and stronger performance, advancing our ambition to help more than one billion people listen, learn and work better together.

About the role

As a Product Designer at Mentimeter, you own the experience your team ships and how it fits into the whole: making sure it works, solves a problem people actually have, and holds together as we build more. Millions of leaders use Mentimeter to lead: to make a decision, bring people with them, understand what their organisation actually thinks.

You join at the point where the work gets hardest and most interesting. Mentimeter has grown from one tool into an engagement suite, and making those pieces feel like one experience leaders and organisations can build on is now one of our hardest problems. The payoff is turning a great moment of engagement into results people act on, insight that holds over time, and value that spreads across an organisation, powered by AI that helps leaders see what matters and act on it.

You’ll report to the Design Director for that area and work day to day inside a product team, alongside a Product Manager and Product Engineers. Beyond the team, you’ll work with other competences such as User Research, Analytics, Content Design, Accessibility, Design Systems, Marketing and Sales to understand users and keep the suite coherent.

What you’ll do

• Design end-to-end experiences across the full development model, from problem framing through shipped and refined iteration: interaction, visual design, usability, prototyping and testing.

• Take an ambiguous problem and leave the room with a clear problem statement, hypotheses and success criteria you can evaluate.

• Ground direction in user evidence. Spend real time with users, read the signal, and read the release data afterwards to know whether anything actually changed.

• Name the trade-offs between user value, usability, coherence and technical constraint instead of letting them sit implicit.

• Design patterns that scale across surfaces and teams, and protect product-wide coherence as the suite grows.

Who you are

You own the experience, not the handoff. You work from the problem through to what shipped and what it changed, and you treat "did this work for the user?" as part of your job, not someone else's follow-up. You can hold a strong design opinion without needing to win the room, and you’d rather get to the right solution to the right problem than polish the wrong one.

You work through AI as part of how you design, not a tool you reach for occasionally. You use it across research, exploration and execution, you read its output critically rather than ship it, and you hold a real view of where it strengthens the work and where it degrades the experience. Autocomplete is not what we mean.

You treat insight and data as design material, not reporting. You're comfortable close to users and close to the numbers, and you bring the team closer to both.

This role might not be for you if…

• You use AI only as autocomplete, or steer clear of it, rather than making it part of how you design and solve problems.

• You want the problem handed to you fully framed, with the user need and success criteria already decided.

• You see design as what happens after the real decisions are made.

• You treat research and data as someone else's job.

• You consider the work done when the design ships, rather than when you know whether it changed something for users.

• You want to stay in visual polish and avoid the ambiguity of early product work.

Requirements

• A portfolio that shows end-to-end product design: problem framing, interaction and visual craft, and shipped outcomes, not only final screens.

• Evidence that you ground design in user research and data, and change direction based on what you learn.

• AI built into how you already work, across research, exploration and delivery.

• Strong product thinking: you frame design decisions in terms of user value, business impact and risk.

• Systems awareness: you design patterns that hold across surfaces and teams.

• Excellent communication, and comfort working independently and in a cross-functional team.

Not required

You don't have to know Swedish. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!

Location

This is primarily an on-site role at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm.

Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 65,000–SEK 82,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter can offer
At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people. AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter
At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Member of Design Staff, Product Design
description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Abridge, you won’t just be designing software. You’ll be redesigning the future of healthcare delivery. You’ll create experiences that give clinicians back time, reduce cognitive load, and enable doctors to give their patients undivided attention again.

Healthcare is broken in ways most people don’t see. Clinicians spend much of their time on administrative tasks, contributing to unprecedented burnout and compromised patient care. The current state of clinical documentation forces doctors to choose between looking at their patients and looking at their computers.

We’re hiring product designers with a range of experience levels, strengths, and areas of expertise. Your scope will reflect what you bring to the team, but every designer at Abridge is expected to take meaningful ownership, navigate ambiguity, and help raise the quality of our products and practice.

This role is for someone who dreams big and can reimagine experiences. You’ll work on problems that have never been solved before, in an industry where design decisions directly affect human lives and well-being.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Designer, you’ll shape the product experience at Abridge, setting a high bar for taste, clarity, and strategic thinking across initiatives that directly impact clinicians, patients, and care teams.

You’ll collaborate deeply with cross-functional partners, immerse yourself in the complexity of clinical workflows, and bring structure and empathy to ambiguous problems. Whether you’re exploring new ideas or refining existing experiences, you’ll advocate for design excellence throughout the product lifecycle.

•
Simplify the Complex: Tackle challenging and ambiguous design and customer problems, transforming complex clinical workflows and AI capabilities into intuitive, thoughtful, and delightful experiences.

•
Elevate Our Craft and Standards: Push the boundaries of visual and interaction design. Bring a strong command of design principles, motion, and prototyping; contribute to our evolving design standards; and ensure every detail and interaction is carefully considered.

•
Own End-to-End Design Execution: Design for today’s needs and tomorrow’s challenges, translating early ideas into clear product direction, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and user flows. No task is too small or too large when it contributes to building an exceptional product.

•
Champion User-Centered Design: Advocate passionately for the clinicians and care teams who rely on our product every day. Engage in user research, synthesize insights, and ground design decisions in a deep understanding of users’ needs and pain points.

•
Lead Through Collaboration: Build strong partnerships across design, product, engineering, research, and other disciplines. Communicate clearly, invite feedback, and help teams make thoughtful decisions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical realities.

What You’ll Bring

•
5+ years of experience shipping impactful digital products, ideally within complex domains. Experience with AI-powered products is a plus.

•
A strong track record of taking meaningful design initiatives from concept through launch and demonstrating an impact on users and the business.

•
The ability to bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous problems, adapting your approach and level of ownership to the needs of the work.

•
A high craft bar that you consistently meet and help others elevate. You care deeply about the details while maintaining sight of the larger product experience.

•
Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence partners across functions.

•
A highly collaborative spirit and low ego, along with a genuine desire to learn, teach, give and receive feedback, and grow with a fast-paced, high-performing team.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

•
AI or machine-learning products

•
Consumer mobile products

•
Enterprise products

We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Must be willing to work from our SF or NYC office at least 3x per week

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to San Francisco or New York.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

•
Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

•
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

•
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

•
Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

•
Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

•
401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

•
Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

•
Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

•
Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

•
Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

•
Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

•
Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

•
... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $218K - $299K

title: Associate Director, Technical Motion Design
location: NY, US, MA, US, IL, US, ON, CAN - Remote
description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for an Associate Motion Technical Director to lead the technical evolution of the OpenAI motion pipeline while remaining an active motion practitioner. This mixed people management, operations, and individual-contributor role is responsible for building the systems that help the team move from brief to delivery with greater speed, consistency, and confidence.

You will directly manage and mentor Motion Designers across the team, with a focus on technical craft, production judgment, workflow discipline, and problem solving. You will partner with Motion Directors, Creative Directors, designers, Project Managers, Quality Control, localization partners, and client stakeholders to translate creative goals into durable production systems.

The role owns hands-on pipeline building across concept, build, approval, localization, delivery, and archive. You will create and maintain tools, scripts, templates, component libraries, file standards, review workflows, and automation that reduce repetitive work without narrowing creative possibilities. You will also step into complex production work, debug failing builds, and help the team deliver when technical risk is highest.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Define and maintain the technical roadmap for the OpenAI motion pipeline, prioritizing improvements that reduce repetitive work, improve quality, and make delivery more scalable.

• Build, test, document, and maintain scripts, plugins, expressions, templates, presets, and AI-assisted tools for motion production, versioning, localization, quality control, and delivery.

• Develop and govern reusable motion components, UI modules, project templates, and shared libraries so teams can reuse approved systems before rebuilding common behaviors.

• Design localization-ready workflows, including responsive layouts, text expansion, structured copy handoffs, automated comp generation, version control, and first-language quality assurance.

• Establish practical standards for file architecture, naming, layer organization, collected project files, dependencies, handoff, archiving, and long-term maintainability.

• Improve the connections between Figma, After Effects, review platforms, trackers, storage, and delivery systems so feedback, versions, approvals, and source files remain traceable.

• Remain hands-on in production by solving complex builds, prototyping technical approaches, debugging project failures, and creating reference implementations the team can extend.

• Directly manage and develop Motion Designers, with responsibility for their growth, performance, daily engagement, and confidence in technical problem solving.

• Coach Motion Designers across the team on efficient build practices, expressions, automation, localization, quality control, documentation, and sustainable project structure.

• Partner with creative and project leadership during scoping and concept development to identify technical dependencies, production risk, reuse opportunities, and automation potential before work begins.

• Evaluate new creative technologies and recommend when to adopt, test, or avoid them based on reliability, maintainability, security, creative value, and team readiness.

• Create clear training materials and onboarding documentation, run workshops, and provide ongoing support so technical knowledge is shared across the team rather than concentrated with one person.

• Track recurring production friction, measure whether workflow changes solve it, and maintain a prioritized backlog of pipeline improvements.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• 5+ years of professional experience in motion design, technical direction, creative technology, animation production, or a related role.

• A strong motion portfolio or body of technical work showing both high-quality execution and the ability to build systems that other creatives can use.

• Deep expertise in Adobe After Effects, including expressions, project architecture, rendering, troubleshooting, and reusable template construction.

• Experience building or maintaining creative-production tools through scripting, plugins, APIs, node-based workflows, or automation; JavaScript or ExtendScript experience is strongly preferred.

• Strong working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Premiere; experience with 3D tools, generative video, command-line workflows, Python, or render automation is a plus.

• Experience with localization, large-scale versioning, responsive motion layouts, structured copy handoffs, production quality assurance, and delivery standards.

• Experience managing, mentoring, or developing creative team members, with the ability to explain technical concepts to people with different levels of expertise.

• Excellent debugging and systems-thinking skills, including the judgment to choose a maintainable solution over a fragile shortcut.

• Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to align creative, production, and client partners around a technical approach.

• Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Animation, Computer Science, Film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

• Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

• 401k plan, plus matching

• PTO

• Paid Company Holidays

• Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

title: Product/Design Recruiter
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

What you’ll do

To further this important mission, we are looking for a driven and collaborative Product & Design Recruiter to grow and scale our global product management and design organizations. You can expect high-impact and wide-ranging responsibility: owning full-cycle recruiting for specialized product and design searches, contributing to our geographic strategy through talent market insights, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, navigate ambiguity, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

Responsibilities:

- Partner with senior leaders across product management and design to understand hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies tailored to each organization’s needs.
- Own full-cycle recruiting across product management and design disciplines, including product design, brand design, content design, design engineering, web presence design, and UX research.
- Build a deep understanding of the skills, experience, and craft required for product and design roles, partnering with hiring teams to define profiles and align on evaluation criteria.
- Develop strategic sourcing and engagement plans to attract product and design talent across different geographies, including passive senior candidates.
- Use talent market insights to advise hiring leaders on candidate availability, search strategy, and geographic opportunities.
- Track and analyze recruiting metrics, share hiring progress with product and design leadership, and use insights to improve search outcomes.
- Initiate creative and scalable improvements to recruiting processes while maintaining a high-quality candidate experience.
- Work closely with Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal to deliver a high-quality and holistic candidate experience.

Minimum requirements

- 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including 4+ years recruiting across product management and design in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with in-house experience.
- Experience supporting hiring across both product management and design, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
- Ability to understand distinct product and design profiles and translate business needs into effective search strategies.
- A growth mindset and flexibility to shift tasks and priorities as business needs change.
- An active, data-driven approach to problem-solving, using recruiting trends and market insights to improve processes and outcomes.
- Proven ability to attract passive senior candidates and build diverse pipelines across different hiring locations.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise hiring leaders and navigate competing priorities across product and design searches.
- Strong operational rigor and the ability to stay organized amid change.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness.
