title: Creative Engineer, Stripe Creative Lab
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling.

Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

About Stripe Creative Lab

Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

Responsibilities

• Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools

• Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better

• Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it

• Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work

• Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects

• Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them

• Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner

• Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience

• Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies

• A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology

• Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences

• Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it

• Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence

• Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with realtime graphics, WebGL, WebGPU, Three.js, shaders, animation, generative systems, or other forms of creative coding

• Experience working with hardware, physical computing, embedded systems, sensors, displays, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, or interactive installations

• Familiarity with backend development, APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, or other areas beyond frontend engineering

• Experience collaborating with designers, artists, fabricators, creative studios, or other multidisciplinary partners

• Experience identifying, evaluating, and directing outside technical specialists when a project extends beyond your own expertise

• Deep curiosity about technology, design, craft, and the ways new technical capabilities can enable new forms of creative work

The group comprises Epidemic Sound, the world's leading soundtracking platform; Soundly, its sound effects platform; Overtone Studios, the group's mood and functional music label; Plenty Labs, an AI-native creative platform for enterprises and creative professionals teams; and Blenda Labs, a next generation video entertainment company. The group is backed by EQT, Blackstone, Creandum, Atwater Capital, Alecta, AMF, and IMAS Foundation.



At Blenda Labs, we’re rethinking how movies are made—combining cutting-edge AI tools with the best creative talent to produce jaw-dropping video on famous IP such as Lilla Spöket Laban https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QUCri64QJ_4, Pippi Långstrump https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o0Bs5lOrunI and Sunes värld https://www.youtube.com/shorts/AeEXveZV_f0. Now we’re extending our capabilities from pure 2D animation to 3D and live action.



We're looking for a 3D Creative Engineer to join our team for a 3 month freelance assignment (with a good chance to be extended further). You'll sit at the intersection of art and engineering — rigging characters, building 2D, 3D and VFX workflows, and writing the tools that let our creative pipeline move fast without breaking. From Blender-based animation setups to procedural systems and custom software, you'll help define how content actually gets made here. You'll be laying the foundation for a future team of artists and developers, but this is a hands-on role first and foremost.



What you'll do

 - Build and extend 2D, 3D, animation and VFX pipelines centered on Blender

 - Design and build character rigs and procedural setups that animators can rely on

 - Write pipeline tooling and automations in Python and Swift that connect asset handling, animation, rendering, and versioning

 - Solve hard problems in motion quality: animation cleanup, temporal consistency, and polish on AI-assisted output

 - Collaborate with artists, AI developers, and producers to bridge creative intent and technical output

 - Prototype and ship tools that real artists will depend on daily



What we're looking for

 - A technical director mindset: you think in systems, not just one-off scripts

 - Strong Blender skills, including scripting and add-on development with Python

 - Solid experience of generative AI models for video and images

 - Solid 3D fundamentals: modeling, shading, lighting, and scene and asset management

 - Hands-on rigging experience — character rigs, IK/FK solvers, control hierarchies, or procedural setups

 - Animation experience, with an understanding of timing, weight, and deformation

 - macOS programming experience, e.g. Swift/Rust/C++, for apps or pipeline utilities

 - A sharp eye for motion quality — you feel when something's off before you can name why

 - Fluent in English, with strong written and spoken communication skills

Bonus:

 - Background in VFX or post-production (compositing, simulation, FX)

 - Experience with real-time skeletal animation systems or mesh pipeline tooling

 - Familiarity with a game engine (Godot, Unreal, or Unity)

 - Experience with AI tools and workflows, e.g. ComfyUI or similar

 - JavaScript/TypeScript for tooling or editor extensions
   
   

What we offer

 - Hybrid role in Stockholm. We share office space with Epidemic Sound near Medborgarplatsen, Stockholm.

 - A chance to work hard and grow very fast with an extremely ambitious team.

 - We want to start with a 3 month freelance assignment with a good chance to be extended further.



Equal opportunity employer
We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to apply.

title: Backend Engineer, UI Platform
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations behind Stripe’s Dashboard and many other user interfaces. Sail Services owns the systems that evaluate feature flags and experiments, ingest frontend analytics, and improve Dashboard load times for Stripe’s largest merchants.

We build backend-for-frontend capabilities that connect Stripe’s backend systems to its UI platform. This gives product teams a consistent way to build and operate user experiences without recreating the same infrastructure.

What you’ll do

As a Backend Engineer on the Sail Services team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power Stripe’s user interfaces. You’ll independently drive software projects from problem definition through production, working closely with other UI Platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure partners. Your work will range from APIs and GraphQL integrations to edge systems, architectural migrations, and the tooling needed to operate them safely at scale.

Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, aligning on priorities and then independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operation

• Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable APIs and backend systems that support Stripe’s Dashboard, mobile applications, and other user interfaces

• Help modernize Stripe’s UI architecture through incremental migrations, automated validation, shadow traffic, and carefully controlled production rollouts

• Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and operability of services on critical user paths

• Partner with frontend, backend, and infrastructure engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring problems into reusable platform capabilities

• Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to improve implementation, testing, validation, and delivery

• Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and runbooks that improve the quality of the team’s work

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code

• 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and operating production systems

• Strong knowledge of backend technologies and infrastructure, including the fundamentals of APIs, data storage, distributed systems, and production operations

• Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended software projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, reliability, and user impact

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers, product engineers, and infrastructure partners

Preferred qualifications

•

• Experience building backend-for-frontend systems, UI platform services, developer platforms, or shared infrastructure

• Experience designing or integrating APIs, including GraphQL APIs

• Experience with high-throughput event ingestion, feature flag or experimentation systems, or other latency-sensitive platform services

• Familiarity with caching, asynchronous systems, configuration systems, or data-consistency tradeoffs

• Experience executing large migrations using automated validation, shadow traffic, feature flags, or staged rollouts

• Experience using data, developer feedback, or operational signals to improve a platform or developer-facing product

title: Design Researcher Openings
description:
Conifer Research conducts design research projects both domestically and internationally for clients across a wide variety of industries.

DESIGN RESEARCHER

People are endlessly fascinating, don’t you think? We do. Conifer Research is seeking a curious and empathetic Design Researcher who is passionate about humans, learning, and guiding clients to understand what makes people tick and drive strategy and innovation. Conifer provides opportunities to work on projects across numerous industries, wearing many hats along the way – from researcher to strategist to storyteller to user advocate. Though there may be longer-term opportunities in the future, we are currently looking to hire on a project basis.

ABOUT CONIFER

Conifer Research brings practical insight to companies that wish to change and innovate. Through an ethnographic approach to research, we help our clients embed their creativity into an understanding of the everyday lives of people they hope to engage – customers, workers, and end-users. Our seasoned team of anthropologists, strategists, and information designers act as consultants, facilitators, and coaches helping organizations gather deep insights.

Clients come to Conifer for many reasons, but with a common challenge: How do we align business activities better with the real lives and needs of customers? We have experience in retail, consumer goods and lifestyles, financial services, healthcare, and digital products. Some clients include Sonos, Samsung, PepsiCo, McDonald’s, Google, Discover, Lowe’s, CarMax, and Ferrara Candy Company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

A successful candidate will be expected to:

• Work with internal and client teams through all phases of qualitative research or innovation programs, including: planning, research design, data collection, rigorous analysis and synthesis, identifying patterns, developing key insights, ideation and opportunity definition.

• Execute research programs drawing from established methodologies for ethnography, remote research, evaluative testing, and co-creation.

• Translate research into actionable recommendations and innovation opportunities.

• Contribute to synthesis and sensemaking to create narratives that frame research findings in a way that clearly demonstrates the business implications of insights and opportunities

• Create deliverables and client presentations

• Be adaptable and creative in order to conduct rigorous remote research

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The qualities of an ideal candidate include:

• Relevant experience in research or insights, including experience in a consultative environment

• Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Anthropology, Sociology, Psychology, Design or a related field

• Experience designing and fielding remote ethnography and online community research

• Being strategic, flexible, collaborative, and passionate about advocating for user needs

• Confident presentation skills and passion for communicating user stories and insights

• Active engagement in thought leadership within the design research community

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Proficient with Keynote and remote research software

Bonus points for:

• Experience with video editing (Final Cut, Adobe Premiere and After Effects) and/or visual storytelling preferred.

• Visual communication and presentation design skills

• Previous experience with quantitative research including survey design and quant data analysis

• Proficiency with video, still photography and audio recording equipment.

• Foreign language fluency

• Thought leadership and public speaking experience

title: Creative Director
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

You will shape the visual language of ActAI's product. In AI applications, visual design must do more than look polished. It must help users understand dynamic content, system behavior, reliability signals, and complex AI-driven workflows.

This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for ActAI's product across web and mobile.

•
Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

•
Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

•
Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

•
Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

•
Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

•
Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

•
Make AI-heavy interfaces feel clear and structured without overwhelming users.

What You Will Need

•
Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

•
Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

•
Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

•
Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

•
Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

•
Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

•
Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

•
Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Marketing Art Director
description:

You'll sit in the Marketing team and work side by side with the Game Art Directors on both titles. Together you'll keep each game's identity consistent from in-game to out, and find ways to bring great marketing work back into the games. You'll set the visual direction, build the systems that let others execute it well, and stay hands-on when the work needs it.

Example of responsibilities

Partner with game Art Directors to expand Embark’s 2D art production capabilities, unlocking new opportunities for marketing campaigns

•
Lead art direction across marketing campaigns, keeping the full asset suite consistent across key art, paid media, trailer slates and motion graphics in partnership with game Art Directors.

•
Build brand design systems that turn our games’ visual identities into scalable toolkits for campaigns and advertising.

•
Create and maintain style guides so agencies and partners can apply the brand correctly and consistently across digital, print, merch and licensing work.

•
Explore new visual territory for upcoming marketing opportunities through concept references, mockups and mood boards.

Present creative work with clear reasoning that ties visual choices to channel requirements, audience insights and expected impact.

Who you are

A bridge between strategy and craft. You can shape the big-picture direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it real.

•
A systems thinker. You design for scale, so a single idea can carry from a trailer slate to a T-shirt without losing its identity.

•
Curious about what's next. You keep up with new tools, techniques and design principles to help us lead rather than follow trends.

•
A natural collaborator. You like partnering with game teams, respect their vision and look for chances to make in-game and out-of-game work stronger together.

•
A generous leader. You make the people and partners around you better through clear direction and thoughtful feedback.

•
Passionate about games, especially ours. You're excited to bring our worlds to life for our players and community.

We would love if you have

•
A creative and curious mind

•
Experience as an Art Director or Senior Designer in marketing or brand, ideally for games, entertainment or consumer brands.

A portfolio showing campaign work and brand systems you've led, from first concept to final execution across several channels.

•
Deep knowledge of the channels where marketing art lives (social, paid media, store pages, out-of-home, broadcast, print, merch, licensing) and what each one demands.

•
Proven experience building brand identities, design systems or style guides that other teams and partners have used at scale.

•
Experience directing external partners such as agencies and freelancers alongside internal artists.

•
Strong skills in typography, layout, colour and composition, plus solid knowledge of motion design principles.

•
Comfort with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) or similar tools, and the ability to jump in hands-on.

•
Interest in emerging technologies, and experience integrating these into your workflows

•
Clear communication in English, written and spoken, including presenting to stakeholders.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Senior Technical 3D Artist (Character Focus)
description:
Company: Proxima Studios (Creators of Suck Up!)

Location: Remote / Flexible

Role Type: Full-Time Contract or Permanent

About Us

We are the indie team behind Suck Up!, where we turned goofy social deduction and conversational AI into pure comedic chaos (with over 200m views on YouTube). Now, we are building our next title: a management simulation that sits between the sandbox of The Sims and the chaotic/comedy of Schedule 1.

We operate small, fast, and scrappy. We value creative ownership, rapid prototyping, and people who can establish a cohesive, signature visual language from the ground up.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead 3D Generalist & Technical Artist with a cartoonist’s comedic timing and a systems-first mindset.

You will architect our character pipeline from the ground up. You will build a scalable, modular character system: designing plug-and-play facial features, swappable clothing kits, and a unified rig that lets code drive endless distinct NPCs. Your characters must prioritize bold silhouettes and comedic physicality, extreme emotional states, physical impairment, and chaotic meltdowns instantly readable in first person.

Key Responsibilities

• Modular Character Pipeline: Model, texture, and rig a stylized, low-poly character kit with modular heads, socketed facial features, and swappable clothing that read clearly across extreme states (drunkenness, rage, distress) and across actions.

• Master Rigging & Retargeting: Build and maintain a unified humanoid skeleton with standardized attachment sockets (hands, eyes, accessories, seats) to share animations seamlessly across all roles.

• Smart Objects & Environments: Model modular furniture, stages, and props adhering strictly to interaction metrics, snap grids, and navmesh constraints.

• Unity Integration: Configure character prefabs, Mecanim state machines, dynamic interior lighting, optimized materials, and essential comedic VFX (particles, mess decals).

• Visual Direction: Establish color palettes, trim sheets, and style guidelines that creates a unified aesthetic.

What We Are Looking For

Artistic & Design Sense

• Cartoonist's Comedic Instinct: Strong grasp of silhouette, exaggerated postures, and physical slapstick (Schedule I, The Sims). You favor punchy readability over photorealism.

• Systemic Thinking: Experience designing reusable, modular kits meant to be mixed and matched hundreds of times.

Technical Competencies

• Full Stylized 3D Pipeline: End-to-end expertise in Blender (or equivalent) for low-poly modeling, texturing, rigging, and skinning with clean optimization.

• Deep Unity Proficiency: Direct experience setting up Humanoid Avatars, Prefabs, Animator Controllers, and collision hulls.

• Sockets & Retargeting: Proven workflow for modular prop attachment, socket hierarchies, and retargeting shared animations across varied body types.

• Code based animations: Unity C# scripting for procedural animation/IK, animation blending, target tracking, and more.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and portfolio link.

Portfolio Priorities:

• In-engine captures of stylized/low-poly characters in motion with distinct silhouettes.

• Rigging and animation samples showing comedic timing and clean skinning.

• Modular workflows (customization kits, swappable parts, grid-based props).

title: Sr. Staff Experience Designer
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The community you will join:

As a Senior Staff Experience Designer, you will partner with supporting disciplines such as writers, researchers, product specialists and engineers to build beautiful, usable, forward-looking products that empower people. Our design charter is to help foster an emotional connection with our community, keeping usability and accessibility as our prime virtues. We do our best to practice inclusive design at every turn, spanning both the online and offline experiences we create for our community.

The difference you will make:

As a Senior Staff Experience Designer in London, you will play a critical role in shaping how Airbnb shows up in markets across EMEA, Latin America, and APAC. You will help ensure our global products feel truly local—adapting core experiences to regional needs while feeding market insights back into the broader product strategy. Sitting at the intersection of product, design, and regional strategy, you will work across time zones and functions to define and deliver an international roadmap that spans both tactical UI improvements and larger strategic bets. You will bring a high bar for visual and interaction design craft, model AI-enabled ways of working, and provide senior design leadership in a space that is growing in complexity and impact for Airbnb globally. The Staff/Senior Staff Experience Designer is an individual contributor (IC) role that will report to a Manager or Director of Experience Design.

A typical day:

• Support and shape the evolution of the Airbnb platform from a design perspective; ensure consistency with, and contribute to, our brand architecture and product architecture.

• Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientist, Researchers and Writers to define problems & goals, map user flows, prototype interactions, and launch new products and services.

• Influence leadership decision making through a clear point of view and define and solve highly complex problems autonomously.

• Provide indirect leadership and mentorship for a team of designers through the end-to-end interaction and visual design of products and services for a global audience.

• Anticipate business challenges and independently create product solutions. Indirectly lead the work of a team of talented designers, writers, program managers, researchers, product managers and engineers as the defacto creative director of innovative projects

• Build strong relationships with leaders inside and outside of core product teams; strong communication and executive stakeholder management skills.

• Have a keen understanding of the technological, business and user opportunities and constraints.

• Scopes project work (in partnership with PMs and engineers) and helps define the design process and timeline.

Your expertise:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and progressive experience

• Designer/Design Leader with 12+ years of experience.

• Excellent visual and interaction skills and craft.

• Defines the design direction and process and can lead others through it.

• Can accurately scope their work as well as their teammate's.

• Can effortlessly motivate and drive small to medium teams to transform a product.

• Demonstrated ability to help a team navigate ambiguity, set vision, and set strategy for global products.

• Systems-thinker with the ability to think beyond the pixels and design for offline experiences.

• Experience with making complex information, tools, and services easily digestible for your audience.

• Strong storytelling, presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience designing platforms and systems.

• Experience managing and collaborating with research and writing disciplines.

• 0 to 1 experience or experience redesigning major elements of product, experience or service design.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
description:
Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)

About Assured Allies

Aging well is both a health question and a financial one, yet most people are handed those challenges separately. At Assured Allies, we believe the only way to truly age well is to address both.

We partner with insurance carriers to help their policyholders stay healthier and more independent for longer. Our member program, NeverStop, delivers personalized coaching and simple daily actions that help people take an active role in their health and longevity.

We’re building for two very different audiences: adults in their 60s and 70s who are engaging with NeverStop, and the carrier executives, partners, and investors who work with Assured Allies. Our brands need to feel connected while speaking authentically to each audience.

That’s where you come in.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Brand & Marketing Designer to help define and own how both Assured Allies and NeverStop show up in the world.

On the NeverStop side, you’ll take an evolving brand foundation and extend it across everything outside the product experience—from the marketing website and campaigns to sales materials, email, social, and other member-facing communications.

For Assured Allies, you’ll help shape how the corporate brand evolves alongside NeverStop. You’ll work closely with Marketing and Corporate Development to establish where the two brands connect, where they should be distinct, and how they can feel like part of the same company without becoming interchangeable.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll design, build, and maintain the work yourself, including our marketing websites in Framer. You’ll also create the systems, templates, and standards that enable the broader team to produce high-quality, on-brand work without needing a designer for every request.

We’re particularly interested in someone who understands that designing for older adults requires thoughtful craft: excellent legibility, clarity, accessibility, and warmth—without relying on the clichés or condescension that too often appear in the category.

We’re open to starting with a contract or part-time engagement, with a clear path to full-time. We’re looking for a long-term design partner who wants to take meaningful ownership of the function, not a project-based agency relationship.

What You'll Do

• Own and evolve the visual expression of the Assured Allies and NeverStop brands across marketing and communications.

• Extend NeverStop’s brand system across websites, landing pages, sales materials, email, social, campaigns, and other marketing surfaces.

• Help define and develop the relationship between the NeverStop and Assured Allies brands.

• Design and maintain marketing websites and digital properties, primarily using Framer.

• Create high-quality sales decks, one-pagers, reports, presentations, campaign creative, and executive-facing materials.

• Partner with Marketing and Corporate Development on campaigns, storytelling, presentations, and other high-impact creative work.

• Collaborate with our product designer to ensure member-facing program content remains consistent with the broader NeverStop brand.

• Build and maintain a library of templates, guidelines, and design standards that enable teams to create on-brand materials independently.

• Establish efficient processes for managing multiple design requests and priorities across Marketing, Product, Corporate Development, and leadership.

• Use AI-assisted design and content tools thoughtfully to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining a high bar for quality and brand consistency.

• Bring strong visual and typographic judgment to everything you create.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or visual design, ideally within a technology-focused company.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating range across brand systems, websites and landing pages, presentations, reports, digital content, and campaigns.

• Experience building, evolving, or extending a brand system across multiple channels.

• Strong hands-on web design and implementation skills using a no-code platform such as Framer, Webflow, or a comparable tool. Direct Framer experience is a plus.

• The ability to work comfortably across both B2C and B2B audiences, adapting the visual language and storytelling to each.

• Strong visual, typographic, and systems-oriented design skills.

• Excellent judgment around brand consistency, especially when working across many contributors and touchpoints.

• Experience collaborating directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.

• A thoughtful perspective on designing for older adults, with an appreciation for accessibility, legibility, clarity, and inclusive design.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve creative workflows and production efficiency, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where human craft matters most.

• A high degree of ownership—you’re comfortable identifying what needs to be done and taking it from concept through execution.

Nice to Have

• Experience in health, wellness, longevity, healthcare, insurance, or a related space.

• Experience with video, motion design, or storyboarding.

• Experience as an early or solo designer at a startup or other resource-constrained environment.

• Experience working across multiple related brands or developing brand architecture.

Compensation & Location

This role is open to starting as a contract or part-time engagement, with a path to full-time based on mutual fit and business needs.

The role is remote within the U.S., with a preference for candidates in the Boston, MA area and consideration for candidates elsewhere on the East Coast.

• Experience preparing manufacturing drawings, bills of materials, cutting lists, and fixing schedules.

title: Lead Product Designer | Platform Engineering
description:
Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy - and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.

What we do

RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.

We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we are looking for a Lead Product Designer to own the user experience of core platform capabilities end to end, embedded directly with the teams that build them.

You are a Lead-level designer with excellent design judgement and the skills to understand platform users’ needs and product goals. You apply agentic engineering workflows to ship features into production and contribute directly to delivering customer value. This is a hands-on role where you shape the scope of the work and are accountable for high-quality design outcomes.

The role requires understanding both the technical infrastructure behind applications and the use cases they aim to solve. Being part of the platform department calls for systemic thinking and solutions that scale to broader use cases and needs.

This role reports into Platform Engineering and is part of the Design Excellence community of 15+ designers across RELEX.

What we need you to do and be

Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.

• Own the user experience of Core Platform application's configuration end to end, embedded in the team that builds it

• Work daily with engineers: talk an idea through, review the first build, and bring it up to production quality, and prototype new features with agentic tools

• Contribute directly to code, combining design judgment with AI-assisted development to ship to production

• Work with the internal builders who use the platform to shape the team’s direction and keep the UI consistent with the main product

• Cover design quality for both UX and UI for the team, so craft and quality are yours to set and keep

What you’ll bring to the table

Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don’t make sense. We stop doing what doesn’t add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.

• Strong product design thinking and execution: have a clear approach on identifying what to build, with good quality

• Systems thinking and information architecture: ability to learn a complex platform quickly

• Research skills in technical domains: experience working with technical, business-first internal users

• Hands-on contribution to shipped solutions: you contribute to working front-end code and are comfortable with agentic and AI-assisted development

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure in a fast-moving environment

• Interest in building tools for the people who build, and in AI-assisted development

• Strong collaboration with engineering, product and design, and the ability to challenge assumptions with evidence

• Fast learning and a proactive, self-managing way of working

• Fluent in written and spoken English

As a bonus

• Experience in AI-assisted workflows

• Experience with plugins, extensions or platform tooling

• Have worked on platform teams or building applications to enables others to build

What we offer in return

You’ll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.

• An international career and learning opportunities in a fast-growing, financially robust software company

• Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness and everyday life, and annual leave

• A diverse, inclusive and supportive work culture, with ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies

• Work that reduces waste and improves sustainability

• Real ownership of an area end to end, close to the team that builds it. You decide how it looks, works and ships.

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other.

Please note that to be considered for this position, you must be fluent in English, be based in Finland and hold a valid work permit for your country of residence. We’re excited to connect with applicants who meet these criteria and share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what’s next for the product, the planet, and the people.

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume and portfolio through the application form as soon as possible.

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

description:
Kurppa Hosk is looking for a Senior Designer to join our team in Oslo!

In this role, you will work closely with our brand strategists, digital designers, and other highly skilled creatives in our field to develop and deploy outstanding brand identities and visual systems. As a Senior Designer, you confidently lead brand design workstreams across medium- to large-sized projects, from initial concepts to fully realized identity systems and final delivery.

You are curious by nature and like to explore new tools and technologies, whether that’s AI, generative and code-based design, or new production methods. You test things early, share what you learn with the team, and look for ways new tools can make our work better and open up new creative possibilities.

You take clear ownership of your projects, proactively drive creative development, and ensure that the design solutions we deliver meet both brand and business objectives. You combine strong craft with structured thinking and are comfortable presenting and discussing your work with clients.

As part of Kurppa Hosk, you will work with some of the world’s leading brands that seek true transformation. You are self-propelled, structured, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with a portfolio that showcases visually strong, well-crafted brand identity systems across a variety of touchpoints.

Main responsibilities

•
Lead brand design workstreams in medium to large projects, from first concepts to complete identity systems and final delivery

•
Translate strategy and brand platforms into high-quality visual solutions, optimized for the relevant touchpoints, formats, materials, and requirements

•
Present and articulate design decisions confidently to clients

•
Secure high craft quality and consistency across all brand deliverables, and mentor more junior designers

•
Collaborate across disciplines, with colleagues in our Stockholm, New York, Chicago and London offices, and with our sister companies in Eidra

•
Explore and bring new tools and technologies into our design process

Qualifications

•
Relevant education within graphic design, visual communication, or similar, or equivalent experience

•
Minimum 5 years of experience in brand or graphic design

•
Proven experience developing and implementing comprehensive brand identity systems

•
Hands-on curiosity for new tools. Experience with AI, generative or code-based design tools is a plus

•
Strong presentation and communication skills

•
Fluent in English; additional languages (including Norwegian) are a plus

Who we are

Kurppa Hosk is a brand agency built for decisive moments. Across Europe and the U.S., our team of 200+ partners with companies at the moments that define them, when clarity is required, and compromise is costly. Working closely with leaders, we help turn bold decisions into confident brands that stand out far from the middle to create momentum and drive demand. We work with brave organisations, from early-stage start-ups like Heart Aerospace to established brands like Zalando, Scania, Nike, Meta and Minecraft.

We’re also a founding member of Eidra, a collective of specialist companies, so you’ll have management consultants, digital experts, and product innovators down the hall, and regularly work together with them on shared client projects.

The Oslo office

Our Oslo team consists of 30 designers, account directors, and strategists located in newly renovated offices at Eidra House on Bankplassen in the historical area of Kvadraturen. As we continue to strengthen our strategic offering and grow our international impact, we are looking for a Senior Designer to help shape the next phase of our journey.

What we offer

•
An international client list, with varied brand challenges across Norwegian and international projects

•
A creative environment with high ambitions for both strategic thinking and design

•
Responsibility for your own workstreams, alongside close collaboration and professional sparring

•
Opportunities to develop through coaching and knowledge sharing within Kurppa Hosk and Eidra

•
A collaborative culture built on curiosity, clear thinking, and respect for each other’s expertise

•
Newly renovated offices at Bankplassen, with all the facilities you need for a great working day, and a lunch worth looking forward to

•
Competitive salary and benefits reflecting your experience and responsibilities

22 of your potential 30 new colleagues at an Oslo office offsite in 2026.

Application requirements

To be considered, you must include your resume and a link to your portfolio with your recent and best work. We use your portfolio as a key part of our evaluation of candidates. If you have a password-protected portfolio, don’t forget to submit your username and password as well.

Application deadline: November 13, 2026
Workspace: Kurppa Hosk in Oslo, Kongens gate 2. Office/hybrid arrangement.
Preferred start date: As soon as possible

title: UX Designer in Growth team
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale up which has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management we need more top-notch competence in our Product team, and we are now looking for a Growth Designer. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!

We're looking for a Growth Designer to own the user experience of how farmers discover, buy and grow with Nofence. You'll design the website, purchase journey and growth products like our referral and partner programs, and use experiments and data to decide what ships next. You'll be part of the Growth team's leadership trio alongside the VP Growth and Tech Lead, setting the UX bar and helping shape what we build.

About the role

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

•
Design the purchase journey: Own the UX of the first-time buyer funnel and checkout, so smaller farms can buy on their own and larger farms move smoothly into a conversation with sales.

•
Shape the website: Own information architecture, page design and improve conversion across markets, working closely with our Growth Manager

•
Build growth products: Design our referral and partner programs end to end, across app, web and email.

•
Cross-Functional collaboration: Work with other teams to align patterns, coordinate releases, and remove seams between journeys. Share insights, resolve dependencies, and contribute to a consistent experience across the app.

•
Interaction design: Create engaging, intuitive interfaces and flows. Move from low-fidelity sketches to high-fidelity prototypes and ready-to-build specifications.

•
Collaborative problem solving: Work closely with UX designers, and the broader Growth team to tackle complex design challenges and deliver feasible solutions that meet user needs.

•
User-centered design: Plan and run discovery, concept tests, and usability evaluations. Use findings to inform prioritisation, iteration, and acceptance criteria.

•
Stakeholder engagement: Communicate decisions, trade-offs, and user insights with clarity. Ensure shared understanding and buy-in for your domain's direction.

About you

The right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:

•
Portfolio is needed to showcase your work

•
You have 5+ years of experience as a product, UX or growth designer, ideally with e-commerce, subscription or self-serve purchase flows with a track record of successfully delivered projects

•
Proficiency in AI, design and prototyping tools such as Figma is a must and you have strong interaction and UI skills and move easily from rough sketches to build-ready designs.

•
Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.

•
Relevant degree/diploma/certificate in Design, HCI, or equivalent.

We are looking for someone who is:

•
You make design decisions with data and are comfortable with funnels, conversion metrics and experiment results.

•
You're commercially curious and understand how design affects conversion and acquisition cost.

•
You work independently and own outcomes, not just deliverables.

•
You're comfortable shipping a good first version and improving it over time.

•
Exceptional design skills with a deep understanding of user-centred design principles and methodologies.

•
You communicate clearly and can explain design trade-offs to developers, marketers and leadership alike.

•
Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to partake in workshops and design sprints that drive collaboration and innovation.

•
Comfortable with working cross-functionally collaborating with different stakeholders to find solutions and drive decisions to impact design.

•
You speak up early when a plan or deadline doesn't look realistic, and you share decisions openly with the team.

•
You're friendly, curious and thrive in a fast-moving team where priorities shift.

About Us

As a company still scaling up, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Product team is currently a team of 15 employees working with Product development, UX Design and Global Customer Support. We're excited to add a Growth Designer to our team who's not only skilled in interaction design but also embodies the collaborative and friendly spirit of Nofence. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment!

What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we are not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We are a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you will be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

We believe in seeing results fast. As a Growth Designer in our team, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

We will evaluate candidates continuously.

About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture? Just like the soil needs a balanced diversity of nutrients to thrive, a company needs a diversity of hearts and minds. We are an equal opportunity employer!

Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and our data protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you!

title: UI Designer
description:
UI Designer - Work from Home (must be residing in the Philippines)

Are you a skilled UI designer ready to embark on an exciting remote contract opportunity? We're looking for a talented individual to join our team!

Job Overview:

•
Position: UI Designer

•
Type: 6-month Contract (with potential to transition to regular employment with benefits)

•
Experience: 2-3 years (with a strong emphasis on delivering high-quality UI design)

•

title: Lead Art Director
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

This is a rare ground-floor opportunity to help build Pinterest's EMEA creative department from the start, as part of House of Creative. As an Art Director, you'll play an integral role in shaping the next iteration of the Pinterest brand — launching global, culturally relevant, award-winning campaigns with a particular emphasis on concepting and art direction. Working across both consumer and B2B marketing, you'll partner with Creative Leaders across the company to tell our story in the most impactful and inspiring way to Consumers, Creators, and Advertisers.

What you’ll do:

• Conceptualize and develop compelling campaign creative from end to end – taking embryonic ideas towards their strongest possible 360 degree creative execution.

• Create memorable films, commercials, and 360° campaigns, including brand partnership work.

• Art direct photography and video shoots, from treatments and mood boards through to final selects.

• Uplevel creative quality of work across the team in partnership with marketing - delivering both business results and international recognition for the Pinterest brand in the industry

• Provide meaningful feedback to in-house art directors and designers (across a breadth of disciplines, like graphic, motion, digital, video, editing, etc) across a variety of formats

• Compellingly represent the thinking behind your team’s work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members Compellingly represent the thinking behind your work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members, including partnering with the US creative team to adapt flagship campaigns for EMEA markets when needed.

• Bring depth to conceptual creative direction, art direction, and design

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to explore more ideas faster and bring concepts to life, while owning the craft and quality of the final work

What we’re looking for:

• Minimum of 8 years of experience as an art director with an emphasis on producing film, commercials, and 360 campaigns (with 3+ of those years in a creative leadership role)

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Visual Communications, Design, Advertising, or equivalent experience

• A book of work with examples of outstanding creative across a variety of brands

• Excellent leadership, mentorship, and interpersonal skills, with a track record of inspiring creative teams to achieve their best work

• Strong grasp of art direction and design craft across a wide variety of formats

• Proven ability to craft a story or concept that shapes culture, rather than reacting to it

• Strong presentation skills, with an ability to convey complex concepts in compellingly simple terms

• Proven experience art directing on set and managing production partners, from treatments and mood boards through to final selects.

• An accomplished creative leader who can bring out the best work in others and produce exceptionally high quality work individually

• An expert collaborator: a creative with deep experience working with writing partners to develop concepts, through to execution

• Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in your art direction process (e.g. concepting, mood boards, pre-visualisation), with strong judgement on originality, brand consistency, rights and representation

• Full proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma

Why this role is compelling for a strong candidate:

• A ground-floor opportunity to help build and shape Pinterest's EMEA creative department from scratch, within House of Creative — a globally recognized, award-winning in-house team.

• Close partnership with Pinterest's US creative team, with exposure to global brand strategy and campaigns.

• Based in London, creating high-impact work for one of the world's most visually iconic platforms.

Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

Collaboration with colleagues in-office at least one day a week. We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration on average 1 time per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from one of the following offices London.

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-AKEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. title: Midweight Motion Designer
description:
Landor is looking for a Midweight Motion Designer to join our London studio. Could this be you?

 

We are Landor, part of WPP

World-leading brand experts,
underpinned by the most expansive strategic & creative capabilities in our category.

We make brands more valuable and less vulnerable.

We build brands differently. We work with our clients to define and solve their business problems through the lens of brand. We strategically join the dots between our design, experience, governance and measurement capabilities, and always connect our brand work to business outcomes.

Landor companies also include amp (sonic branding), bdg (workplace & architectural experts), Deep Local (creative technologists) and ManvsMachine (3D motion design).

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Motion Designer to join our multidisciplinary team in London, bringing brand identities to life through best-in-class motion design. Working across all Landor clients, you'll use your expertise in 2D and 3D motion design and video editing to create dynamic brand assets, brand films, social content and campaigns that elevate brands and engage audiences. Motion plays an increasingly central role in our branding work, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how global brands behave across digital products, campaigns, experiences and social platforms.

In this fast-paced studio environment, you'll collaborate with designers, strategists and creatives to push the boundaries of motion. Your core focus will be motion design and animation, supported by strong video editing skills that help craft compelling brand stories across multiple touchpoints. From high-energy digital activations to refined, cinematic brand expressions, you'll bring a deep understanding of movement, pacing, editing and storytelling to every project.

 

What you’ll need

You are a motion specialist with a passion for bringing brands to life through movement. With an expert grasp of animation principles, you know how to transform static design into fluid, engaging and expressive motion. Equally confident editing short videos, you understand how pacing, rhythm and sequencing can shape powerful narratives and create memorable brand experiences. You have a sharp eye for detail, timing and craft, ensuring every piece of work feels refined and impactful.

Comfortable working across multiple clients, industries and visual styles, you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two projects are the same.

You're highly proficient in Cinema4D, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro and Illustrator, with the ability to develop compelling motion narratives that extend brand identities beyond the static. Experience with generative AI workflows for motion, as well as emerging tools such as Cavalry, would be an advantage. You're a natural problem-solver, always experimenting with movement, transitions, composition and editing techniques to find the strongest creative solution. Above all, you bring energy, originality and a deep understanding of how motion and film can amplify brand storytelling.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

We build brands. We build futures. Landor, a WPP company, is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics, committed to a culture of respect where everyone belongs and can progress in their careers.

title: Creative Brand Strategist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are seeking a Creative Brand Strategist to shape brand direction, elevate storytelling, and drive high-impact marketing initiatives that reinforce Bjak’s positioning across ASEAN. This role blends strategic brand thinking with hands-on creative execution across campaigns, content, and community-building initiatives.

You will be responsible for developing compelling brand narratives, designing integrated marketing strategies, and ensuring consistent, memorable brand presence across all channels.

What You'll Do

1. Brand Strategy & Creative Direction

•
Define and evolve Bjak’s brand narrative, positioning, and messaging across markets.

•
Lead the ideation and development of creative concepts for campaigns that strengthen brand perception and audience engagement.

•
Ensure brand consistency across all communication touchpoints, content formats, and marketing activities.

2. Campaign Development & Execution

•
Plan and execute integrated brand campaigns to drive awareness, engagement, and lead generation.

•
Work closely with designers, content creators, and cross-functional teams to translate brand strategies into high-quality creative assets.

•
Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and provide strategic insights for continuous improvement.

3. Content & Community Engagement

•
Oversee content strategy for social media, newsletters, and community channels to ensure impactful storytelling.

•
Build and nurture an active online/offline community aligned with Bjak’s mission and brand values.

•
Develop initiatives that increase participation, advocacy, and brand loyalty.

•
Identify and leverage user-generated content to strengthen brand authenticity.

4. Partnerships & Insights

•
Collaborate with influencers, creators, and brand advocates to amplify Bjak’s reach.

•
Develop programs that turn loyal users into brand champions and ambassadors.

•
Conduct in-depth data analysis to uncover insights that support brand strategy and future campaigns.

What We're Looking For

•
3–5 years of experience in brand strategy, creative strategy, digital marketing, or related fields.

•
Strong understanding of branding, content development, social media, and community engagement.

•
Ability to translate business goals into creative concepts and integrated brand strategies.

•
Familiarity with content management systems, community platforms, and analytics tools.

•
Excellent communication, storytelling, and strategic thinking skills.

•
Proven ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail.

•
Highly proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

•
Portfolio review

•
Online assessment or practical task

•
Role-specific interview

•
CEO / Final Interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: User Researchers: Feedback On New Analysis Tools

title: Creative Producer
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Creative Producer to help bring Linear's creative work to life. You'll work closely with Linear's internal creative studio, the Magic team, to manage projects across brand, marketing, and product launches.

In this role, you'll help keep our creative team focused and moving forward. From managing incoming requests and coordinating projects to tracking timelines and aligning stakeholders, you'll make sure great ideas turn into great work that ship on time.

What you’ll do

 - Manage creative projects from initial brief through production and delivery, keeping timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders aligned

 - Own the intake and coordination of creative requests across teams, helping prioritize work and allocate resources effectively

 - Work closely with the Creative Director to plan projects, manage priorities, and keep the team's workload organized

 - Coordinate designers, engineers, copywriters, and external collaborators to ensure projects move forward smoothly

 - Work closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, and other teams to align on project goals, priorities, timelines, and deliverables

 - Maintain clear project documentation, timelines, and status updates, ensuring everyone has visibility into ongoing work

 - Identify potential blockers early, resolve dependencies, and continuously improve how the creative team operates

What we’re looking for

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities

 - Excellent communication skills and confidence working with creative teams and cross-functional stakeholders

 - A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership and attention to detail

 - Good creative judgment and an appreciation for high-quality design and craftsmanship

 - Experience working with designers, developers, and other creative disciplines

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

• Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.

• Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.

• Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.

• Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.

• Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.

• Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.

• Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.

• Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

Who You Are
