title: Agent Data Management Researcher (PAYE Contractor)
description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

•
Staying customer-centric,

•
Inspiring dedication,

•
Persevering,

•
Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated researcher to explore emerging technologies in AI Agent data management, Agent Memory, and AI-driven data systems. The role combines technical research and industry analysis with hands-on prototyping and project coordination. You will evaluate academic research, open-source projects, and industry solutions, identify promising opportunities, and work with the team to validate research ideas and advance practical outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

•
Track developments in AI Agents, Agent Memory, intelligent data management, and the integration of AI and databases; review relevant research papers, open-source projects, and industry products.

•
Identify potential technical innovation opportunities based on practical needs, and propose research directions and feasible validation plans.

•
Participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) and demo development, including experimental validation and performance evaluation of new technologies and solutions.

•
Support research project planning, progress tracking, technical discussions, and reporting; collaborate with team members to help move research outcomes forward.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

Required:

Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Master's degree or PhD preferred.

Programming: Good computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or C++.

Technical interest: Familiarity with, or a strong interest in, databases, data management, large language models (LLMs), or AI Agents.

Research skills: Strong learning, analytical, and summarisation skills; ability to independently read English research papers and produce clear technical reports.

Collaboration: Good communication skills, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work effectively in a team.

Desired:

•
Project experience related to databases, AI Agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Agent Memory, or multimodal data processing.

•
Experience with academic publications, open-source projects, technical surveys, or prototype development.

•
Experience in technical project coordination, cross-team communication, or research project support.

•
Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required to support regular communication with HQ stakeholders and manage relevant business documentation.

title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description:
Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

What you’ll do

• Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.

• Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.

• Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.

• Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.

• Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.

• Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.

• Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.

• Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.

• Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

What you’ll need

Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.

• Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.

• Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.

• Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.

• A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.

• Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.

• Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.

• Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers

• Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

How You’ll Be Rewarded
✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

• Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.

• Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.

• Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

• Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.

• Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.

• Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.

• Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.

• Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

• Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.

• Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.

• Provide constructive feedback and support team development.

• Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.

• Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

• Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.

• Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.

• Maintain an organised creative asset library.

• Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

• Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

• Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.

• Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.

• Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.

• Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.

• Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

• Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.

• Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.

• Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.

• Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.

• Review and approve high-priority creative assets.

• Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.

• Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.

• Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.

• Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.

• Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

• Website and landing-page conversion rate.

• Product-page conversion rate.

• Advertising creative performance.

• Customer acquisition cost.

• Return on advertising spend.

• Click-through rate and hook rate.

• Creative testing volume and testing velocity.

• Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.

• Revenue generated from new creative concepts.

• Email engagement and conversion performance.

• On-time completion of creative projects.

• Creative production efficiency.

• Brand consistency and quality across channels.

• Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

• Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.

• Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.

• Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.

• Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.

• Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.

• Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.

• Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

• Experience working with physical consumer products.

• Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.

• Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.

• Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.

• Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.

• Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.

• Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

• A senior leadership role with direct ownership of the company's ecommerce creative direction and growth.

• High level of autonomy and the opportunity to shape creative strategy, processes, and team development.

• Direct impact on ecommerce performance, conversion, and creative effectiveness across multiple channels.

• Opportunity to build and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary creative team.

• A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture where creative decisions are connected to business results.

• Competitive compensation based on experience.

• Bonuses.

• Paid Time Off.

• Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded Creative Director who wants to take ownership of a growing ecommerce creative function, combine creative leadership with performance-driven decision-making, and build a scalable creative operation with a direct impact on business growth.

title: Senior Cyber Security Researcher
description:
What we do at Detectify

We’re Detectify, and we’re not your average cybersecurity company. We’re a team obsessed with building cutting-edge tech that actually makes a difference in making the internet a safer place. We’re talking about real-life hackers who know their stuff. You'll learn from the best and join a team that combines human ingenuity with automation to streamline asset discovery and vulnerability assessments.

What you’ll get to do

As a Security Researcher, your main mission is to develop proof-of-concepts for novel ways of detecting vulnerabilities, broadening what Detectify’s engines can find. In other words, your research ends up protecting thousands of real-world attack surfaces.

Other responsibilities include:

•
Stay on top of the latest security research, disclosures and techniques, and figure out which ones we can and should turn into scalable detection.

•
Research new attack vectors and vulnerability classes that can be automated, and identify where we can source them.

•
Design and build agentic workflows that use AI to uncover new vulnerabilities and 0-days.

•
Reverse engineer binaries to find vulnerabilities and understand how they can be exploited.

•
Review detection code to make sure our tests are accurate and keep false positives to a minimum.

•
Act as a go-to security expert for colleagues across the company and help with security-related questions and tasks.

•
Talk with customers to understand their attack surfaces and security challenges, and use those insights to shape what we research and build next.

Who you are

•
You’re highly versatile and self-motivated, and you can create and drive change. You’re active in the security community and you understand how vulnerabilities work, not just that they exist. You probably also have:

•
Hands-on experience finding and exploiting live vulnerabilities, for example through bug bounty programs, CVEs, CTFs, penetration testing or published research.

•
Deep knowledge of web application security and common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 and beyond).

•
Solid programming or scripting skills (for example Python or Go) and the ability to turn an idea into a working proof-of-concept.

•
Curiosity about using LLMs and AI agents in offensive security, or experience building with them already.

•
The ability to explain technical findings clearly to engineers, customers and non-security stakeholders.

Bonus points if you:

•
Have experience with reverse engineering.

•
Have publicly disclosed vulnerabilities, written blog posts or given talks at security conferences.

What’s in it for you?

Hybrid work

This position is for the Stockholm office. We offer hybrid working, with access to our office in central Stockholm and would like to see you at the office at least 3 days per week.

So, what do you think? We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about security! Go hack yourself!

Please note that to be eligible for this position, candidates must already possess a valid work visa for Sweden, as we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

You'll work closely with Product and Engineering day to day, and partner with Design on standards, craft and our evolving Design System

What You’ll Do

•
Own design work end-to-end in the Growth stream, from early framing through to build-ready delivery and iteration after release

•
Produce clear, implementation-ready design output such as flows, states, edge cases, content and acceptance criteria, so engineering has less back-and-forth

•
Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to clarify problems early and avoid late-stage rework

•
Contribute to Design System usage and consistency through your delivery, reusing and improving patterns where needed

•
Use AI as part of your workflow to accelerate exploration and delivery, in a way that stays repeatable and legible to the team

•
Take part in our research and evidence practice. We run concept, usability and comprehension testing across the team, and you'll help plan and run studies, then turn findings and product and behavioural data into design decisions

•
Design in a regulated context, with a strong bias toward clarity, fair treatment and customer comprehension

What We’re Looking For

•
5+ years of experience designing digital products as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.

•
Strong product design craft, spanning interaction design, systems thinking and end-to-end journey ownership

•
Comfortable being hands-on with research. You're happy to get stuck into user research as part of the role, with our support, and you make design decisions from evidence rather than opinion

•
Data-driven design. You use product and behavioural data, along with experiment results, to frame problems, prioritise and prove that designs actually work

•
High ownership and autonomy, comfortable operating as a senior contractor, clarifying ambiguity and driving work forward

•
Excellent collaboration, working as a partner to Product and Engineering rather than a service desk

•
Pragmatic judgement on quality versus speed, knowing where polish matters most

•
Comfort working within a design system and contributing to it

•
Comprehension-first, fair-treatment mindset. You design for genuine customer understanding, not just usability. Experience in a regulated environment such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, gambling or utilities is a strong advantage, but what matters most is that you can clearly evidence this mindset, whether or not it comes from regulated work

•
English fluency (C1 level and above) — we are a UK-based company, and the role involves regular communication with the team

Nice to Have

•
Experience with growth experimentation and funnel optimisation

•
Strong prototyping skills for quick validation

•
Prior experience operationalising AI in team workflows, beyond personal use

•
Fintech or investing-domain experience specifically. Regulated experience is a strong advantage, and the sector itself is a bonus

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and transparency.
You’ll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root, not just treating the symptoms.

What We Offer

Impact from day one
You’ll take on meaningful work from the start, tackling real challenges that drive the stability, efficiency, and growth of our business.

Room to grow
As we scale, you’ll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities, influence how we work, and help shape our long-term direction.

Transparent and open cultureWe share decisions openly, keep communication channels clear, and encourage collaboration across every part of the business.

Supportive, high-calibre teamWork alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.

Remote first and flexible
Work in the way that best suits you. We focus on results, not rigid hours, and trust you to manage your time effectively.

Our Hiring Process

•
Introductory call with our Talent team

•
Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

•
Competency interview focused on your experience in operational risk and controls (may include a short task or case study)

•
Senior leadership interview to explore alignment with our culture, values, and strategic direction

title: Senior Design Engineer Energy - Remote
description:
Job Description

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Design Engineer Energy - Remote. This remote position is based out of our Oak Ridge, TN office.

Your role 

• Process and Facilities serves as the recognized expert on chemical process design for nuclear facilities within AtkinsRéalis US Nuclear.

• Anticipates internal and/or external business challenges and/or regulatory issues.

• Recommends Engineering process and service improvements, with a focus on their particular discipline.

• Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions to solve unique and complex problems that have a broad impact on the business.

• Works independently with guidance only in the most challenging situations.

• Leads functional teams (e.g., chemical process engineering discipline) for projects, and may lead project teams, meeting milestones and objectives.

• Regarded as an expert in their discipline, with in-depth expertise in their discipline and broad knowledge of other disciplines within Nuclear facility design, construction, operations, and maintenance.

• Work involves directing design and solving unprecedented technical problems of considerable scope and complexity, the solution of which may have a far-reaching impact on extensive technical activities of the firm.

• Receives general administrative direction; executes independent decisions and resolves important questions concerning area of expertise, being recognized as a technical authority in his/her field of expertise, on a regional or national basis, both within and outside the company.

• Provides oversight and supervision of the technical work of senior professionals.

• Interfaces with senior technical managers and all levels of management throughout the firm.

• Provides technical direction throughout the company within field of expertise.

• Establishes technical criteria on projects related to field of expertise and provides technical input/direction to project managers and team members.

• Owns development and configuration control of process documentation, including PFDs, P&IDs, line lists, tag registers, and equipment datasheets.

• Reviews designs for constructability, leads site walkdowns and verification of existing conditions, and supports construction and startup.

• Represents/defends company's technical work to client, regulatory agencies and others, serving as expert witness at hearings and legal proceedings.

• Participates in technical and professional organizations at a prominent leadership level.

• Participates in technical quality assurance reviews.

• Assists management in conducting project review audits involving specialty discipline.

• Participates in development and maintenance of firmwide professional standards, guidelines and procedures, including design procedures and technical quality assurance review guidelines for application to project production.

• Monitors utilization and compliance by technical staff relative to these standards, documents, guidelines and procedures.

• Participates in the development and implementation of in-house technical development programs and coordinates with operating managers to selectively involve appropriate engineering staff in these in-house programs as well as in outside technical development opportunities (conferences, seminars, student coursework, etc.)

• Coordinates with operational managers to identify staffing needs, deficiencies and opportunities for recruitment in technical specialty area.

• Assists in the identification, screening, recruitment and orientation of qualified candidates to fill key vacancies within specialty field.

• Leads initiatives with considerable risk and complexity; develops the related strategy for execution.

• Solves unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business; requires conceptual and innovative thinking to develop unprecedented solutions.

• Impacts the direction and resource allocation for initiatives, projects or services; works within general functional policies.

• Communicates complex ideas, anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.

• Performs other duties as required. 

About you 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering or similar discipline.

• This level may be achieved by technical professionals with 15 years of experience. Typical incumbent has 20-25 years of experience.

• Strong communication skills in a challenging, multi-tiered environment.

• Strong organizational skills

• Ability to foster and achieve goal alignment among participants with differing interests

• Expert knowledge of chemical process design for nuclear facilities, including flowsheet development, mass and energy balances, equipment sizing, process hazard analysis, and P&ID development.

• Expert knowledge of key design codes and standards for nuclear facilities required. Participation in appropriate national consensus standard/code committees preferred.

• Codes and standards include, but are not limited to:

• ASME B31.3 process piping and ISA-5.1 instrumentation symbols and identification

• IAEA safety standards and applicable national nuclear regulations (e.g., NRC regulations in 10 CFR)

• Expert knowledge in the use of process simulation and P&ID software.

• Senior design professional on Commercial and Department of Energy nuclear fuel cycle facilities preferred.

• Design experience with process systems handling toxic, corrosive, or radioactive materials preferred.

• Experience supporting construction, startup, or commissioning of process facilities preferred.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license required, with ability to be licensed in multiple jurisdictions required.

Rewards & benefits

title: Industrial Designer
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

Industrial design at Menlo is not cosmetic. Asimov is a physical product that will be assembled, operated, serviced, and iterated on, and how it looks, feels, and reads to the people around it is as consequential as how it performs. As our Industrial Designer, you will own the form language and physical identity of Asimov, from enclosures and surface treatments to ergonomics, CMF (color, material, finish), and packaging. You will translate that vision into parts that manufacture, assemble, and survive the real world, working shoulder to shoulder with mechanical and electrical engineers so every design decision holds up in production. This is design that ships to real hardware, not renders.

What You'll Do

•
Own industrial design for Asimov and the Menlo hardware family: form, proportion, ergonomics, and CMF, from concept and form language to production-ready enclosures, covers, and structural aesthetics

•
Turn mechanical and electrical constraints into clean, intentional design that does not hide the engineering

•
Prototype fast in foam, print, and machined parts, then iterate on real robots to test design intent

•
Own the CMF specification process: material selection, surface finish standards, color systems, and supplier engagement, and make sure those choices hold up in the field

•
Own design for manufacturing and assembly alongside mechanical engineering: DFM reviews, tolerance stack-ups, fastening, serviceability, part count, and assembly sequencing, catching issues before tooling

•
Design the human-facing details: grips, handles, access panels, indicators, and anything a person touches or reads

•
Shape the packaging and unboxing experience and user-facing documentation for Asimov kits and development hardware

•
Maintain design consistency across the Menlo hardware product family as the portfolio expands

What We Look For

•
A strong portfolio of shipped physical products, ideally complex electromechanical hardware, showing a consistent design sensibility under real technical constraints

•
4 or more years shipping physical products: consumer electronics, robotics, medical devices, or similarly complex hardware

•
Deep industrial design fundamentals: form, proportion, ergonomics, and CMF

•
Strong proficiency in 3D modeling and surfacing (Alias, Rhino, SolidWorks, or equivalent) and rendering (KeyShot or similar), plus real DFM and DFA experience

•
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes: injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and surface finishing

•
Experience working directly with mechanical engineers and contract manufacturers in a fast, iterative environment

•
Comfort moving from sketch to prototype to production without needing a large team around you

•
Experience designing for humanoid or legged robots, cobots, or other electromechanical systems

•
A bias for building, testing on hardware, and iterating quickly, with the judgment to know when to obsess over a detail and when to ship

Nice to Have

•
Experience taking a product from zero to first production run

•
Hands-on shop skills: 3D printing, machining, moldmaking, and finishing

•
Exposure to DFM/DFA review in a high-mix, low-volume manufacturing context

•
Familiarity with simulation-driven or CAD-driven design workflows

•
A feel for how design and brand reinforce each other

•
Interest in open-source hardware communities

Why Join Menlo

You will define what a humanoid robot looks like at the moment the category is being written. That is a rare brief at this stage of a company, and it comes with the autonomy to match. Your work ships to real machines, in the real world, fast, alongside a small team that moves fast and takes the craft seriously. If you want your design to live in hardware people actually use rather than a slide, this is the place.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

title: Director, Creative Strategy
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative and/or Organic Social service—our Al-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

•
Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

•
Sales: Deliver game-changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

•
Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

•
Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50+ new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance, combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

Responsibilities:

•
Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

•
Testing & Learning: Design the testing roadmap (what gets tested, in what order, against what hypothesis, and what a real win looks like before spend goes live.)

•
Copywriting: Own ad copy for US-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to funnel stage and threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy.

•
Organic Social: You may also lead organic content strategies for Instagram and TikTok by owning content pillars, creative direction, briefing, and performance measurement.

•
Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

•
Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

•
Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

•
Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

•
Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

•
Team Building: Assist with establishing processes, systems, and testing frameworks that raise the floor on quality and speed. Continuously refine our Performance Creative service so it scales without losing rigor as volume grows.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

•
2+ years in a Director-level or equivalent leadership role, with experience leading creative strategy, managing teams, and driving performance marketing results.

•
4+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

•
A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

•
You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

•
You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

•
You already use tools like Claude, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

•
You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

•
You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

•
Comfortable in Figma including Auto Layout, components, and systems. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

•
No Meta performance creative ad experience.

•
No portfolio link or no performance context.

•
Strategy-only with no full-funnel ownership. Haven’t been accountable for testing, iteration, or driving deliverables and results.

•
Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

•
Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

•
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

•
Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

•
Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

•
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

•
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

•
Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $160,000-$175,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Director, Creative Strategy
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

This is a dedicated, senior role on a single account, helping a key client bring a brand new product to market, with Darkroom owning all media channels. You are the creative lead on that engagement, accountable for the brand's whole creative story, from positioning and messaging down to the hook on a 15-second ad.

That makes this different from a typical agency creative role. You are not spreading yourself across a portfolio. You are going deep on one enterprise client, setting creative positioning with their leadership, then sitting with designers and editors to tighten the frame across paid, social, and retention.

What you'll do

Responsibilities:

•
Brand & Creative Positioning: Own creative positioning for the brand and its new product launch. Turn brand strategy, audience insight, and competitive context into a clear point of view on what a brand says and how it looks and sounds.

•
Copy & Messaging: Lead copy and messaging end to end, from messaging frameworks, taglines, and campaign lines to ad copy, email, and SMS. Flex tone by channel and funnel stage, and be the person who delivers when a client asks you to "punch up the copy."

•
Full-Funnel Creative Strategy: Lead creative strategy across paid (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon), organic social (Instagram, TikTok), and retention (email, SMS, lifecycle), so every channel ladders up to one brand story.

•
Campaigns: Concept and lead the launch campaign and the large, integrated campaigns that follow, from the big idea through briefs, production, launch, and measuring what they actually did.

•
Testing & Learning: Own the testing roadmap: what gets tested, in what order, against what hypothesis, and what a real win looks like before spend goes live. Balance brand-building work with performance.

•
Hands-On Creative Direction: Work directly with Designers and Editors, briefing statics, motion, short-form video, UGC, and storyboards. Give sharp, tactical feedback on design, pacing, and edit structure, and jump into Figma or an edit yourself when it's faster. This isn't the role for strategy-only folks.

•
Data Analysis: Read performance data across paid, social, and retention, from ad metrics to open rate, click rate, and repeat purchase, and turn it into the next concept.

•
Executive Presentation & Client Leadership: Present creative strategy and campaigns to the client's leadership with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale. Own the creative relationship on the account and navigate pushback with ease.

•
Cross-Team Partnership: Work daily with Paid Media, Analytics, and the client's own program leads so creative and media run as one program.

•
Team Leadership: Lead the creative team on the account, raise the bar on craft, and build the processes, frameworks, and AI-enabled workflows that keep quality high as volume grows.

You should apply if this sounds like you

•
6+ years in creative strategy, brand marketing, or creative leadership, including 3+ years at Director level or above.

•
Brand marketing experience. You've shaped positioning, messaging, and brand voice for consumer brands, in-house or agency side.

•
Creative experience across paid, social, and retention. You've led work on Meta and TikTok ads, organic social, and email/SMS, and you understand how each channel works and where they connect.

•
You've directed large-scale, integrated campaigns, including OOH, from the big idea through launch and results.

•
You're a strong writer and lead copy and messaging yourself.

•
A portfolio of proven brand-scale and go-to-market case studies, showing brand, performance, and campaign work across statics, short-form video, motion, OOH, and lifecycle, with context on the results it drove.

•
You've owned production end to end, from brief and pre-production through shoot, post, and delivery, on time and on budget.

•
You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

•
You're comfortable working directly with designers and editors. You can storyboard, give frame-by-frame feedback, and jump into Figma or Adobe Creative Suite to polish assets.

•
You already use tools like Claude, Midjourney, Perplexity, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped work with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

Soft skills

•
Team management: You've managed and grown creative teams. You lead with clarity, direct feedback, and a high bar, and people want to work for you.

•
Stakeholder management: You have enterprise client experience and keep everyone, from the client's C-suite to their program leads, aligned without slowing the work down.

•
Communication: You're an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to senior clients.

•
Ownership: You take a program from brief to delivery and are accountable for the outcome, not just the idea.

•
High EQ, low ego: You give and take direct feedback, stay calm under pressure, and know where every person on your team truly sits.

Hard disqualifiers

•
No brand marketing or positioning experience. Performance-only with no brand point of view is not a fit.

•
No paid social creative experience on Meta or TikTok.

•
Can't lead copy and messaging.

•
No portfolio link or no results context.

•
Strategy-only, with no hands-on work alongside designers and editors.

•
Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

•
Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

•
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

•
Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

•
Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

•
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

•
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

•
Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $160,000 to $220,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

title: Human Centered Design Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

• Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.

• Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

• Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.

• Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

• Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.

• Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

• Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.

• Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

• Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.

• Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

• Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.

• Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.

• Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.

• Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.

• Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.

• A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

• Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.

• Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.

• Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.

• Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.

• Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.

• Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.

• Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

• Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.

• Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.

• Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.

• Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.

• Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

• Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor

• Location: Remote

• Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Electronics Engineer in IC Design Department | Telematics
description:
We, Teltonika Telematics, have been creating Internet of Things (IoT) solutions for more than 27 years. Our greatest passion is turning complex IoT technologies into simple and accessible solutions. Our success is built on a professional team of more than 500 ambitious employees. That is why we place strong emphasis on employee well-being, and our efforts to help employees become professionals in their field are our highest priority.

Teltonika’s telematics business unit develops and produces easy-to-use GPS tracking devices for effective fleet management across logistics, agriculture, car sharing, construction, and more. We use the latest technologies to set new standards for the telematics industry.

We are establishing a new department dedicated to Power Electronics Integrated Circuit design. This experienced and highly motivated group of engineers will lead the launch of IC design at Teltonika Telematics, defining specifications, developing methodologies, and creating the company’s first integrated circuit designs.

In this role, you will:

A typical workday will consist of the following main activities:

• Schematic and PCB design for prototypes and evaluation platforms.

• Development and assessment of new technical solutions.

• Preparation of technical specifications and requirements.

• Development of measurement and evaluation methodologies.

• Electrical measurements, calculations, root-cause analysis, and troubleshooting.

• Prototype testing and creation of new test and validation scenarios.

• Close collaboration with IC designers, manufacturing, and other engineering teams.

• Working with professional measurement equipment.

• Optionally – gradual involvement in IC design activities and competence building in integrated circuit design.

What we expect of you:

• Higher or advanced education in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in electronics or power electronics engineering.

• Strong experience working with analog and power electronics circuits.

• Ability to design and review schematics and PCBs using Altium Designer (or equivalent tools).

• Experience designing PCBs for analog or power electronics systems.

• Solid understanding of power converter operation (buck, boost, LDOs, drivers, etc.).

• Practical experience with debugging functional issues, stability problems, and EMI/EMC-related behavior.

• Ability to perform circuit simulations (LTspice, PSpice, or similar) and correlate them with measurement results.

• Hands-on laboratory experience, including SMD soldering, rework, and prototype bring-up.

• Confidence working with professional measurement equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power analyzers, etc.).

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

• Strong theoretical and practical background in power electronics and power conversion topologies.

• Knowledge of EMI/EMC standards, measurement techniques, and mitigation methodologies.

• Experience with PCB signal-integrity, power-integrity, or electromagnetic simulation tools.

• Experience developing measurement automation software, including instrument control (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads) and data acquisition.

• Previous exposure to or hands-on experience in integrated circuit design (analog, mixed-signal, or PMIC-related).

• Understanding of the full product lifecycle, from concept and prototyping to validation and production.

• Proactive mindset: ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and generate technical ideas.

• Strong motivation to learn, grow, and build competence in IC design within a developing team.

What we offer:

• Opportunity to work on strategic, long-term engineering projects, creating the foundation for integrated circuit design.

• High degree of engineering autonomy and decision-making freedom in a newly forming team.

• Direct involvement in defining specifications, methodologies, and technical direction for future IC products.

• Continuous professional development in a team of experienced engineers, with clear opportunities to specialize and grow toward IC design.

• Collaboration across hardware, manufacturing, and system-level teams in a mature engineering organization.

• Work based on Agile principles, adapted to hardware and IC development workflows.

• Care about your emotional and physical well-being by offering flexible work schedules, hybrid work opportunities and health insurance.

• Company-paid sports activities (basketball, football, volleyball, yoga) and other sports events.

• Celebrating achievements and having fun together in team building, summer festivals, and other important occasions.

• Opportunity for solid bonuses when participating in the recommendation program.

• We delight with birthday and Christmas gifts and rewards on work anniversaries.

• Office snacks.

Salary:

We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise. The salary for this position ranges from 15 Eur/h up to 35 Eur/h (~2502 Eur—5839 Eur) pre-tax, depending on your experience and expertise, with the option to get *bonuses.

*In an employment agreement, we specify and define a fixed (tariff) hourly salary rate before taxes.

If you have questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment colleague Ingrida Poceviciute, email ingrida.poceviciute@teltonika.lt.

title: Interaction Design Lead
description:
Interaction Design Lead

In a Nutshell

IDEO London is seeking an Interaction Design Lead with a passion for creating human-centred experiences and helping teams do their best work. You’ll lead and co-lead multidisciplinary teams, stay close to the craft, and guide clients from complex questions to tangible products and services. Your work will span digital and physical experiences, including new ways for people to interact with AI.

About IDEO London

We're a global design consultancy where curiosity, empathy, and solving complex challenges drive us. For over 40 years, we've partnered with clients to innovate in healthcare, mobility, education, retail, and beyond. Here, every challenge is a chance to grow, connect, and create impact.

Why is this role important for IDEO's work?

Interaction Design is at the heart of creating meaningful human-centred experiences that meet people’s needs and help businesses move forward. As an Interaction Design Lead, you’ll bring together craft, creative direction and project leadership to help teams turn strategy into experiences people can use. As AI becomes part of everyday products and services, you’ll help us explore how people understand, trust and stay in control of systems that can act on their behalf.

Once Here You Will

• Lead and co-lead multidisciplinary project teams from research and framing through design, prototyping and delivery, balancing people’s needs, client goals and technical possibilities

• Set a clear design direction and stay hands-on with journeys, flows, interfaces and interaction details, connecting individual touchpoints to a coherent product or service experience

• Build and guide prototypes at the right fidelity to answer the team’s questions, using Figma, code and AI-assisted tools to make ideas tangible early and test them with people

• Partner with researchers and technologists to plan experiments, test usability and accessibility, and use qualitative feedback and product data to refine designs and assess their impact

• Explore conversational and agentic UX: design how people express intent, approve actions, understand what an AI system is doing, redirect it and recover when things go wrong

• Own project plans, resource needs and delivery milestones; brief and delegate work clearly, spot obstacles early, and help the team navigate ambiguity while maintaining creative quality

• Be a main client point of contact, facilitate working sessions and present compelling design narratives; align stakeholders on decisions, trade-offs and next steps

• Help scope client challenges and shape proposals and follow-on opportunities with senior colleagues, drawing on project learnings and collaboration across Europe and beyond; travel as projects require

• Mentor designers, give actionable craft feedback and build an inclusive team culture; share methods and learnings across our London community, including thoughtful use of AI that protects client and participant information

We're looking for someone with

• 6–8 years of professional experience in interaction design, digital product design, UX/UI or a related discipline, including 1–2+ years leading projects or multidisciplinary teams

• Strong interaction design craft and a portfolio showing how you turn complex requirements into clear experiences; advanced expertise in one or more areas of digital, visual, service or systems design, with fluency across others

• A strong grounding in human-centred design, research and usability testing, with the ability to guide a team from evidence to design decisions and measurable outcomes

• The ability to scope, brief and delegate design work, manage timelines and resources, and empower a small to medium team to take ownership of different parts of a project

• A keen eye for visual hierarchy, responsive interfaces, motion and micro-interactions, and the ability to critique work and offer clear, actionable feedback

• Strong prototyping skills in Figma or comparable tools, and confidence experimenting with AI-assisted ideation and prototyping while checking outputs and making your own design judgements

• A commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, and thoughtful judgement about privacy, bias and people’s agency when designing with AI

• The ability to connect interaction details to wider service and system needs, and work with engineers to understand technical constraints and bring designs to life

• Excellent storytelling, presentation and facilitation skills; confidence building trusted client relationships, aligning stakeholders and helping others succeed with empathy and openness

• An Interaction Design qualification or equivalent work experience, alongside curiosity, self-awareness and a willingness to give and seek feedback

It's a bonus if you

• Have worked closely with product managers and engineers to take digital products or services from concept to launch and learn from their use

• Have used product analytics and experimentation to evaluate design decisions and improve outcomes

• Have designed conversational or agentic experiences, including human approval, transparent system behaviour, error recovery and hand-offs between people and AI

• Have built functional prototypes with code or AI coding tools, and can explain where these tools improved your process and where your judgement changed the outcome

• Have helped shape proposals, scope engagements or develop repeat client work

• Have contributed to design systems or reusable interaction patterns, or explored emerging technologies through creative experimentation

What does IDEO offer you?

Innovation and creativity: Dive into a variety of projects from creating breakthrough digital products and experiences, to designing new customer interactions, to building innovation capabilities – working alongside talented individuals across disciplines.

Learning and growth: Whether it’s strengthening your project leadership, deepening your interaction design craft or exploring new technologies, we’re here to support your journey.

Community and well-being: Collaboration and community are central to what we do. We foster moments for creativity, connection, and reflection, respecting the need for work-life balance.

Projects with purpose: We partner with clients to use design as a means of realising their purpose and making a positive impact. We work 'upstream,' from defining the problem, designing possible solutions, and exploring what, why and how they might be brought to life.

Compensation

£70,000–£80,000 GBP, depending on experience

Location

This position is based out of our London studio.

Some Previous Projects To Check Out

To get a flavour of the work we do in London, take a look at these case studies:

Climate action for SMBs – Designing a strategy and experience to help Sage’s SMB customers transition to net zero.

Redefining retail with FEMSA – Designing Spin Premia, a digital loyalty experience connecting everyday shopping at OXXO with rewards and services.

Sustainable packaging system – Helping H&M increase their sustainability and growth, by designing and scaling a universal packaging system for all of their brands.

Commitment to Diversity

At IDEO, we are committed to the work of advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion within our organisation and in the world. Our purpose of having disproportionate, world-changing impact through design is directly connected to our ability to bring many different perspectives to the table. This applies to our candidates, the people we hire, the clients and customers we serve, and the communities we learn from in our research.

As a human-centred organisation, we are committed to working with and designing for people of every race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, socio-economic status, physical ability or attribute, religion, national origin, or political belief. We recognize that this commitment requires ongoing work and sustained attention, as well as adaptation to new insights and best practices

Application Requirements And Instructions

If you identify with our values, are excited about great design, and would like to contribute to our community, we would love to see your CV, a cover letter and examples of your work.

• CV: please highlight experiences related to the ‘We’re looking for someone with’ and ‘It’s a bonus if you’ sections above

• Cover letter: please share why you are interested in this role and how it aligns with how you are looking to grow in your career.

• Work examples (confidentiality permitting): please include two projects that show your interaction design craft and project leadership. We’d love to see how you think, make and help a team move forward. In your work examples, focus on:

• The challenge you were trying to solve

• The context, users and client goals you were designing for

• Your specific design contribution and how you led or supported the team

• The research, design and prototyping methods you used, including any AI tools and how you evaluated their outputs

• Key design decisions, iterations and trade-offs, illustrated with flows, interfaces or prototypes

• The impact on people, the client and the team, and what you learnt from the outcome

description:
