About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. title: Thesis: Design and evaluation of a voice AI agent for 24/7 structured support intake
description:
High Level Description
Customer Success and Support teams are expected to be reachable around the clock, but staffing phone lines 24/7 is expensive and often unrealistic. Outside business hours, customers are typically met by voicemail or a web form, which leads to incomplete information, delayed responses and missed requests.

Recent advances in speech-to-text, text-to-speech and large language models make it possible to build voice agents that can answer inbound calls, hold a structured conversation, collect the information needed to handle an issue, and hand it over to the support team in a consistent format. This thesis aims to design, implement and evaluate a voice AI agent for structured support intake, and to investigate how reliable and consistent this approach is compared to today’s alternatives.

Project Description
In this thesis, design and implement a voice AI agent that receives inbound customer phone calls in Swedish or English, guides the caller through a structured intake dialogue, handles follow-up questions within a controlled scope, generates a structured summary of the call, and delivers it into the existing support workflow (initially a shared mailbox).

The agent itself is a means, not the end. Building the prototype is required, but the contribution is the evaluation: how complete and consistent is the collected data, how faithful are the summaries, and how well current speech pipelines perform for Swedish and English support conversations. Compare design alternatives such as a scripted intake flow versus an LLM-driven flow with structured output. Existing telephony, STT, LLM and TTS platforms/APIs should be used; building components from scratch is not expected. The prototype will be evaluated with simulated calls. Scope is adapted to 15 credits (bachelor) or 30 credits (master).

Who are we looking for?

•
Bachelor/Master of Science in Computer Science/Engineering

•
Graduation in June 2027

•
Fluency in Swedish, both written and spoken

•
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Purpose
Bachelor students typically focus on one question; master students take a broader comparative evaluation.

In this thesis, investigate these questions:

•
How do different dialogue control strategies (scripted flow vs. LLM-driven with structured output) affect completeness and consistency of collected intake data?

•
How accurate and faithful are automatically generated call summaries compared to the transcript

•
What transcription accuracy and latency do available STT/TTS/LLM pipelines achieve for Swedish and English support calls, using the same intake flow in both languages?

•
What architecture and integration points are needed to fit such an agent into an existing support workflow?

An Exciting Journey with Knightec Group
Semcon and Knightec have joined forces as Knightec Group. Together, we are Northern Europe’s leading strategic partner in product and digital service development. With a unique combination of cross-functional expertise and a holistic business understanding, we help our clients realize their strategies – from idea to complete solution.

Practical Information
This is a thesis position, located at our office in Sundsvall. Start date January or March 2027.

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-11-30. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact johanna.edstrom@knightec.se. Note that due to GDPR, we only accept applications through our careers page.

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

We are looking for a computer architecture and algorithm researcher with expertise in CPU and NPU architectures and a focus on the design of routing protocols for networks-on-chip. The ideal candidate will be an expert on algorithm design and analysis for computer architecture, and be responsible for developing innovative lock-free, flow-balanced, fault-tolerant, and high-speed routing protocols for networks-on-chip. This role will also support the local research team in communicating effectively with the headquarter, so as to ensure seamless collaboration. Strong mathematical problem-solving and analytical skills, proficiency in relevant programming languages and micro-architectures, and passion for cutting-edge innovation are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

The candidate will be a key member of computation theory team at the forefront of networks-on-chip development. The responsibility is to design and implement routing protocols and relevant simulators and tools for architecture exploration and performance analysis. The ideal candidate should have a strong theoretical computer science or mathematics background, and research experience on computer architecture.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Required:

* Profound understanding of a broad range of relevant fields: algorithms, networks, computer architectures, compilers, programming languages, mathematical logic, linear algebra, combinatorics, probability and statistics, etc.
* Extensive industry experience in algorithm design and computer architecture.
* Quick learner, capable of familiarizing oneself with new areas through academic research, conferences, and discussions with experts.
* Excellent communication skills and experience engaging with reputable companies and individuals; able to present ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
* MSc or PhD degree in Theoretical Computer Science, Mathematics, or Electronic Engineering.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).

title: UI Designer
description:
Hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

In this role, you’ll work with a talented team of digital designers in our growing offices in Zagreb or Split, shaping top-notch experiences for international clients.

As a UI Designer at Dept, you’ll shape industry leading digital experiences into their final form. You have a soft spot for branding. You love to create digital products that look and feel just right. And you enjoy working in a dynamic environment with what we think are the best people the industry has to offer.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Translating strategy and UX into pixel-perfect interface designs;

• Work back-to-back with ux designers on the final product and delivery;

• Substantiating your design choices with annotations and animations;

• Presenting your work to clients and stakeholders and handle input and feedback;

• Taking responsibility for the highest quality of final delivery and proper implementation.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3+ years of experience in a same or similar role and an impressive portfolio showcasing sophisticated experience design and a deep understanding of digital platforms, ideally gained within a fast-paced agency environment.

• Experience with designing websites, apps and digital products.

• A strong portfolio (website or PDF) demonstrating your experience and passion for digital design.

• You enjoy working in cross-functional teams, speaking the "languages" of UX Designers, Copywriters, and Developers to bring together ideas to life.

• You are fluent in English and are able to effectively communicate complex design concepts to both executive-level clients and engineers.

• Mastery of Figma is a must; experience with motion design and prototyping tools like Framer or Jitter is a massive plus.

• You actively explore and implement AI-powered design tools and workflows, using them to accelerate ideation and prototyping, and raise the quality of design outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on craft and human-centred design.

WE OFFER

• Transparent career development and pay;

• A flexible, hybrid working policy;

• A rewarding, supportive and healthy company culture.

• Supplemental and additional health insurance;

• Pension scheme: third pillar pension fund;

• Referral bonus program;

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, and a multisport programme;

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Lead Product Designer - Rentals
description:
This posting will be open until October 31, 2026. Applications received after this date may not be considered.

Redfin and Rocket are rebuilding the rental experience from the ground up. Rentals is one of the largest, most fragmented corners of real estate — millions of renters every month navigating a search-to-lease journey that is slow, opaque, and disconnected from everything that comes next. We have the audience, the data, and the distribution to fix it. What we don't have yet is the product.

As Lead Product Designer for Rentals, you’ll be the founding design voice on a business we’re rebuilding from zero to one, serving renters (B2C) and the property managers and landlords who list to them (B2B). We’re building the B2B side from the ground up, so you’ll have real say in what it becomes. You’ll partner directly with the Director of Product, Rentals, and a small, senior engineering team to define what we build, prove it fast, and ship it to a real audience at real scale. This is a true greenfield mandate with the backing of a company that already reaches 50M+ monthly visitors.

We're looking for someone who works fast and modern. The designers doing the best work right now are using AI to compress the distance between an idea and something real — generating and pressure-testing concepts in hours, building working prototypes instead of static flows, and spending the time they save on judgment and craft. We want someone who already works this way and will raise the ceiling for how the rest of the team does, too.

About the role

• Own end-to-end design for the Rentals experience for both renters and property managers — from the first search to a signed lease.

• Set the product vision for a business that doesn't exist yet: define the bets worth making, make them concrete enough to argue about, and sequence the path from first shippable thing to category-defining product.

• Move from idea to evidence fast. Use AI and prototyping tools to put real, testable artifacts in front of users and stakeholders in days rather than weeks, and let what you learn reshape the plan.

• Partner with the Director of Product, Rentals as a true peer — co-owning strategy, scope, and tradeoffs rather than receiving requirements.

• Design the B2B experience from scratch, including the tools property managers use to list, manage, and connect with renters.

• Ground decisions in both numbers and people. Run lightweight research, read the funnel, and know which signal to trust when they disagree.

• Build on our design system where it serves renters, and make the case for departing from it where it doesn't.

About you

•
8+ years as a product designer, with a portfolio of shipped products you can speak to in depth — what you decided, what you got wrong, and what the work actually did for users and the business.

• You've done zero-to-one work before and know how it differs from optimizing something mature. You're comfortable making decisions on incomplete information and changing your mind when the data arrives.

•
AI-native in practice, not in theory. You use AI tools daily in your design process and can show us how. You have a point of view on where they help, where they don't, and how designers should be working two years from now.

• A systems thinker who can hold a multi-sided marketplace in your head — renters, property managers, listings, and the rest of the Redfin and Rocket ecosystem.

•
Exceptional craft. You care about the details that make a product feel trustworthy, and you can defend why they matter to people who'd rather ship without them.

• A compelling communicator who can make a vision legible to engineers, executives, and skeptics — and move a room with it.

•
Scrappy and self-directed. You'd rather build the thing than write the deck about the thing.

•
Genuinely interested in renters. The people using this product are often at their most stressed and least served. That should feel like an opportunity to you.

•
Experience with marketplaces or B2B products is a plus. You can hold a multi-sided system in your head: renters, property managers, listings, and the rest of the Redfin and Rocket ecosystem.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About us

Redfin is a technology-driven real estate company with the country's most-visited real estate brokerage website. As part of Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), Redfin is creating an integrated homeownership platform from search to close to make the dream of homeownership more affordable and accessible for everyone. Redfin’s clients can see homes first with on-demand tours, easily apply for a home loan with Rocket Mortgage, and save thousands in fees while working with a top local agent.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll shape the future of Imprint's member experiences, leading complex product initiatives from discovery through execution. You'll combine exceptional design craft with strategic thinking and strong product judgment to identify opportunities, simplify complex problems, and deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll influence product direction, champion exceptional user experiences, and raise the bar for design craft, collaboration, and decision-making across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Shape Product Strategy & Direction

•
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify high-impact opportunities grounded in customer needs, business goals, and product insights.

•
Proactively define problems, challenge assumptions, and influence product priorities and direction.

•
Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from early discovery through launch and iteration.

•
Balance near-term product improvements with longer-term opportunities to meaningfully improve the customer experience.

•
Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problems, helping teams make thoughtful decisions and move forward.

Lead End-to-End Product Design

•
Own the design process from discovery and concept exploration through detailed interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

•
Translate complex financial products and workflows into simple, intuitive, and engaging experiences.

•
Explore multiple approaches, establish clear design principles, and articulate the rationale behind decisions.

•
Create thoughtful, high-quality experiences that balance usability, accessibility, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

•
Partner with Engineering throughout implementation to ensure the quality and integrity of the shipped experience.

•
Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate solutions and continuously improve the product.

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Build strong, trusted partnerships with Product Managers and Engineers, operating as an equal partner in shaping product outcomes.

•
Facilitate collaborative problem-solving, bringing teams together around shared goals and thoughtful solutions.

•
Navigate competing priorities and constraints, making pragmatic tradeoffs without losing sight of the customer experience.

•
Communicate design decisions clearly and persuasively, building alignment across stakeholders and leadership.

•
Take shared ownership of product outcomes, not just design deliverables.

Elevate Design Quality & Team Impact

•
Set a high bar for UX craft, interaction design, and the overall quality of our product experiences.

•
Contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, and collaborative problem-solving.

•
Mentor and support other designers and teammates, helping strengthen their craft, judgment, and strategic thinking.

•
Identify opportunities and propose solutions to improve design practices, workflows, and collaboration across the organization.

•
Contribute to the evolution and adoption of our design system, balancing consistency with opportunities for innovation.

Explore the Future of Product Design

•
Embrace emerging AI tools and workflows to accelerate discovery, exploration, prototyping, and execution.

•
Experiment with new ways of working that increase design velocity without compromising quality.

•
Help shape how Design collaborates with Product and Engineering as AI transforms the product development process.

•
Bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge traditional approaches to designing and building software.

What We're Looking For

Required

•
7+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

•
Exceptional UX and interaction design skills, demonstrated through strong craft, thoughtful problem-solving, and measurable outcomes.

•
Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs with business goals and balancing near-term improvements with long-term vision.

•
Proven experience independently identifying opportunities, framing problems, exploring compelling solutions, and influencing product direction.

•
Strong partnership with Product and Engineering to navigate ambiguity, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions based on impact and effort.

•
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, articulating design rationale, building alignment, and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

•
A pragmatic, iterative approach to design, balancing speed and quality, incorporating feedback, and thoughtfully phasing solutions to deliver value over time.

Nice to Have

•
Experience designing complex financial products, consumer fintech experiences, or regulated workflows.

•
Experience working in fast-moving, high-growth startup environments.

•
Experience evolving and scaling design systems, identifying opportunities to improve patterns, strengthen consistency, and contribute to a more cohesive product experience.

•
Familiarity with experimentation, product analytics, and research-driven design.

•
Experience using AI-assisted design, prototyping, or development tools.

•
Familiarity with frontend technologies and modern design-to-development workflows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months:

•
You've led meaningful product initiatives from problem definition through launch, delivering measurable customer and business impact.

•
You've built trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and other stakeholders, helping shape priorities and improve product decisions.

•
You've introduced thoughtful, innovative and intuitive solutions to complex customer problems while maintaining a high bar for usability and craft.

•
You've helped the team move faster and make better decisions through clear design rationale, effective collaboration, and pragmatic execution.

•
You've elevated the quality of design across the team through mentorship, critique, and shared practices, and contribution to our design system.

•
You've helped evolve how we design and build products, embracing new tools and approaches that increase our effectiveness.

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Figma, Storybook, design tokens. Frontend component libraries (React/TypeScript). AI-assisted design and development tooling.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

•
Competitive compensation and equity packages

•
Leading configured work computers of your choice

•
Flexible paid time off

•
Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

•
Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

•
20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

•
Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

title: Director of Brand & Creative Marketing
description:
Director of Brand & Creative Marketing

Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to the Co-CEOs | Remote (U.S.) | Director: $150k-210k

About the Role

Seeking is looking for a highly entrepreneurial, hands-on Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing to lead the brand side of our marketing organization.

This is not a traditional management role and it is not a position for someone who wants to sit above the work.

We are looking for an operator.

This person will own Seeking's brand marketing strategy and lead an approximately 13-person organization spanning PR, creative, copy, social, influencer marketing, and broader brand initiatives and activations. They will be responsible for turning company goals into marketing strategy, turning strategy into executable plans, ensuring the right people are accountable for the right work, and ultimately determining whether that work is moving the business.

The role works closely with Seeking's Co-CEOs and alongside our Director of Growth and Lifecycle Marketing. Our Digital Marketing team owns areas such as paid acquisition, lifecycle/CRM, conversion optimization, and digital growth. This role owns the brand side of marketing while partnering closely with Growth to ensure both functions operate as one marketing organization and share accountability for company performance.

Seeking moves quickly. Our team is lean, scrappy, ambitious, and highly adaptable. The right person is comfortable making decisions, changing direction when the data requires it, getting into the details, and personally helping solve problems when necessary.

We do not need another layer of management. We need someone capable of building and leading a high-performing marketing organization.

What You Will Own

Marketing strategy, performance, and budget

• Own Seeking's brand marketing strategy, positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and overall brand direction.

• Translate company objectives into quarterly and annual marketing priorities, initiatives, OKRs, budgets, and measurable business outcomes.

• Develop the marketing strategy in close partnership with the Co-CEOs, progressively assuming greater ownership as alignment and trust are established.

• Understand Seeking's distinct audiences and develop strategies capable of effectively reaching both sides of the marketplace.

• Identify untapped audiences, market opportunities, positioning gaps, competitive opportunities, and new ways to grow the business.

• Own consumer research, competitive intelligence, campaign learnings, and brand insights.

• Determine what Seeking should do more of, less of, stop doing, or approach differently based on performance and business priorities.

Integrated Campaign Leadership

• Originate and lead major brand campaigns from initial insight through strategy, concept, execution, launch, measurement, and post-campaign analysis.

• Develop bold, culturally relevant ideas capable of generating conversation, press, signups, and revenue.

• Define the objective, audience, strategic insight, messaging, channels, success metrics, budget, responsibilities, and execution plan for major initiatives.

• Work closely with Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Digital Marketing, Product, Legal, and external partners to bring campaigns to market.

• Personally contribute ideas rather than relying exclusively on the team for campaign concepts.

• Evaluate concepts, scripts, copy, messaging, creative direction, activations, partnerships, and channel plans with strong creative and commercial judgment.

• Lead campaign production, including talent, agencies, production partners, shoots, post-production, rollout, media requirements, legal considerations, and timelines.

Performance & Business Accountability

• Own the performance of the brand marketing organization and ensure marketing activity ultimately contributes to business growth.

• Monitor company and marketing performance closely, including joins, revenue, CAC, ROAS, conversion, brand search, campaign performance, social growth, influencer performance, earned media, and other relevant KPIs.

• Diagnose why initiatives are or are not working and make changes quickly.

• Reallocate budget, resources, priorities, or strategy when performance does not justify the current approach.

• Maximize ROI across productions and activations by identifying opportunities to create additional revenue-driving content within existing budgets, helping recover costs and improve the overall return on each investment.

• Establish meaningful measurement frameworks for brand initiatives that connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes, including brand health.

• Partner closely with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing to understand acquisition and funnel performance and ensure brand and performance marketing strengthen one another.

• Lead campaign and quarterly retrospectives and turn learnings into concrete changes.

PR & Cultural Relevance

• Set the overarching PR narrative and determine what Seeking should be known for culturally.

• Lead and challenge the PR organization on strategy, angles, pitches, media opportunities, reactive opportunities, partnerships, spokesperson positioning, and execution.

• Help develop provocative, differentiated stories that can break through crowded cultural conversations while protecting the business and brand.

• Be comfortable operating around controversial subjects and challenging cultural conversations without becoming unnecessarily risk-averse.

• Understand what makes a story interesting to media rather than simply what the company wants to communicate.

• Be capable of rewriting or strengthening an angle, headline, pitch, talking point, or narrative when senior intervention is required.

• Build and develop a strong internal PR function rather than relying exclusively on agencies to provide strategic thinking.

• Own reputation and crisis communications, partnering with the Co-CEOs and Legal to protect the brand.

Team Leadership & Organizational Performance

• Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable an approximately 13-person brand marketing organization.

• Manage managers and senior individual contributors across Creative, Production, PR, Social, Influencer, Copy, Brand Marketing, and related functions.

• Establish clear ownership, expectations, goals, accountability, and decision-making authority across the department.

• Evaluate talent continuously and identify where employees need coaching, clearer expectations, additional resources, changed responsibilities, or stronger performance management.

• Recognize high-potential employees and create opportunities for them to grow.

• Make difficult personnel recommendations when performance does not meet the needs of the business.

• Identify organizational gaps and recommend changes to team structure, roles, hiring plans, agencies, contractors, or external resources.

• Participate meaningfully in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, performance management, and termination decisions.

• Build a culture that combines empathy and development with extremely high standards for performance.

Marketing Operations & Planning

• Own the integrated marketing calendar in partnership with the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing.

• Set department priorities and determine what gets worked on, delayed, re-scoped, or stopped.

• Turn large initiatives into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and success metrics.

• Build and continuously improve the operating processes required for a sophisticated marketing organization.

• Establish clear processes for briefs, campaign development, research, creative concepting, moodboards, reviews, approvals, production, PR planning, launch readiness, asset delivery, reporting, and postmortems.

• Ensure teams are brought into initiatives at the right stage rather than operating reactively.

• Remove bottlenecks before they reach the executive team.

• Identify unclear ownership and correct it.

• Ensure initiatives move forward without requiring the Co-CEOs to manage day-to-day execution.

Budget & Commercial Management

• Own and manage a significant seven-figure brand marketing budget.

• Build annual and quarterly budgets and allocate resources against the highest-value opportunities.

• Evaluate spend based on strategic importance and expected business return.

• Maintain visibility into commitments, actual spend, forecasts, and ROI.

• Oversee agencies, production partners, talent, influencers, vendors, sponsorships, and other external relationships.

• Lead or oversee high-stakes negotiations and ensure the team is negotiating effectively.

• Challenge unnecessary spend and identify opportunities to achieve better outcomes with existing resources.

How This Role Works With Other Marketing Leaders

Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

The Director / Sr. Director of Brand & Creative Marketing and Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing will operate as peer leaders.

This role owns brand strategy, integrated brand campaigns, PR, Creative, Copy, Social, Influencer, brand activations, consumer insights, and the brand marketing budget.

The two leaders jointly plan around company goals, audience strategy, campaign performance, acquisition, landing-page effectiveness, creative performance, the marketing calendar, and overall business growth.

Leadership vs. Delegation

The Director creates the environment in which the marketing team can perform at a higher level by setting the strategy, establishing priorities, structuring the work, challenging the thinking, coaching the team, reviewing performance, removing gaps, and holding the organization accountable for results.

At the same time, this is a hands-on leadership role.

When a major campaign needs a stronger concept, a pitch needs to be rewritten, messaging is not working, a brief is unclear, a negotiation is stuck, or an important initiative needs senior attention, this person is expected to get involved and help solve it.

Strong leaders here do not say, "That's not my job."

They also do not take over their employees' jobs.

They know when to coach, when to challenge, when to make the decision, and when to roll up their sleeves.

What We Are Looking For

• 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, with exceptional candidates considered based on demonstrated scope and trajectory rather than years alone.

• 4+ years of meaningful people-management experience, including experience managing managers or senior functional leaders.

• Demonstrated experience across both brand marketing and PR/communications.

• Strong experience developing and executing integrated consumer marketing campaigns.

• Experience in a startup, high-growth environment, agency environment, or similarly fast-moving business, with the ability to operate with a high sense of urgency and keep pace with rapid execution, shifting priorities, and tight deadlines.

• Experience owning or meaningfully managing substantial marketing budgets.

• Experience working with agencies, production companies, creators, talent, vendors, and external partners.

• Working knowledge of campaign production from concept through delivery and distribution.

• Exceptional copy judgment and the ability to provide meaningful feedback across advertising, PR, social, influencer scripts, campaign messaging, and brand communications.

• Strong negotiator with sound commercial judgment.

• Experience creating structure, processes, and accountability inside growing or evolving teams.

• Comfortable making difficult decisions with incomplete information.

• Able to operate effectively with founders and senior executives who are highly engaged in the brand.

• Confident enough to challenge an executive recommendation when the data, customer insight, or strategy supports a different direction.

Marketplace or two-sided consumer platform experience is a plus.

Experience with culturally provocative, unconventional, entertainment, lifestyle, dating, or otherwise conversation-driving brands is highly valued.

What Will Not Work Here

This role will likely not be a fit for someone who:

• Primarily wants to delegate through layers of management.

• Measures success based on outputs rather than business outcomes.

• Is uncomfortable with provocative ideas or controversial conversations.

• Struggles with changing priorities.

• Avoids difficult conversations.

title: Staff Product Designer (AI Track)
description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

•
Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.

•
Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.

•
Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

•
Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.

•
Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.

•
Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.

•
Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.

•
Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.

•
Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

• You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.

• You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.

• You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

• 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.

• Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.

• Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.

• Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.

• Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.

• Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.

• Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

• Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.

• Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.

• Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

•
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.

•
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.

•
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

•
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.

•
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.

•
Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.

•
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Designer
description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

Location: This role is a full-time remote position.

What You’ll Do:

•

Product Design

•
Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

•
Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

•
Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

•
Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

•
Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

•
Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

Design Systems

•
Use and extend Jeeves’s existing design system and standards

•
Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

•
Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

Research & Validation

•
Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

•
Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

•
Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

•
Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves, grounded in evidence

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•
Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

•
Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

•
Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

•
Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

•
5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

•
Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

•
A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

•
Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

•
Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

•
Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

•
Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

•
Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

•
Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

•
Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

•
Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

•
Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

•
Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

•
Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

•
Native or professional English and Spanish, Portuguese ability preferred

title: AI Solution Designer / AI Business Advisor
description:
{"lang":"en","role":["AI","Data, AI & Analytics","UX, Design & Strategy"],"country":["Finland"],"seniority":["mid","senior"],"image":"https://www.solita.fi/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Openpositions-26-19.jpg","intro":"Join us in helping organizations turn AI into real business value"}

Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing industries, services, operating models, and ways of working. At Solita, we help organizations move beyond isolated experiments toward sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

We're now looking for professionals to join our AI community in Finland as either an AI Solution Designer, an AI Business Advisor, or a combination of both.

Both roles operate at the intersection of business, people, data, design, and AI. Together, they help customers identify valuable opportunities, design AI-powered solutions and ways of working, and scale AI adoption across the enterprise. Two profiles, one mission

AI Solution Designer

As an AI Solution Designer, your focus is on turning AI opportunities into practical solutions that create measurable value.

You help customers identify and prioritize opportunities, redesign workflows, define requirements, create concepts and implementation roadmaps, and ensure solutions can be successfully adopted in practice. You work closely with AI Architects, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

You understand modern AI capabilities such as Generative AI, AI agents, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Optimization, and Recommendation Systems well enough to identify where they create value and how they can be applied to real business challenges.

AI Business Advisor

As an AI Business Advisor, your focus is on helping organizations understand how AI impacts their business and where it can create competitive advantage.

You work with senior leaders to identify strategic opportunities, prioritize investments, shape AI strategies, redesign operating models, and guide AI-enabled transformation. You help organizations navigate the opportunities, risks, costs, and organizational implications of AI while ensuring initiatives are connected to measurable business outcomes.

You bring your own perspective on business transformation, technology adoption, and organizational change, and are comfortable facilitating strategic discussions with executive stakeholders.

We are especially interested in people who can bridge both worlds. Many of the most impactful AI transformations require both strategic thinking and practical execution. Perhaps you're already comfortable working across business strategy, transformation, design, and implementation. Or perhaps you're stronger in one area today but want to grow toward the other.

We're equally interested in:

• Strong AI Solution Designers

• Strong AI Business Advisors

• Hybrid professionals who combine both capabilities

Whatever your profile, you'll help customers connect business objectives, human needs, and technological possibilities to create sustainable value with AI.

What we expect

Regardless of your profile, we value:

Strong understanding of AI, analytics, and data
We're not looking for AI Engineers or Architects. Instead, we're looking for professionals who understand modern AI well enough to recognize where different approaches create value, how they can be combined, and what is required to make them successful in practice.

You understand that successful AI depends on trusted and well-managed data, including data quality, governance, and modern data platforms. You understand the opportunities, limitations, risks, costs, and organizational implications of technologies such as Generative AI, AI agents, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Optimization, and modern analytics. Most importantly, you have demonstrated experience in identifying when different approaches are appropriate and how they can be combined to solve business challenges and create measurable value.

Ability to bridge business, people, and technology
You can translate between stakeholders with very different perspectives. You understand enough about business to discuss value creation, enough about technology to discuss possibilities and limitations, and enough about people and change to ensure solutions are actually adopted.

Design and transformation capabilities
Depending on your profile, you may facilitate workshops, conduct discovery work, design services and workflows, create roadmaps, define operating models, shape transformation initiatives, or help leadership teams make investment decisions related to AI.

Consulting mindset
You enjoy working with customers, navigating ambiguity, facilitating discussions, and helping organizations move from ideas to implementation. You combine critical thinking with practical problem-solving and are comfortable working with diverse stakeholder groups.

Why join Solita?

At Solita, you'll work alongside AI experts, designers, consultants, data scientists, software developers, and business strategists solving some of the most important transformation challenges of our time.

Our projects range from AI strategy and governance to enterprise AI adoption, AI-powered products and services, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI. Few companies can combine strategic advisory, design excellence, AI expertise, data capabilities, and software engineering depth in the way we do.

Whether your passion is designing AI solutions, advising leadership teams, or combining both, you'll have the opportunity to shape not only customer transformations but also the future of AI consulting itself.

Want to hear more?

Please send us your application through our website. Tell us about yourself and your background in your own words. Our recruitment consists of two or three rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita.

AI Solution Designer salary range is €5,500-6,500/month and AI Business Advisor salary range is €6,000-7,000/month, depending on experience and expertise.

If you have any questions, please contact our Head of Talent Acquisition, Johanna Lintunen, by email (firstname.surname@solita.fi).

Due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email. Please apply directly through our website.

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. In addition, some of our customers may carry out a separate security clearance vetting made by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service, for example in case you start working for a customer operating in critical infrastructure sector.

We're seeking a Senior UX Designer to own and elevate the end-to-end user experience at Fastn. As our first senior UX hire, you'll lead the design of intuitive, elegant workflows that simplify complex technical tasks, enhance user satisfaction, and drive product adoption.

You'll play a pivotal role in defining Fastn's UX strategy and design system crafting onboarding journeys, feature discovery flows, and everyday interactions that make integration management feel seamless and empowering. Your work will directly impact our core metrics, including user activation, engagement, and retention.

What You'll Do

• Own the UX design process across Fastn's platform from initial concept to user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI designs

• Design and optimize critical user journeys including onboarding, activation, and feature adoption experiences

• Translate complex product requirements into clean, intuitive interfaces and interactions

• Build and test prototypes at various fidelity levels to communicate design concepts and gather feedback

• Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer interviews to validate design decisions

• Create and maintain our design system, ensuring consistency across the platform

• Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and leadership to align designs with business goals

• Champion user-centric design thinking across the company and help establish UX best practices

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Haves:

• 10+ years of professional UX design experience, with a focus on SaaS or complex web applications

• Early stage startup experience in B2B space

• Strong portfolio showcasing user flows, prototypes, and finalized designs that solved real user problems

• Expertise with Figma and modern design/prototyping tools

• Proven ability to balance product goals, technical constraints, and user needs

• Experience conducting user research and applying insights to design decisions

• Exceptional communication skills able to present and explain design decisions clearly

• Experience working with component-based design systems

• Collaborative approach to working with product and engineering teams

Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience designing for platforms involving integrations, APIs, or developer-facing products

• Experience with low code/no code softwares

• Understanding of frontend technologies (HTML/CSS/JavaScript fundamentals)

• Experience scaling UX processes in a fast-growing startup environment

Our Work Style

• Our team collaborates remotely across multiple time zones with flexible working hours

• We value asynchronous communication and thoughtful documentation

• We maintain a healthy balance between independent work and collaborative sessions

• As a startup, we value success over the number of hours, so if you are a clock watcher, this role is not for you.

Why Join Fastn?

• Shape the UX vision of an AI-driven product in a rapidly growing market

• Work in a high-impact environment where your designs directly influence business growth

• Join a team that values craftsmanship, creativity, and velocity

• Opportunity to build and possibly lead a design team as we scale

title: Brand Designer
description:
Description

Creative Producer(In-House)

Remote (US) · Full-time

﻿

Cybersecurity is one of the most cinematic industries on earth. Hackers get movies made about them. Heists, hoodies, red rooms, blue teams, zero days, ransom notes typed on cracked screens. And yet most of the marketing looks like a stock photo of a padlock.

We want to fix that. We're hiring an in-house Creative Producer to help us do it.

Terra is an AI-native offensive security company. We build agentic pentesting that runs continuously, finds real exploitable vulnerabilities, and helps security teams close them before attackers get there first. Our customers are CISOs at banks, hospitals, and enterprises where a breach is a very bad day. The work is serious. The storytelling shouldn't be.

What you'll actually do

Produce the stuff people stop scrolling for. Short videos, launch films, event content, podcast episodes, motion pieces, weird one-offs, campaign assets, founder content, customer stories that don't sound like customer stories. You'll work directly with marketing, our founders, our researchers, and customers who occasionally let us tell their war stories.

You'll own the concept, the shot list, the shoot, the edit, and the ship. Sometimes you'll direct. Sometimes you'll be a one-person crew. Sometimes you'll wrangle a scrappy team of freelancers and AI tools into something that punches three weight classes above what it cost to make.

You will not be handed briefs and asked to execute them. You will be asked what you'd make, what you need, and how fast you can get it up.

Logistics

Remote, US-based. We have gravity in NYC, Boston, Florida, and San Francisco, but you can live anywhere in the US. Travel is 10 to 20% for shoots, events, and occasionally being in a room with the rest of us.

Compensation: Competitive base, plus meaningful early-employee equity and benefits. Where an offer lands depends on experience and the strength of your portfolio.

Requirements

• You have a portfolio that makes us want to hire you before we finish scrolling

• You're 3-5 years into your career and at least 2 years of experience as a Brand designer

• You can operate cameras, direct talent, edit, and finish work yourself when you need to

• You've used AI tools in production and have opinions about which ones are actually good

• You can get technical when it helps and get out of the way when it doesn't

• You say yes to weird ideas and then figure out how to pull them off

• You do not need to know anything about cybersecurity yet, but you have to want to learn it fast

How to apply?

Send your portfolio. That's the first thing we're going to look at, so lead with it.

Then tell us: what would you make for a company like Terra in your first 90 days? Give us two or three concepts you're actually excited about. What would you need to pull them off? How would you do it on a shoestring with AI tools and a team that says yes too often?

We are not hiring an agency. Please do not submit through recruiters. We want to hear from the person who's going to make the work.

• Turn creative briefs into AI-generated and AI-enhanced imagery, video and motion across social, paid, digital and campaign work

• Share what you build and learn through show-and-tells and training sessions

• Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard

• Stay close to new tools and models, testing them against real briefs and recommending what we adopt

WHAT YOU BRING:

• A portfolio of AI-generated or AI-enhanced work finished to a professional standard, for brands, agencies or personal projects

• Solid design fundamentals: composition, typography, colour and an eye for what looks right on screen

• Hands-on experience building work in node-based AI workflows (e.g. Figma Weave, ComfyUI, Flora) that chain models like Flux, Veo, Kling and Sora with editing steps, and the judgement to pick the right model and route for the job

• Strong Photoshop skills, with working After Effects and/or Premiere Pro to take output through to finish

• Some ability to build as well as make: scripting or automation (e.g. Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, Figma plugins, ComfyUI) used to speed up creative work

• A problem-solver’s instinct for spotting inefficiency in a workflow and fixing it properly

• Understanding of how social, paid and digital assets are specced and delivered (formats, safe zones, aspect ratios, versioning)

• Awareness of the ethical, legal and brand-safety considerations around generative AI in commercial work

• Fluent English, with confidence explaining your process and presenting to creative directors, account teams and clients

• A willingness to share what you know and help others get better with these tools

• Curious, experimental and self-directed when a tool or workflow doesn’t exist yet

• Nice to have: motion, 3D or VFX background, custom model training, LLM APIs and agentic tooling, content provenance standards.

WE OFFER

• Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.

• Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

• Dog-friendly office

• Hybrid working policy

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.

• Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.
