description:
Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.

I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.

Background & reason for hiring

Modash helps brands scale creator partnerships on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Brands pay creators in lots of different ways: free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions. Today those are separate flows rather than one coherent experience.

This role is about building one payment experience that handles all of them, on both sides:

• Brand side - setting up the deal and paying for it

• Creator side - getting paid

You own the entire workflow end to end. The role combines design and product management in one person: you decide what to build and why, and then you design how it works.

This is what you'll own:

The payments experience

Free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions, for brands and creators alike, from setting up the deal to the creator getting paid. You work on prototypes and concepts for future iterations, design them, collect feedback and get the requirements ready for engineering.

Running development cycles

• Prepping user stories and explaining them to the engineers

• Doing the QA once the work is ready

• Giving and receiving feedback in retros

• Deciding when it's good enough to get into customers' hands - it's your product

The customer voice and the story

• Talking with customers about their pains and needs around paying creators, gifting products and running affiliate programs

• Keeping everyone in the company up to date on your roadmap, new releases and plans for the next sprints

• Working closely with product marketing so your product stands out and customers understand what's new

• Tracking your impact using customer feedback and north star metrics

Your first months in Modash will bring

• Onboarding with the product and Creator teams on how brands and creators use Modash today

• Customer calls with brands and creators, plus time in Fullstory and Amplitude to see where the payment flows break down

• Joining sprint planning with the engineering team and getting to know the backlog

Team structure

You'll report to me (Head of Product) and work closely with a dedicated engineering team lead Besnik. You'll also join a group of talented designer/PMs Renata, Maksym & Heidi who own other parts of our B2B SaaS product, and you'll work with them on product ideas, the shared design system and synced roadmaps.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

• Experience as both a product designer & product manager or in a hybrid PM/design role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

• You've written great user stories and communicated your designs clearly to developers

• You've prioritized work with a bigger goal in mind and built a roadmap yourself. You can explain why some things came first and others didn't make the cut.

• You've worked with a design system to keep the experience coherent

• Extreme attention to detail. You notice the wrong spacing, the unclear label and the missing edge case, and you don't ship sloppy work.

• Get-it-done attitude. We all run into roadblocks every day. We're looking for someone who finds solutions, motivates themselves and keeps getting things done.

• You're used to, and actually enjoy, a fast pace and constant change in a growing company

• You aspire to be great. We're not shooting for mediocrity here.

• Interest in the creator economy. Our mission is to help creators get paid. You don't need to live and breathe the creator world, but we'd like your values to align with ours.

• You're fluent in English. Our team is spread across many countries, and we work together in English every day.

Nice to haves:

• UX work on affiliate, marketplace or payments products

• Strong instincts in research or analytics (you don't need to be an expert in both)

• Experience with our tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, Amplitude and Fullstory

If you meet most but not all of these, don't let that stop you from applying. We're not looking for a finished product, and we'd be happy to grow with you.

Benefits

What we're offering

• Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.

• Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 65,000€ - 85,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.

• Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.

• Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you're happy and well rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.

• Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we'll cover it.

• Ownership 💡 You're the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.

• Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

title: Staff Product Designer, Incentives
description:
We are looking for a skilled Staff Product Designer to lead and execute all user experience and design-related initiatives within our Incentives group. You’ll be responsible for our brand-new Bolt Plus programme, take the challenge of scaling it further, and obsess about new ways to engage customers with Bolt’s services across business verticals and all our markets.

About us:

With over 200 million customers in 50+ countries, Bolt is one of the fastest-growing tech companies in Europe and Africa. And it's all thanks to our people.

We believe in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

Our ultimate goal is to make cities for people, not cars, and we need your help to achieve this mission!

About the role:

As Staff Product Designer, you co-lead the vision, strategy, and execution for Bolt's customer subscription and loyalty programmes, including scaling our new product - Bolt Plus. You take end-to-end ownership, from discovery to global launch. Define and deliver on short- and long-term roadmaps aligned with our company goals and stakeholders within our Rides, Rentals and Delivery verticals. You contribute to the growth strategy across all Bolt verticals and influence the ways of working within the global design function.

Your ability to build strong stakeholder partnerships, challenge existing solutions and drive the improvement of customer experience across the group will be essential to your success in this role.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in Berlin. However, relocation support is provided only for candidates relocating to Tallinn, Estonia.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

•
Advocating for the user, conducting usability tests, and ensuring design decisions are based on user research and feedback.

•
Collaborating with User Researchers, Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to comprehend project requirements and limitations.

•
Developing interactive prototypes to illustrate design concepts and test usability.

•
Managing design projects, ensuring they adhere to timelines while effectively balancing multiple tasks.

•
Contributing to or developing design guidelines and patterns to maintain consistency across products.

•
Creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that enhance user engagement and satisfaction.

About you:

•
You have experience as a Staff Product Designer, preferably in a fast-paced technology or internet-based company, and a proven track record of shipping digital products that serve millions of users.

•
You have experience designing for growth, incentives, or subscription-based products, with a strong understanding of how to balance user needs and business impact.

•
You have an excellent portfolio showcasing a range of design work for mobile and web platforms, including user interface and user experience design.

•
You're highly proficient in design tools and software, including Figma, Jira, Confluence, and various usability testing tools.

•
You stay up-to-date with the latest design trends and emerging technologies and apply this knowledge to your work.

•
You can communicate fluently in English and your exceptional collaboration skills enable you to effectively work with cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders and the ways of how we work and execute at Bolt.

Why you’ll love it here

•
Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.

•
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.

•
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.

•
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.

•
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.

•
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.

*Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
location: New York, NY, Boston, MA, Washington D.C.
description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.

Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.

Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.

Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

What You'll Do

• Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music.

• Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms.

• Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction.

• Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations.

• Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust.

• Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify.

• Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact.

• Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.

Who You Are

• You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners.

• You have significant hands-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, ideally in a domain involving LLM evaluation, user-generated content, or complex user behavior.

• You communicate clearly, form well-founded, evidence-backed points of view, and can bring together messy, multimodal signals (quantitative, qualitative, and model telemetry) into clear narratives for senior executives, researchers, engineers, and the music industry.

• You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact.

• You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities.

• You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy.

• You have a solid grounding in experimental design and causal inference, such as A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and power analysis.

• You thrive when tackling loosely defined problems in ambiguous, zero-to-one spaces.

Where You'll Be

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

• This team operates within the US Eastern timezone for collaboration

The United States base range for this position is $144,714–$206,735 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

location: San Francisco, CA, US; New York, NY, US; Seattle, WA, US; Remote, US
description:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The User and Content Foundations org is responsible for deeply understanding our content, users and their interactions by generating high-quality, reusable signals and insights that power relevance and personalization across the platform. We work at the intersection of distributed machine learning, large multimodal models, data infrastructure, and product adoption to build foundational capabilities that support our partners, including Discovery, Search, Growth, and Ads. You’ll work across research, machine learning, infrastructure, and engineering domains to turn advances in VLMs, LLMs, multimodal learning and sequence modeling into impact. title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX DESIGNER, SEEKING

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA (Las Vegas, NV strongly preferred)

Compensation

$90,000 to $140,000 base

Travel

Required for team weeks, user research, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We work at the intersection of technology, consumer psychology, and product design at the highest level. Our mission is to help people foster genuine relationships and find love, and to rethink how social platforms can advance human connection.

We are hiring a UI/UX Designer who combines three things: systems thinking, customer obsession, and an eye for emotionally rich interaction design. Dating is an emotional product. People act on emotion first and logic second, so our interface has to earn trust, build excitement, and guide each member toward the next right step.

You will work directly with the Co-CEOs and Head of Product, embedded in a cross-functional pod with a Product Manager, engineers, and a data engineer. Each pod owns a funnel, such as onboarding, and is measured on the sign-ups, engagement, and purchases it drives. You will design across web and native iOS and Android: onboarding, discovery, matching, messaging, profile, and subscription surfaces.

AI tools can now produce a basic, competent interface in minutes. That makes tool skill table stakes. We pay for judgment: understanding the member deeply, anticipating edge cases before they ship, and knowing when an experience should be fast and minimal and when it should be layered with motion, video, and texture that pull the member forward.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is UX Designer, UX/UI Designer, Product Designer, Interaction Designer, Visual Designer, Motion Designer, or Product Design Engineer. If your day-to-day is designing and shipping consumer experiences that real people love using, apply regardless of title.

What You'll Own

Customer Obsession & Research

• Spend real time with members: interviews, session recordings, support tickets, and beta groups of real users who test new work before it ships.

• Turn what you learn into designs that match how members actually want to browse, connect, and communicate.

Systems Thinking & Edge Cases

• Design complete flows, including every state, error, empty screen, and edge case, so engineering builds it right the first time.

• Break big experience problems into small, shippable steps that build momentum.

• Work inside our design system and extend it cleanly when a new pattern is needed.

Emotional & Interaction Design

• Design for emotion and guidance: motion, video, fluid transitions, and layered texture that build excitement and lead members along the right path.

• Keep task moments such as settings, payments, and verification fast, clean, and effortless.

• Make the effect of member actions visible, so adding a photo, completing a profile, or verifying feels immediately rewarding.

Core Experiences You'll Shape

• Onboarding that takes a new member from download to a compelling profile in minutes.

• Conversational, AI-guided profile building that replaces long forms.

• Discovery and shortlisting flows that move members from browsing to real connection.

• Messaging as seamless as the best consumer apps, with rich media and video built in.

• Self-presentation tools that let members who value discretion show who they are with confidence.

Data-Driven Iteration

• Work from funnel and engagement data with your pod. Instrument what you ship and read the results.

• Prototype in Figma, Framer, or code (v0, Lovable, Cursor) and put ideas in front of real members within days.

Agentic Operating Model

• Use Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools every day to explore more options and ship faster.

• Help build the design team's agent workflows and playbook so the whole team compounds.

Required Qualifications

• A portfolio of shipped consumer product work that shows exceptional UI/UX craft: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and polish.

• A consistent pattern of customer obsession across your career. Your case studies start with the user and end with what changed for them.

• Systems thinking. You anticipate edge cases, design every state, and see how one screen affects the whole journey.

• Proven ability to design for emotion, using motion, transitions, video, and visual texture with purpose.

• Relentless curiosity. You keep asking why until you understand the member, and you are always learning.

• Smart risk-taking. You try bold ideas, test them small, and learn fast.

• Three or more years of hands-on UI/UX or product design experience in consumer B2C, mobile, or subscription products.

• Expert Figma: component systems, auto-layout, prototyping, tokens, and multi-file library management.

• Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, or comparable), with enough technical and architectural fluency to direct AI toward results that scale. You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.

• Comfort working from funnel and engagement data (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable).

• Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can walk the CEO through a design decision clearly and quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior work in dating, social, marketplace, or subscription products.

• Motion design skills in tools such as After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or Principle.

• Front-end fluency (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) sufficient to ship small changes yourself.

• Experience running or partnering on customer beta programs.

• Public work we can see: portfolio, prototypes, Dribbble, Behance, or a personal site.

• Bachelor's degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field. We weigh the work most heavily.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary: $90,000 to $140,000, commensurate with experience and craft.

• Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US.

• 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees.

• 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.

• Direct exposure to the CEO and Head of Product, and regular time with real members.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. WE OFFER

• DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.

• Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

Great office located at the core of Östermalm

Build enablement and cross-functional capability

• Use and evaluate AI throughout the content design process to accelerate synthesis, exploration, prototyping, and testing while maintaining accuracy, brand integrity, privacy, and customer trust.

• Facilitate working sessions and mentor content designers to raise the quality and impact of content across Rocket.

About you

• A portfolio demonstrating strategic and hands-on content design across complex, customer-facing digital experiences.

• Experience mentoring content designers and raising the quality of work through critique and feedback.

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! location: Remote, Europe, Switzerland, Poland, United Kingdom, Netherlands
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

 - Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

 - Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

 - Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.




REQUIREMENTS

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

 - Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

 - Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

 - Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

 - Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

Location:

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Technical Game Designer (Level)
description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Technical Level Designer, you will create worlds and sandboxes filled with opportunities to play. You are a level designer by craft, with the technical skills to build gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints and/or C++.

You will create new world affordances: gameplay verbs, activities, challenges, and interactions that invite players to experiment and engage with their surroundings. You will prototype, validate, iterate on, and deliver these features, then use them to build levels that encourage exploration, problem-solving, and memorable multiplayer moments.

A Day In The Life:

•
Rapidly prototype and validate new gameplay verbs, activities, and environmental interactions in Unreal Engine for online multiplayer.

•
Build and refine levels using the mechanics and tools you create alongside existing systems, hazards, and enemies.

•
Playtest with the team to understand how players discover and use these affordances, then refine levels and features to encourage experimentation and memorable moments.

What You’ll Do:

•
Own the design, implementation, debugging, polish, and maintenance of interactive world features and environmental gameplay toys that offer new choices, challenges, and benefits. Creature and NPC behaviors are outside this role.

•
Build levels from blockout through delivery, shaping flow, pacing, navigation, and readability across exploration, puzzles, traversal, and encounters.

•
Create reusable, configurable gameplay components and tools that help designers build and iterate on levels efficiently.

•
Rapidly prototype and playtest ideas to validate their potential, refine features, and manage scope and complexity.

•
Collaborate across disciplines to align with design direction, integrate player abilities and creature encounters, and meet technical requirements.

•
Partner with Engineering to resolve performance issues and ensure reliable multiplayer behavior.

•
Keep implementations organized and document features and tools so the team can use, tune, and maintain them.

What You’ll Bring:

•
Strong level design fundamentals in spatial composition, flow, pacing, and player guidance for open-world exploration and multiplayer play.

•
At least one shipped game as a level designer on a multidisciplinary team.

•
Proficiency in Unreal Engine Blueprints and/or C++, with the ability to independently prototype, implement, and debug gameplay features.

•
Experience building levels and authoring collision and navigation in Unreal Engine.

•
Strong playtesting and iteration habits, with an understanding of how design shapes player behavior, cooperation, and relationships.

•
Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

Nice to Have:

•
Experience building reusable level design tools, modular gameplay kits, or procedural workflows in Unreal Engine.

•
Experience designing systemic puzzles, physics-based interactions, or environmental features that support multiple solutions and emergent multiplayer play.

•
Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay scripts and level content.

The Team:

•
This role reports to the Design Manager.

How We Work

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

•
Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.

•
Adapt when plans change.

•
Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.

•
Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.

•
Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.

•
Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

You'll Thrive Here If...

•
You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.

•
You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.

•
You balance ambition with pragmatism.

•
You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.

•
You care about helping your teammates succeed.

•
You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

Please Note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

Our Interview Process

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

•
Step 1: People Operations Introduction

•
Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview

•
Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)

•
Step 4: Gardeners Debrief

•
Step 5: Offer

Life at Gardens

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us could build alone.

Gardens Offers:

•
Competitive salaries and pay transparency

•
Stock options

•
Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for individuals, 90% for dependents)

•
Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, and additional benefits

•
401(k) contributions (U.S.) / RRSP + DPSP contributions (Canada)

•
Paid parental leave

•
A fully distributed remote studio across North American time zones

Benefits and perks listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Gardens and the country in which you work.

Physical Requirements: This is a primarily sedentary, remote role requiring the ability to remain stationary and perform computer-based work for extended periods, including sustained use of monitors, keyboards, mice, and game controllers for a minimum of six hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role. Gardens is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Encouragement: We believe that diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our games better. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every single qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Research consistently shows that talented people, particularly women, people of color, and those from historically underrepresented communities are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. We care far more about curiosity, growth, and a willingness to learn than checking every box.

Scam Note: Unfortunately, scammers have impersonated Gardens Interactive by offering fake employment opportunities intended to collect financial information.

Official communication from our team will always come from a @ email address. We will never ask for financial information during the hiring process.

Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain. And the strongest engineers in the market should have a reason to choose us that has nothing to do with the offer.

• That is a rare kind of impact for this discipline. Most tech brand roles are asked to manufacture credibility that isn't there. Here the engineering is genuinely strong and already documented — the gap is that it doesn't travel. You'd be building the function that closes it, with real autonomy, very little inherited process, and direct access to engineering leaders and our CTO.

A Typical Day:

• Own the editorial engine. Run the Airbnb Tech Blog end to end: sourcing topics from teams, coaching engineer-authors, editing to a high bar, and moving posts through legal, security and comms review without letting them stall. Set and hold a publishing rhythm the org can rely on.

• Find the cross-team narratives. Our biggest gap is that individually strong posts never add up to a story. You'll work across orgs to identify the themes that connect work from multiple teams, and publish them as connected sets — while each domain keeps publishing in depth for its own specialists.

• Build our voices. Help our engineers and technical leaders develop genuine public presence: bylines, talks, speaker coaching, and a pipeline of new voices. This includes partnering closely with our CTO to establish his public technical presence.

• Own distribution. Establish our canonical home on an Airbnb-owned domain, stand up the surfaces we're missing including video, and decide what our social channels are for. Publishing well and distributing poorly is the pattern we're here to break.

• Run our external presence. Set conference and event strategy — where we speak, where we sponsor, where we skip — and manage what we host ourselves. Own our academic collaborations and technical media relationships, and the budget and vendors behind all of it.

• Steward our open source presence. Make sure what Airbnb claims publicly is accurate and actually maintained, and that the projects carrying our name reflect how we want to be seen.

• Prove it works. Partner with Talent Acquisition to connect this work to hiring outcomes — inbound share of the senior pipeline, offer acceptance at staff level and above in ML and infrastructure — and be honest about what is and isn't attributable.

Your Expertise:

• Substantial experience in technical content, developer relations, engineering communications or technical editorial — including time spent working directly with engineers, not adjacent to them.

• Technical fluency. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation, read a design doc, and judge whether a draft post says anything real. Credibility with staff engineers is the difference between this role working and not working.

• Editorial judgment and hands-on craft. You can edit an engineer's draft into something sharper without flattening their voice, and you know the difference between a post that teaches something and one that announces something.

• Influence without authority. Nothing you need is owned by you. You've built systems and incentives that got busy senior people to produce, rather than relying on persistence.

• Program discipline. You've owned events, budgets and vendors end to end, and you're comfortable with the unglamorous half of the job.

• Measurement literacy. You connect brand work to funnel outcomes, and you're straight about the limits of attribution rather than reaching for impressions.

• Judgment on risk. You've navigated legal and security review, and you know what shouldn't be published as well as what should.

Nice to have

• Experience migrating a technical publication between platforms, including the SEO and redirect work.

• Experience running or fixing an open source program.

• Experience helping a senior executive build a public technical presence.

• Familiarity with AI and ML engineering topics, and with academic or research communications.

• Video or multi-format content experience.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

title: Employer Brand Designer & Multimedia Producer

Role Overview

The Employer Brand Designer & Multimedia Producer brings the organisation’s employer brand and Employee Value Proposition (EVP) to life through compelling visual design, multimedia content and creative storytelling. Working within HR and in close partnership with Employer Brand, Talent Acquisition, Communications, Marketing and other stakeholders, the role leads the creative execution of employer-brand initiatives across digital, social, recruitment and internal channels. The role combines graphic design, multimedia production, motion graphics, video and brand stewardship to deliver a consistent, distinctive and high-quality employee and candidate experience.

Creative & Graphic Design

•Translate the EVP and employer-brand strategy into engaging and distinctive visual concepts.

•Create infographics, illustrations, animations and visual storytelling assets that make complex information engaging and easy to understand.
•Develop creative concepts from initial brief and ideation through to final production.
•Adapt creative assets for different audiences, markets, formats and digital channels while maintaining brand consistency.
Video, Motion & Multimedia Production
•Create and edit video, motion graphics, animation and multimedia content that showcases the organisation, its people, culture, career opportunities and EVP.
•Produce engaging employee stories, testimonials, recruitment videos, social content, campaign assets and other multimedia experiences.
•Manage multimedia production from concept and storyboarding through editing, post-production and final delivery.
•Optimise video and multimedia assets for different digital platforms and formats.
•Explore new creative formats and production techniques to continually evolve employer-brand storytelling.
Visual Identity & Template Management
•Build, maintain and continuously improve a suite of employer-brand visual templates that enable consistent and efficient content creation.
•Develop templates for social media, presentations, recruitment campaigns, job marketing, events, digital content and other recurring requirements.
•Ensure employer-brand visual standards remain aligned with the broader corporate brand while addressing the specific needs of talent audiences.
•Provide guidance to stakeholders on the correct application of employer-brand templates and visual assets.
Creative Quality & Brand Governance
•Ensure creative quality control across employer-brand materials and campaigns.
•Review creative outputs for visual quality, consistency, accessibility, accuracy and alignment with brand standards.
•Act as a guardian of the employer-brand visual identity, helping ensure a coherent candidate and employee experience across channels.
•Establish practical creative standards and guidelines that enable teams and partners to produce consistently high-quality work.
•Provide creative direction and constructive design feedback to internal stakeholders and external partners where required.
Digital Experience Support

EVP & Employer Brand Projects

•Contribute creative thinking and visual expertise during project development and campaign planning.

•Establish and maintain appropriate naming conventions, version control and asset-management processes.
•Maintain visual standards and guidelines to support consistent application of the employer brand across the organisation.
•Coordinate with agencies and external creative partners when additional production support is required.
Skills & Experience

•Experience creating infographics, animations, motion graphics and multimedia content.
•Strong video production and editing skills, including experience taking content from concept through post-production.
•Experience creating and maintaining visual templates and design systems.
•Strong understanding of brand identity and experience applying brand guidelines consistently across multiple channels and formats.
•Experience managing creative quality control and reviewing assets against established visual standards.
•Digital-design capability, with an understanding of designing for websites, landing pages, social platforms and mobile experiences.
•Ability to translate strategic concepts, EVP messaging and employee stories into engaging visual communications.
•Experience managing digital or creative asset libraries and maintaining effective version control.
•Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret creative briefs and work collaboratively with both creative and non-creative stakeholders.
•Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Desirable Technical Capabilities
Experience with a combination of the following would be advantageous:
•Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro and After Effects
•Figma or equivalent digital-design and prototyping platforms
•Motion graphics and animation tools
•Video editing, colour correction, audio editing and post-production
•Photography and video production
•Canva or enterprise template-management platforms
•Digital asset management systems
•Web and responsive design principles
•Basic understanding of HTML/CSS
•UX/UI and accessibility principles
•Generative AI and emerging creative technologies, with an understanding of responsible use in professional creative production

•Creative Excellence - Produces distinctive, polished and engaging creative work while maintaining a consistently high standard of execution.
•Visual Storytelling - Transforms EVP themes, employee experiences, data and complex messages into clear and compelling visual narratives.
•Employer Brand Mindset - Understands how creative execution shapes candidate and employee perceptions and uses design to reinforce an authentic and differentiated employer brand.
•Brand Stewardship - Protects visual consistency while finding creative ways to evolve and activate the employer brand across different audiences and channels.
•Digital-First Thinking - Designs with the channel, audience, user experience and format in mind rather than simply adapting print-led creative for digital use.
•Collaboration - Works effectively with Employer Brand, HR, Talent Acquisition, Communications, Marketing, Digital, agencies and other partners to turn business requirements into strong creative solutions.
•Ownership & Delivery - Manages creative work from brief and concept through production, quality assurance and final delivery, balancing creativity with deadlines and business priorities.

title: Senior Design Engineer, PSA
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Design Engineer to help create the next generation of experiences at PSA. From marketplace and fintech to submissions and collector tools, you'll combine design excellence and engineering expertise to build products that make collecting more safe, easy, and fun.

What You’ll Do

As a Design Engineer at PSA, you will report to the Director of Design and partner closely with Design, Product, and Engineering to deliver experiences across the PSA ecosystem. From marketplace and fintech experiences to submissions, account management, and the future of collecting, you'll help bring craft, quality, and delight to products that collectors use every day.

•

company: General Dynamics - Ordnance and Tactical Systems (AR,ME,N...
description:
Company Overview
General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems (OTS) is a global leader in the design, engineering and production of munitions, energetics, weapons, armaments, and missile subsystems around the world. OTS empowers the U.S. military and its allies with an extensive range of overarching product segments applied across all levels of strategic and tactical operations, providing a cutting-edge advantage to our warfighters. Our Ethos of Honesty, Trust, Transparency, and Alignment, are the guiding principles that form the foundation of everything we do. Integrity is paramount, innovation fuels our passion, customer satisfaction is at the core of our mission, and collaboration is key to our success - fostering a culture of teamwork and mutual respect among employees, partners, and stakeholders. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits that include career development and recognition programs. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!
Job Summary
We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our growing Solid Rocket Motor Engineering Team. The ideal candidate will have experience as Mechanical Design Engineer for solid rocket motors. That would include Mechanical Design Integration of Solid Propulsion Systems, mechanical system design, mass properties and integrating all sub-assemblies. They will be responsible for the design, development, and integration of mechanical components used in solid rocket motor systems. This role focuses on creating CAD models, engineering drawings, and specifications for critical hardware such as motor cases, nozzles, insulation systems, joints, and structural interfaces. This position can be remote or at our Huntsville, AL, Niceville FL, or Hampton, AR facility.
Impact of the Role

General Profile

• Solves complex problems

• Works independently, receives minimal guidance

• May lead projects or project steps within a broader project or may have accountability for on-going activities or objectives

Essential Functions

• Applies engineering techniques to design, install, modify, analyze, repair and test tools, engines, machines, and other mechanically functioning equipment.

Additional Responsibilities

•
Knowledge, skills & abilities: Oral and written communication skills. Ability to meet deadlines. Interpersonal skills. Problem-solving skills. Analytical thinking skills. Applied mechanics. Design engineering. Design optimization. Design review. Mechanical engineering. Prototyping. Requirements engineering/analysis. CAD software. Computer-aided engineering (CAE) software.

Physical Requirements

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time.

• Requires regular movement throughout GD-OTS facilities.

• May need to stand for long periods of time.

• Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.

• Work may require employee to work inside and outside with exposure to changing climate and/or operate machinery.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

Role

You will shape the visual language of A1's product. In AI applications, visual design must do more than look polished. It must help users understand dynamic content, system behavior, reliability signals, and complex AI-driven workflows.

This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for A1's product across web and mobile.

•
Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

•
Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

•
Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

•
Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

•
Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

•
Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

•
Make AI-heavy interfaces feel clear and structured without overwhelming users.

What You Will Need

•
Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

•
Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

•
Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

•
Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

•
Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

•
Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

•
Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

•
Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

description:
Overview

At SSOE, you will engage with an innovation-driven culture where integrated delivery across architectural, structural, MEP, process, civil, and automation disciplines fuels impactful industrial and complex commercial projects worldwide. Our senior engineers thrive within a mentorship-rich environment fostering continuous learning, technical excellence, and cross-discipline collaboration. We prioritize delivering the highest quality engineering products underpinned by well-defined processes and technology investments, including advanced BIM and AI tools.

Career advancement paths are clearly defined, enabling you to grow your technical and leadership capabilities while contributing to projects that shape critical infrastructure. SSOE’s commitment to social responsibility, safety, and integrity ensures your work promotes sustainable, safe, and resilient built environments.

AI and Innovation

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities

The following duties are typical of the position but are not all encompassing. Responsibilities include those required to deliver quality service on schedule and within budget in a team environment.

• Interprets, organizes, executes and coordinates medium assignments with the overall responsibility for budget adherence, quality control and inter-discipline coordination.

• Makes decisions independently on design problems, practices and methods, but may receive input on unusual or complex problems from the department manager or project engineer/architect for proposed design solutions.

• Completes work on major engineering/architectural projects or total design work on projects of smaller or moderate scope.

• Serves as a job captain on single discipline projects and may serve as a job captain on multi-discipline projects.

• Prepares or reviews construction budgets based on experience and scope of project.

• Writes scope of work for design based on preliminary review and meetings with the customer

• May be requested to perform project management functions.

• May assign and review work of project design team. Checks progress of work and alerts project manager to changes of scope or additional services.

• May devise new approaches and solutions to problems encountered and communicate them to the team.

• May represent the firm in meetings and conferences to resolve important questions and to plan and coordinate a project.

• May prepare total design and construction cost estimates.

• Travel required.

• Valid driver's license required. May be waived for international assignments.

What We Offer:

•
Competitive Salary: $111,000 - $125,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and certifications.

•
Bonus and Incentives: Based on experience, you will be eligible for our annual target bonus/incentive program derived from company and individual performance and goals.

•
Ownership Opportunities: SSOE offers ownership opportunities to all employees at the Associate level and above.

•
Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), professional development and training, generous PTO, and paid holidays.

Additional Perks:

•
Dynamic Culture: Experience a supportive culture where you're an essential and highly valued member of our vibrant team.

•
Exciting Projects: Work on thrilling projects from inception to completion and engage directly with some of the most innovative clients globally.

•
Continuous Learning: Embrace a culture of perpetual learning where curiosity is celebrated, innovative ideas are welcomed, and your career growth aspirations are fully supported.

•
Career Stability: A diversity of market sectors, project types, and geographic locations that help insulate your career from economic ups and downs.

•
Career Advancement: Embark on a structured career journey with abundant opportunities for growth and advancement.

•
Holistic Compensation: A holistic approach to compensation and benefits that supports your physical and mental health, encourages work-life balance, and empowers your career advancement and financial success.

SSOE – The Best of Both Worlds

At SSOE, our growth trajectory allows us to offer the opportunities normally associated with a large firm while embracing the collaborative and supportive culture often found in smaller firms. As a member of the SSOE team, you will work on exciting and diverse projects for Fortune 100 clients around the globe, supported by the best technology for the task at hand. You will experience our employee-centric culture that strives to offer a healthy balance, flexible working arrangements, direct access to leadership at all levels, and a mindset of continuous learning. Once you experience the SSOE difference, you’ll understand the why behind our metrics:

•
28% - of our employees have been with SSOE for 10 years or more.

•
15% - of employees with tenure exceeding 15 years.

•
99% - our CEO’s approval rating on Glassdoor.

•
98% - portion of our clients who say they would recommend us to a colleague.

Qualifications

• Associate degree or certification of completion of other post secondary training in engineering or architectural fields preferred.

• Minimum fifteen (15) years experience with SSOE as a Designer or nineteen (19) years experience with former employer(s).

• Working knowledge of BIM collaboration and review platforms including ACC/BIM360, Bluebeam, and Navisworks.

• Experience on Industrial and Manufacturing building projects is mandatory.

• Experience on Data Center and/or Pharmaceutical projects is preferred.

title: Senior Technical Artist
description:
Senior UE5 Technical Artist, Defcon Zero | TriArts Games | Remote

Join the team building Defcon Zero, a high-fidelity RTS powered by Unreal Engine 5.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Artist to join our technical art team, working on scalable materials, production tools, asset integration, and real-time optimization inside Unreal Engine 5. You will bridge the gap between art and development, helping our units, structures, environments, and battlefield effects meet high visual standards while remaining performant at RTS scale.

You will have direct ownership, work closely with both artists and developers, and see your work reflected throughout the final game.

What you'll own

•
Performance and optimization: Profile and optimize materials, geometry, textures, lighting, shadows, foliage, and visual effects for large-scale RTS battles.

•
Materials and shaders: Build scalable materials and shaders supporting faction colors, damage states, construction effects, and gameplay-driven visuals.

•
Art pipeline: Build reliable workflows between Maya, Substance Painter, and Unreal Engine 5 for asset preparation, importing, validation, and automation.

•
Tools development: Create tools and scripts that reduce repetitive work and improve iteration speed for artists and designers.

•
Environment systems: Develop workflows for landscapes, foliage, instancing, procedural placement, and level assembly across RTS camera distances.

•
Gameplay visual integration: Connect art and effects to gameplay, including construction, destruction, damage feedback, abilities, and world-space indicators.

•
Destruction systems: Build and optimize destruction for vehicles, structures, and environments using Chaos and other techniques, covering fracturing, damage states, debris, and effects.

•
Visual effects support: Help VFX artists integrate, troubleshoot, and optimize Niagara systems and materials while maintaining gameplay readability.

•
Technical problem-solving: Resolve rendering, shading, lighting, geometry, texture, import, and performance issues across the art pipeline.

•
Standards and documentation: Define asset budgets, naming conventions, material and LOD guidelines, validation checks, and production documentation.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional technical art experience in games.

• Strong Unreal Engine 5 experience in asset integration, rendering, and production tools.

• Advanced knowledge of the Material Editor, master materials, material instances, and shader optimization.

• Strong understanding of lighting, shadows, geometry, texture memory, draw calls, shader complexity, and overdraw.

• Hands-on experience profiling and resolving performance bottlenecks in Unreal Engine.

• Experience with LODs, instancing, culling, and scalability settings.

• Hands-on Chaos Destruction experience, including Geometry Collections, fracturing, clustering, physics fields, and runtime optimization.

• Hands-on experience integrating and implementing VFX in Unreal Engine 5, including Niagara systems and runtime performance optimization.﻿

• Experience integrating art and visual systems with gameplay alongside developers.

• Working knowledge of Blueprints, HLSL, C++, or Unreal Engine editor plugins.﻿

• Experience with Unreal Engine's PCG framework, landscapes, and large-scale foliage.﻿﻿

• Able to work independently and collaborate with artists, animators, designers, and developers.

• At least one shipped game with a significant personal contribution.

• Fluent in written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• Experience with Houdini, and procedural pipelines.

• Knowledge of Maya and Substance Painter workflows, including topology, UVs, baking, and texture preparation.﻿

• Tool development and automation experience using Python, editor scripting, or similar solutions.

• Experience creating real-time VFX using Niagara, including weapon effects, explosions, abilities, and environmental effects.

• Experience evaluating and optimizing Nanite, Lumen, and Virtual Shadow Maps.

• Experience with RTS, strategy, or high-unit-count games.

• A passion for RTS games.

Who you are

• You understand both art and technology.

• You turn visual goals into reliable, scalable technical solutions.

• You balance visual quality, gameplay readability, and performance.

• You identify problems early and take ownership of solutions.

• You debug methodically, validate improvements through profiling, and communicate clearly.

• You build tools around the needs of their users.

• You collaborate proactively and welcome constructive feedback.

• You independently learn and introduce new tools, workflows, and methods.

What we offer

•
The Forefront of PC Development: Join one of Israel's few studios building a high-fidelity, hardcore PC strategy game in Unreal Engine 5.

•
Fully Remote: Work remotely with clear communication, personal ownership, and focused collaboration.

•
A Veteran Team: Work with experienced developers and artists who share a passion for RTS and high production standards.

•
Growth Potential: Expand your influence, ownership, and responsibility as the studio and Defcon Zero grow.

•
Direct Impact: Shape the game's visuals, performance, and production through your tools and technical solutions.

•
Collaborative Culture: Join a friendly, dedicated team committed to the professional standards needed to ship a top-tier game.

title: Motion Designer (UX/Interface)
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

You will design motion and animation for AI interfaces. In AI-driven products, motion is not decoration - it is how users understand system state, loading behavior, uncertainty, progress, and transitions between AI actions.

This role applies HCI thinking to motion design: helping users understand what the system is doing, whether it needs attention, and what is happening next.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Design motion and animation for AI product interfaces, including loading states, streaming responses, task progress, and system transitions.

•
Create motion that helps users understand what the AI is doing without requiring them to read long explanations.

•
Develop animation patterns for uncertainty, thinking states, waiting states, failure, recovery, and asynchronous AI processes.

•
Work with product and UX designers to define how motion supports feedback, confidence cues, and error states.

•
Build motion specs and prototypes that engineers can implement accurately.

•
Define and maintain motion design principles and a reusable animation library for AI surfaces.

•
Ensure motion performance is appropriate for real-time and latency-sensitive AI interactions.

•
Use motion to reduce confusion, not add decoration.

What You Will Need

•
Experience in motion design for digital products, with a portfolio showing interface animation.

•
Proficiency in After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or equivalent tools.

•
Understanding of how motion communicates system state, feedback, progress, and user guidance.

•
Ability to design animation that works within technical constraints of mobile and web.

•
Experience working closely with product designers and engineers.

•
Awareness of accessibility and performance considerations for animation.

•
Good judgment on when motion helps users and when it creates noise.

•
Curiosity about how motion can communicate AI behavior, trust signals, and uncertainty.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.
