title: Visual Designer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

Role

You will shape the visual language of ActAI's product. In AI applications, visual design must do more than look polished. It must help users understand dynamic content, system behavior, reliability signals, and complex AI-driven workflows.

This role supports HCI by making the interface clearer, more readable, and easier to trust.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for ActAI's product across web and mobile.

•
Create visual patterns that help users parse AI-generated content, distinguish system states, and understand confidence and reliability signals.

•
Design for information density and hierarchy in AI interfaces where content is dynamic, variable, and often uncertain.

•
Work with product and UX designers to translate interaction flows into polished, accessible visual designs.

•
Build and maintain a design system that supports speed, consistency, and clarity.

•
Define visual standards for error states, empty states, loading states, task states, and AI-generated output.

•
Contribute visual assets and design specs that engineers can implement accurately.

•
Make AI-heavy interfaces feel clear and structured without overwhelming users.

What You Will Need

•
Experience as a visual or UI designer with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

•
Strong skills in typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy.

•
Proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.

•
Ability to design for dynamic content where AI output varies in length, format, tone, and reliability.

•
Understanding of accessibility standards and how to design for legibility and contrast.

•
Comfort designing under ambiguity, with evolving product requirements.

•
Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

•
Awareness of how visual cues communicate AI system behavior, trust, and confidence.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Associate Director, Creative Strategy (Paid)
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

•
Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

•
Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

•
Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

•
Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

Responsibilities:

•
Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

•
Testing & Learning: Design the testing roadmap (what gets tested, in what order, against what hypothesis, and what a real win looks like before spend goes live.)

•
Copywriting: Own ad copy for US-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to funnel stage and threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy.

•
Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

•
Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

•
Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

•
Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

•
Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

•
5+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

•
A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

•
You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

•
You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

•
You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

•
You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

•
You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

•
Deep in Figma, including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

•
You've worked closely enough with designers and editors to know what your brief takes to execute. You're comfortable in Figma and , where you can pinpoint why a design or hook isn't working and give clear, actionable feedback.

Hard disqualifiers

•
No Meta performance creative ad experience.

•
No portfolio link or no performance context.

•
Hands-on production isn't required, but a strategy-only background won't be a fit, given the strategic and collaborative nature of the role.

•
Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

•
Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

•
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

•
Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

•
Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

•
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

•
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

•
Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $100,000-$120,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

You're not looking to just execute what someone else already figured out, you want to be in the room when the concept takes shape. If you've been pushing your design work past "good enough" and you're ready to grow into the person other people trust with a brand's visual direction, this is where that starts.

Lead art direction and execution of integrated campaigns across assigned pharma and healthcare brands, keeping every deliverable aligned to brand strategy and client objectives

Guide projects from concept through final production without letting craft or consistency slip

Push for better, exploring new creative approaches and technologies rather than defaulting to what's safe

What this role is not

This isn't a purely hands-off management role, you're still expected to have a strong point of view on the work itself, not just delegate it. And it's not an entry point into pharma advertising, you should already know how MLR and regulatory review shape creative before you walk in.

The environment

P10 is remote-first, always has been. This role is open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for Eastern time zone. You'll be working inside a structure flat enough that your creative vision actually shapes client work.

Interested in working with us? Apply online today. For this role, a copy of your work portfolio will also be required for later interview stages.

Not an agency*

The layer-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego-driven dog-and-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn't working—or could work better—change it. And that's exactly what we did. We know that what we're not makes us who we are. And we're not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.

P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different - join us.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience our members rely on every day across iOS, Android and web.

You'll own the moments that matter: onboarding, listing homes, finding and applying for sits, matching with the right sitter or owner, preparing for a stay. This is a hands-on role as the primary designer in your squad. You'll have real strategic influence over your area's direction and drive measurable impact for both our members and the business.

What You'll Do

• Design mobile-first experiences that work across iOS, Android and web, respecting platform conventions while staying consistent with our design system

• Own discovery research and testing for your squad (interviews, usability testing, concept testing) and measure impact using product analytics and qualitative signals to guide iteration

• Define problems and hypotheses with your squad, choose the right validation method to make sure we're building the right thing for our customers

• Design AI-powered features for matching, personalisation and communication with trust and transparency built in, and use AI tools daily to speed up exploration, prototyping and synthesis

• Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, user research, content, data and commercial teams, communicating design rationale clearly to stakeholders, facilitating workshops to create alignment and negotiating trade offs

• Contribute to and evolve the design system, partnering with Design Systems to create robust, accessible, cross-platform patterns

• Build solutions that scale. Map journeys and service relationships rather than solving problems in isolation, and champion craft and accessibility throughout

What you'll need

Strategy and systems thinking

Strong systems thinking with experience designing complex customer journeys end to end. Proven ability to set customer-centric vision and translate it into practical, phased delivery while balancing member needs with business goals and technical constraints.

Research and methodology

Hands-on user research skills, confident choosing methods and synthesising insight into clear design direction. Able to frame complex challenges into clear problem statements and testable hypotheses, with solid understanding of experimentation methods and when to use each.

Craft and execution

Exceptional interaction and visual design craft with meticulous attention to detail, including advanced prototyping and working within mature design systems. Deep knowledge of mobile interface guidelines and best practices, backed by a portfolio showing end-to-end, beautifully crafted, user-centred work with measurable impact on customer and business outcomes.

AI in design

Confident daily use of AI-assisted design and prototyping tools as part of your everyday workflow. You'll ideally be working in Cursor, Claude Code or similar for at least some of your workflow and you'll bring ideas of how AI tools can be used to drive efficiency and impact across the design process.

Collaboration and culture

Excellent communication and storytelling skills with comfort working in empowered, cross-functional squads. Experience in scale-ups with strong product and experimentation culture. You'll need to be confident in selling your ideas across the business, creating alignment and inspiring others.

Nice to have

• Experience designing AI/ML-powered features such as recommendations engines and LLMs with good understanding of the UX challenges they create - trust, comprehension, feedback loops, agency etc.

• Experience in two-sided marketplaces, subscription or membership businesses, or trust and safety-sensitive products.

• Self-serve analytics experience (we use Amplitude, Mode) and familiarity with research depository tools such as Dovetail, Chattermill.

Our hiring process

• Intro call with hiring manager

• Technical portfolio review with PM, Design lead and Engineering partner

• Leadership and first 90 days presentation

What you'll bring

You'll own the product design process end-to-end.

At TrustedHousesitters we start with the customer. You'll need to be able to show us how you've used quantitative and qualitative user research to inform your approach to solving product design problems.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

• Your design experience is web-only - you haven't shaped native iOS or Android app experiences.

• Your background is mainly B2B, enterprise, or public sector - you're used to solving problems functionally, and this role needs you to think about design emotionally too.

• You'd rather be handed a fully-scoped brief than help define the problem yourself - you'll be the primary designer in your squad, shaping direction, not just executing someone else's spec.

• You're sceptical of AI having a genuine place in the design process, or you actively avoid using AI tools in your own workflow.

• When you disagree with a decision, you tend to raise it and step back - we need people who'll stay in the room and help find the way through.

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

• Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family

• Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
year towards travel costs to and from sits

• Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💻 Working environment

• Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start

• Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

• Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

• 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)

description:
Position Summary:  

As a founding product designer of the newly formed Innovation team, you will build and ship solutions with real complexity and scale to tens of thousands of clients. You will also play a key role in foundational decisions about user experience, product, design systems, and business strategy.

This is a rare opportunity to build product at the 0 to 1 stage, and ship it immediately to scale. You will work directly with Will Peng, Chief Innovation Officer — a former founder of a fintech company that raised $40M and exited in 2025.

About Cerity Partners

Cerity Partners is the one of the largest and fastest growing independent financial advisory firms, managing over $160+ billion in assets under management, and over $1 trillion assets under advisement. We serve high- and ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families, business owners, and institutions with comprehensive financial planning, investment, tax, and retirement solutions.

Backed by growth capital from Genstar Capital, Warburg Pincus, and Lightyear Capital, Cerity Partners ranks in the top 10 RIA's in the country by Barron's. Founded in 2009, we are extremely entrepreneurial and feel we are still in the early innings.

Our mission is to make every client steadier than we found them. We measure ourselves not by what we deliver, but by whether the people who trust us are better for it. Advice, service, and care do not bend to compensation, affiliation, or convenience — and they do not bend to the size of the client. We uphold the fiduciary standard at its highest levels.

The Innovation Team at Cerity Partners

Cerity Partners' Innovation Team is the firm's center of excellence for the strategy and deployment of technology and applied AI.

We are combining the best of technology and professional services to build the future of financial services. We believe the biggest opportunity is in the application of AI to scaled, complex industries like wealth and investment management — to raise the bar for quality of service, in service to our clients.

This is a rare opportunity to join a generational company at a key inflection point. We are extremely ambitious and entrepreneurial, and approach innovation with a "blank sheet of paper" mindset — so there will be no shortage of exciting technical challenges to work on.

We approach every problem through the lens of experience and design, with the client at the center. Our team partners with colleagues across the entire business to understand workflows, and create cohesive experiences across the client, advisor, and colleague journey.

Our vision is to build the new OS of wealth intelligence. We are building the entire AI stack — harness, context, memory, evals, agents, models, workflows, data, knowledge — both in applying it to wealth management, as well as in how we work and collaborate with each other.

By fully leveraging the insights and institutional expertise of the firm, we will move the firm into a client-first, AI-native era.

Primary Responsibilities 

• Own the end-to-end experience: The Innovation Team is highly autonomous, and you will be responsible for full user journeys and business goals, not just a silo. You will have the opportunity to build both 0-to-1, as well as scale products post-launch.

• Build in partnership with clients, advisors, and colleagues: Identify high value opportunities, understand their needs and root problems, map workflows, test prototypes and hypotheses, and build and advocate for the best experience.

• Establish foundational product strategy and user experience: The decisions you make will be the foundation of our product, client experience, advisor experience, and colleague experience. These are decisions that can drive business strategy, goals, differentiation, and prioritization.

• Build at the cutting edge of applied AI: Work across every part of the AI stack — harness, context, memory, evals, agents, models — both in applying it to wealth management, as well as in how we work and collaborate.

• Define the standards of design: As a founding designer, you will have a blank slate to define how we design at Cerity Partners. This includes setting the overall design direction, prototyping and shipping to test hypotheses, defining how design collaborates with engineering and product, and creating the visual language and interaction models for experiences.

Required Qualifications: 

• Years of experience: Minimum of 7 years

• Financial services industry experience required - understanding of wealth management, investment advisory, or related financial services operations

• Demonstrated experience in AI tooling, models, harnesses, workflows

• Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity and building 0-to-1 products from first principles rather than established processes

• Expertise and experience with Figma, Claude Code, Codex, or similar

Skills and Competencies:

• You have a track record of outsized impact: Your impact extends beyond individual features. Your work has created broad, lasting results on the customer, your colleagues, and in the foundational systems that endure.

• You are a systems thinker: You are able to see the bigger picture and the patterns that emerge. You are able to consider decisions in the broader context, and know what are the most important factors to consider

• You have excellent product and business intuition: You know what decisions will have wide-ranging impact. You put experience and the user first. You know where to cut, and what is important.

• You lead with agency: You take initiative and move work forward independently. You navigate obstacles resourcefully while building the trust, alignment, and influence needed to mobilize others and amplify your impact.

• You move quickly with rigor: You have a bias towards action for learning. You balance speed and quality, demonstrating a high shipping velocity, rapid learning, and a hypothesis-driven approach.

• You thrive in ambiguity: You are energized by new, undefined, ambiguous spaces, and excel in shaping the right approach as the space changes quickly. You are humble and adaptable. You have a demonstrated record of creating and shipping real products—not simply operating within established systems. As a founding designer, you will help define the systems themselves.

• You are passionate about AI: You have experience building and shipping AI agents and harnesses. You stay close to emerging capabilities, continually experimenting to identify where they create meaningful opportunity.

• You do your best work when collaborating with others: You love working with cross-functional teams, connecting feedback, workflows, and downstream implications to make coherent decisions across the organization.

• You are comfortable with code: With the product-engineering-design collaboration process being redefined, it’s important that you are comfortable with code, and understand how your designs are handed off and implemented with AI-native processes. It’s not expected that you will write code, though that would be a big plus!

Compensation Range:

$177,000 - $260,000 (salary + bonus)

Why Cerity Partners:

Our people drive our success by working together to deliver exceptional service to our clients. Below is a glimpse of the key elements of our total rewards package:

• Health, dental, and vision insurance – day 1!

Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, equipment, and benefits.

This engagement will primarily focus on PowerClerk®, Clean Power Research’s configurable, no-code workflow platform used by utilities and energy agencies to manage complex energy programs. PowerClerk streamlines application intake, review, approval, and ongoing program operations in a secure, enterprise-grade system.

The role may also contribute to projects across the SolarAnywhere® family of products, which support solar resource assessment, performance monitoring, and forecasting. These products serve a wide range of analytical and operational use cases, requiring clear, usable interfaces for technically complex data.

Scope of Work

• Collaborate with Product/Program Managers and Engineers to understand user problems, product requirements, and constraints, and propose appropriate design solutions

• Deliver high-quality designs for new features and refine existing experiences

• Partner closely with multidisciplinary teams on the ideation and definition of new user experiences

• Follow a user-centered design process, delivering design artifacts with an appropriate level of fidelity and detail at each stage

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable design system components that support consistency, flexibility, and extensibility

• Contribute innovative ideas and deliver groundbreaking designs that shape the future of our products

• Transform complex concepts into engaging and intuitive user experiences

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in Product Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design or similar field

• 4+ years of experience in user experience design, with a strong emphasis on interaction design or similar role

• Portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, including navigation, user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and information visualization

• Clean, modern design aesthetic with strong attention to detail and a passion for simplifying complex experiences

• Experience designing complex, data-centric web applications, with a strong understanding of how to make them intuitive and delightful

• Fluency in UX best practices, including user-centered design, interaction design, and information architecture, grounded in strong UX principles and techniques

• Experience building and contributing to a shared design system, including defining component architecture and variant structure

• Ability to write clear component documentation that other designers and engineers can use

• Experience collaborating with engineers to ensure designs are implemented consistently and efficiently

• Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear user flows, information architecture diagrams, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes

• Experience working across multiple levels of fidelity throughout the design process, from low-fidelity wireframes to pixel-perfect design specifications

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and building and maintaining design libraries

• Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage work independently against agreed timelines

• Experience with planning and executing lightweight, rapid, iterative usability testing is a plus

• Passion for renewables and for advancing the transition to clean energy

Additional Notes

• The role does not include people management responsibilities

• The focus is on individual contributor design work and delivery of defined project outcomes

Contract Compensation

• Contract Engagement: Approximately 5 months

• Hourly Rate: $55–$70 (flat rate)

• This engagement is structured as an independent contractor (1099) role and does not include employee benefits

Please include a link to your portfolio and a cover letter detailing your interest in this position and the renewable energy space along with your resume.  Due to the large number of applicants for our positions, we regret that we can only respond to candidates who meet our requirements.

Clean Power Research provides equal opportunity for all contract engagements. All qualified individuals will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: UX Quantitative Research Intern (USA)
location: Remote, US; San Francisco, CA, US; Seattle, WA, US; New York, NY, US · Remote (United States)
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We’re looking for inquisitive, collaborative UX Quantitative Research interns to bring statistical rigor to product decisions. Partnering with mentors across product, design, data, and engineering, you’ll craft surveys, model attitudes alongside usage data, and translate complex findings into compelling narratives for our teams. Expect real projects, supportive teammates, and opportunities to shape Pinterest experiences that are impactful, inclusive, and meaningful for our Pinners.

What you’ll do:

• Influence and evolve our product roadmap to help us fulfill our mission - to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love - using data and exploratory analysis to understand user behavior and trends, and identify opportunities for product innovation.

• Use surveys to gather insights about Pinner, Merchant, Creator, or Advertiser sentiments and preferences using survey methodologies and statistical/modeling based approaches.

• Explore the intersection of user attitudes and behaviors by combining surveys and log analysis

• Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights.

• Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest.

What we’re looking for:

• This position requires current enrollment in a school or education program in which the individual is working towards a PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field

• Obtain PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field by June 2028

• Currently pursuing a PhD in statistics, psychology, sociology, applied sciences, computer science or related field.

• Experience with survey methodology, including experience developing surveys and analyzing survey data

• Demonstrated experience in descriptive, inferential, and multivariate statistics, and experimental design.

• Experience using Python, R, or SQL.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to tell a complete narrative using data.

• Ability to connect data analysis to real business problems, in order to impact business performance.

• May 17, 2027 - August 6, 2027

title: Senior Project Manager, Creative
description:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of our Creative & Media team based in Rotterdam and Amsterdam. Our team is a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, Brand & Content Strategists to Account Managers, Programmatic and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling and performance-driven strategies with cutting-edge technology to create engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Senior Creative Project Manager, you work closely with our major accounts and teams on a daily basis, running diverse creative projects from start to finish. You’re able to combine the best way of work for our creative teams and the briefed timeline of the client into a feasible workflow. Because of your knowledge and interest in the creative industry and its processes, you have an opinion that is respected and appreciated by both the customer and the internal teams.

You know exactly what our customers need, even if they don't explicitly ask for it. You are good at making schedules and monitoring budgets and you enjoy meeting or even exceeding customer expectations together with the team. You are the customer's first point of contact during projects, which means you have daily contact with them to update the progress of the project with them and foresee risks.

You feel responsible for bringing the project to a successful conclusion and coordinating the deliverables with the customer and the team. In short, you are the spider in the web who keeps the focus on getting our projects delivered, who does not shy away from deadlines, who can monitor overviews and budgets, and who can coordinate all of this with the customer.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Work on one of our biggest client teams, working with multiple team members such as creatives, strategists and technical specialists.

• Manage end to end creative projects (content creation, social, design, affiliate marketing, toolkits, 360 campaigns), you make sure qualitative work is delivered on time and within budget.

• Be the key contact for clients, an advisor who provides resources, and who addresses problems and solutions

• Tracking time and budgets. You’re able to forecast, flag and act when it comes to project and client financials.

WHAT YOU BRING

• At least 6 years of relevant professional experience in both project management and digital marketing;

• Experience on the agency side;

• Have experience and ambition to manage digital marketing projects within the creative field (content creation, organic social media, design, affiliate marketing);

• Experience and/or affinity with project management tools such as Asana, Trello, Jira;

• Have experience with A-brands and their digital performance issues;

• Located and available to start working either from our offices in Amsterdam or Rotterdam;

• Speak fluent Dutch and English.

WE OFFER

• A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.

• 24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.

• DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.

• Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• You can discover even more employee benefits here.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: Product Design Engineering Internship - 6 or 12 months  (2027 start)
description:
Introduction

Are you a curious and creatively minded individual studying product design engineering and looking for exciting and fulfilling experiences? Do you have creative flare and a passion for design for manufacture and assembly? Would you like to contribute to a wide selection of products for clients in the Industrial, Consumer, Energy and Defence industries?

You may be a graduate, or a candidate with a couple of years of industry experience. You can expect this role to include a mixture of desk-based and practical tasks.

Successful candidates can join us on a 6 or 12 month industrial placement.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Your role

The Realisation group is responsible for dynamic hardware development of products, in both high and low volume markets following the guiding principles of Design for “X” (DfX) with particular emphasis on design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA). The group operates from product conception and design all the way through to manufacture and product launch, often bridging the gap between novel technology and high volume manufacture. Our work spans a range of industry sectors, such as consumer electronic products, energy sensors and metering, sustainability and agricultural systems.

The Realisation group is home to some of the most talented and passionate design engineers in the UK, who bring together their collective knowledge and skills to deliver elegant technical solutions. Our projects often involve the development of novel manufacturing techniques and complex supply chain management.

Some examples of some of our more recent exciting and challenging projects we have worked on include:

• Collaborating with LEGO to develop LEGO® SMART Play™

• Scaling transformative metal organic framework innovation with Ahbstra

• Ouroboros - An Easily Repairable Smartwatch

What you’ll be doing

This is an excellent opportunity for a product design engineering student with the ambition and ability to achieve excellent results within highly demanding industries under tough commercial and time constraints. You will be using your design skills to contribute to product development projects with lots of support and guidance from senior product engineers; from initial idea generation through to the delivery and manufacturing support for market ready products. This may include:

• Taking part in concept generation and problem-solving workshops

• Preparation of detailed designs in CAD, from system to component level, using design for “X” (DfX) e.g. manufacture, cost, assembly etc best practices

• Contributing to the development of manufacturing solutions

• Manufacturing of parts and assemblies, hands-on or by liaising with suppliers

• Testing of designs to ensure they meet the client’s and end customers’ needs

What you can bring

• Demonstrate an excellent academic record, studying for a relevant engineering degree

• A successful Graduate Product Design Engineer in the Mechanics and Design Department will have the ability to:

• Communicate with peers and clients to understand their problems and present solutions

title: Principal Product Designer, Design Systems Lead
location: New York, NY (HQ), San Francisco, CA, Remote (US)
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

How we build software is changing. Designers are building tools and agents, prototyping in code, and shipping directly into the product. More people can create software than ever before. That makes design judgment more important, not less.

We’re looking for a Design Systems Lead to build that judgment into the foundations of Ramp.

This is not just about maintaining a component library. It’s about making it possible for designers, engineers, and agents to build experiences that look, feel, and work like Ramp—without a designer driving every decision or the design systems team reviewing every change.

You’re a designer first, with the technical depth to guide architecture and get into the code. You have exceptional taste and strong opinions about typography, hierarchy, interaction, and motion. Just as importantly, you know how to turn that judgment into patterns, tools, and guidance that make everyone else’s work better.

You’re deeply curious about AI and already using it to change how you work. You build, experiment, inspect the results, and push past the demo. You can imagine a different way of building software—and lead a team toward it.

This role is for you if you’re excited by:

 - Making great design reproducible. Raise the quality of Ramp’s product and encode what makes it good, so people and agents can produce coherent, usable experiences by default. The system should make excellent work easier, not make every experience look the same.

 - Reimagining what a design system can be. Build beyond components and tokens into composition, interaction patterns, agent guidance, and evaluations. Connect exploration and production so the fastest way to build is also a path to great quality.

 - Leading a team that multiplies everyone else’s impact. Create clear direction, ambitious goals, and a caring yet demanding environment. Inspire curiosity, develop people, and stay close enough to the work to help make it exceptional.

The opportunity is to raise the floor for everyone building at Ramp, while giving designers more room to make the most important experiences extraordinary.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and develop the design systems team. Set clear priorities, ownership, and goals. Give direct, timely feedback, hold people accountable, and help them do the best work of their careers.

 - Own the system’s vision and direction. Decide what to preserve, evolve, simplify, or replace based on what builders and customers need. Turn that direction into focused work the team can deliver.

 - Elevate Ramp’s visual and interaction design. Raise the bar for typography, hierarchy, density, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility, and the states beyond the happy path.

 - Make design judgment usable by people and agents. Translate principles into reusable patterns, reference experiences, composition rules, and guidance that produce better work without you in the room.

 - Guide technical architecture with engineering. Shape everything from components and tokens to how agents discover guidance, compose interfaces, and check their work. Make sound tradeoffs between flexibility, coherence, performance, and ease of use.

 - Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, work in code, and get into implementation details to test ideas, unblock the team, and understand where the system breaks down.

 - Define and measure quality. Build repeatable evaluations grounded in real tasks. Measure whether builders can ship better work faster, with less rework—not just whether they use the tools.

 - Improve the path from idea to shipped experience. Partner with engineering and AI teams on workflows that support fast exploration, useful iteration, and appropriate production safeguards.

 - Earn adoption. Work alongside product teams, listen closely, teach through examples, and turn recurring questions and exceptions into improvements to the system.

 - Keep the team moving forward. Experiment as models and tools evolve, share what you learn, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.




WHAT YOU NEED




 - Experience leading and developing strong design or design engineering teams, with a track record of setting direction and delivering meaningful outcomes.

 - Exceptional visual and interaction design skills. Your work shows a clear point of view, attention to detail, and an ability to make complex experiences feel simple.

 - Deep systems thinking and experience building systems that other teams actually adopt. You can show how your work improved both their speed and the quality of what shipped.

 - Strong technical fluency. You can prototype and build in code, understand front-end architecture, and work through implementation tradeoffs with engineers—not just hand off specifications.

 - Active, hands-on use of AI in your design and building workflow. You understand where it helps, where it fails, and how to improve its output rather than accept it.

 - Experience turning design principles into practical guidance, reusable patterns, and quality checks that work at scale.

 - Strong product judgment and a habit of staying close to the people using what you build. You connect system decisions to real workflows and customer outcomes.

 - The ability to create clarity in ambiguity, make decisions, give difficult feedback, and maintain momentum without losing the quality bar.

 - Curiosity that borders on obsession about how AI changes software and how we build it—and the ability to ignite that curiosity in others.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building agent-usable design guidance, generation workflows, or evaluations for design quality.

 - Experience building developer or designer tools that became part of other teams’ daily workflow.

 - Experience leading a major design-system migration or company-wide change in how teams build.

 - Experience evolving a system across platforms or connecting product and brand experiences.

 - Founder or early-stage startup experience.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
What we’re looking for

We are looking for an Industrial Designer to shape TwentyFour Industries’ physical products so function, usability, manufacturability and a recognizable product language reinforce each other.

You will turn rugged technical systems into coherent products that operators can understand, trust and use under real conditions. Your scope spans aircraft, ground-control equipment, accessories, transport, charging and other operator-facing hardware.

This role is for a hands-on designer who works closely with engineering from the beginning—using sketches, CAD, mock-ups, prototypes and field observation to improve the architecture, not decorate it after the fact.

The day-to-day

• Own industrial design across aircraft, ground-control equipment, accessories, transport, charging and operator-facing hardware.

• Translate mission context, operator workflows, environmental constraints and technical architecture into physical product concepts.

• Create sketches, CAD surfaces, mock-ups and functional prototypes to make design decisions early and tangible.

• Work directly with mechanical, electronics, RF, thermal, production and systems engineers so design improves the architecture.

• Develop a coherent design language across the portfolio, including form, material, colour, finish, labelling and physical interaction.

• Design for field use: gloved handling, visibility, setup speed, maintainability, transport, cleaning, damage tolerance and low-light operation.

• Support DFM/DFA, supplier discussions and the transition from prototypes to repeatable production.

• Use user observation, testing and failure evidence to refine designs; join field tests and demonstrations regularly.

• Balance speed, cost, ruggedness, signature, mass and manufacturability without losing product coherence.

• Create design documentation and specifications that survive engineering change and production scale-up.

You should apply if you

• Have 4+ years in industrial design for technical, rugged, mobility, robotics, aerospace, defence or professional hardware products.

• Have an excellent portfolio showing concept development through production, including constraints, trade-offs and physical prototyping.

• Bring strong CAD and visualisation capability plus hands-on model-making and rapid-prototyping skills.

• Understand materials and processes such as injection moulding, composites, machined parts, additive manufacturing and soft goods.

• Can work at startup speed, accept incomplete inputs and iterate closely with engineering.

• Bring low ego, strong judgement and a willingness to test designs outside the studio.

Nice to haves

•
Experience with UAVs, aerospace, defence, robotics or ruggedised field equipment.

•
Experience designing complete product families rather than isolated products.

•
Knowledge of human factors, maintainability, transport systems or field repairability.

•
Experience taking products through supplier selection, tooling, first articles and production ramp.

What we offer

•
Portfolio-level influence: Define the physical product language across aircraft and their wider operating ecosystem.

•
Design with engineering: Shape architecture, usability and manufacturability from the earliest concepts.

•
Real field feedback: See products used, test assumptions and improve designs from operational evidence.

•
Visible impact: Build products whose usability and physical coherence directly affect mission performance and trust.

title: Senior Web Designer, Growth
description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About this role

Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.

You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.

You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.

What you’ll be doing

• Experimentation: Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.

• Collaboration: Working with Growth, Self-serve, Brand, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to turn opportunities into clear, buildable experiences.

• Data and insight: Using user insights and funnel data to identify opportunities, define hypotheses, and measure impact.

• Product design: Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.

• Prototyping and systems: Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.

• Roadmap ownership: Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.

Must have experience

• Experience: 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.

• Growth mindset: A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.

• Experimentation: Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.

• Craft and taste: Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.

• Systems and brand: Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.

• AI fluency: Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.

• Ownership: Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.

Who this role is not for

This role is not for you if:

• You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.

• You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.

• You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.

• You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.

• You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.

• You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.

What success looks like

You’ll know you’re successful if:

• More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.

• You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.

• Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.

• You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.

• You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.

• You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.

Interview process

We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.

You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.

Ready to build something great?

If you’re excited by the opportunity to help existing businesses get more value from a self-serve product, and you have the craft, curiosity, commercial thinking, and autonomy to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

title: Creative Director (Copywriter)
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create a better future. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive ideas, services, and experiences that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns and growth for our clients.

Creatives at AKQA apply artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight, to create and bring to life powerful ideas that move the world. We collaborate at the intersections of diverse disciplines to expand the edge of possibility for our clients, ourselves, our industry.

As Creative Director (copywriter) at AKQA London, you will inspire and lead a team of creatives to craft compelling narratives that drive meaningful change. Through storytelling, innovation, and problem-solving, you will shape ideas that resonate with audiences and transform their experiences. Your role is to push the boundaries of innovative creativity, influencing the future of brand expression and engagement while inspiring some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies. You will support our dynamic studio, collaborating with ambitious local, regional, and global teams and clients. Your leadership will be essential in crafting work and culture that resonates not only within London but also across the EMEA region and with international audiences.

There will be the opportunity to learn and grow within a creative and technically advanced environment, with access to ongoing personal and professional development. At AKQA, we’re committed to your growth, as well as your wellbeing.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Deliver and inspire award-winning work from your team, influencing change through ideas, creativity, and innovative brand experiences across any channel.

• Consistently deliver a number of successful solutions and high-quality work to clients on time.

• Immerse within the client’s business. Identify, understand, and overcome commercial and internal challenges to inspire and deliver effective solutions that consider the holistic needs of the brand.

• Contribute to the strategic development of a well-defined creative brief and any additional briefing documents, speaking with clients directly where necessary.

• Contribute thought leadership and team leadership to the conversation of the Writing practice. This is particularly important in this time of AI writing. Have a POV on the place and importance of human crafted writing and its value to clients.

• Lead by example to help build an inspiring, fun, and high performing creative culture.

• Generate useful, usable ideas across all existing and emerging platforms.

• Continually develop practices and processes to inspire, innovate, and harness new ways of thinking - including the use of AI.

• Set creative direction and offer hands-on guidance throughout client team projects.

• Inspire clients with opportunities, growing partnerships organically through both ideas and successes.

• High level of internal and external client and team satisfaction.

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Learn new skills and stay abreast of technical and digital design developments, and successfully apply them to work practices to help improve processes and procedures.

• Display a cohesive understanding and execute principles that make innovative and effective digital communications, interface design, and interaction design.

• Select the most appropriate supplier for the required task. Successfully manage multiple suppliers, partners, and clients to ensure outsourced projects are creatively delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards.

• Oversee creation of award entries and case studies of key projects, ensuring they are distributed across the business to relevant people (e.g., client team, Business Development Director).

• Creatively lead new business pitches. Responsible for ideas and creative work, and competently present pitches.

• Develop strategies to build a climate of trust, openness, and respect; forge strong relationships to drive successful outcomes.

• Possess highly advanced writing skills to effectively present a point of view, using logic, fact, and a compelling storyline via any medium.

• Represent AKQA by delivering talks, connecting with new talent, and inspiring the next generation of creatives.

• Be hands-on from a design craft standpoint. The ability to use creative programs such as Adobe Creative Suite and Figma to a high level is essential, in addition to emerging AI tools.

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• Extensive experience working at an Associate Creative Director or Creative Director level in a similar agency environment with a background in Copywriting.

• Demonstrated creative success in leading collaborative multi-functional teams, including project planning, to winning a number of industry-recognised awards.

• Considerable experience of European and Global projects.

• Experience developing/leading client relationships.

• Curiosity and hunger to experiment with new creative tools and ways of working

• Proven track record generating new business.

• Exceptional information presentation (visual and written) experience.

• Experience in, and enthusiasm for, creating digital platforms and products from brief to delivery and beyond.

• Experience in side-by-side collaboration with UX and development teams and leaders.

• Expert knowledge of user interface, application, mobile, and responsive design, using the latest prototyping and design tools.

AKQA is committed to developing wellbeing and supporting our team's life choices. We provide an extensive range of benefits. To find out more, click here.

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
