title: Social Content Creative
description:
Budapest

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

If you’re a social-first creative who knows TikTok, META, YouTube and internet culture inside out, and loves turning strong ideas into brilliant content, we want to hear from you.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll develop, film and edit social-first content that connects with audiences, taps into culture and helps our clients stand out. Working across platforms including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, you’ll create primarily for organic social, with opportunities to develop and adapt creative for paid campaigns.

You’ll bring proven content creation experience and the confidence to take ownership of assigned briefs from concept through to delivery. That means developing original ideas, recommending an approach, planning content capture and delivering work that meets the brief, brand and platform requirements.

You’ll work closely with Creative, Strategy, Community, Account and Media colleagues, bringing your own perspective and judgement while drawing on specialist expertise. Senior creatives will provide direction and agreed check-ins, with the expectation that you can move your work forward independently, recognise when input is needed and raise challenges early.

Regularly appearing on camera is an expected part of this role. Your image, voice and likeness will feature in content created for clients’ organic social channels. Content featuring you may also be considered for paid media, subject to appropriate usage terms, approvals and DEPT® policies.

No two days will look the same. You might be leading a small content shoot, filming on location, creating something reactive from the office or collaborating on a larger production. Location shoots and travel are a genuine part of the role, so you’ll need to be comfortable working in different environments and travelling where required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Develop original social-first ideas: Interpret briefs and independently develop creative concepts that combine audience understanding, cultural relevance and each client’s brand objectives. Bring a clear recommendation on how ideas should come to life.

• Own content from brief to delivery: Plan, film and edit assigned content, taking responsibility for the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of your work, with agreed creative reviews and approvals.

• Plan and lead content capture: Own the creative preparation and delivery of smaller content shoots, including formats, shot lists, props and capture requirements. Collaborate with senior creatives and production colleagues on larger or more complex shoots.

• Appear on camera: Regularly feature in the content you create, bringing confidence, personality and an understanding of the client’s tone to presenting and other on-camera activity.

• Identify cultural and reactive opportunities: Proactively recommend relevant trends, conversations and emerging formats, bringing an original creative angle and sound judgement about what is right for each brand.

• Deliver strong platform-native craft: Apply confident filming, editing and storytelling skills to create effective hooks, narratives and formats. Adapt content thoughtfully for different platforms, audiences and client tones of voice.

• Develop and adapt paid social creative: Collaborate with Creative and Media colleagues on content for paid campaigns, developing variations in hooks, messaging, formats and calls to action that support the brief.

• Apply performance learnings: Work with Social, Strategy and Media colleagues to interpret results, identify creative learnings and recommend and deliver improvements to future content.

• Present and recommend: Confidently present ideas and work in internal and client conversations, explain your creative decisions and respond constructively to feedback. Flag changes that affect the agreed brief, timing or production requirements.

• Manage your creative workload: Balance planned activity with reactive opportunities, coordinate dependencies with colleagues and raise competing priorities or delivery risks early.

• Spot community-led opportunities: Identify interesting comments, conversations and community behaviours, suggesting creative responses or content opportunities for Community Managers to activate.

• Support junior colleagues: Share production skills, platform knowledge and constructive creative feedback, helping junior content creatives develop their craft and solve practical challenges. This does not include formal line management.

• Experiment and improve: Propose and test new formats, production techniques and creative approaches, sharing useful learnings with the wider team.

• Publishing, channel management, community management and moderation are not responsibilities of this role. You will contribute creative expertise while working with the colleagues who own strategy, media, account management and production responsibilities.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Proven experience creating social-first content for brands, agencies or established social channels, with a portfolio demonstrating both original thinking and strong execution.

• Experience delivering content against briefs, brand guidelines, stakeholder feedback and deadlines.

• Strong concepting skills, with the ability to independently develop relevant, entertaining ideas and explain why they will work for the intended audience.

• Confident hands-on filming and editing skills, with the ability to take content from initial idea through to finished delivery.

• Strong editing skills using in-platform features and tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent.

• A deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram and the wider social landscape, including platform behaviours, creators, online communities and emerging formats.

• Confidence and willingness to appear regularly on camera as part of your role.

• Experience planning and leading smaller content shoots, making practical production decisions and adapting when circumstances change.

• Strong social storytelling skills, including hooks, pacing, narrative and adapting tone of voice for different brands and audiences.

• The ability to use content performance and audience feedback to recommend creative improvements.

• Confidence presenting ideas, explaining creative decisions and working directly with clients.

• Sound judgement about when to move work forward independently, seek creative input or escalate a challenge.

• Strong attention to detail, organisation and the ability to balance multiple deliverables and changing priorities.

• The ability to share knowledge and give constructive, practical feedback to more junior colleagues.

• A proactive, collaborative and resourceful approach, with a continued appetite to learn.

• Comfortable travelling and working on location for shoots when required

WE OFFER

• Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.

• Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

• Dog-friendly office

• Hybrid working policy

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.

• Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Art Director / Senior Art Director
description:
Blue Matter is a strategic consulting firm serving the life sciences industry. With deep expertise in specialty therapeutics, particularly oncology and rare diseases, we help clients achieve commercial success across the lifecycle of their products, portfolios, and organizations. Market access is a core part of that work, helping clients navigate an increasingly complex access landscape. Through SALT Access, our integrated creative agency, we translate market access and commercialization strategies into compelling, effective multichannel marketing, design, and communications, with a focus on value and access messaging. Blue Matter, together with SALT Access, fosters an entrepreneurial culture and is committed to being one of the best places to work.

We are seeking a versatile, experienced, hands-on Art Director / Senior Art Director to join our growing agency team supporting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients.

This is a role for a driven, self-sufficient communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. In this role, you will actively contribute to day-to-day design execution across a range of formats and channels, and your primary responsibility will be to translate complex information into high-quality creative that is easy to understand, compelling, on-brand, and resonates with key audience segments, including payers, healthcare professionals (HCPs), formulary decision-makers, and organized customers.

From creative brief to final delivery, you will shape the look, feel, and visual storytelling of assets, ensuring they meet the highest creative and regulatory standards. You will collaborate closely with others as a key member of a small, cross-functional team, including content and account and strategic consulting teams.
Because we operate as a lean, high-growth agency, you will be expected to manage your projects and deliverables with minimal oversight — bringing established expertise, sound judgment, and the confidence to make calls independently based on solid, demonstrable experience.

Key Responsibilities

Design Execution & Production (primary focus)

• Execute hands-on design work across projects, making sound look, feel, and layout decisions within established brand and creative direction

• Design and build deliverables across multiple channels, including digital and dynamic/interactive materials, print deliverables, presentations, and other pharmaceutical and market access marketing materials

• Manage projects from brief to delivery — including layout, refinement, production, and final file handoff — ensuring accuracy and quality throughout

• Translate approved content and creative direction into clear, polished visuals that resonate with payers, HCPs, and other market access audiences

• Support broader creative team operations by wearing multiple hats, with a strong emphasis on hands-on execution in a lean, fast-paced environment

Creative Direction Support & Presentation

• Bring the Creative Director’s vision to life, upholding visual standards and consistently delivering polished, high-quality work

• Present design work and rationale internally and to clients with confidence and clarity

• Support new business pitches by producing polished pitch materials as needed

Collaboration & Team Leadership

• Collaborate closely with content strategists, copywriters, and account leads to ensure alignment between visuals and messaging

• Provide art direction and constructive feedback to junior designers and freelancers as needed

• Help create, maintain, and evolve internal brand visual standards, templates, and asset libraries

Quality & Compliance

• Ensure creative work adheres to client brand guidelines and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISI, fair balance, and references)

• Prepare files for medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) review, incorporating feedback while maintaining design integrity

Desired Experience and Skills

• Design Software Mastery: High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop), with expertise in Figma and PowerPoint

• Production Mindset: A true “doer” who takes pride in craft, moves quickly, and turns around high-quality, accurate files at volume

• Strategic Visual Translation: Demonstrated ability to translate strategy and content into visually compelling creative

• Regulated Industry Experience: Experience designing for regulated industries, ideally in pharmaceutical or life sciences marketing; market access experience is a plus

• Brand Stewardship: Proven experience working within and adapting brand guidelines, consistently executing on-brand work at a high visual standard

• Organization & Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills and a sharp eye for detail, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and timelines in a fast-paced environment

• Collaborative Communication: A clear communicator, enthusiastic collaborator, and team player who can contribute ideas, accept feedback, and refine work independently

Preferred Qualifications

• Design Experience: 5+ years in a creative or design-focused role; prior agency and pharmaceutical experience strongly preferred

• Portfolio Excellence: A strong portfolio demonstrating polished design execution and layout excellence across both print and digital formats

• Motion & Interactive Design: Experience with motion or interactive work (e.g., HTML5, video, banner animation) is a plus

• Presentation Design: Experience creating or refining high-quality presentation decks in PowerPoint

• New Business Exposure: Experience producing new business or pitch materials

• Market Access Familiarity: Familiarity with the market access space and prior pharmaceutical creative experience

• MLR Process Knowledge: Familiarity with the MLR process, including annotation and reference management

• Startup Agility: Previous experience in a startup or small agency environment where adaptability is key and everyone contributes beyond their job description

Compensation

• Base salary range: $90,000 - $130,000 depending on experience. Generous incentive compensation structure.

Benefits Package

• 401k - generous employer match with immediate vesting and financial planning resources

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage options effective day 1 of employment

• Flexible spending account (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Company paid insurances including Short- and Long-Term Disability and Life insurance as well as additional voluntary options

• Paid parental leave for all new parents

• Health & Wellness Benefit (e.g., gym memberships; $1000 reimbursement annually)

• Employee Assistance Program

• Generous paid time off including vacation, sick days, floating and company holidays

Blue Matter is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, ancestry, age (40 and over), sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), national origin, disability, marital status, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Praktikum Brand Strategy // Intern Brand Strategy (m/f/d)
description:
About Interbrand

Interbrand understands what it takes today to build the world’s most iconic brands.

To support our clients in an ever more complex and fascinating world, we have renewed our commitment to both common global standards and greater empowerment, experimentation and entrepreneurialism.

Interbrand is its people. We are a global team of highly diverse thinkers, makers and collaborators. We are proud of our heritage and often regarded as the university of branding. Over the past four decades, we have pioneered iconic work and invented many of the brand building tools that are now commonplace.

In collaboration with many of the world’s leading brands, we are pioneering the future of brand building. In a world where people’s expectations are moving faster than businesses, we give our clients the confidence to make Iconic Moves that create desire and utility, reshape the competitive landscape and drive extraordinary results.

The Interbrand Best Global Brands study/rankings are resources to our clients and the industry, providing proprietary data and insight for our role as client partner and commentator. We have published 18 books on brands and are often the reference point for university curriculum and professional associations. Today, through our own Academy, we aim to be the most impactful learning environment in the marketing world.

Our Behaviours

Our culture is informed by a set of behaviours we co-created as a business. Our behaviours give us space to experiment, permission to speak out, and a model of leadership that anyone in the business can adopt. Our behaviours are Lead with love, Be Brave, Listen First and Make it happen. We are proud of our behaviours. They make us, us.

LOCATION: COLOGNE, GERMANY

DEPARTMENT: BRAND SRATEGY

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: PAID FULL-TIME INTERNSHIP (6 MONTHS)

The Opportunity

At Interbrand, strategy is where insight meets possibility. As a Strategy Intern, you'll join our Strategy team for 6 months to learn how brands are built, positioned, and evolved. You'll collaborate on real client projects, contribute to strategic thinking, and develop your understanding of how brands create value and connect with audiences. Under the mentorship of experienced strategists, you'll help build the analytical and creative thinking that powers meaningful brand work.

What you’ll be doing

• Learn Interbrand's strategic methodology and approach to understand how we analyze brands and develop strategy that drives meanginful conversations with clients

• Learn how all disciplines collaborate to create iconic moves that can be measured in terms of brand value

• Support cross-functional project teams in building strategic concepts and brand thinking across a varying number of challenges. Specific tasks include e.g.

• Conduct benchmark analysis, trend-spotting, and competitive research to support the team in identifying insights.

• Help prepare client presentations and workshop materials

• Contribute ideas and perspectives in internal regroups and meetings

• Participate in client meetings and presentations, observing how strategy is communicated

What we’re looking for

As this internship is located in Germany within an international working context, we are looking for fluency in German and English.

Experience

You are in your final year of university or freshly graduated. You have a portfolio of previous work (e.g. university projects, previous internship work, personal projects) demonstrating strategic thinking, research, insights and range of thinking. You are an active follower of branding across various channels and can articulate what makes brands interesting.

Not a must, but a plus: You already bring some experience in brand consulting, strategic marketing, market research, or similar fields (internships, projects, or coursework welcome).

Relationships

You are collaborative and eager to learn from experienced strategists and peers. You are equally comfortable speaking up with ideas and perspectives and not afraid to challenge conventional thinking. Overall, you have proven to work well in team environments and actively seek opportunities to work with others.

Curiosity

Naturally, you unpick brands, marketing or advertising to stimulate your thinking. You are fascinated by the combination of strategy, creativity, and insight and eager to learn and explore different industries and brand challenges, as well as develop strategic thinking. You are interested in understanding the business and commercial side of brands.

Ownership

You can understand the importance of deadlines in a client service environment. You take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through, show initiative and reliability.

Communication

You can articulate ideas with strong evidence or references. You are open to and actively listen to feedback and capable to incorporate it into your work. You are comfortable presenting work in progress to peers in German and English.

Why Interbrand

For over 50 years, we’ve been shaping the world’s most iconic brands. We solve brand challenges through our Thinking & Making approach, combining Human Truth, Brand Economics, and Experience to help our clients make the moves that unlock growth and define what’s next.

We nurture a global community of thinkers and makers with the curiosity and confidence to create iconic work. Here, you’ll find transparent career pathways, on-demand learning, honest feedback, real collaboration across borders, and a culture that champions difference and wellbeing.

We don’t do ordinary. And we don’t expect you to either.

We are working through access barriers across our job site, so if you run into any issues and would like this information in an alternative format, or would prefer to apply via email, please send us a message at careers@interbrand.com.

World-leading brand experts,

title: Industrial Designer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Industrial Designer.

Your main responsibilities will be:

•
Generate and visualize design concepts and mechanical solutions for our future livestock hardware products, taking them from early ideas to production-ready models.

•
Design for manufacturing by cooperation with mechanical and manufacturing engineers.

•
Develop the design guidelines for industrial design in the company.

•
Contribute to field research on farms and ranches to observe livestock interactions, working conditions, and operator workflows to inform design concepts.

•
Design products that prioritize animal welfare, prevent injury, and ensure ergonomic, intuitive handling for farmers and agricultural technicians.

•
Partner with Product Management and UX design to translate user feedback, field research, and competitive insights into compelling, feasible physical product concepts.

We are looking for someone who has:

•
Bachelor or Master degree in industrial or product design.

•
Experience designing electro-mechanical products for volume manufacturing.

•
Excellent visualization skills on paper and with physical and digital models.

•
Creative problem-solving skills for complex design solutions.

We are looking for someone who is:

•
Motivated by working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

•
Structured with the ability to bridge the gap between user needs and design for manufacturing.

•
Motivated to facilitate workshops and creative sessions.

•
Comfortable working in an English-speaking work environment.

•
Drivers license and ability to travel abroad.

About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.

What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

About the Application

Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and our data protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you!

If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager Kjetil Grimsæth at kjetil@nofence.no.

title: Manager, Visual Merchandising, EMEA
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

ŌURA is seeking a Visual Merchandising Manager to lead the end-to-end execution of our retail display and fixture programs across the EMEA region. This role is responsible for ensuring a premium, cohesive, and on-brand retail experience across all points of sale — including key partners such as Currys, John Lewis, MediaMarktSaturn, Fnac Darty, Elkjøp and emerging regional and specialty accounts.The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on a creative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has exceptional project management skills, deep experience with large-scale retail fixture programs, and a proven ability to collaborate across internal teams and external vendors.

Location: London

What You Will Do:

Visual Merchandising Strategy & Execution

• Lead the planning, development, and implementation of Oura’s visual merchandising strategy across all retail partners in EMEA.

• Ensure a consistent, premium brand presentation across all in-store touchpoints — from permanent fixtures to seasonal and promotional displays.

• Manage the full lifecycle of display programs: design, prototyping, production, distribution, installation, and maintenance.

• Partner with Retail Channel Marketing, Brand, Product Marketing and Creative teams to translate marketing and brand objectives into physical retail experiences.

Retail Fixture Development & Program Management

• Collaborate with internal design team and external partners from concept through installation, ensuring designs meet cost, quality, and sustainability goals.

• Collaborate closely with third-party fabricators, logistics partners, and third party installation teams to deliver best-in-class retail displays on time and within budget.

• Establish and maintain robust processes for quality control, compliance, and fixture maintenance across all retail environments.

• Manage fixture rollout calendars, tracking progress, resolving issues, and communicating updates to key stakeholders.

Budget Management & Operations

• Own and manage CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to visual merchandising and fixture programs.

• Develop accurate cost estimates, manage purchase orders, SOWs and ensure fiscal discipline throughout all project stages.

• Identify opportunities for cost savings, efficiency, and scalability in the fixture development and deployment process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Retail Channel Marketing, Sales, Creative, Brand, and Operations teams to ensure retail environments align with business objectives and support key product launches.

• Collaborate with global counterparts to align visual merchandising standards and share best practices across regions.

• Support retail readiness for new product launches, ensuring all displays, fixtures, and materials are installed and live at retail on time.

Retail Compliance & Excellence

• Ensure fixture and brand compliance across all retailers, maintaining the integrity of the Oura brand experience at every location.

• Lead periodic in-store audits and partner with retailers or field teams to monitor compliance and execution quality.

title: Creative Director
description:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re hiring a Creative Director to bring Cyera’s brand to life across every campaign and every touchpoint where a customer, prospect, or employee meets us. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Marketing, you will be a key strategic leader of Cyera’s brand and a core creative voice on the marketing leadership team.

This is not an execution-only role. We’re looking for a creative leader who pairs strong visual instincts with strong writing, and who treats every campaign as a chance to tell a story people remember. You’ll partner closely with Design Studio, Integrated Marketing, and other functions across marketing to make sure Cyera’s brand shows up with the same craft and clarity everywhere it appears, and you’ll lead a small creative team that you’ll be expected to grow, in capability and in ambition.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Brand storytelling across campaigns. Turn Cyera’s positioning and messaging into campaigns that fuse strong visuals with strong copy. Define and build briefs that serve as a guide to make every campaign feel like one idea, carried consistently across every channel and format.

•
Creative direction for key touchpoints. Set the creative bar for the moments that matter most: launches, events, the website, sales collateral, social, and executive communications. Make sure the brand feels like one brand, wherever someone meets it.

•
Partnership with Design Studio. Work hand in hand with Design Studio to turn creative concepts into finished work. Bring clear direction, sharp feedback, and a point of view that raises the level of what gets made.

•
Partnership with Integrated Marketing. Sit alongside Integrated Marketing from the start of campaign planning, so creative is built into strategy rather than added at the end. Help turn campaign briefs into ideas that earn attention.

•
Creative team leadership. Lead, coach, and grow a small creative team across Copy and Video. Model the craft, help your team members develop into stronger creative thinkers, and build the bench for Cyera’s next stage of growth.

•
Brand stewardship. Act as a guardian of Cyera’s voice and identity across the company. Give partners across marketing, sales, and product the creative guardrails they need to move fast without losing consistency.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

• 10-12 years of creative experience, including time as an art director, creative director, or similar role, ideally at a B2B technology company or a category-defining brand.

• A portfolio that proves the partnership between visual and copy. You can point to campaigns where the idea, the design, and the words worked as one.

• Enterprise brand experience. You know how to make a serious, technical brand feel human and memorable without losing credibility.

• Hands-on craft. You can sketch a concept, sharpen a headline, or direct a shoot yourself, not just brief someone else to do it.

• AI fluency. You know how to define where and how AI tools fit into the creative process, using them to raise quality and velocity together rather than trading one for the other.

• Strong stakeholder management. You build trust with partners across marketing, sales, and product, and you know how to hold a creative point of view while navigating competing priorities.

• People leadership. You’ve hired, coached, and grown creative talent, and people want to do their best work for you.

• Collaborative range. You work well with design, marketing, and brand strategy partners, and you know how to hold a creative point of view without slowing a team down.

• Operating principles that match ours, push boundaries, own and act, elevate together, and a leadership style that matches ours, model, coach, care.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $190,000-$230,000.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

﻿BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

• Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement

• Competitive salary

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid holidays and sick time

• Health, vision, and dental insurance

• Life, short and long-term disability insurance

title: UX Designer, AI App
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

•
Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

•
Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

•
Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

•
Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

•
Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

•
Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

•
Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

•
Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

What You Will Need

•
Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

•
Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

•
Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

•
Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

•
Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

•
Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

•
Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

•
Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Sail is Stripe’s user interface platform and design system. We build the design language, components, tools, and front-end foundations that product teams use to create coherent, accessible, responsive, and high-quality experiences. Designers on Sail work closely with engineers and designers across Stripe to turn recurring product needs into durable solutions.

What you’ll do

With support from experienced designers and engineers, you’ll work on scoped components, patterns, guidance, and tools. This role is a good fit for a designer who cares deeply about visual craft, enjoys thinking in systems, and wants to understand how design decisions become production interfaces.

Responsibilities

• Design and refine user interface components, patterns, and foundations for use across Stripe products

• Create polished, coherent interfaces across interaction states, themes, and responsive layouts

• Partner with front-end engineers to understand constraints and carry designs into production

• Contribute to Figma libraries, prototypes, specifications, documentation, and examples

• Gather input from product teams, share work, and iterate based on feedback

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 2+ years of experience designing digital products

• A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design craft

• Experience using or contributing to a design system or component library

• Experience working with front-end engineers

• Working understanding of components, states, and responsive behavior

• Experience using artificial intelligence tools in day-to-day design work, with familiarity with large language models, agents, and reusable skills or workflows

Preferred qualifications

• Experience creating or maintaining user interface components or shared design libraries

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with experience using artificial intelligence and prototyping tools to build and evaluate interactive interfaces

• Experience designing native mobile interfaces for iOS or Android

title: Editorial Director, Brand & Creative Partnerships
location: US: SF, NYC, Seattle and Remote · Remote (United States)
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team brings together Content Marketing, Brand Marketing, Portfolio Product Marketing, Copywriting, Copy Editing, and Customer Marketing. We create coherent, distinctive stories about the businesses, technologies, and economic forces shaping the internet.

What you’ll do

We are hiring a senior editorial leader to help bring original stories and insights from Stripe–based on our data, expertise, and customer conversations–to a broader audience via media partnerships and other brand marketing channels. This person will be an exceptional editor, writer, and creative partner with strong instincts about what earns attention: an argument worth making, an unexpected angle, an elegant execution, or a piece of work that people genuinely want to share.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the leader of Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team. The role will spend most of its time shaping major external media partnerships, with the remainder split between helping with original editorial work and advising partner teams on new ideas and their execution.

Responsibilities

• Lead the editorial and creative direction for Stripe’s most important external media partnerships, including advertising content, research-led collaborations, and original editorial programs developed with respected publishers and creators.

• Develop work that feels native to the audience and editorial environment in which it appears—not generic brand messaging placed beside someone else’s work.

• Turn Stripe’s original data analyses, economic insights, customer stories, and more into content pieces that are clear, surprising, useful, and memorable–and that readers and listeners won’t want to skip over.

• Shape the full editorial process for partnership work: refining briefs, identifying the strongest ideas, directing creative development, and providing decisive feedback on drafts and final deliverables.

• Direct and manage agencies, external creators, and editorial partners as needed, working within existing partnership structures and commercial agreements.

• Write, edit, and materially improve high-stakes content across formats, including blog posts, newsletter segments, podcast scripts, ad copy, social posts, and more.

• Generate original concepts for creative programs, editorial franchises, and nontraditional formats that broaden how Stripe contributes to conversations about the internet economy.

• Serve as a trusted thought partner to teams across Stripe, helping them clarify ideas, find the strongest expression of their work, and make better creative decisions.

• Partner with colleagues in Brand Marketing, Brand Design, Content Marketing, Portfolio PMM, Copywriting, and Customer Marketing to make Stripe’s storytelling more coherent and distinctive.

• Define and uphold a clear quality bar for editorial and partnership work, making well-reasoned calls about what is ready to represent Stripe and what still needs improvement.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with exceptional editorial judgment and a demonstrated ability to make complicated ideas compelling. You may have developed that experience in a newsroom, independent publication, creative studio, agency, research institution, technology company, or another rigorous creative environment.

• You have 8+ years of relevant experience in editorial, writing, creative development, journalism, publishing, media, brand strategy, or a closely related field. This may include experience writing consistently for a large online followership, even if not professionally.

• You have an exceptional portfolio of published or public-facing work that demonstrates strong writing and editing, original thinking, and an ability to make ideas resonate with an audience.

• You are, in the best sense, very online: an active reader of and contributor to the newsletters, social platforms, and niche communities where people debate new ideas about technology, economics, science, business, and culture. You can spot emerging arguments, voices, and formats early—and engage with them authentically, with intellectual honesty and your own point of view.

• You are an excellent editor. You can diagnose what is missing from a draft or idea, identify the most interesting argument, and give feedback that makes the work materially better.

• You have experience developing original editorial work, sponsored media, advertising, creative partnerships, or other high-quality audience-facing programs.

• You understand the difference between work that is merely on-message and work that is genuinely interesting, useful, or worth discussing.

• You can translate complex subjects—including technology, business, economics, science, or policy—into work that is accessible without becoming simplistic.

• You have strong creative instincts and a sophisticated design sensibility. You understand how language, ideas, visuals, format, and distribution work together.

• You are deeply curious about the technology industry and the broader cultural and economic context in which it operates.

• You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, external partners, writers, designers, marketers, and agencies without relying on formal authority.

• You can move fluidly between strategy and execution: developing the core idea, shaping the brief, improving the draft, and making the final call on quality.

• You have high standards, sound judgment, and enough pragmatism to help teams make excellent work within real constraints.

Key product visuals. Design the visual assets that carry our product marketing: campaign visuals, feature launches, social and web assets, with a consistently high bar for craft.

What we are looking for

 - Visual craft. Strong skills across key visual design, with an eye for layout, typography and hierarchy.

 - Production experience. Hands-on experience planning and running photo or video shoots, including studio setups.

description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to lead design across the Content and Localization teams on our Build pillar. You’ll help shape Source by Webflow https://webflow.com/blog/introducing-source-by-webflow, our new platform where marketing teams and agents build and optimize digital experiences together. Source is where the hard work of web marketing happens: scaling what works, driving impact with every iteration, and keeping brand and content consistent as teams and agents move at speed.

You'll own the Agentic CMS experience: a next-generation content layer that enables enterprise teams to manage content and deliver it across every site, channel, and AI agent they operate. This work spans the full content lifecycle, from authoring and governance to localization and publishing. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, sweats the details, and gets excited about making complex content infrastructure feel simple — so marketers can move fast, agents can operate reliably, and every experience a brand ships stays coherent and on point.

As a Staff Product Designer you’ll …

Define how enterprise marketing teams author, organize, govern, and publish content across multiple sites and channels — and how that experience holds together as a coherent system, from the visual authoring surface to publishing workflows to localization.

 - 7+ years of product design experience with a portfolio showing recent, substantive work navigating ambiguous problems within complex products. You know how to make something complex feel obvious to the people using it. Experience with content systems, multi-user workflows, and agentic experiences is especially relevant. 

 - Systems thinking at scale. You've designed for interconnected surfaces where decisions in one place ripple across others, and

title: Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer, Learning & Inclusion
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.

You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.

What You'll Do

• Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.

• Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.

• Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.

• Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.

• Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.

• Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.

• Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.

• Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.

• Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.

• Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

• Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.

Who You Are

• You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.

• You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.

• You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.

• You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.

• You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.

• You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.

• You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.

• You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.

• You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.

• You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.

• You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.

• You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Where You'll Be

• This role is based in London or Stockholm

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. title: AI Researcher – 4D Reconstruction (Contractor)
description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

•
Staying customer-centric,

•
Inspiring dedication,

•
Persevering,

•
Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

As an AI researcher, you will be part of the team, delivering algorithms inspired by the human visual system. In particular, you will be working in 3D and 4D reconstruction, developing prototypes applying research ideas to real-world problems. The role has the opportunity for involvement in other areas within the group such as; power-saving rendering techniques, motion perception modelling and video quality metrics.

Key Responsibilities:

· Design, implement and evaluate novel algorithms for 3D and 4D reconstruction. Explore compression techniques for 3D and 4D scenes.

· Translate successful research into working prototypes, optimising both the runtime and power consumption of the techniques.

· Characterise trade-offs between different reconstruction algorithms, including model size, training time, rendering time, rendered quality and novel view generalisability.

· Develop metrics for quality of 3D and 4D reconstructions, based on the principles of vision science and human visibility.

· Be collaborative with researchers within the group, researchers and engineers elsewhere in the company, as well as with external researchers in universities, and other labs.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Required:

· PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, with 2+ years of relevant industry or post-PhD research experience or Master in related field, with 5+ years of industry experience.

· Demonstrated expertise in 3D/4D reconstruction, novel-view synthesis or Gaussian splatting. First-author publications in top-tier venues (NeurIPS, CVPR, SIGGRAPH, etc.) or industry experience in these topics.

· Knowledge of human-inspired image/video quality metrics.

· Strong programming skills in Python.

· An in-depth understanding of the deep learning approaches and working experience with machine learning framework/packages (e.g, PyTorch).

Desired:

· Background knowledge of video compression techniques and standards such as HEVC.

· Familiarity with GPU programming such as CUDA.

· Knowledge of vision science, e.g. motion perception, colour science or contrast sensitivity.

Personal Attributes

· A passion for overcoming applied research challenges, strong problem-solving abilities and distinct skills to quickly acquire expertise in new areas.

· Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, research-driven environment with ambiguous, evolving objectives.

· Proactive team player who is also capable of working independently.

· Positive attitude in working & learning and actively seeks to share ideas and information with colleagues.

· Proven ability to work under own initiative, and to seek advice when required.

· Good communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
The creative minds at AKQA apply artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight, creating beautiful ideas, products and services that move the world. As a design and innovation company (part of WPP), we lead change from our Swedish studios with clients including Volvo Cars, Polestar, H&M, Netflix, Nike and Minecraft. We are growing our product design team, and we are looking for a Senior Product Designer of exceptional craft and product judgement — someone who designs products that are beautiful, useful and meaningful, and who is fluent in leveraging modern, AI-augmented workflows to accelerate how those products are built.

You will own product design end to end, from concept to delivery, for some of the world's most influential brands. You will work where the prototype is a primary medium, using modern tooling to test ideas fast and raise the quality bar. Whether designing tightly curated digital products or adaptive, AI-enabled experiences, you understand that when interface design risk becoming commoditized, the true differentiation lies in connecting exceptional strategic execution to exceptional taste — and that is the standard we hold.

Role requirements:

• Lead product design end to end — concept, interaction, UI, usability, accessibility — to the highest standard of craft.

• Set and hold the quality bar across typography, layout, motion, micro-interaction and visual systems.

• Connect design decisions to product strategy and business outcomes — shaping not only how a product looks and works, but what is worth building.

• Treat prototyping as a way to think, validate, and deliver — moving swiftly from concept to functional, high-fidelity prototypes (leveraging Figma, Code Connect, and modern AI/developer workflows like Cursor, Claude, or similar where they add speed and depth).

• Build and evolve scalable design systems — crafting tokens, components, and semantic structures that bridge design and engineering effectively.

• Design for modern interaction paradigms — equally comfortable crafting classic, highly polished user interfaces as well as adaptive, generative, or AI-powered experiences.

• Translate research, behavioral data, and category insights into confident product direction and defensible rationales.

• Run workshops and co-creation sessions with clients, framing complex problems and inspiring confidence in new approaches.

• Mentor and guide other designers, raising the craft, product judgement, and modern tool fluency of the wider team.

Qualities and Characteristics:

• 5+ years (as a guide, not a restriction) designing stand-out digital products from strategy to delivery, with a portfolio demonstrating real-world impact and commercial results.

• World-class craft across UI and UX, with mastery of Figma, design systems, component thinking, and a sharp eye for motion and micro-interaction.

• Pragmatic tool fluency — hands-on with modern design, prototyping, and AI workflows, with the discernment to know where tools add value and where human craft and taste must lead.

• Strong product and commercial acumen — fluent in user value, business objectives, and the metrics that connect them.

• A strategic systems thinker who understands that differentiation comes from uniting rigorous execution with exceptional aesthetic taste.

• Technical literacy to reason about how design becomes code and to collaborate seamlessly with engineering in agile environments.

• An outstanding communicator and storyteller who earns the trust of senior clients and leads multidisciplinary collaboration.

• Genuinely curious about human behavior, business context, and the ethical/trust implications of modern, AI-powered products.

• Please include a portfolio link with your application; we are unable to consider applications without examples of your work.

We believe great work happens when we're together, so we work to a hybrid approach including required in- office days at our Gothenburg or Stockholm studio. Our working language is English; Swedish is welcome but not required. If you need accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Job Summary

INDUSTRIAL DESIGNER — SMARTPHONES, WEARABLES & ACCESSORIES HUAWEI LONDON DESIGN STUDIO

We're a small team designing premium consumer technology. Recent work includes the Mate XT triple-foldable, the Mate 70 RS Ultimate Design and our high-end watches. We're looking for another designer to help shape what comes next.

Key Responsibilities:

THE WORK

We work across two kinds of projects, and the balance between them is part of what makes this role interesting. Roadmap projects define the shape, aesthetics and materiality of existing product categories, phones, wearables, earbuds and more. Here the technology, segment and launch date are usually already fixed. Our job is to design what the product should stand for, how it should look and why anyone would want it over the alternatives.

Innovation projects are more open, helping shape the future of new tech devices. This means undersand cultural and psychological attitudes and trends, working closely with engineers on emerging technologies, and using design intuition to fuse it all into new products and product categories for changing times.

It's a rare balance: work that goes into production and has a direct impact on people's lives, alongside the space to rethink what tech devices are and how people actually use them.

Our ambition is products made in millions that still feel like individual objects. Proportion, surface, colour and finish are central to that thinking from the beginning.

We work both as a team, running workshops, sharing references, developing ideas together, and individually, where you'll lead your own projects and need the confidence and drive to take them from research through to detailed models, with support from London colleagues and reviews with our teams in China.

Proposals move fast and develop through selection. Not every idea reaches production, but our team has a record of getting designs into people's hands.

You'll be able to travel to China to meet the team there, see how factories manufacture and validate mockups as projects develop, a chance to build a real understanding of Asian culture along the way.

THE TEAM

Around seven of us, mostly industrial designers, working alongside teams in China. We share references, discuss proposals, help each other resolve details and eat lunch together. We appreciate people who bring a point of view, listen carefully and can work through a disagreement constructively

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Person Specification:

YOU

Creative, with a genuine curiosity about the world and how things are made. You follow your intuition and you're passionate about design and technology. Your background might be consumer electronics, accessories, footwear, furniture or automotive. We're interested in how you see things and the quality of what you make. You should be able to develop your own designs in 3D. Excellent use of CATIA or Rhino, the Adobe Suite, and visualisation tools such as Blender or KeyShot.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

The role is an agency contract (Full Time Position), but we are recruiting with a long-term view. Studio-based in London with occasional home working. You need to already be UK-based with the right to work here and be able to commute to the studio. We work in English.

APPLYING

Please send us a portfolio of work. Show us your strongest ideas, your visual judgement and enough of the reasoning to see how you got there. Please say what was yours on collaborative projects. A short introduction is welcome. No cover letter needed. Designers in our London team review every portfolio. Applications without a PDF portfolio will not be considered, as our systems don't reliably support external portfolio websites.

title: Head of Design
description:
OUR STUDIO

At Housemarque, we believe gameplay always comes first. With technical excellence and compelling narrative, spiced with our trademark neon flair and top-notch audiovisual feedback, we want our players to always feel actively engaged with the worlds we have created for them.

Our award-winning game Returnal, released on PS5 in 2021, and Saros, released in 2026, embrace all these qualities. THIS is our DNA!

We value Nordic work-life balance by growing sustainably and ensuring our employees have the time and means to develop personally and professionally during work time.

We were established in 1995 with strong roots in the Finnish demoscene. In June 2021 we joined the PlayStation Studios, after years of partnership.

If you wish to join us for our next journey, apply today!

The Job

Want to help shape the future of Design at Housemarque, the award-winning PlayStation studio behind Returnal and SAROS?

We’re looking for an experienced design leader to provide strategic leadership for Housemarque’s Design craft. You’ll shape how our design discipline grows and evolves, building the environment, structures and capabilities that enable exceptional designers to create genre-defining action experiences.

Working closely with Creative Directors, Game Directors and Design leadership, you’ll ensure our teams have the people, tools, processes and shared practices they need to bring ambitious creative visions to life. While our project leaders set the creative direction for our games, you’ll focus on building a world-class Design craft capable of delivering against that ambition.

You’ll have an impact across the entire studio: developing our design leaders, growing and retaining exceptional talent, evolving how our designers work together, and defining a long-term strategy for the discipline as Housemarque continues to evolve.

What you will do

•

Define and drive the long-term strategy for Housemarque’s Design craft, ensuring the discipline evolves alongside the ambitions of our games and studio.

•

Lead, coach and develop Design Leads and other senior design talent, building strong leadership capability and succession across the craft.

•

Own the growth and health of the Design organisation, including hiring, onboarding, performance, career development and retention.

•

Establish and evolve shared design principles, best practices and quality standards, creating a common language that enables designers to collaborate and make confident decisions.

•

Champion the tools, workflows and processes that enable designers to work effectively, removing unnecessary friction and continuously improving how the craft operates.

•

Partner with Creative Directors, Game Directors and Design leadership to understand the needs of our games and ensure the Design craft is equipped to realise their creative ambitions.

•

Collaborate with other craft leaders to strengthen cross-disciplinary ways of working and build a highly collaborative studio environment.

•

Represent Design in studio-level planning, balancing talent and resources across teams, projects and development phases.

Who you are

•

You have extensive experience leading and developing design teams within AAA, PC / Console game development environments.

•

You are an experienced people leader with a strong track record of coaching senior designers and Design Leads, building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.

•

You have a deep understanding of game design principles and can contribute meaningfully to high-level design discussions across multiple design disciplines.

•

You understand modern game development pipelines, tools, engines and production workflows, and how Design works effectively alongside Art, Code, Production and other disciplines.

•

You can think beyond the needs of an individual project, translating studio ambitions into a clear long-term strategy for the Design discipline.

•

You know how to balance creative ambition with production realities and can help teams navigate complexity, ambiguity and competing priorities.

•

You are a highly collaborative and empathetic communicator who builds trust across disciplines and levels of seniority.

•

You influence through expertise, judgement and the quality of your thinking, creating alignment rather than relying on hierarchy.

Bonus points

•

Experience leading a Design discipline across multiple projects, teams or development phases.

•

Experience scaling or transforming a Design organisation, including establishing career frameworks, craft standards or new ways of working.

•

Experience working on high-quality action, action-adventure or systems-driven games.

•

Experience within a first-party studio or another environment involving significant cross-studio collaboration.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Housemarque is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to a culture of inclusion and mutual respect for all employees from every walk of life, reflecting the community we make games for. We welcome and encourage applications from all suitable candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race and ethnicity, religion or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity.

title: Senior Visual & Motion Designer
description:
About the Position

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on Senior Visual & Motion Designer for a consultant assignment to join our UX team in Lund, Sweden. This role requires a mix of solid design craftsmanship and modern workflows. While we use AI tools to speed up prototyping and asset production, core design skills and pixel-perfect precision are still essential. This is especially true when creating completely new product concepts and features where AI tools cannot help because the ideas do not exist yet. You will work with the team from start to finish, taking full responsibility for the final UI and visuals. You need to know when to use AI for efficiency and when to do the manual work yourself to deliver high-quality, mass-market products for both China and international markets.

Job Responsibilities

• UI & Visual Ownership: Partner with the team from project start to completion, taking full responsibility for the final UI, visual assets, and motion design. • Smart Workflow Execution: Balance your day-to-day work by using AI to generate designs quickly, while focusing your energy on evaluating, polishing, and guiding the final output.

• Designing New Concepts: Lead the visual design for completely new ideas and features where AI cannot assist, using core design principles to build new visual systems from scratch.

• Independent Decision-Making: Drive complex projects forward on your own. Make quick, daily design choices to keep projects moving and ensure deliverables are ready for production.

• Seeing the Bigger Picture: Evaluate how your visual solutions and prototypes fit into the broader product ecosystem and business goals.

• Research Integration: Translate user research findings directly into clear visual and interface designs.

• Mass Market Awareness: Design for a global scale, with a clear understanding of what works for mass-market consumer products both in China and internationally.
