title: Senior Systems Engineer – Combat Aircraft (Security)
description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

Helsing's CA-1 programme is building the software-defined intelligence layer for one of Europe's most advanced combat aircraft. As a Senior Systems Engineer specialising in Product Security, Cryptography and Cyber, you will be responsible for defining and governing the security architecture of the entire platform — from the requirements that shape hardware and software design, through to the compliance artefacts that satisfy national and NATO authority expectations.

This is not a role confined to policy or paperwork. You will develop the aircraft security concept from first principles, own the design of intra- and inter-vehicle communication security, and lead Helsing's approach to platform-level cryptographic management, including functions such as erase and zeroise. You will work directly with customers — requirements workshops, technical reviews, solution showcases — and with German national security authorities, making professional fluency in German an operational necessity. The candidate who will thrive here brings a rare combination of systems engineering rigour, deep cryptographic and cyber knowledge, and the ability to translate complex security requirements into engineering reality on a programme that genuinely matters.

The day-to-day

• Guide hardware and software design teams through security requirements specification and architectural decisions, ensuring compliance with national and NATO-level security regulations across the CA-1 programme

• Develop and own the aircraft-level security concept, derived from applicable rules, regulations and standards, and maintain it as the authoritative reference across the programme

• Define and implement engineering design processes applicable to product security, establishing repeatable, auditable workflows that can scale with the programme

• Create and maintain the compliance artefacts required by national and NATO security authorities, ensuring Helsing's security posture is demonstrable and defensible at all stages of delivery

• Design the security architecture for intra- and inter-vehicle communications, covering both on-board and off-board interfaces across the platform

• Develop the design concept for aircraft-level security functions, including erase and zeroise, ensuring operational integrity under all mission conditions

• Conduct vulnerability analysis and adversarial testing on platform systems, translating findings into actionable engineering mitigations

• Define the platform cryptographic management concept, including crypto key management architecture and lifecycle processes

• Engage directly with defence customers — including the Bundeswehr and other national authorities — to capture requirements, present solutions, and represent Helsing's security engineering capability with authority

You should apply if you

• Have designed and delivered end-to-end security architectures for military or defence-grade systems, spanning requirements, system design and compliance evidence

• Understand and can apply NATO security standards and national-level regulations — including relevant STANAGs and German national security frameworks — to engineering programmes

• Have developed cryptographic management concepts for complex platforms, including crypto key management design and lifecycle governance

• Have conducted structured vulnerability analysis and adversarial threat assessments on safety- or mission-critical networked systems

• Have defined communication security designs for intra- and inter-platform data exchange in a defence or government context

• Are professionally fluent in German, with the ability to engage with national security authorities, regulators and customers in technical and formal settings

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with IFF systems and their associated security and certification requirements

• Experience designing erase and zeroise functions at aircraft or platform level

• Background in airborne mission systems or avionics security, including familiarity with DO-326A / ED-202A

• Exposure to Common Criteria evaluation processes or equivalent assurance frameworks

• Experience supporting security authority interactions as a named security engineering lead

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

•

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

•

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

•

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

•

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

•

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

•

Competitive salary and VSOP options

•

Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

•

Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

•

Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

•

Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

•

Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

•

Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

•

A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Associate Design Director, Product
description:
At AKQA Amsterdam, we use creativity to help brands and businesses move forward, from stories and identities to products, services and experiences. We follow the idea wherever it takes us, bringing different people and disciplines together to make it real.

As an Associate Design Director, you help shape how brands come to life through digital experiences. You combine strong design thinking with exceptional digital craft, turning ideas into interfaces, interactions and systems that feel intuitive, distinctive and unmistakably part of the brand. Your depth is digital, but you understand brand, UX, motion, behaviour and technology, and work closely with experience and service designers to make the work stronger.

You design by doing. You’re as comfortable shaping an experience as you are getting into Figma, building a prototype or defining a design system. You use AI naturally to explore possibilities, improve how you work and make the systems you create more effective. Working closely with our Design Director and Creative Director, you bring a distinct point of view to the studio, raise the craft of the work and help the designers around you grow.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Lead the digital craft. Establish and own the design direction across digital products, services and experiences, bringing exceptional UI and digital craft from early thinking through design, prototyping and implementation.

• Shape the experience. Contribute strong ideas to products, services and experiences, helping turn brand, business and human needs into something useful, distinctive and compelling.

• Bring brands to life. Translate what makes a brand distinctive into interfaces, interactions, motion, behaviours and systems, ensuring the experience is as considered as the identity behind it.

• Design by doing. Work hands-on in Figma and contemporary prototyping tools, making things early and often to explore ideas, test interactions and show what an experience could become.

• Understand the experience. Bring a strong understanding of UX and human-centred design, working closely with experience and service designers to challenge assumptions, shape journeys and connect creative ambition with how something needs to work.

• Build smarter systems. Create and evolve scalable, brand-led design systems, using components, tokens, automation and AI to make them more coherent, adaptable and efficient to use.

• Use technology creatively. Make AI a natural part of your workflow and actively explore emerging technologies, using them to generate, prototype, test and uncover new possibilities for the work.

• Lead together. Bring designers, creatives, strategists, experience designers and technologists around a clear vision, knowing when to lead, when to challenge and when another discipline should take the work further.

• Raise the standard. Take responsibility for design quality from first thought through implementation, staying close to the work while mentoring more junior designers through feedback, collaboration and example.

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• A digital craftsperson. You have an exceptional eye for interface design and a deep understanding of the typography, interaction, motion and details that make digital experiences feel intuitive and distinctive.

• A strong design thinker. You can contribute to the idea as well as its expression, understanding the bigger opportunity behind the thing you’re designing.

• A maker at heart. You stay close to the tools and would rather make something tangible than spend too long describing it. Figma is second nature, and prototyping is part of how you think.

• A systems thinker. You can move between an individual interaction, the journey around it and the larger system behind it, understanding how each affects the experience as a whole.

• A generous sparring partner. You understand UX and experience design well enough to ask good questions, challenge thinking and make the work stronger without needing to be the expert in every discipline.

• Technically curious. You understand enough about technology to see possibilities in it, work closely with the people building the experience and experiment when you want to know whether something can work.

• AI-native in your approach. You actively use AI to make your process and output better, while remaining curious about how intelligence itself can become part of the products, experiences and systems you design.

• Versatile by nature. Digital is your depth, not your boundary. You can contribute across brand, product, service and experience and understand how they connect.

• High standards, low ego. You care deeply about quality, communicate your thinking clearly, invite other perspectives and invest time in helping less experienced designers become better.

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Senior Art Director
description:
At AKQA Amsterdam, we use creativity to help brands and businesses move forward. Sometimes that means telling a better story. Sometimes it means designing a new experience, creating a new identity or imagining something that didn’t exist before. We follow the idea wherever it takes us, bringing different people and disciplines together to make it real.

As a Senior Art Director, you take ownership of ideas and the worlds they create. You find compelling ways into complex briefs, establish the creative and visual approach, and take responsibility for developing an idea from first thought through to final expression.

You think beyond the immediate ask, exploring what an idea could become and bringing the right people together to make it better. You bring a distinct point of view while making space for other perspectives, and know when to protect an idea, when to evolve it and when to find a better direction.

Your judgement raises the standard of the work, your direction creates momentum, and your craft makes ambitious ideas real.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

• Own the idea. Take responsibility for ideas within a brief, driving them from first thought through final execution while protecting what makes them strong as they evolve.

• Find the opportunity. Find compelling and unexpected ways into complex problems, looking beyond the immediate brief to explore where an idea could go and what it could become.

• Be versatile. Shape ideas across stories, identities, services and experiences rather than defaulting to a familiar format or output.

• Set the craft standard. Bring a high standard of conceptual thinking, art direction and design craft, creating distinctive visual worlds wherever the idea needs to live.

• Use the tools to go further. Work fluently across Figma, Adobe, Google Workspace and the wider creative toolkit, with AI embedded naturally into how you explore, validate, visualise and prototype ideas.

• Lead together. Bring multidisciplinary teams around a strong idea, creating clarity and momentum while making space for others to improve the work.

• Direct with purpose. Lead photographers, directors, designers and illustrators, as well as colleagues across disciplines, with a clear point of view, using their expertise to elevate the idea.

• Bring people with you. Present creative thinking with clarity and conviction, building trust with clients and teams as the work develops.

• Raise the standard. Take responsibility for creative quality from beginning to end, maintaining ambition through execution while helping less experienced creatives raise their own standard.

QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS

• Ideas first. You’re a strong conceptual thinker who can find the opportunity in a brief and imagine what an idea could become.

• Entrepreneurial by nature. You see opportunities others might miss, take initiative and find ways to turn possibilities into something real.

• A strong visual point of view. You have excellent judgement across design, typography, image-making, film and contemporary visual culture, backed by the craft to make your thinking tangible.

• Curious beyond your craft. You’re interested in culture, technology, behaviour and disciplines beyond your own, and bring that curiosity back into the work.

• Comfortable in the unknown. You explore, experiment and challenge familiar ways of doing things when there might be a better answer.

• Generous with ideas. You make space for other perspectives, build on good thinking wherever it comes from and help the people around you do better work.

• Clear and convincing. You can articulate why an idea matters, bring clients and teams with you and respond thoughtfully when the work is challenged.

• High standards, low ego. You care deeply about the quality of the work without needing every answer to be yours.

• A maker at heart. You stay close to the work, the tools and the details, and know when getting hands-on will make the outcome better.

Each has their own specialism, whether illustration, 3D, or motion, so the team brings something different to every project. You'll help bring the best out of each of them while setting the standard through your own craft.

As a motion lead, you’ll help define motion principles on projects, inspire fellow motion designers and help set high standards across the business.

You'll work closely with design leads to build processes, raise the quality of our output, and evolve how the team works.

Hands-on craft

Collaboration and clients

• Build productive working relationships with other disciplines across the agency to deliver projects

• Collaborate with other heads of design and creative planners

• Present work internally and externally, and act as a design lead on client accounts

WHAT YOU BRING

• Experience in a senior design role within the creative industry

• Experience leading and line managing other designers, including one-to-ones, feedback, and performance and development conversations

• Experience of being involved in hiring, such as interviewing, assessing portfolios, and contributing to hiring decisions

• A design background and the ability to work confidently on the tools alongside your team

• Strong motion design and video editing skills in After Effects and Premiere Pro

• Experience in video production and post-production techniques

• Expert knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite

• Outstanding showreel and/or portfolio

• Strong aesthetic skills and knowledge of graphic design principles, with attention to visual detail

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting work to clients and stakeholders

• Excellent organisational and time management skills

• Ability to stay focused under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• A love of learning new things and exploring new formats

WE OFFER

• Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.

• Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

• Dog-friendly office

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up over half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, engineering and data to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, data and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future — and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

🌱 About Growth

Our Growth collective is focused on helping more people discover Monzo, understand what makes us different, and find the products that can make money work better for them.

For this role, you’ll have a particular focus on our web experiences, helping us rethink how people discover, explore and choose Monzo before they ever open the app. You’ll combine strong visual and interaction design with a data-informed mindset, using experimentation and customer insight to understand what works and continuously improve the experience.

You don’t need to have worked in a dedicated Growth team before. We’re interested in designers who are curious about customer behaviour, comfortable using data to inform their decisions, and excited by the opportunity to apply exceptional craft to high-impact customer journeys.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

• Leading the design of high-quality web experiences that help new and existing customers discover the value Monzo can bring to their financial lives.

• Using quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, understand customer behaviour and make informed design decisions.

• Turning customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, designing experiments and using what you learn to shape what we do next.

• Bringing exceptional visual and interaction craft to our web experiences, creating work that feels unmistakably Monzo while driving meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.

• Tackling complex and ambiguous design challenges, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints to create simple, effective experiences.

• Defining compelling product visions and direction, helping teams think beyond individual experiments towards a coherent long-term customer experience.

• Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Research throughout the design process, bringing people together around customer problems and opportunities.

• Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code.

• Taking a pragmatic approach to experimentation — moving quickly when we need to learn, while knowing when an experience needs a higher level of craft and polish.

• Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the wider Design team.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a proven track record of designing high-quality web experiences, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design craft.

• You’re comfortable using data to inform your design decisions, partnering with Data Scientists or Analysts to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of your work.

• You can connect great customer experiences with measurable outcomes and understand how design can contribute to wider product and commercial goals.

• You’re comfortable forming hypotheses, experimenting with different approaches and adapting your thinking as you learn.

• You can balance speed and experimentation with a high bar for craft, knowing when to prototype quickly and when to invest in creating an exceptional final experience.

• You’re a natural collaborator who can bring together Product, Engineering, Data, Research and other partners around complex customer problems.

• You thrive in ambiguity and can create clarity and direction when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.

• You’re comfortable thinking beyond an individual screen or experiment, connecting work across journeys and helping shape a longer-term vision.

• You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through mentoring, feedback and sharing your expertise.

• You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and the opportunity to help more people discover the value of Monzo.

🙌What’s in it for you

💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.
✅ We can sponsor your visa.
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.
📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.
➕ Plus lots more!

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

• 30-minute call with our Recruiter, Tom

• 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team

• 2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact

This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-TR1
#LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

title: Senior Match-3 Level Designer, New Game
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/2251b9c4-44ce-4ce5-8e1f-2bcd38676418/new%20keyart.jpg]


WE’RE LOOKING FOR A TALENTED AND HIGHLY EXPERIENCED SENIOR MATCH 3 LEVEL DESIGNER TO JOIN OUR LOVELY AND AMBITIOUS GAME TEAM AND HELP CRAFT FUN, REWARDING AND MEMORABLE PUZZLE EXPERIENCES FOR OUR COZY MOBILE GAME.

You’ll own the match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define the game’s level design framework while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

 - Collaborate with designers, product managers, programmers and analysts to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

 - Own the design of blockers, boosters and shape satisfying level progression

 - Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience and reach product goals

 - Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

 - Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

 - Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.
   
   - Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets the team’s standards.

 - Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

 - Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

 - Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

 - Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

 - Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

 - Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

 - Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

 - A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

 - A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

 - A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

 - Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

 - The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

 - A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

 - Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

 - A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

 - A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]


ABOUT SUPERCELL 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]


HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]


YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]


BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]


RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/58a0cf4e-e26b-461b-8541-2129dc6b7311/banner_narrow_portraits-2025-ashby.jpg]


NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY? 

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Brand Strategist
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we help ambitious companies navigate shifting markets and culture, define better futures, and build brands that pioneer, not just compete. We work at the intersection of technology, storytelling, and design, turning brand into strategic advantage.

We’re looking for a senior brand strategist who can combine strategic rigour with creative imagination to join our Copenhagen studio. Someone who can dissect market and cultural shifts, identify compelling positions, and translate them into creative brand ideas that resonate and perform.

The role

As a brand strategist, you’ll operate across brand, campaign, and experience, leading the translation of client challenges into strategies that are both rigorous and creatively compelling. You’ll own strategic direction from foundational brand work through to creative activation, championing value-driven thinking.

What you’ll do

• Define brand futures: Lead brand platforms, positioning, and narrative frameworks; uncover differentiated positions; show how brands can shape culture, not just respond to it.

• Develop activation strategy: Turn insight into sharp creative concepts; define audience insights and communication territories; craft briefs that inspire breakthrough creative work and campaigns.

• Collaborate on creative: Partner with creative teams to develop ideas rooted in strategy; ensure work ladders back to brand strategy while pushing creative boundaries.

• Build the case: Ground strategies in research and evidence; translate them into measurable business value; craft narratives that build client confidence.

• Lead in the room: Present recommendations to senior stakeholders; facilitate workshops; be a trusted strategic voice with clients and creative partners.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work with creatives, designers, technologists, and experience strategists; contribute to new business and pitches across categories.

Who you probably are

• 5–7+ years in brand, marketing, or creative strategy, with experience across both brand-building and campaign activation

• Agency background preferred; consultancy or client-side brand experience also valued

• Past work showing both strategic depth and creative ambition

• Skilled at dissecting complexity and building evidence-based, precisely communicated arguments

• Fluent in brand architecture, positioning, and performance measurement

• Creatively curious and drawn to innovation thinking, able to translate insight into concepts that are simple, memorable, and ownable

• Someone who sees brand as a business value driver, questions assumptions, and stays genuinely curious about culture, technology, and behaviour

Explore our extensive range of benefits here.

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Role

You are an experienced leader, inspiring, mentoring and earning the respect of the team around you to lead them to greatness. You establish close and meaningful relationships with Koto’s clients and deliver exceptional creative work for them.

Your Responsibilities

•
You identify, curate and refine great ideas that can transform brands and businesses. You know how to frame and sell them in expertly. You encourage and nurture all of this in your team, teaching them to do the same.

•
You have an excellent knowledge of all tenets of brand creation and can deliver both a clear vision and specific actionable feedback to ensure you and your team deliver world class brands.

•
You are responsible for the day-to-day leadership, mentorship, culture and output of the Design team. You actively recruit new talent and spend time building relationships with educational institutes and the design community online.

•
You are responsible for sharing work with our clients, inclusive of content, narrative structure and team. You can present work in an incredibly compelling way and can form well considered perspectives to challenge clients.

•
You collaborate intimately with the Strategy team to develop ideas, frameworks, and copy that inspire and inform the brands you create.

•
You demonstrate an encyclopaedic knowledge of branding and have consistently delivered work for the most impactful companies of today and the founders defining tomorrow.

•
You demonstrate ownership of your role and can both take and action feedback from your manager to progress within it. You can deliver actionable feedback and valuable support for any member of your team.

•
You collaborate intimately with the Client Services team to create scopes of work and can deliver on them within the timelines and team you collectively outline.

•
You have a willingness to work in person in our London studio and are open to travel globally, from Stuttgart to San Francisco.

•
You have a great understanding of Figma, InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Pitch and advocate for adoption of new relevant tools?

Our Responsibilities

•
We will ensure you have meaningful and regular access to your manager to support your personal development and career trajectory.

•
We will actively reward performance with promotions, pay increases and a discretionary annual bonus of up to 10% of salary to all employees.

•
We ensure Koto is an equal environment for all its employees regardless of race, gender, age, or sexual preference.

•
We will support you in taking family leave and offer significant paid maternity and paternity.

•
We will actively encourage you to take 25 days holiday yearly, in addition to UK bank holidays (on average eight), one additional holiday day per year (capped at 5 additional days), and a studio closure between Christmas and New Year.

•
We will contribute an additional 3% to anyone wanting to engage in the Scottish Widows pension scheme.

•
We offer private medical insurance via Vitality Health and a monthly ‘employee wellness’ benefits package via Juno of £75 per month.

•
We offer access to YCN and fund relevant training opportunities to any employee looking to develop themselves and career.

•
We reward five years of service with £5,000 and five days holiday. We reward ten years of service with £10,000 and four weeks holiday.

•
We will give you the opportunity to work from any of the five koto studios globally, with appropriate planning and application.

Our Culture

•
At Koto we encourage our team to be ‘rationally optimistic’ about the potential of our work, our clients, their businesses, and the power of brand.

•
We pursue the best briefs, want to inspire meaningful work, and for those interested provide an opportunity to make the work of their lives. We are actively cultivating leadership, culture and spaces to encourage this.

•
We work in person with an optional WFH day on Friday, and an additional 20 days remote a year. We believe this produces the best work, mentoring opportunities, collective learning and culture.

•
We encourage autonomy in each member of our team, allowing them to manage their own time, hours and personal commitments appropriately to complete work.

title: Principal Security Researcher
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, Israel; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of the role

We are seeking a Principal Security Researcher to join our Application Security Team to conduct cutting-edge security research on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps capabilities. As GitLab transforms software development through intelligent collaboration between developers and specialized AI agents, we need security researchers who can proactively identify and validate vulnerabilities before they impact our platform or customers.

In this role, you'll be at the forefront of security research, working with our GitLab DevSecOps platform, Duo Agent Platform, GitLab Duo Chat, and AI workflows that represent the future of human/AI collaborative development. You'll develop novel testing methodologies (including for AI agent security), conduct hands-on penetration testing, and translate emerging threats into actionable security improvements. Your research will directly influence how we build and secure the next generation of AI-powered DevSecOps tools, ensuring GitLab remains the most secure software factory platform on the market.

This position offers the unique opportunity to shape security and AI security practices in one of the world's largest DevSecOps platforms, working with engineering teams who are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI-assisted software development. You'll have access to cutting-edge AI systems and the freedom to explore creative attack scenarios while contributing to the security of millions of developers worldwide.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Application Security.

What you'll do

• Conduct and lead security research projects across multiple functional areas.

• Identify novel, systemic, and chained vulnerabilities in GitLab, where individual weaknesses combine for outsized impact.

• Validate security vulnerabilities through hands-on testing, developing proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate real-world attack scenarios.

• Assess emerging industry vulnerability classes against the GitLab codebase, and drive remediation of the class rather than the instance.

• Lead security research into GitLab's AI and agentic surfaces, and define the security requirements that engineering teams build against.

• Build and direct the tooling and automation that scales security research, including agent-assisted vulnerability discovery across our codebase.

• Research the security posture of open source tools and dependencies integrated with GitLab, report findings to their maintainers, and track mitigation following our responsible disclosure guidelines.

• Solve technical problems of the highest scope, complexity, and ambiguity.

• Help shape the team and sub-department roadmap.

• Lead the integration of security research results into the engineering and business functions that need to act on them.

• Teach, mentor, and advise other domain experts and individual contributors across several teams.

• Share knowledge and novel vulnerability types with the security community.

What you'll bring

• 10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive security roles

• Strong ability in discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in large codebase and complex systems

• Proficiency in two or more of Ruby, Go, Python, TypeScript, or Rust.

• Ability to read and analyze code across multiple languages and codebases

• Strong knowledge of AI frameworks

• Strong understanding of AI attack vectors including prompt injection, agent manipulation, and workflow exploitation

• At ease in establishing and driving complex remediation initiatives involving cross-functional teams

• Excellent written communication skills with an ability to articulate complex topics in a clear and concise manner.

• Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear risk assessments and remediation recommendations

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with creative thinking about attack scenarios

• Nice to Have: Published security research or conference presentations; background in software engineering with distributed systems expertise; experience with GitLab or similar DevSecOps platforms

About the team

Security Researchers are a part of our Application Security team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. We focus on systemic product security risks and work cross-functionally to mitigate them while maintaining Engineering's development velocity.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$203,200-$275,000 USD

title: Senior Visual & Communication Designer - Staff Leased Contract
description:
About Huawei

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. We have more than 200,000 employees, of which 55% are employed in R&D, and we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.

Huawei invests more than 20% of revenues in R&D every year: in the past 10 years our total R&D investments exceed 150B USD.

By the end of 2023, Huawei held +140.000 active patents.

Who we are

Our motto is "make it possible", we use our customer-centric obsession, our perseverance, our dedication and a continuous self-challenge to accomplish the most challenging goals and always raise the bar!

We think and execute very fast, but we are never superficial and always guarantee the highest standards.

We are obsessed about continuous improvement and about creating value for the company, for the employees and for society.

We are a multicultural team where relationships are informal and direct and where cooperation and support are our daily keywords.

We are a place where "results talk and ideas walk", good ideas are always welcome, but you have to take ownership and make them happen too.

Openness and flexibility are our mantra.

Senior Visual & Communication Designer

The position will be part of our Milan Aesthetic Research Center, one of Huawei’s Research Centers, committed to enhancing the quality of Huawei products.

We are dedicated to shaping the future of product design through deep research and visionary thinking. Our team thrives on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration,

exploring new ways to enhance consumer experiences and inspire industry innovation.

We believe in challenging conventional design approaches and integrating cross-disciplinary insights to envision groundbreaking solutions and create outstanding brand experiences in the field of AI.

In this role, the Senior Visual & Communication Designer focuses on exploring new ways to create international brand experiences and helping craft visionary communication strategies that inspire and inform headquarters teams.

Working collaboratively with other design teams, the position focuses on translating insights into compelling visual and conceptual ideas. The role contributes to exploring new approaches and future-oriented design concepts that support the ongoing evolution of brand perception across global markets.

Brand Strategy & Future Vision

· Research emerging trends in visual design, brand identity, digital experiences, and global communication to understand shifts in consumer perception.

· Support the exploration of future-oriented brand experience ideas that align with
long-term corporate objectives.

· Contribute to conceptual frameworks that support the brand’s evolution across international markets.

· Assist in translating brand strategy into visual and conceptual design solutions that communicate compelling brand narratives.

Corporate Identity & Design Systems

· Contribute to the development and evolution of corporate identity systems across brand touchpoints.

· Explore new approaches to visual identity elements, including typography, color systems, imagery, motion design, and AI.

· Support the creation of scalable design principles that enable consistent multi-platform brand communication.

Communication Design & Storytelling

· Develop creative design concepts that support corporate and consumer communication initiatives.

· Explore design solutions that connect digital, physical, and experiential
brand experiences.

· Experiment with new visual approaches and media to engage audiences
across evolving platforms.

· Contribute to the creation of brand guidelines and visual frameworks that support effective storytelling.

Collaboration

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams and include disciplines like product design, retail experience, and UX/UI to ensure brand consistency.

· Contribute research insights, visual explorations, and design proposals within collaborative project teams.

· Support the translation of research findings into visual concepts and design directions.

Market & Consumer Trend Research

· Conduct research on cultural, technological, and consumer trends that influence brand perception.

· Analyze relevant brand benchmarks and visual communication approaches across industries.

· Help to monitor shifts in branding and design practices to identify inspiration and opportunities for innovation.

What are the skills required for this position?

Education & Background:

Qualifications

Master’s degree in Communication Design, Graphic Design, or a related field.

description:

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

An overview of this role

You’ll bring GitLab’s employer value proposition to life through storytelling, recruitment marketing, candidate education, and experiences that connect our external reputation to our internal culture. You’ll partner across GitLab to turn talent brand strategy into campaigns and content throughout the candidate journey.

This role is a strong fit for a brand, recruitment marketing, employer brand, or content professional who can move between strategy and execution. You’ll use editorial judgment, data, and cross-functional collaboration to create clear, inclusive, and authentic candidate experiences.

What You’ll Do

• Translate GitLab’s employer value proposition and company direction into clear, differentiated, and authentic candidate-facing messaging.

• Deliver integrated talent brand campaigns across careers content, social media, employer review platforms, talent communities, events, and recruiter channels.

• Develop and curate stories featuring team members, leaders, teams, culture, values, career growth, and the impact of working at GitLab.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition to create targeted content and campaigns that support hiring priorities, pipeline generation, and conversion.

• Improve candidate journey touchpoints with transparent, consistent, and relevant information throughout the hiring process.

• Use content, channel, candidate feedback, and funnel metrics to improve performance and communicate impact.

• Collaborate across GitLab to ensure content is accurate, inclusive, culturally relevant, and aligned with our voice.

• Manage projects and external partners while improving talent brand processes, systems, reporting, and operations through iteration and thoughtful use of technology and artificial intelligence tools.

What You’ll Bring

• Experience in talent brand, employer brand, recruitment marketing, content strategy, communications, or a related field.

• Experience translating a brand or employer value proposition into content, campaigns, or audience experiences.

• Strong storytelling, writing, editing, and editorial judgment across multiple channels.

• Experience planning and delivering campaigns or programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.

• Comfort using performance data, audience insights, feedback, and market research to improve outcomes.

• Experience influencing across functions and working with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts, creative partners, or vendors.

The GitLab Talent Brand team helps candidates understand what it means to work here through marketing, storytelling, partnerships, candidate education, and recruiter enablement. We evolve GitLab’s employer narrative, strengthen regional presence, improve talent content and platforms, support targeted attraction, and use data to understand our impact on candidate engagement and hiring outcomes.

title: Senior UX Designer (Focus on Research)
description:
Senior UX Designer (Focus on Research)

Zagreb, Split, Hybrid

JOB PURPOSE

As a User Researcher, you help product teams make confident, customer-centered decisions by uncovering real user needs, motivations, behaviors and opportunities. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on research to explore problem spaces, test hypotheses and turn insights into action.

In this role, you’ll work at the core of one of our key client teams, shaping how research contributes to the development of digital products and services. From exploring the adoption of AI technologies to enabling journey-driven product thinking – you’ll bring clarity to complexity and structure to uncertainty.

You’ll design and conduct studies, synthesize results, and make insights accessible and actionable for product managers, designers and other stakeholders. But you’ll also help evolve the research practice itself by refining methods, improving tooling and championing user needs across the team. And you’ll do it all in a dynamic environment with some of the most talented (and fun) people the industry has to offer.

WHAT YOU´LL DO

• Plan and conduct user research – from exploratory discovery work to usability tests and concept validations

• Frame research questions and help teams explore problem spaces before jumping into solutions

• Analyse results, document insights, and share them in ways that support product and design decisions

• Work closely with designers, product managers and developers in a cross-functional team environment

• Support the development of research standards and ways of working that scale across teams and topics

• Bring inspiration and structure to the research process, through methods, tools and best practices

• Advocate for a journey-driven, evidence-based approach to product development

• Stay curious: continuously evolve your methods and contribute to the research culture across the team

WHAT YOU BRING

• Over 5 years of experience in user research, ideally at an agency and in agile, product-focused environments

• Strong skills in running and analysing studies – from usability tests to interviews and concept validations

• A talent for making research results easy to understand and act on for designers, product managers and stakeholders

• You stay up to date with emerging tools, methods and technologies and enjoy bringing fresh perspectives into the team

• Familiarity with journey mapping and experience frameworks and a drive to make them part of real product work

• Confidence in facilitating sessions, speaking with users and contributing to product strategy

• A proactive mindset: you bring structure, keep pushing your practice forward, and enjoy working hands-on

• English working proficiency

• German is a strong plus!

WE OFFER

• Transparent career development and pay;

• A flexible, hybrid working policy (5 days in the office per month).

• A rewarding, supportive and healthy company culture.

• Supplemental and additional health insurance;

• Pension scheme: third pillar pension fund.

• Referral bonus program.

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, and a multisport programme;

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.

• Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager
description:
At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

Bondora is a profitable European fintech on its way to becoming a licensed bank, serving consumers in seven markets. Our brand is about to change: a new visual and verbal identity is coming, and it has to reach every customer touchpoint in every market. At the same time, we are building trust in a category where many lenders look and sound alike.

We are looking for a senior brand marketer to run our brand programmes end to end: the rollout of the new identity, our trust programme, proactive PR, and a few sharp brand activations a year. You will work within the brand strategy and budget set by the Head of Brand & Content, with a lot of room to decide how things get done.

This is a hands-on, operational role for someone who loves getting things live and making a small budget go a long way. It is not a brand strategy role, and it is not a social media role: our Social & Content team runs always-on social and content. Today the role covers our credit products, and brand projects for new products as they launch.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Running brand programmes end to end: plans, owners, sign-offs, quality checks and delivery across seven markets, starting with the rollout of our new brand identity.

• Creating low-cost brand activations that earn attention and reach: partnerships, influencer flights, short video bursts and ideas people talk about.

• Spending wisely and reading results honestly: agreeing the objective and how success will be judged before spending, and reporting what worked and what did not.

• Managing agencies, freelancers and influencers: briefs, scope, budget, quality and adaptations for several markets and languages.

• Building trust: customer reviews, Trustpilot, awards and testimonials, and using them across ads, website and customer communication.

• Running proactive product and campaign PR across our markets.

• Keeping the brand consistent and compliant: handing master assets to the teams that adapt them, settling local requests with country teams, and working with Legal on credit advertising rules.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• You have personally led a rebrand or brand refresh rollout, or a comparable multi-market brand programme, from plan to completion.

• Your experience is with consumer (B2C) brands, and includes marketing to customers in European markets.

• You keep several projects moving in parallel with little supervision, and act early when something slips.

• You come up with ideas, not only execute them: you can give us several different concepts that earn reach for little money, and say why an audience would care.

• You have managed creative, production, media or PR agencies and influencers, including rescuing work that went off track.

• You measure in a way that fits a small budget, and you know when a change in the numbers is just noise.

• You have run PR or trust and review programmes, or are ready to own them.

• You know, or learn fast, what credit advertising may and may not say. Experience in lending, banking, fintech or another regulated business is a plus.

• You use AI as part of how you work, for concepting, adaptations or checks, and you check what it gives you.

What can you expect at Bondora?

• Contribute to Bondora’s ambitious goal of reaching 1BN in revenue. Your skills and efforts will directly impact our growth trajectory and shape the future of our company.

• Our employees deserve the best. We recognize our people with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package (5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental healthcare support, share options and much more!)

• We provide an environment that encourages your personal and professional growth. As we constantly evolve and innovate, you’ll have endless opportunities (and budget) to expand your skills and skyrocket your career.

The next steps

If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now!

Our hiring process:

1️⃣ Meet Anna, our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions.2️⃣ Meet Daria, Head of Brand & Content and your manager.
3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills.4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs.
5️⃣ Leadership interview with Mario, CMO.
6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas, our Chief of People.
7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora!

Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen!

If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE.

title: Senior Industrial Designer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Most industrial designers join companies where the big design decisions have already been made. At HIGHCAT, you’ll have the opportunity to shape what comes next.

Working alongside the Head of Design, you’ll help evolve the physical identity of HIGHCAT and bring it to life across a growing product portfolio from early concepts through production.

This is a role with real ownership. We care less about your process than your ability to create exceptional products efficiently. Whether you sketch, prototype, model in CAD, or use AI is up to you. What matters is great judgement, strong execution, and shipping outstanding products.

If you want to help shape the next generation of products at a new European hardware company and see your work deployed where it matters most, we’d love to hear from you.

CORE TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Evolve the industrial design language and physical identity of HIGHCAT.

•
Drive industrial design projects from concept through production.

•
Collaborate closely with design, engineering, software, and product teams to create integrated hardware experiences.

•
Develop concepts through sketching, CAD, rapid prototyping, and AI-assisted workflows where appropriate.

•
Build and test prototypes using 3D printing and other rapid manufacturing methods.

•
Create compelling renderings and design presentations.

•
Design products that balance aesthetics, usability, ergonomics, and manufacturability.

•
Ensure seamless integration between physical products and digital user interfaces.

•
Help build a pragmatic, fast-moving design culture focused on exceptional outcomes.

•
Support brand and marketing initiatives with graphic and visual design when needed.

ABOUT YOU

•
5+ years of professional experience in industrial design, preferably developing complex consumer, mobility, robotics, or hardware products.

•
You are an independent, self-driven designer who takes ownership and proactively moves projects forward.

•
You know how to navigate ambiguity, make informed design decisions, and deliver high-quality outcomes efficiently.

•
You have an exceptional eye for proportion, form, detail, and product design, with a strong understanding of brand and design DNA. You can interpret and consistently apply an established design language across different products, while evolving it thoughtfully where appropriate.

•
Advanced proficiency in Rhino, including freeform surfacing. Experience with Class-A surfacing is a strong advantage.

•
Experience creating prototypes using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping methods for iterative development and user testing.

•
Excellent graphic design skills with Adobe CC and Figma. Canva and AI-assisted workflows are a plus.

•
Strong rendering and visual communication skills using KeyShot. Experience with animation, motion design, or post-production in After Effects is a plus.

•
Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, including injection moulding, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing.

•
Knowledge of textiles, soft goods, or sewn products is a plus.

•
Strong understanding of ergonomics, usability, and human-centred design principles.

•
Experience designing products where physical form and digital user interfaces are closely connected.

•
You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where ownership is high, processes evolve, and collaboration across disciplines is essential.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Compensation and Ownership:
Competitive compensation with meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company you’re helping to build.
Mission and Impact:
The opportunity to see your work become real products used in demanding, high-stakes environments where good design genuinely matters.
Access and Influence:
A small, ambitious team with direct access to the Head of Design, founders, engineers, and decision-makers—without layers of hierarchy between ideas and execution.
Culture and Environment:
A high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment where decisions move quickly, good ideas can come from anywhere, and strong work earns increasing responsibility.
Resources and Craft:
The freedom and tools to explore, prototype, test, and refine ideas quickly, with a strong emphasis on quality and getting physical products right.
Professional Growth:
The chance to grow alongside an early-stage hardware company, take on increasingly ambitious challenges, and have a lasting influence on the products and design culture we build.

YOUR APPLICATION

We require all candidates for this role to submit a portfolio showcasing their industrial design work. We’re particularly interested in projects that demonstrate strong form development, design thinking, prototyping, CAD, and an understanding of how products are brought into production.

Please keep uploaded portfolios under 15 MB. If your portfolio exceeds this limit, please provide a link to your website, online portfolio, or a shared file instead.

This is an on-site role based in Konstanz, Germany. Please only apply if you are based in the area or are willing to relocate to Konstanz. This is not a remote position.

ABOUT HIGHCAT

Europe’s airspace is evolving. We are building the systems that help secure it.
HIGHCAT is a team of builders, engineers, and problem-solvers. We develop modular unmanned systems designed for real-world deployment. Built and manufactured in Germany, our platforms support the people and organisations that protect critical infrastructure, public services, and operational capabilities.
We like solving difficult problems. From first concept to deployment, we build technology that performs when it matters most. Our focus is simple: reliable systems, intuitive operation, and real-world impact.
Our work enables safer and more effective operations across security, industry, and defence-related applications. Guided by strong ethical principles and a commitment to European technological sovereignty, we are helping build the next generation of operational capabilities for Europe.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries — empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.




OVERVIEW

We're looking for a talented Industrial Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our next-generation autonomous robot systems. In this role, you'll translate technical requirements into compelling product designs, working closely with our Mechanical Engineering team to ensure your designs are both visually strong and grounded in engineering reality.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Concept Development:

 - Design housings, enclosures, and user-facing components for autonomous robot systems, balancing aesthetics, ergonomics, and brand identity.

 - Develop concept sketches, renderings, and 3D models to communicate design intent to stakeholders.

 - Translate design concepts into manufacturable geometry in close collaboration with Mechanical Engineers.

Collaboration and Iteration:

 - Work hand-in-hand with mechanical, electrical, and software teams to ensure designs integrate seamlessly with internal components.

 - Build and evaluate prototypes (foam, 3D-printed, or CNC) to validate form, fit, and user experience.

 - Iterate designs based on manufacturability, cost, and technical feedback.




QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating both aesthetic sensibility and technical understanding of materials and manufacturing.

 - Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, or similar) and rendering tools (KeyShot, Blender).

 - Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (injection molding, sheet metal, CNC, 3D printing).

 - Ability to work at the intersection of design and engineering, and to communicate design decisions to a technical audience.




YOUR APPLICATION

 - Upload 1 PDF file including 2–3 examples of your design work: drawings, pictures, models, products or similar. Include images and a brief description for each

title: Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries — empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

In this role, you'll own the design language of our products end-to-end — from early concept through to a design that's ready to be engineered and manufactured.

Product Design:

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Product Design, Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
