ABOUT BELLWEATHER

Bellweather is a creative agency for legacy brands: the nonprofits, cultural institutions, healthcare systems, and government organizations that are part of peopleâs lives. Weâve spent a decade helping these organizations find what makes them matter and bringing it to life through immersive research, artistic collaboration, and creative work that doesnât look or feel like anyone elseâs.

Our clients include Brooklyn Public Library, MetroPlusHealth, Museum Hue, NYC Votes, and Visit Baltimore, among others. We're a certified woman-owned business and a Webby Awardâwinning agency.Â

Our work starts with immersive research and deep listening. We spend time in communities, collaborating with artists, poets, photographers, and filmmakers to find what makes an organization extraordinary. From there, we build strategic platforms and brand identities that our clients can own and carry forward long after the engagement ends.

ABOUT THE NAME

Our name combines "bellwether" (a leading indicator) and "weather" (constant change). We help organizations find what makes them extraordinary and give it a platform that lasts.

HOW WE WORK

Bellweather is a fully remote company. Our team is distributed across the U.S., with most of our collaboration happening in Eastern time. We've built our workflows, meetings, and creative process around remote work from the start.

______________________________

THE ROLE

The Creative Director leads Bellweather's Creative department â a team of graphic designers, photographers, videographers, and copywriters â and shapes the creative direction of every project, keeping our work aligned with client objectives, market trends, and the standard of quality Bellweather is known for.

Day to day, you'll move between big-picture vision and hands-on craft: partnering with the Strategy team to define creative direction, leading concept development, presenting work to clients, and providing creative oversight on photo and video shoots â from approving cast, wardrobe, and shot lists to traveling on site as the creative lead when a production needs your eye. You'll also run the operational side of the department: allocating resources across projects, managing freelancers and vendors, and continuously sharpening how the team works.

Success in the first six months looks like a creative team that's energized and growing under your mentorship, client work that's completed on time and on budget without sacrificing craft, and a few pitches where your creative vision helped win the room. This position reports directly to the Co-Chief Executive Officer.

______________________________

WHAT YOUâLL DO

Job responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Ideate and Create:Â (35%)

• Creative Vision: Collaborate with the Strategy team to define the creative vision and direction for projects, ensuring alignment with overall business goals.

• Creative Leadership: Lead the creative team in developing innovative, strategy-driven solutions that resonate with target audiences.

• Industry Trends: Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure Bellweather maintains a leading edge in creative innovation.

• Creative Pitches: Oversee the development of creative pitches, ensuring they are compelling and aligned with client needs.

• Presentations: Deliver persuasive presentations of creative concepts and scaled deliverables to clients, effectively communicating the vision and value of proposed solutions.Â

• Creative Quality: Ensure all creative output meets the highest standards of quality, creativity, and innovation.

Scale: (30%)

• Media Plans: Utilize a thorough understanding of media plans and scopes of work to bring creative concepts to market effectively.

• Project Development: Oversee the development and execution of projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. This included oversight of photo and video production.

• Photo and Video Production: Provide creative oversight for photo and video production, including approving cast, wardrobe, set styling, shot lists, scripts and storyboards. This role may also require travelling on site as the creative lead to ensure the vision is executed accurately and creatively.

• Resource Allocation: Manage the allocation of resources, balancing the needs of multiple projects and ensuring optimal team performance including freelancers which include software, and other creative tools.

• Process Optimization: Continuously improve creative processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

• Vendor Management: Collaborate with external vendors and partners to ensure seamless integration and execution of creative work.

Team Management and Development: (30%)

• Leadership: Provide leadership and mentorship to a team of graphic designers, photographers, videographers, copywriters, and other creative professionals.

• Collaborative Environment: Foster a collaborative, learning, and innovative work environment that encourages team members to excel.

• Recruitment: Oversee and manage the recruitment and onboarding of new staff and freelance support, ensuring the team is equipped with the necessary skills and expertise.

• Supervision: Supervise and manage the day-to-day activities of the creative team, including effort tracking and budget allocation.

• Professional Development: Support the professional growth of team members through regular feedback, training, and development opportunities.

• Performance Management: Conduct performance evaluations and implement development plans to help team members achieve their full potential.

Business Development: (5%)

• New Business Opportunities: Participate in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, leveraging creative expertise to attract and secure new clients.

• Pitch Presentations: Contribute to pitch presentations, providing creative insights and solutions that align with client needs and objectives.

• Client Engagement: Engage with clients to understand their goals and challenges, ensuring Bellweather's creative solutions exceed expectations and drive business growth.

• Market Positioning: Help position Bellweather as a leader in creative innovation through thought leadership, industry engagement, and high-profile project work.

______________________________

REQUIREMENTS

• 5â7 years of experience in a creative agency, with at least 2â3 years in a leadership role (e.g., Art Director, Associate Creative Director, Creative Director)

• A portfolio that shows innovative, strategy-driven creative work across campaigns, brand identity, and digital projects

• Proficiency in creative software and tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Google Suite)

• Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or a related field

• Proven experience scaling omni-channel media plans and integrated marketing campaigns

• Proven experience directing photo and video production, from storyboarding through post-production

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to present and sell creative work to clients

NICE TO HAVE

• An advanced degree in Graphic Design or a related field

• Familiarity with emerging technologies and creative trends that keep an agency on the leading edge

• Experience contributing to new business development and pitch presentations at an agency

______________________________

WHAT WE OFFER

• Unlimited/Flexible PTO

• Fully remote work environment with flexible scheduling, subject to change based on organizational needs.

Send your resume, portfolio, and a brief note in the email about why this role interests you to jobs@bellweather.agency with the subject line [Creative Director - Applicant Name].

title: Designer
description:
A Note from the Founder

Intelligent Change began as something personal.

Before it was a company, it was a question I was trying to answer in my own life:

Why do we know so much about personal growth, yet struggle to live it consistently?

Over the years, what we created resonated far beyond anything I imagined. Millions of people around the world now use Intelligent Change products as daily rituals to slow down, reflect, and live more intentionally.

Today, we've sold over 4 million products globally and reached millions of people around the world. But we are still early in our journey. We are building something that can scale meaningfully without losing its soul.

This role matters because design is one of the most powerful ways people experience our brand. Every image, campaign, product, and detail shapes how people feel before they ever read a word.

If you're excited by the idea of creating beautiful, meaningful work that helps millions of people build better lives, we'd love to meet you.

â Alex Ikonn

Founder, Intelligent Change

About Intelligent Change

Intelligent Change exists to help people design better lives through small, consistent rituals that compound over time.

We create physical tools and experiences that turn personal growth into something people can actually live. Not through pressure or motivation, but through structure, reflection, and intention.

We are the creators of the most viral journal in the world, The Five Minute Journal, a product that helped turn gratitude into a daily practice for millions of people globally. To date, Intelligent Change has sold over 4,000,000 products worldwide and built a deeply loyal, values-driven community.

Our products are used and recommended by Tim Ferriss, Emma Watson, Lily Collins, professional athletes, CEOs, founders, and leaders across industries, alongside millions of everyday people seeking more intentional lives.

Intelligent Change has been featured in The New York Times, Vogue, Forbes, ELLE, and other leading global publications. The New York Times described Intelligent Change as a brand that has "turned gratitude into a global movement."

The Role

We're looking for a Designer with exceptional visual taste and a passion for creating work that feels timeless, thoughtful, and emotionally resonant.

This role reports directly to the Creative Director and sits at the heart of our creative team. You'll primarily design for social media and organic channels, bringing our products and ideas to life through engaging visual storytelling across Instagram, email, and digital campaigns.

You'll also collaborate closely with our Product Development team to design packaging, printed products, marketing materials, and launch assets that extend our brand across every customer touchpoint.

This is a role for someone who cares deeply about craft, typography, composition, photography, and the details that make great design feel effortless.

Remote Role

This is a full-time, fully remote contract role.

We're open to candidates worldwide, provided you can work overlapping hours with our team, who operate across ET and GMT time zones.

Candidates based in Toronto or Montreal will be given preference, as you'll occasionally join the Creative Director on set for campaign and content shoots.

What You'll Do

Design Across Social

• Create high-quality designs for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Meta ads, email, and web

• Work closely with the Creative & Social teams to develop engaging social-first visuals that balance performance with strong brand design

• Design static posts, carousels, stories, reels covers, motion concepts, and campaign assets

Shape the Brand

• Help evolve and maintain a consistent visual identity across every customer touchpoint

• Contribute ideas for campaigns, launches, seasonal moments, and new creative directions

• Uphold a high bar for design quality and visual consistency

Design Physical Products

• Support the Creative Director with design on packaging, journals, cards, books, and other physical products

• Design supporting collateral including inserts, retail displays, presentations, and launch materials

• Prepare production-ready artwork for print

Collaborate Across Teams

• Work closely with the Creative Director to bring concepts from idea through execution

• Partner with marketing, product, copywriting, and operations teams to deliver cohesive campaigns

• Give and receive thoughtful creative feedback

Stay Curious

• Bring references, trends, ideas, and inspiration from fashion, publishing, interiors, wellness, and culture

• Continuously refine your craft and contribute fresh creative thinking to the team

Who You Are

Exceptional Visual Taste

You have a strong design point of view and a portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful typography, layout, composition, and attention to detail.

Social-First Designer

You understand what performs on modern social platforms without sacrificing quality or brand integrity. You know how to create content that feels native, engaging, and highly shareable.

Product Minded

You enjoy designing physical objects as much as digital ones. Packaging, books, journals, and printed materials excite you.

Curious and Collaborative

You enjoy working closely with writers, marketers, videographers, photographers, and product developers.

You communicate well, ask thoughtful questions, and care about making the work better.

Values Aligned

You have a genuine interest in mindfulness, personal growth, psychology, wellness, or intentional living. Our products resonate with you because you believe in what they help people achieve.

Detail Obsessed

You notice the spacing. The typography. The kerning. The print finish. The things most people overlook.

What We're Looking For

• Please note: Only candidates with submitted portfolios will be considered

• 2+ years of experience in graphic design or brand design

• Outstanding portfolio demonstrating strong visual taste

• Experience designing for social media

• Strong typography and editorial design skills

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, Capcut

• Experience with AI such as Claude, Midjourney and other AI platforms

• Experience designing packaging or printed products is a significant advantage

• Motion design experience is a bonus

• Photography, art direction, or editing experience is a bonus

Why This Role Matters

Design has always been at the heart of Intelligent Change.

Our products become part of people's homes, routines, and daily rituals. They are gifted, photographed, shared, and used for years.

Every Creative Decision Shapes How People Experience Our Brand.

As our Designer, you'll help define that experience, creating thoughtful work that reaches millions of people and inspires them to live more intentionally.

Associate Director Experience Design

Zürich, Hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of our Experience & Engineering team in the DACH region. We combine technology and experience design to create emotive yet conversion-focused CX platforms, Apps, Online Shops and Design systems at scale and speed. Our specialty is digital experiences and communication that change perceptions and shape new behaviours to make a difference in the market.

As Associate Director, you will lead pitches to win new business in DACH and EMEA and oversee projects for key accounts to develop user-centered experiences that drive measurable growth. Your focus will be on ensuring outstanding design quality to win and retain clients.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Design excellence: As Lead Designer for pitches and key accounts, you’ll set the standard for award-winning design that ensures user, brand, and business requirements are not just met but exceeded.

• Delivery accountability: You are responsible for the design quality and the successful delivery of your pitch or project team. You not only set the direction and monitor quality, but also work closely with the core team to ensure overall success.

• Teamwork and collaboration: You will work closely with other departments, such as Strategy, UX, Content, and Technology, and be part of international teams across the EMEA region.

• Thought leadership: You will act as an internal and external voice, showcasing our pioneering work through speaking engagements and industry contributions to build our reputation as a growth innovation company.

WHAT YOU BRING:

• Craft focus: Over 15 years of experience in brand design, experience design (UX/UI), motion design and large-scale design systems.

• Professional Experience: Proven work history of working in dynamic agency environments, collaborating with international brands, and managing senior stakeholders.

• Portfolio: Outstanding track record across the entire design value chain. From developing compelling design visions to executing actionable UI and motion design tasks. Your portfolio showcases impressive results and measurable business growth. Industry awards aren't a must, but very welcome.

• Tech and AI savvy: Not only are you curious about digital trends, AI and new technologies, you are also committed to incorporating relevant innovations into your work.

• Communication and influence: The ability to translate design visions into compelling presentations that inspire and win over both high-level decision-makers and operational teams. Comprehensive professional language skills in German and English (C1 level) are required.

WE OFFER

• Flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location);

• 25 days holiday with the opportunity to take unpaid leave;

• Flexible health budget and Wellness & personal day.

• Learning & development budget.

• Referral bonus program.

• Occasional breakfast & lunch at the office, Smoothie Tuesday.

• Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform.

• You can choose to work from the spacious and barrier-free location in Zurich; in Bern you can expect a small but nice and fully equipped office where you can hit the keys in peace.

• Social events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.

• A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.

• Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!

• The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

• Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

The Product Design team defines and delivers user-facing experiences across Stripe. Product Designers work closely with engineers, product managers, researchers, strategists, operations, data scientists, and marketers to shape products from early strategy through launch and iteration.

You'll join the Risk team, where design shapes how businesses get started on Stripe, stay compliant, and grow with confidence. Stripe's ability to innovate, expand globally, and serve the world's most ambitious companies depends on world-class risk management. But great risk management requires clear, trustworthy, and surprisingly well-crafted experiences during some of the most important moments in a user's relationship with Stripe. From onboarding and verification to account health, your work will help users understand what's happening, know what to do next, and feel confident that Stripe is growing with them as a trusted partner.

Risk at Stripe is also evolving into a product pillar in its own right. As Stripe builds more modular, configurable, API-first risk capabilities, we have the opportunity to turn internal strength into external products for some of the largest and most innovative companies in the world to leverage. This role will shape that future.

What you’ll do

This role sits at the intersection of building trust in the internet economy, platform design, and new product creation, making it one of the most strategically important design opportunities at Stripe. You'll lead design across critical Risk experiences, shaping the strategy for new products, defining AI-driven and agent-friendly workflows, and setting design standards for the team. It's a strong fit for a designer who is energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and excited to shape the future of how businesses get started and grow on Stripe.

• Shape the future of Risk at Stripe, from core user journeys to entirely new product surfaces

• Design experiences that help users onboard quickly, stay compliant, and manage risk with clarity and control

• Partner with product, engineering, policy, operations, and research to define both near-term improvements and longer-term opportunities

• Raise the craft bar in a domain where quality and trust matter deeply

• Work across dozens of teams to create beautiful patterns for risk and compliance experiences across Stripe

Responsibilities

• Explore, shape, and prototype new ideas and products

• Influence strategy through strong product thinking, storytelling, and design judgment

• Lead design on complex, cross-functional problems with multiple stakeholders and constraints

• Collaborate across the Risk team and the wider Stripe design team to influence the shape and visual standards for all product surfaces

• Help other Risk designers and cross-functional partners raise the bar on craft, and adopt systems thinking

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 12+ years of experience designing products

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent craft, systems thinking, and end-to-end design, including a strong understanding of AI tools

• Experience leading complex product work in close partnership with product management and engineering

• Experience shaping ambiguous spaces and driving clarity through design

• A track record of influencing cross-functional teams and product direction

Preferred qualifications

• Thrive in environments where the opportunity spans systems, strategy, and 0-1 product thinking

• Enjoy turning complex systems, policies, and edge cases into elegant product experiences

• Are energized by ambiguous, strategic problem spaces—not just well-defined execution

• Are an influential storyteller who can align partners around a clear point of view

• Can move fluidly between big-picture thinking and interaction-level craft

• Know how to build trust through design, especially in high-stakes or sensitive user moments

• Work well across disciplines and build credibility with technical, operational, and policy-oriented partners

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Creative Strategist - Ramen Bae

ABOUT RAMEN BAE

Ramen Bae is the original dried ramen toppings company on a mission to level up the ramen category.

We started three years ago as a passion project because we wanted better instant ramen toppings and couldnât find anything like it. Since then, weâve gone viral, built a loyal fan base, grown to over 400,000 customers, and recently launched protein ramen. Weâre still just getting started.

Weâre a small, fast-moving team of builders who take ownership, move quickly, and figure things out as we go. Weâre looking for another like-minded person who is excited to help us build the next great ramen brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramen Bae is looking for a Creative Strategist to build and lead the creative engine behind our DTC ramen brand.

This person will own performance-driven creative across paid social, with Meta currently being our largest channel. Youâll be responsible for understanding our products, customers, audience awareness stages, and performance data, then turning those insights into ad concepts, hooks, scripts, creator briefs, and video assets that convert.

This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing, creative strategy, consumer psychology, and execution. The ideal candidate is analytical enough to understand what is working and why, creative enough to find new angles that break through, and scrappy enough to move quickly from idea to launch.

This is a high-impact role with significant room for leadership and growth. Youâll work closely with the CMO and growth team to build a repeatable system for producing high-performing creative at scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative Strategy

â¢ Own creative strategy across paid social and performance marketing channels, with a strong focus on Meta.

â¢ Develop creative angles based on customer pain points, product benefits, trends, competitor research, customer reviews, and performance data.

Creative Production & Execution

â¢ Ensure creative is both on-brand and built to perform in paid social environments.

â¢ Stay on top of social trends, competitor ads, creator formats, and emerging creative opportunities.

â¢ Jump in wherever needed to keep creative moving, whether that means writing scripts, reviewing edits, sourcing creators, organizing assets, or helping bring concepts to life.

Strong bonus: Ability to shoot and edit your own creator-style content.

REQUIREMENTS

â¢ 3+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, paid social creative, DTC ecommerce, or a performance creative agency.

â¢ Strong understanding of paid social creative, especially for Meta.

â¢ Deep understanding of what makes video ads convert, including hooks, pacing, messaging, storytelling, offers, and visual structure.

â¢ Experience building or contributing to a creative testing system that generates new concepts consistently.

â¢ Strong analytical ability and comfort reviewing performance data to understand what is working, why it is working, and what to test next.

â¢ Comfort developing new creative angles based on product benefits, customer pain points, cultural trends, competitor research, and performance insights.

â¢ Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and able to take ownership without needing constant direction.

â¢ Comfortable working on a small team where everyone is expected to be hands-on, proactive, and accountable.

â¢ Strong collaborator who can work effectively with internal team members, creators, editors, freelancers, and agencies.

â¢ Curious, adaptable, eager to learn, and comfortable moving fast in a startup environment.

WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR

This role is perfect for someone who loves combining data, creativity, and execution.

You want to understand why an ad works, not just whether it worked. You can look at performance data, customer reviews, product benefits, and social trends, then turn those insights into creative ideas that drive growth.

Youâre comfortable leading the creative process, but youâre also willing to execute. You bring a strong creative point of view, a deep interest in performance marketing, and the hustle to move quickly from idea to launch.

This is an opportunity to help shape the creative engine of a growing DTC brand and play a key role in how Ramen Bae reaches, converts, and retains customers.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/38fc40dd-12b9-4ca9-8ba4-925f77673201/Stella_Brawl.png]


FROM EXPLOSIVE ACTION TO COZY CASUAL, JOIN US TO MAKE IT ALL LOOK AS GOOD AS IT PLAYS.

Supercell makes games for as many people as possible – games that are played for years and remembered forever. The Creative Studio's job is to make sure the world sees them at their best. We're looking for a versatile Gameplay Capture & Video Artist to do exactly that across our portfolio, from fast, action-driven titles to midcore and casual experiences.

You'll be the person who knows how to make any game look its best on camera – capturing the moments that stop a scroll and drive installs across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and beyond, then turning that raw material into performance creative at the volume and speed UA demands.

This is a UA-first craft role, and it's built on trust. Supercell runs on small, independent teams and very little process – which means you'll own your work end to end, set your own bar for quality, and be trusted to make the calls on how to hit it. We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do. We're looking for someone who treats this craft like it's their own studio: proactive, self-driven, and relentless about reaching a higher bar than anyone asked for.

If you love games, understand what makes an ad convert, and want real ownership over your work, this is for you.

 
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Capture high-quality gameplay footage and stills across a range of Supercell titles and genres (action, midcore, casual), with the instinct to surface the most compelling, install-driving moments in each.

 - Own the production of UA creative at volume – turning raw capture into testable ad variants optimized for performance across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and other paid channels.

 - Build AI-assisted creative tools (e.g. Scenario, Higgsfield) into your everyday workflow, feeding clean capture into AI generation and iteration to scale output and explore concepts faster.

 - Capture across multiple devices and platforms (iOS, Android, PC) to a consistently high technical standard.

 - Edit and enhance footage with sound, transitions, effects and pacing tuned for short-form, performance-driven formats.

 - Work iteratively with UA – reading creative performance signals and rapidly producing new variants and concepts in response.

 - Collaborate directly across cells – UA, marketing, brand and game teams – with minimal bureaucracy, taking your work where it has the most impact even when that's outside the strict scope of the role.

 - Optimize and version content for different placements, formats and aspect ratios, so every asset fits the channel and the test.
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Proven experience in gameplay capture and video editing for performance/UA creative, with a portfolio that shows both craft and an understanding of what drives results.

 - A self-set high bar – demonstrable evidence (work-related or not) of pushing your craft further than required, without anyone telling you to.

 - Demonstrated ability to capture polished footage across multiple games, genres and devices.

 - Expert proficiency with capture and editing tools – OBS Studio and Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Premiere, Media Encoder).

 - Hands-on experience (or strong, demonstrable aptitude) with AI-assisted creative tools, and a genuine drive to build them into a production workflow.

 - A strong feel for gameplay across genres, and an instinct for the moments that resonate with different player audiences.

 - Proven ability to produce high-quality creative quickly and at volume under tight, iterative deadlines.

 - A collaborative, data-aware mindset and the maturity to "disagree and commit" – push your point of view hard, then get fully behind the decision.

 - Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to own multiple titles and projects in parallel with little oversight.
   
   


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - Strong motion design, graphic design or animation skills.

 - Affinity for digital trends and memes, and the ability to apply them seamlessly into creative.

 - Experience with Unreal Engine for gameplay capture, camera work or visual effects.

 - Experience in a high-volume creative testing environment (in-house UA team or performance-focused agency)


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role will be based in our Helsinki office.

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. title: Senior Product Builder - Talent Pool
location: Prague · Nicosia · France - Remote · Estonia - Remote · European Union - Remote
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.

AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.

Your Impact:

• Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec

• Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.

• Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt

• Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents

• Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line

• Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time

• Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill

Your Qualifications:

• Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19

• A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket

• Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role

• Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already

• Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad

• Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work

Our Stack:

• Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL

• TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart

• PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ

• Unit/integration testing, Java web stack

• AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP

Benefits & Perks:

• 5 Weeks of paid vacation

• Sick Leave Compensation

• 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days

• 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional

• 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate

• Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity

• 2 Volunteer Days

• Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day)

• Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka)

• Hybrid Working Model

• Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus

Interested in joining Wrike when the right opportunity opens up? Apply to our Senior Builder today. We’ll reach out as soon as a suitable role becomes available, or simply to arrange a Meet & Greet call.

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexander Chernev, Senior Recruiter.

#LI-AC1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

description:
About Huawei

Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world.

At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. We have more than 200,000 employees, of which 55% are employed in R&D, and we operate in more than 170 countries and regions.

Huawei invests more than 20% of revenues in R&D every year: in the past 10 years our total R&D investments exceed 150B USD.

By the end of 2023, Huawei held +140.000 active patents.

Find out more about Huawei at this link https://www.huawei.com/en/about-huawei

Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes.

Who we are

· Our motto is "make it possible", we use our customer-centric obsession, our perseverance, our dedication and a continuous self-challenge to accomplish the most challenging goals and always raise the bar!

· We think and execute very fast, but we are never superficial and always guarantee the highest standards.

· We are obsessed about continuous improvement and about creating value for the company, for the employees and for society.

· We are like a big multicultural family where relationships are informal and direct and where cooperation and support are our daily keywords.

· We are a place where "results talk and ideas walk", good ideas are always welcome, but you have to take ownership and make them happen too.

· Openness and flexibility are our mantra.

Milan Aesthetic Research Center (MARC) — Huawei

At the Milan Aesthetic Research Center (MARC), design is not just a discipline — it’s a cultural engine.

MARC is one of Huawei’s global research hubs dedicated to shaping the emotional and aesthetic identity of future cars and brands. Here, we explore new designs, forms, materials, and new experiences that elevate Huawei’s global design language.

As an Automotive Creative Exterior Component Designer, you will join a team where imagination meets advanced technology. Besides being a vital part of the exterior design team, you’ll collaborate with specialists in Product, UX, and Brand, contributing to the next generation of Huawei mobility experiences. All of this happens in the heart of Milan, a city where design, fashion, and innovation collide every day.

What will you be doing?

•
Create bold unique and advanced designs for car exterior components, such as lights, cameras, radars, Lidars, wheels and even more elements that push boundaries and define the next wave of Huawei automotive aesthetics.

•
Shape ideas from sketch to final product, this means that you will follow projects from early concept exploration to production‑ready proposals.

•
By elevating creativity you will be bringing strong creative energy, curiosity, and attention to detail, refining ideas into polished, competitive design solutions.

•
Create compelling design stories that help to present your concepts clearly and confidently, ensuring alignment across teams.

•
Understand the world’s fastest‑moving market by building a deep understanding of the Chinese automotive landscape and its design dynamics.

•
Collaborate globally! You will be travelling to China and other project hubs several times per year to support development, benchmark trends, and work closely with HQ design teams.

What skills do you bring?

•
A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Automotive Design or Product Design.

•
Experience in automotive or mobility design within a top‑tier agency or in‑house studio (3-7 years of experience is a plus, or a highly creative portfolio).

•
Strong 2D/3D design abilities — from expressive sketching to refined digital rendering.

•
Advanced proficiency in Blender or similar 3D programs for modeling and visualization.

•
Ability to collaborate with engineers.

•
A portfolio that demonstrates strong design thinking across multiple sectors.

•
Excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate design intent.

•
A collaborative mindset with the confidence to work independently when needed.

•
Fluency in English; Chinese is a plus.

•
Comfort working in a multicultural, international environment.

What We Offer:

We offer you an exciting professional career in one of the leading and fastest growing multinational technology companies, challenging work and a competitive salary package. Personal development is ensured through many training opportunities in Europe and abroad.

We offer a gross annual salary typically ranging from €80.000 to €90.000 determined according to objective criteria such as professional experience, competencies, and seniority. The applicable collective bargaining agreement is the CCNL Telecommunications, within level 7°.

Privacy Statement

We therefore commit to protecting your privacy following the local legal data privacy legislation. Please read and understand our West European Recruitment Privacy Notice before submitting your personal data to Huawei so that you fully understand how we process and manage your personal data received (http://career.huawei.com/reccampportal/portal/hrd/weu_rec_all.html)

title: Product Designer, Coordinate
description:
We're looking for a Product Designer who is excited by our mission of designing the future of teamwork. With millions of teams using Asana across the globe, our work has only just begun. Join us on a journey of driving clarity for teams, individuals and executives. As designers we are streamlining how teams get work done in a more efficient, effective and delightful way. You’ll make it as simple as possible for teams big and small to realize the value of Asana.

The Coordinate team owns the workflows that sit at the heart of how organizations run: capturing work wherever it happens, and seeing it through to completion. We're building the experiences that users depend on today, while evolving them for a world where humans and agents execute together. When we get this right, Asana becomes the OS for human-agent teams: the place where critical work doesn't just get tracked, but actually gets done.

About the Design team

We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world’s teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.

Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We’re a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centered design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.

We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

Our employees in Poland are employed under a contract of employment.

What you’ll achieve

• Lead the design of end-to-end experiences for Asana products and features

• Partner with cross-functional partners to identify customer problems, establish vision, set strategy, build and ship solutions

• Champion product excellence. Elevate the quality bar for our experience and contribute to our design system

• Work across the organization to ship experiences that are cohesive with the broader Asana product experience, ensuring your design scales

• Facilitate and role model human-centered problem solving. Foster co-creation across the organization

• Learn new methods to solve deeply complex problems in the service of inventing new ways to deliver our customer benefits: flow, efficiency, and engagement

• Help shape a product that is intuitive and elegant, which speaks from a unified voice

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

• 5+ years of experience in product design

• A strong portfolio that showcases a track record of shipping high-quality interaction and interface design work

• Skilled in driving a human-centered design process, clearly communicating design work with solid rationale informed by research and data, and working collaboratively to ship end-to-end features at scale

• Experience designing and shipping web, desktop, and/or native mobile applications

• Creative problem-solver that embraces divergent and iterative methods in order to evolve concepts from raw ideas to beautiful polished designs

• You embody openness, curiosity, and a growth mindset

• Customer-centric: elicits non-obvious customer needs, synthesizes research to gain a deep understanding and narrow definition of a problem

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer:

• Generous, transparent and fair compensation system

• Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles )

• Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med)

• Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the office

• Career growth budget

• Home office setup budget

• Gym/Fitness reimbursement

• Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot

• Mental Health Support in Modern Health

• Group life insurance

• MacBooks with all necessary accessories

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 24,916 - 27,479 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: VFX Artist
description:
We're looking for a FX Artist to craft believable, high-fidelity real-time effects for a visually grounded game. You'll be responsible for the explosions, fire, smoke, fluids, weather, environmental ambiance, weapon and impact effects, and gameplay-critical readability that make our world feel physical and alive. You'll work closely with art, design, and engineering to push realism while hitting performance and clarity targets.

Example of responsibilities

•
Create and own high-quality real-time visual effects: fire, smoke, explosions, debris, fluids, atmospherics, weather, and surface/impact responses, grounded in real-world reference.

•
Build effects that balance visual fidelity, gameplay readability, and runtime performance across target platforms.

•
Author shaders and materials for FX, and collaborate with tech artists/engineers on simulation, lighting integration, and optimization.

•
Develop and maintain reusable VFX systems, tools, and libraries to scale quality across the team.

•
Partner with design and animation to ensure effects communicate gameplay clearly (telegraphs, hit feedback, state changes).

•
Profile and optimize effects (overdraw, particle counts, draw calls, GPU cost) and debug issues across the pipeline.

•
Contribute to look development, references, and visual targets alongside the Art Director and VFX Lead.

It would be awesome if you have

•
5+ years of professional VFX experience in games, with at least one shipped title (or comparable production work).

•
Strong real-time VFX skills in a modern engine; Unreal Engine (Niagara) and/or Unity (VFX Graph/Shuriken).

•
Solid understanding of the physics and behavior behind realistic effects

•
Proficiency with node-based shaders/materials and a good grasp of real-time lighting and rendering.

•
Experience authoring textures and simulations using tools such as Houdini, EmberGen, Substance, or similar.

•
A strong artistic eye, timing, silhouette, color, composition, and motion.

•
Performance-minded: comfortable profiling and optimizing for frame budgets.

•
Strong communication and collaboration skills across art, design, and engineering.

Nice to have

•
Houdini for VFX simulation and tool/HDA creation.

•
Experience with fluid/destruction systems (e.g., Chaos, FLIP/Pyro).

•
Scripting (Python, Blueprint, or similar) for tooling and automation.

•
Background in film/VFX or a strong traditional art/photography foundation.

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, a generous profit-sharing program, and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and are looking forward to reading more about you (in English)!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

The work is unlike anything you've done before.

Defence. Autonomous aircraft. Sovereign AI. Ethics. These are not the usual inputs for a graphic designer. But they are yours now, and the question of how you communicate them, visually, with precision and intelligence, is one of the most interesting design problems in Europe right now. 

This is a high-output role. You will be the engine of a fast-moving creative team, executing across the full range of Helsing's visual output.

The day-to-day

• Design web pages, social content, and digital assets 

• Create exhibition stands, event environments, and branded experiences 

• Develop identities for new and existing products or partnerships 

• Design product brochures, technical publications, and campaign materials that make complex ideas feel inevitable 

• Build presentations shown to the highest levels of government and industry 

• Work across clothing, merchandise, and brand objects 

• Own projects from brief to production, managing timelines, vendors, and your own judgment 

You should apply if you

• Have a portfolio demonstrating high-quality work across diverse formats and disciplines. Please include a PDF or link, with any relevant websites or videos

title: Director of Product Design
description:

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

As Mechanical Designer, you will own the design and development of mechanical parts and full assemblies for current and future drone products within Helsing's physical products and hardware engineering organisation. Working from requirements through to validated hardware, you will translate engineering constraints into robust, scalable, and cost-effective components. Your work spans the full design cycle: from concept and CAD documentation through to prototype integration and validation testing. The designs you deliver will directly determine the structural integrity, manufacturability, and operational reliability of Helsing's drone platforms.

Translate comprehensive requirements sets into design concepts, applying analytical assessments to standard mechanical elements such as bolts, bearings and fittings to verify form, fit and function

Plan and execute validation test campaigns that drive technical maturation and reduce programme risk at each design milestone

Have designed and delivered mechanical parts and assemblies for aerospace or similarly demanding applications, using 3D and 2D CAD tools such as SolidWorks/PDM or Siemens NX/Teamcenter

Have integrated and tested prototypes hands-on, using test outcomes to iterate and improve designs against defined requirements

Communicate complex design intent clearly in written English, producing documentation that meets rigorous engineering quality standards within a PLM environment

Act decisively with minimal guidance, own outcomes end-to-end and initiate solutions without waiting for direction

title: Design Leader, Software Design
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Design Leader of Software Design to lead the end-to-end experience of Oura’s software products, with a primary focus on our member-facing mobile and web experiences. This role sits alongside our most senior individual contributors and is expected to operate in high ambiguity, set a clear design vision, and create enduring, company-level impact across multiple product areas.

You will build, lead, and mentor a multi-disciplinary design organization, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Brand to deliver coherent, insight-driven experiences across Oura’s ecosystem. You are accountable for raising the bar across four core dimensions: Operational Excellence (craft & execution), Impact (strategy & product value), Collaboration (communication & alignment), and Leadership (culture & people). This is a highly collaborative, hands-on leadership role based in Helsinki with a hybrid work model.

What you will do:

Lead and develop a high-performing design organization
You manage software design teams, overseeing multiple designers and design leads. You create the conditions for excellent work: clear expectations, strong feedback structures, and genuine investment in people’s growth. Your management style builds trust while holding a consistently high bar for design quality.

Mentor and develop designers
You invest in the people around you. You support designers at all levels through regular 1:1s, career conversations, and honest, actionable feedback. You help them see around corners, develop their craft, and grow their confidence, not just their output.

Set a compelling, coherent design vision
You define what great looks like for Oura’s member-facing experiences across mobile and web and you make that vision concrete and actionable for the team. You bring systems thinking to the full experience: flows, states, transitions, information hierarchy, microcopy, and the moments between interactions that make or break how a product feels.

Elevate craft through active participation
You are in the room for the work that matters. You lead critiques and working sessions that meaningfully improve what the team produces, not by overriding, but by modeling stronger thinking, asking sharper questions, and holding the quality line. Your presence raises the bar without taking over.

Define and steward the design system
You treat the design system as a lever for coherence and velocity, not overhead. You work with design leads to evolve it as the product scales, ensuring it reflects Oura’s visual language and interaction standards across every surface.

Partner with product and engineering without ceding design authority
You build strong working relationships with product leadership and collaborate on roadmap priorities but you bring a distinct design perspective to those conversations. You know when to push back on pressures that would compromise the member experience, and you do it with clarity and respect.

Build and steward the team
You play an active role in recruiting, hiring, and onboarding designers. You help define what the team needs, and you bring the same rigor to hiring decisions that you bring to design decisions. Over time, you help shape the culture, norms, and practices that make the team exceptional.

Champion AI-enabled design workflows
You lead initiatives to incorporate AI tools, workflows, and new mental models that improve the speed, quality, and personalization of Oura’s experiences. You help designers see themselves as creative directors of AI-assisted output.

Requirements

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

• Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in software design, product design, or interaction design for digital products, including significant time in consumer or health tech environments.

• Proven leadership experience (3+ years) managing and growing UX teams in a product development organization, including setting clear expectations across different levels.

• A portfolio that demonstrates sustained ownership of complex, multi-surface experiences with clear evidence of your design thinking, not just team output. We want to understand your role in shaping outcomes, not just artifacts, especially in highly ambiguous or multi-quarter initiatives.

• Deep fluency across interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, motion, and systems thinking. You’ve shipped polished, coherent consumer software and you understand the difference between good and great at the detail level.

• Track record of improving experience quality in measurable ways through engagement signals, satisfaction scores, qualitative research findings, or reduced friction in core user flows.

• Demonstrated excellence in Operational Excellence (strong craft and execution on complex, multi-platform products) and Impact (connecting software design work to clear product outcomes).

• Strong evidence of Collaboration and Leadership: building effective cross-functional relationships, influencing senior stakeholders, and creating healthy, inclusive team cultures.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and facilitating complex design decisions.

We love

• Experience working on health, wellness, or other trust-sensitive products where emotional tone, clarity, and credibility must be carefully calibrated.

• A history of making the teams around you better through mentorship, cultural contribution, and sustained investment in design quality.

• Experience owning or co-owning a consumer design system and evolving it to serve a scaling product.

• Fluency with high-fidelity interaction prototyping not just static mocks, but communicating motion, feel, and micro-interactions at a fidelity that engineering can build from.

• Experience working with user researchers as partners: drawing on their insights to pressure-test and evolve design direction, without owning the research function yourself.

• Curiosity about AI tools and their effect on design practice with opinions about where human judgment is irreplaceable.

• Experience navigating the intersection of product design and brand, and knowing when and how to hold the line on quality.

What we offer

• Competitive salary

• Lunch benefit

• Wellness benefit

• Flexible working hours

• Collaborative, smart teammates

• An Oura ring of your own

• Wellness Time Off

If this sounds like the next step for you, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible. We aim to start interviewing as soon as suitable candidates are found.

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
