title: Staff Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA - Hybrid; Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid; Toronto, Ontario - Remote

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto’s looking to bring on several Staff Product Designers across our Money and HR Experience product organizations. These teams sit on some of the highest-stakes, most AI-native surfaces at Gusto, where small businesses make financial and people decisions that carry real impact, and where getting the experience right is what builds durable trust. That's exactly why judgment, taste, and craft matter here.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll own experiences end to end within a specific domain, turning ambiguity into clear, trustworthy products and helping define patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto. You'll be deeply embedded in the product quartet, driving design decisions in partnership with Product Managers and Engineers, and demonstrating high craft and storytelling every step of the way.

This is one job posting for five open roles in Gusto Money, Banking, and HR Experiences product orgs. You'll be matched to the opportunity that best fits your strengths and interests. Here are the teams currently hiring:

• Consumer Banking: Consumer Banking builds financial products for the millions of employees paid through Gusto, anchored to Gusto Wallet — spend accounts, savings goals, paycheck splitting, and on-demand access to earned wages. Because Gusto runs payroll, the team sits at the source of income itself, helping workers smooth cash flow between paychecks, save automatically, and avoid predatory alternatives like payday lenders and overdraft fees. One of the fastest-growing engines in Gusto Banking, it moves at a startup pace while incubating 0→1 foundational technology in a regulated space where trust, reliability, and craft are everything.

•

Gusto Money: MoneyOS is the team within Gusto Money focused on helping small businesses better understand, manage, and improve their financial position. This is an especially exciting moment for the team. The space is still taking shape, which means there’s real room to define the product, the patterns, and the customer expectations. MoneyOS works at the intersection of product strategy, financial systems, customer trust, and emerging AI-native ways of building—making it a strong fit for a designer who wants to have outsized influence on both what we build and how we build it.

• HR Experiences (HRX): HRX helps small businesses get expert HR help right inside the product — a customer simply says what they need, and Gusto takes the action, answers the question, or brings in a human expert when the stakes are high. You'll design AI-native experiences across a two-sided service — the everyday self-serve moments, the AI that guides and does the work, and the human HR experts who step in when it matters most — so it all feels like one Gusto, in a domain where judgment and trust matter enormously.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

• Own design end to end in your domain — from framing ambiguous problems to shipping high-craft, accessible experiences that hide the underlying complexity from customers.

• Shape goals, priorities, and roadmap in partnership with your PM and engineering lead, balancing customer trust, business value, and technical realities.

• Translate ambiguous, often 0→1 strategy into clear scopes, flows, and interaction patterns — including patterns that don't yet exist at Gusto.

• Design the experience of AI thoughtfully — representing uncertainty, surfacing errors gracefully, preserving customer agency, and knowing when a human should step in.

• Ground your decisions in customer insight, leading or partnering on research, competitive audits, and hypothesis-driven exploration in high-stakes, sometimes compliance-sensitive domains.

• Raise the craft and systems bar, evolving Gusto's design system where existing patterns fall short.

• Work in fast cycles and use AI tools in your own practice — set a clear target, prototype and ship real things to customers, and let what you learn sharpen the direction.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 6+ years of product design experience owning and shipping end-to-end work, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another high-trust domain, with strong craft across web.

• Experience designing AI-enabled or conversational experiences shipped to real users, and you can speak concretely to how you handled uncertainty, errors, and human override.

• Comfort with ambiguity and 0→1, you frame the problem, scope the work, and move forward without waiting for perfect information.

• Strong systems thinking, you use and contribute to a design system and know when to evolve it.

• Judgment to evaluate and direct AI outputs, when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the bar, especially where the cost of being wrong is high.

• Strong collaboration and communication across design, product, engineering, and data.

Bonus points

• Experience in a high-stakes or regulated domain, fintech, financial services, HR, compliance, legal, or healthcare.

• Hands-on experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences, shaping how an AI or agent behaves, communicates, and hands off to a human.

• Service-design fluency across two-sided or multi-stakeholder products: real journey mapping and blueprinting with operational handoffs, not workshop exercises.

• Helped lead a team's shift to AI-native workflows, and can speak to what changed about the work itself, not just the tools.

• Background contributing to AI governance, evaluation practices, or AI experience design patterns.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $146,000/yr to $183,000/yr in Denver, and $177,000/yr to $222,000/yr in San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Head of Design
description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

• Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.

• Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.

• Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.

• Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.

• Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.

• Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.

• Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.

• Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.

• Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.

• Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.

• Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.

• Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

• Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.

• Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.

• The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.

• Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.

• Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

• Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.

• A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.

• Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.

• Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.

• Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.

• A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.

• The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.

• A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

description:

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

The Opportunity

• Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.

• Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.

• Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.

• Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.

• Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.

• Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.

• Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.

• Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.

• Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.

• Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.

• Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.

• Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.

• Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.

• Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.

• Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.

• Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.

• Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.

• Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.

• Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.

• Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.

title: Senior Product Designer (Remote)
description:
Headquarters: Remote

What is SeekOut?  

SeekOut is a leader in AI-driven talent optimization, helping organizations recruit, reskill, and redeploy talent with AI-driven solutions. SeekOut transforms how companies build winning teams by empowering organizations to align talent strategy with business strategy via breakthrough agentic AI solutions. Our software and services help companies ensure that they hire the right people and match their talent to the highest-impact roles to drive business success. 

What are we looking to add to our team?

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who is deeply creative, visually opinionated, and energized by hard, undefined problems. This role is for a designer who thinks beyond patterns, challenges conventions, and takes pride in exceptional craft. You are bold in your ideas, brave in your execution, and uncompromising when it comes to visual quality. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast without losing taste, and believe great design should feel intentional, surprising, and deeply human.

What you’ll be doing:

• Invent the future of AI recruiting. Design precedent-setting AI and ML-driven product experiences where there is no established playbook, balancing usability, trust, and delight.

• Create bold 0→1 experiences. Explore new interaction models, visual languages, and product concepts that push beyond conventional enterprise UX.

• Design with taste and intention. Produce high-craft, polished design work across flows, surfaces, and systems with a strong point of view on visual quality.

• Rapidly iterate and refine. Generate, test, and evolve ideas quickly, moving from rough concepts to confident solutions with speed and clarity.

• Tell compelling product stories. Use visuals, prototypes, and narrative to clearly communicate the intent, emotion, and experience behind your designs.

• Make it real. Translate conceptual thinking into production-ready designs that engineers can build and users can immediately understand.

• Build and extend design systems. Contribute to scalable, well-structured design systems that enable fast iteration while maintaining a high visual bar.

• Leverage modern design tools. Work fluently in Figma, using components, variables, auto-layout, and prototyping to move efficiently from idea to execution.

• Experiment with generative AI. Use generative AI tools to explore concepts, accelerate ideation, and push creative boundaries in how products are imagined and designed.

• Stay curious and experimental. Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities, interaction paradigms, and visual trends to keep SeekOut’s products modern and distinctive.

What you’ll accomplish in your first 6–12 months:

• Deliver standout, high-impact 0→1 designs for new AI-driven recruiting and talent products.

• Raise the visual and experiential bar on the product surfaces you own.

• Ship designs that meaningfully improve clarity, trust, and delight in complex workflows.

• Demonstrate rapid iteration cycles that balance speed, exploration, and exceptional craft.

What you’ll bring to the team:

• 5+ years of experience designing and shipping high-quality product experiences in SaaS, enterprise, or AI-driven software.

• Proven success delivering 0→1 products or features in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Exceptional visual design skills, with a sharp eye for layout, typography, motion, and interaction detail.

• High proficiency in Figma, including advanced use of components, variables, auto-layout, prototyping, and design systems.

• Deep experience working within and extending design systems without sacrificing creativity or quality.

• Strong ability to rapidly iterate, explore multiple directions, and converge on high-confidence solutions.

• Experience using generative AI design tools as part of the creative process is a major plus.

• Comfort challenging assumptions and proposing unconventional solutions when the problem demands it.

• A deep passion for craft, aesthetics, and pushing quality beyond “good enough.”

• A portfolio that clearly demonstrates creative range, bold thinking, rapid iteration, and outstanding execution across real products.

A design portfolio is a requirement to be considered for this role.  To confirm you’ve read this posting, enter the word LIGHTHOUSE in the question at the end of the application.

At SeekOut, pay equity is at the heart of our compensation philosophy and approach. Our goal is to provide a transparent, fair and rewarding environment where team members are equitably compensated for substantially similar work, feel supported, and ultimately choose to grow their careers here at SeekOut.  To ensure fairness for new hires and existing team members, we factor in an individual's unique skills and experience, market data, and the internal equity of the team.

title: Head of Design
description:
Headquarters: Germany (Remote); London, United Kingdom; Poland (Remote); Romania (Remote)

At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the role

We're looking for a Head of Design who still loves to design. You'll lead a small, strong team of product designers, set the bar for craft and for how we work with AI, and spend about half your time designing with some of our teams.

Ledgy's problems are dense and high-stakes: finance, legal and HR teams use us to manage real ownership and real money across many countries. Design here has to be precise and still feel simple. As the company grows into new markets and new products, you'll shape what design at Ledgy becomes.

Design at Ledgy is AI-first. Work starts with AI models, moves into working prototypes in our codebase, and lands in Figma for the system. Every team ships agent features. You'll make sure the whole team does this well, consistently, and with judgement.

Reports to: VP of Product

Location: Hybrid from our London office, remote in the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland or Romania

What you'll do

Lead the team (~50%)

• Manage and grow three product designers working across our product teams: regular 1:1s, honest feedback, clear growth paths.

• Hire: help shape roles, run interviews and grow the team as Ledgy grows.

• Partner with product and engineering leadership on planning, staffing and the design vision across all teams.

• Own the direction of our design system and shared AI patterns (how agents ask, act, explain and undo), together with engineering.

• Define how we design with AI: tools, workflows, prototypes in code, shared skills and prompts. Make it easy for every designer to work this way.

• Run design critique and design reviews, and own the quality bar across the product.

Design hands-on (~50%)

• Be the designer for one of our teams (for example Tax, Trading, AI Systems - to be decided together): contribute to Ledgy’s product experiences, from agents and AI-assisted workflows to the our trading integrations and compliance reporting

• Prototype in code in our real codebase, and open small front-end PRs when it's faster than a handoff.

• Set the example: work in the open, show your thinking, ship.

You'll thrive here if you

• Have 10+ years in product design on complex B2B or data-dense products, including 2+ years leading or managing designers.

• Still design and prototype yourself, and want to keep doing it.

• Are AI-native: you know when to prototype, when to stop and think, which tool fits which job, and how to turn that into habits a team can share.

• Understand how AI agents work well enough to design for them and argue with engineers about them: the model, the harness, tool calls, APIs, audit trails.

• Build your own tools: prompts, skills, small automations, and help others build theirs.

• Raise quality through people, not just through your own work: you've grown designers and improved how a team works.

• Communicate clearly with leadership and influence decisions across product and engineering. Fluent English.

Nice to have

• Experience in equity, fintech, tax, payroll or accounting software.

• Led design for AI or agent products that shipped to real customers.

• Built or evolved a design system in code.

What your journey could look like

• First 30 days: Meet every designer, PM and EM; learn the product and our customers; review how the team works today.

• First 3 months: Run the team's rituals, ship your first work, and propose how design should work with AI across teams.

• 6–12 months: Grow the team, raise the craft bar visibly, and set the design vision for the next stage of Ledgy.

Our interview process

• Recruiter call (30 min): you, us, the role, logistics.

• Hiring manager interview (45 min): how you work, lead and decide.

• Portfolio presentation (60 min): two projects, at least one showing how you work with AI, and one story about building or leading a team.

You'll get a short guide before each step.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
As an Industrial Designer at Foster + Partners, you’ll join our growing Industrial Design team, creating furniture and product design solutions for major architectural projects, private commissions, and globally recognised design-led brands. You'll have the opportunity to take ideas from concept through to manufacture, combining creativity, technical expertise and hands-on making skills to deliver innovative, high-quality design outcomes.

This role is ideal if you want to:

• Design furniture and product solutions for a diverse range of architectural, commercial and bespoke projects.

• Develop concepts from initial sketches through to detailed design, prototyping and manufacture.

• Collaborate with architects, interior designers, manufacturers and external design teams.

• Take ownership of key aspects of project delivery and design development.

• Work in a highly creative, multidisciplinary environment where innovation and craftsmanship are valued.

What you will bring to the team:

• Strong experience in industrial, furniture or product design, with the ability to deliver high-quality design solutions.

• Proficiency in Rhino, SolidWorks or similar CAD software, producing high-quality 3D models, technical drawings and presentation materials.

• Experience creating physical prototypes, presentation models or workshop-made design studies.

• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• A proactive, self-motivated approach with confidence taking ownership of your work.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships across multidisciplinary teams and external partners.

• A flexible and collaborative mindset, with the resilience to thrive in a fast-paced design environment.

What we offer:

We offer a benefits package designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. This includes: private medical insurance for you and your family; life assurance; personal travel insurance; access to a range of wellbeing support, comprising virtual GP services, mental health support and lifestyle coaching; as well as discount programmes for various retailers. On our London campus, we have subsidised catering facilities and host regular social events, and sports activities, for everyone to enjoy.

To support you in building a meaningful career, the practice offers opportunities to develop both your technical and non-technical skills through continuous learning, professional development support, and knowledge sharing and insights from experienced colleagues.

If our designs spark your curiosity and you would like to contribute to solving complex challenges with local and global impact, we invite you to join our team. You’ll be challenged and inspired, collaborating on extraordinary projects in an environment designed to cultivate excellence.

About Foster + Partners

We believe in the power of design to enhance everyday life. Through a culture of purposeful curiosity, our work defines the way tomorrow’s built environments look, feel and function. Founded in 1967 by Norman Foster, what began as a small team is now a global practice with an outstanding design legacy, creating innovative and thoughtful solutions that shape skylines and landscapes around the world.

Whether designing an entire city or a bespoke door handle, we approach every project with ambition and dedicated creativity - and we seek exceptional people to enrich our practice. If you enjoy solving complex challenges and creating industry-defining designs and solutions, we invite you to join our team.

The practice is committed to supporting diversity and inclusivity and strives to create a working environment that is responsive to different cultures. We value the contributions of our diverse and creative team and are proud to offer equal opportunities for all.

If you have any questions about our application process, or need support submitting your application, please contact us at [email protected].

Details on how we process and retain applicant data are set out in our PreHire Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Industrial Designer
description:
We don’t just believe in better. We make it happen.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.

Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, Sky Stream to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate. We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love. And we do it all right here at Sky.

Role/Team overview

Coming up with fresh ideas. Pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Creating unforgettable customer experiences. Our Design & our Sky Labs Brentwood & Aalborg teams make things happen. That’s why we’re at the heart of delivering the hardware and software for devices that keep our customers entertained. From ID and UX/UI to product strategy and hardware engineering, we bring new devices like Sky Glass and NOW to life at top speed and support them throughout the lifecycle.

What you’ll do

• Lead the industrial design of world-class physical devices.

• Take complex briefs and shape them into simple, elegant, and cohesive design strategies.

• Define and drive a compelling physical design language across a diverse product portfolio.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners across engineering, UI/UX, and product management.

• Own the full design process – from early concepting and 3D CAD to prototyping and production sign-off.

• Champion visual storytelling, using sketching, mock-ups, and presentations to communicate ideas with clarity and impact.

• Mentor and guide other designers, consistently raising standards across the industrial design team.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

• A strategic mindset – able to zoom out, frame the right questions, and bring forward simple, coherent solutions.

• Extensive experience in industrial design, with a strong Industrial/Product Design portfolio of shipped products.

• Exceptional communication skills – comfortable explaining ideas verbally and through visual storytelling.

• Expertise in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Rhino, or similar), KeyShot, Adobe CC, and physical prototyping.

• Strong understanding of CMF, DFM, and high-volume manufacturing techniques.

• Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary projects, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

• A collaborative and curious attitude – thrives in team settings and brings energy to creative problem-solving.

• A passion for designing thoughtful, beautiful, and durable products that improve everyday life.

• You must include an up-to-date portfolio to demonstrate your work at the point of application

Desirable skills and experience:

• Experience working on CMF-focused projects.

• Experience designing consumer electronics or other high-volume manufactured products.

Benefits and perks

There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:

• Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema

• Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution

• Private healthcare with mental health support

• Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance

• Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect

• Tech schemes

• A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

How you’ll work

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week.

Your office base

Our Osterley Campus is a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station. Or you can hop on one of our free shuttle buses that run to and from Osterley, Gunnersbury, Ealing Broadway and South Ealing tube stations. There are also plenty of bike shelters and showers.

On campus, you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants, cafes, and a Waitrose. You can keep in shape at our subsidised gym, catch the latest shows and movies at our cinema, get your car washed, and even get pampered at our beauty salon.

Who we are

We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.

Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK. Please be aware Sky does not offer sponsorship for this position.

To find out more about working with us, search #LifeAtSky on social media.

title: Industrial Designer
description:
Hola 👋

Somos Jungle Design Industries, una firma de diseño que integra investigación, estrategia, branding, diseño digital y de producto en un único modelo. ¿La buena noticia? Buscamos una nueva incorporación en nuestro equipo de Barcelona.

Antes de nada, nos es importante poder compartirte cuáles son nuestros valores, ya que son parte de nuestra esencia y estamos seguros de que también parte del éxito de nuestros proyectos. Aquí te los compartimos con mucho orgullo:

• Somos facilitadores. Sabemos hacer fácil lo difícil.

• Somos impacto positivo. En nuestros proyectos, pero también en las pequeñas acciones de cada día.

• Somos gente buena en nuestro trabajo, pero lo más importante: somos buena gente.

• Somos #DesignLovers. Vivimos, amamos y respiramos diseño.

Si crees que todo esto encaja con tu forma de ser y trabajar, tendrás que seguir leyendo, ya que con el fit cultural asegurado, es probable que esta oferta encaje con tu perfil ;)

Y además de alcanzar retos, disfrutarás de hacerlo en un equipo de personas entusiastas y en una agencia orientada a una cultura sólida y fuerte que prioriza el work-life balance:

• Formarás parte del equipo desde el minuto 0: aquí los retos se consiguen y se celebran en conjunto.

• Recursos a tope: últimas tecnologías y herramientas para potenciar tu creatividad.

• Horario flexible (entrada entre las 7 y las 10), tardes libres los viernes y jornada intensiva en agosto.

• Modelo híbrido: 2 días de teletrabajo y 3 días en nuestra oficina ubicada en el distrito 22@.

• Eventos periódicos para compartir tiempo y celebrar hitos.

• Retribución flexible en seguro médico, comida, transporte y guarderías a través de la tarjeta Cobee.

• Trabajarás en la sede Jungle Barna, un ecosistema creativo que compartimos con otras empresas del grupo Jungle donde la combinatoria y la innovación fluyen constantemente ;)

Tu día a día

• Conceptualización y diseño de producto: Desarrollo de propuestas creativas desde el ideado inicial hasta la definición tridimensional detallada.

• Integración de IA en el proceso creativo: Aplicación de herramientas de IA generativa y diseño paramétrico para acelerar la exploración de formas, texturas y variantes conceptuales.

• Modelado 3D y renderizado hiperrealista: Dominio de herramientas avanzadas para la creación de modelos digitales finos y visualizaciones de alto impacto visual.

• Selección de materiales y ecodiseño: Investigación e implementación de nuevos materiales de bajo impacto ambiental alineados con la filosofía B Corp.

• Prototipado y validación técnica: Supervisión de maquetas y prototipos analizando la viabilidad ergonómica, funcional y de fabricación.

• Colaboración internacional y comunicación: Presentación y defensa de conceptos en inglés ante clientes globales y equipos multidisciplinares.

Cómo te imaginamos

• Formación en Diseño Industrial, Desarrollo de Producto o Ingeniería en Diseño Industrial.

• Experiencia previa demostrable en estudio de diseño, consultoría o departamento de producto.

• Manejo experto en software de modelado 3D (Rhino, SolidWorks) y motores de renderizado junto a la Suite Adobe.

• Uso habitual de IA aplicada al diseño: Conocimiento práctico de herramientas como Midjourney, Stable Diffusion o plugins de IA para optimizar briefings e ideación.

• Nivel de inglés profesional (C1): Capacidad fluida para comunicar, redactar documentación técnica y presentar proyectos ante stakeholders internacionales.

• Sensibilidad estética y visión sostenible: Obsesión por el detalle, la usabilidad, la economía circular y la innovación de materiales.

Un último (pero necesario) apunte:
A veces las personas tendemos a subestimar nuestras capacidades delante de ofertas de trabajo como esta. Si te está pasando, no dudes en apuntarte. Aquí todos abrazamos nuestro síndrome del impostor para lograr ser mejores.

Si toooooooodo esto te encaja, esperamos con ganas tu candidatura. Por nuestra la revisaremos personalmente y si surge la chispa, te contactaremos para una entrevista virtual.

En Jungle promovemos la diversidad y nos comprometemos a brindar oportunidades laborales incluyentes, independientemente de la raza, etnia, religión, sexo, nacionalidad, edad, ciudadanía, estado civil, discapacidad, género, identidad o expresión de género o condición de veterano. Trabajamos arduamente para convertirnos en un lugar de trabajo respetuoso, feliz y con oportunidades más equitativas.

title: Childrenswear Footwear Designer - Brands
description:
Working Pattern: Typically 5 days in the office, with core hours flexible between 8am-6pm.

We love seeing enthusiastic applications, and we want to help you make the best decision for your career! We encourage all applicants to self-assess against our key criteria. You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• Are an established Designer or an experienced Senior Assistant Designer ready to step up.

• Have experience of designing for fast-paced UK highstreet retailers.

• Have a trend-obsessed mindset, with a talent for translating runway and global street-style into commercially viable collections.

• Are highly proficient in Adobe packages & experience of AI software.

• Can demonstrate experience of management or mentoring Assistant Designer or a Graduate/Trainee Designer.

• Have experience within the product category and design field you are applying for is desirable.

The Role

As a Childrenswear Footwear Designer within Next’s Fashion Brands team, you will act as a creative guardian for a prestigious brand portfolio, ensuring the brand's unique "DNA" is translated into elevated, commercially successful designs across Children’s Footwear.

By bridging the gap between trend research and technical execution, you’ll make a tangible impact on the aesthetic direction of our collections, reacting with agility to market data to keep our offerings ahead of the curve.

You will thrive in a highly collaborative environment, working side-by-side with partner brands and internal garment teams to bring concepts to life across diverse product categories. To ensure your success from day one, Next provides comprehensive brand immersion and technical onboarding, supporting your transition into our fast-paced, premium design landscape. This role will be based in London.

What You’ll Take On

• Design Childrenswear Collections: Create innovative, commercial, and elevated Childrenswear garments that blend technical functionality with licensed brand aesthetics.

• Manage Factory Partnerships: Liaise directly with global factories and specialist suppliers to oversee the manufacturing process, ensuring your garment shapes and technical details translate perfectly into the final product.

• Build Trusted Licensing Relationships: Foster strong, professional bonds with external license brand partners and internal teams to build a culture of confidence, trust, and seamless collaboration.

• Coordinate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Garment Technologists, Buying, and Merchandising teams to develop fit-for-purpose ranges that meet rigorous performance standards while hitting critical path deadlines.

• Translate Global Trends: Continually research and communicate emerging global trends in Childrenswear silhouettes, fabric technology, trims, and colour, turning trend inspiration into commercial design concepts.

• Deliver Technical Precision: Produce detailed and highly accurate Tech Packs, specifying garment construction, performance fabrics, trims, and fit specifications to provide factories with clear guidelines that minimise errors and maximise efficiency.

What You’ll Bring

To succeed in this role, you’ll need to balance high-level creative flair with a deep, practical understanding of performance apparel and brand guidelines. We are looking for an experienced designer who brings the following strengths to the team:

• Versatile Childrenswear Expertise: You possess an adaptable design "handwriting" that allows you to switch effortlessly between different licensed brand and trend aesthetics, age ranges, and product tiers across the Footwear market.

• Technical Mastery: You are highly proficient in Footwear and have experience within this product area

• Commercial Sharpness: You stay ahead of macro and micro Childrenswear trends, understanding how to design silhouettes and apparel ranges that are commercially viable, highly functional, and perfectly aligned with a license partner's DNA.

• Resilience and Agility: You thrive in fast-paced design environments, staying organised and positive even when priorities shift. You view fast-moving trends and brand changes as an opportunity to innovate rather than a hurdle.

• Clear Communication: You can present your concepts with confidence and communicate complex technical and brand requirements clearly to both internal stakeholders, brand partners, and global suppliers.

Portfolios

To help us get a feel for your style, please attach a digital portfolio. We’re looking for work that demonstrates a sharp eye for the future of Children’s Footwear and, how these can be commercially viable for Next, and showcases your trend research, garment designs and CAD work within this as well! To help you put your best foot forward, we’ve put together a few top tips on what makes a portfolio stand out to our team.

Please ensure your digital samples are uploaded with your submission, as we are unable to consider applications that do not include a portfolio.

Sponsorship

Candidates wishing to apply who would require sponsorship for this role will be required to meet the Home Office sponsorship requirements. For further information please see: https://www.gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa.

We encourage early applications for our roles, as our recruitment process begins as soon as the role is advertised. If we successfully fill the position, this advert may close earlier than planned.

At NEXT, we believe the best work happens when there are no barriers to collaboration. That’s why we are a Google-powered workspace. From your very first day, you’ll be using the full Google Workspace suite; Docs, Drive, and Meet, to stay connected and move fast. If your previous experience is rooted in other software suites, don’t worry! We’ll point you to a digital Google toolkit the moment you join, packed with handy guides and insider tips to help you transition smoothly and hit the ground running.

#LI-Onsite

Benefits

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

• Profit-related bonus - based on company performance

• Management share options

• Company car or car allowance

• Private medical insurance

• Sharesave scheme - make savings from your net pay to buy NEXT shares at a discount

• Pension - fixed contribution rates from both an employer and employee perspective, but you're also able to make additional voluntary contributions (AVCs) if you wish to save more.

• Life assurance

• Group income protection

• Wagestream - helping you make the most out of your money

• Salary finance - offers access to affordable loans repaid through salary, simple savings and free financial education.

• 25% staff discount on most NEXT products - plus discount on other products

• Direct to work - NEXT orders delivered free to the office for collection

• VIP sale - early access to the NEXT sale

• Access to NEXT staff shops

• Octopus energy - like cycle-to-work, but for electric vehicles

• Free parking (excluding London locations)

• Travel2NEXT - bus services dependent on location

• On site dining facilities (excluding London locations)

• National and local discounts on goods and services - this includes things like discounted cinema tickets

• Wellhub - includes access to discounted gym membership

• Simply health - a healthcare subscription service

• Aviva Digicare Workplace+ healthcare service - 7 Free services including Digital GP appointments and an annual health check.

• Onsite GP - Leicester Head Office

• Onsite Physio - Leicester Head Office

• A range of dedicated 3rd party wellbeing partners

• Free eye testing - voucher to use at specific locations

Conditions apply to all benefits. These benefits are discretionary and subject to change.

We aim to support all candidates during the application process and are happy to provide workplace adjustments when necessary. Should you need support with your application due to a disability or long-term condition, feel free to get in touch with us by email [email protected] (please include 'Workplace Adjustments' in the subject line), or call us on 0116 284 2486 and leave a voicemail.

title: Footwear Designer (m/f/d)
description:
Footwear Designer (m/f/d)

Germany / Bayreuth

CYBEX is a company that puts tomorrow’s people at the heart of its brand. Always questioning the status quo and not afraid of challenging the establishment, CYBEX has become not just a leader in child safety but is seen as an innovative lifestyle and fashion brand for parents. We offer car seats, baby carriers, kids furniture and strollers enabling parents to keep their little ones safe in style. After growing rapidly in the last few years, we look for ambitious talent to contribute to CYBEX’s success story.

Your seat to fill:

• Develop brand-aligned footwear concepts and seasonal design proposals, from research, moodboards, and initial sketches to detailed designs.

• Create distinctive silhouettes, proportions, colorways, and signature details, translating fashion, lifestyle, and sneaker trends into relevant, wearable designs for the target consumer.

• Create precise design drawings and tech packs covering materials, components, colors, and details, and align technical specifications with Development.

• Collaborate with Product Management, Development, Innovation, Sourcing, Quality, suppliers, and factories to balance design ambition, technical feasibility, cost, and commercial objectives.

• Support sample and prototype development, providing design input during technical reviews, fittings, wear tests, and sample approvals.

• Integrate ergonomics, comfort, freedom of movement, durability, safety, and ease of use from the initial design stage, with particular consideration for growing feet and age-appropriate design.

• Develop compelling color and material concepts, selecting suitable uppers, soles, closures, and finishes while considering lasts, patterns, tooling, and manufacturing requirements.

• Maintain a consistent design language across the collection, identify feasible solutions without compromising design intent, and ensure timely execution through production readiness.

Your stroll to CYBEX:

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Footwear Design, Product Design, Fashion Design, or a related field with a focus on footwear.

• Several years of professional footwear design experience; experience with children’s, lifestyle, or sneaker collections is an advantage.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating aesthetic quality, fashion awareness, and technical design capability, ideally from concept through to finished product.

• Strong eye for silhouettes, proportions, colors, materials, and details, with the ability to translate trends into a distinctive, brand-relevant design language.

• Sound knowledge of footwear construction, lasts, patterns, soles, components, materials, manufacturing processes, fit, and comfort; knowledge of children’s foot ergonomics and product safety is an advantage.

• Proficiency in sketching, technical drawings, tech packs, Adobe Illustrator, and Photoshop; 3D design skills are an advantage.

• Experience working with Development, suppliers, and factories, with the ability to turn creative ideas into technically feasible and commercially viable products.

• Creative, independent, and structured working style with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects within seasonal timelines.

• Strong communication and presentation skills; very good English and willingness to travel internationally.

CYBEX operates globally and has employees from copious nations. If you are keen to leave your footprint in a swiftly growing business that offers plenty of opportunities to grow both on a professional and individual level, you’ve come to the right place. You’ll have the chance to develop your personal profile in an international environment. As part of Goodbaby International Holdings Ltd., CYBEX is dedicated to creating an inclusive working environment that encompasses diversity and equal opportunities. At CYBEX, we place great importance on our values: Imagination, Belief, Passion, Strength, Respect, and Love. These values shape our company culture and drive us to develop innovative solutions and achieve exceptional results.

title: Intern - Color & Material Design
description:
In Short:

Whether you aim to launch your career or gain practical experience in a new domain, interning at On offers exceptional growth opportunities, immediate impact, and a direct contribution to our global expansion. We seek inquisitive minds and energetic individuals ready to drive meaningful change. Our six-month internship programs fully integrate you within a dedicated team environment.

Program Details:

- Start date: March 1st

- Program length: 6 months

- Requirements: Valid work authorization for Switzerland (or EU/EFTA citizenship)

- Compensation: Fully paid internship position

- Eligibility note: Meeting these basic criteria (start date, program length availability, work authorization) is essential for consideration. Please ensure complete accuracy in your responses, as our talent team deeply values transparency.

- Application period: Due to the expected high volume of applications, the role will be open for a limited time. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We recommend watching the recording of our careerfairy livestream for our previous cohort in September to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process!

Your Mission

Global Core Expectations:

• End-to-End Project Ownership: Take direct accountability for assigned operational workflows and sub-projects, driving tasks from initial onboarding through to measurable business impact over your 6-month tenure.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with mentors, cross-functional peers, and regional stakeholders across EMEA to align on shared milestones and execute business priorities.

• Process Optimization & Standards: Assist with daily team operations, streamline routines, and optimize internal documentation to maintain premium execution standards.

• Strategic Deliverables & Insights: Present project learnings, campaign outcomes, or analytical findings to team leadership using structured storytelling and clear data insights.

Role-Specific Deliverables:

• Support the Color & Material Design team across multiple footwear categories, dynamically flexing across different performance and lifestyle verticals according to seasonal needs.

• Take full ownership of assigned design projects, driving them end-to-end from initial concept and mood boarding through to final milestone deliverables.

• Create accurate, detailed color CADs, material maps, and specification packages to guide development and sampling.

• Assist in developing mood boards, trend research decks, and seasonal color palettes that elevate On’s product narratives.

• Produce high-quality 2D/3D visual and digital assets by leveraging the Adobe Creative Suite, 3D visualization software, and AI design tools.

• Manage day-to-day material and color library operations, physical swatch organization, and digital documentation with rigorous attention to detail.

• Translate conceptual color and material stories into clear, impactful presentation decks for key internal design reviews and cross-functional milestone meetings.

• Lead a self-directed, mutually agreed-upon personal design project, exploring an end-to-end footwear Color & Material concept from creative research to final execution.

Your Story

Global Core Qualifications:

• Ownership & Growth Mindset: Highly self-motivated with a proactive, entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable taking initiative, navigating ambiguity, and driving solutions independently across a 6-month commitment.

• Structured Execution & Organization: Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and follow through on structured processes.

• Effective Communication & Authentic Connection: Clear verbal and written communication skills in English, with confidence to interact, share updates, and collaborate with diverse stakeholders across levels.

Role-Specific Requirements & Nice-to-Haves:

• Educational background or degree/certification in Color & Material Design (CMD), Textile Design, Fashion Design, Industrial/Product Design, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• A trained eye for color harmony, surface textures, finishes, and tactile material qualities, combined with an understanding of global culture, fashion, and performance sportswear trends.

• Solid working proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign); familiarity with AI visualization tools is a strong plus.

• Highly adaptable and curious, excited to work cross-functionally across multiple product verticals rather than being confined to a single silo.

• Strong organizational skills to maintain physical swatch libraries, track lab dips/samples, and curate clear palette specifications.

• Passion for human movement, performance footwear/apparel, and circular/sustainable material innovation.

Your Team

The Footwear Color & Material Design (CMD) team defines the aesthetic, tactile, and visual identity of On’s footwear across both performance and lifestyle categories. We turn seasonal narratives, material innovation, and color theory into tangible product expressions—translating abstract concepts into technical CADs, material maps, and sample-ready specifications.

Our team fosters an environment where continuous learning, mutual trust, and holistic well-being are championed. We believe in empowering every team member—including our interns—to take full ownership of their projects, challenge the status quo, and build their best work.

What We Offer

Ready to gear up and move with us? You’ll hit the ground running with an onboarding voucher and exclusive On product store credits to gear up in the latest apparel, accessories, and footwear. Because being off is just as important as being on so we cultivate a space where you can rest, recharge and thrive holistically. You will be supported through full access to mental wellbeing counselling and coaching via Kyan Health as well as dedicated internship learning sessions and workshops to supercharge your growth. We also make sure you’re fully protected and supported for the future with comprehensive accident, disability, and income protection coverage.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination. Start date contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

title: Product Design Industry Placement 2027
description:
Industrial Design

Full time

12 Months

South London studio

We are offering a paid Product Design Industry Placement in our South London studio for a student undertaking a placement year as part of their degree. You will work with the Seymourpowell design team across disciplines including Industrial Design, Transport, Digital and Product Experience.

About us

We are a design and innovation consultancy working across product, transport and experience design. We collaborate with organisations of all scales, from emerging ventures to global brands, helping them translate complex ideas into clear, meaningful solutions. Our work spans the full design process, from early insight through to concept development and delivery. We place a strong emphasis on clarity of thinking, creativity and impact.

What to expect

As a placement designer, you will work across all stages of the design process, from early research and insight development through to concept generation, prototyping and communication. You will be involved in a variety of projects across product, transport and experience design, contributing to both individual and team based work.

You will collaborate closely with designers from different disciplines, supporting the development of ideas and helping bring them to life through sketching, visualisation, CAD and storytelling. You will also gain exposure to how projects are structured and delivered within a studio environment, working alongside senior designers and creative leads.

Alongside project work, you will be part of the day to day life of the studio, contributing to the team, sharing ideas and learning through hands on experience. This placement is an opportunity to develop your skills, build confidence and gain a deeper understanding of design in practice.

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who demonstrates clear thinking, curiosity and a strong point of view. You do not need to have everything figured out, but you should be able to communicate your ideas with clarity and intent.

You should show an ability to identify meaningful opportunities, simplify complexity and respond with thoughtful, well considered solutions. We value strong concepts over polished visuals, and we are particularly interested in how you approach a problem and structure your thinking.

A positive and proactive attitude is important, along with a willingness to learn, contribute and collaborate as part of a team. You should be comfortable working independently when needed, while remaining open to feedback and new perspectives.

A strong portfolio is important and will be a key part of how we assess your application. As well as demonstrating a good foundation in core industrial design skills, we are also looking to see a strong focus on process, design thinking, and ultimately how you make design decisions. This is an opportunity to give us insight into who you are as a designer.

Requirements

You must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application.

You should be currently in your second year of an industrial design or related degree and looking to undertake a placement year as part of your studies.

You must be able to travel to and attend our South London studio five days a week for the duration of the placement.

Core knowledge and skills

You should demonstrate a solid foundation in design, including sketching, 3D CAD, rendering and 2D presentation skills. An understanding of prototyping, materials and manufacturing, as well as CMF, will be important in supporting your ideas through development.

Tools and software

You should be comfortable using key design tools such as SolidWorks, KeyShot and the Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator. Experience with 3D printing software and basic prototyping tools is also beneficial.

How to apply

Please apply using our online application form here. You will be asked to share your CV and your portfolio in PDF format.

If you have any questions, please contact [email protected]

title: Senior Industrial Designer (all genders)
description:
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Industrial Designer to join our Munich studio and help shape the next generation of intelligent physical experiences. Combining exceptional craft, strategic thinking, and human-centered design, you will create products, interactions, and connected experiences that bridge the physical, digital, and intelligent worlds.

You will work across a diverse portfolio of global clients and categories, helping organizations transform products into meaningful experience platforms through physical design, interaction principles, ecosystem thinking, and emerging technologies.

• Strong facilitation, presentation, and client communication skills.

• Ability to thrive in ambiguity and collaborate across disciplines.

• Fluency in English; German is a plus.

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset.

Bonus Points For…

• Experience with intelligent products, connected ecosystems, or product-service experiences.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools, generative workflows and emerging technologies.

• Experience with rapid prototyping, connected prototypes, and experience validation.

• Experience defining product behaviors, HMI concepts, or embedded UX.

title: Senior Designer (Maternity Cover)
description:
Are you an experienced product designer with a strong understanding of furniture, materials and manufacturing, and a passion for creating thoughtful products that balance form, texture and function?

We’re looking for a full-time Senior Designer – Maternity Cover to join our in-house design studio in Copenhagen. With a particular focus on the furniture category, you’ll lead product projects from early concept through to final production, while also supporting the wider team and cross-functional coordination.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong creative and technical ability with the experience to manage complexity and support wider team goals.

The Role

As Senior Designer, you will take ownership of product projects across our collections, with a particular focus on furniture, balancing creative ambition with feasibility, quality, cost and timelines.

You will also take responsibility for selected cross-functional processes and studio activities, working closely with the Head of Brand & Design, Category Management and wider teams to strengthen alignment, structure and delivery across the design function.

Alongside independently leading product projects, the role carries broader responsibility within the studio, including helping coordinate junior designer workloads and improve shared processes and studio coordination.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead furniture and other hard-goods projects from initial brief and concept through development, sampling and final production.

• Manage complex cross-functional design processes, working across Category Management, Product Development, Brand, Marketing and E-commerce to maintain alignment and momentum.

What we’re looking for

• Excellent creative judgement across form, proportion, materiality, colour, construction and detail.

• Advanced technical design capability, including 2D drawing (Adobe), 3D modelling (Rhino), rendering (Keyshot) and a strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing.

• Proven experience taking products from concept through development and production, working directly with suppliers and product-development teams.

• Strong organisational and project-management skills, with confidence managing multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders.

Preferred Experience
