title: Product Developer – Lighting
description:
Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

Are you passionate about contemporary design and bringing innovative lighting products to life? Do you have a technical background and experience developing products from concept to production? And would you like to join a creative and international team in the heart of Copenhagen?

If yes, please read on!

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modelling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at [email protected] or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at [email protected].

Who We Hire?

Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. HAY is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.

MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at [email protected].

title: Internship Product Development, Kvadrat, Ebeltoft
description:
Are you studying textile design, design, textile engineering, or a related field? And are you curious about how textiles are developed from an initial idea into a finished product?

Kvadrat Product Development is looking for an intern to join our team in Ebeltoft from January for a minimum of five months.

As part of our team, you will get close to the development of Kvadrat textiles and gain hands-on experience with the creative, technical, and practical processes involved in bringing a textile from idea to commercial launch.

About the internship

Product Development works at the intersection of design, materials, colour, technical development, and commercial requirements. From Ebeltoft, our team drives and coordinates the development process in close collaboration with designers, textile engineers, suppliers, and colleagues across Kvadrat.

As an intern, you will work closely with the Product Development team, with a particular focus on curtains. You will not just observe the development process – you will take part in it, working hands-on with materials, colours, samples, testing, and ongoing development projects.

What you will work with

Your tasks will vary depending on ongoing projects and where they are in the development process. They may include:

Textile and colour development

• Supporting ongoing curtain developments

• Working with colour blankets, lab dips, development samples, and warp setting cards

• Preparing and organising textile and colour samples

Product development and testing

• Preparing materials for testing and evaluation

• Supporting different stages of the development process

• Working with textile performance and product requirements

Collection and product information

• Supporting collection mapping and product overviews

• Updating digital development overviews

• Contributing to naming processes and product information

Research and communication

• Conducting research and market analysis

• Preparing presentations, colour cards, samples, and other development material for internal teams and sales

What you will learn

Through a hands-on approach, you will gain insight into professional textile development and build your understanding of:

• The textile development process – from initial idea and sampling to commercial launch

• Textile materials, construction, colour, performance, and product requirements

• Curtains as a product category and the relationship between design and technical development

• How quality and sustainability are considered throughout the development process

• The balance between creative exploration and the structure and attention to detail required to bring a product to market

Who we are looking for

You are currently studying textile design, design, textile engineering, or a related field and have a strong interest in textiles, materials, and colour.

You enjoy working hands-on and appreciate both the creative side of development and the detailed, systematic work needed to turn ideas into finished products.

You are collaborative, organised, and detail-oriented, take responsibility for your tasks, and are comfortable working across different projects. You communicate confidently in written and spoken English.

Most importantly, you are curious, open to learning, and interested in becoming part of a collaborative design and development environment.

Interested?

title: Product / Industrial Designer – E-bikes (Sparta)
description:
About the Role

Sparta, the Dutch bicycle brand founded in 1917, is entering a new chapter with TENWAYS. We are looking for an experienced Product / Industrial Designer based in Amsterdam to own the exterior design of urban and commuter e-bikes, helping define a clean, modern and recognisable look that respects Sparta’s heritage. You will bring deep knowledge of European riders and the European market, and work closely with our product development center to turn that insight into well-resolved, manufacturable designs.

What You'll Do

• Lead the overall styling, proportion and stance, line and surface, and detail definition for the Sparta city commuter lineup, developing reusable family design features (frame silhouettes, joint treatments, lamp/reflector integration, “clean look” of cable routing).

• Own the exterior design of selected components: displays, lamps, fenders, racks, guards, charging port covers, etc.

• Ensure appearance consistency and brand recognition; establish design specifications.

• Bring European user insight (consumption habits, market demand) into the design direction.

• Build and maintain Sparta’s CMF strategy: color system, surface finishes and decal/branding system.

• Establish CMF standards (color chips, texture, gloss, etc.).

• Own the design process from concept, sketch, 3D and rendering to prototype, managing key milestones (concept freeze, Class-A surface freeze).

• Work with the product development center’s structural and electronics teams on packaging, cable routing, waterproofing, heat dissipation, tolerances and serviceability.

• Drive assembly consistency and tactile details (parting lines, chamfers, button feel).

• Organize design reviews and define “hold design points” and “acceptable compromises.”

• Participate in sample reviews and ensure design intent is realized.

• Coordinate with regulatory teams to ensure compliance in EU / UK (lamps, reflectors, markings, racks).

• Maintain design standards, deliverables lists and version management for cross-timezone collaboration.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Industrial Design, Transportation Design, Product Design or a related field.

• 5+ years of industrial design experience; 2+ products delivered to mass production.

• Experience in e-bikes, bicycles, two-wheelers or consumer hardware; solid understanding of frames, assembly, tolerances and surface finishing.

• Strong knowledge of EU user consumption habits and market demand.

• Strong aesthetic and form-giving skills; able to express the “clean, restrained, timeless” commuter aesthetic.

• Strong communication skills; able to hold key design points within engineering, cost and schedule constraints.

• Willingness to travel regularly to China.

Why Join Us:

Sparta has been on Dutch streets since 1917. Now it is starting a new chapter, and you would be one of the people who decides what it looks like.

• Real ownership: You own the exterior design of the Sparta lineup, from the first sketch to the final surface.

• A brand with heritage and a blank page: Respect 100+ years of Dutch cycling history while defining what comes next.

• Global reach: Work directly with the TENWAYS product development center in China, with regular trips to see your designs come to life.

• A multicultural team: Design and engineering colleagues across Europe and China, with different perspectives and a shared goal.

How To Apply

Interested? Send us your CV and portfolio through LinkedIn, or message me directly at [email protected]. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Jr. - Mid. Industrial/Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:

title: Industrial Design Internship

title: R&D & Design Engineer Intern
description:

We design, develop, and distribute high-quality hearing protection products that allow people to enjoy life safely.

title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

•

• Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship.

•

• Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved.

•

• Integrate complex systems:Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended.

•

• Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next.

•

• Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging.

•

• From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly.

•

• Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs.

Requirements

•

• Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half.

•

• Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people.

•

• Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be.

•

• Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic.

•

• Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models.

•

• Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters.

•

• Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement.

Benefits

•

• Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers.

•

• Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket.

•

• Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known.

•

• Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

How to Apply

Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production: what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer.

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: Internship – Creative Technologist
description:
Design

Internship / Global Electrolux Talent (GET)

Job Description

This internship is open to active students enrolled in a related Bachelor’s or Master’s program at a Swedish or European university, who will remain students throughout the entire internship period and are expected to graduate in December 2027 or later.

Start date 1 February 2027 – duration 6 months – full time.

If you want to help build the home of the future, start your career with us. At Electrolux Group, our vision is to be the home appliance industry leader in consumer satisfaction by delivering outstanding lifetime experiences with solutions that always get better. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver more enjoyable and sustainable living.

About The Role

Creative Technology team sits within the design organization, combining disciplines of design, development, and engineering. We build internal tools that speed up the design workflow, build exploratory vision prototypes that explore novel product ideas and interaction modalities, and bridge the gap between design, development, and engineering.

As an intern in the Creative Technology team, you would help:

• Create prototypes at different levels of fidelity, from quick experiments to robust demonstrators.

• Explore how emerging technologies can create meaningful experiences in the home.

• Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams.

• Contribute to a culture of experimentation, knowledge-sharing, and constructive critique.

• Bridge the physical and digital world through software and electronics, working on both physical appliances and connected digital experiences.

What You'll Work On

• Assist designers in preparing prototypes for user testing of current products.

• Translate design questions and hypotheses into appropriate prototypes and experiments, selecting the right fidelity, tools, and technical approach for each prototype.

• Contribute to the conceptualization and prototyping of vision prototypes for innovation design initiatives.

• Test, debug, and refine prototypes based on feedback from designers, engineers, and users.

• Contribute to the organization and maintenance of the prototyping lab.

• Gain exposure to and contribute across the design process, from research to prototyping and communication of findings.

Combination with Thesis Project

We offer the possibility of hosting a Bachelor or Master thesis project. The topic should be developed in alignment with the people leader of the position and relevant for the Electrolux Group.

• Deep dive into one topic and investigate a jointly defined research question through design research and prototyping, producing both an academic thesis and a tangible prototype or demonstrator. The scope will be agreed with the student, university, and Electrolux supervisors.

What You'll Learn

• How to collaborate on design initiatives across industrial design, interaction design, research, software, and engineering.

• How to determine what a prototype needs to prove and choose an appropriate level of fidelity.

• Hands-on experience in rapid prototyping and idea conceptualization, and strengthening prototyping skills, including but not limited to working with electronics, software development, 3D modelling, and 3D printing.

• Soft skills in project planning, structuring ambiguous work, and communication of ideas.

• How to communicate technical opportunities and limitations to non-technical collaborators.

• How to turn ambiguous opportunities into testable design hypotheses

Who You Are

We are looking for a student who combines structured thinking with genuine curiosity about organizations;

• Currently enrolled in a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s program in the field of HCI / Industrial Design Engineering / Product Design and eligible to undertake a six-month internship or thesis project.

• Interested in using technology as a material for design exploration.

• Curiosity for design craft (interaction, visual, industrial), technology, and emerging trends.

• Able to move from an ambiguous question to a tangible experiment or prototype.

• Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools and technologies when a project requires it.

• Able to communicate ideas, decisions, and limitations clearly through prototypes, visuals, and conversation.

• Structured, dependable, and comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

• Fluent in spoken and written English.

• With a portfolio demonstrating how you explore ideas and solve problems through prototypes, experiments, or technical projects - (At least one example showing your process, including the question, iterations, challenges, and what you learned – not only the final result. Projects may come from coursework, personal experimentation, hackathons, employment, or collaborative work.)

Bonus criteria:

• Experience with one or more prototyping technologies, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, creative coding, PCB design, Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, sensors, actuators, computer vision, or connected devices

• Experience with CAD, 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics assembly, or other fabrication methods

• Familiarity with Figma or other interaction and visual design tools

• Experience preparing prototypes for user research or public demonstrations

• Interest in emerging interaction modalities such as voice, gesture, spatial interfaces, AI-enabled experiences, or tangible interaction

• Experience documenting projects through photography, video, diagrams, or written case studies

Where you´ll be

You will be based at our modern global Headquarters in Stockholm, with 1,200+ colleagues on site. We work in a hybrid setup that gives everyone up to 20% flexibility to work remotely, while boosting creativity and collaboration through regular office presence. The work contract is full-time and limited to 6 months, with monthly compensation of 21,000 SEK for Bachelor students and 22,000 SEK for Master students.

Please note that Electrolux Group does not provide visa sponsorship for internships. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Sweden for the full duration of the internship at the time of application. This may include, for example, EU/EEA citizenship, Swedish permanent residence, or a valid Swedish residence and work permit that does not require employer sponsorship.

Learn more and apply at: career.electroluxgroup.com

title: Eyewear Designer (m/f/d)
description:
What if eyewear could be lighter, smarter, more expressive — and simply better designed?

At Silhouette Group, we believe great eyewear starts with a strong idea. Our three brands — Silhouette, evil eye and neubau — explore different ways of shaping the future of eyewear.

We are looking for a curious, creative and ambitious Eyewear Designer to join our international design team in our Headquarter in Linz.

Your Tasks

• Explore. Track emerging trends in fashion, design, materials, technology and culture — and turn insights into relevant design directions.

• Create. Develop concepts, moodboards, sketches and 2D/3D designs from the first idea to a tangible product.

• Shape. Work closely with Color Design, R&D, prototyping and construction to transform creative ideas into feasible, high-quality eyewear.

• Communicate. Tell the story behind your designs and inspire colleagues, marketing, sales and opticians.

• Contribute. Become part of the development of future collections across our three distinctive brands.

Your Profile

• A degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field

• A strong portfolio demonstrating original thinking, conceptual strength, sensitivity to form and attention to detail

• The ability to develop ideas from concept and sketch through 2D/3D design to the physical product

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and 3D design tools such as Rhino, SolidWorks or equivalent

• A strong understanding of form, proportion, materials and manufacturing processes

• Genuine curiosity for new materials, technologies and production methods

• The confidence to question conventional approaches, explore new ideas and develop your own design point of view

• An independent, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering and manufacturing teams

• Experience in eyewear, product or industrial design is an advantage – but exceptional potential and a strong portfolio matter just as much

For this full-time position, we offer a minimum gross yearly salary of EUR 60,962.30 in accordance with the Austrian Collective Agreement for the Metal Industry. Depending on your qualifications and professional experience, we are happy to offer a higher salary.

At Silhouette, your ideas have the opportunity to become reality – from the first sketch to prototype and, ultimately, to a finished collection. With three brands and distinct design worlds, you will find a broad playground for creativity, ranging from precision and lightness to performance and contemporary expression.

Design and technology go hand in hand. You will work closely with experts from R&D, prototyping and production, gaining first-hand insight into how exceptional eyewear is developed and manufactured.

We offer an international and dynamic working environment with room to take ownership, contribute your ideas and grow both professionally and personally. Depending on your preferred location, the position can be based in Linz or Vienna, with flexible hybrid and home-office options.

Beyond the role itself, you can look forward to a range of benefits, including team events, fitness offers, professional and personal development opportunities, a subsidized healthy company restaurant, modern office spaces and a unique global company culture.

Ready to shape the future of eyewear with us?

Upload your application and portfolio via our online career portal at silhouette-international.com/karriere.

For any questions, please feel free to contact Katrin Kappelmüller at +43 732 3848-843.

title: Concept Model Exploration Internship
description:
Job Description

Concept Model Exploration Internship:

Are You an Aspiring Concept Model Builder Looking to Discover New Play?

Join the LEGO® Group’s Play Discovery team within the Creative Play Lab for a Paid Internship at our Head Quarters in Billund, Denmark!

Are you driven by an unquenchable passion for discovering new play opportunities through early-stage ideation, concept development, and prototyping? If so, you could be one of the talented students joining the Concept Model Exploration Team in our Play Discovery department this year, where sketch-building and concept exploration through bricks is your day-to-day!

Start date: February 2027

Length: 5 months (until end of June 2027) with possibilities for summer extension

About us:

Creative Play Lab is an ambitious, future‑focused innovation hub inventing radical new play opportunities and never‑seen‑before experiences for LEGO® fans of today and tomorrow. We grow the boundaries of what play can become, using bold experimentation, advanced technologies, and deep insight into how kids play to imagine meaningful, next‑generation experiences. Our mix of creatives, innovators, researchers, engineers, and technologists rapidly transforms curiosity into tangible concepts, redefining the future of play and ensuring LEGO® play remains at the forefront of creativity and joyful exploration.

As an intern in our Concept Model Exploration Team within the Play Discovery department, you’ll join colleagues dedicated to letting loose their creative curiosity and exploring new play experiences. You’ll unleash your imagination across a range of innovation missions, collaborating cross-functionally to develop concepts into playable prototypes.

About our Internships:

In Creative Play Lab, we look for interns who bring something genuinely different to our innovation hub, adding fresh cultural insight, creative energy, and new ways of thinking. Your time with us will span personal curiosity projects, team capability-building initiatives, and innovation Missions. Every day is different and you’ll learn directly from a world‑class multidisciplinary team as you build your craft, embracing ambiguity as you discover new play experiences.

Meet the Concept Model Building Exploration team:

The Concept Model Exploration team works in Play Discovery to help turn the teams’ ideas into brick-built prototypes. They work with existing LEGO® elements (classic, technic and DUPLO) to create concept models to demonstrate the minimum viable play of an idea. They work with other skilled inventors of different disciplines to integrate their innovative new digital and physical inventions into LEGO® model form to explore the future play potential of interactive LEGO® models. They leverage their expertise in structural, mechanical and play design to create amazing proof-of-concepts big and small and really bring ideas to life in brick form.

Internship Eligibility:

To qualify for this internship opportunity, you must meet all of the following criteria:

(1) You are over the age of 18

(2) You will be enrolled in higher education as a ‘student’ for the full duration of the internship period

(3) You are currently due to graduate at some point after the end of the internship period

(4) You will not be requesting a delayed graduation date just to qualify for this internship

(5) This internship will contribute quantitatively towards your course credit

(6) This internship is a compulsory part of your education

(7) You are available to undertake this internship contract starting from the stated start date

(8) You are available to work full time for the full period up until the stated end date

(9) You are able to work on site in Billund, Denmark for this period

We also encourage interns to have experience with at least some of the following:

• LEGO® Model Building

• Architectural prototyping

• Sketching

• Sculpture

• 3D CAD programs

• Graphic Design

• Textiles

• Electronics

• Painting

• Woodwork

• 3D printing

• Machine Workshop tools e.g. lathe, drills etc.

• Videography / Editing

What we’re looking for:

Curiosity: Our teams thrive on a playful curiosity in all they do. You need to be always asking questions, seeking the reason “why”, digging for answers even when it’s hard and never stop wondering “what if...”

Bravery: Our organisation is a huge place full of different people and different perspectives. You need to be comfortable meeting new people every day, speaking up when you disagree, receiving feedback, facing the unknowns of innovation head on and forging yourself a path when things aren’t well defined.

Focus: Our workload and priorities are always changing. You need to be happy shifting priorities fast, focusing on a high priority task one week then focusing on developing your own independent curiosities the next.

Vision: Our concepts require a strong vision. You need to thrive in co-creating that vision for future LEGO® models in partnership with the multidisciplinary innovation teams around you.

Responsibilities:

We want you to bring all your energy, enthusiasm and experiences to work every day so we can achieve amazing things together while you learn along the way. Some of your typical responsibilities could include...

• Exploring the different directions a concept model could take

• Leveraging your structural, mechanical and play expertise in your builds

• Co-creating with a multidisciplinary team

• Supporting the wider team in prototyping functions and mechanisms in concept models

• Conceptualising models for both children and adult audiences

Perks:

• Work with a passionate multi-disciplinary team of like-minded creative inventors where you’ll learn something new every day and build your professional network

• Live and work in the global headquarters of the LEGO® Group in Billund, Denmark and explore our state-of-the-art campus

• Be an active co-creator with kids – they know how to make fun and meaningful play.

Application:

We welcome international applications for this role however you must be able to live and work in Billund, Denmark for the duration of the internship itself.

We have many internships available in Creative Play Lab, each supporting a different team with their own focus area. Take a moment to review all these opportunities and apply only to those that truly align with your strengths. If you have broad skills, applying to more than one team is acceptable but applying to a large number of teams doesn’t increase your chances of making a successful application and makes it harder for us to understand where you’d shine so please be thoughtful in your approach.

Please ensure your application is completed in English.

To apply, simply submit the following by Friday 9th October 2026. Please do not risk missing this deadline as we will not consider late applications for this role.

Please attach the following items to your application as 4 separate .PDF documents. Applications failing to do this shall not be considered.

• An A4 size poster (landscape) designed by you to showcase why you think you are a good fit for the internship. You may use text, photographs, colour etc. to communicate your enthusiasm, talent and values.

• A current CV detailing your education and relevant experiences.

• A full portfolio showcasing a more in-depth range of your work. This should include projects that highlight your interests, reflect your passions and demonstrate your hobbies.

• A bespoke cover letter (no more than 200 words) that tells us what motivates you to apply for this internship and why you think you’re best suited for the placement. If you can do or say something to help your cover letter stand out then please do. We encourage you to be original and authentic to who you are.

Come and join us as we explore different concept model builds!

#CPLInternship #Billund #PlayDiscovery #ConceptModelExploration

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

title: Product Designer (Physical Product)
description:
Dolmen Design are looking for an experienced Mid/Senior Product Designer to join our team to help shape the future for some of the world’s most exciting brands in the fields of FMCG and Med-tech & Life Sciences. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, supportive design process where we continually grow our team\'s ability and ambition at our Dublin studio. This is an exciting opportunity for a designer who is passionate about detail, quality and innovation where you will get to lead projects, shape design direction and inspire clients while honing your creative skills.

The role:

• Bring products through the entire design process from discovery to R&D, to manufacture, guiding clients and influencing decisions & strategy.

• You will get to fulfil your passion as a designer solving complex design challenges with innovative solutions.

• We pride ourselves on building strong relationships with our clients, embedding ourselves into their team where you will get to foster a collaborative spirt, understanding their needs & translating them into effective solutions.

• Story telling is a big part of our process where you will help generate content to inspire internal and external teams.

• Lead collaborative ideation sessions, setting the themes and guiding clients through the process with support from lead designers.

• Get exposure to projects from a diverse client base, managing resources, commercial objectives, costs and aligning project activities with business goals.

• You will get to flex your technical and creative muscles on projects that combine innovative engineering solutions married with aesthetic designs & visualisations that reflect and elevate our clients designs language.

• Lead R&D prototype development and testing schedules and translate these into cost effective manufacturable products.

• Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers to ensure cost targets & design intent are kept during the manufacturing process.

• We want our team to keep the passion that inspired them to become designers by encouraging and supporting self-development to help you grow.

• With help from team leads you will be part of nurturing and mentoring junior members of the team to bring on the next wave of talent.

About Dolmen:

We are an award-winning product design + R&D agency specialising in breakthrough product innovation. We partner with the world’s most ambitious brands to create transformative product portfolio pipelines. For the past 30 years we have been developing patent rich and internationally recognized award-winning products across a range of exciting sectors.

We are based in Dublin, Ireland, one of Europe’s most vibrant and friendliest cities. Our studio is in the leafy suburb of Drumcondra, a short 15min cycle from Dublin city centre, and 15mins by car to the airport. We moved into our purpose built 1500m2 studio 3 years ago with dedicated ideation spaces where we regularly host events for some of the world\'s leading brands. Our 200m2 fully kitted out workshop and labs are where we create, experiment and craft breakthrough innovations. At lunch you’ll find our team of researchers, designers & engineers taking walks in the nearby Botanic gardens, playing spikeball or the more intellectually inclined relaxing with a game of chess! We would love to hear from talented designers to join our growing team.

Skills and Knowledge:

• Sketching: Strong sketching skills to quickly communicate design concepts and ideas, both digitally and by hand, with a high level of creativity and precision.

• Visualisation: ability to create compelling and emotive visuals that communicate the design intent using Adobe CS and Keyshot.

• CAD: Strong CAD capabilities in SolidWorks and/or Creo to rapidly develop complex assemblies with accurate parts which are specified with detailed drawings. An advantage to have working knowledge of simulation tools (FEA, CFD, Moldflow) to optimise parameters.

• Prototyping: Strong hands-on prototyping skills to build and test physical models, ensuring aesthetics, functionality and usability are verified at each project stage.

• DFM: Experience in designing for manufacture (e.g. injection moulding, sheet fabrication, casting) to ensure feasible concepts are developed and design intent is maintained to production.

title: Design Internship - 6 to 10 months (2026)
description:
2026 starting internship - This position is for students available to join in October/November 2026.

Introduction

Are you a curious and creative design student eager to explore new opportunities? Do you have a passion for technology and love collaborating in a diverse, multidisciplinary team? Would you enjoy contributing to a variety of projects across industries such as Healthcare, Industrial, Consumer, Energy, and Defence?

We're looking for designers with a strong understanding of user-centered (or patient-centred) design processes, exceptional 2D graphical presentation skills, proficiency in 3D design and rendering, and excellent verbal communication and visual storytelling abilities.

Successful candidates can join us for between 6-10 months. This position is for students available to join in October/November 2026.

Please submit your application, including a copy of your portfolio before 17:00 Wednesday 23rd September.

 

Your role  

Our designers undertake the development of products and services from concept to manufacture whilst addressing considerable technical and design problems.

You will be involved in activities such as front-end concept generation through creative workshops; graphics and packaging design; digital design, including user interface design; foam prototyping for testing; creating storyboards to communicate ideas; and attending user studies to research user/patient needs and evaluate your designs.

We combine user centred design, innovative mechanical engineering, a rigorous analytical approach to problem solving and a broad base of industry experience to form a powerful development team. Our work ranges from undertaking complete product developments from concept to market, to providing consulting services for our clients on their technology, strategy or development processes.

Some examples of our recent exciting and challenging projects we have worked on include:

Midi: User centred design of a novel 'device plus chemistry' approach to Women's shaving.

Alma: a portable cooling case which gives the patient more social flexibility through their IVF process.

Development of "Pebble", a product which provides drug-free relief from menopausal hot flushes.

Check-out our Behance portfolio for more examples of our work: https://www.behance.net/cambconsultants

What you'll be doing  

This is a fantastic opportunity for a design student with the passion and skills to excel in dynamic industries, where commercial and time challenges are a key part of the process. You'll be applying your design expertise to contribute to development projects, with the support and guidance of our collaborative team, from concept generation to delivery and manufacturing support for market-ready products. This may include:

• Carrying out and presenting user research to multidisciplinary teams

• Participating in and leading concept generation and problem-solving workshops

• Designing graphics and visual communications to improve understanding and engagement

• Preparing designs at a range of fidelities i.e., from analogue sketch to a detailed 3D render

• Manufacturing of prototypes, hands-on or by liaising with suppliers

• Evaluating ideas and prototypes with feedback from users and stakeholders

What you can bring 

A successful design intern will have:

• Demonstrate an excellent academic record, studying for a relevant Industrial Design, Product Design or relevant degree

• Confidence and demonstrable experience with a range of graphical presentation tools e.g. Creative Cloud, hand sketching, 3D rendering

• Evidence of the ability to use CAD tools to design attractive, functional and manufacturable designs

• An understanding of human/user centred design processes

• Excellent storytelling/ idea communication skills

• Evidence of having been flexible when working with other disciplines

• Practical experience in UI/UX design is advantageous.

Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules.

Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity.

We can only accept applications that include a portfolio.

By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

title: CMF Technical Designer
location: San Giovanni Valdarno - Arezzo, Tuscany, Italy
description:
ABB E‑mobility is shaping the future of electric mobility with innovative EV charging solutions that deliver seamless, user‑centered experiences. With a strong R&D pipeline and a truly global reach, we are actively enabling the transition to cleaner and more sustainable mobility, fully aligned with our Mission to Zero initiative.

We are looking for a CMF Technical Designer to support our design organization and help translate creative CMF concepts into robust, high‑quality, production‑ready solutions. In this role, you will work closely with the CMF Lead and cross‑functional teams, ensuring consistency, feasibility, and excellence across materials, colors, and finishes.

Are you a technically minded, detail‑driven professional with a passion for CMF quality? Do you enjoy tackling appearance‑related challenges and supporting the journey from concept to industrialized product? If the answer is yes, we encourage you to apply!

Your Responsibilities

• Organize and maintain color masters, CMF documentation, and the material library

• Define, update, and manage CMF specifications, guidelines, and digital documentation, ensuring clear communication to all stakeholders

• Support CMF feasibility assessments and assist with production rollout

• Champion CMF perceived quality, collaborating with suppliers and engineering teams to resolve appearance‑related challenges

• Support the development and implementation of CMF quality standards for products and components

• Facilitate prototype development, appearance evaluations, and CMF matching processes

• Contribute to material research and next‑generation product development with a strong technical and innovative mindset

Your Background

• Degree or equivalent experience in Design, Design Engineering (materials focus), Material Engineering, or Quality Management

• Minimum 2 years of experience in a manufacturing environment or material supplier

• (automotive, consumer electronics, metals, plastics, or coatings are a plus)

• Strong understanding of production feasibility (metal, plastic, coatings, surface treatments, etc.)

• Experience in quality management, perceived quality, technical CMF mastering, or similar fields

• Proven experience in technical CMF delivery; a portfolio is a plus

• Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and/or Figma is an advantage

• Strong problem‑solving, communication (visual, verbal, written), organizational, and prioritization skills

• Proactive and collaborative mindset, comfortable working cross‑functionally with design, engineering, suppliers, and quality teams

• Impeccable color vision

What’s in it for you?

Work with the best specialists in their field, in a diverse environment with unparalleled global reach. Feel inspired by our fast growth. You will have the accountability to own your part in enabling a future of sustainable and efficient mobility. You can also count on a competitive compensation package in line with your capabilities and experience. Diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are at the core of what we do. We celebrate different experiences and perspectives, and we aim to empower everyone in the creation of sustainable solutions for people all over the world. Our individual differences make us successful.

Compensation Package

The employment framework is based on the National Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) for the Metalworking Industry, with an indicative level of C3/B2 and a minimum gross annual salary starting from € 31.000,00. The specific level and compensation package will be defined based on the outcome of the selection process (including experience, skills set, and role fit), in accordance with objective, transparent, and gender-neutral criteria, in line with pay equity and equal opportunity principles. The total compensation package will also include a variable bonus linked to individual and company targets.

About ABB E-Mobility

ABB E-mobility is a world leader in EV charging technology and a partner of choice for the world’s biggest electric vehicle OEMs and nationwide EV charging network operators. With a strong R&D pipeline, our robust product portfolio of innovative holistic solutions – from grid to charge point and domestic installations to large fleet depots – means we are actively enabling the future of E-Mobility, not just predicting it.

title: Transport Designer
description:
The Opportunity

About tangerine

tangerine is an award-winning strategic design consultancy that helps organisations take bigger leaps forward through design. Since 1989, we have partnered with ambitious global brands to create innovative products, services and customer experiences that exceed expectations and deliver meaningful commercial impact.

Our multidisciplinary team combines insight, strategy, industrial design and customer experience expertise to solve complex challenges through creativity, collaboration and rigorous thinking. We work across a broad range of sectors, helping clients identify opportunities, create meaningful innovations and deliver experiences that create value for both businesses and customers.

From pioneering aviation interiors and future mobility concepts to consumer products and technology innovations, we have helped clients including Apple, British Airways, LG, Huawei and Toyota innovate, grow and lead within their markets.

www.tangerine.net

The Opportunity

We are looking for a talented and ambitious Transport Designer to join our London studio.

This role is ideally suited to designers with 2 to 3 years of professional experience within the aviation, rail, automotive, marine or wider mobility sectors, gained either within a consultancy environment or in-house/client-side design team.

As part of our multidisciplinary design team, you will contribute to projects from discovery and research through to concept development, visualisation and implementation. You will work closely with strategists, researchers, CMF designers, engineers and client teams to create compelling transport and passenger experiences that balance user needs, operational requirements and commercial objectives.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on innovative programmes for leading global brands, shaping the future of mobility, passenger experience and transportation design.

Responsibilities

• Support the delivery of transport design projects from concept through to implementation.

• Generate innovative and user-centred design concepts across aviation, rail, automotive, marine and mobility sectors.

• Develop high-quality sketches, renderings, visualisations and design presentations.

• Create and refine 3D CAD models using industry-standard software.

• Translate research, customer insights and strategic direction into meaningful design solutions.

• Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

• Participate in design reviews, workshops and client presentations.

• Produce compelling storytelling and communication materials.

• Contribute to model-making, prototyping and concept evaluation activities where required.

• Stay informed on emerging trends in transport, mobility, technology and passenger experience.

• Support business development activities and proposal creation where appropriate.

Skills & Experience (Required)

• BA or MA degree in Transport Design, Automotive Design, Industrial Design or a related design discipline.

• Minimum 2 to 3 years of professional design experience within aviation, rail, automotive, marine or mobility sectors, either within a consultancy or client-side organisation.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, design thinking and high-quality design execution.

• Excellent sketching, ideation and visual communication skills.

• Proficiency in 3D CAD software such as Alias, Rhino, SolidWorks or similar.

• Strong visualisation and rendering skills.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.

• Understanding of design development processes and production considerations.

• Ability to communicate ideas clearly and confidently both visually and verbally.

• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Skills & Experience (Desirable)

• Experience designing passenger experiences, vehicle interiors, cabin concepts or transportation products.

• Knowledge of CMF development and specification.

• Experience with Blender, KeyShot or other visualisation tools.

• Awareness of human factors, ergonomics and user-centred design principles.

• Experience participating in client workshops and co-creation sessions.

• Prototyping and model-making experience.

• Familiarity with AI-enabled design workflows.

• Additional language skills.

• Willingness to travel internationally when required.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.

• Professional development and training opportunities.

• Access to industry events, conferences and learning programmes.

• Collaborative, supportive and creative studio culture.

• Regular team events and socials.

• Opportunity to work on globally recognised brands and programmes.

• Modern London studio environment.

Location

This position is based in our London studio.

Hybrid working is available, with team members expected to spend three days of their time in the studio collaborating with colleagues and clients.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. tangerine is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

How to Apply

Please write to [email protected]

Subject: Transport Designer – tangerine

Please include:

• A PDF copy of your CV

• A PDF portfolio showcasing relevant project experience

• A brief email introduction outlining:

• Your relevant experience and past employment

• Experience within aviation, rail, automotive, marine or mobility sectors

• Your proficiency in CAD and visualisation software

• Availability or notice period

• Your salary expectations

• Your right-to-work status in the UK

Failure to include any of the above may result in your application not being considered.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Due to the high volume of applications, we may only be able to respond to shortlisted candidates.

tangerine is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Design Intern
Senior Jewelry Designer - Interim
description:
Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you combine a strong creative vision with exceptional sketching skills and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials and the jewellery design process?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Designer to join our Modern Classics & Diamonds team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, bringing creative expertise and immediate impact to one of Pandora's key jewellery categories.

Create the next generation of Modern Classics & Diamonds

As our Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director and wider design team to develop creative projects from initial concept through design execution and prototype development.

Drawing on your creative vision, technical expertise and understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will help develop compelling, commercially relevant collections that combine timeless elegance with modern expression and inspire customers around the world.

Your Role

Design & Collection Development

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs and sketches aligned with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas supporting the strategic direction of the category.

• Develop mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches and technical drawings to support product development.

• Review CADs and provide clear and comprehensive creative feedback within agreed timelines.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and contribute to formal prototype reviews and creative evaluations.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, inspiration references and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing creative and technical guidance.

• Ensure projects are developed and delivered according to agreed timelines and requirements.

Research & Innovation

• Conduct research based on briefs from Creative Leadership and translate insights into strong creative concepts.

• Participate in research activities and trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials and creative inspiration.

• Contribute ideas for new concepts, innovation opportunities and future category directions.

• Keep design presentations updated with relevant concepts, sketches and final designs throughout project development.

A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery

You combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an instinct for commercially relevant product design. You know how to take an idea from inspiration and early sketches through to a beautifully resolved piece of jewellery.

You understand how to balance innovation with the DNA of an established global brand and are comfortable moving between creative exploration and the technical realities of product development.

As this is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity, we are particularly looking for someone who can quickly become part of the team, confidently take ownership of projects and contribute from day one.

What We're Looking For

• Significant experience designing jewellery within a jewellery, luxury, fashion or accessories brand.

• A strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches and finished products.

• Proven experience taking design projects from concept through CAD and prototype development.

• Strong knowledge of jewellery design, craftsmanship, materials and manufacturing processes.

• Exceptional hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into distinctive and commercially relevant products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills within an international environment.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools, including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

Important

Please include a portfolio as part of your application, showcasing your design work, creative process, sketching and technical capabilities, and examples of collections or products you have helped take from concept to final execution.

Applications without a portfolio may not be considered.

Your New Team

As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery.

You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing and Product Development.

Additional Information

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Did We Get Your Attention?

If you see yourself in this opportunity and would like to contribute to Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

Icing on the Cake

You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.
